novel_info.summary: Along with him, there were four others—they’re the 25th round of lab rats. Rich people are watching them live, placing bets on who dies first and who makes it to the end in this twisted survival game.In the apartment, there’s:- A psycho who likes skinning people to make kites.- A modern-day Jack the Ripper who only targets women.- A highly educated, high-IQ criminal mastermind.- And a chainsaw-wielding maniac with a thirst for blood.The system bound to Jiang Ran keeps screaming alerts:【Ding! Host is detected in an extremely dangerous zone! Run!】【Ding! Dangerous person detected nearby, RUN!】【Ding! Extremely dangerous individual detected nearby! Seriously, RUN!】Jiang Ran scratched his head, totally fed up:“System, you’re talking nonsense again. The neighbors are clearly all super nice and friendly, but you keep throwing dirt on them! You’re the worst!”“And anyway, there’s a gorgeous woman right next to me right now. How could she possibly be ‘extremely dangerous’?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Danger Warning System
chapters.content:
"Please, just let me go! I don't want the money anymore, just let me leave this apartment building! You can even cut off one of my kidneys!!!"
"No way. We signed an agreement. If you want to leave, you have to survive for seven days."
"Seven days? This Alice Apartment is full of all kinds of twisted murderers. Forget seven days, I can’t even last one day!!!"
"I'm really begging you... ahhhhh!!"
"Ahhh... help... save me... I... don't want to die..."
...
"My medicine is about to run out again, almost no money left to buy more..."
In Nancheng City, on the street, Jiang Ran, a rather handsome young man, looked at the plastic pillbox in his hand that contained only a few white pills left and frowned deeply.
He exhaled a breath of stale air toward the clear blue sky, feeling extremely troubled.
He suffered from severe dissociative identity disorder.Several personalities existed inside his body.
Normally, he suppressed them by taking medicine. If he didn’t take medicine for a while, the personalities would compete for control of his body and take turns coming out.
Of course, the dissociative identity disorder wasn’t his biggest problem. The worst was that he wasn’t even from this world!!!
He was an Earthling!
But somehow, his soul had transmigrated into a young man named Jiang Ran in this world called Blue Star.
Soul transmigration happened, and the dissociative identity disorder remained.
And here came the real trouble. Back on Earth, the psychiatric medicine he took was prepared by an old village herbal doctor, effective, cheap, and with almost no side effects.
But after transmigrating to Blue Star, the good medicine was too expensive to afford.
He had to take garbage medicine with poor effects, unstable conditions, and many side effects.
He truly feared the day he couldn’t afford his medicine anymore, his illness would flare up, and all the personalities in his body would break free.
Actually, the personalities coming out wasn’t the main issue. Jiang Ran knew clearly that none of the personalities inside him were harmless; he was really afraid that one day they would drag him down to end up in a free prison term.
[Ding! Warning: Host is in a dangerous area! Points +1! Points +1! Points...]
At this moment, just as Jiang Ran felt his future was pitch black, a cold mechanical voice suddenly echoed in his mind.
This was the Danger Warning System, which bound to Jiang Ran right after he transmigrated.
At first, he was very excited, thinking it was a blessing from heaven.
This life was going to be his path to the pinnacle of success.
But later, he realized this system didn’t seem to be very useful.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Its biggest function was danger warning: when you are in a dangerous area, it would keep adding points to alert you.
This was the first time the system issued a danger warning.
Startled by the reminder in his mind, Jiang Ran, who had been drifting away in thought, immediately snapped back to reality.
He looked around and found himself standing outside a grain pancake shop.
At that moment, a very pleasant female announcer’s voice was playing through the shop’s loudspeaker:
"Wangchuan Grain Pancakes! Celebrating 100 years since opening! To thank our new and old customers and friends who support us!!!! Buy a ten-yuan standard grain pancake now and get a lottery ticket!"
"One lottery ticket equals one chance to draw!"
"The grand prizes are as follows!"
"First prize, one winner: a complete apartment unit in Alice Apartment!"
"Second prize, two winners: a 100,000 yuan Jack car each!"
"Third prize, three winners: a 3,999 yuan Jack electric bike each!"
"Fourth prize:..."
This was a huge, time-honored chain grain pancake shop celebrating its 100th anniversary.
The pancakes were delicious, and the advertising was fierce.
It was both an old brand and a trendy snack, so it already had many customers.
Now with a lottery event going on, the queue stretched even longer.
Among the crowd waiting in line, there were voices like: "Damn, first, second, and third prizes are pretty good! Especially the first and second prizes—that’s a house and a car!!!! I usually only buy one pancake! Later I’ll buy three pancakes and draw three times. God, please let me win at least one!!! Let me make some money!!!"
Voices like these rose one after another.
Of course, there was also a more rational voice, though less frequent.
A middle-aged man standing at the end of the line looked at the unusually large crowd ahead with disdain and said:
"I never see you guys buy anything normally. When there’s a lottery, suddenly everyone’s so eager!"
"A bunch of fools thinking they can win?"
At this moment,
Jiang Ran’s figure stopped completely in front of the pancake shop.
The system in his mind kept reminding him he was in a dangerous area.
But he looked around and didn’t feel anything dangerous.
Especially with so many people here, there seemed to be nothing to fear unless the gas inside exploded.
So he just ignored the stupid system completely.
Besides, his stomach was growling loudly.
He might as well buy a pancake to eat.
As for what if there really was danger?
If he died, he died. Living was already a form of suffering.
Being tormented by dissociative identity disorder was just too painful.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Fan Jin Passed the Exam, I Won the Prize
chapters.content:
At this moment, because there were too many people lining up to buy pancakes ahead, Jiang Ran took out his phone to kill time while waiting.
He played a bit of a match-three game, then looked up and saw the festive advertisement poster in front of him displaying the grand prize: a set of apartments in Alice Apartment.
Jiang Ran had only been transported here for a few days, so he wasn’t very familiar with his current situation, just had a rough understanding.
For example, this new identity—Jiang Ran—was, just like his previous life, an orphan.
After graduating from university, they both had similar fates, becoming laborers.
The only difference was the place where they labored.
In his past life, he worked on a factory assembly line.
This version of him worked at home on the computer as a customer service representative for an online store.
Because he wanted to earn more money, to get higher wages, and to slap back at the ex-girlfriend who dumped him,
he ended up doing several jobs at once, which eventually caused him to die suddenly at home.Sigh, no matter what, health is the foundation of revolution. If your health fails, everything else is just empty talk.
“Found it, Alice Apartment.”
At this moment, Jiang Ran found Alice Apartment in Nancheng City online.
Unlike other customers, he was simply hungry and bought a pancake without expecting to win anything.
Because in his mind, the grand prize was definitely a gimmick, reserved for insiders. Ordinary customers shouldn’t even think about winning; they were all just destined for consolation prizes.
Besides, he thought that this so-called apartment was probably a cheap apartment in a mediocre location.
But what he never expected was...
The exact opposite of what he thought!
Alice Apartment was not some cheap place at all.
On the contrary, it was a high-end apartment complex.
Although its location was not the very best in the city center, the position was still quite good.
Looking further at the most important indicator for measuring a house: the price.
The price of apartments in Alice Apartment was shockingly high—50,000 yuan per square meter!!!!
“Damn!”
Jiang Ran couldn’t help but curse silently in his heart.
He knew that the place he was currently renting cost only a little over 2,000 yuan per square meter, yet this was 50,000?!
Whoever owned a place here could say they saved themselves years of detours in life!
And that wasn’t all; next, Jiang Ran saw something even more jaw-dropping about Alice Apartment.
Alice Apartment was a standalone building.
What did that mean?
A residential complex usually had more than ten buildings, sometimes even dozens.
But Alice Apartment was a single building all by itself, and it wasn’t a huge apartment tower with many floors and vast grounds.
It was a small apartment building with relatively few residents inside, meaning it wouldn’t be noisy or chaotic, nor crowded with random people. It catered to elite professionals, following a high-end route.
Overall, it was very suitable for living.
Seeing the detailed information about Alice Apartment, Jiang Ran became even more certain that this was a gimmick—the grand prize was definitely reserved for insiders!
Sure enough, he kept an eye on those in front who bought pancakes to enter the lottery.
Not to mention the grand prize, even the second and third prizes were nowhere to be found.
Still, many people bought five or six multigrain pancakes at once, some even seven or eight, and one person shockingly bought over a dozen.
Faced with human greed, Jiang Ran could only shake his head.
Meanwhile, his thoughts returned to the medicine he had been taking.
“My current appearance is way more handsome than in my past life. Should I become a gigolo? It’s tough, but the money is good, and I could buy better medicine to control my condition.”
That’s what Jiang Ran thought, but ten minutes later, he never expected that his circumstances would undergo earth-shattering changes.
“Holy crap, I won? The grand prize?”
At this very moment, staring at the three big characters in the scratch-off area of the lottery ticket in his left hand—“Grand Prize.”
Jiang Ran was utterly incredulous, at one point thinking he was seeing things.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Until the young and beautiful female employee of the pancake shop congratulated him:
“Congratulations, sir! You won! It’s the grand prize!!! A set of apartments in Alice Apartment!!!!!!”
Snap!
The multigrain pancake in Jiang Ran’s right hand fell straight to the ground.
Only then did he truly believe he had won.
After the shock came joy, ecstatic beyond words.
Great! He was going to have a house!
He had no house in his past life, no house in this life, and now he won a set of apartments?
If he had a house, he wouldn’t have to rent anymore!
He could save a thousand yuan a month in rent!
A thousand yuan—one more step closer to buying effective psychiatric medicine!!!
Amidst the joy, the Danger Warning System in Jiang Ran’s mind kept alerting:
[Beep! Detection: Host is at a dangerous crossroads in life! Please pay attention! Please pay attention!]

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Live Stream Room: Distant Relatives Are Not As Good As Close Neighbors Game
chapters.content:
Today was three days after winning the first prize.
Three days ago, after winning the first prize, Jiang Ran, amidst countless envious gazes from people buying pancakes, was invited inside the pancake shop by the shop manager to claim his prize.
Originally, Jiang Ran thought the prize claiming process would be slow and drawn out.
After all, the prize was a whole apartment!
And not just any apartment—it was valued at 50,000 yuan per square meter.
What surprised Jiang Ran was how fast the reward was processed.
In just three days, Jiang Ran completed the ownership transfer and received the keys to the apartment.
It felt as if this apartment was a huge hot potato that no one wanted to hold for long.
At this moment, it was seven o’clock in the morning, in front of Alice Apartment.
Jiang Ran, carrying a large black 70-liter backpack on his back and dragging an oversized black suitcase with his right hand, basked in the gentle warmth of the morning sunlight.“Is this Alice Apartment?”
Looking at the luxurious ten-story apartment building before him, Jiang Ran couldn’t believe that he was lucky enough in this life to live in such a place.
After all, in his previous life, he was just a tenant who rented rooms like a beast of burden.
He didn’t know the inside of this apartment building, but just from the outside, it gave off a clean, neat, and simply luxurious vibe.
The shop manager had told him that the first prize, the Alice Apartment unit, was already fully decorated, and all the appliances were complete.
So, he just needed to move in with his bags.
Because of this, Jiang Ran had terminated his previous lease early and either sold or discarded all the things he no longer needed.
He only brought his clothes and basic daily necessities.
“Alice Apartment, here I come!”
Feeling great, Jiang Ran said aloud in a slightly loud voice.
What he didn’t expect was that there was an answer, and it came from very close beside him.
“You look pretty happy, huh?”
The voice came from Jiang Ran’s left. Turning his head, he saw a young man about his height and age.
This young man looked ordinary, but his biggest feature was his extremely pale skin, even whiter than many girls.
Also, a tiny beauty mark at the corner of his left eye made him extremely noticeable.
“Ah? Sorry.”
Jiang Ran didn’t know where he might have offended the young man, so he apologized first, which was always the safe choice.
Then he said, “Hello, my name is Jiang Ran. I’m a new resident here.”
The pale young man stared at Jiang Ran for several seconds, then shook his head without saying a word, grabbed his suitcase, and silently walked into the gated entrance of Alice Apartment.
“Strange personality.”
Jiang Ran shrugged, then dragged his black suitcase and entered the gated entrance of Alice Apartment as well.
However, the moment his left foot stepped in, the Danger Warning System in his mind sounded a strong and sharp alarm:
[Danger! Danger! Danger detected! Host is in an extremely dangerous place! Please leave immediately! Please leave immediately!]
[Points +5! Points +5!]
“Uh…”Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
The sudden danger warning caught Jiang Ran off guard.
He looked around left and right but saw nothing that could pose a threat.
He even looked up, fearing some high-altitude object might fall, although he was still quite far from the apartment building. Yet, looking forward and upward, not only was there no sign of falling objects, there wasn’t even a single shadow on any balcony floor.
“This system is acting crazy again.”
Jiang Ran clearly remembered that three days ago, next to the pancake shop, this system also issued a danger warning.
And what happened?
Not only did no danger occur, Jiang Ran even won the first prize!
His luck was off the charts!!!
“Could it be that this Danger Warning System is actually reversed?”
“Maybe the so-called danger warning is actually a luck warning?”
He couldn’t help but speculate.
This was based on his previous experience.
“Mr. Jiang Ran, are you feeling unwell anywhere?”
At this moment, a burly man in his thirties wearing a black security guard uniform walked out from the luxurious security booth next to the gated entrance.
He approached Jiang Ran, slightly bowed, and showed a warm smile.
Jiang Ran was a bit surprised, “Huh? Do you know me?”
While saying this, Jiang Ran pulled out a resident card from his pocket.
This kind of high-end apartment required card swiping to enter.
The security guard smiled and said, “When you transferred ownership a few days ago, Alice Apartment had already recorded your information and sent it to our security and property management. So it’s normal for us to know you.”
Jiang Ran was amazed, wow!
This was truly a high-end apartment.
The service attitude and awareness completely outclassed the neighborhoods he had lived in before.
No wonder they say that wealthy people living in high-end neighborhoods or villas don’t just buy houses; they buy service.
“Mr. Jiang Ran, please come this way. We have already registered your facial information into the access control system. In the future, you won’t need to swipe your card—just scan your face to enter directly.”
“Really?”
Although Jiang Ran had never experienced high-end service before, he had played with facial recognition technology before.
So he walked to the face scanning machine and scanned his face.
Immediately, the entrance gate opened.
Jiang Ran happily dragged his suitcase and walked in.
The security guard at the gate maintained his slight bow and squinted smile from the beginning, watching Jiang Ran walk into the apartment building, then stayed where he was.
Like a statue.
Even though it was early morning, this eerie behavior gave people goosebumps.
Especially since the security guard’s eyes squinted tighter and tighter until they became slits, and finally, even those slits seemed to disappear from his face.
...
...
...
Human progress is terrifying, especially in modern times.
The development of technology is even more terrifying.
Thousands of years ago, messages were still passed through relay stations and carrier pigeons.
But in just a few decades or a century, technology has explosively advanced at a bewildering speed!
Humans have built invisible, intangible networks covering the entire world.
Now everyone only needs an electronic device to communicate with the world.
At this moment, this was a broadcast studio where only the center area was lit; everywhere else was shrouded in darkness.
Standing in front of a huge electronic screen in the studio was a Chinese beauty holding a microphone.
This beauty was at least 1.75 meters tall, and wearing high heels made her reach 1.8 meters.
Her figure was curvy and well-proportioned, with a sweet and pretty face.
She wore a silver dress and had flowing long hair.
She irresistibly drew people’s eyes to linger on her for a long time.
At this moment, no one else was in the studio except her, only multiple cameras hidden in the dark aimed at her.
It seemed to be a live broadcast.
The long-haired beauty raised the microphone in her hand, smiled sweetly, and said to one of the cameras:
“Dear VIP members, the 25th round of the ‘Distant Relatives Are Not As Good As Close Neighbors’ game is about to begin. Let me introduce the five little lab rats for this round!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Five Little White Mice
chapters.content:
With the long-haired beauty's slender left hand gesturing, the electronic big screen behind her changed from pitch black to pure white.
Immediately after, a long list of information appeared on the screen.
There were photos of people along with text.
The clarity was unparalleled.
"The first test subject of the 25th round of the game."
"Qin Fei, male, 20 years old. Due to addiction to online games, he spent all the hard-earned hundreds of thousands of his parents on the game. That’s not all; he recklessly took out a series of online loans, resulting in heavy debt with no money to repay. Therefore, he signed an agreement with us to enter the game. For every day he survives in Alice Apartment, he will receive a 10,000 yuan reward. We hope he can survive several days and pay off his debts as soon as possible."
The long-haired beauty smiled slightly. As her gestures continued, the electronic big screen kept displaying various photos of this boy named Qin Fei, including ID photos and daily life snapshots.
"Next is the second test subject."
"Wang Xixi, male, 27 years old, a rock and hip-hop enthusiast who prides himself on chasing dreams. He once formed a rock band, but unfortunately, it disbanded due to various reasons. He signed an agreement with us to stay in Alice Apartment and receives 10,000 yuan for every day he survives."
After introducing the second test subject, the female host pulled out a black tablet computer from somewhere.She opened the tablet.
Apart from the pre-installed software, the tablet only had one extra app.
This software was called the Black Software.
She opened the app again, operated it for a while, and entered a live streaming room inside the software. The live stream was of herself.
A long-haired beauty stood in front of an electronic big screen.
The current number of viewers in the live room showed 71,499, and it was still rising. Along with the increasing audience came more comments streaming in.
[Wow, finally live! The new round gets my blood boiling.]
[Yeah, I’ve been waiting for so long, so bored every day. Glad it’s finally live.]
[Hope these five in this round survive longer! Don’t die one after another as fast as the last five!!!]
At this moment, a netizen named Middle-aged Uncle commented: [Ah, the new round has started. Let me see who these players are! Hmm... So far, the second guy seems more interesting than the first! I guess he joined this game to make money and rebuild his band. But that’s not an easy task. Back in my day, I also wanted to enter the entertainment industry. I started an entertainment company and signed several newcomers, including some male and female bands. Unfortunately, none of them became famous. Wish he can survive longer and earn more money!]
Another user called Domineering Female CEO said: [Too bad this Wang Xixi isn’t handsome; otherwise, I’d definitely sponsor him to help him achieve his dream. After all, I’m famous for being charitable.]
The long-haired beauty glanced at the comments in the live room and pursed her red lips slightly.
She lifted her gaze away from the tablet and continued:
"Now, introducing the third test subject."
"Murong Fu, male, 23 years old, a factory worker. He wants to save up for a wedding house and dowry to marry his girlfriend. He signed an agreement with us, and for each day he survives, he receives 10,000 yuan."
As she spoke, the electronic big screen showed a slightly handsome young man.
At the same time, new comments flooded the live room.
Fairy Sister: [Cousin, is that you? Cousin?]
Little Aunt: [Cousin, I’m here...]
I am the Hero: [Damn, he even shares the same name as Murong Fu from the novel “Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils,” but this Murong Fu is far inferior. The novel’s Murong Fu focuses solely on his career and scorns women, including his beautiful cousin. This one, however, is willing to play this game just to gather money for marrying his girlfriend.]
Middle-aged Uncle: [That’s normal. You rich kids don’t understand ordinary life. I was once an ordinary person who started from nothing and fully understand this Murong Fu. Of course, I wouldn’t risk my life just for marriage.]
Domineering Female CEO: [Nowadays, ordinary people’s marriages are bound by houses, cars, and dowries. But this is good. Otherwise, if they weren’t short on money, who would join the game? Without their participation, how would we have fun?]
The comment section buzzed with lively discussions.
The long-haired beauty went on: "The fourth test subject."
"Xiao Nuo, female, 19 years old, college student, vain and materialistic, similar to the first subject but better. Her family’s money hasn’t been touched; they probably don’t even know her bank password. Her family is somewhat biased toward males, so she took out quite a few online loans to buy Apple phones, cosmetics, branded clothes, and bags. The interest piled up, and she couldn’t repay, so she dared not tell her family. Therefore, she signed an agreement with us. For every day she survives, she earns 10,000 yuan."
Middle-aged Uncle: [This fourth one is pretty good. I like this type of female college student. The more materialistic they are, the easier they are to support. But this Xiao Nuo doesn’t look good, and her makeup is way too heavy.]
Back to the live room.
"Currently, the first four test subjects have all been introduced."
"Now, the fifth test subject, a surprise for everyone. This fifth test subject is completely different from the previous four and all the test subjects in the previous 24 rounds."
After finishing the introduction of the fourth, the long-haired beauty immediately started introducing the fifth.
The comment section exploded with curiosity after hearing her words, all asking how this one was different.
The long-haired beauty smiled wryly: "In our game, all test subjects sign an agreement before moving into Alice Apartment. They have no idea what’s really inside. They only joined for the 10,000 yuan per day."
"But this fifth test subject is completely different."
"He didn’t sign an agreement with us. He won first prize in a lottery held by one of our chain crepe shops and received an Alice Apartment unit, so he moved in."
"He knows even less about Alice Apartment than the other test subjects."
After hearing this, many in the comment section sighed then cheered.
Middle-aged Uncle: [Knowing nothing means this test subject will probably die the fastest. What’s the point of watching then?]
Fairy Sister: [Exactly. Other test subjects don’t know what’s inside the apartment, but at least they know there’s no free lunch. Earning 10,000 yuan a day isn’t that easy. They have some vigilance about the apartment’s unknowns. This one thinks Alice Apartment is just a regular high-end apartment and got in by winning the lottery, so he’s completely off guard.]
Many expressed regretful cheers.
But some found this type of test subject interesting, appreciating the game operator’s thoughtful design.
Domineering Female CEO: [Although this test subject will probably die first, he’s definitely worth watching. After all, the other four are all cautious. They act carefully inside the apartment. But this one, completely ignorant of the apartment’s situation, lives here like a normal resident. It’s a brand new type! We’ve seen so many cautious ones; now we have one with zero awareness—just for a change of pace! If the other four die faster than him, I’ll seriously laugh my head off!!!]
Little Aunt: [Hey, that’s unfair to the fifth test subject! I’m not talking about the apartment knowledge, but other test subjects get cash deposits for survival days. How will this one get paid? Under what name will the money be sent to him?]ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Betting on Five Lab Rats, Moving into Alice Apartment
chapters.content:
“The fifth lab rat.”
“Jiang Ran, male, 23 years old, a super workhorse holding multiple roles. Although he was trapped here by us, we discovered he used to draw comics. Although he stopped updating, if he can survive for more than a day, ten thousand yuan will be sent to him through the comic channel as a comic reward.”
Jiang Ran’s profile and photo appeared on the electronic big screen.
After seeing Jiang Ran’s photo, many comments popped up in the live chat room.
They all said Jiang Ran looked a bit handsome or something like that.
The long-haired beauty no longer held the tablet but put it down.
She smiled at a black camera and said with a gentle smile:
“Now, the 25th round of five lab rats has been fully introduced.”
“Dear members, please start placing your bets. The minimum bet amount cannot be less than 100,000 yuan!”
After this announcement, everyone in the live chat began placing bets while discussing at the same time.About half an hour later, betting ended.
The long-haired beauty waved her right hand, and the electronic big screen behind her showed the previous five people including Jiang Ran, with their avatars arranged vertically from top to bottom.
They formed a table.
The long-haired beauty looked at the table and said:
“The first lab rat, Qin Fei, received a total betting amount of 10.99 million yuan.”
“The second lab rat, Wang Xixi, received a total betting amount of 50.98 million yuan.”
“The third lab rat, Murong Fu, received a total betting amount of 66.23 million yuan.”
“The fourth lab rat, Xiao Nuo, received a total betting amount of 5.67 million yuan.”
“The fifth lab rat, Jiang Ran, received a total betting amount of 1.08 million yuan.”
Everyone in the live chat can only bet on one of the five lab rats.
There is no limit on the betting amount.
The minimum is 100,000 yuan. You cannot bet 101,000 or 105,000 yuan—you must bet directly 110,000 or more.
Whoever among the five lab rats survives until the very end, being the last to die,
those who bet on him will not only get back their own bets but also take all the money wagered on the other lab rats.
From this table,
betting on Murong Fu, who is expected to survive the longest and die last, has the highest amount.
Betting on Jiang Ran has the lowest amount.
But this does not necessarily mean Jiang Ran’s bettors are few.
After all, it is possible that a member, a rich sponsor, is very optimistic about a certain lab rat and bets a large sum of money.
While some lab rats have many bettors, these sponsors are just testing their luck and only bet the minimum 100,000 yuan.
Therefore, after checking the amounts, the long-haired beauty began to announce how many people bet on each lab rat.
Of course, the situation just described rarely happens.Thɪs
Basically, the more money bet, the more people have bet.
After all, no lunatic would blindly throw too much money on a lab rat with zero certainty.
Unless you are a star player.
For example, that guy who survived three rounds.
Next, the long-haired beauty checked the number of bettors.
Sure enough, the lab rat with the least amount had the fewest bettors, and the one with the most money also had the most bettors.
The one with the most is the third lab rat, Murong Fu, who received the highest amount of bets.
The one with the fewest is Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran only had six bettors.
Among them, five people only bet the minimum amount of 100,000 yuan each.
That adds up to 500,000 yuan.
This means the remaining 580,000 yuan was bet by one person.
The long-haired beauty could check who placed that bet.
She found that the person who bet 580,000 yuan was a user named Diamond Bachelor.
The long-haired beauty could see it.
Others watching the live stream could also see it.
When the viewers saw Diamond Bachelor bet 580,000 yuan on Jiang Ran, the live chat exploded.
Not because of anything else, but because Diamond Bachelor had won more than he lost in the previous 24 rounds of betting.
He was a constant winner.
There was a leaderboard showing who among the bettors had won the most money in total.
Diamond Bachelor was far ahead in a broken, uncontested lead.
He was called the gambling god by the people in the live chat.
Even though none of the people in this “Distant Relatives Are Not As Good As Close Neighbors” game’s live chat were ordinary.
Everyone’s true identity was either a big business owner or a super wealthy second or third-generation heir.
They all had pride in their hearts, looking down on others.
But in this matter, they all sincerely respected Diamond Bachelor.
Then someone asked:
“Brother Wang, why are you betting on Jiang Ran? This guy was dragged in here by force, a total newbie who knows nothing, no caution at all. He’ll definitely be the first to die. Even if he’s lucky, he can’t be the last to die among the five! So what’s your reasoning behind betting on him?”
Diamond Bachelor rarely spoke in the live chat, but if someone asked him something valuable, he would answer.
He said: “Intuition, a man’s sixth sense.”
Domineering Female CEO: “Last time you said the same thing. So are you saying all your successful bets are thanks to a man’s sixth sense? Then why is my woman’s sixth sense never right?”
Little Dragon Girl: “Don’t worry, Female CEO Sister, this time Brother Wang will definitely fail. His sixth sense will be 100% wrong!”
Fairy Sister: “Yes, I just don’t believe his sixth sense will still be right this time. After all, he’s had misses before!”
Although he won more than he lost, this time Diamond Bachelor bet on Jiang Ran, a newbie forced in.
So everyone else in the live chat thought Brother Wang would mess up.
Therefore, they all felt gleeful about it.
At this moment,
the long-haired beauty cleared her throat and continued:
“Since betting is complete, the 25th round of the ‘Distant Relatives Are Not As Good As Close Neighbors’ game officially begins!”
After finishing, the long-haired beauty disappeared into the surrounding darkness, as if swallowed by black ink.
But the electronic big screen behind her did not lose its glow; instead, it showed a live image.
In the image was Jiang Ran, who had just entered the apartment building.
...
Jiang Ran carried a large backpack and pulled a suitcase. Upon entering the apartment building, he was immediately attracted by the pleasant interior decoration.
At this moment, a series of hurried footsteps, “da da,” approached.
A young man in his twenties rushed out of a room and hurried over.
Upon reaching Jiang Ran, he immediately introduced himself and handed over a white business card.
“Hello, Mr. Jiang Ran.”
“I am the administrator of Alice Apartment. You can call me Xiao Zhang.”
Jiang Ran looked at Xiao Zhang in front of him, who seemed about the same age.
He looked ordinary, always smiling kindly, wearing a black uniform.
Jiang Ran took the business card and glanced at it. It had Xiao Zhang’s name, job title, and phone number.
“If you have any problems in the apartment later, you can call me directly or come downstairs to find me. I live there.”
Seeing Jiang Ran take the card, Xiao Zhang continued to introduce himself and pointed behind him, where his usual residence seemed to be.
“Alright, got it. By the way, my name is Jiang Ran. You don’t need to use honorifics with me. We’re all equals.”
Jiang Ran gave a warm smile toward the administrator Xiao Zhang.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Unlucky Jiang Ran, the First to Encounter an Apartment Resident
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran increasingly felt that the high-end apartment was truly great, with service levels that were simply impeccable.
Not only the security at the entrance, but even the apartment manager treated the residents with such enthusiasm.
And they were all young people.
Jiang Ran liked communicating with young people because there was hardly any generation gap.
Talking with middle-aged or elderly people was exhausting due to the generation gap.
“Okay, Mr. Jiang Ran, I understand. You can go upstairs now. If you need anything, just call me anytime. Xiao Zhang is at your service 24/7!”
Xiao Zhang showed a bright set of white teeth, making Jiang Ran think of Kakashi, the mentor of Xiao Li from Naruto.
“This time in my life that I won this prize, it must be heaven rewarding me for the suffering I endured in my past life.”
Jiang Ran said as he stepped into the elevator.
The apartment he won was on the third floor.Room 304.
At this moment, the third floor was completely silent, only the sound of Jiang Ran dragging his suitcase echoed in the hallway.
Taking a rough look around, the third floor had only four rooms.
301 and 302 on one side.
303 and 304 on the other.
One side was south, the other north.
They were not opposite each other but staggered.
With excitement in his heart, Jiang Ran had already arrived at the door of 304 and used his key to open the house that fully belonged to him.
Upon entering, despite his prior expectations and the pancake shop owner’s description,
Jiang Ran was still surprised at how well the 304 apartment was decorated.
It was truly eye-catching.
Using a popular phrase from long ago: understated luxury with deep connotation.
Especially since the decoration style leaned toward white tones, not the so-called matte high-end black that Jiang Ran didn’t really like.
Besides that, Jiang Ran found the refrigerator, washing machine, TV, and so on, all fully equipped.
There was even a coffee machine...
This made him even more thrilled beyond words.
Because it was an apartment, it only had one living room, one bedroom, one bathroom, an open kitchen in the living room, and a balcony at the end.
Though the space was not large, it was more than enough for Jiang Ran to live comfortably by himself.
Actually, if needed, one or two more people could live here comfortably.
After about ten minutes of excited exploration, Jiang Ran finished touring his house thoroughly.The source of thɪs content is N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
He then began to take out his personal belongings from his backpack and suitcase, placing them in their respective places.
Ready to start his brand-new life.
But before Jiang Ran had even finished organizing halfway through,
there was suddenly a knock on the door.
He was a little puzzled—who would come to knock on his door?
He had just arrived; no deliveries or takeout had come yet.
Could it be the manager Xiao Zhang?
Jiang Ran opened the door directly with curiosity, without peeking through the peephole first because he never had the habit. (Bad habit, don’t follow!)
After opening the door, he didn’t see anyone and was still confused when a voice came from below.
Looking down, he saw a man standing there.
It was an old man leaning on a cane, with a severely hunched back.
He looked to be over seventy years old.
His face was full of wrinkles.
The old man looked up at Jiang Ran with effort and then showed a kind smile:
“Hello, young man. I live in 301. The light bulb in my house is broken, and I can’t replace it. Could you please help me?”
As he spoke, the old man pointed to the farthest door on his right—301.
Jiang Ran nodded in agreement immediately.
“No problem. Shall I replace it now?”
The old man probably didn’t expect Jiang Ran to agree so smoothly and said with a smile, “Alright, let’s go replace it now.”
Then he leaned on his cane and walked ahead to lead the way.
After closing the door, Jiang Ran followed behind the old man.
This simple scene happened to be live-streamed in the chatroom.
The chatroom immediately erupted with excitement.
“Hahaha, I’m dying laughing! I never expected someone to die so fast!”
“Can’t be helped. This is round 25. This newbie called Jiang Ran was just tricked in with no caution at all. But I didn’t expect he’d be dealt a deadly blow so quickly!!! Just plain bad luck!!!”
Domineering Female CEO: “Looks like Brother Wang is about to be slapped in the face this time, and the slap is coming fast.”
Middle-aged Uncle: “Actually, I kind of sympathize with this young man called Jiang Ran. So unlucky. I saw how excited he was inside the room. Probably his first time living in such a high-end apartment. Too bad he won’t even survive one night.”
Little Dragon Girl: “It’s not about dying—everyone dies sooner or later! The problem is he’s going to be taken down by that old man. The way that old man tortures people is sick!”
The old man from 301.
Don’t be fooled by his cane and hunched back—he was faking it all.
This old guy was a classic case of playing dumb to fool others.
Not only was he in perfect health, but he was also extremely tough.
Despite being over seventy, if a fight broke out, even several young men probably couldn’t take him on.
This old bastard seemed to have trained.
When he took off his clothes, his physique was unbelievable.
He had eight-pack abs.
This old man was originally a serial killer with multiple cases outside.
Later, he was put into the apartment by the game organizers.
Current record: five test subjects have died at his hands.
Don’t be fooled by the number five—that’s because he only encountered five.
Therefore, his win rate was 100%.
Fairy Sister: “Jiang Ran might not necessarily die. After all, the old man has his own peculiar killing rules.”
Little Aunt: “Jiang Ran is definitely going to fall. The old man indeed has his own killing rules, but are you sure Jiang Ran won’t trigger them unknowingly?”
In this world, there were many psychopathic killers.
Among these killers, many had their own killing rules.
For example, they specialized in killing a certain type of person or used particular methods.
This old man was no exception.
His killing rule was as follows: find an excuse to lure the victim into his home.
Then, have the victim do chores for him.
Such as changing light bulbs, fixing faucets, cleaning, and so on.
Once one task was finished, the old man immediately asked the victim to do the next one.
Nonstop.
Moreover, the demands became more and more excessive.
At this point, the victim would be unwilling.
After all, “You’re not my grandpa. I have my own things to do!”
So, refusing to help and preparing to leave.
Well, if you do that, you trigger the old man’s killing rule.
Get ready to be taken down!
Middle-aged Uncle: “I agree with Little Aunt. Jiang Ran can only escape from the old man’s clutches in two ways.”
“First: do whatever the old man asks patiently, wear him down until he loses patience and lets you go. But this is impossible. The five before lasted the longest and only did three tasks before giving up.”
“Second: trigger the old man’s killing rule, then knock the old man out. But this is even more impossible. We have seen the old man’s combat power—it’s too strong. Unless you are Tyson. Even if you are Tyson, it won’t help, because the old man also uses tricks.”
“Not afraid of a strong opponent, but afraid of a strong opponent who’s a cunning old fox.”
“Therefore, Jiang Ran has fallen into a death trap!”
Others in the chatroom also agreed, convinced Jiang Ran was doomed.
Fairy Sister: “Brother Wang, are you in the chatroom? The Jiang Ran you bet on is about to die!”
Seeing this, others also began to call out to Diamond Bachelor.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Diamond Bachelor Is Actually a Girl
chapters.content:
At this moment, the Diamond Bachelor was of course in the live stream room, still watching this scene along with the comments from others.
However, the Diamond Bachelor didn’t reply to those people’s words right away.
Because, right now, the Diamond Bachelor was furiously raging in real life.
“Ahhhhh! Damn it!!! It’s all your fault! Because of you, I chose the wrong person!!!”
Inside a super luxurious villa room,
a very beautiful girl wearing revealing clothes stood with her hands on her hips, scolding a middle-aged woman.
After scolding until she was out of breath, the girl waved her hand and let the middle-aged woman off.
It was obvious that the girl was the owner of the villa, while the middle-aged woman was a servant hired by her family.
And this was not an ordinary master-servant relationship.
After all, even if you are my boss and scold me like this for so long, once I lose my temper, I can just quit!But the middle-aged woman had been scolded for so long, yet she kept her head lowered and admitted her fault without any resentment.
It seemed she was already used to it. Maybe the beautiful girl paid her too well. She wasn’t bowing to her; she was bowing to the money.
After the middle-aged woman left, only the girl remained in the luxurious pink princess room.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
The girl sat in front of a large display screen, feeling extremely miserable.
The misery made her flail her hands and feet constantly, her long hair flying wildly.
“At first, I wanted to pick Wang Xixi from that band! But I recklessly chose Jiang Ran! I’m going to get slapped in the face!!!!”
The girl was in utter agony.
Only six people had bet on Jiang Ran.
Then, who was this girl among those six?
She was the Diamond Bachelor.
Everyone in the live stream room assumed the Diamond Bachelor was a man and quite old.
Unexpectedly, the Diamond Bachelor was actually a young woman!
And she was a stunning beauty just barely over twenty, with a face that could make fish sink and birds fall.
At the start, her extremely accurate sixth sense told her to choose Wang Xixi, but she was disturbed by that middle-aged woman just now, causing her to pick the wrong person.
In this game, once you pick the wrong person, you can’t change it.
That was why she was so furious.
Her sixth sense was very accurate.
Accurate to one hundred percent.
Others in the live stream only knew the Diamond Bachelor sometimes slipped up, losing little but winning much.
But what they didn’t know was that those few losses were all intentional.
She deliberately ignored her sixth sense and instead chose based on her own analysis of each round’s test subjects.
The result was her analysis was totally wrong, but her sixth sense was spot on.
Therefore, afterwards, she completely trusted her sixth sense.
And to maintain her first place ranking in the game, she always followed her sixth sense’s choice.
But this time, she accidentally picked wrong.
Not only that, she chose the test subject most likely to die first.
She didn’t care about the 580,000 lost — 580,000 was nothing; even if it were 5.88 million or 58.88 million lost, she wouldn’t care.
What she cared about was her ranking.
After raging for a long time, she finally accepted reality.
“Fine, I’ll accept fate. At worst, I lose this round. Anyway, I’m still the undisputed number one. Just don’t pick wrong next time.”
This beautiful girl known as the Diamond Bachelor sat stubbornly in front of the computer, watching the live stream showing Jiang Ran and the old man, while others in the live stream kept tagging her.
She almost couldn’t hold back and spat out a curse.
“Jiang Ran, Jiang Ran, even if you can’t survive till the end, at least fight for me a little, okay?! Don’t die first! Do I have no dignity?!”
...
Alice Apartment.
“Young man, you’re a new tenant, right?”
The old man from Room 301 looked back at Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran nodded, “Yes, I just moved in, and then you came right away.”
The old man in Room 301 smiled, “Yeah, I can tell you’re a warm-hearted good person, unlike those in 302 and 303. They’re so cold. When an old man like me needs help, they act like they don’t even see it. For example, just now, I knocked on your door first, then on theirs, and they all pretended to not be home.”
He was very upset.
Scratching the back of his head, Jiang Ran glanced at the tightly closed doors of 302 and 303.
“Maybe they really aren’t home? Maybe they went to work.”
The old man was still quite angry. “Heh heh, young man, you just came and don’t know them well. Once you get to know them, you’ll see I’m telling the truth.”
The old man from Room 301 led Jiang Ran to his apartment, opened the door, and walked in.
Once inside, Jiang Ran couldn’t help but sigh at the antique decoration style. “Old man, your place really has that old-time charm.”
The old man chuckled, “Heh heh heh, I just like ancient architectural styles, so when it came to decorating, I had my kids do it this way.”
“Old man, do I need to change into slippers?”
“No need, young man, just come right in.”
“Alright, old man, which light bulb do you need replaced?”
“Oh, the one in the living room.”
Jiang Ran stepped into the living room first. The old man glanced at Jiang Ran’s back, closed the door, and stood there for several seconds as if locking it. Whatever he did, he gave a cold smile before returning to normal.
He then followed Jiang Ran into the living room.
Jiang Ran examined the light bulbs overhead in the living room.
First, he tested to see if they really didn’t work.
After testing, he found that out of the four bulbs, three needed replacing.
Then he noticed several spare bulbs on the sofa.
He took them, pushed over a table, stood on it, and prepared to replace the bulbs.
While replacing, Jiang Ran chatted with the old man.
“Old man, do you live here alone? What about your family?”
The old man sat on the sofa, watching Jiang Ran change the light bulbs, smiling as he said,
“I’m the only one living here. My wife passed away long ago. After my children got married, they started their own families and don’t want this old man anymore.”
Hearing the old man’s sad tone, Jiang Ran said, “At least you still have a place to live and don’t have to worry about food and drink. If it’s like this, your children are quite filial.”
Unexpectedly, after Jiang Ran said this, the old man suddenly burst out cursing.
“Young man, you don’t understand! I bought this house with my own money! My children didn’t pay a cent! Now I eat and drink with my own pension. Them giving me money? They’ve sucked a lot of money out of me!!!!”
The old man angrily tapped the floor repeatedly with his cane, making Jiang Ran feel extremely awkward.
But finally, the light bulbs were replaced quickly.
“Old man, the light bulbs are all replaced.”
Jiang Ran flipped the switch and showed the old man the newly replaced bulbs shining brightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The 301 Old Man Completely Confused and Driven Crazy by Jiang Ran
chapters.content:
The old man in Room 301 stared at the light bulb, then lowered his head and said, "Young man, I have to trouble you again. Actually, many of the light bulbs in my house are broken. Could you replace them all for me?"
Jiang Ran, who was pushing the table back into place, was momentarily stunned.
Then he nodded: "Sure, no problem."
Within about ten minutes, Jiang Ran had replaced all the broken light bulbs in the old man's house with new ones and checked everything once more.
"Sir, all done."
Jiang Ran returned to the living room.
The old man in Room 301 gave Jiang Ran a thumbs-up: "You're really a good kid! Old man really likes young people like you!"
"If there were more people like you in society, our world would definitely become a better place!"
"By the way, I have a granddaughter about your age. She'll be visiting me in a few days. How about I introduce her to you?"
Jiang Ran was first a bit embarrassed, scratching the back of his head after being praised by the old man.Then, hearing about an introduction to a girlfriend, his interest suddenly piqued.
After all, the Alice Apartment was a high-end complex, and the old man in Room 301 could afford to buy there, which meant he was definitely wealthy.
Therefore, if he could really get together with his granddaughter, he could enjoy a comfortable life.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Sir, you look quite handsome yourself. Your granddaughter must be very pretty, right?"
"Of course! Wait a moment, I'll find a photo of my granddaughter for you."
Jiang Ran leaned over as the old man found a photo of his granddaughter and showed it to him.
He proudly said, "My granddaughter is beautiful, right?"
Jiang Ran put on a surprised expression on the surface, but in fact, the first glance at the photo shocked him.
It was like a thunderbolt striking his head!
His heart screamed, "What the hell? She looks even more masculine than me?!"
If they stood side by side, he wouldn't even know who was the man and who was the woman.
Immediately, he dismissed the idea of mooching off them.
But he still said, "Beautiful, definitely beautiful."
The old man proudly put away his phone: "That's right, my granddaughter has always been single because she’s too beautiful. No guy dares to get close to her."
Jiang Ran thought, "No wonder no guy dares to approach! I wouldn't dare either!"
At this moment, Jiang Ran felt that all the work was done and it was time to leave, so he tried to go.
But the old man grabbed him abruptly: "Grandson-in-law, can I ask you one more favor?"
Jiang Ran's mouth twitched: "Sir, go ahead."
The old man said, "Look at how messy my house is. Can you help me tidy it up?"
Jiang Ran glanced around briefly and indeed found it a bit messy. His eyes fell on the old man's weathered face, bent over to an exaggerated degree.
He said, "Alright."
Sticking to his usual good-natured style, Jiang Ran started cleaning the old man's house thoroughly.
This big cleaning lasted about half an hour, using two garbage bags.
After finishing, Jiang Ran sat down on a redwood chair to rest, leaning his head against the chair's back, his face turned toward the ceiling.
Just as he was about to rest for a bit, the old man said again, "Grandson-in-law, you only cleaned the living room. You haven’t cleaned my bedroom, balcony, or bathroom yet!"
When Jiang Ran heard this, he immediately waved his hand: "Sir, let me rest for a moment first."
"Alright," the old man agreed.
At this moment, the old man stared at Jiang Ran sitting with his head down resting. His pale lips twitched slightly.
He thought to himself, "He’s about done for, right? Kid, when you can’t take it anymore and leave because you’re fed up, I’ll take your life. Hmm, let me think about how I’ll collect your life this time."
Not long after,
Just as the old man was pondering how to take Jiang Ran’s life, Jiang Ran stood up from the chair, took a broom and a rag, and started cleaning the balcony, bedroom, and bathroom.
He cleaned the balcony and bedroom quickly — sweeping some garbage off the floor, wiping the table, and tidying up the clothes.
When it came to the bathroom, he discovered it was filthy and messy.
It made his scalp tingle.
Especially the toilet paper on the floor stained with yellow substances, scattered in heaps on the white bathroom floor. The trash bin was already full, with a towering yellowish-white peak protruding.
The originally white bathroom tiles were now all blackened, with black grime conquering every corner.
A stench, almost visible, wafted over.
It was obvious the bathroom hadn’t been cleaned for a long time.
The old man saw Jiang Ran standing hesitating behind the bathroom door, reluctant to enter.
He felt proud: "Heh heh heh, young man, this is my great achievement after three months of neglect, just waiting for today. What’s wrong? Can’t do it? Don’t want to clean? Go ahead and refuse me! Storm off in a fit of anger!!!!"
Jiang Ran stared at the bathroom, feeling it was disgusting, but inwardly he was filled with a different kind of emotion:
"Sigh, it’s really pitiful to grow old. Wanting to clean the house but powerless. Such a dirty place—this old man must have wanted to clean it for a long time, but his back is bent like that. He simply can’t."
"Will I be like this when I grow old? That’s just too pitiful..."
"They always say marriage and children help care for the elderly, but I don’t see that in this old man..."
Shaking his head, Jiang Ran developed a deeper feeling about marriage and having children.
Then, carrying that feeling with him, he stepped into this bathroom BOSS room.
He began to fight the BOSS.
The old man, seeing Jiang Ran silently enter, instantly widened his eyes as if witnessing something that shattered his worldview.
Then he saw Jiang Ran cleaning vigorously inside.
His slightly open mouth snapped shut completely.
He sat back down on the sofa, speechless.
The BOSS room lived up to its name.
After two hours of cleaning, the entire bathroom was finally spotless, renewed from top to bottom.
Jiang Ran couldn’t help but feel a sense of pride.
"Sir, sir, I’ve cleaned your bathroom. You can go check it out. It’s really clean!!!"
Jiang Ran happily reported to the old man.
He didn’t notice that the old man’s face had darkened to the extreme.
The old man stared at the freshly cleaned bathroom and thought, "Today I’ve finally met an opponent?"
Jiang Ran finished cleaning the bathroom and started packing the garbage bags from today’s cleaning—there were more than a dozen.
"Sir, is there anything else? If not, I’ll leave and take these garbage bags with me."
Hearing this, the old man immediately turned and smiled brightly:
"Young man, what time is it now?"
Jiang Ran took out his phone: "Almost 11 o’clock."
Old man: "Alright then, there are some vegetables and meat in the fridge. How about making me lunch? I’m really hungry!"
Jiang Ran hesitated only for a few seconds before agreeing.
He tied on an apron and started making lunch in the open kitchen of Room 301.
At this moment, the old man’s face darkened even more.
He scrutinized Jiang Ran’s back carefully, thinking: What kind of thing is this?
Are you an idiot?!
Why are you so eager to help others?
Don’t you have your own things to do?
If I tell you to do something, you just do it?
If I told you to eat shit, would you do it?!

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Smooth Escape, Live Stream Audience Stunned
chapters.content:
Step one: change the living room light bulb. Step two: replace all the broken light bulbs in the entire house.
Step three: clean the living room.
Step four: balcony, bedroom, boss’s bathroom.
Step five: make lunch.
The Old Man in Room 301 thought that the vast majority of people in this world would barely get past step two.
After all, I don’t even know you—we’re just neighbors who recently met.
Helping you change a light bulb is already going above and beyond. You want me to help clean your living room too?
Besides, under normal circumstances, who would dare ask a newly acquainted neighbor to clean for them?
That was how the people he met before usually behaved.
The most extreme one had endured to step three—he cleaned the living room for the old man but refused to clean anywhere else.Then he was killed by the old man.
But this guy in front of him?
He actually followed through with every single step!!!
Especially when facing the bathroom that even professional cleaners didn’t want to touch.
This guy actually insisted on cleaning it?! And he cleaned it so thoroughly?!
The Old Man in Room 301 had never met such a troublesome opponent before.
To be honest, preparing lunch was already the last step he had planned.
And yet Jiang Ran managed to get through it all!!!
The old man was stunned, not knowing what he should make Jiang Ran do next to get him to refuse.
Of course, the old man could have asked for something completely impossible, like making Jiang Ran eat his own excrement.
No matter how patient Jiang Ran was, he wouldn’t do that!
But such an outrageous request didn’t fit with the old man’s killing rules.
His killing rules never required something so despicable.
Even though he wanted to kill the other person, he had some boundaries.
Soon, plates of fragrant, home-cooked dishes were placed on the table.
After Jiang Ran served the food, he untied his apron around his waist and smiled at the Old Man in Room 301:
“Sir, I hope my cooking suits your taste.”
The old man stared blankly at the table full of dishes with perfect color, aroma, and taste, saying nothing.
Jiang Ran ignored him and then said, “Sir, if you ever need anything in the future, you can come find me. You can also ask the manager, Xiao Zhang. He seems pretty good too.”
“Well then, if there’s nothing else, I’ll be going now, sir.”
Jiang Ran grabbed more than a dozen bags of garbage and headed to the door, only to find it locked from the inside.
Just as he was about to call back, he realized the old man had silently appeared behind him like a ghost.
“Sir…”
Jiang Ran wanted the old man to unlock the door, but the old man seemed to anticipate this, pulling out a key and unlocking it for him.
“Goodbye, sir!”
The door opened, and Jiang Ran said his final farewell before leaving.
The old man stared blankly at Jiang Ran’s departing back, wanting to say something but ultimately staying silent.
Jiang Ran muttered as he left, “Looks like this system is completely useless, totally malfunctioning. There’s nothing dangerous here, just a poor lonely old man!”
When entering the apartment building area,
the system had issued alerts like [Dangerous area detected, move away quickly, points +5].
But after entering, he met the security guard.
In Jiang Ran’s mind, the system again prompted, [Dangerous person detected, move away quickly, points +3, something like +3].
Then he met the manager Xiao Zhang, and again the system warned: [Dangerous person detected, move away quickly, points steadily +4 or something].
Finally, when the old man knocked on the door and Jiang Ran opened it, the system announced: [Dangerous person detected, move away quickly, points steadily +5 or something].
The result?
It was proven the system was completely useless and totally wrong.
Which of these three so-called dangerous people was truly dangerous?
The kind and responsible security guard, the manager Xiao Zhang,
and a pitiful old man whose children ignored him and who had a troublesome granddaughter.
Which one posed a real threat to Jiang Ran?
Therefore, when the system initially gave its warnings, he had completely ignored them as nonsense.
“Thinking of you three hundred sixty-five nights a year.”
At this moment, Jiang Ran hummed a tune, saying, “Helping others feels so good!”
Carrying a huge pile of trash bags, he went downstairs to throw out the garbage.
Jiang Ran felt great about doing a good deed.
But a whole lot of people were upset.The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
First and foremost, the Old Man in Room 301.
Now sitting at the dining table, he hadn’t moved his chopsticks even once.
He was lost in thought.
He couldn’t figure out whether his recent encounter with that young man was a dream.
Was there really such a patient and kind-hearted person in this world?
“Looks like I set too few tasks, too simple.”
The old man thought to himself.
He looked down at his calloused hands and clenched them tightly.
This time the guy got away; his hands itched badly.
In the live stream room,
the audience was exploding with shock.
Those who had witnessed the entire process felt as if they had seen a ghost.
Fairy Sister: “Wow! So strong!!! Jiang Ran actually accidentally dodged the old man’s killing rules!”
Little Dragon Girl: “Right! This is the first time anyone has escaped the old man’s grasp! Who said Jiang Ran, this newbie, is useless? He’s amazing!!!”
The live stream was filled with amazement. Everyone had thought Jiang Ran would die at the hands of the Old Man in Room 301, but he escaped unscathed!
It was a miracle!
After all, Jiang Ran was different from the others. He was tricked into this and didn’t know anything at all—a total rookie.
And yet, he was fine!!!
But after the astonishment came doubt.
Middle-aged Uncle: “WTF, WTF, WTF, this kid Jiang Ran—is he really the newbie the organizers said he was? Or is he a planted actor arranged by the organizers to scam us? Who in their right mind would patiently do so much for a neighbor they just met? Especially that bathroom—I swear I could smell the stink through the screen!”
Domineering Female CEO: “Although I like Jiang Ran’s looks, I have to agree with Middle-aged Uncle. If he’s not a plant by the organizers, I really can’t believe anyone would help a newly acquainted neighbor with so many things! I’ve traveled widely and seen a lot, but I’ve never even heard of such a nice person!!!!”
Middle-aged Uncle: “Exactly, I seriously suspect this is a setup by the organizers!!! Damn it! Refund my money!!!!”
Middle-aged Uncle and others felt something fishy was going on.
Jiang Ran must be a plant!
But someone immediately spoke up to oppose this.
I am the Hero: “Uncle and CEO, don’t be so absolute. Are you sure there isn’t really such a patient and kind-hearted person in the world? The world is vast and full of wonders. No matter how much you’ve seen, how many people have you met or heard of in your lifetime? Setting that aside, before we started watching the ‘Better to Have Distant Relatives than Close Neighbors’ game, could you have imagined that someone or some force would be so twisted and powerful as to put a bunch of deranged criminals and killers into one apartment, have them live quietly, and then release newbies inside with a live stream? Do you really think the organizers would be short of money or greedy enough to scam us for a little cash?”
After I am the Hero’s statement, the live stream room fell silent.
There were currently 150,000 people in the live stream.
Unlike the live rooms accessible to ordinary people outside,
those who could access the live stream inside this Black Software were not ordinary people.
Among these 150,000, any one person placed outside would be a wealthy figure admired by the common folk.
But even these wealthy people, including the ultra-rich,
had no ability to gather so many deranged killers to create such a real-life reality show livestream game...

chapters.title: Chapter 10: The 7:30 PM Welcome Party
chapters.content:
It’s the same with people and forces that have such strength.
Would they really create a plant just to make some quick money?
Why not just earn money more straightforwardly?
After all, the total betting amount for the 25th round of the game is only 130 million.
130 million is a small sum—not only for people or forces with such abilities but even for those currently in the live stream room.
Take Diamond Bachelor, for example. This beautiful girl currently lives in a villa halfway up the hill by the bay, worth as much as 1.1 billion.
She even hired a world-renowned designer to design it.
Therefore, the middle-aged uncle’s speculation simply does not hold!!!
The middle-aged uncle then spoke again: “Hahaha, I must have been confused. After all, it’s really hard for me to believe that such people exist in this world. Thanks for the reminder, Hero brother!!!”
The Domineering Female CEO replied: “Hmm... I still hold my previous opinion. I believe the organizer wouldn’t create a plant just to scam our money, but is it possible that Jiang Ran is such a plant to increase the game's watchability?”As soon as she said this, the live stream room fell silent again.
Even I am the Hero didn’t say a word.
Someone immediately tagged I am the Hero.
I am the Hero also replied: “The organizer definitely doesn’t lack money and wouldn’t create a plant just for a mere 130 million. But what the Domineering Female CEO said isn’t unreasonable—Jiang Ran might indeed be such a plant! However, whether that’s true depends on what happens next! If it’s really to boost watchability by planting him, there will definitely be slip-ups later!”
Many in the live stream room agreed.
In reality,
Diamond Bachelor, this beautiful girl, was dancing with joy as she watched Jiang Ran take out the trash downstairs.
Because she originally thought Jiang Ran would die.
She had prepared snacks to watch the upcoming feast of carnage.
But unexpectedly, Jiang Ran escaped unscathed!
Although she still thought Jiang Ran would soon perish in Alice Apartment, at least not so quickly!
He wouldn’t make her lose face!
“Ugh, it’s this woman again. So annoying. I hate people who look as good as I do.”
At that moment, Diamond Bachelor puckered her lips in disgust at the computer screen.
At Alice Apartment,
Jiang Ran was carrying a bunch of trash bags, preparing to take the elevator downstairs to throw out the garbage.
When the elevator doors opened,
there was a woman standing inside.
Jiang Ran glanced casually at first, then fixed his gaze.
He immediately swore this was the most beautiful woman he had ever seen in real life.
This woman was about 25 years old.
She had a mix of youthful girl and mature woman vibes.
Her long hair flowed gently.
Her features were delicate, skin like creamy jade, brows and eyes like a painting.
Even more stunning, she was wearing a blue stepmother dress.
Her figure was graceful, curves perfectly accentuated.
Absolutely breathtaking, simply breathtaking.
Her face was a youthful beauty, but her body was the perfect mature woman’s.
Jiang Ran was stunned for a moment.
To the extent that the constant ringing in his mind—“Ding! Extremely dangerous person detected!! Points +9! Points +9! Points +9!”—was completely ignored.
This woman seemed to be a resident of the third floor as well. When she got off the elevator and passed by Jiang Ran, she smiled at him faintly.
Then her high heels clicked as she walked away, leaving a light fragrance behind.
Jiang Ran took a deep breath of the scent, his mood instantly lifted.
He originally wanted to see which room this beauty lived in on the third floor, but since the elevator wouldn’t wait, he had to enter it first.
After entering the elevator, the woman’s fragrance still lingered inside.
“Is she smiling at me because my face looks decent?”
In his previous life, Jiang Ran looked ordinary. No woman, whether acquaintances or strangers, ever smiled at him first.
In this life, his appearance was somewhat handsome.
Is that why?
While pondering this question, the elevator doors opened.
He carried the heavy trash bags outside the apartment building and threw them into the trash bin.
Then he clapped his hands and was about to return to the elevator entrance on the first floor when the apartment manager, Xiao Zhang, hurried over and called out to him.
“Mr. Jiang Ran, I almost forgot something very important! Let me add you on WeChat first, then add you to our apartment residents’ group.”
“Oh, I see.”
Jiang Ran wondered what it was, then took out his phone and added Xiao Zhang on WeChat.
Xiao Zhang’s WeChat profile picture was him in his uniform.
Xiao Zhang added Jiang Ran to a group chat called: [Alice Apartment Residents Group].
“Alright, from now on, I’ll notify you here if anything comes up. By the way, there’s a welcome party tonight in the activity room on the first floor. You must come!”
Xiao Zhang put away his phone and smiled.
Jiang Ran was somewhat overwhelmed: “Really? A welcome party? Isn’t it a bit extravagant if it’s just for me?”
Jiang Ran didn’t expect there to be a welcome party for his move-in. Wow, the atmosphere was great.
Xiao Zhang smiled: “No, not just you. Including you, there are five new residents recently, so it’s for all five of you.”
Jiang Ran: “Oh, I see.”
Jiang Ran instantly felt much better. After all, being the center of attention at some party would be a bit awkward.
Xiao Zhang glanced at the watch on his left wrist: “The welcome party starts tonight at 7:30, but there’s still one new resident who hasn’t moved in yet. I’m not sure if they’ll arrive on time or if we need to postpone.”
Listening to Xiao Zhang talk to himself, Jiang Ran casually looked to his left and saw a boy dragging a suitcase and carrying a backpack, walking towards them—just like his situation this morning.
“Is that the last new resident?”
Jiang Ran pointed outside.
Xiao Zhang turned and stared for a few seconds, then his eyes lit up: “Yes, that’s him.”
Immediately, Xiao Zhang went out to greet the boy and brought him inside.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
“Hello, Mr. Qin Fei, I’m the manager Xiao Zhang.”
“Oh, hello.”
The boy named Qin Fei looked at Xiao Zhang with a calm expression.
Then Xiao Zhang repeated the same routine he had done with Jiang Ran, saying that if there’s anything, just call him, 24-hour service.
They added each other on WeChat, and Qin Fei was added to the Alice Apartment Residents Group.
Xiao Zhang also told him about the welcome party tonight.
Compared to Jiang Ran’s excited reaction, Qin Fei seemed indifferent to all this.
At this moment, the elevator finally arrived at the first floor. Jiang Ran entered the elevator.
Qin Fei, seemingly unable to tolerate Xiao Zhang’s nagging, also stepped into the elevator dragging his belongings.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Qin Fei: Is This a Haunted House?
chapters.content:
In the confined space, two men stood.
Jiang Ran was the one who finally broke the silence.
"I'm Jiang Ran," he said. "I just moved in here today too."
Qin Fei glanced at Jiang Ran, apparently surprised they were both new residents.
He nodded. "Qin Fei."
Then silence fell between them again.
When the elevator reached the third floor, Jiang Ran stepped out. To his surprise, Qin Fei followed.
Jiang Ran slowed his pace curiously, watching as Qin Fei dragged his luggage to Room 302's door.
"So the old man is in 301, Qin Fei's in 302, I'm in 304... that must mean the beautiful woman I met earlier is in 303?"
Lost in thought, Jiang Ran entered his own apartment, 304.The moment his door closed, Room 301's door cracked open slightly.
Meanwhile, Qin Fei unlocked Room 302's door with his key.
Stepping inside, his jaw dropped.
The apartment's luxurious interior completely exceeded his expectations.
Just as promised - fully furnished, ready for immediate occupancy.
After closing the door and leaving his luggage in the living room, Qin Fei began exploring 302.
A quick tour left him speechless - the place was perfect.
Living here would be pure bliss.
But enjoyment aside, his mind kept returning to that strange agreement.
Qin Fei, age 20, attended a mediocre university but was technically a college student.
An avid gamer since childhood, he'd poured countless hours and money into games.
Small purchases at first - just allowance and New Year's money.
But as he grew older, the spending escalated.
Several years ago, he discovered a private game server.
Addicted instantly, his spending spiraled out of control.
Not only did he exhaust his own funds, he stole tens of thousands his parents had painstakingly saved.
Worse, he took out numerous online loans.
Now his parents hunted him down.
Debt collectors hounded him daily.
His phone rang nonstop with calls.
Only then did he realize the magnitude of his mistakes.
But realization alone solved nothing - he needed solutions!
Yet what could he possibly do?
Even ignoring his parents' money, the online loans demanded repayment.
Where could a broke student find over 500,000 yuan?
Borrowing was impossible - everyone knew about his troubles.
Debt collectors even called his professors.
Just when all seemed hopeless...
A miracle appeared.
A mysterious middle-aged man approached him.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Promised 10,000 yuan per day just for staying at Alice Apartment.
Frankly, Qin Fei didn't believe it at first.
Since when did such opportunities exist?
Googling Alice Apartment only deepened his skepticism.
Until the man showed his bank balance - that staggering number forced belief.
Desperate, Qin Fei agreed.
Signed a confidentiality agreement.
10,000 yuan per day of residence.
Now here he stood.
Checking his phone (he'd removed the original SIM card due to harassment, using a new one registered under someone else's ID), he messaged the middle-aged man:
[Hey, about that 10k per day - I'm here now. Arrived this afternoon. Does today count?]
Qin Fei had decided:
Payment was promised daily, in cash.
If he stayed a day or two without payment, he'd leave immediately.
The reply came seconds later:
[Of course today counts. Once midnight passes, 10,000 yuan will deposit into your new account.]
Qin Fei's eyes lit up. He pocketed his phone, calculating:
"10k daily means 300k monthly, 600k in two months, 900k in three... 3.65 million yearly!"
"Not only could I clear my debts, I'd become a millionaire!!!"
His imagination soared - until reality intruded.
If this deal was real...
10,000 yuan just for staying?
Why would such an opportunity exist?
What's the catch?
He'd asked the middle-aged man, who revealed nothing beyond the daily payment.
"Could this be... a haunted house?"
Qin Fei considered the possibility.
Some properties became unsellable after violent crimes occurred.
Hence "haunted house testers" existed.
But he wasn't one.
Besides, testers earned maybe 1,000 daily - not 10,000.
Suspicious, Qin Fei thoroughly inspected the apartment.
Thirty minutes later, he remained puzzled:
"Completely normal. No signs of haunting. Nothing feels off or creepy."
He searched online for "Alice Apartment hauntings" - zero results.
"Whatever. I'll stay for now," he muttered.
Qin Fei's inspection skills proved lacking - or rather, the organizers' camera installation skills excelled.
Room 302 contained hidden cameras everywhere - absolutely no blind spots, even the bathroom.
Not just 302. The old man's 301, Jiang Ran's 304 - all secretly monitored.
The entire Alice Apartment was under surveillance.
No resident could hide.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Qin Fei's smarter than expected - gaming didn't rot his brain completely. Actually questioning why he's getting paid, suspecting hauntings. Last round had a similar gaming addict who never questioned the deal - just booted up his laptop immediately.]
Domineering Female CEO: [Oh right, that gaming addict! Dude slept three hours daily, gamed the rest.]
I am the Hero: [Pity. With that dedication applied elsewhere, he could've achieved anything.]

chapters.title: Chapter 12: The Old Man from Room 301 Knocks on Qin Fei's Door
chapters.content:
Little Aunt: [Nothing to regret about. Just think about it - he spent so much time gaming yet still sucks at it. With skills like that? He'd probably fail at everything else too.]
Fairy Sister: [Hahaha, that's so true. That gaming addict is all enthusiasm but zero skills.]
Little Dragon Girl: [Big brothers and sisters upstairs, you all seem to look down on that gaming addict? I remember he was actually the last one to die in his round!]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Well... gotta admit that point. The kid never went out, lived on instant noodles - who had a chance to kill him? Only when he finally ordered delivery did his neighbor seize the opportunity... Otherwise, that kid could've survived much longer...]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Now let's see how this gaming addict fares. But no matter how clever he is, he'd never guess the whole apartment is full of serial killers and criminals... Not haunted at all! Even ghosts would have to pay protection fees here before leaving...]
Just as the live stream chat was heating up:
Suddenly someone posted: [Look! The old man from 301 is knocking on Qin Fei's door again!]
Third floor.
After inspecting his apartment and finding nothing, Qin Fei took out his laptop to game.
After all, he was a young man hopelessly addicted to games.His fingers itched if he didn't game for a while.
Just as he launched the game, someone knocked on his door.
Qin Fei was in the living room, using the dining table for his laptop, keyboard and mouse.
He only needed to turn his head left to see the door.
But he just glanced and turned back, muttering: "Didn't hear it. I'm not home."
Self-hypnosis at work.
Qin Fei hadn't ordered food or expected any deliveries.
So no matter who knocked, he pretended not to hear it - standard procedure for him.
Sure enough, the knocking stopped after a few tries.
Just as his game finished loading and he was about to unleash his nimble fingers...
The knocking resumed, louder and more insistent this time.
Qin Fei still ignored it, continuing his "not home" act.
The knocking stopped again.
But within seconds, it started once more - now so loud Qin Fei couldn't pretend anymore.
Annoyed, he marched to the door shouting: "Who the hell is it? Stop banging like a maniac!"
Unlike Jiang Ran who never used peepholes (his previous rentals didn't have any), Qin Fei always checked first.
He pressed his eye against the peephole to see which bastard kept knocking without answering.
What he saw startled him.
There was nobody outside!
"Shit!"
He looked again.
No mistake - the hallway was empty.
His eyeball darted around the peephole's limited view, but saw nothing.
Instantly, Qin Fei felt chills.
He remembered his earlier suspicion about this too-good-to-be-true apartment being haunted.
Was a ghost appearing already?
"Ghosts in broad daylight?"
"Aren't they supposed to come out at night in horror movies?"
Though frightened and confused, his youthful bravado kicked in.
Grabbing a kitchen knife, he cautiously opened the door - just a crack at first.
First glance: nothing.
Second glance: an old man with a cane, hunched over.
Seeing no one else around, Qin Fei asked: "Was that you knocking?"
The old man from 301 nodded: "Yes young man, it was me."
Realizing it was just an old man, not a ghost, Qin Fei immediately straightened up, looking down at him:
"Then why didn't you answer when I asked who it was?"
