"Hmm? You called me?" The old man scratched his head confusedly, then smiled innocently: "I'm hard of hearing at my age."
Seeing how elderly and hunched the man was, Qin Fei suppressed his anger: "What do you want?"
Old Man 301: "Young man, my light bulb burned out. Could you help replace it? I already bought a new one."
Before he finished, Qin Fei snapped: "No time! Do it yourself!"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
SLAM! The door shut in the old man's face, leaving him standing awkwardly outside.
Back in the live stream:
Everyone was stunned by Qin Fei's move.
This was an option?
Domineering Female CEO commented: [I remember Middle-aged Uncle summarizing two ways to deal with the old man before.]
[First: Like Jiang Ran - comply with everything until the old man gets exhausted and lets you go.]
[Second: Trigger his killing rules but overpower him physically.]
[I never imagined a third method! And the simplest one at that!]
The old man had killed his first five victims (plus the sixth escapee Jiang Ran) using the same tactic - pretending to need help changing a light bulb.
All had taken pity and entered his apartment.
None returned alive.
Only Jiang Ran's patience broke the pattern.
Thus, none of the live stream viewers had considered simply refusing the old man from the start.
Maybe someone had, but never voiced it.
Middle-aged Uncle: [Don't jump to conclusions yet. Let's see how the old man reacts.]
Third floor.
Faced with Qin Fei's rejection, Old Man 301 muttered:
"Youth these days... no respect for elders at all."
He started knocking again.
Soon Qin Fei reopened the door, now visibly irritated:
"Old man, are you senile? Had enough knocking?"
Old Man 301 smiled innocently: "Please help this old man, young fellow!"
Qin Fei snapped: "Help my ass! I've got tens of thousands in online loans - who's helping me? Ask someone else on this floor! What about that Jiang Ran guy? Get him to help you!"
SLAM! The door shut again.
"Jiang Ran..."
Just hearing that name made Old Man 301's mouth twitch.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: All Dangerous People?
chapters.content:
The old man from Room 301 didn't give up and kept knocking on the door. Hearing the chaotic knocking outside, Qin Fei initially wanted to go out and yell at him. But he worried that the old man might have a heart condition or something at his age, and he didn't want to be blamed for any mishap.
So he simply put on headphones and turned the game volume up to maximum. This way, no matter how fiercely the knocking continued outside, he couldn't hear it anymore.
After knocking for a long time and seeing Qin Fei wouldn't open the door, the old man from Room 301 could only sigh in defeat and slink away, apparently giving up for now.
In the live stream room:
[This 25th round is amazing! First Jiang Ran, now Qin Fei. Though both just got lucky, at least they survived this disaster!!!] commented one viewer, clearly relieved because he had bet 230,000 on Qin Fei during the betting session. If Qin Fei had been killed by the old man from Room 301, he would have lost all his money.
Middle-aged Uncle: [Alright, now there are three ways to deal with the old man from 301.]
Domineering Female CEO: [This 25th round's participants are quite interesting. I wonder how the others will fare?]
These live stream viewers could freely switch between different camera feeds to observe everything happening in the apartment building. They weren't limited to the main broadcast view. However, after switching through various feeds without finding anything particularly interesting—like Jiang Ran or Qin Fei interacting with the serial killers in the building—many logged off to wait for the evening's welcome party. Usually, something interesting happened during these welcome parties.
Of course, these viewers weren't idle people either—they all had their own lives and responsibilities. They only watched the stream during their free time. Because of this, they often missed exciting moments, especially when test subjects got eliminated. Though the organizers provided replays, it wasn't as thrilling as watching live.
Time passed quickly, and soon it was 7:00 PM, just half an hour before the welcome party. Jiang Ran left Room 304 early, took the elevator to the first floor, and found the activity room that manager Xiao Zhang had mentioned.The activity room was quite large, with a very long table in the center surrounded by metal folding chairs. It had clearly been decorated, with a birthday party-like atmosphere. A red banner hung on the front white wall: "Warmly Welcome Five New Residents to Alice Apartment!!!"
When Jiang Ran arrived, several people were already in the activity room. Besides two staff members setting up, the others were probably residents of Alice Apartment. Jiang Ran didn't approach to greet anyone but simply found a seat and sat down, soon pulling out his phone to pass the time.
As 7:30 PM approached, more and more people arrived in the already-decorated activity room. And with each new arrival, the system's voice in Jiang Ran's mind began rapid-fire announcements like spitting out beads:
[Ding! Dangerous person detected. Please distance yourself immediately! +2 points, +2 points...]
[Ding! Dangerous person detected. Please distance yourself immediately! +6 points, +6 points...]
[Ding! Dangerous person detected...]
Listening to these alerts while observing these seemingly ordinary residents, Jiang Ran couldn't help but show an expression of utter disbelief. He was completely exasperated with the system. Couldn't it even lie convincingly? Was he in a prison? Were all these people vicious criminals? How could every resident in a perfectly normal high-end apartment be dangerous? This was absolute nonsense!
Finally, 7:30 arrived, and almost everyone had gathered. Especially important was the arrival of Xiao Zhang, the manager organizing this welcome event. Seeing that almost everyone—particularly all five new residents—had arrived, Xiao Zhang began the welcome party.
All participants sat around the long table while Xiao Zhang stood at the front with a smile: "Welcome everyone to tonight's welcome party! Alice Apartment has five new residents this time. Let's give them a round of applause!"
Clap clap clap clap. The activity room filled with applause.
Then Xiao Zhang continued: "To help our new and existing residents build friendly relationships, we'll now have our five new residents introduce themselves!"
"First up, Mr. Qin Fei!"The most update n0vels are published on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Following Xiao Zhang's gesture and gaze, everyone looked toward one spot. Qin Fei, uncomfortable under so many stares, quickly stood up and said: "I'm Qin Fei, 20 years old, a college student." Then he immediately sat back down.
Faced with this extremely brief introduction, Xiao Zhang seemed accepting and moved on: "Next, Mr. Wang Xixi!"
Wang Xixi was a man with average looks but very fashionable clothing and hairstyle. He stood up and said: "Hello everyone, I'm Wang Xixi, 27. Though currently unemployed, I'm working hard to reform my band." After glancing around, he sat down.
This introduction was clearly more substantial than Qin Fei's. Immediately, another fashionably dressed young man in his twenties smiled and said: "Wang Xixi? So you're in a band too? I used to be in one that recently disbanded. Maybe we could form a new band together?"
Wang Xixi was surprised to find another musician among the residents: "Really? Though I only do lead vocals, not other positions."
The young man laughed: "Perfect! I can play any position except vocals—never got blessed with good singing pipes. After this, want to check out my place? I've got several great guitars, including one signed by Acamellon."
"Really?!"
Unlike before, Wang Xixi's eyes now shone with excitement. The guitar was his favorite instrument, and Acamellon was the world's top guitarist! Just seeing his signed guitar from afar would be an honor—getting to see it up close? That would be incredible!!!
In just these few exchanges, it was clear these two were kindred spirits getting along famously. The other residents, all quite polite, didn't interrupt their conversation despite not being particularly interested in bands or music.
After their exchange ended, Xiao Zhang continued: "Now, let's have our third new resident introduce himself—Mr. Murong Fu!"
"Murong Fu?"
Jiang Ran, sitting on the right side, looked toward the moderately handsome man standing up on the left, thinking what a memorable name this was. After all, everyone knew "Northern Qiao Feng, Southern Murong Fu." He just wondered if this world had that famous novel "Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils"...

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Wang Xixi Steps Into the Death Vortex
chapters.content:
This world probably exists.
Jiang Ran could tell by observing the reactions of other long-term residents.
The others showed visibly stronger reactions to this name compared to Qin Fei and Wang Xixi earlier.
Then Murong Fu began introducing himself: "Hello everyone, my name is Murong Fu, 23 years old. I recently graduated from university and currently work at a factory."
Murong Fu's self-introduction was as brief as Qin Fei's.
After him came the fourth person.
"Hello everyone, I'm Xiao Nuo, a 19-year-old female college student. Nice to meet you all. I hope we can get along peacefully in the future."
Jiang Ran stared at the female college student Xiao Nuo standing to his front left.
He thought Xiao Nuo was a "back-view beauty."
Beautiful from behind but quite ordinary looking from the front.Despite heavy makeup, she couldn't conceal her plain features, though her speech did reveal her to be a lively girl.
Just as Jiang Ran was thinking this, he suddenly heard someone calling his name.
"Mr. Jiang Ran, Mr. Jiang Ran, it's your turn!"
It was time for his self-introduction. The manager Xiao Zhang had called him several times.
He quickly stood up and said to the others:
"Hello everyone, I'm Jiang Ran, 23 years old. I've graduated from university and started working already."
After saying this, Jiang Ran sat back down, nodding and smiling at the others.
As he sat down, someone remarked:
"Oh ho, all five new residents this time are young people?"
Another voice added: "Youth means vigor and vitality."
Following these comments came a familiar voice Jiang Ran recognized:
"Alright, now that all five new residents have introduced themselves, let's have some cake!"
Manager Xiao Zhang left the activity room and returned about five minutes later pushing a cart.
On it sat an enormous cake, like a small mountain of desserts.
The cake was magnificent and spectacular.
It had ten layers in total.
Each layer was a different flavor.
From what Jiang Ran could identify, there were chocolate, strawberry, cherry, and other layers.
Some flavors he couldn't recognize.
But one thing was certain - this cake definitely wasn't cheap.
Probably costing several thousand yuan at least.
Jiang Ran was once again amazed by the high-end services of this apartment.
Even a welcome event came with such an extravagant cake.
Simply amazing.
After the cake arrived, it was time for distribution.
Manager Xiao Zhang and two other helpful residents handled the serving.
Jiang Ran received a piece of chocolate cake. With just one taste, he knew it used real dairy cream, not that cheap, unhealthy vegetable oil cream.
The difference in texture was obvious.
His appetite immediately awakened, and he dug in heartily.
While eating, his eyes unconsciously scanned the room.
He didn't see the beautiful woman he'd encountered on the third floor - probably didn't attend the welcome event.
Also missing was that extraordinarily pale young man he'd seen outside the apartment earlier.
Seeing him pulling a large suitcase, Jiang Ran had assumed he was another new resident, but apparently not...
"There's plenty more, everyone take your time!" Manager Xiao Zhang announced loudly after everyone got their first slice.
He continued distributing, placing cake slices on paper plates and arranging them on tables like a buffet.
"Xiao Zhang, next time could we skip the cake? I'm getting sick of it."
"Yeah, Xiao Zhang, just take us out for a meal next time. Cakes are boring."
Some residents voiced their opinions while eating.
"Hey, those are terrible suggestions. I say Xiao Zhang should just divide the cake money among us all! Wouldn't that be better?"
"No way, if we split money, even those who didn't come would show up."
The activity room remained lively during the cake eating.
The familiar residents chatted cheerfully among themselves.
A very harmonious atmosphere.
The welcome event ended at 9 PM.
Afterwards, residents gradually dispersed, including Jiang Ran.
Only Xiao Zhang remained in the activity room, cleaning up leftover cake plates.
Along with new resident Wang Xixi and another resident named Zhang Le.
This Zhang Le was the one who'd mentioned being in a band before and owning several valuable guitars, including one signed by the world's top guitarist Acamellon.
After the event, Wang Xixi didn't return to his apartment.
Instead, he followed Zhang Le to see those prized guitars and the Acamellon-signed instrument.
As Wang Xixi walked off with Zhang Le,
many viewers in the live stream room who saw this through numerous cameras exploded in reaction.
Among the five participants of Round 25,
Wang Xixi had total bets placed on him amounting to: 50.98 million.
The second highest among the five.
This massive sum clearly indicated he had many backers!
Extremely many!
These were the people now panicking.
[Oh no, oh no, my 1 million is going down the drain! Brother, have some caution please! You just follow someone because they ask you to?]
[Worthless! You deserve to die!]
[Shouldn't have bet on him... he's definitely dead now]
[Hey seniors, I'm a new member who just started watching these game streams. Can someone explain why you're so sure Wang Xixi is doomed? He's just going to see guitars, right?]
[Ah, new member eh? Let me explain. It's not that simple!]
[This Zhang Le isn't normal! He's a deranged criminal! The terrifying thing is he and that old man from Room 301 both have 100% kill rates! Once they target prey, that prey absolutely dies!!! That's why we say Wang Xixi is doomed!!!]
[Really? But I watched earlier streams - Jiang Ran and Qin Fei survived fine. Even 100% can be broken, no?]
[That... that was just their good luck! How many people get that lucky!]
[Just keep watching. Damn it, I bet 500k on this guy too. If he dies, my money's gone!!!!]
......
Wang Xixi followed Zhang Le excitedly, taking the elevator to the fifth floor.
Only upon arriving did he remember the circumstances of coming to Alice Apartment.
He had arrived earlier than both Jiang Ran and Qin Fei.
Like Qin Fei, he'd initially maintained vigilance.
After all, if this were just a normal apartment, why pay 10,000 yuan per day?
There had to be something unusual here, but so far, he couldn't detect anything wrong with Alice Apartment.
Whether the units, overall environment, or other residents - everything seemed perfectly normal.
Especially after learning from the welcome party that he wasn't the only new resident, his worries had diminished further.
Even if there were something strange about this apartment, what could possibly happen to a grown man like himself?

chapters.title: Chapter 15: The World's Best Guitar
chapters.content:
For now, he'd take it one day at a time and focus on earning more money. After all, it was ten thousand a day. Where else could you make money this fast? He planned to save enough here to reform his band. He wasn't afraid of whatever mysteries this apartment might hold - what truly scared him was the possibility of not getting paid for his stay, or having the agreement terminated early before he could earn enough.
Soon, he arrived at Room 501 with Zhang Le - Zhang Le's home. Zhang Le entered first, followed by him. Zhang Le paused briefly before casually closing the door behind them.
"Where are the guitars you collect?" Wang Xixi asked eagerly as soon as they entered. He scanned Zhang Le's apartment, noting the excellent decor that carried the distinct vibe of a musician's dwelling.
"In here." Zhang Le pointed toward the bedroom, indicating Wang Xixi should go ahead while he went to the open kitchen to prepare tea.
As a former band vocalist who'd been involved in music for years, Wang Xixi naturally had his favorite instrument - the guitar. That's why he'd followed Zhang Le here. Had Zhang Le collected any other instrument, no matter how rare or autographed by world-famous musicians, Wang Xixi wouldn't have come. But guitars were different.
When he opened the bedroom door, Wang Xixi saw exactly what he'd imagined - guitars. Five of them hung on a pristine white wall - two on each side with one in the center. The four flanking guitars already looked exquisitely crafted and undoubtedly expensive, like fine works of art. But the center one stood out like a king surrounded by its court. The white lightning-shaped guitar bore an English signature - none other than that of Acamellon, the world's greatest guitarist. This signature alone multiplied the guitar's value exponentially.
Wang Xixi was stunned speechless. Forget the signed centerpiece - even the four surrounding guitars were far beyond anything he could ever hope to own. He recognized all four: the Eisen 120, Red Island S, Shell 238, and Hausen 300. Each cost hundreds of thousands. For someone whose own guitar was worth merely five thousand, this sight was intoxicating.
But what truly captivated Wang Xixi was the Martin D200 in the center - the favorite and most frequently used guitar of Acamellon himself. Limited to just 300 worldwide with a starting price of 1.2 million. Wang Xixi could hardly contain his excitement at seeing such a rare instrument here, especially with that priceless signature making it even more valuable. An ordinary guitar with Acamellon's signature would be far less collectible.
"Don't get too excited now. Take your time looking," Zhang Le said with a chuckle as he handed Wang Xixi a cup of tea. But how could Wang Xixi think about tea now? His eyes and heart were completely captivated by the five guitars on that white wall.
"Drink your tea, and I'll let you try playing all five," Zhang Le suddenly offered, making Wang Xixi freeze in disbelief."Really?" His eyes widened.
Zhang Le nodded. "Yes."
Wang Xixi still couldn't believe it. "You're not joking? I can play all five? Even the center one?"
As Zhang Le sipped his tea, leaving Wang Xixi's cup on the nearby table, he replied, "Of course. Aren't guitars meant to be played? The finest guitar becomes worthless if only kept as a collectible. Their value lies in creating music. I play these regularly myself."
Wang Xixi nodded fervently. "You're absolutely right." He never dreamed such an opportunity would come his way. Most collectors guarded their prized instruments jealously - never letting others touch them, barely playing them themselves, and keeping them locked in special cases rather than hung casually on walls like Zhang Le did.
After testing the tea's temperature with a quick touch and sip (he wasn't fond of tea, being more accustomed to bar drinks during his performing days), Wang Xixi gulped down half the cup in one go. Then he rushed to the white wall, carefully taking down the Martin D200 before sitting on the bed to admire it. He cradled the guitar like a delicate beauty rather than an instrument.
Watching from the bedroom doorway, Zhang Le narrowed his eyes and smiled faintly.
Outside Alice Apartment at 9:30 PM, darkness prevailed with only the moon visible against the starless sky. In the quiet night, attentive ears might catch the faint sounds of guitar and song.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
Inside Room 501's bedroom, Wang Xixi played and sang using the 1.2 million yuan signature guitar. His skills as a former lead vocalist were undeniable - both his playing and singing were excellent. The sole audience member, Zhang Le, swayed gently to the music with a look of deep appreciation.
When the song ended, Wang Xixi reluctantly set down the Martin D200. "The difference between a good guitar and an ordinary one is incredible," he marveled. "I thought my few-thousand-yuan guitar was decent enough, but after playing this, I can't bear to put it down! Going back to my old one would feel wrong now. If only I could own a guitar like this in my lifetime..."
Despite his exhilaration, a tinge of sadness remained knowing this guitar wasn't his. If he became a famous singer, a 1.2 million yuan guitar would be nothing. But reality was cruel - in his current situation, such an instrument would forever be beyond his reach.
Hearing this, Zhang Le laughed. "Brother Wang, while your playing and singing are excellent, your discernment needs work."
"Huh? Needs work?" Wang Xixi was puzzled.
Zhang Le explained, "While my Martin D200 is quite good, it's merely a mundane product. Yet you consider owning such an ordinary item the height of your aspirations - doesn't that show poor discernment?"
"Mundane? This is mundane?" Wang Xixi was shocked. How could a limited edition guitar favored by the world's best guitarist be considered ordinary? What then would qualify as extraordinary?
"You must be joking," Wang Xixi said. "This guitar is top-tier. You might find others more expensive, but none significantly better."
Zhang Le smiled. "I'm quite serious. Let me show you the world's best guitar - along with the other world-class instruments in my collection."

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Wang Xixi, Where Do You Think You're Going?
chapters.content:
Wang Xixi still didn't believe Zhang Le's words. Although Zhang Le seemed capable, the claim was just too outrageous. Yet, curiosity got the better of him, and he followed along.
The two left apartment 501 and entered the neighboring 502.
Wang Xixi was surprised to find that 502 also belonged to Zhang Le. But then again, considering the man owned a signed guitar worth 1.2 million, buying two apartments here wasn't that shocking.
Zhang Le opened the door and stepped inside. Wang Xixi followed, noticing the interior had a similar style to 501, except this place was completely empty—no furniture, no appliances, just open space.
Because of that, the living room had plenty of room for other things.
At the moment, a set of musical instruments occupied the space: a drum set, a guitar, a bass, and a keyboard—basically everything needed for a band. If they had enough people, they could start playing right away.
That was the first impression. The second look, however, was different.
Because Wang Xixi realized that the drum set, guitar, bass, and keyboard…
Were unlike anything he had ever seen before.
He took a few steps closer, examining them carefully. Then, with a chuckle, he turned to Zhang Le."Zhang Le, your instruments have a real 'hellish skeleton' vibe, huh?"
The set had an eerie, sinister aura.
Every piece looked as if it had been crafted from bone—white, skeletal structures forming the main body, with other materials serving as accents.
Wang Xixi reached out and touched one, expecting cold metal or some synthetic material made to resemble bone.
But no.
He had never actually touched real bone before, so he couldn't be sure, but…
Zhang Le spoke up.
"These instruments are made of bone."
Wang Xixi nodded. "Yeah, that's… interesting. First time I've ever seen or heard of someone making instruments out of bone. Kinda like those ancient barbarians who turned skulls into drinking cups after killing people."
He paused. "Wait, Zhang Le—are these cow bones? Sheep bones?"
Zhang Le replied flatly, "What do animals know about music? Instruments made from their bones would be worthless. These are made from human bones."
"Specifically, bones from people who understood music."
Wang Xixi froze.
Perhaps because he had hit a topic he was passionate about, Zhang Le suddenly seemed like a little boy proudly showing off his treasures.
Eagerly, he began explaining:
"This drum set? Made from the bones of four drummers."
"That guitar, bass, and keyboard? Each came from two guitarists, bassists, and keyboardists."
As Wang Xixi stared at Zhang Le—standing before those skeletal instruments, enthusiastically detailing their origins—he felt his mind go blank.
Using bones to make instruments was already bizarre.
But human bones?
From actual musicians?
"You're joking, right? Stop messing with me."
Wang Xixi forced a laugh.
Zhang Le grinned back at him—bright, cheerful.
"Do I look like I'm joking?"
Wang Xixi’s smile slowly faded as he stared at Zhang Le’s earnest expression.
…He didn’t seem to be joking.
After a long silence, Wang Xixi muttered, "This is insane. So… this is what you consider 'divine-grade' instruments?"
Zhang Le nodded. "Yes. These surpass all others. They’re the best."
Another pause.
A cold draft swept through the empty apartment—Wang Xixi didn’t know where it came from—but it made him shiver.
He hugged his arms, the initial excitement over the instruments long gone.
"Uh… it's getting late. I’ve seen your collection now, so if there’s nothing else, I should head back. Got work tomorrow."
Just as he turned to leave, Zhang Le blocked his path.
"You can’t go yet."
Wang Xixi tensed. "Why not?"
"You’ve only looked at my bone instruments. You haven’t tried them. How will you know they’re superior if you don’t play them?"
Wang Xixi glanced at the skeletal instruments.
Just the idea of bone-made instruments was unsettling enough.
Actually playing them?
That was a whole other level of discomfort.
And now, knowing they might be made from human bones?
Forget playing—even touching or holding them felt horrifying.
"Nah, you play. I’ll listen."
Zhang Le nodded, then walked over and picked up the bone guitar.
The silver strings glinted under the light as his fingers moved.
Wang Xixi really wanted to leave, but his love for guitars kept him rooted. Despite his unease, he listened carefully.
Maybe his musical ear wasn’t refined enough.
He could tell the craftsmanship was masterful—this guitar sounded far better than his cheap one.
But when comparing it to that 1.2-million signed guitar?
Which was better?
He honestly couldn’t tell.Thɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
So when Zhang Le finished playing and asked for his opinion, Wang Xixi admitted he couldn’t decide.
Zhang Le said nothing.
Just stared at him with those unsettling eyes.
The silence made Wang Xixi’s skin crawl.
A bad feeling crept up from the depths of his mind.
"I’m gonna go."
He turned toward the door—only to find it wouldn’t open.
No matter how hard he tried, it wouldn’t budge.
He looked back. "Zhang Le, open the door. I’m tired, I need to sleep. Work tomorrow, y’know?"
His voice was tense but still polite.
Zhang Le ignored the request. Instead, he asked:
"Wang Xixi, what do you think my band setup is missing?"
The atmosphere was already chilling. The empty apartment. The eerie instruments.
And Zhang Le himself—something about him felt off.
Wang Xixi had no patience for this.
"I don’t know."
Zhang Le sighed in disappointment.
"Ah… you’re a lead singer, yet you didn’t notice? There’s one crucial thing missing."
"I have all the instruments. But no microphone. What’s a band without a lead singer’s microphone?"
"Oh. Got it. So… can I leave now?"
That bad feeling in Wang Xixi’s gut was getting worse.
Zhang Le smiled.
"Leave? If you go, how will I make my microphone? I’m out of materials."
He spread his hands helplessly.
And then—
The realization hit.
"ZHANG LE! STOP JOKING AROUND! THIS ISN’T FUNNY!"
Zhang Le tilted his head.
"Who’s joking? You really can’t leave. You’re the material for my microphone. If you go, I’ll be in trouble."
As he spoke, he reached into a kitchen cabinet and pulled out a gleaming cleaver—sharp, menacing.
Holding the blade, Zhang Le grinned, his lips stretching unnaturally wide.
Step by step, he advanced toward Wang Xixi.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: The First Dead Guinea Pig: Wang Xixi
chapters.content:
Wang Xixi was truly terrified by the scene before him, goosebumps rising all over his body. He retreated to the door, unable to open it, so he kicked it with all his might, but the door was unusually sturdy.
The door wouldn't budge.
Turning his head, he saw Zhang Le getting closer, so he screamed for help at the top of his lungs.
But after shouting for a long time, not only did no one come to rescue him, but the corridor remained completely silent, deathly quiet.
He then took out his phone, preparing to call for help.
But bizarrely, his phone had no signal at all!!!
Zhang Le stopped about three meters away from Wang Xixi, chuckling darkly:
"Stop struggling. When I renovated this apartment, I soundproofed it and installed signal jammers. So don't expect anyone to save you."
Hearing this, Wang Xixi felt despair creeping in.
But staring at Zhang Le, who was even skinnier than himself, despite the sharp cleaver in his hand, Wang Xixi thought he might still have a fighting chance.So he tensed his body, preparing to lunge forward and snatch the cleaver away.
Yet at that very moment, he discovered his body wouldn't obey him.
His legs went weak.
This weakness gradually spread throughout his entire body, his arms and hands becoming limp as noodles.
The next second, he collapsed to the floor, leaning against the door.
Now helpless as a lamb, he realized he was truly doomed.
"Zhang Le! Seriously, stop joking around! Murder is illegal! And even if your instruments are made from human bones, they must be from people who died long ago, right?! You wouldn't use living people?!"
Wang Xixi desperately hoped Zhang Le was just playing an elaborate prank on him.
"Long-dead people have dead musical cells in their bones too."
"That's why I need fresh ones, just like fish. Would you prefer soup made from live fish or dead fish?"
Zhang Le only uttered these two sentences before approaching Wang Xixi.
His left hand was surprisingly strong as it grabbed Wang Xixi's right leg and dragged him toward the bedroom.
Wang Xixi struggled with all his might, but his limbs remained limp.
In this life-or-death crisis, he suddenly remembered a movie character's line:
"My fate is mine to control, not heaven's! Whether I become demon or immortal is my choice..."
"AAAAAH! HELP!!!"
He screamed helplessly in complete breakdown.
Finally, he was dragged to the bedroom doorway, where he saw the scene inside through the open door.
There stood a silver metal execution table, with various metal tools hanging on the walls. Despite the cleanliness of the space, a faint scent of blood still lingered.
At this moment, Wang Xixi truly despaired.
He could literally smell his own death approaching.
In his despair, he suddenly remembered why he had come to Alice Apartment.
He seemed to understand now why they offered such favorable conditions - 10,000 yuan per day.
But no one had ever told him the price would be his life?!
...
The "Neighbors Over Distant Relatives" live stream room.
This was the top-ranked live stream room on the Black Software platform.
With at least 100,000 viewers online 24/7, the numbers would sometimes suddenly drop by 50,000-60,000.
Those moments were exactly like now - when a guinea pig was being executed.
Because the scenes were too gruesome, some viewers couldn't handle it and would exit, only returning after it was over.
After all, this wasn't a movie or documentary - everything was happening in real time.
While the wealthy viewers here were clearly twisted to be watching this, even they had their limits.
Some couldn't watch more than a few seconds without feeling sick, while others watched with relish.
Like Diamond Bachelor, a real-life wealthy heiress.
Currently eating sushi prepared by her chef, she watched as Zhang Le skillfully used his tools to perform inhuman "artistic processing" on Wang Xixi.
Wang Xixi's agonized screams emanated from her computer, echoing through her princess-themed bedroom as Diamond Bachelor watched entranced.
Her appetite whetted, she popped sushi into her mouth one after another.
The execution lasted nearly three hours.
The Wang Xixi on screen was now beyond "horrifically mutilated."
Motionless, he appeared to have peacefully departed.
Then.
The long-haired beauty host reappeared on stream.
Now wearing a form-fitting purple-red cheongsam that accentuated her curves.
A smile graced her delicate features as she spoke softly: "Of our five guinea pigs, the second one - Wang Xixi - has died."
"The 50.98 million yuan in bets have all been transferred to the final prize pool."
On the large electronic screen behind her, five portraits were displayed. Wang Xixi's was now grayed out with a large red X over it.
[My money...]
[Sigh... This sucks. The two most normal-looking ones were Wang Xixi and Murong Fu, yet Wang Xixi was first to go. Damn idiot Wang Xixi!]
Those who bet on Wang Xixi cursed him relentlessly.
Then Middle-aged Uncle chimed in: [Don't blame Wang Xixi for your losses - blame yourselves. As longtime viewers, you should know Alice Apartment has that Zhang Le who specifically targets musical guinea pigs for his instruments.]
[We knew, but Zhang Le hadn't been active for so long, and didn't participate in recent welcome activities. Who knew he'd show up this round?]
The welcome activities, ostensibly ordinary, actually introduced new prey to all Alice Apartment residents.
Domineering Female CEO joined: [Middle-aged Uncle, who did you bet on?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Murong Fu!]
Domineering Female CEO: [What a coincidence - me too.]
Fairy Sister: [Me too.]
Little Dragon Girl: [Same here.]
I am the Hero: [I also bet on Murong Fu, but now I'm more curious who's next to die?]
[Well, Wang Xixi's experience serves as a warning - never accept drinks from strangers.]
[If Wang Xixi hadn't drunk that tea Zhang Le gave him, he might've stood a chance to resist.]
...
The day after Wang Xixi's skull was transformed into a microphone.
Jiang Ran woke early for work. In the elevator down, he encountered Murong Fu.
Murong Fu also appeared headed to work.
As new residents, they exchanged greetings.
Alice Apartment Room 302.
Qin Fei's first act upon waking was checking his phone.
Having stayed up gaming in bed last night, intending to wait until 1 AM for the 10,000 yuan transfer, he'd unexpectedly fallen asleep.
Thus his morning priority was checking for messages.
Unlocking his phone, he saw an unread notification.
After reading it, he literally jumped for joy.
"Holy shit! 10,000 yuan! A full 10,000! It's real! The money's here!!!"
Yesterday he'd still doubted the promised daily 10,000 yuan, but now with cash in hand, all reservations vanished.
"Perfect timing - I need equipment upgrades. This 10,000 should cover it."
With the money secured, Qin Fei immediately recharged over 9,000 yuan into his game, completely forgetting about the tens of thousands he'd already spent of his parents' hard-earned money and his online loans.Thɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
In Room 904, Xiao Nuo found herself in the same situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 18: 804 Wang Tao
chapters.content:
The first thing Xiao Nuo did after waking up in the morning was check her phone. When she saw the notification about the 10,000 yuan deposit, her reaction mirrored Qin Fei's joy.
Normally someone who slept during the day and went clubbing at night, she unusually stayed awake this time and immediately contacted her friends to arrange a spending spree. Within five minutes, she had gathered her crew - including several boys, one of whom happened to be her crush.
Excited, Xiao Nuo got out of bed to prepare for the midday meetup with her friends and her special someone. She lived in apartment 904, while directly below in 804 lived a man in his thirties.
This man had also woken up, though his morning ritual involved spending an hour sunbathing on the balcony. Today, as he gazed at the beautiful scenery beyond his balcony, he felt profoundly grateful to be alive. Only in these moments could he truly feel his existence - vivid and tangible.
The man's name was Wang Tao, age 32. Formerly a high-ranking white-collar worker with substantial income, he had what seemed like a perfect life - a beautiful, capable wife and two adorable children. The epitome of success.
Until everything shattered a year ago.
He discovered his wife's infidelity. Worse yet, neither child was biologically his. The revelation devastated him - he would have accepted even just one being his own.
One day, he lied to his wife about a business trip. In truth, he planned to catch her in the act. The next morning, his trap succeeded. A violent argument erupted between him, his wife, and her lover. Overcome with rage, he killed them both.
To his shock, the children woke during the commotion. Seeing their mother and the other man lying in pools of blood, they rushed forward crying "Mommy! Daddy!" Realizing they'd always known he wasn't their real father - that the dead man was - Wang Tao's fury erupted anew. He stabbed both children to death.
Four lives ended in one night. Most would panic after such an act, but Wang Tao felt little fear. Why? Because this wasn't his first killing.As a child, he'd accidentally pushed a playmate into a river. Terrified but silent, he never told anyone. When the missing child was eventually found drowned, it was ruled an accident. His first escape.
In college, he fell for a brilliant, beautiful classmate - his goddess. When she rejected his confession, claiming she wanted to focus on studies, he admired her dedication. Until he discovered her secret relationship with a handsome but dimwitted classmate.Follow current novels on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"Study focus" had been a lie. Cold toward him but throwing herself at another. So began his second, premeditated murder. After stalking the couple to their meeting spot in an abandoned building, he raped the girl before killing them both. Three entered, one left.
The wife and children had been his third killing. As a highly intelligent graduate, he covered his tracks perfectly. To outsiders, his family had simply vanished.
Now living alone, Wang Tao soon had new neighbors above him - a noisy family. Repeated complaints to them and management failed. His patience exhausted, he committed his fourth murder.
This time, misfortune struck. Unbeknownst to him, the family had invited relatives over that day. Caught red-handed, he expected execution after arrest. Miraculously, a mysterious man visited him in custody, striking a deal that spared his life.
The price? Permanent residence in Alice Apartment with strictly limited movement - though he could wander nearby. Additionally, he received 10,000 yuan monthly allowance. Wang Tao accepted gladly; he should have been dead anyway.
Eyes closed, Wang Tao basked in the sunlight's warmth...
At noon, Xiao Nuo met her friends - five boys and six girls, all around her age. Gathering in a park, they discussed evening plans.
"Xiao Nuo, are we clubbing tonight?" someone asked.
Xiao Nuo scoffed. "Clubbing every night is boring. Let's party at my place!"
"Your place? The villa?" a girl asked excitedly.
Xiao Nuo shook her head. "No, my parents bought me a new place. They said I was too noisy at home so made me move out."
"Wow! You're amazing, Xiao Nuo! Having your own place so young!"
"I'm jealous! My sister and I still share a rented room!"
"Xiao Nuo is incredible!"
The compliments inflated Xiao Nuo's ego. Among these friends, she always played the rich heiress, maintaining dominant status.
The prettiest girl in the group suddenly sneered, "A new house? I'd love to see this 'new house.'"
This girl, called Xiao Hua by everyone, had been the group's leader before Xiao Nuo joined. Though from an ordinary family, her beauty and style had secured her position - until Xiao Nuo's "rich girl" persona dethroned her. Resentment had festered ever since.

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Jiang Ran and Zhang Le Meet
chapters.content:
More importantly, Xiao Hua had discovered that Xiao Nuo had feelings for her boyfriend.
His name was Xiao Peng.
He was the most handsome among the five boys—Xiao Nuo's crush.
Considering both points, Xiao Hua detested Xiao Nuo.
But there was nothing she could do about it.
During one incident, Xiao Hua suspected that Xiao Nuo's identity as a wealthy heiress might be fake.
So she kept targeting this weakness.
"Wait until tonight when you all come to my place. Then you'll know for sure?"
Xiao Nuo smirked triumphantly,
her gaze provocatively fixed on Xiao Hua.Among the group, everyone else had already bought into her rich heiress persona.
After all, she had been meticulously faking it—her clothes, accessories, and lifestyle were all high-class.
But somehow, Xiao Hua had caught onto something and kept questioning her.
Heh, tonight, once they saw her new apartment, let’s see how Xiao Hua could still doubt her.
With that thought, she cast a tender glance at Xiao Peng, who was dressed in trendy Japanese-Korean fashion.
Xiao Peng noticed her gaze and responded with a gentle smile.
Xiao Nuo's heart fluttered with joy.
When she first joined this friend group, she had immediately fallen for the handsome Xiao Peng.
But she knew she wasn’t as naturally pretty as Xiao Hua, so she had to rely on other things.
If not for that, she wouldn’t have taken out so many online loans to maintain her wealthy heiress act. Before this, though she loved luxury brands and had a taste for vanity, her spending wasn’t this extreme.
It was only after meeting these people that her expenses ballooned, forcing her to borrow heavily.
"Tonight, once Xiao Peng sees my place, he’ll probably completely side with me, right?"
The thought flickered through her mind.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
……
For the rest of the afternoon, Xiao Nuo and the group went wild—watching movies, visiting an amusement park, and trying an escape room.
Of course, Xiao Nuo paid for everything while the others freeloaded.
As evening approached,
Xiao Nuo led them to a supermarket, buying loads of ingredients for a house party.
7:17 PM.
Jiang Ran dragged his exhausted body back to Alice Apartment.
Because the original owner had taken on multiple jobs to earn money—
just to spite his ex-girlfriend who dumped him—
his schedule was brutal.
First job: Online customer service for an e-shop (work-from-home).
Second and third jobs: Part-time gigs.
One was hourly work at KFC, the other a night shift at Sam’s Club.
This was also why the original owner had died from overwork at home.
Jiang Ran didn’t want to drop dead, even if he needed money for better medicine.
Between sudden death and being broke, he’d choose being broke—at least he’d still be alive.
So today, he went to both places and quit his part-time jobs. But since they were short-staffed, he had to keep working for a while longer.
"Hm? What’s going on over there?"
After entering Alice Apartment, Jiang Ran spotted a noisy group of about ten people ahead.
Their laughter and chatter reached his ears as he observed the college-aged boys and girls.
"Ah, youth," he mused to himself.
He followed them into the elevator,
only for it to beep—overloaded.
With no other choice, Jiang Ran stepped out to wait for the next one.
The elevator stopped at the 9th floor, then the 5th, and finally returned to the 1st.
When the doors opened, a stylishly dressed man walked out.
Jiang Ran recognized him and greeted him.
The man, having just exited the elevator, nodded back.
Jiang Ran then asked, "After yesterday’s welcome event with Wang Xixi, how did your music discussion go?"
The man was Zhang Le from Room 501.
Zhang Le smiled. "We really clicked."
Jiang Ran nodded. "Oh? Once you two form the band, you’ve gotta let me know! I’ll be your first audience!"
Zhang Le: "Definitely. Oh, Jiang Ran, I haven’t introduced myself properly—I’m Zhang Le. By the way, do you play any instruments? Right now, the band’s just me and Wang Xixi. He’s the vocalist, I’m the guitarist. We still need a bassist, drummer, and keyboardist."
Jiang Ran shook his head. "Nope, not at all. I’ve got all five notes, but I’m a total music idiot.
That’s why I admire you musicians. What if one of your songs suddenly blows up? Then you’d be rolling in cash with tons of girls chasing after you."
Zhang Le burst out laughing.
"Hahaha, I guess most people get into music for the fame and money. But for me, it’s purely about pursuing the music in my heart. As for fame—well, I do want more people to hear my work. Money? Not really something I lack."
After chatting a bit longer, they went their separate ways.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room—
The conversation between the two sparked some discussion.
[Hey, do you think Zhang Le will keep killing now that he’s got all the instruments for his band?]
[Good question. No idea.]
[Then why butt in?]
[I’ll answer. I think he’s done. Killers like him target specific victims to create their ‘perfect instruments.’ Now that he’s achieved that, he won’t kill again.]
[Agreed.]
[Same.]
[I think so too.]
[I disagree. If he’s really stopped, why did he ask Jiang Ran if he played any instruments?]
[Uh… maybe just making conversation?]
……
"Wow, Xiao Nuo, this is your place? It’s gorgeous!"
The moment Xiao Nuo’s group arrived outside Alice Apartment, they were already in awe.
Just from the exterior, it was clear this was a high-end residence for the wealthy.
After looking up the property prices online, they were even more convinced.
When they entered the apartment and reached Xiao Nuo’s unit—904—the interior décor left them dazzled.
They looked like country bumpkins in comparison.
Xiao Nuo was basking in the attention. "Alright, alright, there’s plenty of time to look around tonight. Who can cook? A few of you, come help set up the hot pot!"
"I’ll do it!"
Xiao Peng was the first to volunteer.
Xiao Nuo’s heart soared seeing her crush step up to help.
Meanwhile, Xiao Hua watched as her boyfriend ignored her feelings to assist Xiao Nuo.
Naturally, she was furious.
But beneath the anger, she sensed something worse—his heart might no longer be with her.
Before, he would’ve considered her feelings. Now, after seeing Xiao Nuo’s apartment, the scales had tipped completely.
Thanks to Xiao Peng’s help, Xiao Nuo kept the kitchen to just the two of them—even though it was an open layout.
She didn’t want anyone interrupting their moment.
The others wandered around, admiring her home.
Only Xiao Hua sat sulking on the sofa, staring blankly at her phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: The High-IQ Criminal - Wang Tao
chapters.content:
804.
Wang Tao was enjoying his dinner.
Today he was eating frozen steak he bought online, learning how to pan-fry it from online tutorials, along with some pasta.
He also had some red wine as his drink.
Of course, he wasn't idle while eating - he watched TV in the living room as he dined.
When he first moved into Alice Apartment 804, the installed TV was 30 inches. Now it was 99 inches.
The ultra-large screen was truly satisfying.
To be honest, he never used to like watching TV or movies.
During school, he buried himself in studies. After graduation, he was busy with company sales.
He rarely lived for himself.But in this past year at Alice Apartment, he'd finally started living for himself, trying things he'd rarely or never done before.
Like watching TV and movies.
Wang Tao wasn't sure if he was some kind of psychopath.
He didn't care for other genres, only loving foreign horror and thriller films.
Such as: "The Texas Chainsaw Massacre," "House of Wax," "Friday the 13th."
Right now he was watching a foreign film: "It."
He turned off all the lights, only lighting five white candles on the coffee table, creating an intense atmosphere.
Just as Wang Tao was getting into it, during the film's climax,
Thumping and banging noises came from upstairs.
He frowned and looked up at the ceiling.
Shortly after the movie started, chaotic noises had begun from upstairs.
They'd stop, then start again. Stop, then start again.
This was already the fifth time.
He couldn't take it anymore.
So he turned on the lights, went out, intending to go upstairs to 904 and ask what was going on.
Reaching the 9th floor, he heard chattering in the hallway. The noise grew louder as he approached 904.
Wang Tao looked around - he couldn't understand how other 9th floor residents tolerated this.
He certainly couldn't.
So he knocked firmly. No answer the first time. Only after the second knock did the door open.
A tall male student around 20 years old answered.
He stood a head taller than Wang Tao, with a much larger frame.
"What's up?"
The tall student looked down calmly at Wang Tao.
Wang Tao said evenly: "I live downstairs in 804. Could you keep it down a bit? Stop jumping around on the floor. It's disturbing my rest."
As he spoke, Wang Tao suddenly remembered his fourth murder victims - that family.
He'd gone to reason with them, but it didn't work, and they had terrible attitudes.
"Oh, sorry about that, we'll be more careful."
Hearing this, the tall student looked genuinely apologetic.
Seeing this attitude, Wang Tao thought college students were easier to reason with.
Problem seemingly solved, Wang Tao turned to leave. Through the gap before the door closed, he saw quite a few people inside.
Probably college students having a party.
This made Wang Tao recall his own college days.
The campus goddess he'd admired.
Whom he'd personally strangled.
But his love for her had been real, just like with the wife he later married.
They got together because she resembled his college crush.
Too bad all these women turned out to be promiscuous.
"Hey, who was at the door? My food delivery?"
Inside 904, a female student asked the tall guy who'd spoken with Wang Tao.
Tall guy: "No, some guy from downstairs asking us to keep quiet."
"Keep quiet? Are we being loud? This is an apartment! If he wants quiet he should get a villa! Right, Xiao Nuo?"
The female student complained indignantly to Xiao Nuo.
Xiao Nuo was currently in the kitchen being lovey-dovey with her crush.
So she just absently agreed, "Yeah, yeah."
Wang Tao returned to 804 and resumed watching "It."
As he watched, a question arose in his mind: Could supernatural monsters like this actually exist?
Just as this grand hypothesis was forming - perhaps something worthy of textbooks someday - more thumping noises came from upstairs, disturbing his peace.
Wang Tao frowned and checked the time.
Only ten minutes had passed, and they were at it again?
After waiting a few more minutes with no improvement, he had no choice but to return to 904's door.
This time a different male student answered.
"Could you keep it down? Stop making all that banging noise."
"Oh. Sorry, we'll be more careful."
Wang Tao gave the student an annoyed look before leaving.
"Who was it? My delivery?"
The same female student who'd asked earlier questioned again.
The male student replied: "No, that guy from downstairs again."ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"Him? What does he want now?"
"Told us to be quieter, walk softer, stop banging on the floor."
"Ugh, what a buzzkill. If he comes again, I'll answer."
Meanwhile, in the live stream room...
Although viewers could freely choose camera angles from any floor or room,
The main camera still had the most viewers because it was AI-controlled,
Automatically switching to the most interesting parts of the apartment.
Currently the most interesting part was Wang Tao's interactions with lab rat Xiao Nuo and her group.
Even though nothing major had happened yet.
Domineering Female CEO: [I don't remember this Wang Tao from 804. Has he killed anyone in the apartment?]
Little Dragon Girl: [I don't think so? I don't recognize him at all. Anyone else?]
[No impression.]
[Same, don't remember him.]
Domineering Female CEO: [Let me check his profile then.]
Viewers could access any resident's information in Alice Apartment.
Soon, they'd all reviewed Wang Tao's records.
Domineering Female CEO exclaimed: [This Wang Tao's vicious even by normal standards! Accidentally killed someone as a kid, murdered his college crush and her boyfriend, later killed his cheating wife and children that weren't his, then murdered his upstairs neighbors. A born killer!]
Little Dragon Girl: [True, this background is rare - killing since childhood. But what stands out most is he was always top student, went to elite university, got high position at major company - a real high-IQ criminal. Much more interesting than your average thug.]
The middle-aged uncle who hadn't appeared all day suddenly commented excitedly:
[Damn, I know this Wang Tao! He was middle management at a partner company. When he got arrested, I followed the case forever. Thought he'd been executed! How'd he end up in Alice Apartment?]

chapters.title: Chapter 21: The Missing Female Student
chapters.content:
Most viewers in the live stream room had somewhat adapted to the situation where people who should have received death sentences were now living in Alice Apartment. After all, the power behind Black Software was unfathomable. Pulling death row inmates out was basically standard procedure for them.
Middle-aged Uncle continued: [Back then, I remember having afternoon tea with his company boss, and we talked about Wang Tao. His boss said he never expected Wang Tao to be that kind of person - what a shame! Despite being a murderer, Wang Tao's professional skills were unquestionable!]
Fairy Sister replied: [Really? A top performer! In that case, we're in for a good show. Wang Tao's fourth murder was because of noisy upstairs neighbors. Isn't this situation identical now? Let's see how a highly educated criminal commits his crimes!]
804 Room.
9:00 PM.
Wang Tao had just finished watching "It" and, since it was still early, decided to watch another horror thriller. Say what you will, but foreign horror movies were genuinely thrilling and enjoyable.
Just as he started browsing for another suitable horror film, the all-too-familiar noise came from the ceiling again. Wang Tao was truly exasperated. These college students had promised not to make noise, yet here they were breaking their word again so soon.
"People's manners these days are truly terrible," Wang Tao muttered as he decided to go upstairs and confront them again.
At 904, loud knocking sounded at the door.
"Don't anyone else answer it! I'll get it - I'll give that downstairs neighbor a piece of my mind!" The same female student from before angrily opened the door, ready to unleash a torrent of abuse, only to find it wasn't the downstairs neighbor but her finally arrived food delivery."Hello, your delivery," said a simple-looking, honest-faced middle-aged man in purple delivery uniform from an app called Lightning Delivery.
Though it wasn't the downstairs neighbor, the female student still frowned as she took the food: "Hey, do you know you're late? I ordered at 8 PM and it's already past 9! You're over an hour late! My family bucket of fried chicken is completely cold now!" She opened the packaging and touched the paper bucket containing various fried chicken pieces while complaining.
"There's no way around it - I'm definitely giving you a bad rating!"
The middle-aged deliveryman, already apologetic for being late, began pleading desperately upon hearing about the bad rating: "Please don't give me a bad rating! I didn't mean to be late - something came up on the road. I know I messed up and I'm really sorry, but you can always reheat the chicken in the microwave..."
The female student's already frowning face turned icy upon hearing this: "Still making excuses? It's your fault for being late - take responsibility! And you're a whole hour late!!!" With that, she took out her phone to give the poor deliveryman a bad rating.
At this moment, the tall male student called from the couch: "Enough, stop bothering with the delivery guy! Come eat hot pot! That stuff can be reheated anyway!"
Ignoring him, the female student proceeded to give the bad rating on her phone, then threw the humble, honest-looking deliveryman one last contemptuous glare before turning away.
"Hmm? Why is there a deliveryman here?" Wang Tao had also arrived at 904's door. As he reached it, he passed by the purple-uniformed Lightning Delivery worker.
The female student, having just finished submitting her bad rating, was about to close the door when she spotted Wang Tao arriving. "Who are you?" she asked.
Wang Tao shifted his gaze from the deliveryman to the female student and said: "I live downstairs. Are you guys going to keep making noise endlessly? This is already my third time coming up here!"
Hearing this, the female student thought to herself that he'd come asking for it, and said loudly: "We're not doing it on purpose! With so many of us, some noise is inevitable! And it's just tonight that's a bit rowdy - it's not like this happens every night! Can't you just deal with it?!"
"Besides, you should know you're not living in a villa! If you want complete quiet all the time, go live in a villa then!" Before Wang Tao could respond, she slammed the door shut with a bang, leaving him standing outside in stunned silence.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Inside the apartment, the female student returned to the couch and said proudly to the others: "Let me tell you, with people like this, you can't be nice. Give them an inch and they'll take a mile - coming up here again and again. So annoying! You have to be direct like I was to solve the problem once and for all." As she spoke, she stole a glance at Xiao Hua, who was sitting farthest from her, and saw Xiao Hua giving her a slight nod of approval.
Outside the door, Wang Tao stood completely still for about ten seconds before finally moving again. Staring at the 904 doorplate, a flash of ruthlessness and violence appeared in his eyes.
He remembered something the man who brought him to Alice Apartment had said: You can do anything you want here - it's a world of complete freedom.
But what if what he wanted to do... was the same thing he'd already done four times before?
......
Because Xiao Nuo's group had stayed up too late eating hot pot and playing Werewolf the night before, they all ended up sleeping at Xiao Nuo's place. There weren't enough beds, so many had to sleep on the floor - fortunately it was almost summer, so with just a thin quilt underneath, it wasn't too uncomfortable.
The next morning around 9 AM, the students began gradually waking up, and it wasn't until past 11 AM that everyone was finally awake. Upon waking, they all felt groggy and disoriented, like they'd lost their souls.
After a long period of recovery, by noon they had all regained their energy. Once fully awake, they each ordered delivery food. While waiting for their food, they occupied themselves with phones, TV, or casual conversation.
"Hey, what are you looking for?" Xiao Peng, Xiao Nuo's crush, noticed the tallest male student in their group - the same one who had first answered the door when the downstairs neighbor came knocking yesterday - anxiously moving from bathroom to bedroom to balcony, clearly searching for something.
"I'm looking for Xiao Ju! Wang Ju! I just realized Wang Ju is missing!" The tall male student frowned as he returned from the balcony to the living room.
Hearing this, the group looked at each other and realized they indeed hadn't seen Wang Ju since waking up. Wang Ju was the female student who had yelled at both the Lightning Delivery worker and Wang Tao the day before.
"Try calling her. Maybe she woke up earlier and already left," someone suggested.
The tall male student took out his phone and called Wang Ju, but no one answered. He tried messaging her on WeChat, but still got no response.
"No reply, and she's not answering her phone."
"Hmm... maybe she's busy right now and not looking at her phone. Hey, wait - why are you so concerned about Wang Ju anyway? Do you like her? How come you're the only one who noticed she's missing?" Xiao Peng suddenly asked with a teasing smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Nowhere to Be Found, Mysterious Disappearance
chapters.content:
"Uh... no, how could that be..." the tall male student stammered defensively.
That's what he said.
But his hesitant manner and suddenly flushed cheeks completely betrayed him.
"If you like her, just confess boldly! She doesn't have a boyfriend anyway!"
"Exactly! Secret crushes never lead anywhere! Strike early, enjoy early!"
Everyone teased him.
The tall male student's face turned even redder.
Giving up on explanations, he sat on a nearby chair, waiting for Wang Ju's reply on his phone.
But by the time their takeout arrived and they'd finished eating, already discussing afternoon and evening entertainment plans...
Wang Ju still hadn't responded.Now the tall male student couldn't sit still anymore, and the others also lost their earlier relaxed mood.
In this day and age, everyone's glued to their phones.
Few people go hours without checking their phones unless they're genuinely busy or deliberately ignoring you.
Genuinely busy? Impossible - they were all college students with plenty of free time.
As for deliberately ignoring - even if Wang Ju wanted to ignore the tall male student, would she ignore everyone else?
They'd all sent messages, yet no one got a reply.
"I'm going back to campus to look for her."
The tall male student stood up to leave.
At this point, Xiao Peng's girlfriend Xiao Hua also stood up: "Wait, I'll go with you. I'm her roommate, and you can't enter the girls' dorm alone anyway."
So the two left Xiao Nuo's apartment together.
Wang Ju's sudden disappearance somewhat dampened the remaining group's cheerful mood.
Of course, they still weren't overly worried about Wang Ju.Follow current novels on
Just figured she must be busy with something, not even checking messages.
But half an hour later, when they received a call from the tall male student and Xiao Hua who had returned to campus to check...
All traces of laughter vanished.
Their nerves instantly tensed up.
[What? You say Xiao Ju didn't return to campus?]
[Right, I went to the dorm and asked other roommates - none of them saw Xiao Ju return!]
[If she's not at the dorm, where could she be? Her hometown is in another province, and she doesn't have other friends or relatives here.]
At this point, the tall male student grabbed the phone from Xiao Hua.
[Wang Ju must be in trouble! You guys go to the first floor - yesterday I saw the apartment manager there. Check the surveillance to see if she left yesterday! Find out where she went!!!!]
Xiao Peng took this call.
Having put it on speaker, after hanging up he immediately gathered everyone to go downstairs to find manager Xiao Zhang and check the surveillance footage.
Xiao Nuo, Xiao Peng and the others took the elevator from the ninth floor down to the third.
At the third floor, someone entered.
None other than Jiang Ran.
Having just finished his morning shift as online store customer service, Jiang Ran was heading out to buy drinks to refresh himself.
When the elevator doors opened, he saw those college students from last night.
He entered the elevator.
Leaning against a corner, his gaze unintentionally swept across their faces.
Noticing that while these students had been cheerful last night, now they looked anxious and troubled, as if something weighed on them.
Unlike others who might ignore it indifferently, Jiang Ran asked: "What's wrong? You all look tense - did something happen?"
Xiao Nuo started to answer but was pulled back by Xiao Peng.
Xiao Peng forced a smile.
"Nothing."
"Definitely something," Jiang Ran thought, but since they didn't want to talk, he wouldn't force his curiosity.
The elevator soon reached the first floor.
Everyone exited, Jiang Ran watching as the students hurried anxiously toward manager Xiao Zhang's office.
Coincidentally, Xiao Zhang emerged from a room just then to take out trash.
Poor Xiao Zhang hadn't even disposed of the trash before being herded by the students into the surveillance room.
Inside the surveillance room:
"You're saying a friend is missing, so you want to check the footage?"
Manager Xiao Zhang looked puzzled as he began pulling up the recordings.
"Where to check? We have cameras at the apartment entrance - can see which direction your friend went after leaving."
"Okay, show us the entrance then."
Clearly Xiao Peng was the group's leader.
"What time?"
"From around 11pm last night!"
"Alright."
Xiao Zhang seemed inexperienced with surveillance systems, operating somewhat clumsily.
But within five minutes, last night's entrance footage appeared.
First visible was the security booth and electronic gate.
"Fast forward," Xiao Peng said.
Manager Xiao Zhang nodded.
Alice Apartment's high-end cameras had night vision.
So despite being nighttime, everything was clearly visible.
At 8x speed,
Xiao Peng and the others stared unblinking at the screen.
They saw occasional security patrols, passersby outside, or cars.
But Wang Ju's figure - nowhere to be seen.
"The footage has reached current time - seems your friend never left the apartment?"
After reviewing, manager Xiao Zhang turned to say.
"This... how?!"
Now the students exchanged looks as if seeing ghosts.
They'd assumed Wang Ju left the apartment but didn't return to campus, so wanted to trace her steps after exiting.
Yet after all that footage - no sign of Wang Ju?
"How many exits does this apartment have?"
"Just one."
"Then where is she? If she didn't leave, where'd she go?"
"Should I pull up your hallway footage? If she didn't exit, the cameras would've caught her in the building."
"Fine."
"Your room number?"
"904."
"Start time?"
"Same, 11pm last night."
Manager Xiao Zhang began retrieving the footage again.
After starting the playback, he took his trash out.
Leaving Xiao Peng's group watching the monitors.
After disposing the trash, Xiao Zhang smoked a few cigarettes in the apartment's smoking area before returning.
Soon after returning, he noticed the surveillance room's atmosphere had grown even more oppressive than before.
"What's wrong?"
Manager Xiao Zhang asked, confused.
Xiao Peng looked up with a ghostly expression: "We watched at 64x speed."
"Up to current time - from 11pm last night, no one left 904."
As he spoke, Xiao Peng's face turned deathly pale.
The others looked similarly affected.
Their complexions like corpses with white makeup.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: It Wasn't Wang Tao After All
chapters.content:
"So your friend is still in 904?" asked the apartment manager Xiao Zhang.
Xiao Nuo immediately retorted, "No! If she was, would we be checking the surveillance footage?"
That's right. Earlier, the tall male student had already searched every corner of room 904 for Wang Ju before they began this investigation.
Manager Xiao Zhang frowned in confusion. "What's going on? Ghost activity? The surveillance didn't capture your friend leaving the room or the apartment building, meaning she should still be in 904. But she's nowhere to be found. Did she vanish into thin air inside 904?!"
"Could she have left earlier? Maybe you checked the wrong timeframe?"
While Xiao Zhang was asking these questions, Xiao Peng and the other college students had already walked out of the surveillance room, clearly ignoring the manager.
Xiao Zhang pouted and sat back down to play with his phone.
When the students reached the lobby, the tall male student and Xiao Hua returned from their search. They immediately asked about the surveillance findings, which Xiao Peng explained.
Both the tall male student and Xiao Hua's eyes widened in disbelief.
"Did I really search so poorly? Is Wang Ju still in the apartment?" The tall male student began doubting himself.The others suggested, "Let's go back and search together."
So the group of college students returned to 904.
But even with nearly a dozen people combing through every inch of the apartment, they found no trace of Wang Ju.
"Damn it, Wang Ju! Where are you?! Where the hell are you?!" The tall male student was nearly in tears from desperation. Clearly, he had feelings for Wang Ju—all his earlier excuses had been lies.
Then a male student suddenly said, "If the surveillance didn't catch her leaving, maybe she went out through the window?"
"The window? This is the ninth floor! How could anyone leave through the window?" a female student countered.
But the next second, everyone—including the girl who'd just objected—fell silent as they realized what the boy truly meant.
No one could voluntarily leave through a ninth-floor window unless they could fly. But what if... it had been an accidental fall? If she'd stumbled out the window while drunk...
Remember, they'd been drinking last night...
The tall male student immediately rushed to the balcony window to look down, both hoping and dreading to see something. Others checked the remaining windows, but found nothing. Eventually, the whole group went downstairs to search the area directly beneath the ninth-floor windows.
After circling the area multiple times, they found neither Wang Ju nor any of her belongings—not even the slightest trace.
"Call the police! We need to call the police now!" The tall male student took out his phone to make the call.
Xiao Peng interjected, "I think they won't file a missing person report until 48 hours have passed."
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
[Where did that girl Wang Ju go? I didn't stay up late watching last night—does anyone know? This is so creepy, vanishing mysteriously like that. Is Alice Apartment really haunted?]
[Haunted my ass! You're watching the surveillance footage from the students' perspective—it's all been altered. Check out the live stream's highlight clips. I just finished watching them and now I know the truth. She was taken by someone.]
[Taken? It must be Wang Tao from 804!!! Poor girl.]
[Hahaha, wrong guess! It wasn't Wang Tao from 804. I thought so too, but nope!]
[What the hell? Then who was it?]
[Go watch the clips yourself!]
The first commenter went to check the highlight clips—compilations prepared for viewers who missed the live stream. He found the latest one titled "Wang Ju's Abduction" and clicked play.
The video showed the ninth-floor hallway around 2 AM. A shadowy figure moved quietly toward 904. Whether skilled at lock-picking or not, the figure easily opened 904's door. Inside, the intruder continued moving stealthily, searching until finding Wang Ju. After pressing a white handkerchief over her mouth and nose for several seconds, the figure effortlessly picked up Wang Ju—who'd been sleeping on the floor—and carried her out of 904.
The video ended abruptly there.
The viewer was stunned. "How could it be that delivery guy?!" he exclaimed aloud.
Indeed, Wang Ju's abductor wasn't Wang Tao.
It was that middle-aged deliveryman from Lightning Delivery—the one Wang Ju had insulted and given a bad rating!
Baffled, the viewer immediately posted in the live stream:
[Guys, I watched the clip—it was the middle-aged deliveryman! But here's what's weird: if he took Wang Ju to retaliate for her humiliation and bad rating, why would the organizers alter the surveillance footage for him? He's not even a resident!]
Modifying surveillance footage to assist the apartment's serial killers was standard practice to enhance the show's thrill factor. But doing so for an outsider was unprecedented.
Domineering Female CEO chimed in: [You're overcomplicating it. The organizers didn't alter footage for an outsider—we've all been tricked.]
[Tricked? What do you mean?]
Domineering Female CEO: [That middle-aged deliveryman—none of us viewers expected this—is actually another resident of the apartment. Get it now?]
[What? That deliveryman lives here too? But that can't be! The apartment's rules restrict these psychopaths to the immediate vicinity. How could he deliver food? Unless Wang Ju ordered from a restaurant right next to the apartment last night?]
Domineering Female CEO: [You're overthinking again. The truth is, the actual deliveryman assigned to Wang Ju's order was killed beforehand by this resident. The killer then took his uniform and food order to impersonate him for the rest.]
[Holy shit! That's devious!]
Not just this viewer, but many others confused by Wang Ju's disappearance finally understood after reading Domineering Female CEO's explanation. That middle-aged deliveryman had fooled them all yesterday!
[So who is this bastard?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Lin Shengli, male, 45. A disgusting... rapist...]
Fairy Sister: [A rapist? How could the organizers let such vile scum into the apartment?]
Little Dragon Girl: [I hate these criminals most of all—even more than serial killers!]
I am the Hero: [As a man, I also despise these types. How did this one get selected?]

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Found You
chapters.content:
Domineering Female CEO: "Those who get selected to live here aren't ordinary criminals. According to the profile, Lin Shengli is a very special rapist with principles. His hunting targets are women who've verbally abused him or harmed him in some way. Wang Ju perfectly fits his criteria since she insulted him yesterday and gave him a bad rating, even though that rating couldn't actually hurt him since he's not really a deliveryman."
Fairy Sister: "Hmm, the records show this guy hasn't committed any crimes since being brought to the apartment. This would be his first offense."
Domineering Female CEO: "Right, and this first offense is one he orchestrated himself. He probably couldn't resist after seeing Xiao Nuo bring so many people back yesterday - must have seemed like a golden opportunity!"
Yesterday, Lin Shengli first killed the real deliveryman, then impersonated him while deliberately delivering the order late to provoke Wang Ju into humiliating him, thus satisfying his psychological need for a "worthy" victim.
Fairy Sister: "Poor Wang Ju... I wonder if that bastard Lin Shengli has already..."
...
The tall male student and others had already reported to the police.
The good news was they didn't get the "missing under 48 hours, can't file a case" response. After hearing their account, the police immediately opened an investigation into Wang Ju's disappearance.
"Don't worry, they've filed the case. I'm sure they'll find Wang Ju soon," Xiao Peng comforted, patting the tall male student's shoulder.
But the tall male student shook his head in distress: "What's the use? We already checked the surveillance footage beforehand. And you know what's terrifying? The cameras didn't catch Wang Ju leaving room 904 at all!! Nor did she fall from any windows! Now I'm starting to wonder if this is some kind of ghost story!!!! How could a living person just vanish into thin air like this?!"The others remained silent until a girl hugging her phone frowned and said, "That's really strange. If this place was actually haunted, there'd be rumors online, but there's absolutely nothing?"
About a dozen people now stared up at the beautiful apartment building, their emotions extremely complicated. Several already had goosebumps.
"Should we hire a Taoist priest or Buddhist monk? With supernatural stuff like this, I don't think the police will be much help," another frightened girl suggested.
None of them could have imagined their simple gathering would turn into this nightmare.
Just as the group stood there helplessly, waiting for the police to arrive, a voice suddenly spoke from their left:
"This isn't supernatural. Your friend is currently in room 504."
Everyone whirled around to see a young man only slightly older than them.
The tall male student urgently asked, "Are you telling the truth?!"
The young man replied, "Of course. Go check for yourselves - what do you have to lose?"
Just as the tall male student was about to sprint into the building, Xiao Peng stopped him - just like when he'd prevented Xiao Nuo from talking to Jiang Ran earlier.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Xiao Peng asked suspiciously, "How do you know this?"
The young man coldly said, "Don't worry about how I know. If you keep wasting time here instead of going, you'll regret what happens next."
Hearing this, the tall male student charged forward like an unbridled stallion without another thought, regardless of whether it was true. The others had no choice but to follow.
Xiao Peng turned back for one last look at the young man's features - unusually pale skin with a beauty mark near his left eye.
...
"Please... please let me go... I'll never give you a bad rating again..."
In the living room of 504, a large bed occupied an abnormally large space. On it lay a young girl, weeping uncontrollably, her limbs tied to the four corners of the steel-framed bed with thick ropes, completely immobilized like a lamb awaiting slaughter.
The girl was Wang Ju.
Now completely naked, though her face and figure were rather plain, her youth, vitality, and fair skin still gave her considerable appeal.
The girl kept begging hoarsely, her voice clearly worn out from hours of crying and screaming for help.
Beside the bed stood a middle-aged man wearing only underwear - the "Lightning Delivery" driver from last night, Lin Shengli.
Lin Shengli gazed appreciatively at Wang Ju while continuously kneading her pale flesh with his right hand, chuckling:
"What's the use of saying this now? You already gave that bad rating. Now you need to atone, understand?"
"I'll atone, I'll atone! I'll pay money to atone! Please just let me go..." Wang Ju's crying had long since drained her strength.
When she woke up this morning, she'd found herself tied to this bed completely naked, with this perverted man in his underwear standing beside her - the deliveryman from last night!
At first she'd angrily demanded he release her, but eventually she'd broken down into tearful pleading.
Lin Shengli ignored Wang Ju's begging, simply smiling faintly as his large hands roamed every inch of her pale skin, murmuring to himself:
"7 PM tonight will be the perfect time to devour you. Soon, very soon... just a few more hours and you can atone for your foolish behavior last night."
Lin Shengli's expression remained warm and pleasant.
Just as he was enjoying himself, an extremely urgent knocking suddenly came from the door - loud and rapid.
Lin Shengli wondered who could be knocking - he never ordered deliveries or takeout.
Then he heard a voice outside:
"Wang Ju! Are you in there?"
When no response came, it continued:
"Open the fucking door right now!"
A young voice.
Frowning, Lin Shengli crept to the door and peered through the peephole, shocked to see Wang Ju's classmates outside.
"How do they know she's here?!" He couldn't fathom it.
"Whatever. So what if they know? I just won't open the door - what can they do?"
As he thought this, the sound of someone kicking the door erupted from outside. But the force clearly couldn't break down this specially reinforced door.
Outside, the tall male student led the university boys in taking turns kicking the door while Xiao Peng went to get the key from manager Xiao Zhang.
The tall male student couldn't wait though, violently kicking the door while assuring others he'd pay for any damages. Several other boys joined in, but the door proved extraordinarily sturdy.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: The Tall Male Student's Rage, Wang Ju's Tragedy
chapters.content:
The college students had kicked until their feet hurt, but the door remained firmly shut.
Finally, their hope arrived—Xiao Peng.
Xiao Peng hadn't gone with them to Room 504 initially, instead going to find the apartment manager Xiao Zhang for the spare key.
Seeing Xiao Peng arrive, the tall male student's eyes filled with hope.
But Xiao Peng looked awkward: "No key. Even Xiao Zhang doesn't have a spare for this apartment."
"What do we do then?" a female student asked urgently.
"We'll have to wait for the police," Xiao Peng said.
