The tall male student objected: "We can't wait! Every second increases the danger! Especially since we've already alerted them!"
Xiao Peng shrugged helplessly: "Then what can we do?"
Just as the group stood frozen in panic, a sixty-something old man in a brown suit emerged from neighboring Room 503.The elderly gentleman dressed fashionably, his hair meticulously styled.
He carried himself completely differently from typical old men.
The suited old man asked sternly: "What are you doing? I could hear you pounding on the door from next door."
The tall male student pointed at Room 504's door: "Sir, my friend is inside 504!"
The old man frowned: "Your friend? Then have your friend open the door. Why are you breaking it down?"
The tall student urgently explained: "She must be trapped inside! She wouldn't answer if she could! Something's wrong! Sir, do you know who lives in 504?"
The old man stroked his chin thoughtfully: "I'm not familiar with the resident, but I've seen him a few times—shifty-eyed fellow who looks dishonest. Wait, your friend isn't this person?"
"My friend was just visiting 504! She doesn't live there!" The tall student grew increasingly frantic.
Xiao Peng and Xiao Nuo nodded in anxious agreement.
The old man seemed to reach a decision after some internal debate.
"Fine, this old man will help you youngsters out!"
"Help us? How? Can you pick locks, sir?"
Under the group's watchful eyes, the old man returned to his apartment briefly before reappearing—carrying a massive electric saw.
The stunned students gaped as the old man confidently pulled the saw's starter cord and approached Room 504's door.
Turning back, he solemnly confirmed: "Kids, you're absolutely certain your friend is in there? In trouble?"
The tall student practically shouted: "YES! Please hurry, sir! I'll take full responsibility!"
Nodding, the old man declared: "Right then, stand back."Follow current novᴇls on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
With practiced motions, the suited elder began sawing through the door.
The sturdy door that had resisted their kicks now yielded like soft tofu under the roaring saw's teeth.
The moment an opening appeared, the group surged inside.
In the living room stood a neatly dressed middle-aged man, furious: "What's the meaning of this? Breaking into my home?!"
Ignoring him, the students frantically searched for Wang Ju.
Xiao Hua pointed at the bedroom door: "This one's locked!"
"OPEN IT NOW!!!" the tall student bellowed at the man.
The man shouted back: "This is illegal entry! I'll sue you all!!!"
Having come this far, the tall student grabbed the saw from the old man and cut through the bedroom door.
They knew Wang Ju was inside even before fully breaching—shadowy movements visible through the growing gap.
When they finally burst in, the first students froze in horror.
Wang Ju's neck gushed blood like a crimson fountain.
The scarlet tide had soaked her neck, face, torso, bedding, and dripped onto the floor.
The tall student couldn't process the nightmare—especially since Wang Ju still clung to life.
Despite the gaping neck wound, her mouth moved weakly—likely pleading for help—each motion spurting more blood.
As more students crowded in, they witnessed Wang Ju's brutalized naked body tied spread-eagle on the bed, clearly violated.
"All boys OUT!" the female students ordered through tears, pushing the males into the hallway.
Dazed momentarily, the tall student's shock transformed into crimson rage.
Spotting the middle-aged man—Lin Shengli—trying to escape, he lunged.
"I'LL KILL YOU, YOU ANIMAL!!!"
His massive frame fueled by witnessing his beloved's torture, the tall student lost all restraint.
Lin Shengli initially resisted but soon collapsed under the blows, laughing shrilly through broken teeth:
"Hahaha! I planned to enjoy her properly at 7pm! You ruined my schedule so I had to rush!!"
"YOU FUCKING BASTARD!" The tall student's fists became blurs: "You monster! Why kill her after... after...?!"
Bloodied and missing an eye, Lin Shengli cackled: "That's my signature! First the fun, then the finale! Hahahaha!!"
"I'LL MURDER YOU!!!"
Snatching up the still-running electric saw, the tall student raised it overhead.
Xiao Peng—mid-120-call—yelled for others to stop him, but none dared approach the frenzied giant wielding the buzzing death tool.
"Go on! Kill me!" Lin Shengli taunted as the saw hovered over his chest. "You'll just join me in hell!"
Miraculously, the tall student hesitated—the legal consequences piercing his rage.
But Lin Shengli, with grotesque smirk, delivered the final provocation:
"Ah... though plain-faced, that Wang Ju had such smooth young skin... exquisite texture when I touched her everywhere..."
The saw descended.
Flesh parted. Blood geysered. Bones crunched.
Screams filled the apartment until they didn't.

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Murong Fu's Turn
chapters.content:
Xiao Peng's heart sank when he witnessed the scene before him.
He saw the tall male student had already used the chainsaw to turn Lin Shengli's chest and abdomen into a bloody mess.
Lin Shengli was undoubtedly beyond saving.
The tall male student had committed murder...
After venting his rage, the tall male student's anger receded like the tide.
Once the fury subsided, he stared blankly at his blood-soaked hands, the chainsaw dripping with flesh and blood, and his own splattered body.
He stood frozen in place, silent.
Lin Shengli lay on the ground, seemingly already gone, his bloodshot eyes wide open.
...
"The police and ambulances are here, what happened?"Jiang Ran, who had gone out to buy some daily necessities, returned to Alice Apartment to find several police cars and two ambulances outside the building.
Medical staff were carrying stretchers.
Two stretchers held indistinct figures that were quickly loaded into the ambulances and driven away.
Next came the police, escorting a tall male student wearing silver handcuffs into a police car.
Several other male and female students were also loaded into another police car, which soon departed.
"Xiao Zhang, what's going on?"
Jiang Ran approached the apartment manager Xiao Zhang, who was also watching the scene outside the building.
Manager Xiao Zhang shrugged: "Not sure. Seems one of those college girls went missing. That's all I know."
Jiang Ran turned his gaze to the remaining college students.
Among those who hadn't been taken by police, an argument seemed to have erupted.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Xiao Peng's girlfriend Xiao Hua, tears in her eyes, pointed accusingly at Xiao Nuo:
"It's all your fault! If you hadn't invited us to your place, none of this would have happened!"
Xiao Nuo stuttered in response to the accusation, appearing ashamed but still defending herself:
"How could I have known this would happen?"
Others came to Xiao Nuo's defense: "It's really not Xiao Nuo's fault. Nobody could have predicted this! And if you're going to blame Xiao Nuo, you might as well keep going back further in the chain of blame!"
"Hmph, you're all just taking her side!"
Xiao Hua was both angry and heartbroken.
Wang Ju had been her roommate and close friend.
Last night, when Wang Ju deliberately provoked Wang Tao downstairs, it had actually been prearranged between Wang Ju and Xiao Hua.
Their goal was to sour Xiao Nuo's relationship with her neighbors.
This petty harassment was the extent of what they could do to bother Xiao Nuo.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Spectacular, truly spectacular. That tall young man clearly had feelings for Wang Ju - deep feelings, otherwise he wouldn't have used a chainsaw to kill for her. Ah, love... young love is the purest.]
Domineering Female CEO: [Young love is so innocent. This reminds me of my own youthful romance - so beautiful. Love these days... though I'm surrounded by cute young men, it's just not the same. Everything's so fast-paced now.]
Fairy Sister: [A man's rage for his beloved. Honestly, I thought I was watching a drama. What a pity - that young man will probably spend years in prison...]
Little Dragon Girl: [I wonder if it was worth it. They weren't even officially dating, yet he went that far. "What is love? It compels lovers to join in life and death."]
I am the Hero: [I think it wasn't worth it. Too impulsive.]
Little Aunt: [Right now he probably doesn't regret it, but who knows about later. Though I did enjoy that bloody chainsaw scene - Lin Shengli is definitely dead. I wonder if that girl Wang Ju will survive. If she does, I'd love to see how things develop between them.]
Domineering Female CEO: [If I were Wang Ju, I'd marry him immediately. Where else would you find a man willing to kill for you when you're not even his girlfriend?]
Many in the live stream echoed [Agreed].
After this topic passed, someone immediately said:
[By the way, Xiao Nuo still hasn't suffered any consequences?]
Following a brief silence in the live stream, someone else exclaimed:
[Quick, look at the main feed! Murong Fu is back!!!]
[So what if he's back? Jiang Ran came back from shopping earlier too!]
[No, look at Murong Fu's expression and overall state! He looks utterly devastated and heartbroken. He's carrying a bag that seems full of beer bottles. Did his girlfriend dump him?]
Hearing this, the middle-aged uncle and others in the live stream grew tense.
Because Murong Fu had the most bets and money riding on him in the live stream.
This bastard better be the last one to die!
...
Murong Fu returned to Alice Apartment carrying a supermarket bag full of beer bottles.
He walked with his head down, his expression completely lost.
His eyes were red, as if he'd been crying, with dried tear tracks on his face.
Entering the apartment building, he took the elevator directly to the rooftop terrace.
During the elevator ride, his mind kept replaying the scene from a few hours earlier:
He had happily gone to the station to pick up his girlfriend after not seeing her for a month.
Only to be met with this outcome.
"Murong, let's break up."
"Break up? Why? You must be joking - I know how much you like joking around."
"No, I'm serious this time. I really mean it."
"But... why..."
"I'll be honest. During this month back home, my parents set me up on a blind date. The guy is the son of a canned food factory owner in our town. His family owns four or five properties and several cars. Though he's seven or eight years older than me and has a one-year-old son... I agreed."
"What?! You agreed?! You're going to be someone's stepmother? Even if you won't marry me, you shouldn't settle for being someone's stepmother?!"
"Being a stepmother isn't so bad. At least his family is well-off."
"No, call and reject this right now! Just give me one more month - I can save up enough for a down payment on a house! Or we could first gather the betrothal gift money for your parents. Just one more month!"
"Forget it, Murong. It's hopeless. Even if I gave you a year, could you produce multiple properties, several cars, and a 388,000 yuan betrothal gift?"
"I could! One year would be enough!"
"Enough, Murong. Stop kidding yourself. I admit I'm somewhat materialistic. I'm sorry. I hope you find someone better suited to you."
"No, no! I don't want anyone else - just you! I've only ever loved you! We've been together four years since college! We promised we'd stay together forever, get married! Have children?!"
"Let go, really, Murong. Don't make me say something even crueler to make you give up. I'll tell you - during this month, I've already gotten engaged to him. And... I'm pregnant with his child..."

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Murong Fu Falls Prey
chapters.content:
Murong Fu never imagined that his girlfriend of four years would become engaged to another man and even get pregnant within less than a month. He didn't even remember how he ended up at the supermarket buying beer or how he returned to Alice Apartment and reached the rooftop. His mind was completely muddled.
Sitting on the edge of the rooftop, he chugged can after can of beer, the alcohol transforming into tears that streamed down his face. "Why? Why treat me like this? I've been working so hard!!!"
"Couldn't you give me more time? I could have saved up the money..."
"I'm making ten thousand a day now, why... why couldn't you wait just a little longer?" Murong Fu kept drinking, his body swaying from excessive grief. The live stream viewers' hearts were in their throats.
[Damn bro, don't jump just because you got dumped! It's just a woman! If you survive as the last player, we won't let you die - we'll pay to get you out of this game and arrange a model wife for you, way hotter than your ex! DON'T JUMP!!!!]
[Yeah Murong Fu, cheer up! There's millions riding on you!!!]
[If you survive to the end, I'll help you get revenge! I'll ruin that guy who stole your girl! Make your ex crawl back to you like a dog! Just survive!!! SURVIVE!!!!]
The live stream viewers pleaded desperately, but unfortunately, Murong Fu couldn't see their messages. He just kept drinking can after can of beer. He normally didn't drink at all - not even beer. Getting dumped today made him drink like never before.
The more he drank, the dizzier he became, his mind flooded with happy memories of his ex-girlfriend. "I tried so hard... my family background isn't great but I worked so hard... why couldn't you give me more time?!"
Finally, he finished all the beer he bought. Shaking the last empty can, he rummaged through the plastic bag but found nothing left. "Damn it," he muttered, preparing to leave the rooftop to buy more beer. He intended to drink himself into oblivion - alcohol would numb his pain.Just as he stepped back from the rooftop edge, he heard the click-clack of high heels approaching. Rubbing his eyes, he saw a pair of slender, pale legs walking toward him. At first he thought he was hallucinating, but the vision didn't disappear.
A stunning woman approached gracefully. Her delicate features, flowing hair, and flawless skin gave her both youthful charm and mature elegance. The sexy blue dress hugged her curves perfectly. If Jiang Ran had been there, he would have recognized her as the beautiful woman who lived on the third floor.
Tears streamed down the beauty's exquisite face as she carried a supermarket bag filled with beer cans. She walked to the rooftop edge, set down the bag, and chugged an entire can in one go.
Murong Fu stared dumbfounded. Then something completely unexpected happened - the beauty tossed him a beer and gestured for him to drink.
Of course he would accept a drink from such a beauty, despite childhood warnings about taking things from strangers. He downed it in one gulp. "Amazing!" he exclaimed, then added, "Thank you, beautiful."
The woman waved her delicate hand. "No problem. Have another if you want."
Murong Fu didn't hesitate to take another can. "I'll pay you back later," he said.
She smiled. "Judging by your state, drowning your sorrows too?"
Murong Fu nodded. "Yeah, my girlfriend dumped me. Within a month of leaving me, she got engaged to someone else... and pregnant."
The beauty chuckled. "Same here. Just got dumped by my boyfriend."
Murong Fu looked shocked. "You got dumped? How... how is that possible?" The woman before him was absolute perfection. His ex had been pretty, but compared to this goddess, they were worlds apart.
The beauty covered her mouth as she laughed. "Being beautiful with a great body doesn't make you immune to getting dumped. It happens to everyone."
She had already finished two beers with no visible effect. "Since we're both heartbroken, might as well get to know each other. I'm Qin Yi. What's your name?"
Her beautiful eyes gazed at Murong Fu. "I'm Murong Fu."
"Murong Fu? Lovely name - same as that novel character."
"Yeah... my dad named me after him. Fitting since our family name is Murong." He sighed. "Though I'm ashamed to share his name. That Murong Fu may have failed to restore his kingdom and became a joke, but at least he came from nobility, had incredible martial arts skills, was handsome, and had a cousin devoted to him."
"What I admire most is how he focused solely on his ambitions, treating women like floating duckweed. If I could be like him... maybe I wouldn't be in this mess." Murong Fu drank deeply.
Qin Yi comforted him, "Everyone goes through breakups. You'll move on."
Murong Fu smiled bitterly. "I'm afraid I won't recover."
Qin Yi reached out and patted his head. "You will."
The touch made Murong Fu blush crimson. Whether from embarrassment or alcohol, he suddenly felt lightheaded and weak-legged. His vision swam as he collapsed to the ground, Qin Yi's beautiful face fading from view.
"Murong Fu, Murong Fu, wake up! Your girlfriend's here!" Qin Yi crouched beside him, shaking his arm, but he was out cold.
Standing up, Qin Yi stretched languidly toward the sun, her curves on full display. Then she took out her phone and dialed: "All clear. Come up."
Within five minutes, another beautiful woman arrived dragging a large blue suitcase. She resembled Qin Yi but had short hair and an equally stunning figure. Together, they stuffed the unconscious Murong Fu into the suitcase.
Chatting and laughing, the two women dragged the suitcase downstairs.
In the live stream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Murong Fu, thank you for not jumping. But more importantly - THANK YOUR ENTIRE FAMILY! You idiot, why did you drink that woman's beer?!!!]

chapters.title: Chapter 28: The Demoness Sisters
chapters.content:
Qin Yi was called the Demoness by the viewers in the live stream room.
The short-haired girl was her younger sister, Qin Kelian.
Known as the Little Demoness.
The two sisters had an impressive track record within the apartment building.
They could rival Sun Erniang, the infamous female butcher from Water Margin.
While Sun Erniang sold human meat buns,
these demoness sisters specialized in making human meat paste.
Which they then sold to some extremely perverted individuals in the apartment.
Compared to other deranged killers in the apartment who had to carefully plot schemes or use brute force,
the sisters needed no such effort.Both were naturally beautiful with stunning figures.
Capable of charming both men and women alike.
They would simply approach their targets, offer them drugged water or drinks,
then stuff the unconscious victims into suitcases and take them back to their apartment.
To be processed into human meat paste.
Murong Fu had fallen victim to exactly this method.
Of course, before Murong Fu, many other "lab rats" had met the same fate.
In one round, four out of five test subjects had fallen prey to the sisters.
Murong Fu wasn't dead yet, but it wouldn't be long now.
He was already like fish on a chopping board.
In the live stream room,
those who had bet on Murong Fu were either cursing or sitting in stunned silence.
Domineering Female CEO: [Can't be helped, can't be helped. Blame Murong Fu's bad luck for catching the demonesses' attention right after being dumped. When a gorgeous woman shares your misfortune and offers you alcohol, who wouldn't drink?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [These demoness sisters charm both men and women, and living in the same building makes it hard to stay wary. Refusing their drinks is nearly impossible.]
I am the Hero: [Sigh, another lost bet. What frustrates me is...
Out of five test subjects this round, the two most normal ones - Wang Xixi and Murong Fu - are already done for.
The remaining three - gaming addict Qin Fei, vain girl Xiao Nuo, and plain Jiang Ran - these abnormal ones are doing just fine. How unpredictable life is. Their luck is just...]
Fairy Sister: [Calling it luck isn't quite right. Remember Jiang Ran and Qin Fei were the first to encounter deadly residents, but somehow managed to escape...]
The live stream was filled with lamentations.
Though some viewers who had bet on the other three were thoroughly enjoying themselves.
With great enthusiasm, they watched through the main camera as the sisters returned to their apartment and began processing Murong Fu into meat paste.
The process was extremely bloody and cruel.
Murong Fu briefly regained consciousness, screaming in agony for help - a scene many viewers found utterly fascinating.
Like the apartment residents, these live stream viewers were also deranged, just not to the same extreme degree.
"The third test subject, Murong Fu, has died. Total bets placed: 66.23 million. All funds have been transferred to the final prize pool."
The long-haired beauty host announced when Murong Fu finally expired.
This announcement dashed any remaining hopes of those who had bet on him.
...
In Room 303,
the floor was covered with red blood, white flesh fragments, and other human tissue remains.
Qin Yi and Qin Kelian, wearing aprons and black leather gloves, were cleaning up.
Both sisters wore those sexy stepmother dresses, making their cleaning process resemble two living masterpieces - their stunning curves were a sight to behold.
Yet their graceful movements contrasted sharply with the gruesome human remains they handled.
Such beauty didn't match people's expectations of criminals - especially not such deranged ones.
"Big sis, there are three test subjects left this round. Who should we target next?"
Qin Kelian paused her cleaning, resting her arms on the broom handle as she gazed at her sister.
Qin Yi replied calmly, "Two males and one female remain. The two men happen to live on our floor."
"Let's go for Jiang Ran first. He's quite handsome - his meat paste will fetch a good price."
"Will you go or should I?"
"You go. I handled Murong Fu."
Qin Kelian nodded: "Consider it done."
In the live stream:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Well, Murong Fu's dead. Jiang Ran's next.]
Domineering Female CEO: [I suggest saving Jiang Ran for last. He's much better looking than Qin Fei.]
I am the Hero: [Don't forget Diamond Bachelor bet on Jiang Ran. If he dies last, Brother Wang wins again.]
Other viewers suddenly remembered - Diamond Bachelor had indeed bet on Jiang Ran this round.
They had mocked her choice initially, thinking she would lose.
Yet Jiang Ran had miraculously survived his first encounter with an apartment resident.
If he died last this round, her winning streak would become even more terrifying.
Little Dragon Girl: [Brother Wang? Are you watching? Your Jiang Ran is about to die too.]
Little Aunt: [She won't respond. Brother Wang's too aloof for that.]
In reality, Diamond Bachelor was sipping strong coffee with her long legs propped on the desk, leaning back in her luxurious leather chair as she watched the stream with disinterest.
"If he dies, he dies. At least Jiang Ran wasn't the first to go."
She had actually bet on Jiang Ran by mistake.
Though she was pleasantly surprised he survived the encounter with the old man from Room 301.
At least it didn't immediately prove her wrong.
As for Jiang Ran surviving until the end?
She held no such hopes.
Now that the demoness sisters had targeted him,
his previous escape from the old man must have used up all his lifetime's luck.
But rather than worrying about Jiang Ran's fate,
she was more concerned about her supposedly infallible sixth sense.
This round, it had told her Wang Xixi would be the last to die.
Instead, he was the first!
How could her never-wrong intuition fail her now?Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
She hoped it was just a temporary glitch.
...
8:00 PM, Room 304.
The live stream's main camera focused here.
"Being an online store customer service rep isn't easy. Staring at the computer all day, having to respond instantly. Worst of all, I used to think most people were normal - but after dealing with all sorts as a CSR, I realize normal people are rare."
Jiang Ran complained after finishing his day's work.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Targeting Jiang Ran
chapters.content:
Despite his complaints, he was actually quite satisfied with this job.
At least he didn't have to commute and could work from home.
Moreover, the apartment he currently lived in was his own.
Pulling out the property deed for Room 304 from the drawer, Jiang Ran hugged it and planted several enthusiastic kisses on it.
This reflected the terrifying obsession Chinese people have with owning their own home.
The deep-seated fixation on having a place to call one's own.
Many viewers in the live stream room couldn't help but laugh at this display.
After all, most of those viewers lived in luxury apartments, villas, or even mansions.
They couldn't understand how someone could get so excited over a simple studio apartment.
Just as Jiang Ran finished kissing the deed and set it down, he heard knocking at his door.He went to answer it immediately.
Upon opening the door,
he saw an extremely beautiful girl standing outside.
She wore a sexy black stepmother dress,
had short hair and delicate features,
with a smoking hot figure
that exuded temptation.
Jiang Ran stared dumbfounded at the girl's face for a long time until she broke the silence herself.
"Hello, I'm Qin Kelian, your neighbor from Room 303."
This was none other than Qin Kelian, who had come specifically to hunt Jiang Ran.
"303?"
Jiang Ran suddenly remembered the beautiful woman in the blue stepmother dress he'd seen entering that apartment before.
He asked curiously, "You live in 303? I think I saw another girl entering 303 last time - is she your friend?"
Qin Kelian smiled sweetly. "That's my older sister! Her name is Qin Yi!"
"Really? Your sister? Now that you mention it, you two do look somewhat alike..."
Jiang Ran's mind began comparing the two sisters' appearances, figures, and demeanors.
The older sister: A youthful face with a mature woman's body, creating a fascinating blend of innocence and sensuality. Extremely charming and feminine.
The younger sister: An innocent face with a curvaceous figure, and a more lively, cute personality.
Both sisters were absolute stunners.
"So Miss Qin, what brings you here today?" Jiang Ran asked, refocusing on the present.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Qin Kelian gestured with a small bronze teapot in her right hand.
"Since you live in 304 and we're neighbors now... I'm a tea master, and I just brewed some excellent tea. I thought you might like to try it."
"Really? I love tea!" Jiang Ran said with exaggerated enthusiasm.
Qin Kelian seemed surprised. "Oh? What kind do you prefer?"
Jiang Ran: "Iced black tea."
Qin Kelian nearly choked but managed to say, "How... humorous."
After entering 304, Jiang Ran took two disposable paper cups from a cabinet drawer and placed them on the coffee table.
Seizing the opportunity, Qin Kelian immediately poured the golden-hued tea into both cups - the color suspiciously resembling urine.
"This is golden tea. Have you tried it before?" she asked after sitting on the sofa and pushing one cup toward Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran stared at the liquid. "Nope. Never even heard of it. I only know about West Lake Longjing, Pu'er, black tea, green tea..."
Facing tea offered by a beauty, Jiang Ran carefully lifted the cup with both hands, blew on it several times, then took a tiny sip.
After smacking his lips, he didn't find this "golden tea" particularly remarkable.
Just then, a notification popped up in his mind:
[Ding! Detected host has consumed drugged tea! System has neutralized effects! Points consumed: 100!]
Actually, the Danger Warning System had already sounded alarms when he first saw Qin Kelian:
[Detected dangerous individual! Please distance yourself immediately! +8 points! +8 points!...]
But Jiang Ran had long stopped paying attention to these routine warnings.
The new alert about drugged tea was different though - the system claimed to have neutralized it at a cost of 100 points.
So this was how points worked?
But the real question was: Could the system be trusted?
Was there really drugs in this tea?
Highly skeptical, Jiang Ran took another sip - triggering the same system message.
Okay, so he hadn't misheard.
The system insisted the tea was drugged.
But systems could be wrong.
First: Why would Qin Kelian drug him?
He'd only heard of men drugging women for... certain activities.
Fine, maybe some aggressive women might drug men for the same purpose.
But that made no sense here!
He was decent-looking but no supermodel,
while Qin Kelian was undeniably gorgeous.
If she wanted him, she could just ask directly - he'd never refuse!
Only an idiot would refuse.
Plus they were neighbors in the same building - not strangers.
Why drug him just to steal his stuff?
Second: Where would this beautiful Qin Kelian even get drugs?
Aren't those hard to obtain?
Considering these points, Jiang Ran found the drugged tea theory ridiculous.
But to test the system's reliability,
he decided to ask Qin Kelian directly:
"Did you put drugs in this tea?"
Qin Kelian had been secretly pleased seeing Jiang Ran drink twice, already imagining how to process this handsome man - she and her sister made more than just human meat paste.
But Jiang Ran's sudden question threw her completely off guard.
What?
How could he know?
Wait... was that a question?
"Drugs? What drugs? I've never even seen such things in my life," Qin Kelian lied smoothly.
"Thought so. Just joking - I read a novel recently about a guy drugging girls to take advantage of them," Jiang Ran covered hastily.
Qin Kelian laughed nervously. "Oh... is that so?"
She thought it must be a coincidence - no way he actually knew.
Then Jiang Ran did something unexpected - he pushed the second cup of tea toward her.
"You should drink too before it gets cold."
Though reluctant, under Jiang Ran's intense gaze, Qin Kelian took several sips before putting the cup down with feigned enjoyment.
After watching Qin Kelian drink the tea herself and remain perfectly conscious minutes later,
Jiang Ran concluded the system had lied again about the drugs.
If the tea were really drugged,
Qin Kelian wouldn't have drunk it,
or would have passed out by now.
Instead, she showed no ill effects whatsoever.
"This system... I'm at a complete loss with it," Jiang Ran sighed internally.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Targeting Qin Fei
chapters.content:
Time passed minute by minute.
Ten minutes had elapsed since Qin Kelian finished her tea.
Jiang Ran had already drunk his cup and poured himself another, taking several sips.
The faint fragrance emanating from Qin Kelian sitting beside him made Jiang Ran enjoy the tea he normally wouldn't drink, feeling utterly relaxed and euphoric.
While Jiang Ran was floating on cloud nine, Qin Kelian certainly wasn't!
Currently frowning, she stared intently at Jiang Ran who showed no signs of being affected, extremely puzzled.
The knockout drug in the tea was supposed to take effect within five minutes, ensuring an adult would remain unconscious for an entire day.
Yet over ten minutes had passed.
Why was Jiang Ran still so energetic?
And becoming even more cheerful as he drank?"Could sister have forgotten to put the drug in this pot of tea?" Qin Kelian wondered.
"But that can't be - sister never makes such basic mistakes. Unless Jiang Ran is like me?"
Qin Kelian studied Jiang Ran's handsome profile with confusion.
She had also drunk from this same teapot earlier under Jiang Ran's watchful gaze without issue.
That was because since childhood, she had trained in preparing such drugs, personally testing their effects.
Her body had long developed immunity.
But Jiang Ran?
Could he also have built up immunity?
After waiting another ten minutes with no signs of Jiang Ran collapsing, Qin Kelian gave up waiting.
Making an excuse, she took the small teapot back to her own apartment 303.
Before leaving, she noticed Jiang Ran's reluctant gaze following her, which left her utterly speechless.
Returning to 303, her sister Qin Yi complained: "Why did it take so long to deal with him?"
Already frustrated, Qin Kelian retorted: "Sister, did you forget to put the knockout drug in this tea?"
Qin Yi was startled: "Why do you say that?"
After Qin Kelian explained the situation, Qin Yi made a surprised sound.
She took the teapot to a blue metal cage in the living room containing a small rabbit.
Pouring some tea into the cage's water dish, the snow-white rabbit hopped over to drink.
Within a minute or two of drinking, it collapsed unconscious, dead to the world.
Seeing this, Qin Yi spread her hands: "The drug wasn't forgotten. Seems the problem lies with Jiang Ran himself."
Qin Kelian couldn't understand: "Problem? What problem? Unless he's like us with immunity? But that shouldn't be..."The source of this content ɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Qin Yi said: "The world is full of wonders. Some people can drink endlessly without getting drunk, others have four kidneys making them endlessly energetic. As for Jiang Ran, I suspect his body might be special - immune to knockout drugs, or at least this particular one."
Qin Kelian sighed, seeing no other explanation.
"So sister, what do we do now?"
Qin Yi picked up the teapot with a faint smile: "Since we failed with Jiang Ran for now, let's try Qin Fei instead."
"This time, it's my turn."
In the live stream room...
Jiang Ran's narrow escape once again left all hundred thousand viewers shocked beyond belief.
Surviving one assassination attempt from apartment residents was already unbelievable enough.
Yet this was his second escape!!!
Moreover, Jiang Ran differed fundamentally from other test subjects - he had been tricked into coming, while others had signed agreements and maintained some vigilance.
Middle-aged Uncle: [The 301 old man with 100% kill rate, and the demoness sisters who've never failed... Jiang Ran... I'm impressed...]
Domineering Female CEO: [Can someone tell me if such people really exist? Naturally immune to knockout drugs?]
Little Dragon Girl: [I have a relative in pharmaceuticals who mentioned such cases - like how some are naturally allergic to penicillin.]
I am the Hero: [Incredible! If Jiang Ran were in wuxia novels, he'd be invincible - no sleeping drugs work on him, might need aphrodisiacs instead.]
Fairy Sister: [I'm starting to think Diamond Bachelor Brother Wang's judgment holds increasing merit. Jiang Ran survived twice now - he might actually be the last one standing.]
Other viewers felt indescribably conflicted.
They never expected Diamond Bachelor himself would witness Jiang Ran's second escape.
His astonishment mirrored theirs completely.
Even this beautiful girl began wondering - could she actually win this round?
......
Room 302
Since entering the apartment these past few days,
Qin Fei hadn't left his unit.
Ordering takeout for meals, with the daily 10,000 yuan payment, he spent most on gaming, keeping just enough for food.
At 9pm,
Qin Fei was immersed in an intense game battle.
The glowing black keyboard and mouse clicked rapidly.
Then came knocking at his door.
In the heat of gameplay,
Qin Fei at his living room desk didn't even glance toward the door, fully focused on his game.
The knocking persisted briefly before stopping.
Qin Fei continued gaming uninterrupted.
The knocking resumed several more times, but Qin Fei remained glued to his screen.
Live stream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Could Qin Fei actually escape like Jiang Ran did?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Hard to say after Jiang Ran's example - anything's possible now.]
Little Dragon Girl: [Aaaah! I just want this round over! Qin Fei die already so we can start next round!]
Little Aunt: [Agreed.]
I am the Hero: [Agreed.]
10pm.
The match finally ended.
Qin Fei, who'd been holding his bladder, rushed to the bathroom immediately after.
Relieved, he strode back to his desk, grabbing a bottle of water to gulp down.
After drinking, he prepared instant noodles for a late-night snack.
Tonight being a major guild battle, he planned to pull an all-nighter, dedicating his heart to the guild!
Just as he prepared to return to battle, knocking sounded at his door again.
"Seems someone knocked several times during my game."
"Could it be that damn old man again?!"
Recently, the 301 old man had knocked multiple times asking for help.
Qin Fei fantasized about smashing the old man's skull with a hammer.
But curiosity got the better of him - he went to check the peephole.
What he saw shocked him to the core.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Qin Fei Falls for the Trap
chapters.content:
Outside, through the haze, there seemed to be a woman? And not just any woman—an absolute stunner?
Without hesitation, Qin Fei swung the door open with the lightning-fast reflexes honed by twenty years of singlehood.
As expected, standing at the doorway was a breathtaking beauty that made Qin Fei's eyes pop out of his skull. Though an internet-addicted youth, he was still a red-blooded male who couldn't help but react to such a vision.
"Hello there, I'm Qin Yi from Room 303," the beauty at the door introduced herself.
Hearing her name, Qin Fei chuckled. "No kidding? What a coincidence—I'm Qin Fei. We share the same surname! Must be fate."
Qin Yi smiled. "Indeed, what are the odds?"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"So... what brings you here, Qin Yi?" Qin Fei asked, his heart pounding like a drum. Every glance at Qin Yi's flawless face and the curves accentuated by her blue stepmother dress sent his pulse into overdrive.
Not that he could be blamed for losing composure. Between Qin Yi's staggering beauty and the fact that it was already 10 PM, any man's imagination would run wild. What business could a knockout like her have knocking on his door at this hour? Maybe her shower broke and she needed to borrow his bathroom?
Qin Yi interrupted his fantasies. "Since you're new here, I thought we should get acquainted as neighbors. I'm a tea master—this is my special brew. Would you like to try some?"
Qin Fei's hopes deflated. So much for shower scenarios. Still, he invited her in. Remembering the previous knocks, he asked if they'd been from her. Qin Yi confirmed—she'd assumed he wasn't home and was about to give up after this last attempt.Qin Fei claimed he'd been gaming with headphones on, careful not to admit he'd deliberately ignored the door earlier. After all, who wouldn't want to impress a gorgeous woman? Whether male or female, when an attractive person shows interest, the mind naturally wanders to possibilities.
"Got any cups?" Qin Yi asked. Qin Fei produced two clean glasses, which she filled with golden-hued tea. As Qin Fei admired the vibrant color before taking a sip, Qin Yi surveyed his messy apartment—piles of trash bags, snack wrappers, empty soda bottles, and the cacophony of computer game sounds.
"I enjoy gaming too," Qin Yi remarked.
Qin Fei's eyes lit up. When she named a few mobile and PC titles, he launched into passionate explanations, thrilled to have found common ground. Soon he was showing off his laptop, enthusiastically pitching his favorite game. "This is literally the best game in the world!" he declared, secretly hoping to lure Qin Yi into his gaming world—and by extension, his life. As a top player, guiding a newbie girl would be child's play. More importantly, it'd give them reasons to keep interacting. Maybe even kindle romance?
Qin Fei had dated before—mostly online relationships. One disastrous meetup with an internet girlfriend who turned out to be... underwhelming had traumatized him into singlehood. But tonight, Qin Yi was resurrecting his petrified heart.
Qin Yi studied the game screen and shook her head with a smile. "The best game in the world? I doubt that."
Qin Fei blinked. "How so?"
"I know a game that's far more... exciting," Qin Yi murmured, her liquid gaze locking onto him, making his face burn. "You'll see soon enough."
No man could withstand such a look from a goddess-level beauty, especially with that tantalizing promise. Qin Fei's mind raced—what could be more thrilling than his beloved game unless...? Was she hinting at...? Could his luck really be this good? What would an absolute stunner see in him? Maybe she had unconventional tastes? Some women preferred unconventional looks—he recalled a celebrity wife who'd cheated with a remarkably plain man. Not that he was anywhere near that level—he was way better looking!
Still... something felt off. What kind of woman visits a stranger's apartment at 10 PM just to share tea?
"Whatever," Qin Fei decided. "It's not like I'd be the one losing out here."
Just as he fantasized about what might unfold, a sudden dizziness overwhelmed him. The world spun violently—even Qin Yi's beautiful face distorted grotesquely. With a heavy thud, he collapsed, consciousness slipping away.
"Qin Fei? Qin Fei, wake up," Qin Yi called, nudging him. When he didn't stir, she pulled out her phone. Soon, her younger sister Qin Kelian arrived dragging the same large suitcase that had once held Murong Fu.
"Help me, sis! This stinking man weighs a ton!" Qin Kelian struggled to lift Qin Fei alone while Qin Yi watched impassively.
"Consider this your punishment for failing with Jiang Ran," Qin Yi smirked.
Qin Kelian pouted. "Not my fault! You just got lucky not being assigned Jiang Ran. Who knew he'd be immune to sedatives?"
Qin Yi shrugged. "Luck is part of competence."
As Qin Kelian wrestled Qin Fei into the suitcase, Qin Yi's gaze landed on the laptop. The game's chat window showed frantic messages from Qin Fei's guild:
[Where are you?? We're getting slaughtered!]
[Dude, did you fall into the toilet?]
[We're losing because of you!]
[You bail now? I'll hunt you down in real life!]
Qin Yi's red lips curved. "Poor things. Your vice guild leader won't be fighting by your side... ever again."

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Terrified Qin Fei
chapters.content:
"Ugh, my head is so dizzy..."
"Did I stay up too late? Whatever, at least I didn't die from exhaustion..."
"Huh? Where am I..."
"Wait, is this my home?"
"What the hell?!"
Qin Fei woke up.
After regaining consciousness, he found himself tied to a rectangular metal platform.
His hands and feet were tightly bound, completely immobile.
Lifting his head, he realized his clothes were gone - well, almost gone, he still had his underwear on.
Utterly confused, he looked around - this definitely wasn't his apartment!His place was never this clean, nor did it have such huge floor-to-ceiling windows.
When Qin Fei raised his head to look toward his feet, he could see an enormous glass balcony window.
The view was spectacular.
Sunlight poured in - it must already be the next day.
But none of that mattered. The real question was: Where the hell am I?!
"Hey! Is anyone there?!" Qin Fei shouted.
"Yes!" came a melodious female voice from one direction. Upon closer listening, the voice sounded strangely familiar.
Footsteps approached.
Qin Fei saw two people coming from either side of him.
As they got closer, he could make out their full appearance.
Both were completely covered from head to toe.
They wore black oil-proof leather work suits with thick leather gloves.
That wasn't the weird part though - the truly bizarre thing was the gas masks covering their faces, like something straight out of a video game.
Maximum intimidation factor.
Qin Fei stared dumbfounded until one of them removed her gas mask, revealing exquisitely beautiful features.
"Qin Yi?"
Qin Fei was stunned.
He hadn't expected to see Qin Yi here, though it wasn't entirely surprising - he remembered having tea with her last night.
"Seriously, Qin Yi, are you cosplaying? Untie me now! My arms and legs are killing me!"
Qin Yi shook her head at his demand.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"Can't let you go. As for..."
"Cosplay? No no no, this isn't cosplay. It's a game. Remember what I told you last night about the most fun game?"
Racking his brains, Qin Fei vaguely recalled Qin Yi mentioning something like that.
But what kind of game was this?
Stripped nearly naked with only underwear left, restrained against his will?
Suddenly, realization struck Qin Fei. "Holy shit, Qin Yi, are you trying to play S&M with me?!"
Qin Fei was a normal guy - he had no interest in that kind of thing.
Especially not being the submissive one. He didn't want to be the abused or the abuser.
Qin Yi's beautiful face twisted into a creepy grin (though even her creepy grin was attractive).
"S&M? Not my thing. The game we're about to play is called Human Dismemberment Processing."
"Human Dismemberment Processing? What the hell is that?!"
Qin Fei was completely lost.
Qin Yi wheeled over a metal cart loaded with various tools.
From it, she picked up an orange chainsaw and started it up - the motor buzzed to life.
"Simple really. We use this chainsaw to cut you up, then use your limbs and other parts to make appropriate food products. Like human meat paste or canned human meat."
Qin Fei's mind went blank.
Was this a nightmare?
Then strange sensations from his body confirmed this was all too real.
The other masked figure was using a black marker to draw lines across his body like some kind of blueprint.
"What are you doing?" Qin Fei asked.
"Marking cutting lines so we don't make mistakes," came the reply.
Qin Fei was surprised to realize the other person was also female.
Turning back to Qin Yi, he pleaded, "Qin Yi, seriously, untie me! I'm not in the mood for this game! It's not for me! And I need to get home for my guild war! Just let me go!"
Qin Yi smiled. "Guild war? Don't worry, I checked your place this morning. Your guild already finished the battle."
"Who won?" Qin Fei asked urgently.
"Your guild did."
Qin Fei sighed in relief. "Good, that's good."
Qin Yi added, "But they're really mad at you for standing them up last night. Said they'd come after you."
Qin Fei shrugged. "No big deal. I'll just buy them all monthly passes and they'll forgive me."
"Seriously though, Qin Yi, let me go. I'm starving."
Qin Yi shook her head. "Can't do that until the game's over."
"Then hurry up already!" Qin Fei was exasperated. He wanted no part of this "game."
Qin Yi smiled slyly. "Don't worry, I'll make it quick."
With that, she lowered the chainsaw onto Qin Fei's ankle.
The metal teeth bit into his flesh with horrifying intimacy, drawing screams from Qin Fei.
"FUCK! WHAT THE HELL, QIN YI?! WHY ARE YOU CHAINSAWING ME?!"
Qin Fei shrieked in agony.
Qin Yi replied calmly, "Playing the game."
Qin Fei no longer cared how beautiful Qin Yi was.
"You're insane! You're actually cutting me?!"
"Call an ambulance! Get me to a hospital!!!"
Qin Yi ignored him, continuing to saw.
Qin Fei howled curses through the pain.
"STOP! YOU'LL KILL ME! I QUIT! I DON'T WANT TO PLAY ANYMORE!!!"
Qin Fei had assumed this "Human Dismemberment" game was just pretend - like childhood make-believe.
He never imagined she'd actually start sawing into him!!!
Qin Yi said firmly, "Doesn't matter if you want to play. The game continues regardless."
Seeing Qin Yi's deadly serious expression, Qin Fei nearly cried.
"Please, I'll bleed to death at this rate! I promise I won't call the police if you take me to the hospital now!"
Qin Yi kept sawing, ignoring his pleas.
Qin Fei's entire body convulsed in pain. Veins bulged on his forehead like tree roots, and foam bubbled from his mouth.
Only now did Qin Fei truly understand - this wasn't pretend. Qin Yi's "game" was horrifyingly real.
To drive the point home, Qin Yi had her companion bring something over.
"Remember this person?"
Qin Fei stared at what the other woman presented, too terrified to speak.
It was a human head. He vaguely recognized it - someone from the welcome party for new residents... Murong Fu, was it?
He remembered thinking the guy was handsome, and sharing a name with that famous character.
Now they'd met again... in completely different circumstances.

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Qin Fei Falls in Battle
chapters.content:
“Help! Help!!!”
“Jiang Ran! Help! Is anyone there? Call the police!!!”
That severed head was unclear whether it was real or fake, but it certainly didn’t look fake; props couldn’t be made this realistic.
Qin Fei was sure it was Murong Fu’s head. He didn’t know how Murong Fu met such a deadly fate.
But he felt that he was about to die at Qin Yi’s hands. He was about to join Murong Fu in the afterlife.
He remembered that there was someone else living on the same floor named Jiang Ran.
On the same floor as himself.
So he shouted and yelled desperately.
His only hope was pinned on Jiang Ran, or anyone passing by.
But Qin Yi’s words shattered his hope:“Stop shouting. This building has soundproofing.”
Qin Fei didn’t believe it. Only when his voice went hoarse did he accept it.
“Let me go, Qin Yi. You’re so beautiful; you shouldn’t be doing this! You’re going to jail!”
Qin Yi laughed: “Jail? Heh, it’s not like I haven’t eaten jail food before.”
Qin Fei was desperate, pain forcing him to ask, “Why? I have no grudge against you. Why are you torturing me like this?”
Qin Fei was a college student, young and inexperienced. The biggest trouble he had was borrowing online loans and being hounded by debt collectors.
Because of this, faced with life and death, he could not remain calm or treat death lightly.
He was sure Qin Yi was that kind of twisted murderer often seen in movies, TV dramas, or news reports.
But such killers always seemed far from him. He never expected one to be right beside him.
The most baffling was: why would a twisted murderer look so beautiful?!
“I don’t have a grudge against you, so why torture you? Good question. In this world, many things happen like this. It’s not because you and I have a grudge that I want to hurt you. Maybe if I just didn’t like your face on the street, I’d kill you.”
“Of course, I’m a good person. I’ll give you a specific answer: blame yourself for coming to Alice Apartment. Do you think it’s easy to get ten thousand a day here?”
Those words woke Qin Fei up from his dream.
Only now did he realize the truth.
But it was far too late to realize it now.
Fixing the fold after the sheep is lost is too late.
“No, no, I don’t want money. I want to leave!”
Qin Fei howled in pain.
Qin Yi said nothing, only crazily cutting with the chainsaw.
...
“First test subject Qin Fei has died. The total betting amount is 10,990,000, all added to the total prize pool.”
About three hours later.
The long-haired Beauty Host reappeared in the livestream room and announced.
In the livestream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: “Too bad Qin Fei didn’t have the luck Jiang Ran did, just died like that.”
Domineering Female CEO: “Actually, he didn’t have to die. If Qin Fei hadn’t lusted after beauty, if he treated Qin Yi like they treated the Old Man in Room 301, he’d still be alive and well now.”
Middle-aged Uncle: “Forget it, unless Qin Fei is gay and not interested in women. More importantly, Qin Yi and Qin Kelian, these two sisters, are too beautiful. Even I’ve seen many beauties and played around a lot, but facing sisters of their caliber, it’s hard to resist, let alone a college student like Qin Fei, basically a newbie encountering a max-level succubus.”
Fairy Sister: “There are only two test subjects left: Jiang Ran and Xiao Nuo. They have the lowest betting amounts and fewest bettors, but those who bet on them are happy…”
Among the five test subjects:
Xiao Nuo’s total bet amount: 5,670,000, second to last.
Jiang Ran’s total bet amount: 1,080,000, last.
Naturally, the bettors on them were in a great mood.
If one of these two dies, those who bet on the survivors would split all the prize money in this round’s pool.
Perhaps the money won wouldn’t be a huge fortune for the winners in the livestream room.
But the thrill and adrenaline rush from winning this way was irreplaceable.
That’s why these people loved watching this real-life “Relatives Are Worse Than Neighbors” game livestream so much.
...
At 11 a.m., Jiang Ran finished his morning customer service work and went out to find food again. He saw several men in blue work uniforms going in and out of Room 302.
Coincidentally, the apartment manager Xiao Zhang was outside, so Jiang Ran asked him.
After asking, he learned that Qin Fei had moved out.
Jiang Ran was puzzled: “Moved? Did he buy or rent? He just lived here a few days and moved out? Isn’t that troublesome?”
Apartment Manager Xiao Zhang smiled: “It’s a rented place. Qin Fei didn’t want to move, but he’s an internet addict. He only lived a few days and made a mess of the place, so the landlord kicked him out.”
Jiang Ran nodded, thinking it was good he was clean, and more importantly, this place was his own.
As Jiang Ran left the apartment building, he ran into Xiao Nuo’s group of college students again.
But because of the events of the past couple of days, these students all looked quite troubled.
Regarding Xiao Nuo’s side:
The female student Wang Ju, although having her throat slashed, was rushed to the hospital in time and rescued, without life danger.
She was still unconscious, and her parents had rushed over from another province to take care of her.
As for the criminal Lin Shengli, who was chainsawed by the tall male student, he had already died before the medical personnel could get him out of the apartment.
Even though Lin Shengli committed heinous crimes, once dead, there was nothing anyone could do.
Finally, the tall male student was now detained.
Although he killed a criminal, he still committed homicide and took the law into his own hands.
Among these students, one had a lawyer in the family. After a brief inquiry, it was estimated the tall male student would definitely face prison time.
So much turmoil had erupted in such a short time.
These students all felt uneasy.
Originally, they liked to hang out together at bars or find places to party.
But now they had no mood for it
Still, with nothing else to do, they gathered together.
They were now at Xiao Nuo’s place, forming teams to play “Glory of the Dead” or “PUBG,” and watching TV to pass the time.
Xiao Nuo’s crush, Xiao Hua’s boyfriend Xiao Peng, had gone outside to smoke with another guy.
This unfamiliar young man wasn’t part of the group that had gathered at Xiao Nuo’s place in the past few days.
Everyone called him Xiao Q.

chapters.title: Chapter 34: The Kite
chapters.content:
Xiao Q and Xiao Peng attended the same university.
However, they were in different departments and not even the same class.
Xiao Q had been fascinated by criminal cases, crimes, and detective work since childhood.
He majored in criminal investigation and planned to become a police detective after graduation.
Although he was good friends with Xiao Peng, he usually didn't like hanging out with Xiao Peng's rowdy group of friends.
He came this time because he was extremely interested in what had happened two days ago.
The two were smoking outside the apartment building. Behind Alice Apartment was a massive garden with a small stream where fish could be seen swimming.Follow current novels on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
The air was fresh here, with open views—a perfect spot for smoking and chatting.
As they arrived, they noticed someone flying a kite not far away.
Coincidentally, the kite string snapped.The kite swiftly descended from the sky toward Xiao Peng and Xiao Q.
It eventually landed not far in front of them.
Xiao Peng walked over and picked up the kite. It wasn't large, shaped like the cartoon character Pikachu, bright yellow and incredibly lifelike—just as cute as the one seen on TV.
The moment Xiao Peng held it, he noticed how realistic it was, with an exceptionally smooth texture.
"Thank you, that's my kite."
A simple, honest-looking middle-aged uncle hurried over from a distance.
"Here you go."
Xiao Peng handed the Pikachu kite back. The uncle gratefully took it, thanked them, and went back to flying his kite.
At that moment, Xiao Peng turned and noticed his friend Xiao Q squinting sharply, like a cat eyeing its prey, staring intently at the departing middle-aged man.
"What, you keep staring at him like that? Don't tell me you've fallen for him? Got some daddy issues?" Xiao Peng teased.
"Shut up! You're the one with daddy issues!" Xiao Q retorted. "I just feel like I've seen him somewhere before."
Pulling out his phone, Xiao Q suddenly grinned at Xiao Peng. "Hey, let me tell you something interesting."
Xiao Peng: "What? Did some hot new girl transfer to our school?"
Xiao Q gave him a disdainful look. "Even if there was, she wouldn't be for you—she'd be some rich guy's. Stop dreaming."
"Look at this. Does it seem familiar?"
Xiao Peng glanced down casually at Xiao Q's phone screen. At first, he didn’t pay much attention, but then his eyes widened in shock.
Pointing at the screen, he exclaimed, "Hey hey hey! Isn't this the guy who almost killed Wang Ju?! How do you have his photo?!"
Xiao Q chuckled. "You described him to me before, remember? I thought he looked familiar, and sure enough, I found him."
Xiao Peng took the phone. On the screen was an online encyclopedia entry for a man named Lin Shengli—the very same man who had nearly killed Wang Ju.
"So his name is Lin Shengli..." Xiao Peng muttered, scrolling further down.
But the more he read, the more his expression darkened.
By the end, he wondered if his eyes were playing tricks on him—or if the encyclopedia was wrong.
"It says here Lin Shengli was a convicted rapist and murderer involved in multiple cases. He was sentenced to death three years ago. What the hell? Then who did we just meet?! A twin brother? Or someone who looks just like him?"
Xiao Peng frowned deeply.
Xiao Q laughed. "The guy you met earlier was definitely Lin Shengli, no doubt about it."
"As for why a man who should've been dead three years ago is still alive and committing crimes again?"
"Simple."
Xiao Q lowered his voice. "Four words: 'paper sentence served.'"
"Paper sentence served?!" Xiao Peng nearly shouted in disbelief.
"That kind of sick, disgusting bastard—god, I wanna punch someone!"
Xiao Q shook his head. "Calm down. 'Paper sentence served' isn't that uncommon—most people just don’t know about it. Lin Shengli must’ve had money or connections. Otherwise, do you think he could afford living here after getting out?"
Xiao Peng was still furious. "So money means you can do whatever you want?"
Xiao Q patted his shoulder. "Money doesn’t mean 'whatever,' but it’s pretty damn close."
"Thankfully, your friend had the guts to finish him off with that chainsaw. Otherwise, if he could fake his sentence once, he could do it again."
"Too bad it was a one-for-one trade, though."
Xiao Peng fell silent for a long moment.
Then Xiao Q added, "I only came because I was curious about Lin Shengli. But just now, I noticed something else interesting."
Xiao Peng: "What? You spotted a hot girl?"
Xiao Q scoffed. "Can you think about anything besides women? 'Walk by the river often, and you’ll get wet.' Keep playing around, and you’ll catch something nasty."
Xiao Peng grinned. "Nah, I’m careful. Always use protection."
"Anyway, what did you find?"
Xiao Q nodded toward the middle-aged man flying the kite in the distance.
"I just remembered who he is. And he’s even more messed up than Lin Shengli."
Xiao Peng squinted. Though he couldn’t make out the man’s face clearly, he could see his figure and the kite.
"More messed up? Don’t tell me that 'honest-looking' guy is also a psycho criminal?"
Xiao Q smirked. "Wow, smart! Almost as sharp as Zhuge Liang. You nailed it."
Xiao Peng rolled his eyes. "Cut the jokes. Who is he?"
Xiao Q: "You guessed it. That guy’s a sick criminal. I’m not kidding."
Xiao Peng looked stunned, as if he’d seen a ghost.
Xiao Q continued, "His name is Wang Nuli. A deranged killer. Loved kites since he was a kid—a master at making them. His handmade kites were practically art. But he was never satisfied, always thinking they weren’t perfect."
"Wang Nuli’s parents divorced early. He grew up poor with his grandparents and dropped out of school to work. Because of his poverty, none of his relationships in his youth worked out—never married. Later, he gained fame for his kites, his life improved, and he finally married."
"His wife was over a decade younger, very beautiful. They had two sons together."
"Unfortunately, that hard-earned happiness didn’t last."
"One day, Wang Nuli came home early and caught his wife cheating. Worse, he found out his two sons weren’t his—they were the other man’s."
"And the final blow? He discovered his young, beautiful wife had been with her lover even before marrying him—and had never broken it off. He was the one who had 'stolen' her from their relationship."
"Even more infuriating? All the money he’d given his wife over the years had gone straight to her lover."
"Enraged, Wang Nuli killed both sons in front of her, then slaughtered the lover right before her eyes. Finally, he gave his wife a choice: 'Let’s start over.'"
"Whether she refused or he was just toying with her, in the end, he killed her too."

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Will Xiao Nuo Leave Alice Apartment?
chapters.content:
"He had killed four people. Wang Nuli originally intended to turn himself in."
"But at that critical moment, as he looked at the four corpses of varying sizes lying in pools of blood, inspiration suddenly struck him."
"He skinned all four victims and began making kites."
"From that moment onward, Wang Nuli transformed from an honest kite craftsman into a deranged criminal."
Xiao Peng noticed Xiao Q had been reading something on his phone aloud. He took the phone and discovered Xiao Q had been reciting an article about Wang Nuli written by a self-media account.
He continued reading the article detailing Wang Nuli's subsequent crimes.
Wang Nuli's later story was equally straightforward.
He committed multiple skinning murders, plunging the entire city into panic. Everyone lived in fear of encountering this psychopath.
Ultimately, during his final crime, Wang Nuli was caught and arrested on the spot.
The self-media article claimed this deranged criminal had already been executed by firing squad.The blogger concluded with personal reflections on Wang Nuli's case:
"A man should marry for virtue. Had it not been for his wife's betrayal and infidelity, would Wang Nuli have embarked on this path of no return?"
Returning the phone to Xiao Q, Xiao Peng searched for Wang Nuli's information on his own device, particularly photos.
He mentally compared these images with the simple, honest-looking middle-aged man he'd met earlier.
The more he compared, the paler his face became.
Then he remembered - he'd held that yellow Pikachu kite and marveled at its incredibly smooth texture.
Now he realized - that texture had felt exactly like a young girl's skin!!!
His complexion turned deathly white as he stammered: "Xiao Q... don't tell me this Wang Nuli, like that Lin Shengli, only served a paper sentence?"
Xiao Q lit another cigarette, exhaling smoke: "What else? Why would someone sentenced to death be living here? Judging by his appearance, he must be another resident of Alice Apartment."
"Damn it! I'm calling the police!" Xiao Peng declared, pulling out his phone.
Xiao Q immediately grabbed his hand, chuckling: "Buddy, do you really think reporting someone who got out via paper sentence will accomplish anything?"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Xiao Peng grew agitated: "We have to try! We can't let this psycho roam free! What if he kills again? And my girlfriend lives here! It's too dangerous!!!"
Xiao Q sighed: "Why do you have stronger justice instincts than me, a criminal investigation student? As your friend, my advice is stay out of it. Just have your girlfriend move away from this area."
After careful consideration, Xiao Peng found Xiao Q's reasoning sound. He turned to return to the apartment.
Xiao Q followed behind, smoking while frowning deeply. He muttered to himself:
"Strange... why do I feel like countless eyes are watching us?"
...
The "Distant Kin Are No Match for Nearby Neighbors" organizers' most impressive feat was their surveillance system.
High-end cameras covered not just the apartment, but the surrounding areas too, capturing crystal-clear video and audio.
Thus, Xiao Peng and Xiao Q's entire conversation was broadcast live to viewers.
Domineering Female CEO: [This college student is impressive! I'm certain he wasn't part of Xiao Nuo's group two days ago!!! He actually identified the apartment resident's background and advised against reporting Wang Nuli while suggesting relocation. With this intelligence and courage, the organizers should recruit him for the next round! The drama would be incredible!!!]
Little Aunt: [I second CEO's suggestion! Throwing this promising candidate into the mix to outwit the residents would be fantastic!!!]
Little Dragon Girl: [Exciting idea, but hard to execute. Previous participants all joined due to financial desperation. Unless this student has money problems too...]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Forget next round, focus on the current situation.]
[Xiao Peng's about to convince Xiao Nuo to leave Alice Apartment.]
[If she leaves, wouldn't Jiang Ran's bettors automatically win?]
Fairy Sister: [Not that simple.]
[Each game round lasts seven days.]
[Only by surviving the full week can participants terminate the agreement to leave or continue.]
[She can't leave now, and might not want to.]
...
Xiao Peng returned to the apartment.
He pulled Xiao Nuo into a bedroom alone, explaining Wang Nuli's situation and urging her to move out immediately.
At first Xiao Nuo thought it was a joke, but soon realized he was serious.
Fear gripped her - living alongside a serial killer? She vividly remembered what happened to Wang Ju recently.
Yet she couldn't leave.
She'd signed a contract requiring her to stay seven full days, otherwise facing massive penalties.
Moreover, she didn't want to leave.
Where else could she find such luxurious housing plus 10,000 yuan daily?
Now that she and Xiao Peng were officially dating,
She knew perfectly well - lose this apartment and income,
And her handsome, caring boyfriend would vanish instantly.
Despite Xiao Peng's desperate pleas, Xiao Nuo refused to move out,
Only promising to be extra cautious.
While initially terrified by the killer neighbor, she reasoned -
With so many residents, what were the odds he'd target her?
That evening, the college group remained at Xiao Nuo's place.
Though Wang Ju's incident dampened spirits,
They still needed dinner.
To celebrate her relationship with Xiao Peng, Xiao Nuo ordered lavish takeout for everyone.
The students cheerfully called her "Sister Nuo" between bites and board games.
All enjoyed themselves except Xiao Hua - gloomy after her breakup with Xiao Peng.
Her ex had ultimately chosen money over beauty.
Xiao Peng had actually wanted to date both, but pressure from the girls forced him to choose.
After much deliberation, he'd picked Xiao Nuo.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Another Missing Person
chapters.content:
There was no other way. She and Xiao Hua were both ordinary college students from not-so-wealthy families.
Whenever they went out, they could clearly feel the harsh reality of being poor.
The happiest moments for them were intimate activities in bed.
Xiao Peng was happy, and Xiao Hua was happy too.
After all, they were both attractive young people...
But aside from that, they couldn't think of anything else that brought them joy.
Xiao Nuo was different.
Though average-looking, she had money.
Money could buy happiness.
Just one example - the 7,000-yuan smartphone Xiao Peng was using had been bought by Xiao Nuo.Moreover, for his favorite mobile game Honor of Kings, Xiao Peng used to have no skins except the basic ones.
But now Xiao Nuo had gifted him dozens of skins, all epic, legendary or limited editions.
Therefore, he ultimately chose Xiao Nuo and abandoned Xiao Hua.
After eating some snacks, Xiao Hua excused herself to get some fresh air outside.
But everyone knew the real reason.
Xiao Peng was still concerned about Xiao Hua despite their breakup.
Xiao Q noticed the pleading look in Xiao Peng's eyes and, to reassure him, volunteered to follow Xiao Hua.
Xiao Q and Xiao Hua went out together.
There were now four guys and four girls remaining in Xiao Nuo's apartment.
After finishing their takeout, the eight college students started playing Truth or Dare out of boredom.
They used rock-paper-scissors to decide who would answer or perform - the last one losing each round would choose between truth or dare.
The first loser was a girl who chose truth.
The question was: Who among us do you like?
She answered none, saying the person she liked wasn't present.
The second loser was a guy who also picked truth.
His question: How many girlfriends have you had?
His answer: Three.
The third loser was another guy who again selected truth.
His question: How many adult films have you watched?
Answer: Many, at least over a hundred.
This drew laughter from the group.
The fourth loser happened to be the same guy who lost the third round, and he stuck with truth.
This time the question was: Who's your most frequent fantasy object?
Blushing, he answered: My college English teacher.
The group erupted in teasing, urging him to call his teacher and confess.
He immediately refused: "Hey hey, I chose truth, not dare! I have the right to refuse!"
Seeing that everyone was choosing truth and no one picked dare, they found the game boring.
So they changed the rule - losers must perform a dare.
The fifth loser was a girl.
She was usually introverted with no juicy gossip about her.
So the dare they gave her was:
Go knock on Room 701's door and take a selfie with the resident in front of their door.
The shy girl shook her head vehemently, asking for a different dare.
But the others insisted, saying this would help improve her social skills and make her more outgoing.
Reluctantly, the introverted girl went to complete her dare.
The remaining seven waited for her return.
After ten minutes with no sign of her, they weren't too concerned and kept waiting.
But by the twentieth minute, they started feeling something was off.
They were in Room 904; the girl had gone to Room 701 - just two floors apart.
Even taking the stairs shouldn't take twenty minutes.
"Maybe she's still hesitating at the door? Too scared to knock?" one girl joked.
Introverts might agonize over how to ask a classmate for an eraser, let alone knock on a stranger's door for a photo.
So the others didn't think much of it.
But Xiao Peng grew increasingly worried.
He remembered Wang Ju from two days ago, and Wang Nuli he'd seen earlier today.
With these disturbing thoughts, his heartbeat unconsciously quickened.
Truthfully, he hadn't approved of this dare from the beginning.
But he'd been outvoted by the others.
After five more minutes, Xiao Peng suddenly stood up, startling everyone:
"Let's go check Room 701. Why hasn't she come back yet? Don't tell me another Wang Ju situation happened."
The others agreed and prepared to go together.
"Relax, what are the chances of another Wang Ju incident? Unless this whole apartment is full of psychos..."
The seven took the elevator to the 7th floor. The motion-activated lights illuminated the previously dark hallway as they stepped out.
At Room 701's door, finding no trace of the girl, Xiao Peng knocked directly.
Within two minutes, the door opened to reveal a tall, blond, blue-eyed foreigner about their age.
His Chinese was heavily accented - probably also a student here.
After a quick glance, Xiao Peng asked bluntly: "Did a female friend of ours come knocking on your door? Have you seen her?"
Though polite on the surface, Xiao Peng felt intense dislike looking at the foreigner's face.
Xiao Peng hated all foreigners, white or black.
Why?
Because at bars, foreign guys always got first pick with girls.
Even though he was handsome, when girls had to choose, they'd pick a foreigner every time.
Didn't matter if the foreigner was ugly - they were just more popular.
Thus Xiao Peng despised foreigners and even more the girls who mindlessly fawned over them.
He could never be friends with such girls.
The young foreigner took several minutes processing the question before smiling down at them:
"No, no one knocked tonight."
"Really?"
Xiao Peng scanned the foreigner suspiciously, trying to peek inside.
Noticing this, the foreigner politely stepped aside to let Xiao Peng look:
"See? No one here."
Since the foreigner was being courteous, Xiao Peng couldn't rudely barge in. He just apologized before the door closed.
......
"Thank you, Xiao Q. I feel much better after talking with you."
Having come down from the rooftop, Xiao Hua and Xiao Q were now returning to Xiao Nuo's apartment.

chapters.title: Chapter 37: The Chainsaw Maniac
chapters.content:
After Xiao Q went out earlier, he had been chasing Xiao Hua all the way to the rooftop. Once there, Xiao Hua stood by the edge, gazing at the beautiful night scenery and starry sky before bursting into loud sobs.
Heartbreak is normal - unless you're the one playing games, investing real feelings will always bring pain. Faced with Xiao Hua's heartbroken state, Xiao Q managed to comfort her with just a few sentences.
The gist of his words was: "I'm Xiao Peng's childhood friend - the kind who grew up together. I know exactly what kind of person he is. He's handsome and never lacks female attention. Even if Xiao Nuo hadn't appeared, even if you, Xiao Hua, could have walked into marriage with Xiao Peng, he would still have had a continuous stream of other women. Unless you can tolerate that kind of life, breaking up now is for the best - unless you're just playing around like him."
Xiao Hua seemed to take his words to heart. After calming down for a while and easing her mood, she wiped her tears and went downstairs with Xiao Q.
When they arrived at Xiao Nuo's place and knocked, no one answered. Just as they were about to call, the silver elevator doors opened and Xiao Peng, Xiao Nuo and others emerged.
"What were you guys doing? It's so late - don't tell me you went looking for us?" Xiao Q joked.Follow current novels on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Xiao Peng's expression turned serious. "No, we..." He explained how they had been playing Truth or Dare and how the introverted girl had gone missing.
Both Xiao Q and Xiao Hua's eyes widened in disbelief. Xiao Q exclaimed, "What the hell? Just two days ago Wang Ju briefly disappeared, and now another girl vanishes in less than half an hour?"
Xiao Peng said, "Enough with the sarcasm - let's focus on finding her! Her phone's unreachable and she's not replying to messages." Because of the previous Wang Ju incident, everyone took the introverted girl's disappearance very seriously.
Xiao Q led everyone back to the elevator and declared, "Let's check Room 701 again.""Again? Why? We've already been there. That white guy said she never went to his place and even let us search. He didn't seem to be lying," one girl objected.
Xiao Q countered, "Didn't seem to be lying? The more skilled they are, the more convincing they appear! Unless we thoroughly search the place, we can't be sure he's telling the truth! And according to him, if the missing girl never went to his place and no one knocked on his door, then she disappeared between the 9th and 7th floors? Are you kidding me? Is this a den of thieves where people vanish the moment they step out?"
The girl, who was probably proud and arrogant by nature and not close with Xiao Q to begin with, felt her pride wounded by his retort. She immediately fired back angrily, "Hmph! Everyone knows she's very introverted. Maybe she got to 701 but was too shy to knock, yet too embarrassed to come back, so she just went home alone!"
Xiao Q looked at her like she was an idiot. This was exactly why he disliked hanging out with Xiao Peng's friends - they were clueless about their own stupidity yet thought themselves clever.
The group arrived at Room 701 again. This time, Xiao Q took the lead in knocking. The door soon opened, revealing the same young white man who frowned at seeing them. "What do you want now? I already told you your friend never came here."
What no one expected was that right after these words, Xiao Q suddenly kicked out violently, his foot connecting squarely with the white man's chest and sending him flying several meters backward. As he kicked, Xiao Q shouted, "You're lying, foreign devil!"
Then Xiao Q charged into 701 with the stunned Xiao Peng and others following. Waving his arm, he commanded, "Search the place!" The scene resembled Ming Dynasty imperial guards in feiyu uniforms raiding a residence.
"Hey! This is breaking and entering! I'll call the police!" The kick must have been powerful, as the white man coughed violently while delivering this warning from the floor. But the threat meant nothing to Xiao Q's group.
Xiao Q wasn't afraid at all, and those following him - including Xiao Peng - certainly weren't either. After all, Xiao Q was the one who did the kicking; it couldn't be pinned on them.
After searching the entire apartment, they all gathered before the only closed bedroom door. "Open it!" Xiao Q, usually gentle and refined, now resembled the King of Hell as he viciously ordered the still-prone white man.
The white man hesitated, his evasive eyes clearly showing guilt. "Fine, not opening it, huh?" Xiao Q made everyone step back as he prepared to kick the door down.
Just as his powerful leg lifted for the decisive strike, the bedroom door unexpectedly opened from inside. Xiao Q froze in shock, as did Xiao Peng and Xiao Nuo - none had expected someone else to be living there. But they immediately spotted who they were looking for.
The introverted girl was tightly bound to a red wooden chair, her limbs and torso secured firmly. Transparent tape covered her mouth, leaving her only able to sob desperately and make muffled noises when she saw Xiao Q's group. They'd found her!
Overjoyed, the group then focused on the tall young black man standing before the bound girl. He was extremely dark, his oily skin reflecting the light. As he stared at Xiao Q's group, he suddenly disappeared from view for several seconds before reappearing holding a roaring chainsaw.
"Die, all of you!" the black man suddenly screamed, gripping the chainsaw with both hands as he charged at Xiao Q's group outside the bedroom. Terrified screams erupted as everyone scrambled out of 701 in panic, splitting to flee down opposite stairwells.
The black man brandished his chainsaw and chased the left group. Those who went right, including Xiao Q, sighed in relief when he didn't follow them. But then they heard a new chainsaw's buzzing from inside the apartment.
Out came the white man Xiao Q had kicked earlier, now standing in the hallway with an evil grin, holding a razor-sharp chainsaw, his eyes blood red. Like a demon, he advanced step by step toward them.
"Run!" Xiao Q shouted, and everyone scattered in terror.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room...
The middle-aged uncle had just finished work and opened his streaming app to watch the broadcast when this scene unfolded before his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Jiang Ran Gets Involved
chapters.content:
Staring at the battle royale scenario before him.
Middle-aged Uncle commented with confusion: ["Hmm... I just logged in and don't quite understand what's happening, but I remember those two foreigners chasing Xiao Nuo and her college friends were cultists, right? Why aren't they acting as cultists now but as chainsaw murderers?"]
The two residents of Room 701 were members of a certain cult.
They lived here to hunt lab rats and sacrifice them to their evil god.
Like that introverted girl tied to the chair.
If not for this accident, she would have been sacrificed by these two.
But previously, the live stream viewers had only seen them perform sacrificial rituals - never witnessed them chasing people with chainsaws.
After understanding the whole story.
Middle-aged Uncle finally realized why these two foreigners were chasing people with chainsaws.
Meanwhile in Alice Apartment, Xiao Q and others forced into this battle royale.Were fleeing desperately.
They screamed for help while running, begging someone to call the police.
