While passing various rooms, they frantically knocked on doors seeking assistance.
But most residents seemed aware of the situation outside and refused to open, fearing they'd be dragged into this deadly chase.
In Room 304, it was 9 PM.
Jiang Ran, having finished his day as a customer service rep, sat on the sofa resting with eyes closed.
On the glass coffee table before him were medicine.
And a glass of water.
He had just taken his dissociative identity disorder medication and was resting.
His brief rest was interrupted by increasingly loud noises.
Frowning slightly - this was the first noisy disturbance since moving in days ago.
After all, this apartment housed few residents, all wealthy.
Not like those large complexes with mixed crowds of prostitutes and clients.
He assumed the noise would soon fade.
Instead it grew louder and clearer.
As if right outside his door.
Unable to tolerate the noise and curious, Jiang Ran went to his door, opened it and peeked out.
Wanting to see which bastard was making nighttime ruckus.
He frowned before looking - and regretted looking after.
He saw several sweaty, blood-stained people running toward him, pursued by unseen figures.
Instinct warned Jiang Ran to shut the door immediately - this was beyond his involvement.
He obeyed his instinct and tried closing the door, but too late - the group barged in.
Forced backward, Jiang Ran watched as they entered and immediately closed the door behind them.
Then all three collapsed on the floor, chests heaving violently.
Breathing like exhausted bulls.
After momentary confusion, Jiang Ran recognized them.
"Aren't you Xiao Nuo's classmates and friends?"
Three people had entered - two males and one female.
Led by Xiao Q.
Xiao Q gasped: "Yes."
Jiang Ran: "What's your situation? Why are you covered in blood?"
Xiao Q: "Long story short - we're being hunted by those two foreigners from Room 701!"
"They kidnapped our friend, and when we discovered it, they tried to silence us!!!!"
Jiang Ran froze: "That wild? That intense? Feels like you're filming a movie?"
Seeing Jiang Ran's skepticism.
Xiao Q insisted: "Not lying! One of us is already dead! This blood is proof!!!"
During their escape, one male student inexplicably stopped to hide in an elevator.
Instead of safety, he met the chainsaw.
That image would haunt Xiao Q's group forever.
"Damn, if true, I need to call police!"
As Jiang Ran reached for his phone, he learned they'd already called - now just needed to survive until police arrived.
For some reason, Jiang Ran felt ominous foreboding.
Then he understood why.
"Open door! Open door!"
Broken Chinese accompanied furious pounding.
Instantly, all four in the room held their breath.
Soon the knocking stopped.
Replaced by chainsaw buzzing.
Their pursuer was sawing through the door.
"Wait... is that a chainsaw?"
A stunned Jiang Ran stared at the trio.
"Yes, a chainsaw - why else would we three be running?"
Xiao Q panted rapidly.
"Do you think my door can stop a chainsaw?"
Jiang Ran suddenly asked.
All four fell silent.
A minute later, they acted in unison - pushing a large table against the door as makeshift barricade.
But the chainsaw proved too powerful, already destroying most of the door's center.
Jiang Ran's high-quality door stood no chance against such force.
"Heh heh heh"
Through the damaged door.
The young white man outside flashed a terrifying grin before resuming destruction.
Soon the hole allowed easy entry - the table now useless.
All four immediately fled to the bedroom, slamming its door shut.
"What do we do! What do we do! Why aren't police here yet!!!!"
In the bedroom.
The female student had broken into tears.
Crying uncontrollably.
The other male turned to Xiao Q: "Didn't Xiao Peng say you study criminal investigation to become a detective? Think of something!!!!"
Xiao Q, nearly shaken sick by the guy, replied helplessly:
"What can I do? Yes I study investigations, but I'm no detective yet! Especially against chainsaws! How could I handle this?!"
The male student also neared breakdown, especially remembering his friend killed by the young white man, and collapsed crying:ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"Ahhhh! I don't want to die!!! Why did this happen to us!!!!"
Meanwhile in the live stream room.
The main screen split in two.
One side showed the young black man chasing.
The other the young white man pursuing.
Both had many viewers, but more watched the white man's side.
Because the black man was still chasing.
While the white man had cornered his prey.
A life-or-death standoff naturally drew more attention.
What shocked many viewers was.
Jiang Ran the lab rat had gotten dragged into this!!!
Originally during this battle royale.
Many assumed Xiao Nuo would be the fourth to die, given the circumstances.
Several of her group had already fallen to chainsaws.
But no one anticipated.
Jiang Ran getting involved.
Whether from misfortune or what - just opening his door out of curiosity got him trapped.
Now the most thrilling moment approached.
Between the final two lab rats.
Who would die first - Jiang Ran or Xiao Nuo?
In Room 304's bedroom.
Jiang Ran watched as Xiao Q's trio frantically piled bedroom items against the door.
He sat on his bed, frowning at the scene.
Chaos outside, chaos inside.
His mind filled with Danger Warning System alerts:
[Ding! Host in imminent danger! Evacuate immediately! Points +10!]
[Ding! Host in imminent danger! Evacuate immediately! Points +10!]
[Ding! Host in imminent danger! Evacuate immediately! Points +10!]
"Ahhhhh, am I really going to die here?!"
"No way, I can't die like this - at least I'll fight back!"
If only Jiang Ran had known this would happen, he'd never have opened that door.
But regrets were useless now.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Danger, Danger, Danger
chapters.content:
The atmosphere was tense and oppressive, with only the roar of the chainsaw audible from outside. Jiang Ran didn't even notice as the system in his mind suddenly announced:
[Ding! Detected host is about to encounter danger. Will actively awaken host's alternate personality to resolve danger. Cost: 1000 points!]
Buzz buzz buzz!
At this very moment.
The young white man brandishing the chainsaw had already entered Room 304. After entering, he immediately started breaking down the bedroom door.
Room 304's door was a security door, and a high-quality one at that, yet it couldn't withstand the chainsaw. An ordinary bedroom door stood even less chance - forget this massive chainsaw, even a regular fire axe could smash through easily.
Although Xiao Q and the other two had piled many objects behind the door, they might as well have been scrap metal before the chainsaw's onslaught. Soon, the young white man cleared everything away and appeared at the bedroom doorway.
His cold smile, bloodstained body, towering frame, and the chainsaw in his hands made a terrifying sight. Upon entering, he sneered at Xiao Q: "Hehehe, you kicked me earlier. Now I'll let you try kicking me again."
Xiao Q's group all held makeshift weapons - whatever they could find in the bedroom like lamps and chairs. Even a cornered dog will jump over a wall, let alone humans. The three had originally planned to rush the intruder together when he entered, going all out!
But when he actually broke in, none of them made the first move. Each waited for someone else to go first - textbook self-interested behavior. Now, under the chainsaw's threat, all three retreated together behind the bed, pressed against the wall."Let me think... who should I kill first?" the young white man chuckled coldly. Suddenly he noticed someone still lying on the bed. "Stupid Chinese, think pretending to sleep will save you? I'll chop you up first!" he laughed loudly.
"Hey! Wake up already!" Xiao Q pushed Jiang Ran, unable to tell if he was truly asleep or faking. He wouldn't budge!
"Bro! Get up! Playing dead won't help!" Xiao Q desperately wanted Jiang Ran awake - another fighter would help. He wasn't the type to think "as long as someone dies before me, I can die later." But no matter what they said, Jiang Ran wouldn't wake.
Xiao Q decided you can't wake someone pretending to sleep, so he stopped trying. Standing straight, he glared at the smirking white man still by the doorway.
"Foreign devil, you and that black guy - are you both mentally ill? The black guy I get, born with underdeveloped brains. But you're white - why join his stupidity?" Xiao Q suddenly spat through gritted teeth.
The white man kept smirking: "Hehe, Chinese, if my friend heard your racist remarks, you'd die painfully! No - you'd beg for death but not get it!!!"
Xiao Q: "Racist? I'm racist against him AND you! You two idiots can't tell which crime is worse - kidnapping one person versus murdering several of us?"
Xiao Q truly believed these foreigners had brain damage. When they were discovered committing kidnapping, so what? That's still better than later taking out a chainsaw and killing several people! Murder to cover it up? Even if you kill us all, you can't silence this! With so many deaths, other residents would definitely call the police!
Thus he genuinely couldn't comprehend these foreigners' thought process!!!
The white man sneered: "You're clever, but we're not that stupid either. You're judging us from your own perspective, projecting onto us. But you're not us - we have information you don't. Killing you all is our best option."
Xiao Q scoffed: "Fine! Then do it now!" Extremely provocative, yet the white man remained motionless in the doorway. Xiao Q's companions also noticed something odd - why wasn't he attacking? Earlier he'd chased them relentlessly!Thɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Though studying criminal investigation, this was Xiao Q's first experience with such an intense manhunt - real crime. He'd been panicked earlier, only now fully regaining his wits. He realized why the white man hesitated:
"That chainsaw requires contact to kill, unlike a gun. If you charge in, at best you can only hit one person at a time. If the others aren't too cowardly to take advantage - if they all rush you to grab the chainsaw - you'd be screwed. That's why you're hesitating!"
The white man mocked: "Clever. So come try grabbing it then, you trash who ran so pathetically earlier! I'll start with you!" His gaze fell on Jiang Ran still lying on the bed - he'd make an example of him first.
"Get up bro! He's really going to chop you!" Xiao Q warned Jiang Ran again, but he remained as if truly unconscious. Xiao Q felt he'd done all he could.
Now the white man reached the bedside, eyes cold, lowering the chainsaw vertically - ready to give Jiang Ran an impromptu abdominal surgery. Xiao Q's group couldn't bear to watch, mentally preparing for the bloody scene and agonized screams while readying themselves to either seize the chainsaw or flee during the chaos. This was the chance Jiang Ran was giving them - they had to take it!

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Jiang Ran's Alternate Personality
chapters.content:
When the chainsaw was just half a meter away from Jiang Ran's abdomen, with all four people intently watching the scene, Jiang Ran suddenly moved on the bed.
His left foot kicked the side of the chainsaw with bizarre speed and strength, sending the tool flying to the ground despite being firmly gripped by the young white man's hands. In one fluid motion, Jiang Ran performed a rapid kip-up and smashed his right fist into the young white man's face. A single punch sent the attacker flying backward, leaving him writhing on the ground clutching his face in agony.
The entire sequence lasted barely three seconds. Everyone except Jiang Ran stood frozen until the dust settled. The young white man continued rolling on the floor in pain while Xiao Q and the other two could only exclaim "Holy shit!" repeatedly, their eyes locked onto Jiang Ran's retreating figure as he slowly walked out of the bedroom into the living room.
The Jiang Ran now standing in the living room wore a smile - but an unsettling one. His usual amiable expression had transformed into something sinister and unrestrained, his entire demeanor fundamentally altered. He strode to the balcony, leaning his hands on the railing as he surveyed the outside world, his lips parting to release a triumphant declaration:
"Hahaha! I'm finally out! It's finally my turn to take control of this body!!!"
He stared at his own palms, repeatedly clenching and unclenching his fists as he savored the vitality coursing through his body.
Back in the bedroom, Xiao Q picked up the now-still chainsaw and placed it on the bed. He and another male student tore Jiang Ran's bedsheet into makeshift ropes to restrain the injured white man. Though the attacker resisted fiercely despite his facial injuries, he was no match for the two young men working together. Even after being tightly bound, the white man continued hurling curses until several solid punches from Xiao Q and his companion silenced him.
"Thank you! We never knew you were this strong!!" The three approached Jiang Ran at the balcony to express their gratitude after securing their prisoner. Honestly, including Xiao Q, they'd all believed Jiang Ran was done for when the chainsaw came within inches of his stomach. None had expected him to be such a hidden martial arts expert.
Hearing their thanks, Jiang Ran slowly turned from the balcony view. Instead of acknowledging their appreciation, his face darkened as he suddenly snapped: "You three idiots dare thank me?!"
The abrupt hostility left the trio stunned. One male student retorted indignantly: "Hey, what's with the attitude?""My attitude?" Jiang Ran raised an eyebrow. "If you three morons hadn't broken into my home, would I have been involved in this mess?"
"Uh..." The protest died on the student's lips - Jiang Ran wasn't wrong. Their forced entry had indeed dragged him into danger. What Jiang Ran didn't say aloud was that he should actually thank them for giving him this opportunity to emerge.
Meanwhile, outside the apartment...
The young black man had chased Xiao Peng's group all the way outside Alice Apartment with his chainsaw. Fortunately, police arrived just as they reached the building's exit.
"Drop your weapon!" Five or six officers aimed their guns at the chainsaw-wielding attacker while Xiao Peng's group took shelter behind them.
The black man responded with bravado: "Go ahead and shoot! I dare you!" He charged forward, convinced the police wouldn't fire. To his shock, multiple gunshots rang out the moment he moved.
Five bullets tore through the black man's body. He looked down at the bleeding holes in disbelief. "You..." The chainsaw clattered to the ground as he collapsed, dead before he hit the pavement.
Only when their pursuer lay motionless did Xiao Peng and the other students finally exhale, grateful to have escaped death. Their relief was short-lived as they remembered their remaining companions inside. After hearing their report, several officers rushed into the apartment building.
The subsequent resolution unfolded methodically. Within half an hour, the situation was under control. The black man had been justifiably shot dead for attacking officers, while his white accomplice was captured alive. The introverted girl was rescued unharmed. Tragically, while she survived unscathed, several other students hadn't been so lucky during the manhunt.
Originally a group of ten - five male and five female students - they'd lost three members: one killed by the white man's chainsaw, two by the black man's. Initially, they believed these were their only casualties. Then they discovered another absence - Xiao Nuo had mysteriously vanished during the chaos.
No calls or messages reached her. With police already on scene, they checked surveillance footage, only to find Xiao Nuo had entered a camera blind spot during the escape and never reappeared. Searches of nearby apartments yielded nothing, forcing authorities to file a missing person report before removing the prisoners.
Inside a departing police car, the handcuffed white man sat sandwiched between two uniformed officers. Once Alice Apartment faded from view, he protested in broken Chinese: "Why did you kill my partner?! I know you're fake cops - you work for the organizers!"
The man in the passenger seat - presumably a game official - responded coldly: "Your black friend was stupid enough to attack us. He got what he deserved."The most update n0vels are published on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"You could've shot his leg or arm! You didn't have to kill him!" the white man argued.
"Shut up. Keep talking and I'll reunite you with your friend permanently." The icy threat in the organizer's voice made even this experienced killer hesitate.
"Where are you taking me now?"
"To another Alice Apartment overseas. You've been eliminated from the Chinese version."
"Which country?"
"Japan."

chapters.title: Chapter 41: The 25th Round Nearing Its End
chapters.content:
The remaining six members of Xiao Peng's group had all gathered at the base of Alice Apartment. Even after several police cars left, they still hadn't moved from the spot.
After waiting for some time, several ambulances arrived. Medical staff loaded the bodies of the three deceased onto the vehicles while calling their university advisors to contact the students' parents. Soon, the ambulances departed as well, leaving the area in temporary silence.
"Let's go back to Xiao Nuo's place first! Our stuff is still there!" one of them suggested.
Truth be told, after experiencing this manhunt event, the remaining six had developed an inexplicable sense of fear toward Alice Apartment. If not for their belongings left in Xiao Nuo's apartment, none would have wanted to return.
Upon entering Alice Apartment, they saw the first-floor manager Xiao Zhang anxiously making phone calls—likely contacting his superiors to handle the aftermath of such a major incident.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
As the six took the elevator to the 9th floor, the Introverted Girl suddenly broke down in tears inside the elevator. After being rescued, she had exchanged information with the others. It turned out during the dare game, she had actually knocked on the door, and the young white man from Room 701 answered. They conversed, and since the challenge required a group photo including the room number, the young white man called his black roommate to help take the photo using the girl's phone.
What happened next shocked the Introverted Girl completely. Just as they prepared for the photo, the young white man suddenly attacked, covering her mouth while his black roommate helped drag her into Room 701. Given her petite frame, she stood no chance against two tall foreigners—even one could easily overpower her. They tied her to a chair and gagged her, leaving her terrified and sobbing uncontrollably, especially after witnessing what happened to Wang Ju earlier.
Fortunately, she didn't suffer Wang Ju's fate, and Xiao Peng's group arrived just in time. However, upon seeing the mutilated, bloody corpses of her three friends who had been chainsawed to death, she had been barely holding herself together until now.
Her crying triggered emotional breakdowns among the others. After all, they were just college students who had never experienced such terrifying events—it felt like being hunted in a horror movie. Their bodies trembled uncontrollably, with only Xiao Peng, Xiao Q, and Xiao Hua maintaining relative composure.
Though Xiao Hua didn't cry, she started cursing: "This is all Xiao Nuo's fault! If she hadn't lived in this damn place, if we hadn't come here to hang out, none of this would've happened! First Wang Ju's incident cost us two people, now this—several more are gone!!!"Xiao Peng grew impatient with her complaints: "Enough! Always blaming Xiao Nuo—she's missing herself now! How can you still talk like this?" Xiao Hua fell silent but resented how Xiao Peng defended Xiao Nuo. After all, how long had Xiao Nuo even dated him compared to her? Secretly, she hoped Xiao Nuo would stay missing forever.
Returning to Xiao Nuo's apartment, they found the door locked but Xiao Peng had the key. The once lively living room now felt cold and empty, starkly contrasting their initial joyful gathering. After retrieving their belongings, none dared linger, fearing further incidents, and quickly left. They still had many matters to handle and cooperate with...
[The fourth lab rat Xiao Nuo has died. Total bets of 5.67 million have been transferred to the final prize pool.]
[Round 5: Four out of five lab rats have died, leaving only Jiang Ran remaining.]
[Total bets for Round 25 reached 134.95 million, all distributed according to shares among those who bet on Jiang Ran.]
[Three days remain in Round 25's seven-day period.]
After announcing these updates, the Long-haired Beauty disappeared from the live stream again, leaving viewers to discuss among themselves.
While Xiao Peng's group remained clueless about Xiao Nuo's mysterious disappearance, the live stream audience with their omniscient view knew exactly how she vanished and where she died. Witnessing her death scene, they could only comment: "Xiao Nuo was truly unlucky." Those who bet on her felt particularly bitter—had Jiang Ran been chainsawed to death, they would've won instead. Who could've predicted Jiang Ran's incredible combat skills?
Little Dragon Girl: [Diamond Bachelor Wang won big in the end! Of the 1.08 million bet on Jiang Ran, Brother Wang alone invested 580,000 yuan. That means out of the 130+ million, he gets over 7 million!!!!]
The payout wasn't divided equally but proportionally based on individual betting amounts. Thus Diamond Bachelor Wang profited enormously.
Many in the live stream fell silent, having initially believed Jiang Ran—a complete novice—would die first. Yet...
Domineering Female CEO: [Next time I'm following Brother Wang's bets!]
Fairy Sister: [Me too! I want to make money!!!]
I am the Hero: [Alright, Round 25's outcome is settled, payouts done. Now let's see if Jiang Ran can survive these last three days—or even make it to the next round.]

Wait, holy shit! The organizers just updated Jiang Ran's info! He recently got prescribed medication for dissociative identity disorder? He's mentally ill?!]

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Another Confrontation with the Old Man from Room 301
chapters.content:
Middle-aged Uncle: ["A split personality disorder patient? So he has multiple personalities inside him? No wonder he looks different now. Could one of his personalities have taken over?"]
The live stream chat was buzzing with discussions.
Just then, someone commented:
["Hey everyone, look at the stream! Jiang Ran is making contact with the old man from Room 301 again!!!!"]
...
At this moment, Jiang Ran was preparing to leave the apartment to enjoy some freedom.
As he passed by Room 301, the door opened.
The hunched figure of the old man from Room 301 appeared again.
"Jiang Ran, do you have time? Could you help this old man with something?"
Jiang Ran stopped in his tracks, tilting his head with a strange smile. "What is it, uncle?""Oh, just that my light bulb exploded. Could you replace it for me again?"
The old man from Room 301 came prepared this time. Last time he only had five tasks ready.
After Jiang Ran escaped last time, the old man had carefully planned thirty tasks this time.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NovᴇlFirenᴇt
He refused to believe Jiang Ran could complete them all this time.
Last time you escaped, but not this time. He would erase that humiliation.
"Sure, uncle, no problem."
Jiang Ran strode into Room 301.
Seeing his prey take the bait, the old man from Room 301 smirked coldly.
But as he followed Jiang Ran inside, something occurred to him.
The Jiang Ran he saw today felt different from before, though he couldn't quite pinpoint how.
"Never mind, he took the bait. He's dead today!"
Inside Room 301:
"Jiang Ran, the new bulb is on the sofa. The broken one is in the living room."
"Got it, uncle."
Jiang Ran worked with his usual efficiency, quickly replacing the living room bulb.
Before he could even step down from the table he was standing on, the old man spoke again:
"Jiang Ran, I'm really hungry now. Could you cook me a meal?"
After climbing down, Jiang Ran checked his phone.
2:30 AM.
The incident with those two foreigners had only just settled.
Putting away his phone, he smiled. "Of course, uncle."
And so Jiang Ran began cooking.
The old man from Room 301 obediently sat on the sofa, waiting to eat while watching Jiang Ran work.
Jiang Ran started preparing the meal.
The old man's fridge was surprisingly well-stocked.
Jiang Ran set up the pan, turned on the heat, poured oil - before it even got hot -
He dumped in a chaotic mix of unwashed, uncut vegetables, fruits and meats all at once.
Tomatoes, potatoes, spinach, pork, beef...
Creating one big mess.
Jiang Ran stirred the concoction with an evil grin.
Soon the "dish" was ready.
Jiang Ran brought the entire pan to the table.
The old man stared at the food in shock, wrinkling his nose - he'd smelled something odd while Jiang Ran was cooking.
When he stood up from the sofa and saw what Jiang Ran had made, his eyes nearly popped out.
"This... this..."
What was this disgusting, multicolored, blackened monstrosity?
Last time Jiang Ran's cooking was mediocre but at least edible.
But this? Was this even food?
Just a jumbled mess of ingredients...
"Uncle, time to eat!"
Jiang Ran served him a bowl of rice that had only been cooked for ten minutes - still hard and undercooked.
Chopsticks were provided.
Everything set before him.
Jiang Ran stared intently at the old man.
The old man from Room 301 forced a smile. "Alright, I'll eat. But there's something else I need your help with!"
Jiang Ran: "What is it?"
Old man: "Could you clean my apartment?"
Jiang Ran: "No problem. But I need to see you eat my cooking first. After you finish, I'll feel better about cleaning."
The old man looked down at the half-raw rice and the pan of culinary horror.
He swore internally never to touch it.
Eating this would land him in the hospital.
He smiled. "No need, you can clean while I eat. We'll do both at once."
Jiang Ran shook his head. "No, you eat first. I worked hard on this meal for you, uncle! Wouldn't refusing it be disrespectful?"
The old man was speechless.
Was he really stuck here?
Did he actually have to eat this?
Jiang Ran hadn't refused to help - he just set eating this abomination as a condition.
Jiang Ran was exploiting a loophole.
Not technically violating the murder rules.
A stalemate ensued.
The old man sat motionless at the table, head bowed, while Jiang Ran stood arms crossed, looking down at him.
Time ticked by.
Suddenly, the old man had an idea. "Jiang Ran, why don't we eat together?"
The old man's murder rule required getting people to do tasks in his apartment.
Refusal meant death.
Though inviting someone to eat together wasn't exactly a "task."
But cornered, the old man had no choice.
Jiang Ran beamed. "Great!"
He served himself a bowl of rice and sat down. "Let's eat, uncle!"
Old man: "Mm."
Jiang Ran: "You go first!"
Old man: "No, you first!"
Jiang Ran: "No no no, you take the first bite, then I'll eat."
Trapped, the old man reluctantly took a bite of the rock-hard rice.
So tough he could barely chew it.
"Uncle, have some dishes!"
Jiang Ran encouraged.
The old man had no choice but to take a bite of the grotesque mixture.
The taste was revolting, but he forced it down.
"Your turn, Jiang Ran."
The old man grabbed a glass of water to rinse his mouth.
But Jiang Ran said, "Oh, I'm not hungry. I won't eat."
Fury surged through the old man - he'd been tricked!
You made this disgusting mess and won't eat it yourself, but tricked me?!
Then he realized - Jiang Ran had violated his murder rules! He could attack now!!!
Though even the old man felt this trigger was stretching his usual rules.
But Jiang Ran was too troublesome - he'd make an exception!
The old man already planned:
After subduing Jiang Ran, he'd force him to eat every bite of his own disgusting creation!
That'll teach you to torment an old man!!!
"Take your time, uncle, no rush."
Jiang Ran said cheerfully.
And as Jiang Ran smiled,
The previously hunched old man sitting at the table
Slowly straightened his posture before Jiang Ran's eyes.
Then, gradually, the old man stood up.
Standing straight as a pine tree.
Back perfectly erect.
His full height reaching 175cm.

chapters.title: Chapter 43: The 25th Round Concludes
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran didn't seem particularly surprised by the sudden change in the old man from Room 301. Instead, he responded with playful sarcasm:
"Old man, your back healed up? You should thank me! Must be my cooking was so good it cured your back problems."
The old man from Room 301 stood up with a wrinkly smile that squeezed his entire face.
"That's right, thanks to you, young man. So to show my gratitude, let me treat you to some steamed buns."
No sooner had he stood up than the old man suddenly attacked. His right fist shot out like lightning. Even disregarding the force behind it, the sheer speed of the punch surpassed what most twenty-somethings could manage.
But what happened next was even more astonishing. As the fist came at him, Jiang Ran simultaneously rose to his feet and threw a counterpunch with equally fluid, lightning-fast movements.
BAM!
Their fists collided violently. Jiang Ran calmly withdrew his hand afterward, completely unfazed, while the old man's entire arm trembled uncontrollably, his face twitching several times.
"Not bad, kid. I underestimated you. Didn't expect you to be a trained fighter."
"Haha, likewise, old man. Who would've thought not only was your back injury fake, but your martial skills are nothing to scoff at either!"After three seconds of intense eye contact, the two suddenly launched at each other like mortal enemies.
Like some other apartments, Room 301 had soundproofing. So despite their life-and-death struggle creating massive commotion, none of the other residents noticed.
But the live stream audience saw everything. Though it was already 3 AM, many viewers remained awake due to the earlier manhunt events and now witnessed this brutal fight unfolding live.
The chat exploded with comments:
[Damn! Jiang Ran's current personality is ridiculously strong! He's actually trading blows with that old man!]The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
[No kidding! That old man fights like a demon - definitely professionally trained. I run a martial arts school, and his techniques are legit!]
[This is insane! More exciting than any martial arts movie! So damn satisfying!]
[Right? Remember how this old bastard slaughtered those five victims like chickens? Always playing weak. Serves him right to finally meet his match!]
The battle raged for a full hour, leaving the living room in shambles. In the end, Jiang Ran remained standing - though covered in wounds, his face swollen. Spitting out blood, he looked down at the far more battered old man gasping on the floor.
"Old man, if you were decades younger at my age, I'd have lost for sure. Pity age caught up with you."
Before leaving, Jiang Ran considerately called an ambulance for the old man. Originally planning to go out, he instead returned home, physically exhausted from the fight.
But shortly after resting, a cold mechanical voice echoed in his mind:
[Ding! Host no longer in danger. Alternate personality receding. Primary personality resuming control!]
Jiang Ran's eyes turned bloodshot as he cursed: "Dammit! I don't want to go back!"
...
Next morning.
Dawn.
Jiang Ran woke from nightmares to discover his entire body covered in painful injuries.
"Strange... where did all these wounds come from? And wasn't I trapped in my bedroom by that chainsaw man last night? Was it all a dream?"
Inspecting his bedroom revealed complete disarray. The living room was worse - especially the security door which now looked thoroughly wrecked. Clearly, it hadn't been a dream.
But if not, what happened afterward? And how did he get these injuries?
As he pondered, familiar voices sounded in the hallway. Apartment manager Xiao Zhang entered with a team of workers in uniforms carrying tools and materials.
"Ah, Mr. Jiang Ran! Our deepest apologies for last night's incident and the damages to your home. Rest assured the apartment management will cover all repair costs. We'll have everything fixed up now."
The workers immediately got to work. Scratching his head, Jiang Ran asked Xiao Zhang what exactly had happened last night.
The manager briefly explained: two foreign criminals had targeted Xiao Nuo's classmate, but police intervened and resolved the situation.
Some details still didn't add up for Jiang Ran, but he decided not to dwell on it - at least he was alive. As for his injuries...
Noticing the wounds, Xiao Zhang quickly added: "Mr. Jiang Ran, these must be from last night too. Please get checked at the hospital - we'll cover all medical expenses."
Jiang Ran had planned hospital treatment anyway, so free healthcare was welcome.
The following days passed smoothly. The repair team efficiently restored Jiang Ran's apartment, and all structural damages from that night's manhunt throughout the building were fixed. Hospital checks confirmed only superficial wounds - nothing serious.
More importantly, all this occurred within the last three days of the 25th round's seven-day period. Meaning Jiang Ran had survived the 25th round as a lab rat.
The live stream audience wasn't particularly surprised - that fight had been too intense. Even if it wasn't Jiang Ran's primary personality but an alternate that did the fighting, it proved how incredibly hard he was to kill.
Live stream chat:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Well, the 25th round's over. Now we wait for the 26th. Wonder how many days this time.]
Domineering Female CEO: [There were five days between Rounds 24 and 25 - average pacing for this show! The 26th round can wait!]
Little Dragon Girl: [Stream closes in ten minutes. While Jiang Ran survived Round 25, it'd be a shame if he died in the apartment before Round 26 starts.]
Many previous lab rats had survived one round only to perish before the next began. After all, when the "Neighbors Over Distant Relatives" live stream ended, the apartment's psychopathic killers didn't take vacations.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Class Reunion, The Ex-Girlfriend
chapters.content:
I am the Hero: [Can anyone recommend other interesting live streams on this Black Software?]
Fairy Sister: [Check the popularity rankings, but none are as good as this one.]
...
Jiang Ran received a call from his ex-girlfriend that day.
To call her his ex-girlfriend wasn't entirely accurate—she was actually the original host's ex-girlfriend. The original host had worked multiple jobs and pushed himself to death precisely because this ex-girlfriend had dumped him.
Searching through his memories, Jiang Ran realized the original host and his ex hadn't contacted each other since their breakup. So why was she calling now?
"Don't tell me it's some cliché scenario where she's inviting her ex-boyfriend to her wedding?"
After answering the call, Jiang Ran understood the reason. His ex was crying about her new boyfriend dumping her and wanted comfort from her former flame.
Jiang Ran knew there was a high chance he could "score" if he went to see her. But recalling the original host's memories, he realized this ex-girlfriend wasn't someone easy to deal with—despite being quite attractive.
In the end, Jiang Ran decided against meeting her. Getting entangled with this "monster" would be disastrous.That same day, Jiang Ran received a second call—this time from some of the original host's college friends inviting him to dinner the next day. Since he was free, Jiang Ran thought it would be nice to get a free meal and agreed.
The next day at noon, in a private room at a restaurant:
Three men and two women. One of the men was Jiang Ran. Another was quite overweight, around 200 pounds at 5'7", always wearing a cheerful smile. The last was of average build but very short—only 5'3", though he appeared taller now thanks to hidden shoe lifts and terrifyingly high heels.
As for the two women: the first had ordinary looks but decent height at 5'3". The second was beautiful with a mature, elegant appearance and matching height at 5'7".
All five had attended the same university, same year, and same club. They'd met through the club and maintained a strong friendship since college until now.
The dinner had been initiated by the 200-pound guy. His reason was simple: after struggling to find a girlfriend due to his weight, he'd finally met a girl through a family-arranged blind date. Their relationship was going well, and they'd gotten engaged. So this meal was both a celebration and a reunion with long-unseen friends.
"Damn, fatty! You're actually engaged! And you didn't even invite us to the engagement!" The short guy grabbed a bottle of baijiu and poured several shots down the big guy's throat as punishment.
"Come on, it was just the engagement! Only relatives were there. Of course I'll invite you to the wedding—you'll need to give red envelopes after all!" The big guy laughed heartily, raising his glass and downing it in one go.
After drinking, he scanned the others. "Don't just talk about me—how about your love lives?"
The short guy suddenly wrapped an arm around the ordinary-looking girl beside him, grinning broadly. "We're doing great too—almost engaged!"
The girl blushed furiously.
"What the hell? When did you two get together?" the big guy exclaimed in surprise.
"Secret! But since we're almost engaged anyway, might as well tell you all now!" the short guy declared.
"Congratulations!" the big guy said, then turned his gaze to the tall, beautiful mature-looking woman.
Her name was Wang Qingzhao—named by her parents after the famous Song Dynasty poet Li Qingzhao.
"Qingzhao, how's it going with your boyfriend?"
Wang Qingzhao smiled faintly, unconcerned. "We broke up a while ago."
"Broke up? Why? Everything seemed fine!"
Wang Qingzhao shrugged. "Might as well tell you—I'm quite conservative and refused premarital sex. He couldn't handle that, so we split."
Everyone had an "aha" moment before simultaneously turning to Jiang Ran.
The big guy smirked mischievously. "Jiang Ran, how's it going with Shen Xing? I clearly remember you two were the first couple in our group—stuck together like glue back in college."
Shen Xing was the ex-girlfriend who had called earlier.
Jiang Ran replied calmly, "We broke up long ago."
"Broke up?" Everyone looked shocked, especially Wang Qingzhao sitting to Jiang Ran's left.
"How? You two were so close! I was already preparing to attend your wedding after graduation!" the big guy exclaimed.
Jiang Ran remained composed. "Forget the wedding wine. Shen Xing thought I was too poor, so she found someone richer."
This surprised the big guy—the Shen Xing they knew in college hadn't seemed materialistic at all. Jiang Ran simply said people change; just because someone didn't care about money before didn't mean they never would.
Suddenly, the big guy suggested, "Hey, Jiang Ran, Wang Qingzhao—since you're both single now, why not get together?"
The big guy had activated his "matchmaker" skill.
The two protagonists were stunned, instinctively making eye contact before immediately looking away in mutual embarrassment.
The big guy downed another full glass of baijiu in one gulp, then continued, "Come on, no need to hide it anymore. Back then, everyone knew both you, Wang Qingzhao, and Shen Xing liked Jiang Ran. He just happened to choose Shen Xing. Now that she's gone, wouldn't you two make a great pair?"
Just as he finished speaking, the private room door suddenly swung open.
Everyone assumed it was the waiter, but instead, familiar faces appeared.
"Looks like we're not too late after all!" a clear female voice rang out.
Jiang Ran's ex-girlfriend Shen Xing had arrived—with her boyfriend Zhou Wu in tow.
Stunned by his ex's sudden appearance, Jiang Ran shot a questioning look at the big guy, who awkwardly laughed, "Haha, well... Shen Xing was part of our little group too! But... didn't you say you weren't coming earlier? What changed?"
Indeed, this university club group originally had six members—Shen Xing was the sixth.nᴇt
Shen Xing had a very feminine charm. Now she sat down beside her boyfriend Zhou Wu.
Answering the big guy, she said, "How could I miss a gathering with old classmates?" Then her gaze shifted to Jiang Ran across the table.
Jiang Ran stared at Shen Xing, then at Zhou Wu beside her, thoroughly confused. Weren't they supposed to have broken up? How were they back together?

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Wang Qingzhao
chapters.content:
The sudden arrival of Shen Xing and her boyfriend gradually cooled down the previously lively atmosphere.
Noticing the awkwardness, Shen Xing took the initiative to break the silence: "I have good news to share with everyone! Zhou Wu and I are already engaged and will be getting married soon. We hope you can all come to our wedding banquet! You must come!" She specifically added, "That includes you too, Jiang Ran!"
At that moment, everyone at the table couldn't help but feel secondhand embarrassment for Jiang Ran. After all, they had dated for so many years - it was impossible to say there were no feelings involved. Inviting an ex-boyfriend to her wedding like this... Who wouldn't find that uncomfortable?
But it seemed their concerns were unnecessary. Jiang Ran replied calmly, "Sure, I'll definitely attend." His reaction was so composed, as if he were just attending an ordinary classmate's wedding rather than his ex-girlfriend's.
Jiang Ran noticed the strange looks others were giving him and found it somewhat amusing. After all, he wasn't the original owner of this body and had no emotional attachment to Shen Xing. So what if she was getting married?
Seeing Jiang Ran's indifferent reaction to her wedding invitation, Shen Xing felt inexplicably irritated. She changed the subject: "I haven't properly introduced my boyfriend to everyone yet."
"My boyfriend is Zhou Wu, same age as me. His family owns a textile factory. He drives a Mercedes worth 300,000 yuan, and we've bought our marital home at Alice Apartment." Shen Xing wore a proud expression.
Everyone had already guessed that Shen Xing's new boyfriend was wealthy, as Jiang Ran had previously mentioned she found someone rich.
The chubby guy asked curiously, "Sounds like your boyfriend is doing really well - probably the best among us. But why buy an apartment as your marital home? Apartments are usually messy places with all sorts of questionable people around."
Shen Xing rolled her eyes at him. "What do you know, fatso? Alice Apartment isn't some low-class public housing! It's a high-end apartment complex where only wealthy people can afford to live! It costs 50,000 yuan per square meter!"The chubby guy scratched his head. "Oh, I see!"
Shen Xing offered, "After lunch, you can all come see our marital home." But everyone quickly made excuses to decline.
The lunch ended around 2 PM. Outside the restaurant, the group went their separate ways. The chubby guy drove off to meet his own fiancée, while the shorter guy and plain-looking girl also left in their car, claiming they had another date. Shen Xing got into her boyfriend Zhou Wu's Mercedes, heading to their new home.
Although Zhou Wu hadn't spoken a word throughout the meal, Jiang Ran could clearly sense the intense hostility in the man's gaze - he obviously knew Jiang Ran was Shen Xing's ex.
"Jiang Ran, where are you going? Let me give you a ride home," offered Wang Qingzhao, who had also driven there. Among the group, Jiang Ran was the only one without a car.
"Thanks, I won't stand on ceremony then," Jiang Ran smiled at her.
Soon after, the last two - Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao - also left the restaurant.
As they departed, a young man in his twenties emerged from a café across the street, staring intently at Wang Qingzhao's car as it drove away.
Inside the car:
"Where to, Jiang Ran?" Wang Qingzhao asked as she drove, the scent of her perfume filling the vehicle.
"Alice Apartment," Jiang Ran replied.
Wang Qingzhao glanced at him, her eyes flashing with disappointment. She thought to herself: "So he still can't let go of his ex-girlfriend after all..."
Jiang Ran seemed to read her mind. "Qingzhao, don't misunderstand. I'm not going because of Shen Xing's marital home. I'm going because... I also live at Alice Apartment."
"You live there too?" Wang Qingzhao was astonished. "Why would you rent there? The monthly rent must be expensive! It's 50,000 yuan per square meter!"
Jiang Ran chuckled. "Renting would indeed be pricey. But I'm not renting - I own a place there."
Wang Qingzhao's surprise grew. "You own a place? Since when did you become so wealthy?"
Jiang Ran explained, "It's like this..." He recounted how he'd won the apartment through a pancake purchase lottery.
Wang Qingzhao shook her head with a smile. "Lucky you! If you'd won this apartment earlier, maybe you and Shen Xing would still be together."Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"Maybe," Jiang Ran conceded. "But we would have broken up sooner or later anyway."
The car soon arrived at Alice Apartment. As Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao approached the security gate, they saw Shen Xing and Zhou Wu about to pass through.
Spotting them, Shen Xing said with surprise and pride, "Oh? Didn't you two say you weren't coming to see our marital home? Why did you follow us here?"
Jiang Ran glanced at her. "You've misunderstood. I live here too."
"You live here? Renting, I suppose?" Zhou Wu, who had remained silent until now, finally spoke with a condescending tone: "No wonder Xing'er broke up with you. You really don't know how to manage your finances. Even the cheapest unit at Alice Apartment costs at least 3,000 yuan in monthly rent. There's absolutely no need for you to live here just to pretend you're doing well." As he spoke, Zhou Wu twirled his Mercedes car keys.
Jiang Ran remained silent. Wang Qingzhao wanted to defend him, but Jiang Ran stopped her. They waited for Shen Xing and Zhou Wu to pass through the security gate first before proceeding themselves. They even let the couple take the elevator first.
"Jiang Ran, why didn't you explain yourself earlier?" Wang Qingzhao complained in the elevator, feeling indignant on his behalf. "You didn't have to let them look down on you like that!"
Jiang Ran shrugged. "Let them think what they want. I don't care."
"Hmm... you've changed," Wang Qingzhao remarked after hearing his response, studying Jiang Ran carefully.
"How so?" Jiang Ran asked.
"Your personality isn't as competitive as before. The old you would definitely have explained that you own a place here, not rent."
Jiang Ran smiled. "People change."
He thought to himself that the original owner's personality had indeed been quite competitive and unwilling to admit defeat. That's why he'd taken on multiple jobs just to earn more money and prove himself to his girlfriend, ultimately working himself to death. Jiang Ran wouldn't do that - he only worked one job now, just enough to cover his living expenses and medication for his dissociative identity disorder.
At the door of Room 304, Wang Qingzhao followed Jiang Ran inside after he unlocked it with his fingerprint. Upon entering, her eyes lit up in surprise.
Jiang Ran's home was quite nicely decorated, creating a very comfortable atmosphere. Most importantly, it was spotlessly clean. To be blunt, it was even cleaner than her own place. She didn't think this was because Jiang Ran had done special cleaning - he couldn't have known in advance that someone would visit. This level of cleanliness must simply be Jiang Ran's normal standard.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Unexpected Turn of Events
chapters.content:
"Truly outstanding."
Wang Qingzhao gazed at Jiang Ran's retreating figure, her eyes flashing with deep admiration.
"Have some water."
At this moment, Wang Qingzhao sat on the sofa while Jiang Ran poured her a glass of warm water and prepared some milk candies.
When Jiang Ran went to the balcony to collect laundry, Wang Qingzhao's curious glance happened to fall upon a medicine bottle on the coffee table.
"Anovoxidine"
She read the drug name aloud without much thought, casually turning it in her hands until the treatment indications came into view.
When she saw it was used to treat dissociative identity disorder, schizophrenia, depression, and anxiety, her mouth fell open in shock.
Jiang Ran returned just then, noticing Wang Qingzhao holding his medicine bottle.
Looking up, Wang Qingzhao asked, "Jiang Ran, this medicine...?"After tossing the laundry onto his bedroom bed, Jiang Ran replied, "Yes, it's mine."
Wang Qingzhao felt stunned. She distinctly remembered Jiang Ran never having any mental health issues since she'd known him.
"Could it be because of the breakup with Shen Xing?"
From that moment, her heart ached even more for this young man.
And she regretted that past incident all the more.
Back then, Jiang Ran had been equally close with both her and Shen Xing.
Both girls had liked Jiang Ran, but neither had confessed.
Until one summer vacation during university.
Jiang Ran had called both her and Shen Xing, saying he wanted to meet.
She happened to be traveling that summer, so she had to decline without much thought.
Shen Xing went anyway.
By the time she returned from her trip, those two had become a couple.
Later she learned Jiang Ran hadn't called them randomly - he'd been severely ill with flu and needed someone to care for him.
He'd called her first, but she hadn't seized the opportunity.
Had she not been traveling, she definitely would have gone.
But regrets were useless - what's done was done.
The past couldn't be changed.
"By the way Jiang Ran, remember during university when our school had that..."
Seeking to steer away from this melancholy topic, Wang Qingzhao brought up amusing university memories.
Drawing from the original host's memories, Jiang Ran engaged in the nostalgic conversation.
By the time they finished talking, it was already 6pm, so Jiang Ran invited Wang Qingzhao to stay for dinner.
Wang Qingzhao gladly accepted, curious about Jiang Ran's cooking skills since back in university his specialty had been instant noodles... the less said about other dishes, the better.
After dinner at 7pm, it was time for Wang Qingzhao to leave.
But then she awkwardly said, "Jiang Ran, I don't want to hide this - could I stay overnight at your place?"
Jiang Ran blinked. "Why?"
Wang Qingzhao explained, "The upstairs neighbors are renovating - abnormally, day and night. Complaints do nothing. These days I've been either in hotels or sleeping in my car, so..."
"Fine by me. Saves you hotel expenses anyway."
Jiang Ran didn't mind.
That night, Jiang Ran gave Wang Qingzhao his bedroom while he took the sofa, making her both embarrassed and touched.
Unable to sleep late at night, Wang Qingzhao crept out to check if Jiang Ran was asleep. His soft breathing confirmed he was sound asleep.
In the darkness, she gazed at his vague form on the sofa and sighed inwardly: "There's no renovation upstairs. I just wanted an excuse to spend more time alone with you."
With this melancholy thought, she returned to bed.
Early next morning, both rose early.
After breakfast of buns and soy milk Jiang Ran bought, Wang Qingzhao prepared for work.
Jiang Ran saw her off to the apartment entrance, watching her drive away.
As Wang Qingzhao's car left Alice Apartment, a figure emerged from bushes across the street.
It was the same young man from yesterday who'd followed them from the café.
Now his forehead veins bulged as he ground his teeth audibly.
Through clenched teeth, he spat out each word:
"Wang Qingzhao, didn't you claim to be conservative, refusing premarital sex?"
"Why? Why break your own rule?"
His furious fist struck a nearby tree, which remained unharmed except for shedding some aged bark.
This man was Zhao Jie, Wang Qingzhao's ex-boyfriend.
At yesterday's reunion, Wang Qingzhao had said Zhao Jie initiated their breakup because she was too conservative - a lie.
In truth, she'd dumped him.
The reason? She simply wanted out.
Zhao Jie was furious - he'd genuinely loved Wang Qingzhao.
Throughout their relationship:
No sleeping together, not even kissing, hand-holding, waist-hugging or embracing.
Wang Qingzhao refused!
He endured it!
Every text exchange saw him writing paragraphs while she replied with cold "mhms."
He tolerated that too!
Yet his endless concessions earned no sincerity!The source of thɪs content is
Finally, she dumped him!
So Zhao Jie quit his job to secretly follow Wang Qingzhao, determined to learn why she'd left him.
After days of surveillance, her life seemed as monotonous as ever - no new lover emerged.
Until yesterday.
She attended the reunion, then drove some man home.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: The 26th Round Begins
chapters.content:
He didn't take it too seriously at first.
But when they entered the apartment together and stayed there for an increasingly long time, not coming out all night until the next morning!
Zhao Jie was disappointed, utterly disappointed.
He believed that when a single man and woman stayed alone together all night, something was bound to happen!
And those things that happened were what he refused to acknowledge!!!
Zhao Jie lowered his head at this moment, tears welling in the corners of his eyes, his face twisted like a pretzel:
"Fine, fine! So cold and distant in front of me, yet willing to abandon all principles for another man! Fine, just fine!"
"All that talk about staying chaste before marriage - that was just for me!!!"
Zhao Jie probably never imagined that he was completely mistaken in his assumptions.
Absolutely nothing had happened between Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao!......
"Welcome dear audience to our 'A Distant Relative Is Not as Helpful as a Near Neighbor' game livestream."
"The 26th round of the game is about to begin."
"Let me introduce this round's lab rats!"
The same dark studio as before, where the long-haired beauty wore a blue qipao dress, ethereal as a fairy, continued hosting as usual.
Currently in the livestream room:
The viewer count stood at 189,054, bustling with activity.
Middle-aged Uncle: [After waiting a whole week, it's finally back on air!]
Little Dragon Girl: [The wait was torture, wuwuwu...]
Little Aunt: [Tell me about it! The past week without the livestream felt so dull!]Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on
Domineering Female CEO: [You're all exaggerating... It's just one week. Couldn't you just spend time with some young men instead?]
......
The long-haired beauty continued hosting:
[Now let me introduce this round's five lab rats.]
[The first lab rat is Jiang Ran, who survived last round and had the last laugh. You're all familiar with him, so I won't elaborate.]
Domineering Female CEO commented: [Honestly, I never expected Jiang Ran to survive another week and make it to the 26th round.]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Same here! During the days without broadcast, I was actually worried Jiang Ran might die. Turns out he's really tenacious, our little Haki Ran!]
Little Aunt: [Wow, Middle-aged Uncle, are you really middle-aged in real life? You sound so young, even saying 'Haki Ran'!]
Middle-aged Uncle: [I'm definitely middle-aged, no doubt about it!]
As the livestream buzzed with discussion, the long-haired beauty continued:
"Alright, now introducing the second lab rat."
"Second lab rat: Zhou Wu, male, 24 years old, family owns a textile factory. Recently moved into the Alice Apartment with his fiancée Shen Xing, where they bought their marital home."
Hearing this, the livestream erupted again:
[Huh? Bought a marital home in Alice Apartment? But Alice Apartment isn't for sale to the public, is it?]
Alice Apartment appears listed for sale, but actually purchasing it is impossible.
Especially when the buyers are just ordinary people.
Domineering Female CEO said: [I know! The organizers must be short on money! Selling property to ease financial pressure!!!]
Little Dragon Girl: [Uh...haha, really? Then I'll donate 100 yuan to the organizers!]
Little Aunt: [I'll donate 50!]
No one actually believed the organizers were short on money - even if they were, they wouldn't sell property to solve it!
The only possibility was that this was similar to Jiang Ran's situation last time - an unconventional way for lab rats to enter Alice Apartment.
The long-haired beauty said: "Many of you have probably guessed it - Zhou Wu and his fiancée, like Jiang Ran last time, entered Alice Apartment through unconventional means."
"And what's even more interesting - Zhou Wu's fiancée Shen Xing is Jiang Ran's ex-girlfriend."
The moment these words were spoken, the livestream exploded.
[Holy shit, what a small world! They actually ran into each other?]
[Ex-girlfriend, ex-boyfriend, current fiancé, marital home...this is getting interesting...]
[Not sure if the organizers planned this or if it's pure coincidence that the ex-girlfriend and her fiancé bought property here...]
[Pure love faction passing by, don't want to see any NTR...]
[NTR is a must! Perfect opportunity with an ex-girlfriend involved! Isn't this a popular theme in Japanese media?]
"Alright, alright, moving on to introduce the third lab rat."
"Third lab rat: Xiao Q, male, college student, 20 years old. You probably know him already - Xiao Nuo's friend from last time. Signed a contract with us for 10,000 per day."
Domineering Female CEO: [This keeps getting better! Last round we were just speculating how interesting it would be to get this smart college student involved, and now they actually did it!]
"Fourth lab rat: Ke Bei, male, 25 years old, unemployed. Mother died young, father was a private investigator who mysteriously disappeared during a case. Signed a contract with us for 10,000 per day."
Fairy Sister: [Ke Bei? Please tell me his dad wasn't named Conan Edogawa?]

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Betting Amounts
chapters.content:
"The fifth lab rat, Li Mengmeng, female, 30 years old, dance streamer, signed a contract with us for 10,000 yuan per day."
"Now all five lab rats have been introduced."
"Please place your bets. The betting period will end in half an hour."
Soon, half an hour passed.
The Long-haired Beauty began announcing the betting amounts for the five lab rats.
"The first lab rat, Jiang Ran, has received bets totaling: 60 million."
"The second lab rat, Zhou Wu, has received bets totaling: 10 million."
"The third lab rat, Xiao Q, has received bets totaling: 51 million."
"The fourth lab rat, Ke Bei, has received bets totaling: 10.99 million."
"The fifth lab rat, Li Mengmeng, has received bets totaling: 6 million."In the live stream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: [I knew Jiang Ran would have the highest amount.]
Domineering Female CEO: [Last time he was the lowest, this time the highest. But I bet on Xiao Q.]
Jiang Ran having the highest amount was normal. As the survivor from the previous round who had lived through another week without streaming until the 26th round began, his strength was undeniable. Of course, what really made people confident in betting on him was that he was a patient with dissociative identity disorder - the brutality of the alternate personality that had once taken control of his body remained fresh in the viewers' memories.
The second highest was Xiao Q. As the friend of Xiao Nuo's boyfriend Xiao Peng from the previous round, he had left a deep impression on the viewers. A smart guy majoring in criminal investigation.
Third highest was Ke Bei, who benefited entirely from the "Conan effect" (referring to the famous detective Conan) and his missing detective father - very story-like.
Fourth was Zhou Wu.
Fifth and last was Li Mengmeng.
These two clearly lacked any standout qualities that would attract bets.
If there was any standout point, many viewers wanted to see Jiang Ran cuckold Zhou Wu (NTR scenario).
In reality, the Diamond Bachelor (wealthy heiress) had already placed her bet long ago. For the 26th round, her intuition told her Xiao Q would be the last one standing. Normally she would directly bet on Xiao Q, but this time she hesitated, torn between Jiang Ran and Xiao Q. Ultimately, she still chose Xiao Q, trusting her sixth sense.
At this moment, the Long-haired Beauty said: "Since everyone has finished betting, I declare - a near neighbor is better than a distant relative - the 26th round game begins now!"
"All five lab rats have moved in!!!"
...
Day 1 of the 26th round.
7:00 AM.Follow current novels on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
It happened to be Saturday.
Xiao Q in Room 904 was looking out at the beautiful morning scenery through his balcony window. Careful observers might notice that Room 904 was previously Xiao Nuo's residence, now assigned to Xiao Q.
"This Alice Apartment definitely has major problems," Xiao Q muttered to himself.
A few days earlier, a middle-aged man had approached him with an offer - sign an agreement to live in Alice Apartment for 10,000 yuan per day. Had it not been for his previous experiences coming to Alice Apartment with Xiao Nuo and Xiao Peng, he would have scoffed at such an offer, dismissing it as some new scam. But after what he'd been through, he knew better.
Especially after meeting Xiao Nuo's parents a few days ago, he became even more convinced. They - including Xiao Peng - had all thought Xiao Nuo's parents were wealthy entrepreneurs living in a mansion. But when her parents came to handle their missing daughter's affairs, they turned out to be ordinary folks - one worked in a factory, the other as a waiter in a local restaurant. Nothing like what they'd imagined.
This confirmed one thing for Xiao Q - Xiao Nuo must have signed this agreement too. So now he had signed it and moved into the apartment as well. Unlike Xiao Nuo, who he guessed was in it for the 10,000 yuan per day (though that was certainly attractive), Xiao Q was primarily motivated by his growing fascination with Alice Apartment.
"Too bad that middle-aged man wouldn't say anything - I'll have to investigate myself."
Xiao Q opened his phone and checked the Alice Apartment residents' group chat. He saw a message from the manager Xiao Zhang about a welcome party for new residents at 7:30 PM that evening. New residents were encouraged to attend, while existing residents could come if interested.
Putting away his phone, he left Room 904 and headed for the elevator to go find Xiao Zhang on the first floor.
"Wang Ju encountered that perverted criminal Lin Shengli."
"The human-skin kite maker Wang Nuli that we met."
"And those two foreign chainsaw-wielding psychopaths that night."
"Normally encountering just one of these freaks would be 'lucky' enough. But to have so many in one apartment building? Unbelievable."
"Also, there must be a reason behind this 10,000 yuan per day agreement. What makes that middle-aged man seek out people like me or others to live in Alice Apartment?"
Reaching the first floor, he found the manager Xiao Zhang in the management office.
"Oh, Mr. Xiao Q! What can I do for you?" Manager Xiao Zhang was as enthusiastically friendly as ever with everyone.
Xiao Q: "I wanted to ask - aside from me, are there any other new residents moving in recently for tonight's welcome party?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Yes, of course there are."
Xiao Q: "How many?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Including you, there are five new residents this time. Though two of them are an engaged couple who bought an apartment here as their marital home."
Xiao Q: "What about last time when my friend Xiao Nuo moved in? Was there a welcome party then?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Yes, we hold them regularly."
Xiao Q: "How many new residents were there last time?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Five."
Xiao Q: "I see. Can I ask - are those other residents who moved in around the same time as Xiao Nuo still living here?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Well... your friend Xiao Nuo went missing from our apartment. Jiang Ran is still here. The other three - Qin Fei, Murong Fu, and Wang Xixi - moved out long ago."
Xiao Q: "Do you have contact information for those three who moved out?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Of course we do."
Xiao Q: "Could you give it to me?"
Manager Xiao Zhang shook his head: "Sorry, no. Our apartment has an obligation to protect residents' privacy, whether current or former."
Xiao Q: "Alright then."
Xiao Q realized he'd have to wait for tonight's welcome party to get more information.
After leaving the management office, instead of returning to Room 904, Xiao Q decided to ride his bicycle around the neighborhood for a while.
At the apartment's ground-level parking area for residents' bicycles and electric scooters, Xiao Q noticed something very strange.

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Ke Bei
chapters.content:
There were very few bicycles or electric scooters here. Extremely rare, in fact.
Of course, given the property prices at Alice Apartment, only those with considerable assets could afford to live here.
Thus, most residents traveled by car. Though Xiao Q hadn't been to the underground parking garage, he hadn't seen many cars parked above ground either.
Just as he was unlocking his bicycle in the garage,
someone approached nearby, also unlocking their bicycle.
The man wasn't far away, and after unlocking his bike, he pushed it toward Xiao Q.
Xiao Q noticed the man wasn't particularly old, but had an unkempt beard covering his upper lip, chin, and thick sideburns.
With dark circles under his eyes, the man walked over and asked directly: "Are you one of the new residents this time?"
Xiao Q nodded. The man then said: "I'm also a new arrival. My name is Ke Bei."
Xiao Q froze: "Ke Bei? Do you have a younger or older brother named Ke Nan?"Ke Bei seemed accustomed to such jokes and continued: "You're probably not an ordinary resident."
"Are you investigating Alice Apartment?"
The sudden question wiped the slight smile off Xiao Q's face.
He replied seriously: "Investigation? What investigation? I don't understand what you're talking about."
Ke Bei muttered to himself: "My father was a private detective. He mysteriously disappeared several years ago while investigating a case. The case he was investigating involved Alice."
"Also, there's no need to hide it. I can smell a fellow investigator on you. Even if you're not one, you must have deep knowledge about detectives and criminal investigations."
"Additionally, I can read lips. I know everything you discussed with that administrator."
To others, this rapid-fire speech might have been confusing.
But Xiao Q listened carefully, pondering each word before finally asking: "What do you want?"
Ke Bei gestured: "Let's talk while we walk."
The two pushed their bicycles and left Alice Apartment together.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
[Damn! What are these two planning? Both investigating Alice Apartment?]
[Let them investigate! Makes it more exciting. There were investigators before, but none started this intensely.]
[Getting interesting! This 26th round keeps getting better.]
[Interesting? Now that they've left, we can't see or hear what they're doing!]
[Doesn't matter. They can't run far from their base anyway.]
Walking their bicycles without riding, they moved along the roadside where few pedestrians passed.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Ke Bei spoke first: "My purpose here is simple - investigate Alice and my father's disappearance. What about you?"
Xiao Q replied: "Mainly interested in Alice, plus I have a friend who signed the agreement and also disappeared here."
Ke Bei said: "Since our goals align, we can cooperate."
Xiao Q stared at Ke Bei for a long moment: "Cooperate? We just met today, still strangers, and you want to team up? Do you think I'd dare?"
Ke Bei countered: "If you lacked courage, you wouldn't have come to Alice Apartment as a new resident."
Xiao Q smiled: "True. 'Knowing there are tigers in the mountains, yet deliberately heading there' - we're the same type. Fine, let's uncover the apartment's secrets together."
"A cooperative gamble."
Internally, Xiao Q thought temporary cooperation made sense given his limited individual capabilities. He could always withdraw later if issues arose.
He continued: "I haven't properly introduced myself. Just call me Xiao Q. I'm a college student majoring in criminal investigation."
Ke Bei: "No need for my introduction - you know my name and purpose. Oh, one thing I forgot - my occupation: unemployed. Used to be a private detective like my father, but quit after he disappeared."
Ke Bei added: "As partners, to show good faith, we should exchange information."
Unzipping his jacket, Ke Bei retrieved something from an inner pocket - a palm-sized leather notebook.
He led Xiao Q to a roadside bench where they sat down.
Handing the notebook to Xiao Q: "My father's journal - years of diaries. Flip to the last pages - that's where he wrote about Alice."
Xiao Q was surprised this new acquaintance would share something so important, despite their verbal agreement to cooperate.
He asked: "You trust me so quickly? Sharing critical information? What if I'm dangerous?"
Ke Bei: "Impossible. Though we've just met, I've observed you for a while. You're trustworthy. Otherwise I wouldn't have proposed cooperation."
Xiao Q chuckled and opened the notebook while Ke Bei smoked nearby, offering one to Xiao Q who declined.
The first page shocked Xiao Q.
Most people's handwriting deteriorates after school, sometimes becoming illegible even to themselves.
But Ke Bei's father's diary entries were exceptionally neat, without any sloppiness - like model student work.
After skimming early pages of routine detective notes (daily activities, clients etc.), Xiao Q went straight to the end for the Alice entries.
The diary began:
March 8th, Weather: Sunny
At 8am today, a young man came to my office.
He asked me to investigate his sister's disappearance.
Honestly, I usually avoid missing persons cases - too time-consuming.
But the payment was irresistible.
I took the case. Fortunately, this search wasn't worldwide.
The location was fixed - the young man said his sister disappeared at Alice Apartment.
April 9th, Weather: Sunny
Alice Apartment is bizarre. Surface-level normalcy, but I sense major secrets inside.
May 10th, Weather: Cloudy
Alice Apartment is undoubtedly the most mysterious case I've ever encountered!
Now even without the client, I want to uncover its secrets!
June 9th, Weather: Partly Cloudy
Days ago, a middle-aged man approached me and signed a contract - ¥10,000 per day to live inside.
Surface investigation yielded nothing. This is the only way - live there to discover the truth.
Hope everything goes smoothly!
The diary ended here... with the last entry dated years ago.
"This has some value, but not much."
"At least it confirms the apartment is definitely problematic, with numerous disappearances."
"And your father was in our exact situation - entered after signing the contract."
"Nothing else useful though."
Xiao Q concluded.

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Welcome Party
chapters.content:
"Yes, there really isn't much value to it. We can only say this apartment has problems, but what exactly those problems are requires us to investigate ourselves," Ke Bei said.
Xiao Q responded, "Since you shared your information, I'll share mine too!" He then proceeded to recount everything he had experienced in Alice Apartment to Ke Bei.
After listening, Ke Bei fell into a long silence. Then his eyes suddenly lit up as he leaned close to Xiao Q's ear and whispered something.
...
Time passed minute by minute. Soon it was 7:30 PM - time for the welcome party.
Just like last time, Jiang Ran arrived early at the first-floor activity room. Before long, almost everyone had gathered.
As in Jiang Ran's previous experience, the welcome party began with Manager Xiao Zhang asking the new residents to introduce themselves.
First to introduce themselves were Zhou Wu and Jiang Ran's ex-girlfriend Shen Xing. Next was Xiao Q. Seeing Xiao Q immediately reminded Jiang Ran of the incident when the young white man had blocked his door with a chainsaw. Had this guy actually moved in too?
The third person to introduce themselves was Ke Bei. Many people's first reaction was to think of the detective Conan. Last to introduce herself was Li Mengmeng, the dance streamer. She had a pretty face and an especially good figure - understandable for a dancer.
After the new residents finished introducing themselves came the cake-eating session. It was the same towering cake mountain as before. While Jiang Ran enjoyed his cake with relish, the long-term residents complained just like last time, grumbling about whether Xiao Zhang could try something different instead of serving cake every time.By around 9 PM, the welcome activities concluded and Alice Apartment's residents began returning to their rooms. As he left the activity room, Jiang Ran greeted Xiao Q, who responded with a bright smile. They'd become friends after their initial conflict.
As for Zhou Wu and his ex-girlfriend Shen Xing, Jiang Ran didn't greet them, mainly because the pair showed no intention of speaking to him either.
"Aren't you two leaving?" Soon the activity room was nearly empty. Manager Xiao Zhang, preparing to leave, noticed Ke Bei and Xiao Q still there.
"We'll leave after finishing this game," they said, raising their phones to show screens displaying Honor of Kings.
"Oh, take your time then. Remember to lock up when you leave."
"Will do."
After waiting five minutes to ensure Xiao Zhang had left, they immediately quit their game, abandoning three lonely teammates to battle alone in the canyon. After locking the door, they stayed in the activity room, speaking in hushed tones.
Ke Bei: "Well?"
Xiao Q: "Just like you said - among the long-term residents, I recognized several people who've appeared in online reports."
After hearing Xiao Q's earlier experiences in Alice Apartment, Ke Bei had focused particularly on the psychopathic criminals. He wondered - where else could you find so many psychopathic criminals gathered together? Prison?Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Assuming this was indeed a prison, might there be other psychopathic criminals here? This welcome party provided the perfect opportunity to observe the other residents. Even without Ke Bei suggesting it, Xiao Q had planned to do this anyway - after all, he'd recognized the kite-making serial killer Wang Nuli without even being suspicious initially.
From this welcome party alone, Xiao Q had immediately identified at least three psychopathic criminals who'd appeared in news reports, plus several others who seemed familiar. Now in the activity room, they began searching online for news reports about the country's psychopathic killers over the years, comparing them to the long-term residents they'd just seen.
Their online search was really just confirmation - they already knew the answer in their hearts. The answer was:
"This apartment probably houses quite a few different psychopathic killers," Xiao Q said while multitasking between searching and talking.
Ke Bei agreed: "Yes, that seems to be the case. Besides these killers, there must be ordinary people living here too - like the new residents this time, that Jiang Ran you knew from last time, and your friend."
"An apartment housing both ordinary people and psychopathic killers... We ordinary people all signed agreements to get in. Did the others sign agreements too? If so, why would the apartment bring us ordinary people in? To live alongside a bunch of psychopathic killers? That's incredibly dangerous! You could lose your life any day."
Suddenly Xiao Q looked up and asked Ke Bei if he'd ever read any horror or mystery novels. Ke Bei said of course he had.
Xiao Q continued: "Doesn't our situation resemble those novels? The apartment putting us ordinary people in here - doesn't it feel like some kind of survival game where we have to outwit opponents? Ordinary people struggling to survive among psychopathic criminals? Maybe that's why we get paid 10,000 per day - because it's worth that much?"
In the live stream room at that moment:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Damn, these two have figured out about 80% of it. Impressive.]
Domineering Female CEO: [Impressive indeed. I wonder what they'll do after discovering the truth - leave the apartment or stay?]
Back in the activity room, Ke Bei and Xiao Q both got goosebumps. Their own hypothesis had frightened them. Though just speculation, they felt this might very well be the truth.
"If this is how things are, then my friend Xiao Peng's girlfriend Xiao Nuo disappearing from the apartment probably means she's already dead? Killed by one of the apartment's psychopathic criminals? And your father might already be dead too."
Ke Bei fell silent. He wanted to argue that his father might still be alive, but if he were, why had there been no contact for years as if he'd vanished from the world?
Finally Ke Bei said: "This might be the apartment's truth, Xiao Q. What will you do next? Leave?"
Xiao Q shook his head: "I'd like to, but the agreement states we must stay seven full days before leaving. Breaking it would require paying massive penalties that would bankrupt my family."
Ke Bei: "In that case, just focus on surviving the seven days safely. By the way, are you still going to look for that missing female student?"
Xiao Q: "No, I only knew her for a few days through my friend. Why would I look for her? Some kind of savior complex?"
Ke Bei: "Alright. But I need to find my father. Even if our speculation suggests he might have died long ago, I still need to discover how he died, who killed him, and get revenge."
Xiao Q: "Don't worry, I'll help you look."
Checking the time, they realized it was already 10 PM - they'd been in the activity room for a full hour.

chapters.title: Chapter 51: The Chainsaw Killer
chapters.content:
Their butts lifted from the chairs.
The two prepared to return to their respective homes for rest.
Ke Bei walked ahead while Xiao Q followed behind. Ke Bei pulled open the door.
A vast shadow entered their vision, causing momentary discomfort.
Looking up, they were shocked to see someone standing at the doorway.
The person appeared about 1.8 meters tall - nothing unusual, except his exceptionally broad frame made him seem enormous.
Then they realized this man stood extremely close, almost pressed against Ke Bei face-to-face.
There was no telling how long he'd been standing there.
"Who are you?"
Ke Bei frowned, only now noticing the man wore a grotesquely ugly mask. Even more bizarre was his butcher-like attire."Dodge!"
Just as Ke Bei prepared to speak again, Xiao Q suddenly yanked him backward.
The man at the door, who had kept both hands behind his back, suddenly swung them upward in a circular motion - a sharp axe came crashing down toward Ke Bei's original position. Had Xiao Q not pulled him away in time, Ke Bei might have died from that single axe blow.
"What the hell? Attacking without warning?"
Ke Bei shouted, his heart still pounding.
Before he finished speaking, the distinct roar of a chainsaw filled the air.
The masked man now wielded a massive chainsaw that had somehow appeared in his hands.
The chainsaw roared to life, its terrifying buzz sending chills down their spines.
"Fuck! Texas Chainsaw Massacre?!"
Xiao Q cursed loudly.
The man's outfit perfectly matched the killer from Texas Chainsaw Massacre.
Of course, this couldn't actually be him!
The Texas Chainsaw Massacre was just a film series - fictional characters, not real!
Yet this imposter seemed more terrifying than the real thing.
Xiao Q couldn't help recalling that night of chainsaw-induced terror.
"Run!"
He shouted desperately, searching for an escape route.
