The activity room was spacious with both front and rear exits. Now the front was blocked, leaving only the back door.
But when Xiao Q reached it, he found it wouldn't budge - as if chained shut from outside.
"Here!"
Ke Bei yelled.
Fortunately they were on the first floor - the windows offered escape.
Had this been the second or third floor, jumping would have meant serious injury if not death.
Ke Bei escaped through the window first.
Xiao Q followed just in time - as he leaped out, the chainsaw's roar reached the window behind them, shattering the glass explosively.
Neither were ordinary civilians - one a former private investigator, the other a criminology student who'd survived a chainsaw manhunt before.
After running a safe distance, they turned to see if their pursuer followed.
The result surprised them.
They expected the man to chase through the window, but when they looked back - nothing.
Gone.
Completely vanished!!!
"Maybe he's coming around through the door?"
Not taking chances, they circled cautiously to the apartment entrance but saw no sign of the chainsaw killer.
"Why isn't he chasing?"
Ke Bei frowned.
As they puzzled over this, a male voice suddenly spoke behind them, startling them into whirling around.
A powerfully built security guard in his thirties stood there in uniform.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"Is everything alright, gentlemen?" the guard asked curiously.
"There's a chainsaw killer in your apartment chasing us!" Xiao Q panted.
The guard blinked, then chuckled. "Don't joke like that. I remember you - you're one of those chased by those foreign tenants before. But that's over now - one dead, one arrested. Where would another chainsaw killer come from? Making a movie?"
"Come see for yourself if you don't believe us," Ke Bei said.
After consideration, the guard nodded, retrieved nunchucks from his booth, and followed them to the first-floor activity room.
Now only the lights remained on - the room stood empty.
"Don't see any chainsaw killer here," the guard smiled.
"He's gone now, but check the window - you'll see where his chainsaw struck."
The guard examined the escape window and paled at the damage - shattered wood frame and glass everywhere.
"Well?" Ke Bei approached.
"Window's definitely damaged," the guard admitted. "But we should check surveillance footage to confirm."
"Perfect - we want to see where that chainsaw man came from and went."
The three headed to security, only to find the monitoring room locked - the key with manager Xiao Zhang.
They tracked down Xiao Zhang, fortunately still awake gaming.
Hearing their story, he remained skeptical.
Two chainsaw maniacs recently dealt with, and now another?
The four reviewed security footage together - and collectively gasped.
The footage showed the hulking chainsaw killer emerging from a blind spot.
He first chained the activity room's back door shut, then pressed himself against the front door.
He maintained this position for a full twenty minutes.
Then came the door opening, the interior footage.
Ke Bei and Xiao Q's window escape.
The killer stood at the window, staring intently before finally leaving... and vanishing again into another blind spot.
Manager Xiao Zhang and the guard exchanged wide-eyed glances.
"Xiao Gao, what do you think?" Xiao Zhang asked the guard.
Security captain Xiao Gao - the same guard Jiang Ran first met upon arriving - answered decisively:
"Call the police! Let them handle this!"
"Agreed!" Xiao Zhang nodded, then addressed Ke Bei and Xiao Q: "Deeply sorry about this incident. We'll resolve it quickly! You gentlemen should return home for now - we'll notify you of any developments."
After exchanging glances, Ke Bei and Xiao Q agreed and left.
"Why didn't he chase us?" Ke Bei wondered in the elevator.
"Not sure," Xiao Q replied. "Maybe he knew he couldn't catch us outside."
"Regardless," Ke Bei said grimly, "this place is more dangerous than we thought. Stay sharp - let's not die here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Li Mengmeng and the Middle-aged Man
chapters.content:
Xiao Q lived in Room 904.
Ke Bei lived in Room 601, and next door in Room 602 lived Li Mengmeng, the dance streamer.
As Ke Bei unlocked his door with his key, faint sounds of intimate activity between a man and woman could be heard from next door.
Ke Bei wasn't surprised by this - after all, these streamers all had their sugar daddies or wealthy female sponsors.
It would be strange if they didn't.
He pushed open the door and entered his apartment.
Next door in Room 602.
A man and woman lay resting in bed after their intimate activities.
"Honey, you're getting better and better..."
The woman was dance streamer Li Mengmeng. Though already thirty years old, her face looked like that of a girl barely twenty, arousing strong desires in others.She was now coquettishly sweet-talking the middle-aged man beside her - a potbellied man in his forties or fifties who could easily be old enough to be her father.
The middle-aged man was thoroughly enjoying Li Mengmeng's flirtations and happily pulled her delicate body closer: "Baby, the night is still young! I'll show you something even more impressive!"
Li Mengmeng's eyes sparkled: "Really?"
As the man was about to respond, his phone on the nightstand suddenly rang.
He picked it up and immediately frowned deeply.
"Who is it?" Li Mengmeng pouted.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Tch, just my nagging wife!" the man said impatiently.
"Oh, her? Why's she calling so late?"
"No idea. I'm hanging up."
After rejecting several calls from his wife, she finally stopped calling and sent a text instead:
"If you don't come home and answer my calls tonight, I'll burn the house down."
Reading this, the man froze momentarily before hurriedly putting on his clothes.
"What's wrong? Going back to your wife?" Li Mengmeng said unhappily.
After kissing Li Mengmeng's snow-white cheek, the man said: "I have to go back. That crazy woman really would burn the house down. After twenty years of marriage, I know she means what she says. We live in a residential complex - if she actually does it, I'll be ruined for life."
"Fine, go back then. As long as your heart stays with me."
"Of course, baby."
Soon the middle-aged man left her apartment.
Once alone, Li Mengmeng stretched her curvaceous body on the bed, her previously seductive expression turning ice cold.
"Disgusting middle-aged creep. Can't even last two minutes without pills. If it wasn't for the money, I'd never sleep with someone like that."
She stretched luxuriously on the bed.
Then staring at the white ceiling, she murmured: "Do I really get 10,000 yuan per day for living here?"
Li Mengmeng was a small-time streamer whose income relied entirely on online gifts and sugar daddies like the man who just left - a factory owner.
Did she have any feelings for him?
Absolutely none. To her he was just an ATM, a business transaction, and she was certain he felt the same.
This lifestyle had been quite enjoyable.
But then, to show off in front of her girlfriends, she'd overspent during an overseas trip, maxing out her credit cards.
Otherwise she never would have signed that agreement to live here.
As for why they were paying 10,000 yuan per day to live here...
Whether there was something fishy or dangerous about it...
She didn't care. She just wanted the money.
"Ugh, so tired. Time to sleep."
Though the middle-aged man wasn't very capable due to his age, after taking pills he could still perform vigorously.
Which was why she now felt exhausted and sleepy.
...
"I'm coming home right now, don't burn the house down! If you do, even selling myself as a gigolo couldn't cover the losses!"
Having just reached the first floor by elevator,
the middle-aged man immediately texted his wife, who quickly replied giving him one hour to return.
If he wasn't back by then, she'd burn the house down and ruin them both.
"What kind of shrew did I marry? If only I could divorce her."
Cursing, he put away his phone, only to take it out again because the first floor was inexplicably pitch black with no lights at all.
He stomped several times, but the motion-activated lights didn't turn on.
"And this is supposed to be a luxury apartment? 50,000 yuan per square meter? I don't get why people are moving in. A normal complex would be better."
Using his phone's flashlight, he complained while making his way forward.
Finally, the sound of his leather shoes tapping the floor...
brought him close to the glass automatic doors.
Suddenly, his phone light illuminated something -
a figure standing motionless in front of the doors.
"Hey, move aside."
The man said, but the figure didn't budge.
Growing impatient, the man rudely shone his phone light directly at the figure's face.
What he saw nearly scared the soul out of his body.
The figure - apparently male - wore a hideous, terrifying mask
straight out of a horror movie.
"Fucking hell! What kind of psycho stands around scaring people in the dark like this?!"
The man considered himself lucky not to have heart problems, otherwise this shock might have killed him or at least sent him to the hospital.
Though relieved he hadn't been scared to death, he was still furious -
this could have given someone a heart attack!
"Shitty apartment! Not only are the motion lights broken, but there's some asshole deliberately scaring people!"
After cursing, he moved to go around the figure through the automatic doors.
Just then...
he heard a whooshing sound.
Shining his phone toward the noise, he saw a sharp axe swinging down from above.
...
"What the hell? Who calls people in the middle of the night? So annoying!"
A sleeping Li Mengmeng was awakened by her ringing phone.
Bleary-eyed, she reluctantly grabbed her charging phone from the nightstand.
Without even looking at the caller ID, she answered to hear a woman's abusive voice:
"You homewrecker, where's my husband?"
Being called in the middle of the night and immediately insulted
woke Li Mengmeng up instantly.
"Who is this?" she demanded.
The voice replied: "Don't recognize my voice? My damn husband just slept with you."
Li Mengmeng realized it was the middle-aged man's wife.
She said: "Why are you calling me?"
"Hmph, put that bastard on the phone."
"Put him on? He left long ago after your text about burning the house down."
"Hmph, I know he's there with you! He never came home! Stop lying!"
"What? He didn't go back? Are you joking? He left ages ago - he's not here!"
"I don't believe you! He must be there! Fine, so he's really rebelling now, daring to lie to me? Looks like he really wants his house burned down!"

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Xiao Q and Xiao Peng Meet Again
chapters.content:
The two of them bickered for quite a while.
Li Mengmeng said he had left, while the other party insisted he hadn't. Eventually, Li Mengmeng couldn't take it anymore and muted her phone.
She buried herself under the covers and slept.
Completely exhausted.
She slept until around 10 AM the next morning. When she finally checked her phone again,
there were dozens of messages, all from the middle-aged man's wife.
Li Mengmeng was utterly speechless.
The man had gone back yesterday - he wasn't even at her place.
"Maybe he has another new lover. After leaving me, he went to her place."
Li Mengmeng thought to herself, ignoring all the messages as she prepared to go back to sleep.But less than thirty minutes later,
there was knocking at her door.
"Open up! This is the police!"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The voice from outside startled Li Mengmeng.
"The police?"
She couldn't believe her ears. Why would the police come to her place?
Flustered, she threw on her pajamas and went to open the door.
There stood five people.
Two police officers led the group, followed by
a young couple and a middle-aged woman.
Li Mengmeng recognized the middle-aged woman - she was the wife from last night.
As for the young couple...
"Huh? Aren't you the new residents from last night's welcome party?"
Li Mengmeng remembered this pair - the man was Zhou Wu, the woman Shen Xing.
"They're my son and daughter-in-law."
The middle-aged woman spoke up.
Li Mengmeng was stunned. What a coincidence!
She was living in the same apartment building as the middle-aged man's son and daughter-in-law?
No wonder she'd heard him mutter yesterday: "What's so great about this apartment? Why does everyone want to live here?"
So his son and daughter-in-law lived here too...
"Then why did you bring the police to my home? Surely having an affair with your husband isn't illegal?"
At worst, extramarital affairs were a moral issue, not a legal one.
The middle-aged woman snapped: "I don't care about your affair! I just want to know if my husband is still here!!!"
Li Mengmeng frowned: "Lady, I already told you on the phone - your husband left long ago. He's not here. Why won't you believe me?"
Middle-aged woman: "You say he's not here, but he never came home last night."
Li Mengmeng: "Maybe he's with another lover. Your husband's rich - nothing stops him from finding young pretty girls."
Middle-aged woman: "Enough talk. Let us search your place to see if he's really not here."
Li Mengmeng stepped aside: "Go ahead. I've got nothing to hide - I'm not lying."
The group searched the apartment.
It wasn't big, so they finished quickly.
Indeed, there was no sign of the middle-aged woman's husband.
"That bastard! Where did he go? He's not answering calls or messages!"
The middle-aged woman stomped her foot in frustration.
Li Mengmeng said: "Now that you've confirmed he's not here, can you leave?"
The woman glared hatefully at Li Mengmeng: "You've been with him so long, and now he's disappeared all night - aren't you worried at all?"
Li Mengmeng shrugged: "Why worry? He's a grown man."
The woman muttered: "Damn it... look at the kind of vixen you chose. Now you've suddenly disappeared and she doesn't even care. Your taste is terrible - you might as well die!"
Little did the middle-aged woman know her angry words would prove prophetic.
After seeing off the police, Zhou Wu and Shen Xing drove the middle-aged woman (Zhou Wu's mother) home.
During the ride, she kept cursing - that bastard husband of hers must be off with some other vixen.
Despite her anger, she was genuinely worried about her philandering husband.
This had never happened before -
being unable to contact him for so long.
Unlike his concerned mother,
Zhou Wu wasn't worried about his father at all.
In fact, even if something happened to his old man, he wouldn't care.
On the contrary - he'd be happy!
Why?
Because if something really did happen to his father,
he could directly inherit the family textile factory and become the boss.
He'd control everything.
Zhou Wu actually resented his father - in recent years, the old man had spent way too much money on women.
An obscene amount.
Why did it bother him?
Because he considered his father's money as his own future inheritance. So every penny his father spent now was essentially his money being wasted.
Though he wished misfortune upon his father, he knew it was unlikely.
The police had already checked the apartment's surveillance -
it showed his father driving away from the complex. Where he went afterward was unclear since the street cameras happened to be broken.
As for searching that vixen's home? That was just his mother picking a fight.
After all, the man had driven away - why would he still be there?
...
Alice Apartment 904.
Cycle 26, Day 2. Sunday.
When Xiao Q woke up that morning, he saw a bank notification on his phone - 10,000 yuan had been deposited.
This gave him pause; it took him a while to process.
Though he'd been mentally prepared, actually receiving the money felt surreal for a kid from an ordinary family.
But remembering how he and Ke Bei had nearly been killed by that chainsaw-wielding man last night sent chills down his spine.
"This money literally comes with blood on it."
He sighed.
Just then, the phone clenched in his right hand suddenly rang.
Looking at the screen - it was Xiao Peng calling.
He answered immediately.
"Xiao Peng, what's up? Just to be clear - I'm not hanging out with your friends."
"Not about hanging out. I just... Xiao Q, I need to talk face-to-face. Vent a bit. Too much has happened recently."
"Sure. Come to Alice Apartment 904 then! I'm here."
"Alice... 904? You joking?"
"No joke. You'll understand when you get here. I don't kid about stuff like this."
A long silence followed before one word came through: "Fine."
The call ended.
Half an hour later,
when Xiao Peng stepped back into the familiar Alice Apartment 904,
he found everything unchanged.
There stood Xiao Q on the balcony, surveying the view below.
Xiao Peng strode over and demanded:
"What's going on? Why are you here?"
Xiao Q flashed a mysterious smile:
"Let's not start with that."
"Xiao Peng, I've discovered an earth-shattering secret about Xiao Nuo. Want to hear it? Though... it's dangerous. You might regret knowing."
The moment Xiao Nuo was mentioned, Xiao Peng forgot all about questioning Xiao Q's presence.
"About Xiao Nuo? Tell me! Do you know where she is?"

chapters.title: Chapter 54: The Unexpected Xiao Peng
chapters.content:
Although Xiao Peng was handsome and popular with women, having had many girlfriends throughout his life, he was different from other men. He made sure never to owe anything in any relationship. That's why Xiao Nuo's disappearance weighed heavily on him—he genuinely wanted to find her. Alive or dead, he needed closure.
After all, Xiao Nuo had been exceptionally good to him, buying him iPhones and gaming skins, spending lavishly on him. Even after discovering she wasn't actually from a wealthy family—that her parents were just ordinary people, not business tycoons—the fact remained: Xiao Nuo had treated him extraordinarily well.
"Oh, by the way, are Xiao Nuo's parents still in Nancheng City?" Xiao Q suddenly changed the subject.
Xiao Peng shook his head. "They left yesterday. I saw them off at the high-speed rail station."
Xiao Q asked, "Really? So what did her parents decide to do about Xiao Nuo's situation?"
With a bitter smile, Xiao Peng replied, "Her family always favored sons over daughters. With all the online loans Xiao Nuo took out, her parents never wanted anything to do with her. Now that she's missing, they just came to go through the motions before leaving. It's like they never had a daughter named Xiao Nuo."
"How tragic," Xiao Peng sighed. "At this point, I might be the only person in the world who still cares about what happened to her."
Xiao Q nodded. "It is tragic. Now, what I'm about to tell you about Xiao Nuo must stay between us—you can't share this with anyone else."
Xiao Peng agreed, "You have my word. Go ahead."
Xiao Q lowered his voice dramatically, as if they were being monitored despite being alone in the room. "Xiao Peng, haven't you ever wondered why Xiao Nuo would rent such an expensive place like Alice Apartment?"Xiao Peng reasoned, "She was vain, wanted to show off to our group, right? That's why she rented such a pricey place and claimed her parents bought it—to convince us she was a rich heiress."
Xiao Q challenged, "Are you sure about that? If she had a few thousand to spend, wouldn't she get more mileage pretending to be rich by spending it elsewhere? Why waste it all on rent?"
"Uh..." Xiao Peng stroked his chin thoughtfully. "You're right. Although she always made excuses when someone suggested visiting her place, she was otherwise extremely generous—dining at fancy places, wearing designer clothes. Everyone except Xiao Hua believed she was wealthy. She didn't need an expensive apartment to prove that."
Xiao Q confirmed, "Exactly. Now let me tell you why she really lived here—and why I'm here too. Both Xiao Nuo and I signed a special agreement." He then explained the details of the contract to Xiao Peng.
After hearing about the agreement, Xiao Peng sat frozen like a statue. Getting paid 10,000 yuan daily just for living there? What kind of unbelievable deal was this? Suddenly everything made sense—Xiao Nuo didn't pay rent here at all; she was actually getting paid!
"So this is the secret about Xiao Nuo? And... is this for real? 10,000 a day?"
"It's real." Xiao Q showed Xiao Peng his bank transaction alerts as proof.
Xiao Peng's eyes nearly bulged out. "Damn! This kind of luck actually exists?"
Xiao Q burst out laughing. "Xiao Peng, think carefully—does this kind of luck really exist?"
The contract revelation had scrambled Xiao Peng's thoughts. Only after Xiao Q gave him time to process did he realize: there's no such thing as a free lunch. Even if fortune smiled on someone, it wouldn't be him. There had to be a catch—but what?
Xiao Q knew his friend was reasonably intelligent, but it might take forever for him to deduce the truth behind the agreement. So he laid it all out—how he and Ke Bei had concluded that Alice Apartment housed numerous dangerous criminals among its residents.
Xiao Peng listened in stunned silence, as if his soul had left his body. After a long pause, he suddenly grabbed his phone.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on
When Xiao Q asked what he was doing, Xiao Peng said he was calling the police.
Xiao Q smiled wryly and pointed at him. "See? Always rushing. Remember when you wanted to report Wang Nuli, the human skin kite maker? I stopped you then. Should I stop you again now?"
Xiao Peng realized the truth—if he couldn't handle one Wang Nuli, how could he take on an entire apartment complex backed by some mysterious organization? Whoever orchestrated this operation wouldn't be stopped by a simple police report. More likely, he'd disappear before anything happened to the apartment.
Pacing anxiously around Room 904's living room, sweat beading on his forehead, Xiao Peng processed aloud: "So based on your discussions with this Ke Bei guy, this place is full of psychopathic criminals mixed with ordinary people like you. The 10,000 yuan daily payment is like those web novel rewards—compensation for surviving each day."
"Which means Xiao Nuo's disappearance wasn't ordinary. During that chaos, she might have been..." Xiao Peng couldn't bring himself to finish the thought.
Under normal circumstances, he'd never believe such a story about secret agreements and apartments full of criminals. He'd dismiss it as fiction. But this was Xiao Q telling him—his closest friend.
"Xiao Peng," Xiao Q said earnestly, "I told you all this so you can have closure about Xiao Nuo's disappearance. It's time to move on and live your life." That was his real purpose.
Their friendship ran deep—Xiao Q understood how Xiao Peng would obsess over unresolved matters. He needed to provide answers.
Xiao Peng's eyes reddened. "Thank you, Xiao Q, for telling me everything. But I have to find out who killed Xiao Nuo."
The first part of his statement warmed Xiao Q's heart, but the second part struck like lightning.
Wait—what exactly are you planning? "You're determined to find Xiao Nuo's killer?" Xiao Q asked gravely.
Xiao Peng nodded. "It's the least I can do for her."
Xiao Q suddenly realized he might not know his best friend as well as he thought. "But what about Xiao Hua? You broke up with her for Xiao Nuo—don't you owe her anything?"
Xiao Peng looked genuinely surprised. "Why would I owe Xiao Hua anything? We spent money on each other equally. And as for sex—it's not like only the guy enjoys it, right? So no, I don't feel I owe Xiao Hua anything."
"But Xiao Nuo was different—she spent so much on me. I never spent a single cent on her..."
Xiao Q was speechless. "Finding Xiao Nuo's body and killer won't be easy—it's dangerous, potentially deadly. Remember when those foreign guys chased us that night? Are you really prepared for that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 55: The Dog Man
chapters.content:
Seeing Xiao Peng's absolutely certain gaze, Xiao Q thought it would be better if he remained a handsome playboy.
"Will you help me?" Xiao Peng asked.
Xiao Q helplessly spread his hands. "I'll help. Consider it risking my life to accompany a gentleman."
Xiao Peng smiled slightly at this moment. "You're so good. If you were a girl, I'd definitely marry you."
Xiao Q turned around and stuck out his butt at Xiao Peng. "That's still an option now."
Xiao Peng's face darkened.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: [It's worth skipping work to watch this live stream. The 26th round is too exciting! Xiao Q brings his own entertainment value by actively investigating and even bringing along Xiao Nuo's ex-boyfriend. But what really surprises me is how conscientious this young man Xiao Peng turns out to be.]
Domineering Female CEO: [This world is quite strange. You really can't judge a book by its cover when finding a partner. Handsome guys aren't necessarily players—they might be loyal. And seemingly honest people aren't necessarily faithful—they might be the biggest players.]
Little Aunt: [Middle-aged Uncle and Domineering Female CEO sister, I have a question. That Ke Bei—I remember him discussing with Xiao Q that night about finding out who killed his father. Was his father also a resident of the apartment?]Domineering Female CEO: [I forgot. With five lab rats every round, who can remember everyone?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [His father should have been an apartment resident long ago. I don't recall anyone with the surname Ke. After all, I didn't start watching this game from the first round. Ask someone else!]
Back at Alice Apartment, Xiao Q and Xiao Peng went to the first floor to find the apartment manager, Xiao Zhang, to inquire about a resident.
"Oh, that person you're asking about? His name is Bai Ze. He lives in Room 201."
Bai Ze was the pale young man who had previously told Xiao Peng and the others which room Wang Ju had been taken to by Lin Shengli. He was also the same person Jiang Ran had encountered when he first came to Alice Apartment.
The reason they were looking for Bai Ze was simple—when Xiao Peng and the others were struggling to find Wang Ju, it was Bai Ze who gave them hope by providing information. Therefore, they felt this person must know something and decided to start with him.
"By the way, Xiao Zhang, was that chainsaw man found that night?" Xiao Q asked before getting on the elevator.
Manager Xiao Zhang spread his hands. "We called the police, but they couldn't find him."
Xiao Q said, "Alright then," and entered the elevator with Xiao Peng.
Inside the elevator, Xiao Peng curiously asked about the chainsaw man. Could it be those two damned foreigners?
Xiao Q explained in detail about that night when he and Ke Bei encountered the chainsaw man—the chainsaw murderer.
Xiao Peng shuddered all over. "Damn, this haunted place really has all sorts of monsters and demons!"
Xiao Q said, "So it's not too late to back out now."
Xiao Peng turned his head away. "Let's talk after we find Xiao Nuo, whether she's dead or alive."
Instead of going straight to Room 201 to find Bai Ze, the two first went to Room 601 to find Ke Bei. After finding Ke Bei, they introduced Xiao Peng to him.
Ke Bei was quite happy to have a newcomer join them—after all, many hands make light work. Upon hearing they planned to find that Bai Ze, he decided to go with them.
The three soon arrived outside Room 201. This time, instead of knocking, they rang the doorbell. But after many rings, no one came to answer.
"Not home?" Xiao Q muttered to himself.
Just then, the door of nearby Room 202 opened. Hearing the sound, Xiao Peng turned to see a rather beautiful young woman, about thirty years old.
"Three handsome young men? Who are you looking for?" The young woman swayed her slender waist as she walked over after opening the door.
Xiao Peng spoke first. "We're looking for Bai Ze in 201."
"Oh, that fair-skinned handsome guy? He went out this morning. He's not home."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"Not home?" Xiao Q and Ke Bei also turned to look at the young woman.
Just as Xiao Q looked at her, his pupils suddenly contracted sharply. He pointed into the distance ahead and shouted, "What the hell is that?!"
Then they saw Xiao Q quickly run in that direction. Xiao Peng and Ke Bei had no idea what Xiao Q had seen but could only follow. When they reached the second-floor stairwell, Xiao Q looked around with an extremely confused expression.
"What did you see just now?" Ke Bei also looked around curiously, trying to spot something.
Xiao Q frowned. "I saw a human face peeking out from here, secretly watching us the whole time."
Ke Bei: "Someone was spying on us?"
Xiao Q said, "It was too far away to be sure, but the face that peeked out looked really strange."
Listening to their conversation, Xiao Peng felt like he was in a horror movie.
Since Bai Ze wasn't home and they'd just seen someone with a strange appearance watching them, the three went back to the first floor to find Manager Xiao Zhang to check the surveillance footage.
If this were an ordinary residential complex, residents couldn't just casually request to check surveillance—the staff wouldn't allow it. But Alice Apartment was different. Being a high-end apartment, Manager Xiao Zhang simply let them check the footage themselves.
They quickly found the second-floor surveillance footage from that time. They saw their three figures appear outside Room 201. Then Xiao Q, controlling the mouse, opened the footage from the second-floor stairwell.
What they saw next sent chills of terror through all three of them.
From the third-floor stairs, a human-like creature crawled down on all fours. Its body was covered in what looked like a smooth, tan dog-skin bodysuit. Additionally, its face appeared to be wearing a cheap-looking human mask bought online.
This figure reached the second floor, then peeked its head out to spy on the three of them. When Xiao Q noticed it and shouted while giving chase, the figure hurriedly scrambled up the stairs on all fours like a dog.
Xiao Q continued checking the footage, following this figure. They watched as it quickly climbed to the ninth floor on all fours. Upon reaching the ninth floor, it paused outside Room 904 as if leaving something behind before continuing to crawl away. This time, the surveillance lost sight of it.
The three exchanged glances, then rushed out of the surveillance room and returned to Room 904. There, they found that the figure had left behind a disc—a disc wrapped in a clear plastic case.
"I don't have anything to play this at my place," Xiao Q said as he picked up the disc from the floor. "I haven't used one of these in years."
Ke Bei suggested going to his place, as he still had an old disc player. The three went to Ke Bei's home. Ke Bei took out an old disc player, connected it to the wall-mounted TV in the living room, and after some adjustments, inserted the disc.
Even though it was daytime, the three breathed heavily in the complete silence. The buzzing sound of the disc player was piercing, as if slowly opening the gates of hell...

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Xiao Nuo's Cause of Death Revealed
chapters.content:
The video began.
The initial footage was shaky and unstable, likely because the cameraman was holding the camera by hand.
Soon after, the camera must have been placed somewhere, as the image stabilized.
At this point, the frame showed a long-haired girl lying on a bed.
Her clothes were intact.
After maintaining this shot for over ten seconds, barking sounds emerged from the video.
Then, a figure crawling on all fours, wearing a yellow dog-skin suit with a crude human-face mask, appeared in the frame.
It was exactly the same eerie creature Xiao Q and the others had seen in the surveillance footage earlier today.
The figure crawled around on the floor before eventually climbing onto the bed.
Mimicking a dog's behavior, it sniffed all over the girl's body—starting from her feet, slowly moving up her calves, thighs, stomach, and finally reaching her face concealed by long hair.Then, it used its face to push aside all the hair covering the girl's face.
The girl's face was revealed.
At this exact moment, Xiao Peng abruptly stood up.
He strode right up to the TV, getting so close his eyeballs almost bulged out of their sockets.
He stared fixedly at the girl's face in the video.
"Xiao Nuo!"
"It's Xiao Nuo!"
Xiao Peng gritted his teeth.
Xiao Q, sitting on the sofa, also realized the girl in the video was Xiao Nuo, though he didn't react as intensely as Xiao Peng—after all, she wasn't his girlfriend.
Beside him, Ke Bei had his right hand against his face, leaning forward intently.
He seemed to be carefully memorizing the girl's features.
The video continued.
The human-face mask—who knows where it was bought—was not only shoddy but also ugly in a repulsive way.
The mask had holes for eyes and nostrils.
An especially large opening was made for the mouth.
Through this mouth hole, the dog impersonator stuck out a red tongue and proceeded to lick Xiao Nuo's relatively pale face like a dog.
Left cheek, right cheek, lips, nose, eyes, forehead...
Soon, Xiao Nuo's entire face was covered in his saliva.
Xiao Peng was seething with rage.
He completely overlooked something strange.
The dog impersonator's tongue was unusually long—not the slender, forked kind like a snake's, but thick and lengthy.
After about ten minutes of licking, the dog impersonator finally took the next step!
He suddenly stood up on all fours on the bed.
Facing the sky outside the balcony, he let out loud barks: "Woof! Woof! Woof!"
Then, imitating certain dogs' howling behavior, he threw his head back and let out a deep, prolonged howl.
Immediately after, he abruptly pounced on Xiao Nuo's neck, biting down hard with his wide-open mouth.
Instantly, the blood vessels in Xiao Nuo's neck burst like ruptured pipes.
Blood splattered everywhere.
Xiao Nuo didn't scream in pain—she merely twisted and convulsed slightly.
This lasted for three minutes.
After three minutes, the dog impersonator—now covered in blood on his face and body—turned to face the camera.
He emitted a sinister "Heh heh heh" laugh.
The laughter was eerie, cold, and carried a hint of triumph.
It was the kind of laugh that, once heard, would be hard to forget—as if branded into one's memory.
The video ended here.
The end of the video also marked the end of Xiao Nuo's life.
Even without medical expertise, anyone could tell from the neck wound in the video and the endless gush of blood staining the bed and floor that Xiao Nuo was beyond saving.
"Damn it!"
Xiao Peng angrily stomped the ground with his right foot.
Then, clenching both fists, his entire body tensed up. His teeth ground against each other with such force that they produced a grating "zizi" sound.
One could easily imagine that if the dog impersonator appeared before Xiao Peng now, Xiao Peng would hack him to death just like how the tall male student had killed Lin Shengli.
Meanwhile, Xiao Q and Ke Bei on the sofa remained silent for a long time after watching the video.
Finally, Ke Bei spoke:
"This video tells us at least four things."
"First: Xiao Nuo is dead, and the murderer is this dog impersonator—let's call him the Dog Man."
"Second: During the attack, even when her neck was bitten through like that, Xiao Nuo showed little reaction. The Dog Man must have heavily sedated her."
"Third: This Dog Man is undoubtedly a psychopath who enjoys filming his crimes and sending the videos to people connected to the victims."
"Fourth: The Dog Man has definitely been observing you all for a long time and is familiar with your interpersonal relationships."
Ke Bei listed these four points.
Xiao Peng turned around, his eyes bloodshot: "Is this a provocation? Damn it, I'm calling the police right now! Unless he's left this apartment, I'll chop him into pieces!!!"
Xiao Q stopped him again: "Xiao Peng, look—you're getting worked up again."
Xiao Peng roared: "How is this getting worked up?! We have the damn crime footage right here! This is undeniable evidence!!! Why not call the police?! Let them search this place—I refuse to believe they won't find him!!!"
Xiao Q shook his head helplessly: "Xiao Peng, calm down. The reason I'm stopping you from calling the police is the same as the previous two times."
"This apartment situation isn't something the police can handle."
"If they could, why would we be investigating on our own?"
"We can only rely on ourselves."
"The forces behind this are too powerful."
"I feel like this is just the apartment's backers' sick entertainment—watching ordinary people like us fight against these psychotic criminals."
Xiao Peng was on the verge of breaking down. Just an ordinary college student, he now found himself trapped in this bizarre vortex.
Though he had entered it willingly.
He said: "Rely on ourselves? Catch the Dog Man first, then call the police? Like with Lin Shengli? How's that different from calling the police first?"
At this moment, Xiao Q's eyes suddenly turned icy cold, as if he'd become a different person.
It sent chills down Xiao Peng's spine.
Xiao Q said: "No, no, Xiao Peng. Haven't you noticed something?"
Xiao Peng asked: "What?"
Xiao Q: "Do you remember how many times we've called the police?"
Xiao Peng thought for a moment: "Twice. First time was for Lin Shengli who assaulted Wang Ju."
"Second time was when those two foreigners chased us with chainsaws."
Xiao Q: "Didn't you notice anything odd about these two police reports?"Googlᴇ search ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Xiao Peng shook his head: "Stop playing detective games with me. Just tell me directly!"

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Old Man from Room 301's Extreme Fear of Jiang Ran
chapters.content:
Xiao Q smiled and said, "Out of those two police reports, one time it was fake cops."
"Fake cops?!"
Both Xiao Peng and Ke Bei were stunned.
Especially Xiao Peng, since he had personally experienced both incidents, while Ke Bei had only heard about them secondhand!
Xiao Peng thought carefully before saying, "Are you sure about this? You're certain one time was fake police? They both seemed real to me!!!"
Xiao Q replied, "No, one time was definitely fake."
"The first time, during the Wang Ju and Lin Shengli incident, those were real police. Otherwise, your good friend who killed someone wouldn't still be locked up awaiting trial."
"But the second time, with those two foreigners, those were fakes."
Xiao Peng frowned. "You're sure about the second time? The police car, uniforms, and guns looked more real than the real thing!"
Xiao Q explained, "Police cars, uniforms, even guns - these are hard for ordinary people like us to obtain, but for whoever controls this apartment building, it's no trouble at all.""To confirm, I went to see my uncle."
Xiao Peng asked, "You mean your uncle who's a criminal investigator?"
Xiao Q nodded. "I asked him to check the police records for Alice Apartment in Nancheng City."
Xiao Peng said, "Wait, didn't you say before your uncle never helps with personal matters? Not even for family?"
Xiao Q replied, "Exactly. So I had to ask my cousin to beg him. Of course, this wasn't too big a deal, so he agreed."
"Here's what I found out:"
"My uncle could only find records for Alice Apartment's first police call - the Lin Shengli incident - including personnel deployment and results. But the second time? No record at all."
Xiao Peng exclaimed excitedly, "Nothing? Then the second time must have been fake cops! Probably sent by whoever controls the apartment? Wait, if so, why did they kill that Black guy? And where did they take the White guy?"
Xiao Q said, "Those aren't the important questions."
"I told you about the fake cops to bring up another issue."
"If we successfully catch the Dog Man and call the police, how can you be sure whether real or fake cops will come? If they're real, great. But if they're fake..."
Ke Bei seemed to understand Xiao Q's meaning and said in surprise, "Xiao Q, you're not suggesting... if we catch the Dog Man, we should just kill him ourselves? No police, just dispose of the body?"
Xiao Q nodded and snapped his fingers. "Smart. That private detective experience shows."
"But it's just a suggestion. The Dog Man has no grudge against me or you. He killed Xiao Peng's girlfriend, so the decision whether to use this method is Xiao Peng's."
Xiao Peng's jaw dropped in shock, not expecting Xiao Q to propose something so extreme.
Especially since Xiao Q was just making the suggestion - the final decision rested with him.
Xiao Peng began pacing the living room, torn by internal conflict.
The wall-mounted TV was still on, replaying the earlier footage.
The images flashed before Xiao Peng's eyes again.
In his mind, a black figure advocated capturing and killing the Dog Man, while a white one argued for turning him over to the police.
Ultimately, black defeated white.
"Kill him! That monster deserves to die! We'd be doing the world a favor!!!"
"But..."
"Xiao Q, what if we get caught? If we don't call the police, what if other residents do?"
Xiao Peng scratched his head anxiously, his heart pounding so hard he could barely breathe.
Xiao Q scoffed. "Other residents calling police? Don't kid yourself. This isn't a normal apartment. Besides us, who would bother? When those foreigners were chasing us, we had to call the police ourselves."
"Just avoid the ordinary residents. Keep it discreet!"
Though their conspiracy was known only to heaven and earth...
The live stream audience also knew.
Middle-aged Uncle: [This keeps getting better - three people hunting the Dog Man together?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Maybe it's because I'm a woman, but I really hate these perverts who prey on vulnerable women - first Lin Shengli, now this Dog Man.]
Little Aunt: [Has anyone actually seen what this Dog Man looks like? I've seen his crimes - seven or eight girls dead by his hands?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Never seen his face - the bastard never takes off his mask.]
Just then, a new user named Ultimate Rich Kid commented:
[So exciting! This live stream beats those fake documentaries hands down!]
Little Dragon Girl @ Ultimate Rich Kid: [Haven't seen you before - new here?]
I am the Hero @ Little Dragon Girl: [My real-life friend - I recommended the stream.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Hero, you should've told me sooner! This is so fun, I almost want to sign up and move in for the adventure!]
Fairy Sister @ Ultimate Rich Kid: [That's suicidal! Money won't help - you'd be lucky to survive one round!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Hahaha, don't underestimate me. Maybe I'll sign the agreement and play sometime...]
...
Gurgle.
Meanwhile.
Jiang Ran had just finished his morning shift as online store customer service and taken two pills for his dissociative identity disorder.
His stomach growled fiercely with hunger as he prepared to go out for lunch.
As he left home and approached Room 301, the door suddenly opened.
A hunched old man with white bandages covering his face emerged carrying a trash bag.
Jiang Ran immediately recognized the old man from Room 301 and waved enthusiastically: "Uncle, taking out the trash? Need any help? Oh, what happened to your face?"
Hearing Jiang Ran's voice, the old man - who had just stepped out to throw away garbage - quickly looked at the approaching figure.
He saw Jiang Ran's warm, friendly smile.The source of this content ɪs NovᴇlFirenᴇt

His face twisted with rare terror as he immediately pushed open the not-quite-shut door and darted back inside.

What was wrong with the old man?

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Qin Kelian’s Grudge Against the Dog Man
chapters.content:
Since the last time the Old Man in Room 301 fought Jiang Ran's other personality, he was truly scared of Jiang Ran.
So much so that he didn’t even want to seek revenge anymore.
Because he felt that if it happened again, he would really be done for.
If he were still young, not avenging this grudge would be unmanly, but now, forget it... he was really old...
Of course, besides fearing Jiang Ran's martial power, he was even more afraid of Jiang Ran’s unpredictable nature.
The first time they met, Jiang Ran was a kind young man.
The second time, he became an extremely evil young man.
And now, the third time, he had turned back into a kind young man.
Was Jiang Ran toying with him?!
Using an old man like him as practice material for his acting?He absolutely dared not provoke this ancestor anymore!
At this moment, Jiang Ran took the elevator down to the first floor. The elevator stopped briefly on the second floor, where a beautiful young woman entered, emitting a pleasant floral fragrance.
This young woman was around thirty years old, wearing a tight black sexy dress.
Her face was beautiful, and every move she made exuded charm.
If Xiao Q and the others were present, they would definitely recognize her as the woman they saw earlier this morning coming out of Room 202.
After entering, the beautiful woman saw Jiang Ran and her two big eyes, enhanced by red-colored contact lenses, flashed brightly.
Once inside the elevator, she approached Jiang Ran, her fragrant lips exhaling a breath of orchid scent:
“Oh, since when did our apartment get such a handsome guy living here?”
Jiang Ran smiled and replied, “I just moved in two weeks ago, not long.”
He admired the beautiful woman in front of him.
His nose couldn’t help but inhale the fragrance she wore, causing all the pores on his body to open in comfort.
“Really? Handsome guy, what’s your name? Which room do you live in? We’ll be neighbors from now on.”
Jiang Ran said, “I live in 304. My name is Jiang Ran.”
The beautiful woman nodded slightly, her smile radiant: “I’m Su Mi, living in 202. If you have time, come find your sister to hang out!”
“Sis here loves playing with handsome young guys like you the most...”
The elevator door opened.
Su Mi stepped out, her graceful figure walking away, making anyone’s blood boil.
Jiang Ran also stepped out of the elevator.
Honestly, this kind of seductive beautiful woman was definitely tempting to Jiang Ran.
Especially since Su Mi was openly showing favor towards him.
But it was precisely because of this that Jiang Ran was a bit scared.
The reason? Aiya! What’s going on here?!
As Jiang Ran walked out through the apartment’s glass sensor door, he saw a man around forty, skinny like a monkey, wearing a bright smile, rushing past him.
Turning his head, Jiang Ran saw the man had already run to the elevator and was frantically pressing the elevator button.
It was as if something urgent was about to happen, making him extremely impatient.
Jiang Ran ignored it and went out to eat.
That skinny monkey-like man finally got the elevator and excitedly rushed inside.
He kept shouting, “YES! YES! YES!”
His whole body was in an extremely euphoric state.
The elevator stopped on the sixth floor.
He ran out and dashed toward Room 602 like lightning.
He pounded on the door.
Within a few minutes, the door opened.
The dance streamer Li Mengmeng, dressed in sexy pajamas, stood coquettishly behind the door.
The skinny monkey man quickly pinched his nose, afraid of a nosebleed from the temptation.
Seeing this, Li Mengmeng smiled faintly, pulling the skinny monkey man inside Room 602.
“Baby, I finally get to have you!”
Once inside, the skinny monkey man grabbed Li Mengmeng tightly, his nose inhaling her fragrant hair like crazy.
The skinny monkey man was a regular top supporter in Li Mengmeng’s livestream room.
He often spent a lot on her rankings but had never gotten to meet her in real life.
He was really craving her.
He also knew Li Mengmeng was toying with him, but since he had already spent so much money, he really didn’t want to give up.
Originally, he was somewhat desperate, preparing to spend even more to try and get her. If it didn’t work, he would have to give up.
But somehow, Li Mengmeng suddenly sent him a message today, saying she was willing to meet and agreed to let him come to her home.
Of course, the precondition was that today was her birthday and he had to send her a 9,999 yuan red envelope.
He sent it immediately and then received her home address and a sexy selfie.
He understood perfectly what that meant, so on the way here, he was extremely anxious and excited!
As for Li Mengmeng,
Last night she was scolded on the phone by the middle-aged man’s wife, who told her the middle-aged man had disappeared and no one knew where he was.
Then, at around ten in the morning, she was woken up again.
That woman came with the police looking for him.
Up to this point, Li Mengmeng didn’t think much of it, but when she messaged the middle-aged man and received no reply, she felt that things might be more serious than expected.
After all, the middle-aged man had never ignored her messages before.
Then she sent several more messages and tried calling him, but still no answer.
No answer or not, Li Mengmeng was also angry.
Besides, she needed to pay off the credit cards maxed out from her travel expenses as soon as possible.
So she planned to find another wealthy patron from her livestream room.
That new patron was this skinny monkey man.
At this moment, Li Mengmeng held the skinny monkey man’s hand, leading him into the bedroom he dreamed about.
The skinny monkey man kept swallowing saliva, his heart pounding wildly.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Jiang Ran Confronts the Dog Man
chapters.content:
Ding!
The elevator reached the third floor.
Jiang Ran stepped out after having lunch at a small restaurant near the apartment building.
He planned to return home to rest and relax before continuing his afternoon customer service work.
But the moment he exited the elevator, he found himself face to face with a monster.
Both Jiang Ran and the creature froze when their eyes met.
One stood motionless before the elevator, while the other remained still on all fours.
"Is this cosplay?"
Jiang Ran frowned deeply as he stared at the figure crouched on all fours, wearing a cheap human-skin mask and what appeared to be a yellow dog fur suit.
He couldn't for the life of him recognize which anime character this was supposed to be...Well, even if it wasn't cosplay, it must be some performance art.
Though honestly, it was downright creepy.
Seeing such a thing at high noon made Jiang Ran's heart skip a beat - for a moment he thought it was some mutated dog monster.
Had this happened at night, he probably would have screamed in terror.
The appearance was simply too horrifying and bizarre.
So Jiang Ran, after stepping out of the elevator, moved like a statue pressed against the wall to bypass the space occupied by the dog man.
Then he quickly scurried back to his apartment.
As Jiang Ran's door to Room 304 slammed shut, the motionless dog man resumed movement - slowly crawling up the stairs on all fours, occasionally turning its head left and right as if patrolling its territory.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Hey? Is this the lab rat from previous rounds that survived till now? Doesn't seem special at all. But I have a question - why did the dog man let this guy go without attacking him?]
Fairy Sister: [This dog man's victims are mostly women, though some men too - but only those who pose a threat to him. He's not the type to indiscriminately kill anyone walking down the street.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [I see. By the way, how can I watch recordings of previous 25 rounds? I can't find them in the live stream room.]

Ultimate Rich Kid sent a disdainful emoji: [Hmph, I don't buy that. If I don't want to go in, can they really force me?]
Little Dragon Girl: [Ultimate Rich Kid, your confidence reminds me of another person in this chat room - a young man in his twenties whose family had about 5 billion in assets. He didn't believe the warnings either and secretly recorded videos that accidentally got leaked.]
[The organizers targeted him immediately. He fled abroad with at least fifty bodyguards around him constantly. Guess what? Within a week, the organizers captured him and made him a new lab rat.]
Ultimate Rich Kid was silent for a while before responding: [What... what happened to him in the end?]

The mood turned heavy.
[Alright alright, let's just watch the live stream and not do anything stupid. Look - the dog man went straight from the 3rd floor to the 6th. I remember two residents live there this round. Might see the first casualty of Round 26 soon.]
Meanwhile in Room 602:
Dance streamer Li Mengmeng and the skinny man had just finished their activities.
The rail-thin man tightly embraced Li Mengmeng's curvaceous body.
Putting on a gentle voice, he said: "Baby, I don't know why but I get so excited when I'm with you... finish so quickly... must be because I like you so much..."
Li Mengmeng didn't respond, burying her head in the man's chest.
She smiled sweetly while internally cringing: "Just call it premature ejaculation, don't make excuses. Disgusting pig."
As always, if not for the money, she would never be with such a man.
After cuddling for a while, the skinny man felt ready again.
Just as he was about to initiate, the doorbell to Room 602 suddenly rang.
Not wanting to waste precious intimate time, the skinny man ignored it.
But the doorbell kept ringing incessantly.
"Did you order delivery? Or expecting a package?" the skinny man asked Li Mengmeng.
"No deliveries, and my packages always go to lockers or stations - never to my door. Go see who it is, that constant ringing is annoying."
The skinny man kissed Li Mengmeng's forehead: "Okay baby, wait for me."
He got out of bed, pulling on a pair of pants and t-shirt discarded on the floor.
Walking through the living room toward the door while Li Mengmeng rested with her eyes closed.
"Coming coming, stop ringing already!"
The rapid-fire doorbell suggested someone either mindlessly pressing it or a mischievous kid.
He planned to give whoever it was a piece of his mind - what kind of idiot keeps ringing like the world's ending?
Reaching the door, he yanked it open.

Seeing no one at eye level, he assumed it must be a kid and looked down, ready to scold the little brat who ruined his mood.
But what he saw below froze him in place, sending chills down his spine.
