chapters.title: Chapter 60: The True Identity of the Fair-Skinned Young Man with the Beauty Mark
chapters.content:
The loud shout attracted Li Mengmeng, who was still lying in bed in the bedroom.
However, the moment she stepped out of the bedroom and saw the horrific scene in the living room, her entire body froze.
By the time she regained her senses, she saw the skinny man lying motionless in a pool of blood on the floor, while the figure wearing a cheap human-skin mask was crouched on all fours.
Its face turned toward her, its rear end raised high as it wagged an invisible yellow tail.
...
After watching the video, Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, and Ke Bei had agreed to capture the Dog Man and execute him on the spot.
Since it was already noon, the three went out to eat together, planning to visit Bai Ze in Room 201 that afternoon.
Finally, around 1 PM, they caught Bai Ze returning to Room 201.
Bai Ze had an ordinary appearance, his most distinctive feature being his fair skin and a beauty mark near the corner of his left eye.
Seeing the three waiting at his doorstep didn't surprise Bai Ze. He simply opened the door to Room 201 and ushered them inside before closing it behind them."What brings you here?"
Bai Ze poured three glasses of plain water and placed them on the coffee table in the living room, watching the trio.
The three sat on the sofa.
Xiao Q spoke first: "Last time, thanks to you telling us where our friend Wang Ju was, we were able to rescue her in time. So first, we came to thank you, and second, we wanted to ask you some other questions."
Bai Ze pulled up a chair and sat opposite the sofa, staring at Xiao Q: "I remember you weren't among those college students when I revealed that girl's location."
Xiao Q: "That's right, I wasn't there at the time."
Bai Ze: "No need for thanks—it was nothing. Hmm... Ask whatever you want directly. I prefer straightforwardness."
The three exchanged glances.
Finally, Xiao Peng asked: "Bai Ze, we want to know—how did you know Wang Ju was in Room 504 with Lin Shengli? You should remember me—I asked you this before, but you didn't answer."
Bai Ze replied coldly: "Fine, I'll answer now. That night, I happened to see Lin Shengli abducting Wang Ju."
Though the three found this answer incredibly dismissive, there was nothing they could do about it.
At least he had answered.
Xiao Peng shrank back slightly, while Xiao Q straightened up:
"One night, we were chased by two foreigners in the apartment wielding chainsaws. You know about that, right?"
Bai Ze nodded: "That night was extremely loud. Probably everyone in the apartment knew."
Xiao Q: "That night, three of our friends were killed, and one went missing—Xiao Nuo, who used to live in Room 904. She was Xiao Peng's girlfriend—the guy sitting next to me here."
"This morning, we received a disc. On it, we saw Xiao Nuo... and the entire process of her murder. That's how we also saw the killer."
"The killer wore a cheap human-skin mask and a yellow dog-skin suit, constantly pretending to be a dog, walking on all fours."
"We want to know—do you have any idea which room in the apartment this Dog Man lives in?"
Bai Ze's expression remained cold: "Why would you think to ask me that? Just because I once told you where Wang Ju was, you assume I'd know where this Dog Man lives?"
Hearing this, the three looked at each other.
That... actually made sense.
The atmosphere in the room grew heavy and silent.
Unexpectedly, it was Bai Ze who suddenly broke the silence:
"Ke Bei, right?"
Bai Ze's sudden use of Ke Bei's name surprised him.
Ke Bei and Bai Ze had never interacted—especially since Bai Ze hadn't even attended the welcome party. So how did he know his name?
But what shocked Ke Bei even more were Bai Ze's next words.
"Is your father named Ke Zhenxi?"
Ke Bei's face lit up with excitement: "You know my father?!"
Bai Ze's expression remained icy: "Yes. And I bear significant responsibility for his disappearance."
Ke Bei froze, not understanding why Bai Ze would say that.
What connection did he have with his father?
At that moment, Xiao Q slapped his thigh: "Ke Bei, you're too close to see clearly—but I'm an outsider. Remember your father's diary that you showed me? That young man who asked him to investigate his sister's disappearance?!"
Ke Bei suddenly remembered, murmuring in disbelief: "Don't tell me he's..."
"That's right. It was me—the one who hired your father to find my missing sister. That's also why I said I bear responsibility for his disappearance. If not for my request, your father would never have entered Alice Apartment as a new resident... and subsequently vanished."
Bai Ze said.
BANG!Follow current novᴇls on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Ke Bei suddenly stood up, slamming both hands violently onto the glass coffee table in front of him.
The impact sent everything on the table jumping into the air.
His eyes burned red with fury as he glared at Bai Ze, who remained seated calmly in his chair.
Ke Bei knew Bai Ze was right. Without his request...
He and his father would still be working as private investigators.
By now, he might even be married, with his retired father helping to raise his grandchildren.
Instead, this was reality: his father was missing, most likely dead.
And he had ventured into this dangerous apartment alone to investigate.
"Ke Bei, calm down. Sit back down!"
Seeing the situation escalating, Xiao Q intervened to mediate.
Ke Bei eventually sat back down.
As he did, his expression gradually returned to normal.
After all, Ke Bei wasn't an ordinary person. Though his mind was clouded with rage over his father's fate...
He had once been a private investigator—a profession requiring absolute rationality.
Slowly, logic began to override emotion.
Clenching his teeth in resignation, he said: "I want to blame you... but I can't. My father could have refused the case, but he chose to accept it. He knew the risks—he just didn't expect this outcome."
Listening to this, Xiao Q recalled what Ke Bei's father had written in his diary.
Initially, he had investigated Alice Apartment—where Bai Ze's sister disappeared—because of the commission.
But later, he became deeply fascinated. Even without payment, he would have continued.
Truthfully, he could have stopped investigating at any point before signing the agreement to enter the apartment.
Bai Ze's request had merely been the spark—a spark that could have been extinguished at any time.
"So this is my debt to your father. And that's why I'll tell you where the Dog Man lives—to repay that debt."
"The Dog Man lives in Room 1001."
Room 1001.
The tenth floor.
Now that they knew the Dog Man's location, the three prepared to leave and take action.
But before they left...
Ke Bei asked Bai Ze one last question: "Did you ever find your sister?"
For the first time, Bai Ze's cold expression faltered, replaced by profound gloom: "No. Most likely... she's dead."

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Grab Weapons, Head to 1001
chapters.content:
"Where should we go next? Straight to 1001?"
The three of them exited Room 201, Xiao Peng's hands trembling all the way up to his arms.
It was unclear whether from fear or excitement.
Or perhaps other, more complex emotions.
"Xiao Peng, have you really decided? Do we kill that Dog Man outright, or capture him alive and hand him over to the police?"
Xiao Q double-checked at this moment.
Xiao Peng froze for three seconds before saying, "Xiao Q, I just remembered - isn't your uncle a detective? If we catch this Dog Man, we're worried fake cops arranged by the apartment might show up if we call 911. Could we have your uncle bring a team directly?"
Xiao Q frowned: "We could...but haven't you forgotten how many criminals in this apartment, like the kite-making killer Wang Nuli, served paper sentences and got released? Even if we hand him over, given the powerful forces behind this apartment, they might just get him out again..."
After hearing this, they all sighed deeply several times.
Xiao Peng declared: "I'll do it. Killing him will prevent more victims."He kept mentally justifying himself, preparing psychological comfort for his potential future actions.
The three couldn't possibly confront the Dog Man empty-handed.
They needed preparations.
Of the three, Xiao Peng didn't live here, and Xiao Q had moved in with just clothes and daily necessities.
Only Ke Bei, determined to succeed or die trying, had brought many items from his original home when settling in long-term.
These included several baseball bats and knuckle dusters - readily available weapons.
Now, the three took the elevator to the 6th floor.
But upon arriving...
A wave of metallic blood scent assaulted them, making all three cover their noses.
Exiting the elevator, they found the entire sixth floor hallway saturated with the stench.
"Where's this smell coming from?"
Xiao Peng wondered aloud.
The other two didn't speak, just kept sniffing, trying to locate the strongest concentration and source.
They finally stopped before Room 602.
The blood smell seemed strongest here.
"This is...Li Mengmeng's apartment..."
Ke Bei murmured.
Xiao Q said: "That dance streamer Li Mengmeng? The pretty one?"
Ke Bei nodded, lightly touching the door handle. He discovered Room 602 wasn't fully closed - the door was flush with the frame but left an almost invisible gap.
When Ke Bei pushed, the door swung open completely, releasing an even more pungent blood odor like some blood demon had descended.
Accompanying this stench was the sight of a male corpse lying in a pool of blood...
All three were stunned.
Actually, when they'd first smelled blood in the hallway, they'd had bad premonitions.
Especially with such pervasive odor - something had definitely died, probably a person.
And when they reached Room 602, hearing Ke Bei say this was the dance streamer Li Mengmeng's room from the welcome party...
They'd assumed they might find Li Mengmeng dead inside.
Instead, upon opening the door, they found not Li Mengmeng, nor even a woman.
But a man!!!!
"Li Mengmeng's not in 602! No idea where she went!"
Xiao Peng checked the entire apartment while Xiao Q and Ke Bei crouched by the dead man, examining him closely.
The man was very thin, especially his arms - so slender.
The cause of death appeared to be the torn, gnawed wound on his neck.
No other bleeding wounds were visible.
After inspecting the apartment, Xiao Peng joined them by the skinny man's body. After a moment, he pointed at the neck:
"The Dog Man did this?! This neck bite matches exactly how he killed Xiao Nuo."
"Probably. The Dog Man must have attacked 602. Anyway this unidentified man is dead. As for Li Mengmeng - either she wasn't home, or the Dog Man took her."
Xiao Q added: "Given how he used Xiao Nuo to make those videos, he probably has...particular tastes."
"Wouldn't kill Li Mengmeng as quickly as he did this man."
"What do we do now?"
Xiao Peng asked.
Ke Bei said: "Get weapons from my place, then go straight for the Dog Man."
None of them dealt with the corpse first, instead going next door to Ke Bei's Room 601.
Ke Bei took a steel baseball bat - getting hit with this would definitely be "fun."
Xiao Peng chose a sharpened dagger.
Xiao Q took Ke Bei's metal knuckle dusters.
"Wait, one more thing."
After gathering weapons, as Xiao Q and Xiao Peng prepared to leave, Ke Bei stopped them. He went into his bedroom and emerged under two minutes.
They stared at Ke Bei but couldn't see anything new in his hands.
"What'd you get from the bedroom? Where is it?"
"You'll see."
The three left 601, taking the elevator to the 10th floor.
Inside the elevator, imagining what was coming, Xiao Peng and Xiao Q kept taking deep breaths to calm their nerves.
Ke Bei, however, remained completely composed, as if they were just going to watch a movie.
Understandable - Xiao Peng was just a college student whose main activity was hitting on pretty women of all ages.
Though Xiao Q studied criminal investigation and knew much about detective work...
He'd never actually practiced it.
Like the difference between a rookie cop and a seasoned detective.
Ke Bei was different - who knew how long he'd been a private eye?
Was there anything he hadn't done?
His mental fortitude was terrifyingly strong.
Soon, with a "ding," the elevator arrived.
They stepped onto the 10th floor.
An eerie silence pervaded the hallway, like the calm before a storm.
Arriving at 1001's door, they moved unusually quietly - even their footsteps after exiting the elevator were deliberately muted to avoid alerting their prey.
"It's locked..."
Pushing the immovable security door of 1001, Xiao Q and Xiao Peng were at a loss. They'd prepared everything except for this.
Now what?
Break it down? That would alert the Dog Man inside, letting him prepare...
Just then, a savior spoke: "Let me."
The two stepped back as Ke Bei approached.
From his pocket, he produced an unusually shaped, slender lockpick.
"You asked what I got from my bedroom? This."ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Seeing the silvery metal pick, Xiao Peng grinned in amazement: "You can pick locks?!"
Ke Bei: "Private detectives need all kinds of skills. Lockpicking's essential."
Ke Bei's skills weren't far from professional level. In three minutes, with a "click," he'd defeated the security door's lock.

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Xiao Peng! Behind You!
chapters.content:
After the door opened, Ke Bei didn't move aside. Instead, he quietly opened a small crack and peered through, finding no signs of danger or anything unusual before slowly widening the gap.
Only when the opening was wide enough for a person to pass through did the three of them file in one by one and close the door behind them.
The entire apartment was eerily silent.
Not a single sound could be heard.
"That Dog Man probably isn't home right now," Ke Bei said.
The other two thought the same.
Because the apartment was unnaturally quiet.
The trio didn't leave just because the Dog Man wasn't home.
They planned to first search Room 1001 thoroughly, then lie in wait to ambush the Dog Man when he returned.
The decor of 1001 was ordinary and unremarkable, everything looking completely normal.After a quick glance around the living room, they noticed a corner piled high with various types of dog food - bone-strengthening, nutritional supplements - along with dog treats.
Additionally, the sofa was scattered with dog toys like balls and plush toys.
The only unusual items were a refrigerator and a separate freezer in the living room - uncommon for most households that typically only have one refrigerator.
A look at the open kitchen revealed it was rarely used, with thick dust covering the knife block and kitchen tools. One chef's knife even showed signs of rust.
Opening the kitchen cabinets revealed unused dishes and utensils covered in dust. But in another cabinet, they found multiple clean dog bowls that appeared frequently used.
Next, they checked the balcony and found several identical tight-fitting yellow dog suits hanging to dry - the same kind they'd seen the Dog Man wearing in surveillance footage.
"Eating dog food, playing with dog toys," Xiao Peng cursed. "This freak might as well be reborn as a dog next life instead of pretending to be one."
The bathroom inspection revealed nothing unusual, except for an unusually strong smell of urine.
Finally, they entered the bedroom.
Immediately upon entering, they made a shocking discovery.
On the soft, large bed lay a beautiful young woman in pajamas, sound asleep.
Xiao Q approached and stared at the woman's face, calling out, "Li Mengmeng, Li Mengmeng." When she didn't wake after several calls and pushes, he remarked, "She's sleeping like a log - probably drugged like Xiao Nuo. But she's luckier than Xiao Nuo since we arrived before anything happened to her."
Turning around, Xiao Q saw Xiao Peng fiddling with a small black handheld camera.
"This must be what the Dog Man uses to film his videos," Xiao Peng said.
"Come look at this! See what I found!" Ke Bei suddenly exclaimed excitedly.Thɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
The other two rushed over to see a cabinet Ke Bei had opened, filled with neatly organized DVDs in plastic cases, each labeled with names in marker.
Picking one at random read "Fang Shuishui." Another said "Gu Ling." From the names, they all appeared to belong to women.
"I saw a disc player in the living room - let's check these out," Ke Bei said, gathering all fourteen labeled DVDs and bringing them to the living room.
Inserting the one labeled "Fang Shuishui" into the player and turning on the TV, they soon saw footage similar to Xiao Nuo's video, just with a different victim - first satisfying the pervert's fetishes, then the brutal neck-biting murder.
The "Gu Ling" DVD showed identical content to the other two they'd seen.
Ke Bei stood grimly by the TV watching the footage. Xiao Q sat on the sofa. Xiao Peng leaned against the white freezer beside the couch, his face twisted in pain and confusion.
"I can't understand why there are so many psychopaths in this world," Xiao Peng said.
Xiao Q replied, "It's actually quite normal. I took a course specifically about why people become serial killers. There are several factors - genetics, environment, personal experiences, psychological issues... With so many people in the world, even the rarest types will exist in some proportion."
"Think about famous ones like Jack the Ripper, the Rostov Ripper, the Smiling Granny, the Student Killer, the Zodiac Killer - all products of various factors. But those are all foreign cases."
"China has them too, though only the most notorious become widely known, like the Baiyin serial murders. Lesser-known ones can be found through online reports."
"But this Dog Man - I couldn't find any information about him online. Unknown as he is, I think his crimes are just as depraved as the famous ones. Think about his victims - innocent lives cut short in their prime. These girls - Xiao Nuo, Fang Shuishui, Gu Ling - all under 25, killed at their most beautiful age."
"After seeing these videos, I'm even more determined to personally eliminate this Dog Man and avenge these girls!" Xiao Peng declared firmly. "But I want to rant about something. Since childhood I've heard ghost stories, seen people online claiming to have seen spirits."
"My question is - why don't victims of these psychopaths become vengeful spirits haunting their killers? Do ghosts even exist?"
Xiao Q turned to look at Xiao Peng. "Who knows if they exist or not, but for these psychopaths, ghosts definitely don't exist."
Just as Xiao Q was about to continue, his expression suddenly changed to one of terror as he screamed, "Xiao Peng! Behind you!!!"
Hearing Xiao Q's warning and seeing his frightened expression, most people would instinctively turn to look. But Xiao Peng was different.
While not as quick-thinking as Xiao Q or Ke Bei, among his peers he was known for keeping a cool head. From stopping his friends from telling Jiang Ran about Wang Ju in the elevator, to questioning Bai Ze about how he knew Wang Ju's whereabouts when others rushed off - in this critical moment, he didn't turn around like a normal person would.
Turning around to identify the danger before running might be too late. Running forward without looking back was undoubtedly the optimal choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Three vs. Dog Man
chapters.content:
But the optimal solution doesn't always resolve the crisis.
Xiao Peng was ultimately too late.
What none of the three people in the room expected was this:
The Dog Man they'd been waiting to return home so they could ambush him...
Suddenly emerged from the freezer Xiao Peng was leaning against, catching them completely off guard.
It was only thanks to Xiao Q's timely warning and Xiao Peng's instinctive reaction to run forward that saved him.
When the Dog Man first appeared, he'd aimed straight for Xiao Peng's neck. But because of these two factors, he missed the neck and only managed to bite Xiao Peng's right shoulder.
The moment his teeth sank in, Xiao Peng let out a pained scream.
"Fuck!"
Xiao Q reacted immediately, grabbing the metal knuckle dusters from the glass coffee table. After putting them on, he rushed to the freezer where the Dog Man still had most of his body inside, jaws firmly clamped on Xiao Peng's shoulder, eyes filled with viciousness.Aiming at the Dog Man's head and back, Xiao Q's first instinct made him choose the less lethal option - the back.
He repeatedly struck the Dog Man's back with the knuckle dusters, but it did nothing to make him release Xiao Peng.
Ke Bei, however, acted differently. Approaching the freezer with his steel baseball bat, his first reaction was to aim for the head.
Simply put, when it came to potentially killing someone with their own hands...
Xiao Q's practical experience and subconscious hesitation manifested in his actions.
Ke Bei's strike proved much more effective.
Though the human skull is the hardest part of the body, the steel baseball bat wasn't to be underestimated either. With one powerful swing, he forced the Dog Man's jaws open, freeing Xiao Peng.
Xiao Peng stumbled forward a few steps before collapsing to the ground, his left hand pressing hard on his right shoulder where the bite had torn through flesh, blood flowing nonstop.
His entire body convulsed in pain.
Meanwhile, the Dog Man who had been struck by both knuckle dusters and baseball bat now climbed nimbly out of the freezer.
In the open space beside the freezer, he assumed the aggressive stance of a large dog preparing to attack - hindquarters tensed for power.
A low, threatening growl rumbled from his throat.
Then, in the blink of an eye, the Dog Man suddenly lunged at Ke Bei.
He launched himself forward in a canine-style pounce.
Ke Bei swung his baseball bat, landing a solid hit across the Dog Man's face. The creature staggered briefly but quickly regained his footing and continued the attack.
His speed was terrifying - before Ke Bei could even recover from his swing to prepare another strike, he could only grip both ends of the baseball bat desperately to block the Dog Man's snapping jaws.
What happened next shocked Ke Bei to his core.
As the Dog Man bit down on the steel baseball bat, the metal began visibly deforming under the pressure of his jaws!!!
If this had been an actual large dog - a wolfhound or Tibetan mastiff - such bite force wouldn't have been so shocking. But this was clearly a human being!
How could human teeth and jaw strength reach such monstrous levels?!
While Ke Bei remained locked in this desperate struggle, Xiao Q quickly moved to the Dog Man's side and began delivering repeated heavy blows to his head with the knuckle dusters.
This time, Xiao Q had shaken off his initial hesitation.
Meanwhile, Xiao Peng struggled up from the floor despite his injured shoulder, grabbing the sharp dagger that had been knocked from his hand during the initial ambush.
He charged at the Dog Man, aiming the blade for his back.
Seeming to notice Xiao Peng's approach from the corner of his eye, the Dog Man suddenly shoved forward violently, knocking Ke Bei to the ground before disengaging his jaws.
Standing upright, he first delivered a kick to Xiao Q's approaching right fist - the one wearing the knuckle dusters.
Another kick followed immediately, striking Xiao Peng in the chest and sending him sprawling backward.
Then, imitating a dog's attack once more, he pounced again.
The dagger flew from Xiao Peng's hand from the force of the kick.
Facing the Dog Man's gaping maw coming straight for him, he could only raise his right arm as defense - which was promptly clamped between powerful jaws. With his left fist, he struck repeatedly at the Dog Man's head and face.
But this creature seemed like some pain-immune monster.
Not only did he not release his grip, his bite only grew stronger.
Only when Xiao Q and Ke Bei came at him again did he finally let go, turning to engage the other two in a vicious melee.
Though Xiao Q and Ke Bei still had their weapons, even after five minutes of coordinated attacks against the Dog Man, they couldn't gain any real advantage.
Many of their strikes had landed, but the Dog Man displayed unnatural endurance.
"Fuck your mother!!!!"
Suddenly, Xiao Peng - who had been lying on the ground catching his breath for the past five minutes - threw himself desperately onto the Dog Man's back, trying to force him down.
Whether from his own weakness or the Dog Man's strength, he couldn't bring him down.
Instead, he ended up clinging to the Dog Man's back like a stubborn burr, arms and legs wrapped tightly around him while shouting: "Hurry the fuck up!"
Xiao Q and Ke Bei certainly wanted to act quickly, but how?
The Dog Man remained on all fours, with Xiao Peng stuck to his back. Their only options were attacking the head or lower body.
The lower body was difficult to reach, leaving only the head.
But Xiao Peng's head was right next to the Dog Man's.
And with all their violent struggling, any misaimed heavy blow could give Xiao Peng at least a concussion, if not kill him outright.
The Dog Man growled continuously in rage, finally abandoning pure canine behavior. Instead of just biting, he reached back with one hand, grabbing a fistful of Xiao Peng's hair and yanking downward with terrifying force.Googlᴇ search
Trying to pull him off.
"AAAAAAH!"
Xiao Peng felt like his scalp was being torn off - the pain was fucking unbearable!
"Fuck this, I'll fight you with everything I've got!"
Xiao Peng went all out, sinking his teeth into the Dog Man's right shoulder - payback in kind.
But his bite strength was clearly in a different league from the Dog Man's - his attack might as well have been a gentle nibble.
Realizing this, Xiao Peng mustered all his remaining strength to stretch forward...
And clamped his jaws onto the Dog Man's right ear.
Even the Dog Man's unnatural endurance had its limits - ears were still vulnerable.
Under Xiao Peng's desperate bite...
The Dog Man finally released a pained howl.
Seeing this, Xiao Q and Ke Bei moved in.
Afraid of accidentally hitting Xiao Peng, they discarded their weapons and tried to pile onto the Dog Man together to subdue him.
The Dog Man had gone completely berserk now.
Adopting a "lose the battle to win the war" approach...
He rolled violently, pinning Xiao Peng beneath him. Then with a powerful upward jerk of his head - combined with Xiao Peng's own pulling force...
The Dog Man tore free, leaving nearly half his ear still clamped between Xiao Peng's teeth.
Ignoring Xiao Peng still tangled beneath him, the Dog Man turned all his fury on the approaching Xiao Q - fists, feet and gnashing teeth working in terrifying coordination.
Despite outnumbering the Dog Man three to one, Xiao Peng was the first to reach his limit.
Exhausted and gasping for breath after biting off the Dog Man's ear - an act that had drained his last reserves of strength - he could only lie on the ground watching the ongoing struggle.
The Dog Man had Xiao Q pinned beneath him now, head lowered as he tried to sink his teeth into Xiao Q's throat. Xiao Q held him off with both hands, creating a desperate stalemate.
Seizing the opportunity, Ke Bei retrieved his discarded baseball bat...
And began delivering a relentless barrage of blows to the Dog Man's head and back.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Does the Dog Man Have Accomplices?
chapters.content:
The Dog Man no longer retreated when the situation turned unfavorable, regrouping like before. Instead, it persisted in biting Xiao Q to death despite taking repeated blows to its head and back, as if harboring some deep-seated hatred against him.
This gave Ke Bei a perfect opportunity. His eyes were bloodshot, his entire body drenched in sweat. Besides sweat, he was covered in blood - even the silver baseball bat had turned completely crimson. Each downward swing carried his full strength, feeling his physical stamina draining rapidly like mana in a game.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Bang!
He lost count of how many times he struck. Only after hearing Xiao Q yell "Stop!" at least seven or eight times did he finally cease. His mechanical movements halted, his vision blurred by sweat that stung when he tried opening his eyes, forcing him to blink repeatedly. Pushing back his sweat-soaked black hair into a fixed side-swept fringe, he looked down at the motionless Dog Man lying atop Xiao Q.
The back of its skull had caved in, white brain matter and tissue oozing out. Its spine was visibly fractured, the entire back grotesquely twisted downward - unquestionably dead beyond any doubt.
After confirming the Dog Man's demise, Ke Bei collapsed exhausted onto the floor.
"Hey... help get this thing off me... I'm spent," Xiao Q gasped weakly.
The two struggled tremendously before finally rolling the Dog Man's corpse aside. Xiao Q could finally breathe freely again.All three now lay identically sprawled across Room 1001's living room floor, savoring their hard-won respite.
After several minutes of rest, Xiao Peng suddenly burst into laughter. "Hahaha! Xiao Nuo! I've avenged you! Avenged you!"
When his laughter subsided, Xiao Q asked, "Xiao Peng, if Xiao Nuo had lived and you discovered she wasn't the wealthy heiress you imagined, would you have broken up?"
Xiao Peng replied, "I wouldn't have dumped her immediately after finding out. I'd wait until I felt I'd repaid everything I owed her before breaking up." He gave a self-deprecating smile. "This whole ordeal taught me something."
Xiao Q asked curiously, "What's that?"
Xiao Peng explained, "I used to read about professional athletes - soccer players, basketball stars - how some with incredible talent ruined their careers by chasing women. I always wondered - could women really affect their performance that much? I never noticed it in daily life, but now I understand completely."
"Of us three, I was the first to run out of steam. Honestly, if not for avenging Xiao Nuo, I'd have collapsed much earlier. After this, I'm cutting back on women. Never realized how much they drained me until this critical moment. My waist, thighs, arms - all feel numb and weak."
"Thank god you two were here, or I'd be dead!"
Xiao Q responded, "Don't say that. Any one of us alone would've died here today. Think about it - we came prepared as a team, armed, and still barely won. What really shocked me was this bastard hiding in the freezer ambushing us!!!"
Ke Bei lay like a man made of sweat and blood, as did the others. Panting, he added, "Thankfully you noticed in time. Losing someone at the start would've been disastrous!"
"Anyway, we won!" Xiao Peng laughed heartily, his grief over Xiao Nuo's death apparently resolved. "Like those anime always say - evil can never triumph over justice!!!"
Turning to the others, he asked, "So... what should we do about the male corpse in Room 602 and this Dog Man?"
"Dealing with corpses is tricky..." Xiao Q said weakly. "Let's rest first. I'm completely drained."
Ke Bei felt similarly, too exhausted to speak.
All three closed their eyes simultaneously, slowly recovering amidst the silence - the same silence they'd encountered upon reaching the 10th floor, though now it felt peaceful rather than oppressive.
Then an event shattered their hard-earned tranquility.
Click!ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Three pairs of eyes snapped open, heads turning toward Room 1001's security door. That unmistakable sound of a key entering the lock couldn't have been misheard by all three simultaneously.
"Does the Dog Man have accomplices?!" Terror crept across Xiao Peng's face.
In their exhausted state, they couldn't resist another Dog Man - even an ordinary man would overpower them now. They were utterly defenseless.
"We're screwed! Totally screwed!!!" Despite their cries, they struggled to rise and retrieve their discarded weapons, but their limbs refused to cooperate. Their hearts pounded violently against their ribs as primal fear took hold.
Death loomed over them.
Creak...
The door swung inward.
Someone had entered.
Too weak even to crawl, weapons out of reach, despair flooded through them. Was this the end?
"Oh? So it's you three in 1001?" came a familiar woman's voice.
They strained to look - the intruder was none other than Su Mi, the beautiful thirty-year-old woman living next to Bai Ze in Room 202!
Was she the Dog Man's accomplice?!
Noticing their terrified expressions, Su Mi looked puzzled. "Why are you all looking at me like that?"
"My friend lives on the 10th floor. I came to go shopping with her when I heard noises from 1001, so I checked inside."
Her explanation made them wonder - had they overreacted? Maybe she wasn't connected to the Dog Man after all?
Still suspicious, Xiao Q demanded, "Then how do you have a key to 1001?"
Su Mi flipped her black hair, releasing a floral scent. "Got it from Xiao Zhang, of course!"
Xiao Q remained doubtful. "Why would he give another resident's key to a random tenant?"
With another hair toss, Su Mi smirked. "Simple - a woman's charm works wonders. Men will do anything if you sweet-talk them right!"

chapters.title: Chapter 65: The Doctor's Meaningful Smile
chapters.content:
Xiao Q and his two companions didn't suspect anything, as the woman before them could indeed be described as charming and flirtatious. Not just Manager Xiao Zhang, but even the three of them—if they had encountered such a woman outside Alice Apartment actively coming onto them—would have found it hard to resist.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Su Mi took a few steps forward, her gaze sweeping over Xiao Q and the other two with disdain. "Why do you three have so much blood and sweat on you? You smell terrible!"
"Hey, why is there someone lying over there?"
Taking a few more steps closer for a better look, Su Mi suddenly exclaimed in shock, "Isn't this the guy who's always pretending to be a dog in the apartment? Why is he here too? Hey, wake up!"
She nudged the Dog Man with her foot in disgust, but he remained motionless. After carefully examining the exaggerated and horrifying injuries on his body, she turned back to look at the three men lying on the floor staring intently at her.
As if realizing something, she immediately rushed to the security door in panic. "Oh my god! Did you three kill him?!"
"I need to call the police! No wonder Room 1001 was so noisy—you were doing this kind of thing inside!!!"
"Wait, hold on!" Xiao Q weakly raised his voice to stop Su Mi from dialing.
Clutching her phone tightly, Su Mi looked ready to bolt at any moment. "Wait for what? Are you going to silence me now that I've discovered your crime?!"
Xiao Q spat out a mouthful of blood. "Do we look capable of silencing anyone in this state? And why would we need to silence you?"Su Mi retorted confidently, "Of course you would! Because I've found your criminal evidence!!!!"
Xiao Peng interjected, "Sister, we did kill this Dog Man, but it was self-defense! You don't know—he's a deranged criminal!! Check the bedroom—isn't there a woman there? That was his next target! If you don't believe us, look at the discs on the TV stand! They're all evidence of his crimes!!!"
After hearing this, Su Mi went to the bedroom with half-belief and indeed found a woman. Returning to the living room, she saw the discs on the TV stand and the paused video on screen. Picking up the remote, she pressed play.
What followed in the video made her pupils tremble with shock. After watching, her voice quivered with horror: "My god... I always thought he was just a mentally ill person pretending to be a dog, or doing some weird performance art... I never imagined he was actually a monster who tortured girls!!!!"
Xiao Q said, "So now you believe us?"
Su Mi nodded. "I believe you. But even so, we still need to call the police, right? Let them handle this. Since you acted in self-defense and there's evidence here, you three won't be in trouble—you're heroes!"
"Fine, call the police then. And an ambulance too," Xiao Q replied.
He figured since the Dog Man was dead and they had clear self-defense evidence, it didn't matter whether real or fake apartment police came. Originally they planned to dispose of the body themselves, but with Su Mi's intervention, so be it.
As for the ambulance—all three were injured to varying degrees, with Xiao Peng being the most severely hurt and definitely needing treatment.
Su Mi nodded, then suddenly remembered something. "It'll take time for the police and ambulance to arrive. Your injuries look serious—you should get treated immediately. Let me call the apartment's dedicated doctor to give you first aid?"
"Dedicated doctor?" Xiao Q was puzzled.
Su Mi explained, "Alice Apartment is a high-end complex—we've always had an on-call doctor. Can't handle major illnesses, but minor ones are no problem. And our doctor used to work at a top-tier hospital!"
Xiao Peng couldn't help commenting, "Damn, the difference between high-end and regular apartments is huge—you even have doctors, and from top-tier hospitals at that!"
Su Mi left Room 1001 to fetch the doctor. Within five minutes, she returned with a middle-aged male doctor in a white coat carrying a medical kit.
Upon seeing the living room's condition, the doctor was visibly startled, his facial muscles twitching. However, he remained silent—likely already briefed by Su Mi—and professionally began examining the three men's injuries.
After the examination, he took out three sealed disposable syringes and a box of glass vials from his kit. Drawing medicine from a vial into a syringe, he approached Xiao Peng to administer the injection.
Xiao Q watched curiously. "Doctor, what are you injecting him with?"
Pointing at Xiao Peng's right shoulder wound, the doctor answered, "Aliconor."
"Aliconor? What kind of medicine is that?" Not being a medical student, Xiao Q had never heard of it.
Ke Bei seemed to recognize it though. "I think that's a foreign medicine—costs thirty thousand per dose. It's a viral infection blocker that can prevent most viral infections."
Xiao Q frowned. "Do we need this?"
The doctor explained, "You all have varying degrees of injuries, especially this handsome guy's shoulder wound—clearly a human bite. Human bites are more dangerous than animal bites because our mouths contain more bacteria. That's why I'm giving you the blocker. Understand?"
Xiao Peng reacted excitedly, "Then inject me quick! Wait—Ke Bei, how much did you say per dose? Thirty thousand? Fuck, we don't have to pay for this, right?!"
Su Mi, standing nearby, smiled. "Residents get it for free. Non-residents though..."
Xiao Peng immediately said, "Then I won't take it. I'm broke. I'll wait for the ambulance!"
Su Mi burst out laughing. "Just kidding! Injuries sustained here are treated for free regardless."
Relieved, Xiao Peng let the doctor proceed. Next was Ke Bei, who had scratch wounds though no bites. Finally, Xiao Q received his injection for the bite on his left arm.
A few minutes after the injections, Xiao Q asked the doctor, who was now taking out bandages and disinfectant, "That's weird, doctor... Why do I feel so sleepy after that shot? Is that a side effect?"
The doctor replied, "The medicine doesn't have that effect."
"Then what's happening? Am I just exhausted?"
The doctor smiled meaningfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Qin Kelian Hunts Jiang Ran Again
chapters.content:
It was currently 3 PM in the afternoon.
Jiang Ran was sitting in the living room typing on his keyboard, dealing with various customer inquiries and growing increasingly annoyed. Suddenly, there was a knock at his door.
"Coming, coming!"
After finishing with one customer, Jiang Ran quickly dashed to the door of Room 304 and opened it.
Standing outside was Qin Kelian, the younger sister of the Demoness sisters from Room 303.
"What's up?"
This was only the second time Qin Kelian had come looking for him, as far as he could remember.
"Oh, I recently brewed some new teas and wanted you to try them."
Qin Kelian flashed a sweet smile and gestured with both hands holding small metal teapots.
"Oh, I see. Come on in then."Jiang Ran led Qin Kelian to the sofa, asking her to wait while he went back to his laptop to request some time off from his supervisor.
After getting approval, Jiang Ran brought out several disposable paper cups and placed them on the coffee table.
Qin Kelian then poured tea from both pots into separate cups for Jiang Ran.
One cup contained a bright red liquid that looked strikingly like blood.
The other held a pale green brew.
As Qin Kelian poured, Jiang Ran admired her beautiful face and the alluring figure wrapped in her black stepmother dress.
Of course, Jiang Ran harbored no improper thoughts - after a brief appreciation, he turned his attention to the two cups of tea.
Seeing the pale green one, he asked, "Is this green tea?"
Qin Kelian shook her head. "This is qing tea. Not exactly green tea, but you could say they're cousins."
Then Jiang Ran noticed the blood-red tea.
He froze momentarily before bending down to examine the crimson liquid in the paper cup.
"Is this red tea?"
Qin Kelian gave a faint smile. "Red tea isn't this red. This is blood tea - you could call it red tea's distant relative."
"Wow, I'm learning something new today."
Jiang Ran scratched his head and unceremoniously picked up the qing tea for a sip.
Hmm. It tasted like tea leaves - nothing particularly special.
The only unusual thing was the sudden message in his mind:
[Ding! Detected host has consumed drugged tea! System has neutralized! Points consumed: 100!]
Same as last time - which had turned out to be the system malfunctioning.
So Jiang Ran ignored it this time.
After tasting the qing tea, Jiang Ran picked up the blood tea.
As he brought it to his lips, a faint metallic scent of blood reached his nose.
Honestly, he hesitated - this blood tea seemed really weird, especially with that bloody smell.
But looking down at Qin Kelian's sparkling, expectant eyes, he took a sip anyway.
It tasted better than the qing tea - sweet with a tea fragrance.
He couldn't help taking another sip.
Similarly, the system notification appeared twice more in his mind:
[Ding! Detected host has consumed drugged tea! System has neutralized! Points consumed: 100!]
"How is it? How do you feel?" Qin Kelian asked eagerly after seeing Jiang Ran drink both teas containing her sister Qin Yi's newly developed sedatives.
Jiang Ran replied, "The blood tea tastes better than the qing tea."
Qin Kelian pressed, "And then?"
Jiang Ran: "Then... nothing else."
Disappointment flashed across Qin Kelian's face.
Her sister's new sedatives had failed again on Jiang Ran.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Thinking she was upset because he lacked tea knowledge to give proper feedback, Jiang Ran laughed awkwardly. "Sorry, I don't know much about tea so I can't give more detailed opinions."
Qin Kelian forced a smile and shook her head. "It's fine, really." Then she picked up both teapots and left abruptly.
Jiang Ran was left thoroughly confused by her sudden departure.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid: "This lab rat Jiang Ran is so lucky! Getting tea served by such a beauty! And to think such top-tier beauties live in that apartment! Even prettier than some celebrity girls I've dated!!!"
Domineering Female CEO: "What? Getting interested, Rich Kid? Want to drink her tea too?"
Ultimate Rich Kid: "With looks and body like that, who wouldn't be? And if a beauty offers you tea, why refuse?"
Domineering Female CEO: "Do you know what's in that tea?"
Ultimate Rich Kid: "Love?"
Domineering Female CEO: "......"
Little Dragon Girl: "Hahaha, you're hilarious Rich Kid! Even Female CEO is speechless. Let me explain - that girl is Qin Kelian, and her tea contains sedatives."
Ultimate Rich Kid: "Sedatives? No way! If there were drugs, how's Jiang Ran still standing there fine?"
Little Dragon Girl: "He's special - naturally immune to sedatives."
Ultimate Rich Kid: "People like that exist???? Wait... why would this beauty Qin Kelian drug Jiang Ran? Unrequited love? But a girl like that could have any man she wants with just a finger snap!"
Little Dragon Girl: "Why the sedatives? Check the apartment resident profiles provided by the organizers in the live stream."
Ultimate Rich Kid: "Okay, give me a minute."
About ten minutes later:
Ultimate Rich Kid returned: "HOLY SHIT! She has an equally hot sister too?!"
Little Dragon Girl: "Seriously? That's all you got from the profiles? Just focused on the women?"
Ultimate Rich Kid: "Hahaha, just making an observation! Though these sisters are stunning, they're absolutely ruthless! Drugging men to turn them into human meat paste and canned products... gotta admit, I'd probably fall for it too..."
Fairy Sister chimed in: "Exactly. These demoness sisters had a 100% success rate until now. Just last round, elder sister Qin Yi used drugged beer on lab rat Murong Fu, then drugged tea on gaming addict Qin Fei. Now their perfect record is ruined by Jiang Ran's immunity."
Ultimate Rich Kid: "So hardcore! I love it! Can we contact the organizers? I'd pay any amount to spend a night with these sisters."
Middle-aged Uncle joined: "Kid, you've got guts. Go ahead and try if you don't mind becoming canned meat."
Ultimate Rich Kid: "But what if... my wealth and charm win them over and they fall for me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Jiang Ran Wants to Become Assistant Manager
chapters.content:
Qin Kelian returned to Room 303. She told her sister Qin Yi about their failed attempt. After listening, Qin Yi merely narrowed her eyes while sipping her blood tea laced with sedatives. After pondering for a moment, she said:
"Little sister, it seems we've met our match this time."
Qin Kelian sighed and collapsed onto the sofa, peeling an orange. "Sis, let's not waste our energy on Jiang Ran. Aren't there other lab rats available this time? Several men we can target first!"
Qin Yi replied, "We can shift targets, but we can't give up on Jiang Ran. He's become a thorn in my side that must be removed."
Qin Kelian asked, "But the sedatives don't work on him! Should we try other methods?"
Qin Yi shook her head. "No need. Keep using sedatives and keep developing new formulas. I don't want to change my usual methods for dealing with men."
Qin Kelian curled up. To be honest, neither she nor her sister had ever used methods beyond drugging men first before acting.
Not to mention her sister, even she felt uncomfortable having someone next door who seemed like the natural enemy of their sister duo.
...
After Qin Kelian left, Jiang Ran continued typing on his keyboard until 5 PM. Finally getting some rest time, he went to the balcony to relax his eyes by looking into the distance. After stretching for five minutes, he returned to the sofa, reclining while playing with his phone.He opened WeChat and noticed someone had @mentioned him in the Alice Apartment residents' group chat. Upon checking, he saw it wasn't directed solely at him but @mentioned everyone in the group.
The @mention came from the apartment manager, Xiao Zhang. He had posted a job announcement:
"Notice: Alice Apartment urgently needs an assistant manager.
Job responsibilities: Assist apartment residents with various tasks, available on call.
Salary: 10,000 yuan per month, five-day work week with eight-hour shifts, includes social insurance and housing fund.
Work hours: 8 AM to 4:30 PM.
Requirements: Good health, enjoys labor, no bad habits or criminal record.
Education requirement: High school diploma.
Interested parties may inquire directly."
Jiang Ran read it silently, then his eyes suddenly lit up.
Damn! 10,000 yuan per month? Five days a week, eight hours a day, with benefits?
Currently working as an online store customer service rep, though he could work from home, he worked six days a week, twelve hours a day, for only 3,000-4,000 yuan take-home pay!
Compared to this assistant manager position, his current job was complete trash!
If he could get this job, he could quit the customer service gig immediately!
Excited by the thought, Jiang Ran started waving his arms around as if he'd already gotten the position. Instead of messaging Xiao Zhang, he rushed down to the first floor to inquire in person.
"Mr. Jiang Ran, you're saying you want to be the assistant manager?"
In the management office, Xiao Zhang had been playing with his phone when Jiang Ran burst in, asking if residents could apply for the position.
Jiang Ran: "Yes, can I do it?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Of course! I posted in the group specifically to see if any residents were interested, or if they knew someone who might want the job. After all, the early bird catches the worm!"
Jiang Ran: "Really? Am I the only applicant?"
He worried he might have to compete for the position, which would be troublesome.
Manager Xiao Zhang shook his head: "Nope, just you. If you're serious, go for a health check tomorrow. Bring me the report so I can check for any infectious diseases. If everything's clear, I'll process your employment paperwork."
Jiang Ran clapped his hands: "Thank you so much!"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "No problem! Serving residents is our duty as managers!"
Meanwhile, sighs filled the live stream room.
Middle-aged Uncle: [This Jiang Ran... I'm speechless. Wasn't being an online customer service rep good enough? Now he wants to be an assistant manager...]
Ultimate Rich Kid asked: [What's wrong with being an assistant manager?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [What's wrong? This apartment has hired assistant managers before - some were lab rats, others were psychopaths. Their endings all shared one thing in common: death.]
[The assistant manager's job is to handle whatever residents need - changing lightbulbs, fixing toilets, etc. Since this is a high-end apartment, unless requests are completely unreasonable, the assistant manager must fulfill them.]
[Because of this, the assistant manager gets forced into contact with too many residents.]
[Originally, Jiang Ran lived on the third floor. The old man in 301 was beaten into submission, scared of him like a mouse seeing a cat. Room 302 is currently empty. Those demoness sisters in 303 couldn't do anything to him either. Working as an online customer service rep, he stayed home all day with minimal contact with other residents.]
[Less contact means lower chances of getting killed. But now, if he becomes assistant manager and starts interacting with all those psycho residents everywhere, doesn't his death probability skyrocket?]
Ultimate Rich Kid pondered: [That makes sense, but why do you care?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [I bet 5 million on him. What do you think?]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [5 million? Even if you lose it, it's not that painful for you, right?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [True, but when watching livestreams and placing bets, who doesn't want to win? Even if I'd only bet 500,000, I'd still want to come out on top!]
Fairy Sister chimed in: [Jiang Ran has it worst among the lab rats. Others get their 10,000 yuan daily payout directly, but his gets donated as tips to his old comic works. For comics, royalties usually get paid monthly, including tips. So he only gets paid once a month. The key point is - a month is over four weeks! I'm afraid he might not live to collect it! If his daily 10,000 yuan went straight to his account, he probably wouldn't take this assistant manager job.]
Middle-aged Uncle: [No way around it. He didn't sign a contract to join - he got drawn in through some lucky draw. How could we justify sending 10,000 yuan daily directly to his account?]
...
After confirming the job with Manager Xiao Zhang, Jiang Ran happily returned to Room 304 to prepare for tomorrow's health check.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Time passed until 8 PM.
Xiao Q opened his bloodshot, exhausted eyes. He had dreamed of being locked in an ice cellar - so cold, without even Dream Girl from Tian Long Ba Bu to warm him, so he froze awake.
Upon waking, he was stunned. His surroundings completely defied expectations.
"Shouldn't I be lying in a hospital bed right now?!"
Xiao Q lifted his neck, moving his body, only to hear clanking sounds. Looking down, he saw black restraints around his neck, wrists and ankles, all connected by long, sturdy black chains to the wall.
Moreover, he realized he was lying on a cold concrete floor.
The only thing preventing complete panic was seeing Xiao Peng and Ke Bei nearby. Having company was always better than being alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: The Dog Man Actually Had an Owner!!!
chapters.content:
Of course, these two were still unconscious at the moment.
Xiao Q sat up on the floor and noticed the two people not far from him, also shackled with iron chains just like him.
"What the hell is going on here?!"
Xiao Q shouted in confusion while scanning his surroundings. He spotted a refrigerator and a freezer.
He saw the paused footage of the Dog Man on the living room TV.
He saw scattered discs on the TV cabinet.
At this point, it finally dawned on him—they were still in Room 1001.
"Xiao Peng! Ke Bei! Wake the hell up!!!"
Xiao Q shouted loudly, trying to rouse the two.
But it had no effect.So he yelled even louder: "Xiao Peng! Your girlfriend went out with another guy! She's cheating on you!!!"
This only took three shouts before Xiao Peng's body visibly reacted on the floor.
Then, Xiao Q turned to Ke Bei and shouted: "Ke Bei! They found your dad!!!"
This only took one shout before Ke Bei showed signs of stirring.
About five minutes later, the two groggily woke up.
Upon waking and seeing their situation and surroundings, they were just as bewildered as Xiao Q had been—utterly confused and disoriented.
"What the hell? Why am I still in this Dog Man's place? And what's with these shackles and chains?!"
Xiao Peng tugged at the black collar around his neck, trying to remove it, but after several attempts, it was futile.
Ke Bei also tried to free himself from the handcuffs and leg irons, but it was equally useless.
"Alright, stop wasting your energy. We've been played," Xiao Q said, sitting on the floor with a look of exasperation.
Xiao Peng grew agitated: "Played? By who?"
Xiao Q: "Think about who we saw last before we passed out. That's probably who got us."
Xiao Peng froze: "You mean that pretty woman and that doctor? Why would they do this to us?"
Xiao Q shrugged: "Don't ask me."
Ke Bei suddenly spoke up: "It's gone. My phone's gone, and so is the lockpick wire I had on me!!!"
Hearing this, Xiao Q and Xiao Peng checked themselves—their phones were missing too.
"What the hell?! Can someone explain what's going on?!"
Xiao Peng was losing it. He had just gotten through dealing with the Dog Man and was already imagining his bright, newly chaste future—only for this to happen.
Just then, the security door of Room 1001 opened from the outside.
Someone slowly walked in.
All three of them focused their gaze—who else could it be but that beautiful woman from Room 202?
"Oh? All three of you handsome boys are awake?"
Under the ceiling light, Su Mi's sweet smile looked eerily pale.
Xiao Peng yanked at the chains on his body and asked Su Mi: "Sis, did you do this to us?"
Su Mi blinked her big eyes and nodded.
Xiao Peng was baffled: "Why?"
Su Mi: "Haven't you ever heard a saying?"
Xiao Peng: "What saying?"
Su Mi smiled: "Even when beating a dog, you must consider its master. You killed my dog—how could I, as its owner, just stand by and do nothing?"
Her smile remained as charming as ever.
But to Xiao Q and the others, she was nothing but a demon wearing the skin of a beautiful woman.
"The Dog Man actually had an owner?! You're the Dog Man's owner?!"
Regardless of the others, Xiao Q was completely stunned by this revelation.
After Su Mi had entered earlier, he had suspected she might be the Dog Man's accomplice.
But her subsequent acting had successfully dispelled his doubts.
Now, after waking up and thinking it over, his first conclusion was that they had fallen victim to either Su Mi or the doctor.
He had considered the possibilities:
First: Su Mi and the doctor were the Dog Man's accomplices.
Second: Su Mi and the doctor had nothing to do with the Dog Man, but this apartment was either full of psychotic criminals or ordinary people. Su Mi and the doctor were just like the Dog Man—psychotic criminals.
But both guesses were wrong.
Who could have imagined that something as brutal as the Dog Man actually had an owner?
Then again, wasn’t it normal for a dog to have an owner? Even if this wasn’t a real dog.
"Since we're in your hands now, what do you plan to do with us? Kill us outright to avenge your dog?"
Bound tightly by the shackles and chains, Xiao Q had no choice but to stay calm.
"Oh no no no, how could I bear to kill you?"
Su Mi smiled coyly: "Since the three of you killed my pet, and now I have none... you three will just have to take its place and become my new dogs!"
At the first half of her words, Xiao Peng felt a flicker of relief—she wasn’t going to kill them. But the second half immediately crushed his spirits.
Xiao Q twitched his lips: "Become your dogs?"
Su Mi nodded: "Don’t worry, I’m a professional dog trainer. I’ll have you all as obedient as my last pet in no time."
She gave a light chuckle: "See how good I am to you? I even had the doctor treat all your injuries. And look at the living room now—isn’t it clean? I’ve given you a lovely living environment."
Only then did the three notice that their wounds had indeed been treated.
Moreover, the living room, previously wrecked from the fight, had been cleaned up—especially the Dog Man’s corpse, which was now gone.
All traces of blood and gore had been scrubbed away as if they had never existed.
Su Mi then brought over a bag of dog food from the corner.
From the open kitchen, she fetched six bowls.
She placed two bowls in front of each of them.
One bowl was filled with brown, pellet-like dog food, while the other was filled with water.
But she wasn’t done yet.
Su Mi also brought over three small plastic pet toilets and placed them in front of the trio.
The three were both speechless and furious.
Was she really planning to treat them like dogs?
At this moment, Su Mi smiled: "Oh, right—today’s a special occasion. Let me get you some dog treats."
She turned and went to a nearby cabinet to rummage for the snacks.
Whether by carelessness or design, Ke Bei was the closest to that cabinet.
And the length of his chains was just enough to reach it.
Seizing the opportunity, Ke Bei calculated the distance and launched a sudden attack, lunging at Su Mi to subdue her.
Xiao Q and Xiao Peng watched, hopeful.
They thought Su Mi had grown too complacent—did she really believe these shackles and chains made her untouchable?
But what happened next shocked them.
As if prepared, Su Mi reacted instantly—the sharp heel of her right shoe lashed out and struck Ke Bei square in the stomach as he pounced.
The kick sent him doubling over in pain, clutching his abdomen.
...
PS: Quick question—many readers have pointed out that the protagonist’s girlfriend, Wang Qingzhao, was introduced too abruptly earlier, and the "little yellow car" scene was especially jarring.
I’ve already deleted the "little yellow car" part. Now I’m wondering—should I revise the earlier parts where Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao’s relationship is established?
Change it from them being in a relationship to just remaining single? It wouldn’t affect the later plot anyway.
Oh, and a lot of people complained that Wang Qingzhao was initially portrayed as conservative, but then suddenly got together with the protagonist, which contradicted her character.
But actually, no—if you think about it, the "conservative" label was something Wang Qingzhao herself claimed.
Her behavior toward the protagonist and her ex is just a common social phenomenon these days:Thɪs ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
If she doesn’t like someone, no matter how much they do for her, she’ll find excuses to reject them.
But for someone she likes? Just how forward would she be?

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Zhang Le Announces Plans to Form a Band
chapters.content:
"Little Zhang Fei, you're being very naughty!"
Su Mi smiled faintly: "Since you're so disobedient, you won't get any snacks this time."
She pulled out two bags of dog treats from the cabinet and casually tossed them in front of Xiao Q and Xiao Peng.
She warned: "You two better not misbehave like Little Zhang Fei! If you make me angry as your owner, I'll sell you to the dog meat factory!"
A flash of cruelty passed through Su Mi's beautiful large eyes.
Then, her snow-white legs in black high heels click-clacked their way out of Room 1001.
Only Xiao Q and the other two remained in the room.
"Little Zhang Fei? I hate it when people call me that..."
Ke Bei's voice trembled as he spoke, unsure where exactly that kick had landed on him.
"Can't help it - your beard's too long and unshaven, plus those heavy sideburns."Xiao Q shrugged, though even that simple motion felt exhausting now.
His hands were firmly shackled, with the chains connected to the wall.
"Xiao Q, what should we do now?!"
Xiao Peng grew anxious - he didn't want to be treated like a dog!
Being trapped here meant no freedom, worse yet eating dog food, and using that tiny plastic toilet!!!
Their only consolation was that they didn't seem to be in immediate mortal danger.
Xiao Q: "Try shouting to see if anyone can hear us and come help."
Xiao Peng's eyes lit up, but after shouting himself hoarse, no one came.
Xiao Q sighed deeply: "Then there's nothing we can do but wait until someone notices we're missing and tries to find us."
Xiao Peng's eyes brightened again: "Right! Tomorrow's Monday - if we don't show up at school, people will notice! And my friends, especially Xiao Hua, will definitely come looking if they can't reach me!!!!"
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Hahahaha this is hilarious! Three people team up against the Dog Man only to fall into the "mantis stalks cicada, unaware of oriole behind" trap!!! All caught!!!!]
[But honestly, even us viewers with god perspective couldn't have guessed the Dog Man has an owner - and that it's that young woman Su Mi... Her acting was impeccable!!!]
Middle-aged Uncle: [You newcomers aren't the only ones surprised. I've been watching Far Neighbor for ages and never saw this coming either.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [How could you not know?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [I didn't start from the first round. When I began watching, there was never any connection shown between Su Mi and the Dog Man.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Oh I see!!! Let's see... This round's five lab rats: Jiang Ran, Xiao Q, Zhou Wu, Ke Bei, Li Mengmeng]
[Xiao Q and Ke Bei got caught immediately, Li Mengmeng was taken by that doctor - three out of five captured already. Does this count as elimination?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Not until death and official announcement by the host.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Then I'm confused - I heard each round lasts 7 days. If it requires death to count, what happens if by day 7 the three captives are still alive? Who wins?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Whoever remains free and uncaptured wins.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Uncle, do you think Xiao Q's group still has hope of escaping? I see the betting amounts show Xiao Q as second highest.]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Who knows? Anything can happen until the final moment.]
In a luxurious golden villa:
Diamond Bachelor, the beautiful long-legged woman, sat on the first floor's 2-million-yuan leather sofa, staring at the massive TV screen showing Xiao Q's trio shackled in Room 1001's living room.
Her exquisite eyebrows furrowed into a frown.
This round, her sixth sense had told her to bet on Xiao Q, yet by day 2 of round 26...
Her chosen lab rat was already captured.
Locked in Room 1001 as a dog.
If he couldn't escape in the coming days, it meant her bet would lose.
More importantly, it suggested her famously accurate sixth sense might be failing.
Round 25 - her intuition said Wang Xixi would survive, but Jiang Ran won.
Round 26 - her gut insisted Xiao Q would triumph, but... damn...
Growing increasingly frustrated, she grabbed a black remote and smashed it violently to the ground, shattering it to pieces.
The perpetrator then stomped angrily upstairs.
Day 3 of Round 26:
Jiang Ran took a day off from his online store customer service job for a pre-employment physical.
He felt confident about the exam since aside from his dissociative identity disorder, he was perfectly healthy.
Fortunately, the physical didn't include psychiatric evaluation.
He finished by noon and returned to Alice Apartment.
Though the results wouldn't be ready until the day after tomorrow, he ran into Manager Xiao Zhang in the lobby.
After inquiring about the physical and which hospital, Xiao Zhang pulled some strings to expedite the process.
Jiang Ran could get his results tomorrow.
With this arrangement, assuming no major issues, he could start his new job tomorrow.
That afternoon, Jiang Ran enjoyed rare downtime at home.
His relaxation method was simple - playing with his phone.
While scrolling through Douyin, his WeChat group kept buzzing with notifications.
Opening it, he saw someone had @-ed all residents in the Alice Apartment group again.Follow current novᴇls on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
It was Xiao Zhang initiating the @-all, but the actual announcement came from Zhang Le in Room 501.
Jiang Ran remembered Zhang Le - the music enthusiast who'd hit it off with Wang Xixi during the welcome party.
What was Zhang Le announcing?
First came a photo:
A complete set of band equipment:
Microphone, guitar, bass, drum set, keyboard.
The accompanying message explained he wanted to form a band, asking if any residents were interested. Musical experience preferred but not required - he could teach.
Jiang Ran had no interest. Hobbies required significant time and money - luxuries he lacked.
He was about to close WeChat when something about the instrument photo caught his eye.
Zooming in, he studied it more carefully.
After a moment, he muttered: "These instruments look... haunted."
"Why are they all bone-shaped?"
The longer he looked, the more inexplicably creeped out he became.
He quickly closed WeChat and returned to Douyin.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Xiao Peng Gets Beaten with a Baseball Bat
chapters.content:
Room 1001.
Nearly a full day and night had passed since Xiao Q and the other two were imprisoned here.
The three of them lay weakly on the cold floor, staring blankly at the white ceiling above.
"Has no one noticed we're missing? What about my teachers and classmates? My friends? What about Xiao Hua?"
Both Xiao Q and Xiao Peng among the three kept hoping someone would notice their sudden disappearance and come rescue them.
But after all this time, there hadn't been any signs of help.
Then, movement came from Room 1001's door.
The sound of the door being flung open, followed by the clicking of high heels on the floor.
None of them needed to look to know it was Su Mi from Room 202.
Su Mi entered Room 1001 and frowned slightly at seeing the three lying on the floor like dead dogs.A foul smell hung in the living room.
It came from the three tiny plastic toilets.
After nearly a full day, the three naturally had needed to relieve themselves.
With no access to a proper toilet, they had to use the plastic toilets - better than going on the floor.
Su Mi seemed pleased they'd used the plastic toilets.
Her attention then turned to the two bowls placed before each of them.
Two bowls:
One filled with dog food, the other with tap water.
The water bowls were mostly empty, one nearly drained completely.
But the dog food bowls remained untouched at the same level as when first filled.
Su Mi's delicate brows furrowed in displeasure. "Why aren't you eating? Not hungry?"
Xiao Peng immediately cursed: "You stupid bitch! You think we're dogs? That's not human food!"
Neither Xiao Peng nor the other two could bring themselves to eat dog food, though they'd reluctantly used the plastic toilets and drunk from the bowls.
"Tsk tsk tsk," Su Mi clicked her tongue. "Handsome, you're the best-looking of the three. I liked you most, but your mouth is so foul. Don't you know dogs shouldn't talk back to their owners?"
Xiao Peng responded with cold laughter.
Su Mi took out her phone and made a call.
About five minutes later, she opened Room 1001's door again.
Two minutes after that, the door closed once more.
Now two more people stood in the living room:
A middle-aged male doctor they'd seen yesterday.
And Li Mengmeng, the girl captured by the Dog Man yesterday.
Li Mengmeng wore black iron shackles that severely restricted her movement.
She seemed deeply traumatized, her former confidence completely gone, now meek and obedient.
"Good girl, go empty and clean those three plastic toilets," Su Mi ordered.
Li Mengmeng nodded obediently and complied.
Xiao Q and Ke Bei watched in shock, remembering how confident Li Mengmeng had been during the welcome party introduction. Whatever had happened to her in the past day must have been horrific to break her so completely.
While Li Mengmeng cleaned the toilets in the bathroom, Su Mi went to the bedroom and soon emerged carrying a baseball bat.
She walked up to Xiao Peng and swung the bat hard at his left arm.
Xiao Peng howled in pain.
"Fuck! You crazy bitch! Why hit me?!"
"Why? This is punishment for your foul mouth and disobedience, puppy. Endure it - it'll be over soon."
Su Mi swung again at the same arm.
This time Xiao Peng reacted quickly, grabbing the bat with his right hand.
He gripped tight with both hands, trying to wrest the bat away from Su Mi.
Seeing this, Xiao Q wanted to help, but then he noticed something strange - Su Mi was smiling despite the struggle.
Then he noticed the bat looked unusual - it seemed detachable, not one solid piece.
"Xiao Peng! Let go!" Xiao Q shouted, sensing danger.
But Xiao Peng, nearly winning the tug-of-war, only tightened his grip and pulled harder.
Su Mi suddenly yanked outward.
Like a rocket separating mid-launch, the bat split in two.
The section Xiao Peng held came free, sending him crashing face-first to the floor.
Su Mi now wielded a shorter bat, which she immediately used to beat the fallen Xiao Peng mercilessly.
Xiao Peng screamed for help, but the other two were chained and couldn't reach him.
Finally, Su Mi stopped, apparently deciding not to beat him to death.
"Punishment over," she said sweetly. "Good dogs behave. Don't talk back next time!"
With a smirk, she swayed out of Room 1001, bat in hand.Thɪs updatᴇd by NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
The doctor remained until Li Mengmeng returned with the cleaned toilets.
Before leaving, he examined Xiao Peng's injuries.
"You're lucky - no fractures, just bruises. Rest and you'll recover."
He tossed some ointment and bandages to Xiao Peng, who stared blankly at them, perhaps still dazed from the beating.
With that, the doctor left, Li Mengmeng obediently following.
Once again, the three were left alone in their misery.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid: "Damn! That sexy woman hits harder than she looks! She almost killed him!!!!"
Middle-aged Uncle: "What did you expect? Besides these lab rats, everyone in that apartment has a backstory worthy of a movie! None of them are saints!"

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Jiang Ran Becomes Assistant Manager
chapters.content:
Domineering Female CEO: [By the way, Ultimate Rich Kid, didn't you want those two sisters to accompany you last time? Those sisters are even more ruthless than this woman - at least this one's still alive, those two ended up dead!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Forget it, I don't want them anymore. Honestly, before watching this livestream, I couldn't imagine such psychos existed in this world... And the scary part is they're all so good-looking...]
Room 1001.
"Xiao Peng, are you okay?"
Xiao Q crawled toward Xiao Peng but still maintained some distance.
Xiao Peng flipped onto his back, sprawling on the floor while grimacing in pain: "I nearly got beaten to death - what do you think?"
"Ke Bei, they took away your wire, but can you use a strand of hair to pick these locks?"
All three had locked collars, handcuffs, and leg shackles with proper keyholes.
Ke Bei leaned against the wall, sighing: "Stop watching so many dramas."
Xiao Peng: "Then what about other items? Look around - isn't there anything in this room that could replace your lockpicking wire? I can't take this anymore! I need to escape!!!"Ke Bei sighed: "Already checked. Since they confiscated my wire, they obviously know I can pick locks and have taken precautions."
Xiao Peng picked up the ointment and bandages from the floor, silently tending to his wounds instead of responding.
...
Round 26, Day 4.
9:30 AM.
Jiang Ran received his medical report showing everything was normal.
Delighted, he returned to Alice Apartment and showed the report to Manager Xiao Zhang.
After reviewing it, Xiao Zhang produced an employment contract for Jiang Ran to sign.
Finding no issues after careful reading, Jiang Ran signed his name.
Manager Xiao Zhang then temporarily left to process Jiang Ran's onboarding paperwork, taking his ID card.
About half an hour later in the management office, Jiang Ran finally saw Xiao Zhang return.
The manager handed back Jiang Ran's ID card along with a photo ID badge and a set of sky-blue work uniforms.
"Alright, Mr. Jiang Ran. Starting today, you're the assistant manager of Alice Apartment."
"You can begin your duties immediately if you wish."Thɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Accepting the badge and uniform, Jiang Ran felt this was the smoothest job hunting experience he'd ever had.
While Jiang Ran was putting on his uniform, Manager Xiao Zhang announced his new position in the residents' group chat.
He specified that residents needing assistance could directly message Jiang Ran for help.
After Jiang Ran finished dressing, Xiao Zhang had him update his group chat display name with an "Assistant Manager" prefix.
Once everything was settled, Jiang Ran confirmed his responsibilities: "Xiao Zhang, so my job is just handling whatever residents need help with? That's it?"
Manager Xiao Zhang nodded: "Exactly. The assistant manager exists to fulfill residents' requests."
Jiang Ran asked: "When there are no requests, where should I stay?"
Manager Xiao Zhang smiled: "You can stay in the first-floor management office with me, or at your own apartment - it's flexible."
Jiang Ran's eyes brightened, increasingly impressed by this cushy job.
"Then I'll just stay at home?"
Manager Xiao Zhang replied: "Sure, no problem. Just respond promptly to requests."
"Oh, almost forgot."
The manager retrieved a logbook from a nearby cabinet.
"This is the work log. Record which unit you visited and what assistance you provided each day."
"That's everything for now. Let me know if you have questions."
Jiang Ran nodded.
Flipping through the blank logbook, he took the elevator back to Room 304.
Settling on his sofa, he immediately checked his phone.
His work notifications would now come through his phone instead of computer.
Most importantly - he needed to quit his online store customer service job!
The resignation went smoothly, though his final paycheck would come with the regular pay cycle.
After handling this, he noticed message notifications - someone had @mentioned him.
Unlocking his phone and opening WeChat, he saw a private message from Room 202's Su Mi.
Su Mi from 202: [Are you there? Handsome Jiang Ran, big sister needs your help - come quick!!!]
The name instantly reminded Jiang Ran of that alluring young woman with intoxicating perfume and an impossibly slender waist.
Exhaling deeply, he grabbed a ballpoint pen for the logbook before heading to Room 202.
At Room 202, the door opened immediately after he rang the bell.
There stood Su Mi, just as he remembered.
Today she wore a seductive purple dress that accentuated her curves, forcing Jiang Ran to maintain eye contact.
He dared not let his gaze wander lower.
Now that he was apartment staff, getting reported for inappropriate staring would be disastrous.
"Ah, you're finally here!"
Su Mi enthusiastically pulled Jiang Ran inside, practically dragging him into Room 202.
Standing in the living room, Jiang Ran maintained professionalism: "Miss Su Mi, how may I assist you?"
Su Mi playfully punched his chest with a delicate fist.
"So stuffy! Just became assistant manager and already talking so formally?"
"Fine, I'll stop teasing. Handsome, I need you to take two large trash bags from my bedroom to the apartment dumpsters."
"Oh, just trash? No problem."
Relieved, Jiang Ran entered the bedroom.
The room carried the same floral fragrance as Su Mi herself.
His eyes first landed not on trash, but on the bed covered with...
Su Mi's intimate apparel.
Each piece more provocative than the last, enough to make anyone blush.
Jiang Ran averted his gaze, scanning the room: "Where's the trash?"
Su Mi pointed to two large patterned duffel bags in the corner - the kind meant for moving blankets.
"You use these for trash? What's inside? They're surprisingly heavy."
Jiang Ran had expected regular trash bags.
No wonder he hadn't noticed - Su Mi used massive duffels instead.
Grabbing one by its handles, he was shocked by its inexplicable weight.
