chapters.title: Chapter 72: Manager Xiao Zhang's Upcoming Matchmaking Event
chapters.content:
"Guess what?"
Su Mi blinked her big eyes playfully.
Jiang Ran replied, "I don't want to guess, and I don't care what garbage is inside these bags. I'm just throwing them away."
He had no idea what was inside the two large duffel bags.
They were extremely heavy.
Jiang Ran estimated one weighed around 100 pounds, while the other was about 140-150 pounds, both bulging at the seams.
Carrying them was out of the question. Fortunately, Room 202 and the hallway outside were fully tiled, making it easy to drag them along.
So Su Mi walked beside him, watching as Jiang Ran pulled the two heavy bags.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Jiang Ran would never guess that one bag contains that skinny monkey-like man who was killed by the Dog Man in 602, while the other holds the Dog Man himself...]All viewers had a god's-eye perspective of the live stream.
They naturally knew what was inside those duffel bags.
After all, they'd witnessed everything.
After the skinny man and Dog Man died,
Su Mi had brought the doctor to clean up both crime scenes.
While the scenes were cleaned,
the two bodies remained unprocessed.
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Hey fellow viewers, I'm curious - doesn't Su Mi want to train Jiang Ran as her pet dog? She keeps flirting with him.]
Domineering Female CEO: [Who knows? You'd have to ask Su Mi directly for that answer.]
[I've been watching this stream twice as long as Middle-aged Uncle. I've never seen Su Mi commit any crimes. The stream organizers' resident profile on her is extremely brief - just three words: Dog Trainer. Nothing else...]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [I can't find anything about her online either. I'd love to know her background!]
Domineering Female CEO: [Like I said, sign the agreement, move into the apartment as a new resident, and go ask her yourself.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [...]
Under Su Mi's supervision, Jiang Ran finally dragged both heavy bags to the large trash bin outside the apartment building.
For the apartment's resident criminals, disposing of bodies was simple - just toss them in these bins, and the apartment would handle the cleanup.
"Thanks, handsome. Come by my place sometime for coffee."
Su Mi blew Jiang Ran a kiss before sauntering off in her high heels.
Jiang Ran turned his head to notice Manager Xiao Zhang from the management office had been stealing glances at Su Mi the whole time she was present.
He particularly noticed Xiao Zhang's gaze frequently lingering on her hips - apparently the manager's particular preference.
"Su Mi from 202 disposed of garbage. Assisted her with two large duffel bags."
Jiang Ran recorded these words on the work log in the management office.
Manager Xiao Zhang watched while munching sunflower seeds, then suddenly asked, "Jiang Ran, don't you think Su Mi is gorgeous? So seductive?"
Jiang Ran realized that if he were still just a regular resident, Xiao Zhang would never speak to him like this.
But now, as an assistant manager and Xiao Zhang's colleague, things were different.
"Beautiful," Jiang Ran replied.
Manager Xiao Zhang sighed: "If I could sleep with her just once, I'd give up living in a mansion and driving a Bentley!!!"
Jiang Ran said dryly, "Stop dreaming. If you had that wealth, you could get her. But in reality, women like that belong to the rich."
Manager Xiao Zhang sighed deeply: "Yeah, money solves everything! By the way, Jiang Ran, do you have a girlfriend?"
Jiang Ran: "No."
Manager Xiao Zhang: "You don't? Perfect timing! The apartment might hold its first matchmaking event soon. Will you come? It's my initiative - I need everyone's support!!!"
Jiang Ran waved his hand: "Thanks but no thanks. I appreciate the thought, but count me out."
Matchmaking in this place would just pair him with monsters and demons.
A shadow flickered through Xiao Zhang's eyes at this refusal.
Suddenly, Jiang Ran froze momentarily.
When Manager Xiao Zhang asked what was wrong, he claimed it was nothing, then took the work log and left the office.
"That's strange," Jiang Ran muttered to himself. "Why did the Danger Warning System suddenly jump from +4 to +5?"
Though Jiang Ran usually ignored the Danger Warning System bound to him,
it continued operating regardless, constantly adding points and disturbing his thoughts.
Just being in Alice Apartment triggered continuous alerts: [Detected host in dangerous zone. Evacuate immediately! Points +5, Points +5...]
These point notifications never stopped.
But when encountering certain individuals, the warnings changed.
For example, when meeting responsible security captain Xiao Gao:
[Detected dangerous individual. Evacuate immediately. Points +3, Points +3...]
The old man from 301 consistently gave +5 points.
Qin Kelian gave +8 points.
Her elder sister Qin Yi, whom he'd met once, triggered [Extremely dangerous individual. Points +9].
And just now, while interacting with Manager Xiao Zhang:Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs
[Detected dangerous individual. Evacuate immediately. Points +4, Points +4...]
Then it suddenly jumped to [Points +5, Points +5...], hence his momentary freeze.
Now that he'd left Xiao Zhang, it reverted to:
[Detected host in dangerous zone. Evacuate immediately. Points +5, Points +5...]
Though Jiang Ran considered the system unreliable,
its behavior was peculiar.
With some people, like those college students including Xiao Q, it gave no warnings at all.
But with others like those mentioned above, warnings persisted.
Take Su Mi earlier:
[Detected extremely dangerous individual. Evacuate immediately. Points +9, Points +9, Points...]
Higher points indicated greater danger.
But were these people truly dangerous?
"What nonsense! I clearly remember the system warning that Qin Kelian drugged my tea, but she drank it herself to prove it was clean! She even served me tea twice after that!"
Thinking of this, Jiang Ran's face darkened... He decided to let the system keep malfunctioning!
Other protagonists' systems helped them soar, while his just malfunctioned, forcing him to keep working.
What kind of transmigrator with a system still had to slave away?
Absolutely ridiculous!
As these thoughts crossed his mind, his phone rang.
He'd recently changed his settings from silent to ringtone for work purposes.
Someone was messaging him on WeChat again.
Coincidentally, it was a private message from someone in the residents' group chat - a very familiar face.
Well, not his familiar face, but the original Jiang Ran's - intimately familiar.
Shen Xing from 404: [Jiang Ran, come upstairs. I need help with something.]
Indeed, this "old acquaintance" was his ex-girlfriend Shen Xing.
"Sigh..."
Jiang Ran sighed. He had no choice but to go up.
What surprised him was that while he lived in 304, Shen Xing coincidentally lived in 404?

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Zhou Wu's Downfall
chapters.content:
They arrived at apartment 404.
The doorbell rang.
The door opened quickly.
Shen Xing, dressed in light pink loungewear, ushered Jiang Ran inside.
After entering, Jiang Ran glanced around at Shen Xing's apartment decor and commented:
"Your place is nicely decorated."
Shen Xing smiled: "This came pre-furnished with the apartment. The style happened to match my taste, so I chose this place."
Jiang Ran nodded: "I see. So, why did you ask me to come up here?"
"Have a seat first, no need to be in such a hurry..."
Shen Xing cooed at Jiang Ran playfully.Jiang Ran looked at the woman before him with an ambiguous smile: "That fiancé boyfriend of yours, Zhou Wu, isn't home right?"
"Nope, he's out. Why do you ask?"
Jiang Ran shook his head with a laugh: "That's what I figured. If he were home, would you dare invite your ex up like this? And act this way with me?"
"Oh, my Jiang Ran is so clever!"
Shen Xing playfully pulled Jiang Ran to sit on the sofa, then nestled closely beside him.
Seeing this, Jiang Ran frowned: "Shen Xing, what exactly do you want from me?"
Shen Xing teased: "Guess~"
Jiang Ran sighed: "No idea."
Shen Xing: "I just missed you after so long and wanted to chat!"
Her sugary sweet tone made Jiang Ran even more exasperated. He could practically see a bright green hat being meticulously woven by deft hands to place atop Zhou Wu's head.
Suddenly remembering something, Jiang Ran asked: "By the way, that morning you called me crying about being dumped - that was fake, right? What was your real purpose that day?"
He clearly remembered - she had called crying about a breakup one day, then appeared at that small class reunion with Zhou Wu the very next day. What kind of absurd situation was that?
"Right, I just missed you that day and made up an excuse to get you to come see me. But you were so cruel, you wouldn't even come!"
"Forget about last time - just talking about today, if Zhou Wu finds out, you'll be in deep trouble. Forget about becoming a rich wife, you might get beaten black and blue. If that pretty face gets damaged, good luck finding another sugar daddy."
Jiang Ran mocked.
"As long as he doesn't find out! Jiang Ran, truth is I never liked Zhou Wu. Not only is he less handsome than you, he barely lasts two and a half minutes in bed - nowhere near as good as you. If not for his money, I'd never be with him."
"Jiang Ran, I've missed you so much. Let's get back together! Of course I won't break up with Zhou Wu - his money can support us. We'll keep our relationship secret, then when I get pregnant with your child, he can raise it for us! Doesn't that sound perfect?"
"Tempted by this wonderful life?"
"Doesn't this satisfy male possessiveness?"
"Isn't this every man's dream? No responsibility, no child support, just some fool footing the bill? Doesn't that sound amazing?"
Staring at Shen Xing's beautiful face, Jiang Ran suddenly felt pity for his original self. Having inherited the original's memories, he knew exactly what kind of person Shen Xing was.
During college - innocent, romantic, naive - the epitome of a pure first love.
After graduation - gradually transforming, becoming materialistic and increasingly unhinged.
If the original Jiang Ran were still alive to see how far Shen Xing had fallen, even contemplating such schemes... would he regret working himself to death trying to prove himself after their breakup? After all, this Shen Xing was no longer the pure girl he once loved.
"Enough, Shen Xing. Drop this idea - I have zero interest in your plan."
Though Jiang Ran had inherited the original's body, memories, everything - he wasn't that person anymore. He felt nothing for Shen Xing now. At most, he wanted to maintain distant acquaintances - no messy entanglements.
Besides, Shen Xing was clearly trouble. Getting involved would only bring future headaches. And what was her real motive today? He didn't buy her sudden affection - this woman only cared about money now. Men were just ATMs to her.
Having said his piece, Jiang Ran prepared to leave.
"You're leaving?"
"Take out the trash on your way out."
Shen Xing's voice turned icy with clear anger.
Jiang Ran shook his head, gladly taking her trash as he left.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Meanwhile...
On a highway elsewhere, Shen Xing's boyfriend Zhou Wu was speeding in a Maybach. His usual ride was a $30k Mercedes, but this Maybach (originally $300k+) was his father's business car - only brought out for important meetings to maintain appearances.
Since his father's disappearance, Zhou Wu had commandeered the luxury vehicle as his personal ride. Now he floored the accelerator, the black Maybach weaving through traffic like an assassin. Not that he was skilled - other drivers automatically gave way to the luxury car. Even so, Zhou Wu kept rolling down his window to curse at other drivers.
His terrible mood stemmed from a meeting hours earlier at the textile factory. With his father missing, Zhou Wu had attempted to take over as head of the factory. But all other shareholders unanimously opposed.
Originally, his father had held majority stake - absolute authority. But now with him missing (not confirmed dead), the shares couldn't transfer yet. Until then, Zhou Wu had zero shares and zero say.
The shareholders weren't being difficult - they simply didn't trust Zhou Wu. The spoiled rich kid who barely showed up to work, always chasing women. They weren't about to let him gamble with their livelihoods. Even his father only maintained control by consistently making them money.
Denied his birthright, Zhou Wu was furious beyond words.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Zhou Wu and the Young Security Guard
chapters.content:
"These old bastards, just wait until I inherit my father's shares! I'll make sure they regret crossing me!"
"And that damned father of mine - if he wanted to die, he should have done it properly! What's this nonsense about disappearing?!"
Zhou Wu drove back to Alice Apartment in a rage. His car got stuck outside the automatic barrier gate.
His Mercedes-Benz had been registered with Alice Apartment's system, so the barrier would automatically open when it arrived. But this Maybach was visiting Alice Apartment for the first time and hadn't been registered yet.
Though he'd owned the car for several days, he'd spent all that time using it to pick up women instead of returning home. What about being engaged? Who said engaged men couldn't see other women?
Impatient, Zhou Wu leaned on the horn for a full ten seconds, the loud "beep beep beep" echoing continuously. But the barrier arm remained stubbornly down.
Already in a foul mood, Zhou Wu grew even angrier at this delay. He rolled down his window and stuck his head out, bellowing toward the luxurious security booth to his left:
"Are you all dead or what?"
"I've been honking forever and this damn thing won't open!"
"Where the hell are you people? Are you all deaf?!"Though crude, his shouting had an effect. Soon, a young man in his twenties emerged from the security booth.
The young man had average looks and wore a security uniform. What stood out most was the brilliant smile plastered across his face - as if he'd just won the lottery jackpot.
"Hello sir, my apologies. I heard you but couldn't open the gate right away - I was using the restroom," the young man explained cheerfully.
Normally, Zhou Wu would have let such an explanation slide - everyone has bodily needs. But in his current furious state, he immediately tore into the young guard:
"Using the toilet? What about the other guards? Don't tell me they're all taking a shit too?!"
"You're all taking our residents' money while slacking off! Believe me, I'll file a complaint and get your ass fired!"
"Terribly sorry, sir. The other guards are all on patrol with Captain Gao. I'm the only one here right now," the young man replied, his smile never faltering, as if it had been borrowed and he was reluctant to return it.
Zhou Wu glared. "Enough! Just open the damn gate already!"
The young guard remained pleasant. "Of course. Please just complete this visitor vehicle registration first."
This request detonated Zhou Wu's temper like a bomb. Spittle flew from his mouth onto the young guard's face as he screamed:
"Are you mentally deficient?!"
"I'm a resident here! This Maybach is mine! Why the hell would I need visitor registration?!"
"I'm reporting you for sure! No common sense at all! Couldn't you tell I'm a resident from how I was talking?!"
As the young guard endured this tirade, a muscular security guard in his thirties noticed the commotion and hurried over. It was Captain Gao.
After assessing the situation, Captain Gao immediately apologized to Zhou Wu: "Our deepest apologies, sir. This young man is new and hasn't memorized all our residents' information yet. Let me get that gate open for you right away."
Captain Gao practically kowtowed to Zhou Wu as he ushered him through. Even after passing through, Zhou Wu deliberately paused his car, leaning out the window to shout:
"Next time, you're fired!!!"
Then his car disappeared around a corner.
Once Zhou Wu was gone, Captain Gao simply said, "I'll continue my patrol. You stay at the booth." He didn't reprimand the young guard over the incident before leaving on his rounds.
Now alone, the young guard looked up at the sky - a brilliant blue with layers of white clouds like a thousand waves. He smiled broadly at the heavens:
"Mom... I saw someone discard their smile again today..."

After parking, Zhou Wu returned to Room 404 where his fiancée Shen Xing greeted him with a hug and kiss. Noticing his dark expression, she asked what was wrong. When he explained about the factory shareholders blocking him from taking over his father's position, Shen Xing immediately deployed her girlfriend skills to comfort him, gradually easing his anger.
As a wealthy second-generation heir, Zhou Wu had dated many beautiful women. Why did he ultimately choose Shen Xing as his fiancée? Simple reasons:
Shen Xing had top-tier looks and figure - mandatory requirements for any girlfriend. Shen Xing excelled at providing emotional support. Shen Xing was smart and knew her place. Even if she caught Zhou Wu dating others, she'd pretend not to notice - giving him absolute freedom. Thus Zhou Wu chose Shen Xing. Maybe she wasn't the most beautiful woman he'd dated, but considering all factors combined, she was undoubtedly number one. She just made him comfortable.
Like now - when those shareholders had him boiling with rage, Shen Xing immediately became the perfect soothing presence to cool him down.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Zhou Wu Gets Captured
chapters.content:
After his temper subsided, Zhou Wu gazed at Shen Xing's graceful figure and immediately felt that certain urge.
He picked up Shen Xing and carried her into the bedroom.
About five minutes passed.
After they finished, Zhou Wu lay on the bed, eyes closed, resting as he spoke:
"Baby, I was thinking of selling this place and buying another one somewhere else. What do you think?"
Shen Xing froze at his words and asked, "Honey, why?"
Zhou Wu sighed. "Well, I didn’t expect your ex-boyfriend to live here too!"
Shen Xing’s eyes reddened, looking pitiful and fragile:
"So what you're implying is that just because my ex lives here, I’ll reconnect with him? Rekindle old flames?"
"Do you... do you really not trust me at all?"Her voice trembled as tears streamed down her face like pear blossoms in the rain.
Seeing her cry, Zhou Wu immediately embraced her, pulling her delicate form close. "No, no, it’s not that I don’t trust you. Your loyalty to me is beyond question. It’s your ex I don’t trust. I’m afraid that since we live so close, he might take advantage when I’m not home and harass you, you know?"
"Besides, this place is fine for now, but once we have kids, it’ll be too small."
"Oh, I see... Alright then, honey, let’s sell it and buy a new place!"
This was what Zhou Wu loved about Shen Xing—she was always so obedient to his decisions.
"Mhm, I’ll call a realtor tomorrow, my dear wife."
The two continued their intimate embrace.
Time ticked by.
Soon, it was midnight.
The world was silent, the night sky pitch black, with only streetlights shining brightly.
In Alice Apartment, a shadowy figure moved like a ghost, footsteps utterly silent.
When the light caught him briefly, it became clear—he wasn’t wearing shoes, walking barefoot, which explained the silence.
He took the elevator, slowly ascending from the first floor to the fourth.
Upon arrival, he walked down the hallway, gaze fixed ahead.
Finally, he stopped at the very last door—404.
In front of 404, he pulled a key from his pocket.
The key slid into the lock.
*Click.* The door opened.
Quietly, he pushed it ajar, slipped inside, and gently closed it behind him.
The room was dark, illuminated only by faint moonlight.
In that dim glow, his small but piercing eyes gleamed with intensity.
After a quick scan of the living room, he headed straight for the bedroom.
The bedroom door was ajar. He entered.
Step by silent step, he approached the bed.
Then, like a statue in an art studio, he stood motionless beside it.
It was unclear what he was doing—perhaps confirming how many people were on the bed, their exact positions?
Finally, after five minutes of stillness, he moved.
From his coat, he pulled out a transparent vacuum-sealed bag.
He opened it, retrieving a cloth handkerchief.
Then, he pressed it firmly against the left person’s nose and mouth for several minutes.
Afterward, he repeated the process with the right person.
Once done, he stuffed both the bag and handkerchief back into his pants pocket.
Next, he lifted the right person’s upper body, propping them halfway up, then turned them to face the edge of the bed.
Bending down, he hoisted the person onto his back.
Even with the added weight, his steps remained steady—carrying someone posed no difficulty.
With the person on his back, he exited the bedroom, left 404, and closed the door behind him.
Then, he melted into the shadows.
Gone without a trace.
**Round 26, Day 5.**
**Apartment 404.**
"Ugh, why does my head hurt so much? And I feel nauseous... Could I be pregnant?"
Shen Xing, clad in a pink satin nightgown, woke up feeling unwell—especially her head, which throbbed dizzily.
Blinking sleepily, she reached for her phone on the nightstand.
The time read **9:30 AM.**
The number jolted her fully awake, erasing all remnants of drowsiness.
Unlike most young people, Shen Xing was an early riser.
She usually woke by 6 AM, 7 at the latest.
Afterward, she’d freshen up, exercise for 30-60 minutes to maintain her figure, shower, then make breakfast for herself and Zhou Wu.
Following that, she’d tidy up the house.
Though she’d inexplicably overslept today, it wasn’t a big deal—Zhou Wu was a notorious late sleeper, often staying in bed till 11 AM when he had nothing to do.
"Mmm... honey?"
She intended to wake him with some morning affection, but when she glanced to the right side of the bed—Zhou Wu wasn’t there.
"Already up? This early?"
Recalling his mention of factory business yesterday, she assumed he’d left for work.
Just then, she spotted his phone on his nightstand.
"Huh? He forgot his phone?"
Stretching her neck, she slipped on her slippers and called out while walking to the living room:
"Honey? Are you here?"
Silence.
"Must’ve gone to the factory and left his phone. Still upset from yesterday, I guess."
Shrugging it off, she headed to wash up.
**Alice Apartment, 1st Floor.**
This floor housed no tenants—only staff.
The manager, security guards, cleaners.
Its layout also differed from the upper floors.
Here, there were many single-occupancy rooms.
Though cramped, each had a toilet, shower, and a small kitchenette (electric stoves only).
Right now, in one such room...
The furnishings were sparse:
A bed, a massive wardrobe taking up half the space, and a brown wooden chair.
Nothing else of note.
On that chair sat a man in his twenties.
But something was very wrong.Follow current novels on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
His hands, feet, torso, and legs were tightly bound to the chair with rope.
His head hung low, as if asleep.
But he seemed about to wake up.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Zhou Wu Wakes Up, Shocked
chapters.content:
The man in his twenties kept nodding his head slightly, again and again.
Finally, the frequency increased until his head lifted completely.
Even before opening his eyes, his mouth moved first:
"Ouch, damn, why does my head feel so dizzy? And my whole body aches strangely?"
The man yawned several times, took a moment to recover, then opened his eyes crusted with sleep.
At first, he showed no reaction upon opening his eyes.
After several dozen seconds, he suddenly turned his head, staring bewildered at the completely unfamiliar surroundings.
Utterly confused, he muttered: "What's going on? Where is this? Am I still asleep and dreaming?"
Instinctively trying to stand up, the man then discovered to his horror that he couldn't move at all. Looking down, he saw his entire body tightly bound with thick rural-style hemp ropes used for tying pigs.
Only his head remained free, his neck unbound.So this explained the earlier pain.
"I must still be dreaming."
"This dream feels unusually real."
The man then bit his tongue hard with his teeth.
Attempting to wake himself from the dream.
He'd seen this trick often in TV dramas - experiencing pain in a dream would make you wake up.
The pain came, but the scene before him remained unchanged.
"Xing Xing? Are you there?"
The bound man called for his girlfriend.
No response.
"Anyone here?"
He shouted again, but still no response.
Finally, panic appeared on his face as he realized he seemed to be in some room.
A completely unfamiliar room with only himself inside.
He clearly remembered - his last conscious memory was falling asleep at home with his girlfriend in his arms!
How could everything change just by opening his eyes?
Where the hell was this place?!
An uncontrollable sense of panic arose in him, though fortunately: the door stood directly in front of him.
He tried to tiptoe and move with the chair to escape this utterly strange place.
But then he discovered his captors were truly insane - even his ankles were bound.
Not just his calves and thighs as he'd initially thought.
Yet he didn't give up, still attempting to move. If he couldn't shuffle slowly with his feet, he'd hop.
Planting his feet firmly, his posture now resembled an elementary student carrying an oversized backpack.
With a small hop forward, he immediately fell flat on his face.
"Ahhhh! Fuck! Is anyone here?! Where the hell is this?!"
Zhou Wu finally lost patience, roaring at the top of his lungs.
As if heaven took pity, his screams finally received a response.
The door opposite him moved as someone pushed it open from outside.
Currently lying sideways on the ground, Zhou Wu had a perfect view of who entered.
"It's you?!"
Zhou Wu exclaimed in disbelief.
He never imagined the person entering would be that young security guard he'd encountered yesterday when driving his Maybach home!!!
Though Zhou Wu was a pleasure-seeking rich second-generation, he wasn't stupid.
Considering the current situation, he quickly pieced together what must have happened.
"Impressive. You're the one who tied me up here?"
Earlier Zhou Wu had been quite panicked, not knowing who had bound him here or what was happening.
But seeing it was yesterday's young security guard, he immediately calmed down completely, acting as if nothing was wrong. As if considering the other just a minor character who wouldn't dare harm him.
The young security guard entered and sat on the bed, smiling at Zhou Wu: "Yes, it was me."
Zhou Wu asked: "Where is this place?"
Young guard: "Where I live."
Zhou Wu: "Specifically?"
Young guard: "Alice Apartment first floor. These are single rooms for staff members."
A strange expression crossed Zhou Wu's face: "You've got balls. Kidnapping someone and not even taking them somewhere remote, but bringing them right here."
The young guard kept smiling without responding.
Zhou Wu then asked: "Last night around 10pm, I fell asleep. I want to know when exactly you moved me here?"
The young guard answered like a Q&
A machine: "After midnight."
After some thought, Zhou Wu said: "How did you get into my home? And moving me here - there's no way I could have slept through that without waking up?"
Zhou Wu truly only remembered falling asleep and now waking up - nothing in between.
Young guard: "First question - I'm security staff here. Your apartment's renovations and smart locks were all installed by the building. You never changed them. So getting a key was simple, no?"
"As for your second question - normally moving a sleeping person without waking them would require incredibly deep sleep. Most people would wake up, so I didn't take chances. I used inhalational anesthetic on both you and your girlfriend. When you woke up, didn't you feel dizzy and nauseous? That's proof of the anesthetic."
Zhou Wu suddenly understood.
No wonder he hadn't woken during the move - he knew he couldn't possibly sleep that deeply!The source of thɪs content is N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
"Wait - how could a mere security guard get hold of inhalational anesthetic?"
This doubt first arose in Zhou Wu's mind.
But hearing the guard had also drugged his girlfriend Shen Xing, Zhou Wu's face immediately darkened.
A terrible premonition surfaced.
Completely forgetting about the anesthetic issue, he now worried only about his girlfriend.
The young guard smiled, seeming to read Zhou Wu's thoughts: "Don't worry, I did nothing to your girlfriend. My target was only you - I don't involve innocents."
Hearing this, Zhou Wu stared into the guard's eyes and temporarily believed him. Those eyes looked exceptionally sincere, and besides, the man had no reason to lie given Zhou Wu's current helpless state.
Zhou Wu then sneered: "You said I'm your target?"
"Just because I yelled at you yesterday? So you're holding a grudge and kidnapped me?"
The young guard kept smiling: "That's part of it, but not the main reason. Yesterday's incident just established a karmic connection between us."
Despite this explanation, Zhou Wu remained absolutely convinced this was simple revenge for yesterday's scolding.
Zhou Wu snorted disdainfully: "Listen, forget about revenge. I admit I was in a bad mood yesterday and you happened to catch the worst of it."
"That you actually kidnapped me for revenge - I'll admit I'm surprised you had the capability."
"But let me tell you - the most you can do is yell at me, humiliate me, maybe hit me to vent."
"Have you considered what comes after?"
"First the police will hunt you down, then you'll lose your job."

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Zhou Wu’s Sugar-Coated Bombshell, The Story of the Young Security Guard
chapters.content:
"Honestly, there’s no need for this. We’re all adults here;
don’t act like a seventeen or eighteen-year-old seeking petty revenge."
"How about this, I did wrong to you yesterday."
"How much do you make a month? Five thousand? Eight thousand? Or ten thousand?"
"Forget it, I’ll just give you ten thousand directly as compensation."
"Now, hurry up and let me go. I’ll pretend none of this ever happened, how about that?"
Zhou Wu’s mouth was parched from talking so much. Especially since his whole body was tied up uncomfortably. Once he was untied, he definitely had to move around properly.
As for whether he would really pretend none of this happened after escaping?
Hahaha, who would believe that?
Once he got free, not only would he make sure this young security guard got fired, but he’d also find people to put him behind bars!
Of course, before prison, he’d gather some thugs to beat him up badly.Then, he’d find some gay guys to assault him.
Damn it! You don’t know the terror of sleeping soundly at night, then waking up the next morning in a strange place, tied up tightly all over your body!
Zhou Wu, the spoiled young master, had never experienced being kidnapped since childhood!
Especially since the kidnapper was just a little security guard he never took seriously!
At this moment, facing Zhou Wu’s tempting words, the young security guard was still smiling, maintaining a standardized warm smile.
When Zhou Wu kept asking if he agreed to let him go, the young guard changed the subject:
"I want to answer that question last."
"First, can I tell you my story?"
Zhou Wu almost couldn’t help but curse again, but thinking he was weak now and couldn’t anger the other party, he nodded in agreement.
The young security guard then calmly began to tell his story in a steady tone:
"My name is Xiao Xing. I was raised by my father;
I’ve only seen my mother in photos."
"My dad and my grandparents told me my mom died."
"But the neighbors said my mom ran away secretly one night because she couldn’t stand my dad’s domestic violence and the whole family’s bullying."
"I have been my dad’s punching bag since I was little. My grandparents have several sons and daughters. My uncles and aunts don’t like me. Their kids, my cousins, bully me too."
"My grandparents treated me the same way."
"I dropped out in the second year of middle school. My dad wouldn’t let me continue. He got me a job washing dishes at his friend’s restaurant."
"The restaurant owner also bullied me, paid me very little every month, used me as if I were three people, making me do all the dirty, hard work, and handed my wages directly to my dad."
"Later, two kids about my age came to the restaurant, a boy and a girl."
"They were my only two friends at the restaurant."
"I had a crush on the girl, and she agreed to date me."
"But shortly after, the boy took her away."
"Not only that, the two of them, along with others at the restaurant, started bullying me."
"Finally, one day, I couldn’t take it anymore."Follow current novels on
"One day when the restaurant was less crowded, I stole some money and ran away."
"I ran to a city far from the one where I was born and lived."
"In that city, I could start over. I wanted to work hard, save money, and then find my mom."
"I found a job in that city."
"It was at a car wash. I became a car washer."
"Because I was young, they bullied me again, paying me only two-thirds of a normal car washer’s wage, sometimes even less for several months."
"Later, I saved enough money and set off to find the mom I’d only seen in photos."
"I searched for a long time and ran out of money."
"Fortunately, heaven favors those who are determined. I finally found my mom."
"I thought I would have a happy life from then on. My mom would definitely love me."
"But what I never expected was that she had already started a new family. She told me not to look for her anymore. Even if I did, she wouldn’t acknowledge me. In the end, she gave me ten yuan to buy a boxed meal and sent me away."
"At that time, I was very confused, but I was out of money and had to work, or else I would starve."
"Later, I found another car wash in the city where my mom lived and worked there."
"This time, the owner was very kind and always smiled. He was a middle-aged man."
"But unfortunately, he was immigrating, leaving the country to develop abroad to give his child a better environment."
"Before leaving, he gave me a book called ‘Smile at Everything.’ The very first sentence in the book was: ‘Smile at everything. Smiling can improve your luck, so smile as much as you can!’"
"After that, I learned from this book, got rid of my constant frowning, and always kept smiling."
"But later, my smile didn’t bring me good luck. The people and things I encountered afterward were all bad."
At this moment, young security guard Xiao Xing still wore a smile on his face.
But that smile, warm and harmonious on the surface, somehow gave off a cold, eerie feeling behind the scenes.
Zhou Wu had grown impatient listening to Xiao Xing’s life story so far.
He didn’t care to listen to others recount their life stories unless they were beautiful women.
So he interrupted, but Xiao Xing ignored him and continued explaining his story:
"Later on, I worked at an art gallery. The owner there was a painter."
"I got along pretty well with him. He was kind, the second person to treat me well besides the car wash owner who gave me the book. To my surprise, he had also read that book ‘Smile at Everything,’ and thought it made a lot of sense."
"I told him my own story, how I kept smiling, but life was still terrible."
"He said I hadn’t found what truly made me happy yet. So my smile was only superficial and couldn’t change my life."
"Then, he showed me what made him happy."
"I thought it would be painting, since he was a painter."
"But it wasn’t."
"He took me to a secret place where I witnessed something shocking."
"That secret place had so many beautiful women."
"But they were like sculptures, completely motionless. I thought they were lifelike wax figures I’d seen on my phone, but he let me touch them, and I realized they weren’t wax figures. They were like living people."
"He said this was his treasure trove."
"He said people age, and to keep people forever at their most beautiful age, he turned these beautiful women into specimens."
"He asked me to try making a specimen of something I liked."
"Of course, making a specimen of a person is very costly, so he recommended I start with small things."

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Would You Like to See My Collection?
chapters.content:
"I've thought about it for a long time, and finally embarked on this path of collecting."
"Would you like to see my collection?"
Zhou Wu's lips were twitching uncontrollably now.
At first, he thought Xiao Xing was recounting his own tragic experiences.
But then suddenly, there was talk about some painter and turning people into specimens?
He wondered, had Xiao Xing been reading too many web novels?
Had he lost his mind?
Who did he think he was scaring?
Did he think Zhou Wu was some timid woman who'd be easily frightened?
In Zhou Wu's opinion, Xiao Xing was just making up these stories to extort more money!"Sure, show me your collection."
Zhou Wu didn't mind giving him a bit more money - once he was free again, this guy was dead anyway.
As for seeing his collection?
What could a poor bastard possibly have collected?
Just wait until Zhou Wu exposed this ridiculous story about a "collection."
Xiao Xing looked delighted when Zhou Wu agreed.
He immediately walked over to the massive cabinet that occupied half the tiny room.
Though Zhou Wu hadn't been tied up here for long, he'd already noticed how oddly out of place this cabinet looked.
It was simply too big for this cramped space - like housing a giant Buddha statue in a tiny temple.
The cabinet had double doors that slid open sideways.
Equipped with wheels at the bottom, they could be opened with minimal effort.
Xiao Xing pulled them open quickly, unlike those collectors who make a big dramatic production out of revealing their treasures.
But given the cabinet's size, he couldn't expose everything at once - the central section came into view first.
Zhou Wu, still bound to the chair, turned his head to look.
His expression was initially full of disdain.
But as the cabinet doors parted to reveal the center section...
His eyes bulged forward involuntarily.
As more of the cabinet became visible...
His face underwent a dramatic transformation - mouth agape, eyes filled with confusion, incomprehension, then terror.
His facial muscles froze completely.
Finally, the cabinet stood fully open.
And Zhou Wu was utterly shocked.
All his previous contempt vanished instantly, replaced by infinite astonishment and horror.
The cabinet was divided into compartments like a Go board, arranged in neat rows and columns.
And in each compartment was... a human head.
So many of them.
Men and women.
Of all ages.
But that wasn't the most terrifying part.
The most terrifying part was how incredibly lifelike they all looked.
Every facial feature, every strand of hair, every inch of skin...
So realistic it was impossible to tell if they were real or not.
And then there was the most bizarre detail of all:
Every single head in that cabinet was smiling.
Yes, every single one wore an identical smile.
Can you imagine? An entire cabinet full of human heads... all smiling at you?
Zhou Wu was utterly horrified, his heart pounding wildly, his entire body trembling uncontrollably.
At this moment, Xiao Xing turned to Zhou Wu and asked: "Well? Not bad for a collection, right? I'm not as good as the painter who introduced me to this, but I think I'm doing alright."
"Zhou Wu, our esteemed resident... would you like to become part of my collection?"
Xiao Xing gave Zhou Wu a friendly smile, then imitated a Western-style bow with his left hand over his chest.
Zhou Wu's face twisted in panic as he screamed: "WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT?!"
"WHO WOULD WANT TO BE PART OF YOUR SICK COLLECTION?!"
"AND THESE HEADS HAVE TO BE FAKE! THEY'RE ALL FAKE!"
Initially, the sight of those heads had shocked Zhou Wu to his core, making him feel like his world was collapsing.
This was more shocking than seeing ten million yuan in cash before him!
How was this any different from a horror movie?
A whole cabinet full of human heads!
In the same tiny room with you!
Wasn't this utterly terrifying?
Couldn't he feel the overwhelming sinister aura?
And every single head was smiling, making it even more horrifying!
As his initial shock subsided, Zhou Wu became convinced they must be fake.
Each head represented a human life.
There had to be dozens here - meaning dozens of murders?
Was this some kind of joke?
A mere security guard being a serial killer who murdered this many people?
And never got caught?
The only way to obtain so many heads would be working at a mortuary.
But even then, procuring heads would be extremely risky.
More importantly, how were these heads so perfectly preserved?
No signs of decay at all?
They looked like they belonged to living people...
So they must be figurines or wax replicas!!!!
Faced with Zhou Wu's protests, Xiao Xing just kept smiling without responding.Thɪs updatᴇd by NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Then came a loud knocking at the door.
"Ah, they're here," Xiao Xing said cheerfully.
It wasn't clear whether he meant the person outside... or Zhou Wu.
The knocker was a middle-aged man.
Dressed in a white lab coat and black leather shoes, carrying a medical kit diagonally across his body.
Clearly a doctor.
Zhou Wu didn't recognize him, but he never imagined Xiao Xing would have accomplices!
"Did you bring it?" Xiao Xing asked.
The doctor replied calmly: "Yes."
From his Red Cross-marked medical kit, he produced an unopened disposable syringe and a glass vial of medicine.
"What are you doing?! What do you think you're doing?!"
Zhou Wu sensed danger - this sudden appearance of a doctor, the syringe and medicine - clearly they intended something for him.
Xiao Xing leaned down until their eyes were level, four black pupils staring intensely:
"Zhou Wu, our esteemed resident."
"You're lucky."
"After we administer the anesthetic, I'll remove your head painlessly."
"Unlike the others who died in agony."
"Of course, you should thank Alice Apartment... and this doctor here."
Zhou Wu began struggling violently, making the chair rock back and forth:
"XIAO XING! STOP JOKING AROUND! DO YOU REALIZE WHAT YOU'RE DOING? THIS IS ILLEGAL! THEY'LL EXECUTE YOU FOR THIS!!!!"
Xiao Xing remained silent, just smiling.
Zhou Wu completely broke down, screaming: "HELP! SOMEONE HELP ME! IS THERE ANYONE WHO CAN SAVE ME?!?!"
"AAAAHHHH! HELP!!!!"
"WAAAAHHHHH—"
He began crying uncontrollably, tears and snot streaming down his face: "Xiao Xing, I'm begging you, let me go this once! I'll apologize for what happened yesterday - I'll get on my knees and apologize if you let me go!"
"I'll pay you compensation too! Any amount! How about 100,000 yuan? Not enough? I'll give you 500,000! 500,000 yuan! That's more than you could earn in years!"
"And - you saw my girlfriend when you came to my place last night, right?! Isn't she beautiful?! Let me go and I'll let you have her, do whatever you want with her, throw her away when you're done!! JUST LET ME GO THIS ONCE!!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Zhou Wu, Deceased
chapters.content:
A human's final struggle before death is terrifyingly intense.
The doctor kept flicking the needle with his middle finger, expelling all air bubbles from the syringe.
Once the air was cleared, Xiao Xing firmly held Zhou Wu's head in place as Zhou Wu thrashed violently, trying to break free.
Feeling the prick in his arm, Zhou Wu's eyes turned bloodshot and he sank his teeth deep into Xiao Xing's arm in one last desperate counterattack.
Xiao Xing merely winced momentarily before resuming his eerie smile.
"No! No! NO!!!!"
Gradually, Zhou Wu released his bite - he had already seen the doctor finish the injection.Follow current novels on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Must stay awake... mustn't fall asleep!!!!"
Zhou Wu knew falling asleep meant never waking up again.
Yet his consciousness proved too weak against the anesthetic's assault.His eyelids grew unbearably heavy.
The two figures before him blurred as his vision darkened...
"No......"
......
"What? You said Zhou Wu didn't come to the factory?"
"Alright, I understand."
Shen Xing had just stepped out of the textile factory compound.
The Zhou family's textile factory wasn't small - a mid-to-large scale operation.
Shen Xing was dressed elegantly today.
She wore a chic black Chanel-style outfit, carrying a branded handbag worth 20,000 yuan.
Her right hand - adorned with pink nail art - kept tapping on her 7,000-yuan smartphone.
"He's been missing since morning, left his phone and car keys at home, and didn't come to the factory either. Where could he be? Maybe visiting his aunt?"
Standing straight-legged by the roadside outside the factory,
Shen Xing called Zhou Wu's mother.
The response came quickly: "Xiao Xing? What's the matter?"
"Auntie, is Zhou Wu with you?"
"Zhou Wu? No, why?"
"Nothing serious. He's been missing since morning - left his phone and car keys at home, and didn't show up at the factory. Thought he might be visiting you."
"What?"
Normally, Zhou Wu's middle-aged mother wouldn't have worried - she'd assume her son was off fooling around somewhere.
But after her husband's disappearance, she'd grown hypersensitive to such situations.
Especially since even when fooling around, he'd at least take his phone - modern life was impossible without one.
So where was her son?
Could it be...
"Don't jinx it!"
She dismissed the ominous thought and asked: "Xiao Xing, where are you now?"
Shen Xing looked up at the sky: "Outside the factory. I'll check his usual hangouts."
"Alright, check his regular spots. If you can't find him, return home - he might already be back. Also contact his friends - I'll make inquiries too about Zhou Wu's whereabouts."
......
Alice Apartment, 1st floor, Xiao Xing's unit.
The doctor entered and closed the door, observing the blood-drenched Xiao Xing at the center of the room:
"Your unit's soundproofing is impressive - rivals mine."
Xiao Xing remained silent, toying with Zhou Wu's severed head.
Zhou Wu's eyes would never open again in this lifetime.
If they did reopen, it would likely be a vengeful ghost seeking retribution.
The doctor studied Xiao Xing before shifting attention to the cabinet full of collected heads.
He randomly picked up a middle-aged man's head, squeezing, stroking and tugging at it.
"Huh? I thought these were all real. Some are fakes!"
Still fondling Zhou Wu's head, Xiao Xing smiled:
"Correct. Mostly fakes, with a few genuine ones."
Perplexed, the doctor asked: "Then why display so many fakes? Collecting them too?"
Xiao Xing shook his head: "No. Just to fill space - I like my cabinet looking full."
The doctor gave a long "Ah" of understanding.
Meanwhile...
Live stream room.
The long-haired beauty host reappeared.
This time in a pink qipao dress.
As the poem goes: "Peach blossoms blush to match fair faces."
Only her flawless pale complexion could carry this vibrant pink without looking ridiculous.
Her appearance always signaled important announcements:
[Round 26 - Second lab rat Zhou Wu has died! Total bets placed: 10 million yuan, all transferred to the final prize pool.]
With that, she vanished into darkness again.
Her exit sparked lively discussions about Zhou Wu:
Fairy Sister: [Poor Zhou Wu - lost his life, but at least died painlessly under anesthesia.]
Little Dragon Girl: [True. Luckier than many lab rats. Hey, where's Ultimate Rich Kid? Usually so vocal. Did Xiao Xing's bloody execution of Zhou Wu make him vomit? Weak!]
Ultimate Rich Kid immediately popped up: [Don't slander me! I enjoyed every minute!]
Little Dragon Girl: [Then why silent earlier?]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [I was fine, but my girlfriend puked. Was helping her rinse her mouth!]
Little Dragon Girl expressed shock: [Wait - you're not watching alone? Brought someone else?!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Yeah, problem?]
Little Dragon Girl: [The apartment organizers can't stop you, but warn your girlfriend - if she blabs, neither of you will escape consequences.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Relax, I've warned her.]
[Actually, I just thought of something about Zhou Wu!]
Little Dragon Girl: [What? The man's dead. Eyeing his girlfriend now?]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Am I that type?]
[My question: Like Jiang Ran, Zhou Wu didn't enter through the agreement, right? So the 10k daily couldn't go straight to his account. But he stayed several days - how was that handled?]
This question about Zhou Wu had actually been raised by several viewers earlier in the stream, but went unanswered.

chapters.title: Chapter 80: The Elegant Old Man in Suits from Room 503
chapters.content:
It was unclear whether it was because the Ultimate Rich Kid was too handsome or because Zhou Wu was already dead, but this matter needed clarification.
The long-haired beauty host who had previously disappeared into the darkness reappeared.
In her melodious voice, she said, "His 10,000 yuan per day was actually given long ago. When he bought Room 404 at Alice Apartment, we gave him a 70,000 yuan discount from the original price."
Hearing this,
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Wow, so the organizers actually lost money? Zhou Wu profited by 20,000 to 30,000 yuan!]
Fairy Sister laughed: [If Zhou Wu could turn into a ghost, he’d definitely come after you, Ultimate Rich Kid. Your words are too infuriating.]
Little Dragon Girl: [True, he was a rich second-generation heir anyway. He wouldn’t care about 20,000 or 30,000 yuan…]
The Ultimate Rich Kid didn’t care at all and continued: [Let me think—Jiang Ran, Zhou Wu, Xiao Q, Ke Bei, Li Mengmeng.]
[Right now, Jiang Ran is the only free one. Zhou Wu is dead, and the other three—two are acting like dogs, and one is a slave to the doctor.]
[As long as Jiang Ran survives this round, those who bet on him will win!][If he dies though…]
Middle-aged Uncle chimed in: [If Jiang Ran dies now, and Xiao Q, Ke Bei, and Li Mengmeng don’t regain their freedom by the end of this round, then those who bet on Jiang Ran still win!!!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Boring. I started watching this livestream too late. Next round, I’m placing my bet too!]
[I also saw the betting winner’s leaderboard. Diamond Bachelor is in first place, right? Just watch—I’ll surpass him eventually!]
…
Round 26, Day 6.
Jiang Ran’s ex-girlfriend, Shen Xing, had only slept two or three hours from yesterday until now.
From the moment she discovered Zhou Wu’s disappearance yesterday until now, there had been no trace of him.
She and Zhou Wu’s mother had already reported it to the police, but after investigating, the police found nothing.
They could only merge Zhou Wu’s disappearance with his father’s missing person case.
Her husband’s sudden disappearance, followed by her son’s sudden vanishing—
For Zhou Wu’s mother, this middle-aged woman, it was as if the sky had collapsed.
In such a short time, the two closest people in her life were gone.
No bodies, no traces—not even a ransom demand.
She would have preferred if someone had kidnapped them and asked for money. At least that would have been better than this complete silence.
In just a short time, her once jet-black hair had turned white, as if she had aged overnight.
As for Shen Xing, though she was somewhat sad, she wasn’t devastated.
With Zhou Wu gone, her biggest worry was that her comfortable life was over.
After all, if Zhou Wu was missing, could she, his girlfriend and fiancée, continue staying in this household?
Unless…
Shen Xing touched her stomach.
…
Afternoon of Day 6.
Jiang Ran, the assistant administrator, was lying on his bed in Room 304, resting with his eyes closed.
When he first took on this role, he thought his job would be busy.
But to his surprise, it was incredibly relaxed.
Since starting, apart from Su Mi from 202 and Shen Xing from 404 seeking him out, no other residents had come to him.
Just as he mused that it would be great if things stayed this leisurely, his phone suddenly rang.
Opening it, he saw a private message from a resident of Alice Apartment on WeChat, asking him to handle a matter.
"Resident from 503? No impression."
Jiang Ran got up with his phone and prepared to head to 503.
Meanwhile, in the livestream room—
The viewer count was holding steady at around 200,000.
Out of the five lab rats, one was dead.
Three had no freedom, leaving only Jiang Ran as the sole point of interest.
Naturally, the main camera was focused entirely on him, and the news of Jiang Ran heading to 503 quickly spread among the viewers.
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Does anyone know who lives in 503? Is it dangerous?]
Domineering Female CEO jumped in: [503 is occupied by an elegant old man who likes wearing suits.]
Fairy Sister: [Wait, is he the old man who helped with the chainsaw when Xiao Peng and the others couldn’t get into Lin Shengli’s place during Wang Ju’s disappearance?]
Domineering Female CEO: [That’s him.]
Fairy Sister: [CEO sis, I’ve only seen this old man once—during the Wang Ju incident. Can you tell us more about him?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Actually, you can check the livestream’s provided info…]
Little Dragon Girl: [Some people like reading, others prefer listening. CEO sis, just tell us!]
Domineering Female CEO: [Fine, whatever. I’m using voice-to-text anyway—won’t ruin my new manicure.]
[Alright, I’ll start.]
[So, this elegant old man in suits from 503—he’s gay. You get it? He likes men, especially young guys.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Holy shit, so Jiang Ran’s walking right into the lion’s den?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Ultimate Rich Kid, shut up and let me finish before you speak!!!]
She continued:
[This old man is in his sixties. Let me tell you a secret—I actually knew him before he became a resident at Alice Apartment.]
[Not super close, but we’ve met a few times and chatted.]
[He comes from a wealthy family—an American-born Chinese. His family owns a golf course in the U.S.]
[He realized his orientation was different from a young age, but he didn’t care. Then, in his twenties, under his parents’ pressure, he married a woman and had a son.]
[After his son was born, he never touched the woman again and continued partying with his boyfriends.]
[Years later, when his son was in his twenties and he was in his forties, something unexpected happened—his son had inherited his orientation and was also gay.]
[This was the turning point for the old man. His son found a boyfriend he deeply loved, but the old man stole that boyfriend.]Thɪs novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
[When the son found out, he had a complete mental breakdown. First, he never knew his father was also into men. Second, his respected father had stolen his lover—both his father and his beloved had betrayed him!]
[This led to the tragedy that followed.]
[Though his son was gay, unlike his promiscuous father, he was loyal in relationships. He was also a top student—an exceptionally talented individual.]
[But after this incident, he became a completely different person—sleeping around, partying every night in bars and clubs.]
[His luck ran out when he met a 30-year-old white man who owned a pig farm. This man was also gay—but with another identity: a deranged serial killer.]
[In the end, his son died at the hands of this pig farmer, and his body was dismembered and fed to the pigs.]
[Later, for some reason, the man who killed his son was acquitted due to insufficient evidence.]
[When the old man’s wife learned that her son’s murderer had gone free, she broke down and committed suicide. Since their marriage, she had endured his emotional neglect, but after their son’s death, she couldn’t take it anymore.]
[At the time, the old man was in his forties. Up until then, his life had been carefree and indulgent.]
[But suddenly, with his wife and son dead, he realized what loneliness truly was.]
[And then, things got worse.
His parents, devastated by the tragedy, got into a car accident while out one day and died instantly.]

chapters.title: Chapter 81: The Human-Skin Kite Maker Makes His Entrance
chapters.content:
[This was the turning point for the old man. Now he was completely alone. However, he was wealthy, having inherited a golf course from his parents. With all his relatives gone, he no longer cared about anything. So he spent a considerable amount of money hiring professionals to help him exact revenge personally, killing that white male pig farm owner.]
[After killing his son's murderer, he thought everything was over. But then he discovered his mental state was deteriorating further.]
[Later, he killed his son's former boyfriend, blaming the man for seducing his son. He believed that if not for this, his son wouldn't have suffered psychological trauma, become promiscuous, and encountered that white male pig farm owner.]
[The old man's psyche grew increasingly twisted. He believed homosexuality had destroyed his son, his wife, and his parents. If homosexuality didn't exist in this world, he wouldn't have ended up like this. From then on, he began approaching other gay men, embarking on a murderous path targeting homosexuals.]
[In the end, he was caught. He became quite notorious in the U.S., where the police gave him a nickname: The Gay Butcher.]
After the Domineering Female CEO finished her account, the live stream room fell silent for quite a while as everyone digested the information.
Then Little Dragon Girl commented: [Sister CEO explained it so well! The apartment's records weren't this detailed—they only had about 70-80% of what you shared!]
The Ultimate Rich Kid said: [Honestly, without your explanation, who could have guessed that elegant old man in a suit was actually a deranged serial killer? He looked so refined...]
[Wait! That means Jiang Ran going to Room 503 isn't dangerous, since he's not gay.]
The Domineering Female CEO sent a sly smile emoji: [Not necessarily!]The Ultimate Rich Kid: [Are you telling me Jiang Ran is gay? Or bisexual?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Jiang Ran definitely isn't, but even the straightest man can be turned.]
[You all joined the stream too late—though I wasn't much earlier myself.]
[There was an early round where another lab rat became assistant manager—a completely straight man. But the old man used money to turn him, and after he was turned, the old man...]
[Now we'll see if Jiang Ran can resist the temptation of money!]
...
Meanwhile, Jiang Ran was already inside Room 503.
He was somewhat surprised by the resident of 503.
An elderly gentleman in a suit, appearing refined and cultured—he rarely encountered such people in real life.
"Hello, I'm Assistant Manager Jiang Ran. Is there anything you need help with?" Jiang Ran asked the elegant suited old man.
The old man gave him a warm smile: "The fill valve and flush valve in my toilet tank are broken. I bought new ones—do you know how to replace them?"
Jiang Ran was relieved—he'd thought it would be something complicated. He patted his chest confidently: "Of course I can. No problem at all."
He'd replaced these parts two or three times before—it was simple.
The suited old man nodded and led Jiang Ran to the bathroom.
After inspecting, Jiang Ran confirmed both valves in the toilet tank were indeed broken—several plastic components inside had snapped.
"Where are the new ones?"
"Over there."
Brand new blue-and-white fill and flush valves sat atop the washing machine.
Jiang Ran began the replacement, first shutting off the water supply valve.
Though he knew how, having done it only a few times before, he worked rather slowly.
The suited old man stood silently behind Jiang Ran, only his breathing audible.
Suddenly, the old man asked: "Jiang Ran, how much does this assistant manager job pay monthly?"
Still working, Jiang Ran answered: "Ten thousand a month."
The old man sounded surprised: "Ten thousand? Would you be interested in making quick money?"
Jiang Ran chuckled jokingly: "Quick money? I don't do anything illegal."
The old man reassured: "Don't worry, it's completely legal."
Curious, Jiang Ran asked: "What is it then?"
The old man proposed: "I'll give you thirty thousand a month to be my sugar baby. How about that?"
Jiang Ran's hands froze mid-task. He quickly turned around, stood up, and covered his rear, thinking he'd misheard: "Sir, did I hear that correctly?"
The old man confirmed: "You didn't. So, are you willing?"
Jiang Ran grew wary: "No. I wouldn't sell myself for even a hundred thousand."
He believed money couldn't buy certain things, and one shouldn't compromise their principles for cash—once you start, your standards just keep dropping.
Unless you're truly desperate—then you might break your rules.
"Heh, I quite like your type," the old man smiled gently.
Though shocked and somewhat frightened to learn this refined gentleman was gay, Jiang Ran relaxed slightly when the old man made no further inappropriate moves beyond that proposition. The surprise actually made him work faster.
Soon, the replacement was complete.
Afterwards, the old man had no other requests.
Jiang Ran had worried he might invent another task to keep him there, but fortunately, the man was straightforward.
Bang!
As the door to 503 closed, the danger warning in Jiang Ran's mind changed from:
[Ding! Dangerous individual detected! Evacuate immediately! +7 points! +7 points...]
to:
[Ding! Dangerous area detected! Evacuate immediately! +5 points! +5 points...]
"The system was right this time—that old man really is dangerous. If I'd been assaulted, I'd have wanted to die."
For a straight man, such an experience would be psychologically devastating—like a nuclear bomb to the psyche.
After leaving 503, Jiang Ran pressed his worksheet against the white wall to record the valve replacement for the suited gentleman.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NovᴇlFirenᴇt
His phone rang again—another private request from the apartment residents' group chat.
This time, it was a resident from Room 801.
Name: Wang Nuli.
Room 801.
Inside 801, whether in the living room, balcony, or bedroom—everywhere was covered with kites, kite-making materials, and tools.
Amid this sea of kites sat a craftsman on a small stool, silently working on a kite with his tools.
Ding-dong!
Hearing the doorbell, the craftsman's lips curved into a smile: "Finally here, Assistant Manager Jiang Ran."
The man appeared honest and simple—his smile should have been amiably foolish.
But this smile carried an eerie, chilling quality.
Had Xiao Q been present, he would have recognized this as none other than the human-skin kite maker Wang Nuli!
Indeed—this was the human-skin kite serial killer Wang Nuli!
Though Wang Nuli preferred being called the human-skin kite craftsman, as he didn't consider himself a killer.
So why had he summoned Jiang Ran?
During the welcome party for new residents that Jiang Ran attended, the human-skin kite maker Wang Nuli had already noticed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 82: The Ancient Beauty Kite
chapters.content:
He remembered that welcome party very clearly.
Five people: Qin Fei, Wang Xixi, Murong Fu, Xiao Nuo, and Jiang Ran.
During their self-introductions, he carefully observed each of them.
Especially the condition of their skin.
Since all five were young, their skin was in excellent condition.
Among them, Jiang Ran and Murong Fu had the skin he desired most.
Why?
Because these two men were among the most handsome of their gender.
He planned to use Murong Fu's skin to make a kite resembling a refined gentleman.
He had it all figured out - since your name was Murong Fu, your skin would become an ancient scholarly nobleman.But unfortunately, when he was ready to target Murong Fu, the man had disappeared, possibly dead - at least he wasn't at home.
Thus, Jiang Ran became the best available option.
He had already decided - after flaying Jiang Ran, he would use the skin to create an exquisitely beautiful retro swallow kite.
The kite's name would be: Spring Swallow.
After shaping the skin into the basic form, the most crucial part would be painting and coloring.
He would mix Jiang Ran's blood with other pigments to breathe soul into the Spring Swallow!
Call him insane? A pervert?
Say whatever you want!
After that incident with his wife and child, he had severed all worldly attachments. His sole desire now was creating perfect kites - various types of flawless kites.
Kites that satisfied his artistic vision!
This was his only purpose for living.
As for how many innocent lives would be sacrificed along the way?
Sorry, that wasn't his concern. His conscience was clear.
With glorious anticipation of transforming Jiang Ran into a kite, he opened the door with a smile.
Jiang Ran stood outside Room 801. When the door opened and he locked eyes with Wang Nuli - this middle-aged man with a simple, honest face - the Danger Warning System in his mind began blaring: [Ding! Detected dangerous individual! Please evacuate immediately! Points +7! Points +7! Points+...]
Hearing the system's cold mechanical voice...
Normally he would ignore it, but now he had to take it seriously.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
After recently experiencing that incident with the elegant suit-wearing old man being a homosexual, he thought the system might actually be reliable sometimes.
Now the danger warning sounded again, and this Wang Nuli actually gave the same +7 points as the guy from 503. Jiang Ran couldn't help suspecting - was this guy also gay?
Though the probability seemed low.
As Jiang Ran entered 801, Wang Nuli closed the door behind them. Staring at Jiang Ran's back, particularly the skin around his neck, his eyes gleamed with hunger. Only when Jiang Ran turned around did he suppress the greedy light in his eyes.
"You're a kite maker?"
Jiang Ran sounded surprised.
Mainly because the floor was completely covered with various kites, half-finished kites, and tools.
Not just that - he noticed kites hanging on the white living room walls too.
Unlike the casually placed floor kites, the wall-hung ones were clearly carefully displayed, each spaced perfectly apart from the others.
These exhibition-style wall kites were naturally superior to the floor ones.
Especially one particular human-shaped kite.
About 1.5 meters long.
Depicting an ancient beauty in elegant classical attire with exquisite head ornaments.
The kite's face was breathtakingly beautiful - clear and refined with bright eyes and white teeth. Jiang Ran found himself deeply captivated.
"Yes, I'm a kite maker. Have been since childhood."
Wang Nuli gave an honest smile.
He noticed Jiang Ran's gaze fixed on that particular kite.
He couldn't help thinking Jiang Ran had good taste.
After all, the wall displayed his proudest creations, all made from human skin.
And the one Jiang Ran admired was his masterpiece of painstaking effort.
The raw materials came from one of his beautiful female fans.
He remembered - that fan had dignified features, a slender figure, and was passionate about kites. She greatly admired his kite-making skills.
Originally Wang Nuli hadn't planned to target her, but seeing her flawless facial features and skin, he couldn't resist.
Surely she would forgive him?!
After all, he had transformed her into the kites she loved so much.
Jiang Ran knew nothing of the ancient beauty kite's backstory.
He only thought - this kite was incredibly crafted, as if wrought by divine skill!
The resemblance was so lifelike, like seeing a real person!
More captivating than any famous painting!
"Can I touch it?"
Jiang Ran turned to ask.
Wang Nuli nodded: "Of course. I enjoy having my kites appreciated. If touching wasn't allowed, I'd have put it under glass."
With permission granted, Jiang Ran boldly reached out with his right hand.
Slowly caressing it - the initial sensation was smooth, delicate, completely unlike the rough, grainy texture he expected.
"What material is this kite skin made from? It feels as smooth as human skin. Must take considerable effort to maintain?"
After thoroughly examining it, Jiang Ran asked curiously.
"The material? What if I told you it's human skin - would you believe me?"
Hearing this, Jiang Ran froze, then shook his head with a laugh: "Didn't expect you to be such a joker."
Wang Nuli also chuckled with a simpleton's grin: "Actually it's made from pigskin, cowhide, sheepskin etc., using special techniques."
Jiang Ran spread his arms, making an admiring suggestion: "You should really hold a kite exhibition! These are incredible - easily rivaling paintings in art museums. They're true artworks!"
He meant every word.
Seeing Jiang Ran's enthusiasm, Wang Nuli thought to himself - soon you'll become an artwork too.
"By the way, why did you ask me here? What do you need help with?"
Getting back on topic, Jiang Ran asked.
Wang Nuli gestured with his chin: "See that pile of bamboo over there? Materials for making kites. I can't handle it alone, so I'd appreciate your help processing them."
Jiang Ran walked to the bamboo pile - the stalks were long, appearing freshly cut.
Lush with abundant green branches and leaves everywhere.
"How should I process these?"
"Simple - use that bamboo knife to trim off all the branches, leaving just the bare stalk. Like that one there."
Beside the pile lay one already processed stalk. Just follow that example.
Jiang Ran nodded: "Got it. Leave it to me."
Wang Nuli: "I really appreciate it. After finishing, I'll treat you to dinner."
Jiang Ran: "No need to be so polite. This is part of our apartment staff duties."
Wang Nuli then brought over a small wooden stool.
"Sit here - easier on your legs."
Thanking him, Jiang Ran sat on the stool with his back to Wang Nuli, starting to trim bamboo with the knife.
Completely unaware that behind him, Wang Nuli's simple, honest face...
Now revealed undisguised greed and cunning.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Headshot, Personality Emerges
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran began processing the bamboo, while Wang Nuli pretended to be occupied with his own tasks nearby.
After about five minutes had passed, Wang Nuli felt it was about time. He quietly returned to the bedroom.
He took off his sneakers, leaving only a pair of socks on his feet. Then, from under the pillow on the bedroom bed, he retrieved a silver-white metal wrench approximately the length of an adult man's forearm.
He swung the wrench a few times in his right hand;
it was heavy, and as he wielded it, it sliced through the air, producing a whistling sound.
He was very satisfied.
Then he quietly moved to the bedroom door.
He observed Jiang Ran.
At this moment, Jiang Ran was focused intently on helping him with the work.
Wang Nuli gave a strange smile, stepped barefoot softly, lowered his voice, and slowly walked out of the bedroom, approaching Jiang Ran from behind. Once behind Jiang Ran,
he raised the wrench with both hands and slammed it down fiercely.Bang!
The metal wrench struck Jiang Ran’s headtop with brutal force.
Hot, fresh blood immediately gushed from the top of Jiang Ran’s head.
It splattered onto the front of Wang Nuli’s clothes and all around.
Right after, Jiang Ran’s body swayed left and right twice before collapsing onto the floor with a thud.
“Jiang Ran, Jiang Ran!”
After the attack, Wang Nuli called out twice. Seeing that Jiang Ran had no reaction, he laughed loudly twice.
Then he walked into the bathroom, preparing to take out his personal set of skinning tools to start his work.
At this time, the live stream room had 230,000 viewers.
The main camera had been focused on Jiang Ran continuously—from the moment Jiang Ran entered room 801 until now, when he was hit on the head with the wrench.
All of this was broadcast into the viewers’ eyes.
Jiang Ran’s headshot instantly silenced the live stream room.
After more than a minute passed, someone finally spoke.
Ultimate Rich Kid: “What? He’s dead just like that?”
Middle-aged Uncle: “He probably isn’t dead yet. A headshot is pretty deadly, but there’s likely still a breath left. Although that breath won’t do much!”
Middle-aged Uncle’s tone carried a sigh of sorrow: “Sigh, I said before that being an assistant administrator like this is dangerous and he’d die quickly, but I didn’t expect it to be this fast.”
Ultimate Rich Kid: “It’s okay, Uncle, don’t be sad. As long as these seven days end and those three people with Xiao Q haven’t regained freedom, Jiang Ran still wins this round. Your five million can still be safe!”
Little Aunt: “Huh? What about Jiang Ran’s fierce personality? Why hasn’t it come out yet? Is he really going to die?!”
Little Dragon Girl: “Little Aunt, maybe you’re overestimating the dissociative personality. This time is different from last time. Last time Jiang Ran wasn’t hurt at all, so the other personality could come out immediately. This time, it’s a headshot injury, and it was a sneak attack. There’s no time to react. Don’t even talk about whether the personality can come out. Even if it did, can the body that just took a headshot really turn the tables?”
Ultimate Rich Kid: “What are you all talking about? Personality?”
Little Dragon Girl: “Oh, I almost forgot. You don’t know about this. Jiang Ran suffers from dissociative identity disorder. Last time, one of his personalities appeared—it was very strong.”
Ultimate Rich Kid: “Damn... immune to sedatives, and also mentally ill?”
Domineering Female CEO: “Alright, alright, no need to watch anymore. Jiang Ran is definitely dead. Sigh, I thought he could survive two rounds and push for a third! After all, the highest record in this game is someone surviving three rounds and leaving the apartment.”
I am the Hero: “Everyone, don’t be sad. Even though Jiang Ran died, at least he died at Wang Nuli’s hands. At least his skin will become a work of art! That’s some consolation, right?”
“Next, let’s say farewell to Jiang Ran! After all, he was one of the best players in recent rounds.”
Middle-aged Uncle: “Jiang Ran, rest in peace.”
Domineering Female CEO: “Jiang Ran, rest in peace.”
Little Dragon Girl: “Jiang Ran, rest in peace.”
The live stream room was flooded with messages.
Inside room 801,
Jiang Ran lay face-down on the floor, his face pressed intimately against the surface.
His mind was a complete blur.
Within this haze, a mechanical godlike voice dispelled the chaos and brought clarity.
[Beep! Detected host suffered fatal injury, consuming 500 points, repairing!]
[Beep! Detected host facing life-threatening danger, consuming 1000 points, awakening other personalities!]
[Beep! Reminder to host: conserve points! If points run out, life is easily lost!]
Inside the bathroom of 801,
this bathroom held Wang Nuli’s skinning knives and various tools.
At this moment, he was selecting the skinning tools he would need this time.
Among these tools, the most frequently used were the metal wrench and the tiny, incredibly sharp skinning knife that gleamed with cold light.Follow current novels on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
The metal wrench was for hitting the head.
You ask why not hit other parts?
Other parts are skin—what if they get injured?
It’s better to hit the head;
it’s practical.
Although it also damages the scalp, it’s much more cost-effective than hitting other areas.
The second tool was the small skinning knife, about the size of a fruit knife, with a slightly curved blade.
This was custom-made by Wang Nuli at great expense.
It was not something available on the market.
“A perfect new kite is about to be born in this world.”
Wang Nuli’s eyes flashed red with a fierce glow.
His usually honest and simple appearance twisted into a crazed expression that was incredibly terrifying.
Having chosen the tools needed this time, he placed them into his portable toolbox.
He walked out of the bathroom.
When he stepped out and looked toward the place where Jiang Ran had fallen earlier,
his walking body suddenly froze.
He softly exclaimed, “Huh? Where is he?”
Wang Nuli was stunned. He had only gone in to get tools for five or six minutes. How had the person disappeared?
The place where Jiang Ran had been lying was empty, only residual red bloodstains remained.
“Looks like this kid called Jiang Ran has a pretty tough head!”
This wasn’t Wang Nuli’s first time hitting someone with a metal wrench.
He had plenty of experience.
Except for the first and second times, when the person hit could still resist after being struck with the wrench,
the rest all ended with the person lying on the ground like a dead dog, unconscious or even dead.
Therefore, Jiang Ran’s case was unprecedented after Wang Nuli’s proficient use of the wrench.
Wang Nuli wasn’t worried about this situation, because he had locked the door of 801. There was a small device on it, and no one except himself could open it.
So, if Jiang Ran had woken up, he definitely was still inside this apartment.
“Hehehehe, very good, very lively. Spring is the season when swallows are active. Spring brings all things back to life, representing vitality and vigor!!! And you, Jiang Ran, are so full of life! Only a kite made like this Spring Swallow fits! I really picked the right person!”
Wang Nuli set down his toolbox, switched the metal wrench from his left hand to his right, ready to play a cat-and-mouse game with Jiang Ran.
He thought it would take some effort to find Jiang Ran. Jiang Ran must be hiding somewhere inside the house, trembling. Once Wang Nuli found him, Jiang Ran would surely kneel down, weeping, begging for his life.
But to Wang Nuli’s utter surprise, when he turned his head, he immediately saw Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran was standing in front of the ancient beauty kite that Wang Nuli had admired so much before.
His right hand’s pinky finger was raised elegantly, gently stroking the ancient beauty kite with great delicacy.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: I Quite Admire You, Let You and Your Kites Fly Together
chapters.content:
Wang Nuli was stunned by this scene, but after a few seconds, he nodded firmly with a satisfied, foolish grin:
"Good, very good. You didn't hide somewhere crying and begging like I imagined."
"Jiang Ran, after making so many human-skin kites, I swear - once I turn you into a kite!"
"You'll absolutely become my favorite masterpiece, just like this beautiful lady kite! The best!"
"Oh? Then I'm quite honored."
Jiang Ran turned his head, wearing a spring breeze-like smile.
Strangely, his every movement and expression no longer resembled a man, but rather a woman - an ancient woman at that!
Wang Nuli froze for several more seconds, his lips twitching. Though unsure what was wrong with Jiang Ran - had he damaged his brain with that wrench? - it didn't matter.
"You're still going to die, whatever you are."
"Be good and don't move. I'm not that kind of sadist who enjoys slow torture. I'll make your departure from this world quick and clean."Indeed, Wang Nuli wasn't the torturing type. He killed solely to harvest skin for his kites.
Metal wrench in hand, Wang Nuli approached Jiang Ran step by step. To his surprise, Jiang Ran didn't flee but actually obeyed, standing perfectly still.
Though unexpected, it pleased him.
As he neared Jiang Ran, Wang Nuli raised the wrench high and swung down fiercely at Jiang Ran's head.
BANG!
At such close range, it should have been a sure hit - yet somehow, the wrench struck only tile floor, shattering it into pieces.
"No...not a miss. He dodged!"
Wang Nuli finally realized this as he tried raising the wrench again, only to find his hand pinned firmly under a heavy foot. No matter how he struggled, it wouldn't budge!
"You-!"
His furious glare upward was met by another foot crashing into his face. The powerful kick sent him flying backward into a pile of kites, crushing them all beneath him.
"What...what's going on?"
Blood streamed from Wang Nuli's nose as he clutched his face, covered in dust. He staggered up, staring at Jiang Ran who stood calmly after delivering the kick.
Somehow, this Jiang Ran seemed completely different from the one who first entered his home.
If forced to describe it - same body, different soul!
Even stranger, Jiang Ran's voice had become effeminate...soft and delicate...
Jiang Ran didn't answer, merely standing there with a serene smile:
