"Wang Nuli, I quite admire you. Your kites are exquisite, especially this one - such dignified, graceful beauty that moves the heart."
Hearing this, Wang Nuli grinned as if meeting a fellow connoisseur: "That's my favorite too. The materials came from a woman with exceptionally refined features. Her skin was premium quality."
Jiang Ran asked: "Have you made other things from human skin?"
Wang Nuli frowned: "Other things? What would be the point? Using human skin for anything but kites would be wasteful."
Jiang Ran nodded: "So you're truly obsessed with kites."
"Then you should depart with your kites - no need to dirty my hands."
Wang Nuli's brows furrowed deeply: "Meaning?"
With a faint smile, Jiang Ran explained: "This is the eighth floor. Here's your chance - tie your favorite kites to yourself, as many as you want, then jump from this balcony window. Let's see if your creations can save you. Survive, and we'll consider your wrench attack on me settled. Agreeable?"
Wang Nuli chuckled, then suddenly snarled:
"Settle your ass!"
He hurled a kite at Jiang Ran's face to block vision while charging forward with a punch.
But the gap between them was vast. The kite didn't obstruct Jiang Ran's view at all, and Wang Nuli took another brutal kick, crashing down onto more destroyed kites.
"Tsk tsk, why must you be so disobedient?"
Jiang Ran picked up the metal wrench, approaching Wang Nuli with a gentle smile:
"Choose - beaten to death by me, or gamble with your kites?"
After being kicked down twice, Wang Nuli finally recognized the insurmountable difference in their abilities.
Yet...
He sneered: "Kill me? You dare murder someone?"
Immediately, he regretted his words as the wrench smashed onto his shin with terrifying force.
One strike was enough to make Wang Nuli scream and weep in agony, clutching his leg. Now he truly understood how his own victims had felt.
"Made your decision yet?"
Jiang Ran's spring breeze-like voice now sounded like thunderous storms to Wang Nuli's ears.
Through pain-slurred speech, Wang Nuli begged: "C-can I not die? I'm not afraid of death - I'm afraid of never making kites again!"
Jiang Ran answered with another wrench strike.
Wang Nuli frantically waved: "Okay! Okay! I choose! I choose the kite gamble!"
Limping on his injured leg, Wang Nuli realized refusing the eight-story plunge would indeed get him beaten to death.
Though the jump seemed equally fatal...maybe there was a sliver of hope?
Jiang Ran watched as Wang Nuli tied kites to himself.
Curious, Jiang Ran asked: "Why only these ordinary kites? Why not your precious human-skin ones on the wall?"
Wang Nuli snapped: "I'm not dying! I'll keep making kites! Those would get ruined! They're my life's work!"
Jiang Ran simply smiled.
Wang Nuli tried attaching numerous kites to maximize survival odds, but could only manage four small ones on his limbs and one large one on his back before reaching capacity. Hobbling to the balcony, Jiang Ran provided a chair to stand on.
"May you soar through the skies like your kites," Jiang Ran wished.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
The eighth floor was terrifyingly high. Standing on the chair, Wang Nuli unexpectedly discovered a fear of heights.
Jiang Ran removed the balcony windows entirely - the kite-laden Wang Nuli couldn't fit through otherwise.
While Jiang Ran worked on the windows, Wang Nuli on the chair suddenly said: "Need to pee. Quick bathroom break."
Jiang Ran nodded, continuing his task.
Seizing this moment, Wang Nuli lunged at Jiang Ran, grabbing his legs in an attempt to lift and hurl him out the window - let him experience flight instead!
But Jiang Ran's body felt immovable as bedrock. Despite all his strength, Wang Nuli couldn't budge him an inch.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Is Wang Qingzhao a Sociopath?
chapters.content:
"I knew you'd try this trick."
"Even a cornered dog will jump over a wall. Ordinary people fight desperately when trapped, let alone a little pervert like you who enjoys making kites from human skin."
Jiang Ran grabbed Wang Nuli by the neck and hauled him onto the chair like a dead dog.
"Let's gamble!" Jiang Ran said.
Wang Nuli stared at the seemingly endless drop below and actually shed a tear:
"Can't you really give me one more chance? I still want to make kites. I haven't tried using foreigner's skin yet. There are so many perfect kite designs left unfinished."
"I really don't want to leave this world yet..."
Jiang Ran smiled faintly: "Crocodile tears?"
"Enough dawdling. Even I'm annoyed by how womanly you're acting. Let me help you."
Jiang Ran pretended to push Wang Nuli out the window. Wang Nuli screamed in terror: "Stay back!"Before Jiang Ran could even touch him, Wang Nuli inexplicably struggled on the chair, then his entire body tipped over—
—and fell straight out the window.
Normally, objects falling from heights descend vertically.
But perhaps because Wang Nuli had kites on him,
his fall was at an angle.
Though the speed remained deadly fast.
By the time Jiang Ran leaned out the window,
Wang Nuli's screams were already fading as he neared the ground.
Then—
BANG!
His body smashed onto the concrete.
A massive pool of blood instantly seeped out, the corpse gruesome beyond recognition.
He'd landed face-first, leaving the relatively large kite on his back to cover the Human-Skin Kite Maker's final disgrace like a shame cloth.
Jiang Ran observed the bloody scene below with only a faint smile.
After watching for a while, he withdrew his head and approached the ancient beautiful lady kite.
"What a fine skin you had," he remarked coolly. "Pity you backed the wrong person and got yourself killed too."
"Let me take you away from this wicked place."
Jiang Ran carefully took down the kite, admired it briefly, then prepared to leave Room 801—only to find the door locked from inside with a small latch.
Returning to the living room, he grabbed the metal wrench and smashed the lock open before elegantly departing.
......
In a luxurious penthouse in Nancheng City's scenic district,
Wang Qingzhao stood expressionless before her bathroom mirror, freshly showered.
Beautiful. Stunning.
Her long hair dripped wet down her back.
Her snow-white skin glowed pink from the hot water.
Even her white bathrobe couldn't compete with her pallor.
For five full minutes, she stared at her blank reflection.
Then she picked up an object from the wide white counter—
A dagger.
No explanation why a dagger sat on her bathroom counter,
but it seemed to have been there forever.
Wang Qingzhao gripped the sharp blade and watched her mirror self
slowly drag the knife from her eye corner downward...
past her cheek...
over her throat...
until it hovered near her delicate collarbone.
"Woof woof!"
Suddenly—a dog's bark.
A white toy poodle in a pink outfit stood at the bathroom doorway,
blinking adorable black eyes at her.
Wang Qingzhao turned her emotionless gaze toward it.
Then approached.
Kneeling, she petted the poodle's head with her left hand.
The dog closed its eyes in bliss—
Only for her left hand to suddenly choke its neck
while her right hand plunged the dagger deep into its body!
"Ghk! Gh...ghk!"
The poodle's pitiful cries came out strangled.
Wang Qingzhao showed no reaction,
stabbing mechanically, expressionlessly,
each thrust splattering more blood across the bathroom tiles.
"Ah...lost control again," she muttered. "The medication's failing. Need to switch prescriptions."
She shook her head—
and found herself still standing before the mirror.
The unharmed poodle waited obediently by the door.
Alive.
Well.
The slaughter just another fantasy.
Dropping the dagger, she strode to the living room,
the poodle trotting after her.
On the coffee table sat an oversized medicine bottle with English labeling.
She swallowed two white pills with cold water.
"Why...why must I have this illness? WHY?!"
Wang Qingzhao slumped weakly into a chair, brows furrowed.
Anyone who could read English would shockingly realize—
the medication treated antisocial personality disorder!
Why was Wang Qingzhao taking these?
Because since childhood, she'd carried this curse:
Antisocial personality disorder.
A mental condition marked by:
- Emotional coldness
- Lack of empathy
- Harmful behaviors
- High aggression
- Disregard for laws
Essentially, a budding criminal.
A latent psychopath.
The cruelest twist?
Such individuals believe themselves perfectly healthy, needing no treatment.
Wang Qingzhao also thought herself normal—
but her parents insisted she was ill.
Thus began lifelong medication and therapy.
After half an hour sitting blankly, she recomposed herself.
An hour later, she carried a square English-labeled case out the door.
Her car wound through the district until reaching Alice Apartment.
After registering with the security guard, she parked and took the elevator to the third floor.
Ding-dong.
Wang Qingzhao rang Room 304's bell twice.
The door opened to reveal Jiang Ran.
Her previously blank face had carefully arranged itself into a smile.
"Hello, Jiang Ran."
Inside stood Jiang Ran—
who immediately adopted a coquettish tone:ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Hello to you too, Qingzhao jiejie~"
"Uh..."
The abrupt act left Wang Qingzhao momentarily stunned.
This Jiang Ran's posture, mannerisms, every smile and gesture differed completely from usual.
Realization dawned.
"Unless this is a joke...you're not Jiang Ran. You're one of his alternate personalities?"
Her last visit had revealed Jiang Ran's dissociative identity disorder.
"So clever~" the persona giggled. "I adore smart women like you."
Wang Qingzhao didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: The Conversation Between Wang Qingzhao and Jiang Ran's Personality
chapters.content:
After entering Room 304, Wang Qingzhao noticed something new on the living room wall.
She walked over, initially thinking it was some kind of human-shaped poster. Upon closer inspection, she realized it was actually a kite!
"Where did this come from? It's incredibly well-made."
Even for someone as worldly as Wang Qingzhao, seeing it for the first time, she couldn't help but marvel at the kite's exquisite craftsmanship and lifelike appearance.
"Someone gifted it to me," Jiang Ran said softly. "By the way, Sister Qingzhao, what brings you to my home?"
"Nothing special, just came to see you," Wang Qingzhao lied. She actually had a purpose for coming but couldn't reveal it now.
More accurately, she couldn't tell the current personality.
She turned to stare at the highly feminine Jiang Ran and suddenly asked, "If you're one of Jiang Ran's personalities, forgive my bluntness, but you seem quite feminine. Do you identify as a woman?"
Jiang Ran shook his head. "I'm a man."
Wang Qingzhao pressed, "Biologically or psychologically?"Jiang Ran smiled brightly. "Both. I'm just slightly more feminine in mannerisms."
After this exchange, Wang Qingzhao found herself at a loss for words. She then asked, "Since you've taken over Jiang Ran's body now, does that mean the original Jiang Ran can't come back?"
Jiang Ran giggled, covering his mouth with his right hand. "I know what you're really asking, Sister. Don't worry. I'd love to keep this body permanently, but I don't have that capability. I'll fade away soon, and the host personality—the one you're referring to—will regain control."
Hearing this, Wang Qingzhao nodded, somewhat curious. "I've read about dissociative identity disorder online. Do your personalities really fight for control of the body like they say?"
Jiang Ran smiled. "It varies by individual, but for us, yes."
"We're constantly competing for control. Whoever is stronger becomes the host personality."
"But unfortunately, your Jiang Ran—the host—is too dominant. We can't overpower him."
Wang Qingzhao looked puzzled. "Dominant? Not really. Jiang Ran always struck me as gentle, sometimes even a bit simple-minded. Just an ordinary guy?"
Jiang Ran maintained his smile. "Sister, appearances can deceive. The Jiang Ran you know might not reflect his true nature. His real self might be dormant. Eyes can be fooled—what we see isn't always truth."
Wang Qingzhao nodded. "You say you can't overpower him, yet here you are now."
Jiang Ran shook his head. "My emergence was due to external forces, not my own doing."
Wang Qingzhao's curiosity piqued. "External forces? What kind?"The source of this content ɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Jiang Ran replied, "That's something I must keep secret."
Wang Qingzhao thought for a moment before guessing, "Is it because of Jiang Ran's medication? Is it ineffective?"
She had researched Jiang Ran's dissociative identity disorder medication afterward—the most basic kind with side effects.
She suspected this effeminate Jiang Ran had emerged because the medication wasn't working properly.
Jiang Ran didn't answer. Instead, he suddenly said, "Sister, I must go now. Goodbye!"
He waved at Wang Qingzhao, then his body went limp like a toy without batteries, collapsing onto the tiled floor.
Coming and going abruptly, this left Wang Qingzhao stunned.
After the effeminate personality vanished, Jiang Ran remained unconscious on the floor.
Wang Qingzhao dragged him onto the sofa.
Now staring at Jiang Ran's somewhat handsome face, Wang Qingzhao recalled advice from her childhood psychologist during college:
"Antisocial personality disorder's core issue is emotional detachment—the inability to feel basic empathy or emotions like ordinary people."
"If someone with ASPD could develop normal empathy—say, feeling sympathy for another's suffering instead of indifference or even deriving pleasure from their pain—they might improve."
"Now that you're in college, I recommend trying romance."
"Genuinely fall in love, regardless of gender. I mean real affection, not self-centered manipulation."
"Start with conventional heterosexual relationships to cultivate normal emotional responses. Then explore further. Learn to love like anyone else."
Following this advice, Wang Qingzhao decided to pursue a relationship.
Despite her ASPD, she felt no attraction to women and resolved to date a man like "normal" women did.
Surveying her surroundings, she settled on Jiang Ran.
She wasn't sure if her feelings for him matched what the doctor described as "normal" female emotions.
But Jiang Ran did stir something in her.
Unfortunately, it never happened.
Had they gotten together, she might have discovered whether she could experience "normal" romantic feelings.
And Jiang Ran wouldn't have been dumped by Shen Xing, developing dissociative identity disorder.
This thought evoked in her a pang of heartache—an emotion she'd never felt toward anyone or anything before.
As Wang Qingzhao stared at Jiang Ran's face, lost in thought for about five minutes...
Jiang Ran slowly opened his eyes on the sofa, gradually sitting up while rubbing his head.
"That's strange. Why does my head hurt?" he muttered.
Before he could ponder this, he noticed he was home—and even more bizarrely, Wang Qingzhao was there too.
"Why are you in my house?" Jiang Ran blinked in confusion.
Wang Qingzhao replied, "Oh, just bringing you something," gesturing to a box in her hands.
Jiang Ran remained baffled. "But how did you get in?"
Wang Qingzhao lied smoothly, "Your door was unlocked, so I came in and found you passed out on the sofa."

chapters.title: Chapter 87: The Livestream Discussion About Jiang Ran's Multiple Personalities
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran's mind went blank.
He clearly remembered being in Room 801 at Wang Nuli's place, helping him with those bamboo materials.
How did he end up back in his own apartment when he opened his eyes again?
Moreover, the top of his head was throbbing with pain?
Most disturbingly, his right fingers that had just touched his scalp had traces of dried blood and blood fragments.
"Could it be..."
Jiang Ran wondered if one of his other personalities had taken over...
Thinking back, during the last incident when he and Xiao Q were cornered in the bedroom by that Caucasian chainsaw man.
His memory stopped there, and when he opened his eyes again, he found himself at home, unharmed but covered in mysterious injuries—just like now.
"This shouldn't be happening?"Jiang Ran scratched his head.
Most patients with dissociative identity disorder have no memory when another personality takes over—it's like being asleep during that period.
But Jiang Ran was special.
Back on Earth in his previous life, when his secondary personality took over, he wouldn't black out but could clearly observe what that personality did with his body.
So what was happening now?
Another personality emerged, yet he had no memory of it?
What exactly did his other personality do?
A wave of fear washed over Jiang Ran.
"Jiang Ran, what's wrong? You look terrible."
Jiang Ran turned to see Wang Qingzhao's mature beauty face and asked, "Qingzhao, when you arrived, did you really only see me lying on the sofa? Nothing else strange?"
Wang Qingzhao shook her head firmly. "No, why do you ask?"
Jiang Ran lowered his head in thought. "Nothing, it's nothing."
"Oh right, is this box in your hand for me? What's inside?"
Jiang Ran decided to set aside his worries and focus on the present.
"Oh, last time I visited, I noticed you were taking the cheapest medication—ineffective with many side effects."
"This box contains two bottles of the latest American medication for treating dissociative identity disorder. You should try them."
Accepting the box covered entirely in English text,
Jiang Ran stared at the foreign words—truthfully, he couldn't understand them.
But he knew this stuff couldn't be cheap.
"This must have cost you. I can't just accept such expensive gifts. How much were these? I'll transfer the money."
Jiang Ran insisted.
Wang Qingzhao smiled and shook her head. "No need. Just treat me to dinner."
Jiang Ran refused firmly. "No way! Please tell me how much they cost!"
Wang Qingzhao replied, "Converted to our currency, each bottle costs twenty-five thousand, so fifty thousand for both."
Jiang Ran's hand, which had been holding his phone ready to make the payment,Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
froze completely.
"F-fifty thousand?"
Jiang Ran was stunned—his entire savings across all accounts didn't amount to that much!
Wang Qingzhao chuckled. "See? Just dinner is fine. If you really want to repay me, do it when you have money later."
"Oh, try the medication first to check its effects and any side effects. Continue if it works normally, but return it if there are adverse reactions. Don't force yourself just to save money."
Jiang Ran nodded. "Alright."
Though he knew perfectly well—once purchased, medicines couldn't be returned.
"Return to you, then back to the seller"? What kind of fantasy was that?
This was clearly Wang Qingzhao giving him an out.
At best, she could resell them at a discount to other patients.
Since he couldn't pay for the medicine, a dinner invitation it would be.
Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao left Room 304.
Before heading downstairs, Jiang Ran mentioned needing hospital treatment for his head wound first.
Only now did Wang Qingzhao notice and asked what happened.
Truthfully clueless, Jiang Ran blamed it on being hit by falling objects while walking downstairs.
They took the elevator to the first floor.
Exiting through the glass automatic doors, they saw a white ambulance driving away from the apartment.
Manager Xiao Zhang happened to be returning from the security booth.
Jiang Ran asked what happened—why was there an ambulance?
Manager Xiao Zhang explained, "That kite-making Wang Nuli from Room 801 must have gone insane from his craft. He tied kites to himself and jumped—probably thought he could fly like one."
Hearing this, Jiang Ran froze for three seconds before muttering strangely to himself, "Right, right... he must have gone mad from kite-making and jumped on his own!"
Jiang Ran dared not speculate whether his alternate personality might have done something to Wang Nuli during that missing time.
He had to convince himself: Wang Nuli's death had nothing to do with him. Even if his alternate personality was responsible, it wasn't his fault.
He was completely innocent—his personalities were too!
Therefore, Wang Nuli's death was unrelated to him—he was just a bystander!
Yes, that's how it was!
He refused to let this disrupt his peaceful life or land him in prison.
Even though it was all just speculation.
Lost in thought, Jiang Ran noticed Wang Qingzhao had already pulled up in her car.
He got in, and they drove away from Alice Apartment.
What Jiang Ran didn't know:
Ever since his "self-proclaimed servant girl" personality took over, the "Neighbors Over Distant Relatives" livestream had exploded.
From Middle-aged Uncle's comment: ["Damn! He woke up after that?! A metal wrench to the head, and another personality still takes over like nothing happened?"]
To Domineering Female CEO's remark: ["Why does this personality talk like some ancient maiden? So effeminate..."]
Then I am the Hero's analysis: ["Shocking! This personality fights as well as the last one but with completely different methods! If it were last time's personality, Wang Nuli would've been beaten to death! But this one turned a kite fanatic into... a kite! So artistic!"]
Finally, Ultimate Rich Kid's realization: ["Now I get why Jiang Ran had the least investments last round but the most this time—this personality is downright cheating! Are multiple personalities always this OP?"]
The livestream went wild because everyone had assumed Jiang Ran was done for.
Yet against all odds, not only did he survive—he got revenge!
Comments flooded with ["Legendary!"] and ["Incredible!"].
After this frenzy, seeing Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao drive off in the main livestream footage finally calmed things down.
Then Middle-aged Uncle raised a new topic:
["Hey, remember what Jiang Ran's personality told Wang Qingzhao? That the host personality (current Jiang Ran) is too dominant, making it hard for others to take over? Do you think that's true or false?"]

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Win Rate Rankings
chapters.content:
The Ultimate Rich Kid was the first to speak: [I think it's definitely fake. Although I didn't see Jiang Ran's other personality last time, I saw this one! It's twisted, ruthless, and artistic. As for Jiang Ran himself... well, judging from his performance these past days, he seems completely ordinary. So when that effeminate personality said they couldn't take over, I simply don't buy it.]

Middle-aged Uncle chimed in: [Then here's the question - if everyone thinks Jiang Ran's main personality is just an ordinary person, why does he control the body almost all the time? Why don't the other personalities take over more often?]

What nonsense about the main personality being too domineering to compete with.
The real reasons should be either the medication's effect or the other personalities weakening each other through internal conflict.
Regardless of the truth, one thing became certain:
The live stream audience now believed Jiang Ran might be the hardest lab rat to kill in history.To stage a comeback after being shot in the head? Absolutely legendary!
He might even break the record for most survival rounds!
The final moments of Round 26 passed quickly.
It was now the last half hour of the final day of Round 26.
When the clock struck midnight exactly, the round would officially end.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Round 26 Ends, Zhou Wu's Sister
chapters.content:
Bang!
In the real world, Diamond Bachelor smashed the ¥10,000+ keyboard onto the floor.
Just smashing it wasn't enough - she stomped on it angrily several times while muttering curses under her breath.
Outside the door, a middle-aged maid who had come to deliver midnight snacks heard the loud swearing in the silent night and didn't dare enter, choosing to wait outside instead.
Inside the room, the beautiful young heiress was fuming.
She wasn't just angry about losing her bet this time - she was furious that her sixth sense had failed her!
Why would it fail?
Her most prized secret weapon, her infallible intuition, had actually failed!
This plunged her into prolonged panic and terror.
"It seems ever since that damned lab rat Jiang Ran appeared, my sixth sense stopped working!""Rounds 25 and 26 proved it! Both times!"
Diamond Bachelor gnashed her teeth as she paced angrily around her spacious, luxurious pink princess bedroom.
A vicious glint flashed in her beautiful large eyes:
"Hmph, Jiang Ran, if you die, my sixth sense should return to normal, right?"
She licked her upper lip coldly: "Seems I'll have to use that special privilege I've never needed before on you."
The privilege she mentioned was what the middle-aged uncle had referred to earlier, though he hadn't explained fully.
The top three players could use special privileges - once every ten rounds.
Diamond Bachelor had maintained first place since Round 1.
Now that Round 26 ended, she could use her privilege twice.
This would be her first time using it... to eliminate a lab rat!!!
Early that morning, Shen Xing drove Zhou Wu's Mercedes to visit his parents' home.
Behind the wheel, she smiled as if something wonderful had happened.
On the passenger seat lay a stack of white documents - upon closer inspection, they were medical reports confirming pregnancy!
Yes, Shen Xing was pregnant with Zhou Wu's child!
Originally, she had planned that if Zhou Wu remained missing, she would need legitimate reason to stay in his household.
If she wasn't pregnant, she'd considered finding another man to impregnate her and claim it was Zhou Wu's.
After all, though Zhou Wu and his father were missing, their shares, money and assets remained!
Everything would go to Zhou Wu's mother.
And any child in her womb - boy or girl - would be of Zhou bloodline!
She stood to gain tremendously!
Especially if it was a boy - her position would be unshakable!
No wonder she was so happy!
So happy she completely disregarded Zhou Wu's disappearance!
Even better - she was already pregnant! And it was Zhou Wu's!
Zhou Wu's parents owned several properties.
Their primary residence was a luxury penthouse in an upscale community with prime location near downtown and beautiful surroundings.
Though Alice Apartment was nice, it couldn't compare in value.
Shen Xing drove smoothly into the upscale neighborhood and arrived at the penthouse.
Standing at the door, she held the pregnancy report in her right hand while using her left to adjust her facial muscles, transforming her earlier joy into sorrow.
After checking her melancholic expression in her phone camera and finding no flaws, she rang the doorbell.
The door opened to reveal a young woman she'd never seen before.Thɪs updatᴇd by No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
"Uh..."
Shen Xing froze, wondering if she'd come to the wrong place.
But a familiar voice from inside confirmed this was indeed Zhou Wu's parents' home.
Inside, Zhou Wu's mother - a middle-aged woman now with graying hair - lay half-asleep on the sofa, her spirit broken by her husband and son's disappearance.
Besides her, there was an unfamiliar young couple in their early twenties, dressed fashionably with an innate air of noble arrogance - the kind Shen Xing desperately wished she had but couldn't acquire no matter how wealthy she became.
"So you're Shen Xing? My brother's fiancée?" The 20-year-old girl scrutinized Shen Xing sharply.
"Yes, I'm Shen Xing, your brother's fiancée. Wait... you mean Zhou Wu is your brother? You must be Zhou Yan? His sister?"
Shen Xing stared in surprise. She'd heard Zhou Wu mention a sister studying abroad in America who hadn't returned even for their engagement.
She also remembered Zhou Wu saying if his sister were male, she'd undoubtedly inherit their father's legacy instead of him.
Because apart from being female, Zhou Yan surpassed Zhou Wu in every aspect - including looks.
Zhou Yan's sudden return filled Shen Xing with dread - was she here to claim the family assets?
Though she couldn't outright ask "Are you here to steal the inheritance?", Shen Xing turned to the tall handsome young man beside Zhou Yan: "And this is...?"
Zhou Yan glanced at him: "She's asking you."
The handsome youth smiled confidently: "Hello sister-in-law. My Chinese name is Li Miguo, English name Tom Lee. You can call me either."
"Zhou Yan and I are university classmates - currently in a relationship."
"I see. So why have you returned now?" As an experienced woman, Shen Xing could tell from their body language they were intimate.
"With my father and brother missing, don't you think as part of this family I should return? Or would that be improper?" Zhou Yan replied with palpable disdain.
For some reason, from Zhou Yan's mannerisms, Shen Xing sensed the young woman looked down on her.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: The American Detective Hired by Zhou Yan and Her Partner
chapters.content:
Shen Xing said at this moment, "Oh, this matter? Your brother and uncle's disappearance—Auntie and I have already reported it to the police. The cases have been merged now, and they'll notify us if there's any news. I believe Auntie has already told you."
Zhou Yan replied indifferently, "I've heard everything from my mom."
"By the way, Shen Xing, what's that in your hand?"
Shen Xing was genuinely annoyed by the girl before her.
At the very least, she was already engaged to Zhou Yan's brother and would be her future sister-in-law. Even if she didn't call her "sister-in-law," calling her "sister" wouldn't be too much to ask, right?
Yet here she was, addressing her directly by name.
"Oh, it's my pregnancy report. I just found out I'm pregnant."
Hearing this, Zhou Yan crossed her arms and sneered, "Oh? Pregnant? Is it my brother's?"
Shen Xing grew angry at this. "If it's not your brother's, whose could it be?"
If she had really been impregnated by someone else, she might have faltered under such questioning. But unfortunately for Zhou Yan, this was indeed Zhou Wu's child.Zhou Yan continued to sneer. "It's just too coincidental that you suddenly turn up pregnant at such a critical juncture."
Shen Xing was truly furious now. "Are you suggesting your brother's disappearance has something to do with me? That I caused it?"
Zhou Yan shrugged. "Who knows?"
"Alright, alright, stop arguing."
At this point, Zhou Wu's mother rose from the sofa, putting an end to the squabble.
She addressed both Shen Xing and Zhou Yan:
"Xiao Xing, don't mind Zhou Yan. She's always been like this since childhood. Please bear with her."
"And Xiao Yan, she'll be your sister-in-law in the future. Show her some respect."
Shen Xing appeared obedient. "I understand, Auntie."
But Zhou Yan merely snorted and fell silent.
"Since everyone's here, let's have lunch together at home. Consider it a rare reunion meal, even though your father and brother aren't here and are missing..."
"I'll go buy groceries."
Zhou Wu's mother stood up with a sigh.
"Auntie, shall I go with you?"
Shen Xing transformed into the perfect attentive daughter-in-law.
But Zhou Wu's mother waved her off. "No need, I'll go alone. I want some time to myself."
Thus, when Zhou Wu's mother left to buy groceries, only Shen Xing, Zhou Yan, and Li Miguo remained in the spacious apartment.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Standing before the floor-to-ceiling windows that offered a clear view outside, Zhou Yan looked down at the scene below.
In a tone that brooked no refusal, she said to Shen Xing, "Shen Xing, although I've heard from my mom about my dad and brother's disappearance and how it all happened, I need to hear it from you too, since you were involved."
"If you want to find my brother quickly and marry him, be as detailed as possible."
"Of course, if this is all part of your scheme and you don't want my brother found—if you're just after our family's money—rest assured, even if you're carrying his child, you won't get a single cent."
Her calm words carried a tsunami of threat.
Truth be told, Shen Xing genuinely disliked Zhou Yan. But one thing Zhou Yan said was correct—she also wanted to find Zhou Wu as soon as possible.
So despite her dislike for Zhou Yan, she recounted everything she knew.
After Shen Xing finished explaining the whole story, Zhou Yan turned to Li Miguo beside her.
"What do you think?"
Li Miguo smiled confidently. "Something's fishy. Extremely fishy. It feels like their disappearance is straight out of a ghost story."
Zhou Yan also smiled. "That's what I think too. So how do we find my dad and brother?"
Li Miguo replied, "I'll need to call my friend Jimmy over to brainstorm. And have him bring an American detective along."
Zhou Yan asked, "Are American detectives reliable?"
Li Miguo spread his hands helplessly. "You know I'm an overseas Chinese who grew up in America. I'm not familiar with detectives here in China. If you prefer, you could find one locally."
Zhou Yan shook her head. "Forget it. I don't have any connections with local detectives either."
Throughout their discussion about finding a detective, Shen Xing listened quietly nearby.
The two spoke without any attempt to hide their conversation from her.
She wondered—was this trust? Or did they simply consider her insignificant, as if she didn't exist?
Three days later.
Shen Xing drove Zhou Wu's Mercedes, with Zhou Yan in the passenger seat.
In the back sat three men.
Given their large builds, the three men were quite cramped in the back seat.
The first man was Li Miguo, the overseas Chinese who had grown up in America.
The second was a white man in his early twenties—Jimmy, the friend Li Miguo had mentioned.
The last man, in his thirties with typically white features like Jimmy, was the detective Li Miguo had asked Jimmy to find.
The detective kept his eyes closed throughout the ride, as if meditating.
The Mercedes soon arrived at Alice Apartment.
After smoothly passing through the gate barrier, it drove in and parked beside the black Maybach that Zhou Wu had driven, which belonged to his father.
The five of them got out of the car.
"This apartment isn't bad. My useless brother might have been a failure since childhood, but at least his taste is still intact."
After getting out of the passenger seat, Zhou Yan assessed the apartment building and its surroundings before offering her evaluation.
Li Miguo nodded in agreement. "This is my first time in China. I've only heard about it from my parents or read things online. They said China was quite backward, but seeing is believing—it's not quite what they described! Take this apartment, for example. It's beautiful! There's a kind of minimalist elegance to it!"
Zhou Yan said, "How long has it been since your parents came back? Their ideas are stuck in the past. The country has developed rapidly in recent years."
Naturally, their visit to Alice Apartment wasn't to tour Zhou Wu and Shen Xing's future marital home.
They were there to investigate the disappearances of Zhou Wu and his father.
After Jimmy and the American detective he'd brought arrived, Zhou Yan and Li Miguo had explained the whole story of the two disappearances.
Upon hearing this, the American detective said he wanted to check the apartment's surveillance footage from the day of the disappearance.
Thus, under Shen Xing's guidance, the group came to Alice Apartment.
They easily found the apartment manager, Xiao Zhang, on the first floor and requested to check the surveillance footage.
Xiao Zhang readily agreed without any objections.
Soon, in the surveillance room, the group began reviewing footage from when Zhou Wu's father disappeared.
Zhou Wu's father—the middle-aged man who was Li Mengmeng's sugar daddy.
The actual surveillance footage should have shown him receiving a call from his wife, leaving Li Mengmeng's apartment, taking the elevator to the first floor, and then being struck dead by an unknown psychopath dressed as a chainsaw murderer.
But what Zhou Yan and the others saw in the surveillance footage was completely different.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: American Detective Mike, One of the Next Round's Lab Rats
chapters.content:
The surveillance footage they were currently viewing showed the following:
Zhou Wu's father leaving Li Mengmeng's apartment and taking the elevator.
After exiting the elevator, he smoothly passed through the automatic glass doors, then proceeded to the apartment's ground-level parking area, drove away from Alice Apartment, and the footage ended there.
After watching this footage, Zhou Yan said: "It seems we'll need to check other surveillance cameras to trace my father's disappearance, preferably traffic cameras along the route he drove, to identify the last location where he was captured on camera."
"Alright, now let's look at the footage of my brother's disappearance!"
After saying this, she reached for the mouse to view Zhou Wu's disappearance footage, but her arm was stopped by the American detective seated in front of the computer. Since he was leading the investigation, he occupied the chair while everyone else stood nearby.
"What are you doing?" Zhou Yan asked in confusion, looking at the American detective.
The American detective responded: "All your earlier deductions were wrong. This surveillance footage has been tampered with." He spoke in flawless Chinese without any foreign accent.
Zhou Yan, Li Miguo, and Jimmy were all astonished—not by the detective's Chinese proficiency, which they'd already been impressed by during previous interactions, but by his claim that Zhou Yan's deductions were completely wrong and that the footage had been altered.
"You're saying all my deductions were wrong? The footage has been tampered with? How? It clearly shows my father driving away from Alice Apartment!" Zhou Yan's competitive personality made her assertive with everyone, carrying a somewhat domineering, queen-like attitude.The American detective then rewound the footage to when Zhou Wu's father exited the elevator on the first floor. Instead of making them guess, he directly pointed out the issue: "Haven't you noticed that from the moment this middle-aged man exited the elevator, we only ever see his back? His face is never shown."
"This... now that you mention it... that's true!" Zhou Yan, who had initially been skeptical of the detective, carefully rewatched the footage showing her father exiting the elevator, passing through the automatic doors, and driving away. She realized the detective was absolutely right—from that point onward, the footage only showed her father's back, never his face. This was clearly abnormal.
Upon closer inspection, while the figure's clothing and silhouette resembled her father's, subtle differences became apparent upon meticulous examination. For instance, Zhou Wu's father had a slight rightward lean when walking, which this figure imitated, but the imitation appeared unnatural and forced.
Li Miguo stroked his chin thoughtfully: "This means the footage has been edited. Everything after your father reached the first floor and exited the elevator is fabricated, including the driving away. So he didn't disappear outside as we thought, but rather within the apartment building itself!"
The American detective nodded approvingly: "Very astute. You grasped it immediately."
Zhou Yan frowned after hearing this conclusion: "Then who edited the footage and impersonated my father?"
"That remains unknown, which is precisely why I'm here to investigate," the detective replied solemnly.
Ever since receiving Jimmy's commission and arriving in China, after hearing the full accounts of both father and son's disappearances, his years of detective experience told him both cases were inextricably linked to Alice Apartment. That's why he'd insisted on reviewing the surveillance footage—and had immediately uncovered issues.
Having examined Zhou Wu's father's disappearance footage, they proceeded to Zhou Wu's case.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
The actual circumstances of Zhou Wu's disappearance were as follows: He returned home during daytime, entered apartment 404, and never came out. Then around midnight, the young security guard Xiao Xing sneaked into 404 and carried Zhou Wu out to his own room.
However, the footage they were reviewing showed something entirely different: Zhou Wu returning during daytime and entering 404, with everything appearing normal, including no footage of Xiao Xing carrying him out at midnight—that segment was completely missing. Then at around 11 AM, Shen Xing left to find Zhou Wu at the factory to return his phone.
This discrepancy was why Li Miguo had sensed something profoundly amiss when Shen Xing first recounted the disappearances—it felt supernatural, like ghosts were involved. After all, Shen Xing, Zhou Wu's mother, and the police had all reviewed this same footage before, showing the exact same inexplicable disappearance without any record of people entering or exiting the apartment. Wasn't that ghostly?
"Great detective, what do you make of this footage?" Zhou Yan asked, her tone mixing genuine inquiry with challenge, as she was completely baffled by the video.
The American detective, intently scrutinizing the replaying footage, replied: "You can call me by name—I'm Mike. Also, this footage has also been edited."
He continued with certainty: "You're fortunate Jimmy found me. Both Zhou Wu and his father's footage were altered with extremely sophisticated techniques that most people couldn't detect without professional equipment."
"Oh, so this one was edited too? Besides that, any other findings?" Given their earlier discovery about Zhou Wu's father's footage, this new revelation wasn't surprising.
"Nothing more. The editing only confirms your brother also disappeared within this apartment. The rest requires further investigation."
Exchanging glances with Li Miguo, Zhou Yan pressed: "How long until you can uncover the truth?"
Mike exhaled slowly: "Uncertain. But my fees aren't time-based—they depend on case difficulty. If I fail, you only pay for my flight and living expenses, so don't worry."
Zhou Yan waved her hand: "No, it's not about money—I'm not short on funds. I mean I need you to find my father and brother as quickly as possible."
Suddenly Mike said: "Bring the manager here."
Zhou Yan was taken aback: "Why him?"
Mike explained: "Since you're in such a hurry, I'll begin investigating immediately. First I need to question him."
Soon, Manager Xiao Zhang was summoned. Upon entering, his gaze kept drifting to Jimmy and Detective Mike's faces—probably because he rarely encountered foreigners.
"Hello, Xiao Zhang. I'd like to ask: Is this surveillance room always locked? Besides you, who else has keys?"
The manager seemed overly familiar with such questions. Waving his hand, he said: "You're all so serious—I thought something major was happening! Just more of these same questions."
Mike and the others looked puzzled.
Xiao Zhang clarified: "The police have asked me similar questions countless times—I know the drill by heart, no need to be surprised. I'll just tell you everything you want to know upfront to save time."

chapters.title: Chapter 92: The 27th Round Begins
chapters.content:
Manager Xiao Zhang continued: "This monitoring room is usually locked, with only one key that I keep. But since the monitoring room isn't used much, I usually leave the key on my desk in the management office. If someone really took it to secretly open the monitoring room or made a copy without my knowledge, there's nothing I could do about it."
Having gotten the answers he needed, Xiao Zhang was allowed to leave. Only Mike and his team remained.
At this moment, Zhou Yan stepped out of the monitoring room, looked around outside for a while, then came back in. She said to Mike: "Mike, I just noticed there are cameras outside the monitoring room too. Check who entered the monitoring room during the time after my father and brother disappeared."
Zhou Yan offered her suggestion, but Mike shook his head: "Won't help. Whoever edited the footage would have thought of that too - they definitely edited out their own appearances in the monitoring room footage as well."
Despite saying this, Mike still checked. As expected, nothing useful was found.
"This is indeed a tricky case, but don't worry - I've handled trickier ones before." Mike stood up and said to Zhou Yan: "Starting now, I need to stay in apartment 404 for some time to facilitate my investigation."
Zhou Yan immediately agreed: "Absolutely no problem. Let me know if you need anything else."
While Zhou Yan agreed, Shen Xing jumped in to object: "I oppose this! That's supposed to be your brother and my future marital home. How can we let someone else live there?"
Zhou Yan looked Shen Xing up and down dismissively, curling her lips: "Shen Xing, be reasonable. While it's true this apartment was meant to be your marital home with my brother, did you contribute any money to buying it?"
Shen Xing was momentarily speechless, but soon began defending herself: "Fine, he can stay there. But have you considered where I'm supposed to live if he moves in?"Zhou Yan replied: "You can stay there with Mike."
Shen Xing's face twisted with anger. Eventually, it was Zhou Yan's boyfriend Li Miguo who mediated: "How about this, Shen Xing - you go upstairs and pack your things, stay somewhere else temporarily. This is all to find Zhou Yan's brother, your fiancé. Please be understanding - surely you want to find him soon too?"
In the end, Shen Xing couldn't win against Zhou Yan. After everyone went upstairs, she packed her personal belongings and vacated apartment 404 for Mike.
Shen Xing only packed roughly, taking about two hours. After that, Mike stayed in 404 with the keys, while Shen Xing took her personal belongings and drove off in the Mercedes to find temporary accommodation.
She was quite clever about it - decent places cost money, and she wouldn't settle for anything inferior. Plus, now that she was pregnant with Zhou Wu's child, she planned to move in with Zhou Wu's mother during this period.
As for Zhou Yan, Li Miguo, and Li Miguo's classmate Jimmy, they didn't ride in the Mercedes that Shen Xing had driven them in. They seemed to have other plans, so they waited by the roadside outside the apartment for a ride-hailing car.
"Jimmy, is this detective you found reliable?" Zhou Yan asked the white boy Jimmy.
Both Jimmy and Li Miguo stood at 185cm tall, looking even taller at about 187cm with shoes on. Their handsome appearances made them quite a striking sight standing together.
"Don't worry, Mike is one of the top ten private detectives in the entire U.S. Do you know what his minimum fee is for taking a case?"
That Mike the detective could speak Chinese wasn't too surprising - after all, he wouldn't take cases here without knowing the language. But Jimmy, an American, speaking Chinese was quite unexpected for just a regular college student. According to Jimmy himself, he had great interest in China's long history and culture, so he learned the language on his own.
"How much?" Zhou Yan asked curiously.
Jimmy held up one finger.
Zhou Yan said carelessly: "$10,000 USD?"
Jimmy shook his head.
Zhou Yan exclaimed: "$100,000 USD? That's about 700,000 Chinese yuan - quite expensive indeed."
Jimmy shook his head again.
This time Zhou Yan's eyes widened: "Don't tell me - $1 million USD?!"
Jimmy finally nodded: "Exactly $1 million USD, and that's just the minimum fee. It's practically priceless - without my connection, you couldn't hire a detective of Mike's caliber even with years of advance booking!"
Zhou Yan still looked shocked. $1 million USD equaled about 7 million Chinese yuan - and that was just the minimum fee! Even as a wealthy heiress, she felt the pinch, never expecting the detective to cost so much.
"Jimmy, you said that's the minimum price - how much is he charging for our case?" Zhou Yan asked again, mainly worried Mike might demand several million dollars later - tens of millions of yuan. That would be significant even for her family.
"Relax, it's a friends-and-family discount - just $1 million USD," Jimmy said with a bright smile.
Zhou Yan exhaled in relief, easing her tension. Jimmy then said: "Alright, leave your father and brother's case to Mike. Let's the three of us go have some fun! We're here after all!"
Zhou Yan nodded: "Fine, I'll play host and show you two around!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Jiang Ran's Betting Amount Reaches an Astonishing 150 Million
chapters.content:
Middle-aged Uncle fell silent for a moment before sighing: "You're right. The benevolent don't become rich, and the rich don't remain benevolent. If I had truly practiced benevolence, I wouldn't have reached my current status."
I am the Hero chimed in: "Alright everyone, no need to argue. After all, who hasn't done something bad? We all know the truth in our hearts."
"What I'm curious about is this young man's name - Wang Anjian. I remember a female orphan named Li Anjian trending on Douyin recently. Tragically, she also passed away from cancer."
The long-haired beautiful host stopped introducing and glanced at her black tablet, appearing thoughtful as she read the crazy comments flooding the live stream room.
Putting down the tablet, she continued:
"The final subject, Test Subject No.5, is the most special one in this round."
"His name is Mike, male, 33 years old, American. His profession is detective. Notably, he ranks 10th on America's detective rankings. Unlike others, he didn't sign any agreement with us. Similar to Jiang Ran and Zhou Wu, he entered through different means. But there's a key difference - he came with a specific purpose."
"Can anyone guess why this American detective entered Alice Apartment?"
In the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid commented: "Since he didn't sign an agreement, it definitely wasn't for money. Of course, 10,000 per day is a fortune for most people, but insignificant for someone like him. I have an American friend.""My friend's father recently discovered his new mistress was pregnant. He hired the 20th ranked American detective to find out who cuckolded him. Just for that simple investigation, the fee was 500,000 USD. Imagine what the 10th ranked would charge! So money couldn't be his motive."
"As a famous detective, he must be investigating something or working for someone!"
On screen, the long-haired host nodded with a smile: "Correct! Let me reveal the answer directly."
"This Mike was hired by Zhou Wu's younger sister, Zhou Yan, to investigate the disappearances of her father and brother."
Middle-aged Uncle reacted: "So that's it? His family actually has a sister! But both men are already dead! One killed by the chainsaw murderer, the other by Xiao Xing. What's there to investigate? Their bodies are gone! Well... except his brother's head might still be found."
Domineering Female CEO added: "So many detectives recently. Hope this one isn't like that counterfeit Conan last time - what was his name? Ke Bei? Still locked up now."
I am the Hero replied: "This guy's skills definitely surpass Ke Bei's. After all, he's America's 10th best detective!"
Little Aunt excitedly commented: "Fascinating! Absolutely fascinating! This round just got interesting again! A detective of this caliber is a first for Alice Apartment!"
"Brilliant! Who will survive - the famous detective or all the psychopathic criminals in the apartment?"
Then Ultimate Rich Kid asked: "Host sister, I have a question. Since Mike is staying at Alice Apartment as a test subject, how will he receive his 10,000 daily payment?"
The long-haired host smiled slightly: "That's for you all to decide."
The live stream erupted:
"What? We decide? What's there to decide about this?"
"Yeah, just give him the money. No need for us to decide, right? Any excuse would work."
The host raised her hand: "Everyone quiet, please let me finish."
"We're offering two options:"
"First: Transfer 10,000 daily directly to his bank account like other contracted residents."
"Second: Like Jiang Ran and Zhou Wu, find another pretext to deliver or compensate the money."
The options seemed similar - both involved paying 10,000 per successful day of residence. Yet there were subtle differences.
Middle-aged Uncle voiced his opinion: "I support the first option. If this American detective Mike were truly like Jiang Ran and Zhou Wu, we'd choose the second option - find a suitable pretext."
"But Mike's different. He was hired to investigate. Since he's here to investigate anyway, why not go all out? Transfer the money directly and observe his reaction to sudden unexplained payments. Wouldn't that create better chemical reactions?"

chapters.title: Chapter 97: The Confrontation Between Mike and Qin Yi
chapters.content:
Round 27, Day 1. 9:00 AM.
Mike, ranked tenth on America’s detective leaderboard, was on the rooftop of Alice Apartment, holding a black telescope tightly with both hands, staring at some unknown direction.
After observing for several minutes, he put down the telescope.
He muttered in confusion,
“Strange, do the people living here never go out?”
Since then, Shen Xing was forced to give him access to apartment 404.
Mike had been staying here for four days.
During these four days, he thoroughly observed Alice Apartment from inside and out.
He found nothing special or particularly strange about Alice Apartment.
It was just a very ordinary high-end apartment complex.The only odd thing was that there were very few parked cars or other vehicles around.
Besides that, he couldn’t see any residents of Alice Apartment going outside.
No one going to work, doing business, or going out for fun?
Especially now, it was already 9 o’clock in the morning.
Not a single person had been seen leaving.
Even the security guards at the entrance were bored and dozing off.
This was the one thing Mike couldn’t understand.
Maybe it was because there weren’t many residents in Alice Apartment!
He decided to observe for a few more days.
Just at that moment, he suddenly heard footsteps behind him—the sharp clicking of high heels.
He put down the telescope and turned around, genuinely surprised.
He hadn’t expected the owner of those footsteps to be a stunningly beautiful Chinese woman with a great figure.
This Chinese beauty had long black wavy hair and was wearing a white camisole dress today.
Her fair and delicate collarbones and the fullness at her chest made it impossible to look away.
“Hello, do you speak Chinese?”
The Chinese beauty walked toward Mike, greeting him warmly and kindly.
“I do. What’s up, miss?”
“Oh, nothing. You just look unfamiliar. Are you a new resident here recently?”
The Chinese beauty asked.
Mike shrugged, “Not a resident. Just staying here temporarily.”
“Is that so?”
“Oh, I almost forgot to introduce myself. My name is Qin Yi. What’s yours?”
“My name is Mike.”
Indeed, this Chinese beauty was none other than Qin Yi!
“Oh, Mike, where are you from?”
“America.”
“Oh, America? It must be a fun place, right?”
Mike thought for a moment and said, “According to your saying, the land of the free, gunfights every day.”
Qin Yi let out a soft laugh, fully embodying a gentle lady.
At this moment, she pointed to a huge object beside Mike that looked like a monocular telescope and asked,
“What’s that?”
Mike answered, “It’s an astronomical telescope. I like stargazing, and the rooftop here is a great place for that.”
Indeed, besides the handheld telescope, Mike also had a decorative astronomical telescope by his side.
The purpose of the astronomical telescope was just an excuse.
Without this thing, how could he explain why a foreigner standing on the rooftop would often use a telescope to look at distant things?
He could easily be mistaken for a spy!
It might sound fantastical, but Mike knew a fellow detective.
That detective once accepted a case commissioned by Chinese nationals and investigated an incident here in China.
He was seen by enthusiastic locals holding a telescope and constantly watching unknown things.
People feared he was a spy and reported him to the police.
So Mike learned from that colleague’s lesson.
“Stars, huh? I like them too, but I’ve never used such professional equipment.”
“By the way, do you want some water?”
Qin Yi came over not empty-handed but carrying a supermarket plastic bag with several bottles of mineral water and drinks inside.
“No thanks, I’m not thirsty.”
Faced with such a beautiful woman offering water, Mike behaved unlike a man and actually refused.
Mike had a rule: he would never eat or drink anything given by strangers.
Why?
Because of the bloody lessons from other senior colleagues.
Of course, the current situation was different because the water was offered by a stunningly beautiful woman.
Although Mike was a foreigner and had different aesthetics from Chinese people, in his eyes, Qin Yi was definitely a super beauty.
Especially since Qin Yi’s figure was amazing, unlike many Chinese women who, despite having delicate faces, were stick-thin.
Mike did not like that stick-thin body type.
At this moment, Mike suddenly thought of his teacher.
His teacher was also a detective.
Even today, Mike felt that his teacher’s overall abilities far surpassed his own.
However, his teacher had a fatal flaw.
He was lustful.
Very much so!
Men being lustful was normal. It was common.
But his teacher’s obsession with women had reached a hopeless state.
To put it simply, if his teacher’s IQ was 200, when he encountered a beautiful woman, his IQ would instantly drop.
The more beautiful the woman, the more his IQ would fall.
No exaggeration, just speaking of the present moment, if his teacher met Qin Yi, his IQ would probably drop from 200 to 50.
Not an exaggeration.
For example, if Qin Yi offered water, his teacher would definitely accept it and drink it with a smiling face.
His teacher had more than one student. All of them used to tell their teacher not to become like an idiot when seeing women.
But it was useless.
In the end, their teacher’s detective career was ruined by a woman.
Therefore, Mike would never make the same lustful mistake.
“Don’t want water? How about a drink? This one tastes pretty good.”
Qin Yi saw Mike refuse her water and offered him a bottle of drink instead.
Mike still shook his head, “No thanks, I’m not thirsty. You drink it yourself.”
Qin Yi nodded and took back the drink.
After chatting a while longer with Mike, Qin Yi left the rooftop.
Mike didn’t suspect or pay too much attention to Qin Yi’s approach.
Because in China, he was often approached by enthusiastic local girls, so passionate it was scary. He remembered being stunned the first time it happened. After all, he looked very ordinary, not a handsome guy. Why would girls be so warm to him?
Of course, this time’s approach was different—this time it was a super beauty.
Nothing else.
Qin Yi returned to room 303.
After returning to 303, Qin Kelian saw her sister frowning and asked, “Sis, is that foreigner still on the rooftop?”
Qin Yi shook her head, “He is.”Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Qin Kelian was indifferent, “If he’s there, then why do you look so lost?”
Qin Yi sighed, “Because... I failed. It didn’t work.”
A flash of surprise appeared in Qin Kelian’s pretty eyes. She was originally lying on the sofa but suddenly sat up straight.
“Sis, don’t tell me that this new foreigner, like Jiang Ran, is immune to sedatives?”
Qin Yi shook her head, “No. It’s just that this guy didn’t accept my water or drink at all!”
Mike had been noticed by Qin Yi and Qin Kelian shortly after entering the apartment.
So this rooftop visit was a hunt.
There were sedatives in the water and drinks.
But unfortunately, the other party didn’t take the bait at all.
“What? Didn’t accept? Oh my god, sis, with your beauty, there actually exists a man who can resist?!”
Qin Kelian was utterly shocked!
Because this had never happened before.
No one had ever been able to resist her sister’s beauty and refuse water or drinks offered by such a super beauty!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Wu You and Wang Anjian
chapters.content:
Qin Yi rubbed the bridge of her nose between her eyes with her right hand, looking troubled as if trying to relieve tension.
"This is the first time I've encountered such a situation."
"Even accounting for different ethnicities having different beauty standards, unless he's blind, how could he not find me attractive?"
"There are several possibilities why he refused my gift."
"First, he's gay and completely uninterested in women."
"Second, he's not an ordinary person - his self-control and wariness of strangers are extreme. Could he be a special agent? A spy? Or perhaps one of those detectives often seen in novels?"
Qin Kelian giggled: "There's another possibility!"
When Qin Yi asked what, Qin Kelian suggested that perhaps Mike simply wasn't attracted to her sister's type, but might prefer someone like herself.
Of course, Qin Kelian was just joking around.
Qin Yi shook her head with a faint smile."Forget it. Ever since meeting Jiang Ran, nothing has gone smoothly for us."
Qin Kelian nodded in agreement: "True. Before him, we sisters never missed our mark. But now..."
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Middle-aged Uncle: [Though I didn't bet on Mike, I must admit this American detective ranked 10th nationally is truly impressive, actually resisting the Demoness Sisters' charms!]
Domineering Female CEO: [Actually it makes sense. Even as a woman, I find Qin Yi breathtakingly beautiful! But if Mike had fallen so easily, that would've made his national 10th ranking seem completely unearned!!!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Detectives really have it tough, resisting feminine charms and all. If I became a detective, I'd probably get fired immediately.]
Back on the rooftop:
Mike remained at his observation post, using binoculars to monitor the situation near the security guard booth at the main entrance.
Suddenly, he noticed two sedans arriving at the gate.
After stopping, one young man emerged from each vehicle. Both went to their trunks to retrieve suitcases before entering the main gate.
Mike observed that both appeared to be around 20 years old.
One was thin with a perpetually weary, worried expression.
The other seemed much more energetic, with a warm smile constantly playing on his lips.
"Are these two also residents? Their clothing looks ordinary, no designer brands - could they really afford this apartment?"
Having researched Alice Apartment's prices at 50,000 per square meter, and knowing China's income levels, Mike understood only wealthy individuals could afford living here.
Though curious about these seemingly out-of-place young men, Mike remained impassive, simply committing their appearances to memory.
Meanwhile, on the first floor:
Jiang Ran was discussing tonight's welcome party with Manager Xiao Zhang.
The welcome party would follow the usual format - Xiao Zhang would give a short speech, new residents would introduce themselves, followed by cake.
Currently, they were debating the cake situation.
Having received numerous complaints from residents tired of the same cake routine at every welcome party, Xiao Zhang wanted to change things up but wasn't sure what to do instead, hence consulting Jiang Ran.
Though Jiang Ran had only attended two welcome parties, even he could tell longtime residents were thoroughly sick of cake.
After some thought, he suggested barbecue skewers or fried snacks - or perhaps both.
Manager Xiao Zhang immediately loved the idea.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The only question was whether to order pre-made food from a restaurant or buy raw ingredients to grill themselves.
Just then, the two young men Mike had observed entered through the automatic glass doors with their suitcases.
Manager Xiao Zhang, mid-conversation with Jiang Ran, immediately went to greet them with a smile while Jiang Ran stood by observing.
From Xiao Zhang's subsequent introduction, Jiang Ran learned these were the new residents.
Xiao Zhang's spiel was nearly identical to what Jiang Ran had heard during his own first meeting, concluding with the standard reminder about the 7pm welcome party.
Observing the interactions, Jiang Ran noticed Wu You seemed disinterested in Xiao Zhang's chatter, standing silently without engaging, while Wang Anjian chatted and laughed easily.
Finally, Jiang Ran and Xiao Zhang escorted both to the elevator.
Inside the elevator:
Wu You stood motionless, gripping his suitcase handle tightly with a vacant stare.
His mind was filled with images of his emaciated father lying in a hospital bed and the crushing medical bills.
Suddenly, Wang Anjian beside him spoke up: "What a coincidence! On the road, my car was following yours the whole time. I thought we were just going the same way, never imagined we'd have the exact same destination."
Wu You glanced at Wang Anjian and gave a noncommittal grunt.
Undeterred by Wu You's lack of enthusiasm, Wang Anjian continued cheerfully: "What's wrong? You look so gloomy."
Wu You didn't respond, just stared blankly downward.
Wang Anjian laughed: "In life, you've got to keep smiling. Things are hard enough already - being miserable won't change anything."
He patted Wu You's shoulder: "Buddy, I can tell you're going through something. But look at me - I've got terminal cancer. Doctors say I won't last three months. Normally, shouldn't I be moping around crying every day? But no, I choose to stay positive and keep smiling. So you should smile more too."
At these words, Wu You's expression shifted - not to happiness, but to confusion and disbelief.
This Wang Anjian struck him as incredibly strange.
They'd just met today - complete strangers - yet he was spouting all this encouragement?
If they'd been old friends or classmates, maybe. But they weren't.
As for Wang Anjian's claim of having terminal cancer?
Wu You frankly didn't believe it. The man looked perfectly healthy.
Even less believable was someone with months to live remaining so cheerful and optimistic.
He knew firsthand - his father was the one with cancer, not even himself. Yet he'd dropped from 150 pounds to 120, constantly drowning in grief and worry.
Clearly this guy was lying through his teeth.
Still, for the stranger's attempted kindness, Wu You managed a quiet:
"Thanks."

chapters.title: Chapter 99: You Must Return at Night
chapters.content:
Wu You lived on a lower floor than Wang Anjian, so Wang Anjian watched Wu You exit the elevator first before stepping out himself.The source of thɪs content is
Wang Anjian lived on the 7th floor, room 704.
When he reached the 7th floor, the hallway was silent. He dragged along his white, battered suitcase that had accompanied him through countless hardships over the years.
Arriving at room 704, he used the key given by Manager Xiao Zhang to open the door.
Upon entering, just like Jiang Ran's first time entering room 304,
He was astonished, completely amazed, never expecting the apartment to be so beautifully decorated.
Wang Anjian carefully inspected every corner, examining everything inside and out.
Suddenly he let out a bitter laugh: "Never thought I'd get to live in such a nice place during my final days. Guess my life has achieved some small measure of completion."
Wang Anjian took out the contents of his suitcase and quickly settled in.
He didn't have many belongings - just some change of clothes and personal toiletries.After finishing, he lay down on the living room's soft sofa, closing his eyes to soak in the feeling.
His sprawled-out posture was quite undignified.
He remained like this for a good ten minutes.
Then he sat up and took out his phone.
It was an old smartphone from years ago.
In this era of full-screen displays, his device wasn't even full-screen, but an outdated "relic."
However, this relic showed signs of careful maintenance, still appearing relatively new.
He turned on the phone and opened the Peach Shopping app.
Anyone standing behind him to see his phone screen would have been utterly shocked!
Because on his personal page of the Peach Shopping app,
The "To Be Shipped" section showed a red number: 223.
While "To Be Received" displayed: 378.
For an individual, calling him a "delivery fanatic" wouldn't be an exaggeration.
But the truth was, none of these hundreds of packages were for him.
They were all purchases for others.
These deliveries would ultimately reach completely different addresses - all sorts of places.
Many were locations most people would never hear of in their lifetimes.
Yet these were all places Wang Anjian had visited and volunteered to teach at.
Most packages contained clothes, secondhand books, new notebooks, stationery, backpacks and similar items, all gifts for children in those areas.
Why did Wang Anjian volunteer to teach and buy things for these children?
Was it to add an impressive line to his resume?
Lay groundwork for his future?
Or because there were benefits after volunteering?
Wrong - as a high school dropout, he didn't even qualify for formal volunteer programs.
He went there entirely on his own initiative, self-funded volunteer teaching.
Aside from free room and board, there was no salary - all expenses came from his own pocket.
Then if volunteering was already good enough, why spend his own money buying things for those children?
Simple - he thought they were pitiful and wanted to buy things for them.
Ultimately, why do this?
What motivated him?
The reason was simple - he was an orphan who grew up in unusual circumstances.
He had an open perspective, believing life was short and wanting to do something meaningful.
He didn't want to struggle for money or so-called better living standards - besides, he didn't think he had what it took to become successful.
So how to do something meaningful?
His abilities were limited, and teaching seemed the most accessible option.
Of course, when teaching those village children, he didn't expect them to change their fates through education.
That was too difficult - competition was too fierce.
He went simply hoping to teach them basic literacy.
At least they wouldn't be illiterate - it would make finding work easier, as being unable to read in modern society was too hard.
The items he most frequently bought online for these children were secondhand books.
He believed books, especially classic novels, allowed readers to experience other lives and things they'd never encounter - spiritual nourishment was important.
At this moment, Wang Anjian held three medical reports.
Reports from three different hospitals.
Sunlight shone through the papers, the dense black text resembling demonic writings.
When he first noticed physical abnormalities and got examined at a local hospital, doctors told him it was cancer - late stage.
His world collapsed, though part of him wondered if it was misdiagnosis.
After all, online advice suggested getting multiple opinions for serious illnesses.
But after visiting two more hospitals, including one in a major city,
He gave up hope.
"Sigh..."
Unlike his usual cheerful, smiling demeanor around others,
Wang Anjian now looked despondent, his calm expression masking deep sorrow.
Squinting, he set down the three reports.
Looking around his current surroundings, he recalled the mysterious middle-aged man he'd met days earlier,
And the agreement they'd signed.
"The 10,000 per day is probably real - this apartment alone proves that."
Wang Anjian didn't sign that 10,000-per-day agreement to earn treatment money.
He'd accepted his fate - late-stage cancer was incurable, despite doctors saying they'd try.
He didn't want to waste money on hospitals.
He wanted to spend it on meaningful causes.
Like using money to help others.
10,000 daily could accomplish so much if he really got it.
"Not again, the pain's starting..."
Suddenly, violent cramps wracked his entire body.
Within moments, Wang Anjian was sweating profusely from his forehead, teeth chattering, whimpering in pain, face and body contorted.
Gritting through the agony, he fumbled a white pill bottle from his suitcase.
Taking several pills, he swallowed them dry without waiting for water.
Painkillers.
He'd gotten many prescriptions and bought more himself.
They couldn't cure him, only alleviate cancer's pain.
......
Wang Anjian signed the agreement to earn money to help more people while he still could.
Wu You's motivation was simpler - to pay for his father's treatment.
At this moment, he'd just left a building.
Fiddling with his battered phone, he sent a message:
[Quick question - I need to care for my dad at the hospital during daytime. If I can't return to the apartment some nights, do I still get the 10,000 per day?]
The recipient was the middle-aged man he'd signed the agreement with.
The reply came within three minutes:
[You must return to sleep every night. Other times you can be away. Today is your first day - complete today and tomorrow to receive your first 10,000.]

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Wu You Missed the Welcome Party, Death Approaches Him
chapters.content:
Whether this agreement offering 10,000 yuan per day was real or fake, Wu You couldn't afford to hesitate. He desperately needed money right now - he'd even sell his own ass if someone would pay him!
So when that middle-aged man approached him with this seemingly heaven-sent agreement, Wu You didn't even stop to consider whether there might be hidden dangers or traps before signing it. He needed the money too badly. This agreement was his lifeline, preventing him from drowning in the whirlpool of financial desperation.
Leaving Alice Apartment, Wu You swiped his bus card to board the bus. Using the bus card saved money - a 1 yuan fare became just 0.8 yuan. Though it was only 0.2 yuan saved, every little bit counted.
The bus took him to the hospital stop. After getting off, he entered the hospital and navigated the familiar route to his father's ward. The shared ward was noisy with other patients. Though he'd seen his father's emaciated condition many times before, Wu You's eyes still reddened each time at the sight.
"Xiao You, you're here? I'll go to work then." A middle-aged woman with graying hair and a weathered face spoke hurriedly before leaving. That was his mother.
Their ordinary family of four had been devastated by his father's illness. With medical bills piling up, his mother couldn't afford to quit her job to care for his father full-time - she worked days and cared for him at night. That left daytime caregiving to Wu You, who had taken extended leave from vocational college without complaint, praying only for his father's recovery. His younger sister, facing middle school entrance exams, couldn't be pulled from her studies.
"I'm sorry, Xiao You... It's all my fault for getting sick, burdening you all..." His father's weak voice came from the bed as he looked at his exhausted son.
Wu You forced strength into his voice: "Don't say that. We're family - there's no such thing as a burden." As he struggled to hold back tears, a white-coated figure entered.
The doctor approached Wu You and opened his mouth to speak, but Wu You quickly stood up, pulling the doctor outside before he could say anything in front of his father.
"Is there something, doctor?" Wu You asked.The doctor replied coldly: "It's about the money again. You've been behind on payments for several days. If you can't settle the balance soon, we'll have to stop treatment and discharge your father."
Wu You had known this was coming - exactly why he'd pulled the doctor outside. His father suffered enough without this additional worry.
"Understood. I'll make the payment soon," Wu You said weakly.
The white-coated doctor walked away. Watching him go, Wu You's gaze swept over the other white-coated figures moving through the hallway. These supposedly life-saving doctors and nurses now seemed like demons to him, their white coats the skins of money-hungry monsters. The hospital itself felt like a demon's lair.
But where could he get money? Their savings were gone, relatives all tapped out... Wu You's chest tightened painfully as if he couldn't breathe.
His phone buzzed. Checking it, he saw a message from the Alice Apartment residents' group chat he'd recently joined. Manager Xiao Zhang had @'ed all members, including him and several others:ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Welcome party tonight at 7pm in the first-floor activity room. All new residents who were @'ed MUST attend. Old residents may come if they wish."
Wu You sighed deeply at the message. He'd go if he had time, skip it if not.
Time passed quickly. Before he knew it, 7pm arrived - the welcome party's scheduled start time.
Jiang Ran normally finished work at 4:30pm, but because of the welcome party, he was working overtime for the first time since starting here. Manager Xiao Zhang had promised 50 yuan per extra hour - compensation Jiang Ran was happy to accept.
This was his third welcome party. The first time he'd attended as a new resident, the second as an old resident coming for fun. Now he stood at the side of the activity room as apartment staff, assisting Manager Xiao Zhang.
Manager Xiao Zhang stood at the front of the room now, wearing a warm smile as he addressed the mix of new and old residents: "Welcome everyone to tonight's welcome party! We have four new residents joining us - let's give them a warm round of applause!"
The crowd clapped enthusiastically, though no one knew who had started the applause.
"Now, as per tradition, our new residents will introduce themselves first. Let's welcome our first new resident!"
Manager Xiao Zhang gestured toward a muscular man in a black tank top sitting in the chairs. All eyes turned toward the fitness instructor as he stood confidently.
"Hello everyone, I'm Sun Yijie, a fitness trainer. Feel free to come to me for any training needs." After his brief introduction, Sun Yijie sat back down.
Murmurs rose from the old residents: "Wow, a muscular guy - we don't often get that type of new resident." "Yeah, look at those muscles! So buff!" Sun Yijie ignored the comments - he'd heard such things too often to care.
"Next, let's have our second new resident introduce themselves," Manager Xiao Zhang said. But unlike his decisive gesture toward Sun Yijie earlier, now his hand waved uncertainly through the air as if searching for someone.
"Wait... where's Wu You?" Manager Xiao Zhang's eyes darted around the room like radar, scanning every face but failing to find that particular weary expression. He called Wu You's name several times, but got no response.
Jiang Ran, standing nearby, suggested: "Maybe he's not coming? Or running late?"
Manager Xiao Zhang kept smiling: "Let's hope he's just late, not skipping it entirely. Well then, let's move to our next new resident!"
His finger pointed toward Wang Anjian, who stood up to introduce himself: "Hello everyone, I'm Wang Anjian, currently unemployed. I used to be a volunteer teacher."

chapters.title: Chapter 101: The Psychopathic Serial Killer - The Clown
chapters.content:
"A volunteer teacher?"
Hearing this, Jiang Ran couldn't help but feel admiration for Wang Anjian.
After all, regardless of the reasons for becoming a volunteer teacher,
it ultimately helped many children in impoverished mountainous areas learn to read and write.
After Wang Anjian finished introducing himself,
Manager Xiao Zhang said, "Next up is our last participant - a lovely foreign friend!!!"
Xiao Zhang's gaze turned toward Mike, who was sitting with his arms crossed.
Hearing this, Mike exhaled and stood up to introduce himself:
"Hello everyone, I'm Mike, from America, doing foreign trade business here."
Mike said this half-truthfully as he stood up.Mike then looked around the room before finally fixing his gaze on Manager Xiao Zhang.
To be honest, he was quite speechless.
Before this welcome party started, Manager Xiao Zhang had suddenly gone up to the rooftop to find him,
insisting that he attend the welcome event.
