"Dissociative identity disorder? Was this diagnosed at another hospital? Or is this self-diagnosed?"
Jiang Ran nodded: "Already diagnosed. At another hospital."
Bai Xiaoliang: "How long have you had it?"
Jiang Ran: "A long time."
Bai Xiaoliang: "Specifically?"
Jiang Ran thought for a moment: "Probably since I became self-aware."
Bai Xiaoliang had the red-contact-lens nurse record this on the computer while he continued questioning:
"So since childhood then? Any family history of mental illness—parents or relatives?"
Jiang Ran shook his head: "Don't know. I'm an orphan."
Jiang Ran had been an orphan on Earth before transmigrating here—only to be an orphan again.
Bai Xiaoliang nodded: "Understood. Since this is your first visit here, we'll need to run some tests to confirm the dissociative identity disorder diagnosis. Other hospitals' diagnoses can only serve as reference."
"There's a payment machine outside. Go pay first, then come back."
Jiang Ran had no objections—starting fresh with tests at a new hospital was standard procedure.
At the payment machine outside, Jiang Ran saw the itemized fees totaling over 400 yuan.
His wallet ached in protest.
After paying, he returned to the examination room.
The red-contact-lens nurse clipped a small device to Jiang Ran's left index finger—a heart rate monitor.
Then she pulled out several printed forms filled with text from a drawer.
Jiang Ran knew exactly what these were.
Assessment scales and questionnaires.
Specifically designed for testing mental disorders.
And these were specialized for dissociative identity disorder.
Jiang Ran first picked up the dissociative identity disorder assessment scale.
It contained numerous questions requiring responses.
For example, the first item:
I enjoy reading sports magazines.
Followed by options: [Yes] and [No].
If he liked reading them, he'd check "Yes";
if not, "No".
If uncertain, he could leave it blank—though leaving too many blanks was discouraged.
Bai Xiaoliang said: "You're probably familiar with these, having been to other hospitals. But I must remind you—"
"There are no right answers. Answer completely truthfully based on your situation. Everyone's different, so don't feel pressured."
"Also, don't overthink each question—just go with your first instinct and actual circumstances."
Jiang Ran nodded and began answering under the monitoring of the finger-clipped heart rate device.
The following questions were diverse.
Like: [My mother is a good person.]
Jiang Ran left this blank—being an orphan, he'd never met his mother.
Another question: [I want to be a singer.]
Jiang Ran checked "No".
[Sometimes I really want to swear.]
"No".
[I cough frequently.]
"No".
[It would be perfect if all laws disappeared.]
"No".
[Sometimes I feel ghosts around me.]
"No".
Jiang Ran kept swiftly answering.
These assessment tools weren't all yes/no types.
There were multiple-choice questions too.
For example:
[What do you hate/dislike most?]
[A: Having girlfriend stolen by best friend]
[B: Getting fired]
[C: Seeing boss harass female employees]
Jiang Ran chose A.
With many question types and numerous items, Jiang Ran spent nearly an hour completing everything.
Bai Xiaoliang collected the completed forms and said:The source of this content ɪs NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"Go pay at the door again, then get an EEG and MRI."
Jiang Ran nodded.
He'd done both tests at other hospitals before.
EEGs monitored brain activity while MRIs examined brain structure—both assisted in confirming mental disorders like dissociative identity disorder.
Before leaving for the tests, Jiang Ran glimpsed Bai Xiaoliang scoring the assessments with a pen.
The two tests took an hour.
When Jiang Ran returned, Bai Xiaoliang was waiting—the EEG and MRI results had automatically transmitted to his computer without physical copies.
Assuming the examinations were over, Jiang Ran was surprised when Bai Xiaoliang announced one final test unlike any at previous hospitals.
"Jiang Ran, we'll conduct one last test now. Are you ready?"
Bai Xiaoliang stood up calmly.
Jiang Ran was puzzled: "Another test? What kind?"
Bai Xiaoliang said: "Just follow my instructions—you'll see soon enough."
He had Jiang Ran lie on a couch in the corner.
Then Bai Xiaoliang pulled out an old-fashioned pocket watch from his coat.
"So it's hypnosis!"
Jiang Ran suddenly understood—the pocket watch instantly made him think of hypnosis, thanks to TV and movie stereotypes.
Bai Xiaoliang nodded: "Done this before?"
Jiang Ran shook his head: "No."
Though he'd seen psychiatrists and psychologists in his past life, perhaps because they were ordinary-level practitioners, he'd never undergone hypnosis therapy.
Bai Xiaoliang reassured: "Don't worry—hypnosis is quite pleasant."
"Just keep your eyes on this pocket watch and follow my instructions."

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Hypnosis Ineffective
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran was already leaning back in the recliner at this moment.
After confirming the surroundings were quiet, Bai Xiaoliang held a pocket watch and gently swung it left and right in front of Jiang Ran’s eyes.
As the pocket watch swayed, it emitted a rhythmic, soothing buzzing sound.
This involuntarily caused Jiang Ran’s entire body to enter an extremely relaxed state.
Jiang Ran’s eyes followed the left and right movement of the pocket watch, rotating along with it.
Bai Xiaoliang then softly spoke in a warm male voice:
“What is your name?”
“Jiang Ran.”
“Gender?”
“Male.”“Age?”
“23 years old.”
“Occupation?”
“Apartment assistant manager.”
“What do you like to do most?”
“I don’t know…”
“Think carefully. Is there really nothing that makes you happy?”
“…When I get paid…”
“Good. Now imagine it’s payday, and you just received a huge amount of money. At the same time, the lottery ticket you bought won a million…”
Jiang Ran involuntarily entered this artificially created moment of happiness, his lips gently curling upward.
Next, Bai Xiaoliang asked several more questions, continuously guiding the hypnosis.
Finally, with a snap of his fingers, he said, “You’re very sleepy now, it’s time to sleep.”
Magically, Jiang Ran fell asleep.
But this sleep was not true sleep;
a certain level of consciousness was retained.
More precisely, it was a special state of consciousness.
At this point, Bai Xiaoliang began asking questions:
“Handsome guy, what is your name?”
Jiang Ran, eyes closed, said, “Jiang Ran.”
Hearing the correct answer, Bai Xiaoliang was suddenly stunned.
“How old are you this year?”
“23 years old.”
Bai Xiaoliang’s expression became somewhat serious:
“There should be other good friends inside your body, right? Let them come out for some fresh air. I want to talk to them. Get to know each other.”
After a few seconds, Bai Xiaoliang asked again: “What is your name?”
Jiang Ran said, “Jiang Ran.”
The hypnosis process continued for thirty minutes.
Finally, with another snap of his fingers, Jiang Ran woke up again.
Upon waking and opening his eyes, he immediately saw the serious face of Bai Xiaoliang.
Thinking something had happened, he asked, “Doctor, is my dissociative identity disorder very severe?”
Bai Xiaoliang slowly exhaled: “Mr. Jiang Ran, regarding your situation, I will give you a response within three days. Then please come to our hospital again. Of course, as compensation for not providing a definite treatment this time, you won’t need to pay the registration fee next time you come.”
Jiang Ran nodded after hearing this.
Although he didn’t understand the situation, not having to pay the registration fee felt great!
After all, Bai Xiaoliang’s registration fee was 300 yuan.
It was one of the highest registration fees in this hospital.
Jiang Ran was escorted out of the consultation room by the red-contact-lens nurse.
After sending Jiang Ran out, under Bai Xiaoliang’s instruction, the red-contact-lens nurse temporarily stopped accepting patients.
Faced with this situation, the red-contact-lens nurse looked puzzled:
“Doctor Bai, what’s going on? This is the first time I’ve seen you like this. Is that patient named Jiang Ran very troublesome?”
Bai Xiaoliang’s face was heavy.
He said, “Based on the current situation alone, he might be the most special patient I’ve ever encountered in my career.”
The red-contact-lens nurse was very surprised.
Though Bai Xiaoliang was young, only 30 years old, he had actually earned his doctorate degree at 22.
He was an absolute genius among geniuses.
He studied and worked in the United States and also worked in other countries, accumulating numerous honors and awards.
Eventually, he achieved great success and returned to China.
As of now, Bai Xiaoliang was undoubtedly the top figure in treating mental illnesses in the country.
On a global scale, he was among the world’s elite in this field.
If this hospital wasn’t founded by his father, Bai Xiaoliang wouldn’t even be here.
Therefore, for Bai Xiaoliang to say Jiang Ran was possibly the most special patient he had encountered in his career showed its weight.
At this moment, Bai Xiaoliang sat in front of the computer in the consultation room, the same seat where the red-contact-lens nurse usually sat.
He operated the computer, which currently displayed several test report images.
He said, “From the EEG and MRI scans, Jiang Ran’s brain indeed shows abnormalities—very significant abnormalities—completely different from ordinary people.”
“But from the scales and questionnaires he completed, the final scores were completely normal.”
“The scales and questionnaires I administered to him.”
“The scale ranges from 0 to 50 points;
normal is under 50, while 70 to 80 points indicates a high risk of dissociative identity disorder.”
“His scale score was 20 points. Normal.”
“The questionnaire ranges from 0 to 90 points;
normal is under 90, while exceeding 90 indicates danger.”
“His questionnaire score was 49 points, also normal.”
“Of course, these are just auxiliary indicators.”
“My proudest skill is my hypnosis technique.”
“I have treated many patients.”
“Especially patients with dissociative identity disorder—I’ve encountered quite a few.”
“Every time I hypnotize someone, I can successfully communicate with the other personalities inside their body. I’ve never failed.”
“But today, Xiaotong, as you saw, I failed. It was Jiang Ran alone talking to me back and forth—none of his other personalities appeared.”
“There are only two possible explanations for this.”
“First, Jiang Ran is not a dissociative identity disorder patient, so naturally, I couldn’t awaken other personalities for dialogue.”
“Second, Jiang Ran’s main personality is overwhelmingly strong, easily suppressing all other personalities, so hypnosis can’t affect him.”
“To be honest, I myself think the second possibility is impossible.”
“Because when I was in the United States, under FBI orders, I hypnotized a deranged serial killer responsible for at least a hundred deaths.”
“That guy was terrifying, right? Also a dissociative identity disorder patient. Other psychiatrists or psychologists skilled in hypnosis failed to awaken other personalities and communicate with them.”
“But I did it with ease.”Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
“So now, I failed with Jiang Ran. Does that mean Jiang Ran has even stronger willpower than that deranged serial killer? More terrifying?”
The red-contact-lens nurse—Xiaotong—thought for a moment and said, “Doctor Bai, I think Jiang Ran isn’t the second type. After all, he’s just an ordinary person. So he must be the first! He actually doesn’t have dissociative identity disorder at all!!!”
Bai Xiaoliang was staring again at the EEG and MRI scans taken of Jiang Ran, looking over them repeatedly.
He murmured to himself:
“Jiang Ran probably has a mental illness, based on these scans, but it’s not dissociative identity disorder. Honestly, I can’t be sure right now. This is the first time in my life.”
The red-contact-lens nurse—Xiaotong—said, “Finally, Doctor Bai, you’ve encountered something you can’t be certain about.”
“But it’s actually nothing unusual.”
“After all, some doctors practicing for twenty or thirty years never encounter a dissociative identity disorder patient, let alone diagnose and treat one. Isn’t there a case where a dissociative identity disorder patient went to several major hospitals before finally getting diagnosed? That shows how difficult it is. Of course, that was just an ordinary dissociative identity disorder patient. But this Jiang Ran is far more perplexing.”
Bai Xiaoliang sighed, “I’ll go find my father and some friends to confirm this.”
“I really don’t want to misdiagnose.”

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Jiang Ran's First Meeting with Robert, The Ugly Woman Xia Xiaomei
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran returned to Alice Apartment in the late afternoon.
He had taken the day off, so he didn't need to work in the afternoon - just attend Manager Xiao Zhang's first matchmaking event in the evening as a filler participant.
With free time in the afternoon, he planned to return to Room 304 and lounge around.
Jiang Ran had just stepped out of the elevator.
As he walked down the third floor hallway toward Room 304,
he unexpectedly encountered someone.
The man appeared to be in his thirties,
with handsome but gaunt cheeks and messy black curly hair.
Nothing particularly unusual - except this person wasn't Chinese, but a foreigner
with distinctly Caucasian features.Jiang Ran noted how many foreigners had been appearing in the apartment lately -
first Mike, now another unfamiliar face.
The white man smiled warmly at Jiang Ran as they approached each other,
appearing friendly and cheerful.
Jiang Ran nodded back with a polite smile.
Just as they were about to pass each other,
the foreigner suddenly spoke: "Hello, my name is Robert. What's your name?" (in English)
"Uh..."
Jiang Ran had assumed this foreigner could speak Chinese,
since Mike's Chinese had been unnaturally fluent for a foreigner.
But this one didn't know a single word!
Now that he thought about it, that assumption had been foolish -
Chinese was notoriously difficult to learn.
Of course many foreigners wouldn't know it.
Now came the problem - Jiang Ran's English was terrible too.
Not completely nonexistent, but certainly not enough for actual conversation.
"Hello, could you repeat what you just said?"
Technology could solve this.
Jiang Ran pulled out his phone with its automatic translation function,
perfect for communicating with foreigners.
"Hello, my name is Robert. What's your name?" (in English)
The white man repeated.
After hearing the translation,
Jiang Ran responded through his phone: "Hello Robert, I'm Jiang Ran."
Robert smiled and said: "Oh, I see. Nice to meet you, Jiang Ran." (in English)
Jiang Ran replied: "Likewise. By the way, are you staying on the third floor or just passing through?"
Robert answered: "No, I'm visiting a friend. Staying for a week before returning to Maple Country - a very beautiful place." (in English)
Jiang Ran suddenly asked curiously: "Friend's invitation? Was your friend an American named Mike?"
Mike was the only American Jiang Ran knew in the apartment - perhaps he was Robert's host.
Robert shook his head: "No. Well, I have things to do, must go now." (in English)
Jiang Ran nodded: "Goodbye."
As Jiang Ran turned toward Room 304,
he completely failed to notice how Robert's eyes burned with dangerous intensity behind him,
nor the sinister smile that remained frozen on the foreigner's face.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid: [He's finally appeared! Robert, one of the world's top ten serial killers!]
Middle-aged Uncle: [I really didn't want to see him.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Haha, because you bet on Jiang Ran, right? I wonder when Robert will make his move?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Definitely within the week. They'll clash during these seven days. Prepare for all-nighters if you want to watch live instead of replays.]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Why?]
Fairy Sister @ Ultimate Rich Kid: [Seriously? Didn't you listen to Robert's profile? This creep only strikes late at night when everyone's asleep!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Oh right... But I do remember Jiang Ran is still on that clown's hit list!]
Domineering Female CEO: [Such an unlucky boy!]
Little Aunt: [Those guys Xiao Q and company aren't doing much better - still being kept like dogs in Room 1001...]
Little Dragon Girl: [Hahaha those poor bastards! I checked their feed earlier - they don't even have toilet paper when they shit now!]
Returning to Room 304,
Jiang Ran cooked instant noodles with two eggs - supposedly good for virility.
After eating,
he turned on the TV, planning to watch something before taking the American imported medicine Wang Qingzhao bought for him in half an hour.
As his gaze fell on the wall-mounted TV,
he couldn't help noticing the ancient beauty kite hanging nearby.
Honestly, he didn't know how it got there,
but suspected one of his alternate personalities must have taken it from Wang Nuli's place during a blackout period.
As for Wang Nuli's death,
the incident had passed and been ruled a suicide.
At least that worry was gone.
"Sigh... I wish I never developed dissociative identity disorder..."
This had always been Jiang Ran's deepest wish.
But wishes were just wishes.
He didn't think this condition could ever be cured - just managed as best as possible.
Just then, his phone buzzed.
Checking it, he saw a message from a resident in Alice Apartment asking for help.
"Hmm..."
Normally he could refuse since he was off today,
but this was the first time someone needed assistance during his day off.
He messaged Manager Xiao Zhang for guidance.
The manager replied he could either decline, citing his day off,
or go help and earn 50 yuan as overtime pay added to his monthly salary.
Jiang Ran was like Tao Yuanming - he wouldn't bend for five pecks of rice.
But six pecks? That was another matter.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
So he got up from the sofa to assist the resident.
The person needing help was someone named Xia Xiaomei in Room 901.
From the name, probably a woman.
Jiang Ran quickly arrived at Room 901 and knocked.
The door soon opened,
revealing a woman who looked at least 35 years old,
with rather plain - frankly ugly - features.
Truth be told,
all the women Jiang Ran had met in this apartment so far -
Qin Yi, Qin Kelian, Su Mi -
could be described as stunning beauties.
So when he first saw this unattractive woman named Xia Xiaomei,
her appearance stunned him for several seconds.
Of course, this shock came purely from her ugliness.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: The Clown Lies in Wait at Jiang Ran's Home
chapters.content:
"Sorry, my ugly appearance must have startled you."
Xia Xiaomei wasn't just physically unattractive - her voice was also rough and unpleasant to hear. She had no redeeming physical qualities whatsoever.
Yet she seemed kind-hearted. At least, she hadn't done anything wrong. Noticing Jiang Ran's reaction, she actually apologized first.
"It's nothing, really. My bad, please don't mind it." Jiang Ran scratched his head apologetically while mentally reminding himself to manage his expressions better to avoid making others uncomfortable.
"No, it's my fault. What can I do when I was born this ugly? You've actually been quite polite - even I get startled seeing my own reflection in the mirror sometimes." Xia Xiaomei forced a bitter smile before welcoming Jiang Ran inside and having him put on disposable shoe covers she provided.
After entering, Jiang Ran quickly scanned the apartment - clean and tidy. He then asked what she needed help with.
"Can you do makeup?" Xia Xiaomei inquired.
Jiang Ran shook his head. "No, I can't."
Her smile made her appear even less attractive, the dense freckles on her face becoming more pronounced. "I can do my own makeup, but my aesthetic sense isn't great. I wanted your male perspective on how I should do it. What kind of makeup do men generally prefer?"
Jiang Ran made a long "ah" sound of understanding. "I see. No problem at all. While I can't apply makeup, I do have decent taste. By the way, what's the occasion? Meeting a boyfriend?"Xia Xiaomei shook her head gloomily. "I don't have a boyfriend. I'm 36 and have only had one relationship that ended badly. My family's pressuring me to marry, so I want to find someone quickly. Manager Xiao Zhang announced a matchmaking event tonight in the group chat, so I thought I'd try my luck with better makeup."
Jiang Ran mused that throughout history, few sought partners without considering looks. Attractive appearances provided significant advantages in dating, average looks offered no edge, while unattractive ones were outright detrimental. Of course, exceptional abilities, family background or wealth could compensate for poor looks.
He guessed Xia Xiaomei's family must be well-off since she lived in Alice Apartments. But he held little hope for her success at tonight's event - all attendees would be wealthy residents unlikely to choose someone both unattractive and older at 36. Wealthy men would prefer 18-20 year olds. Her only prospects would be poorer men where money could offset her appearance.
"Sigh, I don't have a girlfriend either... though that might be for the best. I can't have children - they'd likely inherit my personality disorder, giving them a terrible start in life." Through Xia Xiaomei, Jiang Ran suddenly reflected on his own situation.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
The makeup session proceeded with Jiang Ran providing male aesthetic guidance. Honestly, he thought hiring a professional would be better if she could afford it.
Meanwhile, outside Jiang Ran's Room 304, a figure appeared - none other than the clown from the welcome party. The clown repeatedly rang the doorbell, awaiting Jiang Ran's response, unaware his target wasn't home.
His presence meant that of the original three targets - Jiang Ran, Sun Yijie and Wang Tao - Wang Tao was already dead. The dice had selected Jiang Ran next, and the clown had come to claim his life.
After prolonged knocking brought no answer, the clown stopped his dancing movements, staring puzzled at the door. He left the third floor briefly, returning ten minutes later with a key - Jiang Ran's spare obtained from Manager Xiao Zhang.
How could he get others' keys? Residents of Alice Apartments gained privileges based on their kill counts. While Wang Tao had killed no one, earning no privileges, the clown's dozen-plus murders granted him access to "lab rats'" apartments (though not other killers').
Entering the silent apartment, the clown searched Room 304 but found no one. Returning to the living room, he noticed the ancient beauty kite hanging near the TV. Tilting his head, he chuckled: "Isn't this Wang Nuli's kite? Why's it here?"
The clown knew Wang Nuli well - they'd become friends in the apartments. After each murder, the clown would deliver the corpses to Wang Nuli as kite-making materials, receiving payment based on the bodies' quality.
But hadn't he heard Wang Nuli recently went insane, imitating his kites by jumping out a window? "Did his death involve Jiang Ran?" The clown knew Wang Nuli would gift kites but never his prized wall-mounted masterpieces. This kite's presence was suspicious.
Regardless of whether Jiang Ran was involved in Wang Nuli's death, the clown wouldn't seek revenge. Their concept of friendship differed from normal people's.
Finding no Jiang Ran, the clown decided to wait, entertaining himself by performing ridiculous clown dances in the living room. Rubbing his hands together, he produced bursts of white paper scraps that floated down like snowflakes, creating a winter-like scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: The Perverts' Gathering - A Matchmaking Event
chapters.content:
Through Jiang Ran and Xia Xiaomei's joint efforts, Xia Xiaomei's makeup was finally done.
Jiang Ran suggested that Xia Xiaomei avoid heavy makeup and opt for a light, natural look instead.
The biggest difference before and after makeup was that her skin appeared much fairer, and the freckles on her face were concealed.
Overall, she definitely looked better than without makeup. After all, fair skin could hide many flaws.
However, her facial features were naturally plain, and her makeup skills were just average.
It was passable at best!
After finishing her makeup, Xia Xiaomei kept examining her face in the mirror.
Jiang Ran then said, "Since the makeup is done, do you need help with anything else? If not, I'll head home."
Xia Xiaomei replied, "There's nothing else I need your help with for now."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"By the way, Jiang Ran, are you going to attend this matchmaking event?"Jiang Ran nodded. "I am, but I'm just going to make up the numbers."
Xia Xiaomei said, "Then let's go now. It's almost time."
Only then did Jiang Ran notice that the sky outside the window had darkened.
He checked his phone—it was already 6:30 PM.
The matchmaking event would start in half an hour.
"Alright, let's head straight to the first floor."
Afterward, Jiang Ran and Xia Xiaomei went downstairs together.
Jiang Ran was dressed as usual, while Xia Xiaomei had put in considerable effort—not just with her makeup but also by choosing nice clothes.
Perhaps fate was playing a cruel joke on her, as Xia Xiaomei's figure was... well, rather unremarkable, lacking in both height and curves.
When they reached the first floor, they immediately spotted a conspicuous pink heart-shaped sign.
Following the sign, they arrived at the venue for the matchmaking event.
The event was being held in the same activity room where welcome parties usually took place.
But upon entering, Jiang Ran suddenly realized the room seemed much larger than before—almost twice as big.
Upon closer inspection, he noticed that the wall separating this activity room from the adjacent one wasn't solid but could be retracted upward.
No wonder the room felt inexplicably bigger—it was actually two activity rooms combined into one!
"Xiaomei, I'm going to grab some food first. I'm a bit hungry."
Shortly after entering, aside from noticing the expanded space, Jiang Ran also saw the array of delicious dishes laid out on serving trays.
Even if he weren't attending the event, this would normally be his dinnertime.
Drawn by the food, his stomach growled loudly.
After telling Xia Xiaomei, he immediately made a beeline for the buffet.
Meanwhile, Xia Xiaomei stayed behind, nervously scanning the crowd—especially the men.
As time passed, more and more people arrived.
Jiang Ran hadn't expected such a large turnout—he'd assumed there'd be at most a dozen people, but there were easily over a hundred.
With so many gathered for the matchmaking event, the points in Jiang Ran's mind skyrocketed like an explosion.
[Ding! Detected dangerous individual! Please distance yourself immediately! Points +1! Points +...]
[Ding! Detected dangerous individual! Please distance yourself immediately! Points +3! Points +...]
As usual, Jiang Ran ignored these warnings and focused on the sizzling beef and lamb slices on the grill.
The aroma of the perfectly grilled meat, glistening with oil, was irresistible. Dipped in the specially prepared sauce, it was absolutely delicious!
While eating, he glanced around and soon spotted the fitness trainer, Sun Yijie, chatting animatedly with an unfamiliar woman.
When Jiang Ran turned his head to look for other acquaintances, he nearly bumped into a man standing right beside him.
Upon closer inspection, he realized it was Wang Anjian, the new resident.
"Here for the matchmaking event too?" Jiang Ran asked.
Having just moved into Alice Apartment, Wang Anjian knew very few people, and Jiang Ran was one of them.
Wang Anjian smiled. "Yeah! But I'm not here to find a date—just for the free food."
Suffering from a severe illness, Wang Anjian had no illusions about finding a girlfriend with his body, which might only last a few more months.
He was here purely for the buffet—after all, he'd never eaten at one before and wanted to try it.
"Oh, I see!" Jiang Ran said. "Same here. Dig in! Otherwise, all this food will go to waste, and that'd be a shame."
With that, he took another bite of grilled beef.
Just then, a pleasant female voice sounded beside him.
"Jiang Ran, you're here too?"
Turning around, Jiang Ran saw Qin Kelian.
Tonight, she was dressed simply in a white shirt and jeans—unlike her usual figure-hugging stepmother-style dresses.
Noticing Qin Kelian, Wang Anjian tactfully excused himself to give them space.
Jiang Ran said, "Yeah, but I'm just here to fill a seat. You're participating? Where's your sister?"
Qin Kelian pouted toward a direction. "Over there!"
Following her gaze, Jiang Ran saw Qin Yi laughing and chatting over red wine with a man in his twenties.
"Wait, neither of you sisters have boyfriends? You'd actually come to something like this?"
Jiang Ran was puzzled. Women of their caliber shouldn't have any trouble finding partners.
Qin Kelian replied playfully, "Why do you care if we have boyfriends or not? What, you wanna chase after us? Just so you know, if you're after me, you can't go after my sister, and vice versa. No two-timing!"
Jiang Ran just smiled without responding.
Suddenly, a microphone test echoed through the speakers—*ahem, ahem*—followed by adjustments.
Once everything was set, Manager Xiao Zhang, dressed in a black suit with a red tie, stepped onto the stage with a microphone.
This was the first time Jiang Ran had seen the manager in a suit, and he had to admit—clothes really made the man. He looked the part.
With a smile, Manager Xiao Zhang announced into the microphone:
"Welcome, everyone, to the first Alice Apartment Matchmaking Event, hosted by yours truly, Xiao Zhang!"
"This event aims to help our single residents find love! Make the most of your time—it ends at 9 PM!"
"Additionally, to improve efficiency, I encourage brave men and women to take the stage, introduce yourselves, and showcase your charms!"

chapters.title: Chapter 118: A Brutal Case Mike Solved Before
chapters.content:
Manager Xiao Zhang wanted to liven up the atmosphere by having people come up and introduce themselves.
But after calling out several times, not a single person below was willing to go up.
Just as Manager Xiao Zhang remarked how unexpectedly shy everyone was, Sun Yijie raised his hand.
Seeing this, Manager Xiao Zhang's eyes immediately lit up.
He enthusiastically invited Sun Yijie onto the specially constructed stage for this matchmaking event.
Now standing at the front facing the crowd, Sun Yijie had over a hundred pairs of eyes fixed on him.
If he had Jiang Ran's Danger Warning System,
he might have noticed something interesting.
In this enclosed large space,
apart from Jiang Ran and Wang Anjian in the audience, and himself,every single other person present, including the smiling Manager Xiao Zhang standing beside him,
had constant warning flashes appearing over them.
Each one was continuously accumulating points.
Meaning, aside from these three people, everyone else was a deranged criminal - serial killers.
Three little lambs had wandered into a pack of wolves.
And one particularly bold lamb was now on stage, proudly displaying his plumpness to all the wolves.
Whether this was bravery or foolishness remained to be seen.
While this matchmaking event was underway,
Mike was in a private room of a small restaurant in Nancheng City.
With him in the room were a young man and woman.
Both were Chinese - the man about Mike's age, the woman in her early twenties.
The man began pulling a brown paper folder from his backpack and placed it on the table.
Mike similarly took out a thick paper envelope from his own bag.
They exchanged items.
Mike eagerly opened the folder he received,
while the Chinese man did the same with Mike's envelope,
pouring out rectangular bundles held by rubber bands - humanity's favorite - cash.
And not Chinese currency, but American dollars.
As Mike opened the folder, he glanced at the Chinese man sniffing a dollar bill with intoxicated delight and smiled, asking:
"I've always wondered - after so many collaborations, why do you only take USD and not your own country's currency?"
Still savoring the dollar's scent, the man replied: "USD is more valuable. Plus I'm saving up to emigrate. So you understand now why I want dollars, right?"
Mike nodded, pulling out a dozen printed sheets from the folder to examine carefully.
"Take your time. If anything's unclear, just ask - full after-sales service included."
The Chinese man laughed.
Why did a detective of Mike's caliber charge so much per commission?
First: His reputation and capability justified it, just like A-list celebrities charge more than B or C-listers.
Second: When accepting commissions to investigate cases, he needed information.
He couldn't possibly handle everything alone - there wasn't enough time, and it would be exhausting.
So he needed others to assist.
Like the current task of gathering intelligence.
The Chinese man and woman before him were also detectives who moonlighted as information brokers.
And when outsourcing work, one had to pay from their own pocket.
Hence Mike's high fees.
Earlier when Mike mentioned having several tasks, those involved collecting intelligence on certain individuals - which he'd delegated to these two.
The information Mike had them gather included:
Personal details on Wu You, Sun Yijie, and Wang Anjian.
Information on Manager Xiao Zhang and assistant manager Jiang Ran.
And data on Alice Apartment.
He first reviewed the files on Wu You, Sun Yijie and Wang Anjian.
After reading, he muttered: "Two broke guys and an ordinary man being chased - how could they afford Alice Apartment at 50,000 per square meter? They couldn't even rent there."
Next he examined Manager Xiao Zhang and Jiang Ran's files.
Their birthdates, ID numbers, phone numbers, addresses, family backgrounds, elementary and middle schools attended, post-graduation employment histories.
Romantic relationships.
Social media accounts and posts.
Frequently visited websites and apps used.
Recent life circumstances, even some extremely private matters - all meticulously documented in the Chinese man's files.
The detail was astonishing - after reading these, Mike knew them better than they knew themselves.
After reviewing these, he turned to the Alice Apartment materials.
Construction start and completion dates.
The development company involved, etc.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Finishing these documents,
America's tenth-ranked detective crossed his arms, leaned back in his chair,
rocking backward then forward while staring at the restaurant's golden ceiling,
as if pondering something profoundly complex.
Seeing Mike like this,
the Chinese man across from him remarked curiously: "Known you for years, but this is the first time I've seen you so serious. Is this commission that difficult?"
Mike exhaled deeply: "Extremely difficult. And my instincts tell me what's behind this case is beyond my ability to handle alone."
Surprised, the Chinese man took a stack from the dollars Mike had given him and tossed it back.
"Tell me about it - I'm curious."
Mike pushed the money back: "After all our collaborations, we're practically friends. Throwing money at me is insulting."
The Chinese man smiled: "If you won't take payment, I can't in good conscience listen. Our profession forbids prying into clients' affairs."
Mike said: "Then don't listen - maintain your professional ethics!"
Shaking his head, the man replied: "Ethics are meant to be broken! Come on, tell me - I'm dying to know!"
Beside him, the Chinese woman gave her partner an exasperated glance - she was his girlfriend.
Their names were Lu Fei and Huo Xiaoyu.
Fellow professionals who'd worked together several times before developing feelings and becoming a couple.
Huo Xiaoyu was completely satisfied with Lu Fei except for one thing - his insatiable, almost frightening curiosity.
Now reminiscing, Mike said: "Back in America, I once worked with police and colleagues on a case."
"A simple yet brutal case."
"Wealthy people buying poor people's lives."
"Desperate poor people needing money would get it from the rich, then their bodies became the rich's playthings."
"The brutality lay in how these rich people bought lives solely to satisfy twisted desires - subjecting the poor to various tortures before killing them."
Hearing this, both Lu Fei and Huo Xiaoyu paled.
Mike concluded: "The commission I'm investigating now feels similar in nature, though with some differences."

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Mike and Robert, Sun Yijie and Xia Xiaomei
chapters.content:
Yes, this was the conclusion Mike had painstakingly reached in the early hours of the morning.
After reviewing these documents, he became even more certain his conclusion was correct.
He believed Alice Apartment shared similarities with the new residents he had previously noticed - Wu You, Wang Anjian, and Sun Yijie.
The pattern resembled that old case he had mentioned.
One side provides money, the other provides lives.
But the specific details would differ.
Otherwise, it would be difficult to explain how several poor individuals could afford to live in a high-end apartment costing fifty thousand per square meter.
Moreover, these people had no prior acquaintance, not even online interactions - complete strangers.
Such situations usually involve a neutral party orchestrating everything, manipulating these individuals to gather together.
"Lu Fei, when you provided me with these documents about the individuals and Alice Apartment, did you notice anything unusual about the information?" Mike suddenly asked."Unusual? What do you mean?"
Puzzled, Lu Fei took back the documents and flipped through them repeatedly, finding nothing amiss!
Collecting information was his specialty, so mistakes were unlikely!
This was his bread and butter!
Mike got straight to the point without beating around the bush: "Don't you think Manager Xiao Zhang's biographical information is too... ordinary?"
"Following routine steps, completely unremarkable and lacking any distinctive features."
Lu Fei responded: "Isn't being ordinary normal? The vast majority of people in this world are ordinary!"
Mike shook his head: "Ordinary is normal, but not in this context."
"Among the people I asked you to investigate, apart from this Xiao Zhang - Wu You had a father with cancer, Wang Anjian had cancer himself, Sun Yijie was being hunted down, and Jiang Ran, the assistant manager, has dissociative identity disorder. They all have extraordinary aspects. Only this Manager Xiao Zhang is ordinary, and this apartment's records show it as just another regular high-end residence. These two are the exceptions?"
"If the apartment and its manager are ordinary, then what about Jiang Ran, the assistant manager? Shouldn't he be ordinary too?"
"Investigate Xiao Zhang more thoroughly."
"I suspect all records about him were long ago destroyed and replaced with fabricated ones. What we're seeing now is the falsified version."
Lu Fei's mouth fell open in astonishment, because what Mike described wasn't something he hadn't encountered before.
Completely erasing all traceable history of a person, then creating a fake one to replace it.
Though he'd only come across it a handful of times. Very, very rarely.
...
Mike left the small restaurant's private room and hailed a rideshare to return to Alice Apartment.
The rideshare driver, noticing he was a foreigner, tried making conversation, but Mike only gave perfunctory responses, his mind entirely occupied with this case.
Upon returning to Alice Apartment, he passed through facial recognition to enter the premises.
Mike looked up at the Alice Apartment building before him.
At night, illuminated by surrounding lights, it still appeared as a beautiful apartment building. But in Mike's eyes, the entire structure seemed enveloped in dark energy.
As he walked toward the building, he inadvertently noticed a figure at the fifth-floor corridor window directly opposite.
The figure opened the window, leaning most of his upper body outside.
He was casually taking out a cigarette from his pocket.
An utterly mundane action.
Yet it made Mike - this experienced detective who had weathered countless storms - immediately halt his approach.
His body trembled inexplicably, unclear what emotion caused it.
Only that his face was completely overtaken by shock.
His vision was exceptionally good, especially after undergoing specialized FBI training methods and equipment to enhance his eyesight.
This gave him significantly better night vision than ordinary people.
Thus, while a normal person in his position might struggle to clearly see the smoking figure at the fifth-floor window,
he could distinctly make out the man's features.
Gritting his teeth, he spat out a name syllable by syllable: "Robert?!"
As he froze in place, noticing and locking eyes with Robert,
Robert at the fifth-floor window also spotted Mike.
Their first mutual glance left both equally stunned and incredulous.
But in an instant, Robert's somewhat handsome, narrow face twisted into an extremely sinister, evil grin. Like a demon manifesting.
Then he turned and disappeared from the window.
Seeing this, Mike reacted as if discovering his wife's infidelity - he immediately sprinted toward the apartment building, charging madly toward the fifth floor.
At the matchmaking event...
Sun Yijie had just finished introducing himself.
Manager Xiao Zhang, holding a microphone, asked Sun Yijie: "Mr. Sun, you've presented yourself quite well with excellent qualifications!"
"So may I ask what type of girl you prefer?"
Sun Yijie smiled confidently: "I don't care much about appearance. As long as we get along, that's enough."
As he spoke, his gaze settled on a graceful figure in the audience - Qin Yi.
Truth be told, Sun Yijie had noticed Qin Yi much earlier. He never expected such a stunning woman lived in this apartment.
Just looking at her made his heart itch with desire to have her.
Unfortunately, he had been conversing with another woman while Qin Yi was talking with other men.
Neither had been available.
"Is that so? In that case, are there any ladies in the audience interested in someone like Mr. Sun? Feel free to come up and introduce yourselves."
After Manager Xiao Zhang's invitation, Sun Yijie cast hopeful eyes toward Qin Yi.
The intensity of his gaze made it impossible for Qin Yi to ignore.
Regrettably, she already had her hunting target for this matchmaking event.
Originally, she had come intending to hunt lab rats.
But fate had delivered a new psychopathic criminal straight to her doorstep.
The apartment might welcome new psychos and serial killers daily, but unlike the lab rats, they weren't specially introduced to the live stream audience.
More importantly, the resident who purchased her human meat products had grown tired of lab rat meat and wanted to try other flavors.
Thus, although she knew she could easily ensnare Sun Yijie with minimal effort, she had no time for him.
You might ask - what about her sister?
Sorry, but processing one person and manufacturing various products kept her fully occupied, requiring her sister's assistance too.
So Qin Yi deliberately averted her gaze, ignoring Sun Yijie.
Having played with many women, Sun Yijie immediately sensed Qin Yi's disinterest, leaving him somewhat disappointed.
Just then...
"Can I come up?"
Xia Xiaomei raised her hand.
Manager Xiao Zhang quickly responded with a smile: "Of course! Please come up!"
Hearing this, Xia Xiaomei happily squeezed through the crowd and stepped onto the stage.
When Sun Yijie saw Xia Xiaomei, his heart skipped a beat.
Damn it! This woman was both old and ugly, with a stumpy figure to boot!
She couldn't hold a candle to Qin Yi from earlier, nor even compare to any of Sun Yijie's past flings!
But as an experienced player, Sun Yijie naturally wouldn't show his true feelings.
He maintained his previous smile.
After coming up, Xia Xiaomei introduced herself.
Then expressed her strong interest in Sun Yijie.
Hoping to get to know him better.
Truth be told, Sun Yijie had planned to politely decline - Xia Xiaomei really wasn't his type.
But then Xia Xiaomei did something that completely changed his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: Xia Xiaomei is Truly Twisted, Sun Yijie's Doom
chapters.content:
At that moment, Xia Xiaomei actually pulled out a rectangular red gift box from her pocket.
She opened the box, and instantly, golden light glittered.
Inside the rectangular red box was a thick men's gold necklace, a large men's gold ring, and additionally, a longevity lock made of gold.
Xia Xiaomei handed the red box containing these three expensive gold accessories to Sun Yijie.
She said these were gifts for him and hoped he would accept them.
When Sun Yijie saw these three gold accessories, his eyes immediately glazed over.
His first instinct was to reach out and take them with both hands, but he restrained himself.
He said such valuable gifts were too much and he couldn't accept them.
They could start as friends first, or something along those lines.
Hearing this, Xia Xiaomei was overjoyed. Despite being 36 years old, she bounced up and down excitedly on stage like a little girl.Then, Sun Yijie and Xia Xiaomei left the stage.
Manager Xiao Zhang, seeing his matchmaking succeed with this pair, was very pleased.
Next, he wanted to match a second and third pair.
But unfortunately,
by the time the event ended at 9 PM, he hadn't succeeded in matching anyone else. The main reason was that aside from Sun Yijie and Xia Xiaomei, not a single person was willing to go on stage during those two hours.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Thus, this matchmaking event came to an end.
"Jiang Ran, we're leaving first. Thank you so much for helping me with my makeup today."
After the matchmaking event ended, Jiang Ran stayed behind to help Manager Xiao Zhang clean up the buffet leftovers.
Xia Xiaomei came over holding Sun Yijie's hand to say goodbye to Jiang Ran.
"No need for thanks, it was nothing," Jiang Ran replied.
Seeing Xia Xiaomei and Sun Yijie holding hands and being intimate, Jiang Ran knew this pair was 90% confirmed.
Although he could tell Sun Yijie was only after Xia Xiaomei's money,
at least it worked out, and he should be happy for Xia Xiaomei.
Of course, Jiang Ran hadn't expected Xia Xiaomei to be such a big spender—pulling out three gold accessories just like that.
With gold prices currently over a thousand per gram, those three pieces were worth a small fortune.
No wonder Sun Yijie couldn't resist the temptation. Someone who could casually give away three gold accessories
probably had hundreds, if not thousands, more at home.
At this moment, Wang Anjian was also nearby, watching the scene unfold.
He was eating an ice cream sprinkled with numerous blue painkiller tablets.
Nowadays, he treated painkillers as his daily meals.
For some reason, though it was obvious to anyone with eyes that Sun Yijie was only with Xia Xiaomei for her money—
after all, no matter how well Sun Yijie tried to hide it on stage, his expressions weren't completely under control.
His demeanor before and after the three gold accessories appeared was noticeably different, though subtly so.
Following normal logic, the sequence of events should be: Sun Yijie would swindle Xia Xiaomei for money and favors, squeeze her dry, and then dump her,
leaving Xia Xiaomei with neither love nor money.
But Wang Anjian couldn't shake the feeling that Xia Xiaomei—who barely reached Sun Yijie's shoulders, was stocky, and had an unattractive face—was actually the predator in this relationship.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Domineering Female CEO: "Well, Sun Yijie is done for. Those who bet on him can start mourning now."
Ultimate Rich Kid: "Why do you say that? Is Xia Xiaomei also a dangerous criminal? But Sun Yijie is tall and strong—Xia Xiaomei is tiny compared to him. If it came to a fight, who knows who'd be in more danger!"
Domineering Female CEO: "Just wait and see. This Xia Xiaomei... she's seriously twisted. Though, honestly, I think you're even more twisted, Ultimate Rich Kid."
Ultimate Rich Kid, utterly confused: "?????? How am I twisted????"
Domineering Female CEO: "You grill the attractive female residents—like Qin Yi, Qin Kelian, and Su Mi—for every detail about them. But with an unattractive one like Xia Xiaomei, you don't ask anything about her background or story?"
Ultimate Rich Kid fell silent, likely because she'd hit the mark.
...
Meanwhile, on Mike's end:
When he rushed to the fifth-floor hallway window where Robert had been, the man was long gone.
After searching the entire floor without finding him, Mike immediately ran down to the first floor to look for Xiao Zhang.
He didn't find Xiao Zhang in the management office, but on the desk where Xiao Zhang usually sat, he spotted a large key ring.
Mike grabbed the keys and headed to the surveillance room.
He found the right key, unlocked the door, and entered.
Recalling the approximate time, he pulled up the footage of the fifth-floor hallway and window.
The moment the video played,
his suspicions were confirmed—that man was indeed Robert!
Identical twins might look alike, but no two people have identical mannerisms and expressions.
This was Robert!
He quickly checked where Robert had gone next,
but the footage only showed Robert running toward the sixth floor. When he checked the sixth-floor cameras, Robert seemed to have vanished into thin air.
There was no trace of him.
"These have been edited..."
Mike pressed his face so close to the screen he might as well have merged with it, scrutinizing the footage more intensely than he had with Zhou Wu and Zhou Wu's father's disappearance videos.
He suddenly realized: every frame after Robert reached the sixth floor had been altered or cut!
"From when I saw Robert on the fifth floor from downstairs, to running up to search, then coming back down to get the keys and enter this room—it couldn't have taken more than twenty minutes! In just twenty minutes, someone edited the surveillance footage?!"
Compared to the shock of seeing Robert,
Mike now felt sheer terror at how quickly the footage had been tampered with.
What did this mean?
It meant his every move was being monitored, and whoever—or whatever—was watching him had terrifyingly fast response capabilities.
Even worse, they could predict his actions—anticipating that when Mike couldn't find Robert, he'd check the cameras, so they preemptively altered the footage.
"Damn it!"
Mike slammed his fist on the desk. At this moment, he, a top-ten detective in the U.S.,
felt like a child pinned down by an enormous hand, completely helpless.
He left the surveillance room, returned the keys to their place,
and walked toward the elevators in a daze.
Just as he reached the elevators, someone called out to him.
"Mike, what's wrong? You look exhausted. Have you eaten? If not, there's still plenty of buffet food in the activity room."
It was Jiang Ran, who had been cleaning up after the matchmaking event and had stepped out to throw away trash when he spotted Mike.
Mike waved him off, signaling he wasn't interested.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: The Grudge Between Mike and Robert
chapters.content:
"Audrey Jenny."
At this moment, Mike, inside the elevator, kept repeating this name over and over.
It was a woman's name—his fiancée's name.
They were supposed to have married five years ago.
But in the end, it never happened.
Why?
Because his fiancée died.
She died in a case that occurred five years ago.
That case was related to Robert.
Robert had two nicknames.The first was "The Night Sniper," because he committed crimes only at night.
The second was "Disciple of the Devil," because after each crime, he would leave behind a skull drawn in blood.
During the long period when Robert was active,
the entire Maple Country was gripped by terror, especially the residents of the cities Robert frequented—where multiple murders had already taken place. They were terrified beyond belief, too scared to go outside at night, hiding at home and guarding themselves fiercely, fearing encountering this horrific, psychopathic serial killer in the dark.
This shows just how terrifying Robert’s presence was during that time.
Even worse, no one could confirm the killer’s identity back then;
the clues were too few.
Out of helplessness, the Maple Country police announced a huge bounty.
Detectives from all over the world rushed to Maple Country for the reward.
Among those detectives who arrived were Mike, his girlfriend Audrey Jenny, and several of their friends.
Their professional skills were unquestionable.
Together with other detectives and local police,
after countless hardships, they finally confirmed the true identity of the killer—it was Robert!
So, the current problem was to catch Robert!
After Robert’s identity was exposed, he shockingly remained bold, continuing his crimes without any restraint.
In his last crime, he fell into one of the traps set by Mike and other detectives.
The trap Mike’s girlfriend and two other male detectives were assigned to stake out.
They had set many traps, but the one Mike’s girlfriend was responsible for was calculated as the least likely for Robert to fall into.
But fate was cruel—Robert fell into the trap with the least chance.
After falling into the trap, Robert’s brutality was beyond imagination.
The end result was that Mike’s girlfriend Audrey Jenny was seriously injured and died three days after being hospitalized.
One of the two male detectives died, and the other was seriously injured.
By a stroke of luck, Robert was not in good shape either.
He was badly wounded and tried to escape, but nearby residents who heard the commotion surrounded him and nearly beat him to death.
If the Maple Country police hadn’t arrived quickly, the enraged crowd would have surely beaten him to death.
But it was only nearly—he still didn’t die.
Instead, because of him, so many people died.
"I miss you so much, Audrey..."
In China, there were many intelligence brokers.Google seaʀᴄh ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Many of them were more professional than Lu Fei and Huo Xiaoyu, but why did Mike choose them?
Because Mike’s girlfriend was also a detective, and they eventually fell in love.
How similar was this to Lu Fei and Huo Xiaoyu’s experience?
It was also because of his girlfriend’s death five years ago.
Since then, Mike never took on murder cases involving homicide again.
What he never expected was that Robert, who should have been waiting for the death penalty in a Maple Country prison, was somehow released?
And even more shocking, he appeared in distant China?!
Right inside the apartment where Mike was investigating a disappearance?!
"What on earth is going on?!"
Even Mike was thrown off balance by the current situation, especially since Robert was the murderer who killed his girlfriend. The saying goes, “a confused insider, a clear outsider,” but he had already fallen into the confusion of an insider!!!
But soon, he composed himself again.
A fierce fire ignited in his eyes.
"I don’t care how you got out! But since fate has brought you to me, I will kill you with my own hands!"
Mike stepped out of the elevator. In the darkness, his emerald green eyes emitted a faint eerie glow.
His memories began to resurface.
He recalled Robert’s capture and subsequent court trial.
Although Robert had committed countless unforgivable crimes, and the evidence was solid,
due to the obstruction from the defense lawyer and some surviving witnesses unwilling to testify, it took a long time to confirm his guilt.
Still, in the end, all 59 charges—including murder, manslaughter, theft, and robbery—were proven!
His death sentence was ironclad!
But Maple Country had one terrible flaw regarding the death penalty—it took an incredibly long time to carry out.
So long that many death row inmates died before execution.
Of course, this did not anger Mike.
What angered him was that after Robert’s capture and exposure,
he somehow gained many female fans outside, who worshipped him. There was even a supposedly highly educated elite woman who wrote dozens of love letters to Robert in prison, wanting to marry him!!!!
Because of these fanatical female fans’ influence, Robert’s execution date was continuously delayed. This effectively prolonged the life of this scumbag.
Because of this, Mike felt that some humans deserved to have a serial killer like Robert come kill their families.
...
At 10 p.m.
Fitness trainer Sun Yijie lay on the big bed in room 901, waiting for what was about to happen.
The sound of flowing water continuously reached his ears—Xia Xiaomei was taking a shower in the bathroom.
Honestly, if Xia Xiaomei weren’t rich, he wouldn’t have looked at her, let alone have this happen the first time they met today.
It was all for the money.
Plus, he hadn’t been with a woman for a long time...
So, for now, he was just going along with it.
Just having some fun, no big deal. After all, he had served older, unattractive rich women before.
Just as he was thinking this, the sound of running water stopped.
Immediately after, a figure wrapped in a white towel appeared in front of Sun Yijie.
The person wrapped in the white towel was Xia Xiaomei.
Seeing Xia Xiaomei fresh out of the shower, Sun Yijie was stunned.
Of course, not stunned by beauty.
But stunned by ugliness.
Damn, how could her looks be even worse after washing off her makeup?
Could she possibly get uglier?
He thought Xia Xiaomei’s face at the matchmaking event was already her lowest point.
But he didn’t expect it could get even worse!
Her face was covered with dense, extremely obvious freckles... so disgusting...
Sun Yijie started cursing in his heart: You woman, so rich, can’t you spend money on skincare or get some cosmetic work done?
Damn!
This is poisoning my eyes!
Sun Yijie forced a “happy” smile on his face, suppressing his disgust.
Their eyes met, and what was about to happen next was obvious.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Poor Sun Yijie
chapters.content:
It was unclear whether it was because Sun Yijie and Xia Xiaomei had both gone too long without contact with the opposite sex.
For the next two hours, from 10 PM to midnight,
the two of them went at it a full two times.
After those two rounds, Sun Yijie was already utterly exhausted.
Don’t let his strong physique fool you;
his fit body was the result of rigorous training.
But that physique came at a cost.
Besides his usual diet and workouts,
there was a necessary condition: taking pills.
It was precisely because of the long-term use of these pills that Sun Yijie’s abilities in that area were somewhat impaired.
Add to that his chaotic private life, which left his body strong on the outside but hollowed out inside.So, two times was already his limit.
However, Xia Xiaomei was not satisfied.
She demanded more, but Sun Yijie simply couldn’t keep going.
Then Xia Xiaomei, with her short, ugly body, left the bedroom and came back five minutes later.
In her hand was a box of pills and a white genuine leather box.
Xia Xiaomei was wealthy, and she promised, “One more time, and I’ll give you a gold accessory.”
Sun Yijie couldn’t resist the lure of gold jewelry and reluctantly agreed.
Until 2 AM,
Xia Xiaomei and Sun Yijie had sex three more times.
All three times involved taking pills.
Sun Yijie’s body really couldn’t take it.
He collapsed from exhaustion.
During these three times, he received nine pieces of gold jewelry.
One piece for the first time taking the pill.
For the second time, Sun Yijie insisted he wouldn’t do it again, saying he was about to die. So Xia Xiaomei raised the price to three gold accessories.
The third time, she directly gave him five pieces.
As a result, Sun Yijie collapsed and fainted.
Xia Xiaomei seemed tired as well, but she still had some energy left.
Perhaps it was true what they say: only oxen can die from exhaustion, but fields don’t wear out from plowing.
“Yijie? Yijie?”
At this moment, Xia Xiaomei was shaking Sun Yijie’s shoulders, calling out to him.
But Sun Yijie’s whole body swayed from the push and still hadn’t woken up. If it weren’t for detecting a faint breath, one would fear he was dead.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs
Those pills were like that—extremely potent in effect but with side effects.
The human body was peculiar, with a protective mechanism.
No matter how much chaos it endured, under this protection, at a certain point, the body would automatically suppress itself.
It was like going from 100 down to just 30.
When the body’s protective mechanism sensed it was about to fail, it would desperately suppress itself, making you temporarily unable to get up.
But taking pills was different.
After taking them, the protection was directly broken.
It forcibly drained the remaining 30.
Because of this, many who died in bed had taken such pills.
Seeing that Sun Yijie still hadn’t woken up,
Xia Xiaomei went to the bathroom for a quick shower and put on white pajamas.
Passing by the bathroom mirror, one could see that Xia Xiaomei’s face was extremely calm—so calm it was frightening and eerie. It was completely different from the cute, happy, expectant girl she had shown in front of Sun Yijie before.
She returned to the bedroom, pulled all the covers off Sun Yijie, and threw them to the floor.
Then she dressed Sun Yijie in underwear.
Next, she took out four silver-white metal handcuffs from the bedside table.
The four handcuffs restrained Sun Yijie’s hands and feet, shackling him tightly to both the head and foot of the bed.
Then Xia Xiaomei left the bedroom again, somehow bringing back thick ropes. She used the ropes to tightly bind Sun Yijie’s body parts that could exert force to the solid bed beneath him.
After finishing all this,
Xia Xiaomei checked everything carefully and confirmed it was secure.
She then took a black sports camera from the bedside table, turned on the recording function, and hung it on her chest.
She muttered to herself, “Next is Record 067 of a Wonderful Life.”
Then she pulled out a toolbox from under the bed.
Opening it revealed a full array of tools.
She took out a green utility knife.
The kind with a sliding blade that could be disassembled.
Some people used it for sharpening pencils, others for opening packages.
Xia Xiaomei used it to “awaken life.”
At this moment, she held the utility knife in her right hand and made a slash on a blank A4 sheet held in her left hand.
Though the paper was cut, it was evident the blade was a bit dull.
So she snapped off the first blade segment, revealing a new, sharp second blade.
Because the second blade was new, she didn’t need to test it on paper again.
She bent down beside the bed.
Her gaze focused on Sun Yijie’s ankle and calf.
Using the utility knife, she made a vertical cut on the middle of the skin.
With that one cut, fresh blood began to trickle continuously from the wound.
It was a strange sight.
After this cut, Sun Yijie still did not awaken.
The cut was ten centimeters long.
Three centimeters beside this cut, Xia Xiaomei made a second identical cut with the knife.
At this time, in the live chat room:
Ultimate Rich Kid: “Is the female CEO there?”
Domineering Female CEO: “Why call me sister?”
Ultimate Rich Kid: “Didn’t you say before that Xia Xiaomei is very perverted? Looking at her now, she really is pretty twisted. One moment they’re lovey-dovey, the next she’s acting all perverse...”
“To be honest, I used to really dislike Sun Yijie, but now I feel a bit sorry for him. Who would have thought the one you just had a loving moment with would do these things to you while you’re asleep?”
Domineering Female CEO: “Then let me tell you something that will make you sympathize with Sun Yijie even more.”
Ultimate Rich Kid: “Go ahead.”
Domineering Female CEO: “Those gold accessories are actually fake, not made of real gold...”
Ultimate Rich Kid: “!!! Damn!”
Domineering Female CEO: “Even if they were real gold, Sun Yijie wouldn’t have gotten them, but at least real gold would be less mentally crushing than fake ones.”
After calming down for quite some time, Ultimate Rich Kid asked again: “So, next, will Xia Xiaomei torture Sun Yijie to death with those knife cuts?”
Domineering Female CEO: “Depends. Xia Xiaomei is a pure sadist who enjoys torment and abuse. Just look at her toolbox—so many tools, plenty of means for torture... So, Sun Yijie is really unlucky. If he’s going to die at the hands of some pervert in this apartment, it’s better to die quickly like Wang Nuli, the kite killer who directly kills and skins victims. After all, a short pain is better than a long one.”
Ultimate Rich Kid: “I have another question. What’s Xia Xiaomei’s murder preference or rule?”
Domineering Female CEO: “She probably doesn’t have a murder fetish or strict rules. I think she has specific targets.”
“She only kills men, especially those she’s had relations with.”
...
It was now 3 AM.
In bedroom 901.
Sun Yijie, wearing only underwear, was tightly bound to the bed.
No clothes covered his body;
the exposed skin showed the muscles he had painstakingly built with great effort.
Now, a thin layer of blood covered them.
Looking closely, one could see that except for his head, neck, and feet,
every other part of his body was covered with vertical cuts made by the utility knife.
The dense scratches over his body made anyone see them break out in goosebumps, feeling horrified and disgusted.
Anyone with trypophobia would almost have a panic attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Sun Yijie Wakes Up in Despair
chapters.content:
Yet despite everything, Sun Yijie didn't wake up. He merely furrowed his brows, his face twisted in agony.
It seemed the physical pain had plunged him into a nightmare.
In any case, the three previous doses of drugs had completely drained him, leaving him utterly exhausted.
Xia Xiaomei's expression remained calm as ever, but beneath that calmness simmered a madness-filled indifference.
Seeing that Sun Yijie hadn't awakened,
she said nothing and left the bedroom for the kitchen, opening a cabinet there.
Surprisingly, the kitchen cabinet she opened
contained nothing but various brands of salt.
She took out five or six packets and brought them to the bedroom.
Then she tore open one packet and, mimicking the Salt Bae trend from TikTok, grabbed a handful of salt and let it cascade down her elbowbefore sprinkling it over Sun Yijie's muscular body like seasoning beef.
How painful is salt on wounds?
Excruciating. Absolutely excruciating.
Just how painful?
Heh heh heh.
Sun Yijie, who hadn't woken from the countless cuts made by the art knife earlier,
was now jolted awake by the sheer agony.
The moment he regained consciousness, he let out a pained scream.
To his horror, the intense pain didn't fade upon waking - it grew worse.
The sensation was increasing exponentially.
His mouth twisted grotesquely as he forced his eyes open.
Instinctively, he tried to sit up and examine the source of his pain.
He felt he needed to check his entire body, as the searing pain seemed to come from everywhere.
Was this from overexertion?
But his attempt to rise only moved his neck and head -
his powerful, muscular body remained completely unresponsive.
"What?! What's going on?!"
Sun Yijie screamed in terror at the sight before him.
What had happened to his body? Why was it covered in blood?
And wasn't that ugly freak standing by the bed Xia Xiaomei?
What were those white crystals she kept sprinkling on him, copying that Salt Bae guy?
"You're awake?"
Engrossed in her salt-sprinkling, Xia Xiaomei noticed the vibrations from the bed
and turned to see Sun Yijie's shocked eyes staring back at her.
"What are you doing?! Xia Xiaomei?!"
Sun Yijie struggled violently against his restraints.
He couldn't see his feet, but turning his head revealed his left and right hands
cuffed to the bed with white handcuffs.
No matter how hard he pulled, he couldn't break the cuffs or contort his hands
small enough to slip free like some bone-shrinking martial artist.
His frantic struggles only made the metal cuffs cut bloody grooves into his wrists and ankles.
It was useless.
Not to mention the sturdy ropes binding other parts of his body,
leaving him completely immobilized.
"AAAAAHHHH!!! COME ON, MY MUSCLES!!!"
Sun Yijie pinned all his hopes on the muscles he took such pride in.
This man who had confidently claimed he could knock out Tyson and Ali
now lay spread-eagled and utterly helpless.
"Stop struggling. It's pointless,"
Xia Xiaomei said calmly.
Abandoning the Salt Bae imitation,
she simply tore open the salt packets
and poured them directly onto Sun Yijie's body.
All five packets.
After emptying them,
she used both hands to spread the salt evenly across every inch of his body.
Whereas before the scattered salt had been enough to wake him,
now five full packets covered every wound.
The resulting agony made Sun Yijie stop struggling and simply scream in torment!!!
"Stop! Stop torturing me! Xiaomei! Do you have any idea what you're doing to me? Did I wrong you somehow? Why are you doing this?!"
Sun Yijie convulsed in pain, reduced to begging,
though he couldn't fathom what he'd done to deserve this.
Never could he have imagined that after the nightmare of being chased by a brutal assailant -
which he thought was the worst possible scenario -
he'd wake to something even more horrifying.
"You didn't wrong me,"
Xia Xiaomei replied.
Tears of pain streamed down Sun Yijie's face as he shouted,
"No? Then why are you doing this? Are you some kind of psychopath?!"
Xia Xiaomei's face remained impassive as she mused,
"Psychopath? People have called me that before. I rather like it."
Sun Yijie completely broke down then.
The Xia Xiaomei before him now seemed like a different person entirely.
The one he'd known had been a love-starved, wealthy ugly duckling -
eager, simple-minded, and easy to manipulate.
This version was pure cold-blooded insanity,
without a trace of her former smile.
"Let me go! Right now! If I die, you'll get the death penalty! Life in prison!"
Sun Yijie roared.
Xia Xiaomei wordlessly left the bedroom.
Sun Yijie thought she'd gotten scared - after all, murder was illegal.
But his soul nearly left his body when she returned
carrying an armful of salt packets, clearly with no intention of freeing him.
"AAAHHH! HAVE YOU GONE COMPLETELY MAD?!"
Sun Yijie had always considered himself an expert on women.
Never could he have imagined one would torture him
right after being intimate with him.
What the hell - had he stumbled into some psychopathic woman
straight out of a movie or novel?
Even though Xia Xiaomei called herself a psychopath, Sun Yijie refused to believe it!
He refused to accept he could encounter such a deranged woman!!!!ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Wait! Did that boss send you?!"
Sun Yijie suddenly thought of the married woman's husband,
though he doubted Xia Xiaomei was part of some revenge scheme.
He truly couldn't think of how he'd offended her.
As she sprinkled more salt, Xia Xiaomei said, "No."
"Don't bother guessing."
"I'm doing this for no reason. We have no grudge."
"Like you said earlier - I really am a psychopath."
"I enjoy this. I take pleasure in it."
"Understand?"
Her tone remained perfectly calm as she spoke,
which only made it more devastating.
Sun Yijie would have preferred her to say it with a sinister expression -
this detached demeanor was far more terrifying.
More horrifying.
"Please, let me go! Xiaomei, even one night together creates bonds! I'm begging you - just free me and I'll do anything! I'll be your dog! Anything you want! I'll even kill for you if that's what you want!!!"
Sun Yijie broke down into hysterical sobs.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: The Lingchi Master - Sherlock
chapters.content:
Xia Xiaomei turned her head and asked, "Are you really willing to obey me and do anything I say?"
Sun Yijie nodded frantically like pounding garlic. Seeing a chance to survive, he naturally said whatever sounded good: "I am! I'll do anything you want! I'd gladly be your slave for life!"
Xia Xiaomei asked, "What if I told you to help me capture other people for me to kill? Would you do that?"
"Yes! I would!!!" In his current situation, Sun Yijie would agree even if she demanded his parents' lives.
Xia Xiaomei nodded in satisfaction. But then she sighed deeply: "What a pity, what a pity. You've already been reserved by someone else. Your life isn't mine to decide anymore."
"W-what do you mean?!" Sun Yijie stammered.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Xia Xiaomei explained, "In the past when I killed men, I would torture them endlessly until they died in agony. But now that's not possible. I need money, so I've sold you to someone else."
"Sold? What the fuck! I'm a living human being! Wait, you need money? You're so rich already! Look at all that gold jewelry!!!"
Xia Xiaomei said calmly, "Those are all fake. Just ordinary metal painted gold. Bought online for 9.9 yuan with free shipping." She picked up a gold bracelet from the nightstand, cut it with pliers from her toolbox, and showed Sun Yijie the cross-section.
Real gold would remain gold-colored inside when cut, but this bracelet revealed dark brown metal - who knows what cheap material it was made of.Pfft!
Sun Yijie literally spat out a mouthful of blood - not figuratively. He was genuinely wounded, having risked his life for worthless fakes.
About 50,000 viewers remained in the live stream at this late hour - the most hardcore fans of "Far Neighbor."
Seeing Sun Yijie vomit blood, Ultimate Rich Kid laughed uproariously: [HAHAHAHA, this is hilarious! Poor little Sun Sun.]
Little Aunt commented: [Nothing funny about it. I just see a desperate man. By the way, did you catch what Xia Xiaomei said earlier? She sold Sun Yijie! To whom?!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [No idea... maybe she's lying?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Probably not. Several residents have sold lab rats or other perverted tenants in this apartment building before. There are also several buyers!] [I think this time it might be...]
Just as Domineering Female CEO was about to type the buyer's identity, new movement appeared in the stream. Someone was knocking on Xia Xiaomei's door in the middle of the night.
Xia Xiaomei opened the door and brought the visitor to the bedroom - a man who appeared to be in his twenties at first glance. But the crow's feet at his eyes betrayed his true age of 35.
He was strikingly handsome, blending Eastern and Western features - clearly mixed-race, though his exact heritage was unclear. Dressed in a burgundy suit and black leather shoes, he carried a black briefcase.
"Your buyer is here," Xia Xiaomei said flatly to Sun Yijie on the bed.
Sun Yijie stared at the man, shocked that the buyer would arrive so quickly and even more surprised by his handsome, foreign appearance.
The handsome mixed-race man smiled at Sun Yijie: "Let me introduce myself. Hello, I'm Sherlock."
His Chinese was flawless.
Sun Yijie blinked: "Sherlock? Sherlock Holmes?"
"No no no," Sherlock waved his hand. "I'm not that fictional world-famous detective. My father just admired him, so he named me Sherlock. Coincidentally, his surname was Xia too."
Sun Yijie's mind couldn't keep up: "Your father's surname is Xia? Foreigners have that surname?"
Sherlock smiled, his dimples charming: "I'm mixed-race. My father is Chinese, mother is British. Understand?"
After speaking, Sherlock carefully examined Sun Yijie's entire body, studying every muscle and vein with intense scrutiny.
Xia Xiaomei said, "Since you're here, I'll hand Sun Yijie over. How much can you pay?"
Sherlock thought for a minute: "Normally 700,000, but since it's our first transaction, I'll give you an extra 300,000 - 1 million total. I hope we can cooperate often in the future."
Xia Xiaomei nodded, clearly satisfied with the amount. Hearing he'd been sold for 1 million (when his base price was only 700,000), Sun Yijie felt both speechless and humiliated.
He asked Sherlock directly: "Sherlock, why are you buying me? Don't you know human trafficking is illegal?"
Sherlock ignored the second question, only answering the first: "You'll soon find out why I bought you."
Xia Xiaomei brought Sherlock a folding table. He placed his black briefcase on it, opened it, and took out a delicate silver box.
Inside the silver box were only two items: one straight, sharp small knife, and another curved blade.
Sherlock chose the curved knife and stood beside Sun Yijie. Seeing this, Sun Yijie felt extremely uneasy.
Sure enough, Sherlock smiled as he pressed the curved blade against Sun Yijie's eight-pack abs and sliced off a palm-sized piece of bloody flesh.
Sun Yijie screamed in agony. Then something even more horrifying happened.
Sherlock took out a white cloth from his briefcase, spread it neatly on the table, and placed the flesh upon it with sacred reverence, as if handling holy relics.
Sun Yijie was completely stunned, watching this scene in terror, his eyes nearly popping out of his skull.
What the hell was this guy doing?!
Was he... some kind of sadistic, body-mutilating psychopath?

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Madman! Pervert! Demon!
chapters.content:
"Madman! Pervert! Demon!"
"Ahhhhh! Let me go!!!!!"
Sun Yijie struggled violently at this moment, suddenly realizing this buyer was an even more terrifying pervert than Xia Xiaomei.
This guy, this guy!
This guy isn't human!
How could anyone do such things?!
Because after Sherlock cut off his first piece of flesh, he proceeded to cut the second, then the third.
And neatly arranged them all on the white cloth.
Xia Xiaomei watched from the side and asked, "How many cuts will you make like this?"
Sherlock replied, "The more the better. It all depends on the Lingchi Master's skill level."After speaking, he closed his eyes, then reopened them, as if the previous cuts were just warm-up, and now the real show was about to begin.
Time for true enjoyment.
Sherlock turned and continued pulling items from his black briefcase.
That black briefcase didn't look large, but seemed bottomless.
From it, he pulled out white gloves and put them on both hands.
Then he said to Xia Xiaomei:
"Want to join? I think you've got potential as a Lingchi Master. The way you cut wounds on him and sprinkled salt shows real talent."
Sherlock turned his head to look at Xia Xiaomei.
Xia Xiaomei shook her head: "No thanks, I'll just watch from here. I've already vented earlier."
"Mmm, fine then."
"Fitness guy, this is my first time performing lingchi execution on a fitness trainer. Look at these perfect muscles, ah, so beautiful, such exquisite texture!"
Sherlock sighed with admiration.
Sun Yijie was now scared out of his wits.
He cursed at Sherlock, demanding to be released.
But it was useless.
Sun Yijie knew he'd encountered the kind of dismemberment psycho that only appears in movies, TV shows, or news reports.
But those psychos dismembered to dispose of bodies - this guy actually enjoyed dismembering living people!!!!
Survival instinct made Sun Yijie struggle desperately.
Tears and snot mixed together, presenting a pitiful sight.
Like a fat pig knowing it's about to be slaughtered.
...
Meanwhile, in the live stream room:
Ultimate Rich Kid was cursing: [Damn! Isn't this guy too perverted?! Lingchi? The lingchi I'm thinking of?!]
Little Aunt questioned: [Besides the lingchi you're thinking of, is there another kind in this world?]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [Shouldn't this ancient execution method have disappeared by now?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Who said it disappeared... It's just not an official punishment anymore so you don't see it...]
Lingchi execution was one of the most cruel and terrifying punishments in ancient China.
Absolute torture.
Watching yourself being killed bit by bit, cut by cut.
Pure physical and psychological torment, lasting an extremely long time.
