Historical figures executed by lingchi included: Fang Xiaoru (executed with ten familial generations), the Ming Dynasty eunuch Liu Jin.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
And the controversial late-Ming figure Yuan Chonghuan.
Ultimate Rich Kid said: [I just searched online - lingchi execution requires at least 8 cuts, up to thousands, depending on the Lingchi Master's skill. Wonder how skilled this Sherlock is - the better he is, the worse for Sun Yijie...]
Domineering Female CEO: [Right, Sun Yijie's really unlucky - first tortured by Xia Xiaomei, now getting someone even worse!!!]
Ultimate Rich Kid: [This Sherlock is seriously perverted... Female CEO, do you know his background? How did he become someone who enjoys lingchi executions? Or was he born like this?]
Domineering Female CEO: [The apartment's profile on Sherlock just says: 'Lingchi Master by family tradition.']
[As for the rest, I don't know.]
[If you want his background, you'll have to dig yourself. Or wait until he appears more and shares his own story.]
...
Meanwhile at Jiang Ran's place:
After the 9pm matchmaking event ended, Jiang Ran helped clean up.
He packed some buffet food and returned to his room 304 by 10pm.
Normally he should have encountered the clown upon returning home.
But for some reason, the clown who planned to wait for Jiang Ran's return...
Left after waiting over four hours.
Thus Jiang Ran completely missed him upon returning home.
After getting home, Jiang Ran put the packed food in the fridge and prepared for bed.
But before sleeping, he noticed something odd - why was there a large area of white paper scraps on his living room floor?
Dense like snowflakes.
Day 3, Round 27.
Wang Anjian left the matchmaking event's activity room around the same time as Jiang Ran last night, also packing food.
After returning home, he took painkillers and went to sleep.
He slept until 1am.
Suddenly waking, he spewed a mouthful of liquid.
After spitting it out, he felt extremely weak. Waiting five minutes, he turned on the bedside lamp.
The sight shocked him.
His quilt and sheets were covered in red bloodstains.
Large patches everywhere.
Looking down, Wang Anjian saw his white T-shirt was also stained red.
Wiping his mouth with his right hand revealed fresh blood on his hand.
Staring at the mess before him, Wang Anjian breathed heavily, unclear what to think.
After a while, he used his relatively clean left hand to grab his charging phone from the nightstand.
He saw a new message notification.
Unlocking the phone, he found a notification for 10,000 yuan deposited.
He smiled faintly.
Then began spending the money immediately.
This was his second time receiving 10,000 yuan - the first had already been fully spent.
He'd bought various daily necessities, school supplies, mailing them to the mountain village where he once taught.
The rest he donated to online medical fundraisers.
This new 10,000 would be spent the same way, keeping only basic living expenses for himself.
By 3am, he collapsed weakly onto the bed.
Eyes empty and lost.
Why did he spend the money immediately upon receiving it?
Simple reason - he feared dying the next second with money still in his account, having no family or friends to handle his affairs.
Wouldn't that be wasteful?
"I hope I can live a bit longer!"
Wang Anjian didn't believe in any religion.
But now he prayed to heaven to let him live longer, earn more money.
To help more people.
Unbeknownst to Wang Anjian, two floors away in room 901...
The physically healthy Sun Yijie was suffering inhuman torture.
One thing was certain - Sun Yijie would likely die before Wang Anjian.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Bai Ze Tells Mike to Go to Room 1001
chapters.content:
At six in the morning, the sun peeked through the clouds at the horizon, its golden rays soon to bathe the earth. American detective Mike currently stood on the rooftop of Alice Apartment, smoking a cigarette.
The ground was littered with over a dozen cigarette butts, evidence that he had been smoking alone here for quite some time. After failing to track down Robert last night, he hadn't frantically continued his search. Instead, he returned to Zhou Wu and Shen Xing's bridal suite to sleep. At five in the morning, after washing up, he came to the rooftop and had been smoking here ever since.
The time now was 6:10 AM. A long text message appeared on his phone, sent from overseas. The message read:Follow current novels on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
[Mike, I visited Robert at Prometheus Prison as you requested. Video attached.]
Before sleeping last night, Mike had asked his friend in Maple Country to visit Robert in prison. Of course, not just anyone could visit - this friend was no ordinary person. The friend successfully visited Robert and secretly recorded the meeting, sending the video to Mike.
Mike opened the video. The footage was clear, showing the friend was skilled at covert recording. In the video, Robert sat arrogantly on a chair, smirking without restraint as he talked freely with Mike's friend. The friend's face wasn't visible since it was shot from their perspective.
After watching the video three times, Mike confirmed one thing: "This Robert in prison is fake."
Though the imposter looked nearly identical to the real Robert - with similar hairstyle, voice, and mannerisms - Mike could tell it was an act. A convincing performance, but still a performance. This meant the Robert he saw in the apartment yesterday was undoubtedly the real one.
While Mike had already been certain yesterday, he always required one hundred percent proof rather than relying on hunches. Now, he felt himself sinking into a dark whirlpool. How could a notorious serial killer who terrorized Maple Country be secretly swapped out? What kind of person or organization could pull this off?
As he finished his current cigarette and reached for another, the elevator dozens of meters away suddenly activated. It had been on the sixth floor, descended to the second, then rose continuously until reaching the ninth floor, approaching the tenth.Mike expected it to stop at the tenth floor, but instead it came all the way to the rooftop. "Who is it? It's barely past six. From my observations these past few days, no one usually comes up this early."
Leaning relaxed against the rooftop railing, Mike immediately tensed up, his gaze shifting between the elevator and nearby staircase - the two access points to the rooftop.
Ding! The elevator arrived, its doors slowly opening to reveal a pale young man in his twenties. Mike studied him carefully. The young man was exceptionally pale.
Watching as the pale youth approached and stopped two and a half meters away, Mike pocketed his unlit cigarette. Clearly, this young man had come specifically for him. Only an idiot wouldn't realize that.
"Looking for me?" Mike asked.
The pale youth nodded. "You're investigating this apartment, right? Investigating Zhou Wu and his father's disappearance? I'm here to give you clues."
Mike's already tense body stiffened further. He didn't know this young man - hadn't even met him before today. So how did he know about the investigation? Normally, only Manager Xiao Zhang in the apartment should be aware.
"Who are you?" Mike squinted as he asked.
The pale youth replied calmly, "My name is Bai Ze."
"If you trust me, go to Room 1001. You'll find the answers you want there, including the secrets of this apartment. Though given your skills as America's tenth-ranked detective, you've probably already figured most of it out - just missing some details."
This sudden appearance and string of key information left even the experienced detective momentarily bewildered. But a seasoned detective was still a seasoned detective. His next question wasn't about how Bai Ze knew his investigation details or identity, nor whether he was being watched, or whether to believe him.
Instead, he cut to the core: "Why are you telling me this?" Skipping trivialities to ask the essential question - why help a complete stranger?
Bai Ze answered, "Because we entered this apartment with the same purpose. You're investigating two disappearances. I'm investigating one."
With that terse reply, Bai Ze turned and left without caring whether the American believed him.
Mike remained on the rooftop for another ten minutes before taking the elevator to the first floor and leaving Alice Apartment. He returned an hour later carrying something, went straight to the tenth floor, and pretended to casually walk around the hallway. After ensuring no one was around, he installed the object - a pinhole camera aimed at Room 1001 and the entire tenth floor hallway. Actually, Mike installed five cameras, which was why he had left earlier - to acquire surveillance equipment.
After completing this, he left the tenth floor and checked his phone, where he could now monitor all five cameras. For a detective like Mike, one principle was paramount: trust but verify. Any lead must be confirmed before acting. If he had rashly entered Room 1001 just because Bai Ze suggested it, he might have walked into a trap. Therefore, thorough investigation was essential before entering.
Meanwhile, inside Room 1001, a pungent stench persistently permeated the entire space.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: The Reappearance of Xiao Q and the Other Two
chapters.content:
This disgusting stench that made people want to vomit as soon as they smelled it was a combination of several foul odors.
First: the smell of sweat and body odor from not bathing for a long time.
Second: the stench of feces and urine.
Third: the smell of stagnant air in Room 1001.
Fourth: other minor unpleasant smells.
This combined stench, anyone who smelled it just now would probably cover their nose and run away quickly.
But those who had already adapted to it didn’t care anymore.
At this moment.
Inside the living room of Room 1001, there were three people who had gotten used to this stench.
Three miserable brothers in hardship.Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, and “Conan’s distant younger brother”—Ke Bei.
All three were lying on the floor, some with eyes open, some closed.
Weak and lifeless, like ghosts.
If it weren’t for the rise and fall of their chests, or the breath coming through their noses, they might have been mistaken for dead.
At the same time, the current appearance of these three was somewhat frightening.
They looked like savages.
Their hair was messy and disheveled.
Their faces looked terrible, as if they hadn’t bathed for many days.
Their upper clothes were dirty, blackened and gray.
As for their lower bodies, surprisingly, none of the three wore any clothing at all.
Not even underwear.
Looking around, their outer pants were thrown aside, and their underwear was covered with yellow dried fecal stains.
A heavy stench emanated from their bodies.
Among the three, Ke Bei looked the scariest.
Because Ke Bei already had a scruffy beard and thick sideburns like Zhang Fei, and after being locked up here for so long without trimming, his beard had exploded wildly.
That was why he looked the most terrifying among them.
At this moment, Xiao Peng, lying on the ground, suddenly got up.
He was bare-bottomed, still heavily shackled with strong iron chains.
He walked a few steps and sat directly on a tiny plastic toilet.
He began to defecate loudly, contributing new layers to the stench.
Logically, the other two should have reacted, but having long since adapted, even if all three defecated simultaneously, they didn’t care at all.
After finishing, Xiao Peng didn’t use paper to wipe because, of course, he had none.
He got up and returned to lie back on the ground, his eyes dull and vacant.
Not long after Xiao Peng stood up, Xiao Q also got up.
But he didn’t go to defecate;
he went to eat and drink.
He crawled over to two basins.
Imitating a dog, he stretched out his head and tongue, drinking water and eating the densely packed round pellets of dog food.
In the first few days after being locked in Room 1001,
the three were still normal people, their minds racing desperately to find a way to escape.
They would rather die than yield.
Except for drinking water, they didn’t touch the dog food.
Because touching it felt humiliating enough—drinking water from a dog bowl was already shameful enough, but eating dog food from the dog bowl was breaking their own bottom line and dignity.
But later, just drinking water without eating anything became unbearable.
It was Ke Bei who suggested that eating dog food wasn’t so bad, reminding them of Goujian’s perseverance through hardship.
They ate dog food to preserve their vital strength, to escape.
Thus, the bottom line they once swore never to cross was broken.
Little did they realize that bottom lines were made to be broken, step by step.
The three ate dog food and drank water.
Their bodies gradually returned to normal circulation.
Their bowel and bladder functions normalized, no longer excessive urination and insufficient defecation.
When they were first locked in, they wiped themselves after bowel movements using two small rectangular packs of tissue paper that Xiao Peng carried with him.
What? Curious why Xiao Peng would carry tissue paper with him? Guys usually don’t carry tissue paper, right?
Actually, it was all for impressing girls—when a girl didn’t have tissue paper or ran out of it and was in distress, you could offer it, showing your charm.
He didn’t just carry tissue paper;
he also had several condoms!
Thus, the three used those two packs of paper sparingly.
But because their bodies had returned to normal circulation,
the paper was all used up.
So then, what next?
The three were chained and couldn’t reach the restroom or anywhere else.
They could only scavenge for whatever they could reach within the maximum range allowed by the iron chains.
But Su Mi had long prepared for this, leaving nothing within their reach.
They couldn’t even reach the curtains.
Because of this, the paper ran out.
They started using their underwear to wipe themselves, which led to the yellow stains of feces all over the underwear, even staining their hands.
They could only take off their outer pants to wipe their hands.
Later, the three gave up wiping altogether.
It became what it is now.
Then, about eating and drinking.
Before, the three held the basins to drink water and grabbed dog food with their hands to shove into their mouths.
But now, their hands were covered in feces and couldn’t be washed with water.
They could only wipe with their pants.
They had no other choice.
For cleanliness,
they had to imitate real dogs.
Stretching out their heads and tongues to eat dog food and drink water.
Trying not to use their hands at all.
Because of this,
the three probably didn’t even notice
that Su Mi hadn’t done anything except imprison them here.
Their behavior was becoming more and more like dogs, not humans.
Everything was under Su Mi’s control and rhythm.
She was a professional.
She had trained countless dogs before.
“Xiao Q, how many days have we been locked here?”
At this moment, Ke Bei, lying aside, asked weakly.
Xiao Q also answered weakly: “I don’t know.”
At first, the three kept track of time, but later, their sense of time grew more and more vague, so they didn’t know what day or time it was anymore.
They could only roughly judge by the setting sun outside.
“Are we going to be locked here forever? Xiao Hua, Dad! Mom! Damn it, no one has come looking for me! Haven’t they noticed I’m missing?!”ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Xiao Peng wailed in despair.
During this short time locked up, he felt like he was living in hell.
Especially after defecating without paper to wipe, leaving feces stuck to his bottom.
Xiao Q glanced at Xiao Peng, who was covering his face crying, and had nothing to say.
He had no hope that his family or friends could find him.
He felt that if anyone could find him, it would probably be his detective uncle.
But even that hope was only about one percent higher than the hope from family and friends.
There was no way.
Think about it carefully—they definitely weren’t the first batch to enter Alice Apartment.
Before them, who knew how many batches had come in.
Those people were probably either dead or imprisoned just like them.
The sudden disappearances of those people hadn’t caused any uproar, so how could they expect to cause one?
Moreover, the forces behind the apartment were too huge. The disappearance of just a few people like them had probably already been handled long ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Mike Prepares to Infiltrate Room 1001
chapters.content:
All three of them felt utterly hopeless.
They wished someone would come save them.
But none of them could think of who might rescue them? Who could possibly save them?
Bang!
At that moment, the door suddenly opened.
Without even looking up, Xiao Q and the other two knew it was Su Mi entering.
Su Mi came every noon to pour dog food and water for them, ensuring they wouldn't die of thirst or starvation.
Beyond that, she took no other actions.
Xiao Q thought Su Mi was a master.
A master at boiling frogs alive slowly.Had Su Mi used extreme methods from the start, trying to train them into dog-men like those creatures, they would have resisted fiercely.
It was uncertain whether they could truly be transformed into dog-men, and even if successful, it would require tremendous time and effort.
Not worth it.The source of this content ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
But now?
After simply imprisoning them for some time, wasn't their current lifestyle already quite dog-like?
Before this, Xiao Q would have sworn he could never be trained into a dog.
He had full confidence in himself, firmly believing he was human.
But now, he wasn't so sure anymore. He couldn't trust himself.
He truly feared his mind was trending toward collapse, his psychological defenses gradually being broken down.
He feared he might not withstand Su Mi's next moves and actually be trained into a dog.
"Sister, could you give us some toilet paper? We're not asking for anything else, just some toilet paper to wipe ourselves after using the bathroom."
After Su Mi had poured fresh dog food and water for the three men, Xiao Peng quickly made his request as she was about to leave.
Xiao Peng was extremely obedient before Su Mi now, probably from being beaten some time ago, not daring to mouth off anymore.
Su Mi smiled faintly: "Toilet paper? You're not humans, why would you need toilet paper?"
"When have you ever seen a dog use toilet paper after pooping?"
Xiao Peng was left speechless.
Ke Bei chimed in from the side: "Then could you open the window? It stinks too much in here."
Su Mi shook her head: "No can do. Opening it would ruin the soundproofing."
Xiao Q sat up and said: "Then give us more water!"
Su Mi looked puzzled: "Why? Isn't the water I give you enough to drink?"
Xiao Q: "We want to take a bath. Look, dogs can take baths, right? Don't pet dogs get taken to pet shops regularly by their owners for baths?"
Xiao Q was still the clever Xiao Q, following the logic of Su Mi's earlier statements.
Xiao Peng and Ke Bei immediately imitated dogs begging on their hind legs, pleading with Su Mi.
All three had adopted a meek attitude before Su Mi now, unlike their initial defiance.
Not because they'd become cowardly or surrendered.
But because they were enduring humiliation to preserve their lives, learning from Goujian who slept on firewood and tasted gall.
Their current submission before Su Mi was for the sake of future freedom.
"Oh? But that still doesn't fit. You're right that pet dogs get taken for baths by their owners, but you three are strays, mutts! When have you ever seen stray dogs getting baths?"
"Uh..."
The three were left speechless again.
But immediately,
Xiao Q put on an ingratiating expression: "We're willing to be your dogs! Woof woof!!! We want an owner too!!!"
The other two joined in: "Woof woof!"
Three young men uniformly imitating dogs made quite a comical scene.
Su Mi was amused by their antics, covering her mouth as she laughed charmingly.
Her laughter was pleasant, melodious.
Especially when Su Mi laughed, she became even more feminine.
After laughing, Su Mi curled her lips in a faint smile, covering her mouth: "Alright, you three, save your energy. You're not at the level of being my pet dogs yet, so don't think pretending to submit will make me lower my guard and let you out."
That was exactly what they'd been thinking.
But clearly, Su Mi was an extremely perceptive woman.
Those alluring eyes could see right through everything.
Su Mi continued: "As for wanting toilet paper and extra water, I know you just want to clean yourselves."
"I've got a great idea that doesn't require paper or water. Why don't you three just lick each other clean?"
"After all, you can't teach an old dog new tricks, and dogs love eating shit the most!"
"Oh, and there's a shortcut right before you three."
"If you perform for me right now—eating each other's shit—I'll believe you've fully evolved into dogs. Then I'll move to the next step ahead of schedule, making you my pet dogs sooner. How about that?"
Hearing this, all three broke down inside.
Eat shit?
Each other's shit?
Unless they truly became dogs, who could possibly do something so disgusting?
Thus, Xiao Q and the others understood from Su Mi's words that only by eating shit would they be considered fully evolved dogs?
Only then would she proceed to the next step?
So if they never ate shit, would they never proceed, remaining trapped here forever?!
"I'd rather die!"
Xiao Peng broke down completely.
But if someone truly wanted to die, they wouldn't say it out loud.
It was like employees constantly complaining about the boss's exploitation, threatening to quit.
In the end, those who kept threatening never quit.
It was always the quiet ones who actually resigned.
Su Mi looked at the three broken men, smiling slightly as she left Room 1001.
Round 27, Day 4, Midnight.
American detective Mike made his move.
Having observed through the five pinhole cameras for a full day,
he'd seen no one enter Room 1001 except for an elegant Chinese woman.
Moreover, the camera installed directly opposite Room 1001 had captured a glimpse of the living room when that Chinese woman opened the door to enter.
Though somewhat blurry, Mike clearly saw through his phone screen that there were three people—likely three men—chained up inside.
They appeared to be imprisoned.
Unfortunately, the Chinese woman opened and closed the door too quickly.
Both when entering and leaving.
The pinhole cameras couldn't do more.
No additional footage was captured.
Normally, given his cautious nature, he would have observed another day.
That would be safer.
But for some reason, his heart kept pounding violently.
As if warning him that waiting another day would lead to something dangerous.
He needed to act quickly.
You might not believe it, but this was his intuition as a famous detective.
Sometimes, intuition was more reliable than reasoning.
Therefore, he chose midnight as his time to act.
Coincidentally, at that exact moment, another 10,000 Chinese yuan was deposited into his account.

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Mike Meets the Three
chapters.content:
Mike set off from the marriage room 404 of Shen Xing and Zhou Wu.
Only ten minutes later, at 12:10 a.m., he arrived in front of Room 1001.
Of course, before opening the door, he merely passed by Room 1001, tiptoed around the tenth floor quietly to confirm there was no danger, and then finally stopped in front of Room 1001.
At this moment, Mike's breathing was steady, and his heartbeat was calm, but inside his mind, waves of intense thoughts surged, his caution never ceasing.
Sharing this feeling with him was a group of wealthy viewers watching the live broadcast through cameras.
At this time, the Far Neighbor live stream room was abuzz.
The Ultimate Rich Kid complained: "Damn, I've realized that everyone in this apartment likes to move around at night. I was about to cuddle my girlfriend and go to sleep, but Mike suddenly pulled this stunt—coming to rescue people in the dead of night! Now I can't sleep at all!!!!"
Fairy Sister: "Luckily, 12 a.m. isn’t too late. Watching Mike rescue people before sleeping is fine. But honestly, I never expected Mike to be the one saving Xiao Q and the others!"
Little Dragon Girl: "Actually, these three should thank Bai Ze;
he’s the one who pushed Mike to come to 1001. You all saw yesterday morning’s rooftop live stream, right?"
Domineering Female CEO: "It doesn’t matter if you watched or not. Key moments are always recorded in the stream. It’s just that those who didn’t watch might not understand what happened. For example, if you don’t know about the rooftop conversation between Mike and Bai Ze, how else would Mike come to 1001?"Middle-aged Uncle: "I can’t hold on, can’t hold on, I’m getting old. I just drank a cup of coffee and have to watch this part! Honestly, I really like the trio of Xiao Q and friends. If it were someone else, like Li Mengmeng who’s about to be rescued, I wouldn’t stay up late drinking coffee to watch."
...
What is the most important thing to be a detective?
Smart? Wise? Decisive? Careful? Bold?
All are necessary, but none are the most important.
Mike, the tenth-ranked detective from the United States, tells you:
The most important thing to be a detective is to be well-read.
You don’t have to master every profession or all things in the world, but you must at least understand them.
At the same time, you must master multiple skills.
Why?
Because if you are not well-read, the day you encounter a case or danger that you don’t know about or understand, you might be dead meat.
Then, skills.
Take Mike for example.
He can drive cars, operate yachts, and fly helicopters.
Of course, armored vehicles and tanks were things he learned back in the day.
Besides these, he also needs some life skills.
For instance—lock picking.
Ke Bei, an ordinary detective not well-known in China, can pick locks.
Naturally, Mike can too.
If he couldn’t pick locks, he’d be stopped by the security door of 1001 right now.
So he had to figure out how to open the door, steal keys, or something else.
But because he could pick locks, things were much simpler.
In less than a minute, Mike used his usual lock-picking tools to open the lock of 1001.
After opening it, he didn’t just shove the door open recklessly.
Instead, he slowly and cautiously pushed the door.
Because it was just past midnight, the inside of 1001 was pitch black.Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
After pushing the door halfway open, he took out a palm-sized flashlight from his pocket, turned it on, and shone it inside 1001.
Without the light, it was fine;
but once lit, he saw three people sitting on the living room floor like beggars, their dim eyes all fixed on him.
Mike slipped inside the door.
Then closed the door quietly behind him and walked lightly toward the three in the living room, constantly scanning left and right to avoid any unexpected surprises.
Soon, he arrived in front of the three.
He switched the flashlight’s beam to a dispersed mode and pointed it at the ground.
The peripheral light illuminated the three people in the living room as well as himself.
He didn’t waste words but looked down on them and said directly:
“I know you’re curious now, but I’ll keep it brief.”
“My name is Mike, a detective from the United States. Zhou Yan asked me to investigate her brother Zhou Wu and her father’s disappearance in Alice Apartment.”
“I’ve introduced myself. Now it’s your turn.”
When Mike opened the door, the three had actually heard the noise and looked toward the entrance. They hadn’t fallen asleep yet. You might ask why they weren’t sleeping so late at night?
Because after being here for so many days, with nothing to do during the day, they just slept then. Since they slept in the day, they naturally couldn’t sleep at night.
So any slight noise immediately caught their attention.
They were curious about what Su Mi was doing here so late at night.
After all, Su Mi had been coming once a day, always at noon, never at night.
So curiosity stirred.
But when the door opened, it wasn’t pulled open suddenly but pushed slowly, like a thief stealing something.
The three immediately realized it was not what they expected;
the person coming this late at night was not Su Mi...
Sure enough, when the door opened halfway, a strong flashlight beam shone their way.
They knew for sure it wasn’t Su Mi because if it were Su Mi, she wouldn’t use a strong flashlight but would just open the door and turn on the living room light.
But since it wasn’t Su Mi, they had no idea who it was.
Then, as the person with the flashlight approached, they finally saw who had come to 1001 so late at night.
The three of them were shocked beyond belief.
This person was a foreigner?!
Moreover, he spoke Chinese exceptionally well.
What he said afterward completely exceeded their expectations.
An American detective?
Here to investigate the disappearances of Zhou Wu and Zhou Wu’s father?
“My name is Xiao Q, a college student studying criminal investigation. This is my friend Xiao Peng, also a college student, and that one over there is Ke Bei, a detective like you.”
After Mike’s self-introduction, the three digested the information, and Xiao Q immediately introduced himself and the other two.
He was a bit emotional, speaking so fast it sounded like his tongue was burning.
Probably because he hadn’t seen anyone besides Su Mi for so long, especially since he felt this person might be the key to their freedom.
Mike understood the identities of the three.
He paid more attention to Xiao Q, since he studied criminal investigation, and after learning that Ke Bei was also a detective like him, he was somewhat surprised.
“I see. So who locked you three up here?”
Mike asked.
Xiao Q said, “Before I answer that, can I ask if you can save us?”

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Rescuing the Three
chapters.content:
After Xiao Q asked this question, Xiao Peng and Ke Bei both showed hopeful expressions. There was no helping it—they had been imprisoned here for too long.
They desperately wanted freedom!
They really, really wanted it!
They wanted it so badly they could cry!!!
It was the same as Hu Hai wanting to become emperor!
Mike nodded: "Naturally, but I also need to learn some things from you."
Xiao Q asked: "What things?"
Mike said: "I met a very pale Chinese youth in the apartment who told me that Room 1001 held the answers I wanted and the secrets of this apartment. That's why I came."Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs
"A very pale... Chinese youth?"
"Wait, isn't that Bai Ze?!"The three exclaimed in unison.
Actually, after being imprisoned here, they had wondered whether Bai Ze might come to rescue them.
But since they had no relationship with him, they thought it unlikely.
Unexpectedly, Bai Ze hadn't come himself but had sent someone instead.
Because of this, the three felt completely at ease with Mike.
After all, they clearly remembered how Su Mi had pretended to be good but turned out to be terrible.
Of course, this time—just like last time—whether Su Mi or Mike were good or bad made no difference.
Because last time, right after dealing with the Dog Men, even if Su Mi hadn't pretended, she could have easily captured them.
This time, they were even worse off—completely restrained. What could they do?
Therefore, to be rescued as soon as possible,
Xiao Q said: "I don't know what answers you want, but I can tell you about our experiences and what we believe are the apartment's secrets."
Mike: "Alright, go ahead."
"Consider it payment for me rescuing you later."
Xiao Q nodded:
"You asked earlier who imprisoned us here—it was Su Mi."
"Next, I'll tell you about the apartment's hidden secrets."
"Of course, this is just our speculation—you can take it as reference."
"This apartment houses many perverted criminals and serial killers."
"As well as ordinary people who signed agreements to live here."
"Ordinary people receive 10,000 yuan per day they stay here."
"It's essentially a survival game for those who signed the agreement."
Hearing this,
Mike felt it matched what he had imagined—one side providing money, the other providing lives.
However, Xiao Q's explanation filled in the specific details of this arrangement.
One thing that surprised Mike was the existence of these agreements.
And another big question:
Those who signed agreements got 10,000 yuan per day for staying here.
But he had never signed any agreement—why was he also receiving 10,000 daily?
Could it be that simply entering here automatically made him like those who signed agreements?
Unaware of Mike's thoughts, Xiao Q continued:
"I'm a resident who signed an agreement to live here."
"Xiao Peng's ex-girlfriend signed the agreement, then was killed by Dog Men in the apartment. The three of us killed Dog Men to avenge her, then were imprisoned here as dogs by Su Mi, the Dog Men's owner."
"As for Ke Bei, he also signed an agreement—he came to investigate his father's disappearance. His father had signed an agreement to live here years ago."
Mike frowned: "What are Dog Men?"
Xiao Peng interjected: "They're people trained to behave like dogs—we call them Dog Men."
Mike nodded: "I see. Also, this owner Su Mi you mentioned—she's a very beautiful woman, right?"
The three nodded, asking if Mike had encountered her.
Mike said he had installed pinhole cameras on the 10th floor this morning and saw the woman who entered Room 1001 at noon.
Mike then asked about Zhou Wu and his father.
After all, Mike hadn't forgotten that he entered this apartment to complete that commission.
Xiao Q thought for a moment: "Zhou Wu and his girlfriend were part of the same batch of new residents as me and Ke Bei—we all attended the same welcome party."
"As for Zhou Wu's disappearance—now that you've seen this apartment, he was probably either killed or imprisoned like us."
"As for Zhou Wu's father, we know nothing."
Mike: "Alright, I understand. Now I'll free you."
Mike placed his flashlight on the ground, shining it against the wall.
First, he took out his lockpicking tools and crouched beside Xiao Q, who pointed out the three padlocked iron restraints on his body.
"Mike, do you have any extra lockpicking tools? Give me one."
Ke Bei, who was closer to the wall, moved over.
Mike pulled another lockpick from his pocket and tossed it to Ke Bei.
Picking it up, Ke Bei noticed it resembled his own tools—both were specially made wires.
So he began picking his own locks.
Unexpectedly, he couldn't open any of the three restraints—neck shackle, handcuffs, or leg irons.
These locks were far more difficult than Room 1001's security door—completely different levels.
Mike obviously noticed how challenging these restraints were to open.
But being ranked tenth in America,
his skills surpassed Ke Bei's.
While Ke Bei failed to open any, Mike had already removed Xiao Q's neck shackle.
Freed from the neck restraint and its chain,
Xiao Q immediately felt relief.
"What's wrong? Can't open it?"
Mike turned to Ke Bei.
Ke Bei smiled awkwardly: "I can't pick this lock. Normally, I can handle most locks—even security doors don't trouble me. But this one has me stumped."
Mike said: "Seems you've never picked rich people's safes. These locks rival those."
Ke Bei: "No wonder then..."
As Mike spoke, he freed Xiao Q's handcuffs too.
At this moment, Xiao Peng said: "Mike, I realize you're no ordinary detective. You must be among the best."
"Oh? What makes you say that?"
Mike suddenly grew interested.
Honestly, among the three, Xiao Peng had made the least impression.
Xiao Peng said: "Look at us—more ragged than beggars, no pants, not even underwear. Yet when you saw us, you barely reacted—no surprise at all."
"Also, since we've been imprisoned here, the windows haven't opened. So our unwashed stench, plus urine and feces smells, have nowhere to go. Though we're used to it, the stench must be unbearable."
"This is your first time here—you didn't vomit or even cover your nose! You're amazing!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Su Mi in the Elevator, Three Men with No Escape
chapters.content:
Mike replied, "About these... When that woman opened the door at noon, my pinhole camera captured all three of you. Though the footage was a bit blurry, I've already gotten a general look and was mentally prepared."
"As for the smell you mentioned?"
"Well, it is a bit stinky, but it's nothing compared to what I've smelled before."
"Back in the U.S., I worked on a case involving a serial killer who stored all his victims in a basement, pickling them in giant vats. It was summer, and the basement was stuffy and hot. The stench of rotting corpses was a hundred times worse than this place."
Xiao Peng's eyes lit up upon hearing this. "A serial killer? You've handled cases like that?!"
Mike nodded while continuing to pick the locks.
During their days trapped here, Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, and Ke Bei, having found no way to escape and with nothing else to do, had resorted to pure conversation as their only entertainment. Most of their discussions revolved around Ke Bei's detective career, as the profession carried an air of mystery.
Xiao Peng had previously watched *Detective Conan* and assumed Ke Bei's detective life would be similar, given how alike their names were. However, after hearing Ke Bei recount his actual experiences, he realized he had been overestimating things.
Private detectives in China? The police would never let them near real cases, much less give them opportunities to solve crimes. Their work mostly involved investigating affairs, tracking cheating spouses, or conducting corporate surveillance. These were the kinds of jobs Ke Bei usually took.
Forget serial killers—he hadn’t even handled ordinary criminal cases. Well, unless you counted catching petty thieves or recovering stolen goods.Just like that, the glamorous, mysterious image of detectives shattered in Xiao Peng’s mind. And it wasn’t just him—Xiao Q’s illusions were crushed too. As a criminology student, he had consumed countless detective novels, movies, and TV shows, all of which painted detectives as brilliant sleuths taking on thrilling cases.
Reality, however…
Yet Mike’s brief description reignited their idealized image of detectives. Even Ke Bei’s eyes sparkled with interest.
"Does working as a detective in the U.S. mean you get to handle serious cases like that often?" Ke Bei asked eagerly.
Mike shrugged. "It’s hit or miss. I’ve dealt with plenty, sure, but I’ve also taken on the usual divorce cases, corporate espionage, and wealthy family dramas."
By then, Mike had completely removed the three shackles binding Xiao Q.
Once freed, Xiao Q felt an overwhelming sense of relief. He stood up, stretched his limbs, and after a moment, began jumping around the living room in sheer exhilaration.
Xiao Peng and Ke Bei watched enviously.
Next, Mike worked on Xiao Peng’s restraints. About ten minutes later, both Xiao Peng and Ke Bei were freed as well. They mimicked Xiao Q’s actions, stretching their stiff limbs after being shackled for so long.
Once they had loosened up, the three picked up their long-unworn pants from the floor and pulled them on. As for underwear?
Well… all three pairs were stained yellow with filth. Best to leave those behind.
"Now that you’re free, what’s the plan?" Mike asked.
Xiao Peng answered first, "I’m going home! I never want to step foot in this hellhole again!"
He was genuinely terrified, never wanting to relive imprisonment.
Xiao Q nodded. "Same. I’m heading home too."
He had initially signed a contract requiring him to stay in the apartment for seven days. Though he wasn’t sure exactly how long he’d been here, it had definitely exceeded that timeframe. That meant he wouldn’t have to worry about breaching the agreement or paying any penalties for leaving early.
After speaking, Xiao Q glanced at Ke Bei, whose unkempt beard now rivaled Zhang Fei’s legendary scruff.
Unlike them, Ke Bei had entered the Alice Apartment purely out of curiosity after signing the contract. His purpose wasn’t revenge—it was to find traces of his missing father.
So far, he had found nothing.
Whether Ke Bei would willingly leave the Alice Apartment remained uncertain.
Understanding Xiao Q’s unspoken question, Ke Bei said, "I’ll leave for now too. I need time to recover—physically and mentally. Even if I’m searching for my dad, it’ll have to wait."
Xiao Q exhaled in relief. He had feared Ke Bei would insist on staying, despite the danger.
"By the way, Mike, what about you?" Xiao Q turned to their rescuer. He had asked about their plans—but what were his?
"I’m staying. I still have unfinished business here," Mike replied.
"Since all three of you plan to leave, are you going now or staying overnight? It’s almost 1 AM."
The response was immediate and unanimous: "We’re leaving NOW. No staying!"
Their time as Su Mi’s captives had left deep psychological scars.
"Alright, let’s go."
Mike led the way, with the three men following. Though they had stretched their limbs after being freed, their movements were still stiff and awkward from prolonged confinement. It would take time to readjust.
The four opened the door, stepped out of Room 1001, and closed it behind them. The sound triggered the voice-activated lights in the 10th-floor hallway, instantly illuminating the previously dark corridor.
They walked toward the elevator, which was still parked on the 10th floor.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
It seemed no one had used it since Mike arrived. Understandable, given the late hour.
Mike pressed the button to summon the elevator down.
Behind him, the three chatted about their plans—first, a thorough shower, making sure to scrub every inch clean, especially… certain areas.
Just as they were fantasizing about their post-escape routines, the elevator doors slid open with a soft chime, its interior lights spilling into the hallway.
But Mike didn’t step inside.
Puzzled, the three stopped talking and craned their necks to see why.
What they saw would haunt them forever.
No wonder Mike hadn’t moved.
Because standing inside the elevator was someone they recognized—someone they both feared and despised.
Su Mi.
She was alone in the elevator.
Against four of them, even without Mike’s help, the three could have easily overpowered her.
But the way Su Mi was dressed tonight was unlike anything they had seen before.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Chainsaw Murderer, Joint Hunt
chapters.content:
Usually, Su Mi dressed flamboyantly.
Her high heels clicked loudly with each step.
But today, Su Mi wore a pair of white sneakers. Besides that, she was dressed in tight black clothes that allowed for easy movement.
On her back was a quiver—something rarely seen in real life but often spotted in historical dramas.
The quiver was filled with many arrows fletched with feathers, clearly visible.
Naturally, having a quiver meant she needed a weapon to shoot those arrows.
Indeed, Su Mi tightly gripped a white crossbow with both hands.
An arrow tipped with a sharp head was loaded and ready to fire on the crossbow.
“Ugh, you foreigners are really annoying!”
At this moment, Su Mi frowned deeply, clearly displeased. “Not only did you install a camera on the tenth floor, but I never expected you to have raised these three dogs to save me!”“Uh...”
Mike recognized the woman in front of him—the same Su Mi who had imprisoned the three people in Room 1001 that afternoon.
He was honestly quite shocked to see her here, but after hearing her words, he was utterly stunned.
So all along, the hidden pinhole cameras he installed had been monitored by Su Mi?
“So that means you knew everything about my operation on the tenth floor tonight at midnight?”
Su Mi nodded.
“More or less. I also installed pinhole cameras on the tenth floor.”
“I originally planned to just watch when I was bored, but I discovered you sneaking around installing stuff.”
“So normally, I go to bed around 10 p.m. to get my beauty sleep, but because of you, I didn’t sleep. I planned to stay up until midnight no matter what you were doing. But unexpectedly, my luck was great—I just happened to run into you on the tenth floor.”
Mike twitched his mouth.
Suddenly, he felt like sometimes his instincts weren’t so accurate. This time, he had been completely duped...
What he didn’t know was that the pinhole camera system Su Mi installed on the tenth floor was all high-tech.
Whenever someone went up to the tenth floor, the phone automatically received an alert.
So even if Su Mi went to bed at 10 p.m., when Mike arrived at midnight, they would still meet Su Mi in the elevator.
There was no way around it.
Unless Su Mi saw them and didn’t want to bother, but that was clearly impossible.
“To be honest, I’m too bored staying in this apartment, so the little puppies I raised are absolutely not allowed to be stolen.”
“Also, didn’t I tell you three little dogs that if you misbehave, you’d be sold to the dog meat factory?”
“Looks like the three of you are all planning a day trip to the dog meat factory!”
No sooner said than done.
In a flash, Su Mi raised the crossbow and fired an arrow.
Mike shouted hurriedly, “Duck down!”
At that instant, all four people dropped down simultaneously—that was some good luck.
Su Mi had aimed this arrow directly at their heads, so after they ducked, the arrow shot straight into the white wall behind them, deeply embedding itself.
Seeing this, Mike prepared to pounce on Su Mi inside the elevator.
Usually, this kind of crossbow could only load one arrow at a time.
To fire another shot, the archer needed to take an arrow from the quiver on the back.
So this was the best time to subdue Su Mi.
But Mike was unlucky. This was not the usual case.
After Su Mi fired the first arrow, the crossbow automatically loaded another arrow from beneath into the firing slot.
It was a repeater crossbow with a magazine.
If Mike tried to rush Su Mi now, she could shoot him in the chest immediately. He would surely die.
“Run first! Head to 404! Or just get out of the apartment and call the police! I’ll hold her off!”
In this critical moment, Mike threw the 404 keys from his pocket directly to Xiao Q, telling them to run first while he stayed behind.
“Thanks!”
Although Xiao Q was a little stunned to hear this, the three didn’t hesitate or argue about who should leave first like some soap opera drama.
They immediately sprinted crazily toward the stairway going down.
They quickly put more distance between themselves and the two people behind.
Xiao Q and the others ran straight to the fifth-floor stairwell.
Seeing no one chasing after them, they stopped to catch their breath, bending over to rest.
Their physical condition was very poor.
Although Su Mi provided dog food and water during their imprisonment, it was just enough to prevent starvation.
Plus, being tied up with chains for so long meant their bodies hadn’t moved properly.
So after suddenly engaging in such intense activity upon regaining freedom, the three were physically overwhelmed.
“That woman Su Mi really has a screw loose! If she ever falls into my hands, I’ll make her regret it!”
At once, Xiao Peng cursed while panting.
Then he turned to Xiao Q and asked, “Are we going back to 404 later or leaving the apartment directly?”
Before Xiao Q could answer, the three suddenly heard a familiar buzzing sound.
Not the buzzing of bees, but a strong, fast humming.
All three knew the sound very well.
“It’s a chainsaw!”
All three shouted simultaneously, their faces filled with terror.Thɪs updatᴇd by N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Then they looked toward the source of the chainsaw noise.
They were at this stairwell, and the sound came from the opposite stairwell. The chainsaw’s buzzing triggered all the voice-activated lights in the fifth-floor corridor to turn on.
With the lights on, they saw their old friend—the chainsaw murderer.
The chainsaw murderer was probably a thrifty person.
His clothes seemed unchanged.
Still wearing butcher-style attire, with an ugly mask covering his face.
The large, sharp chainsaw in his hand looked like the scythe of death.
“Holy crap! Joint hunt!”
At this moment, the Ultimate Rich Kid, watching the live stream, excitedly pounded the table and typed on the keyboard in real life.
Besides the thrill of seeing this scene, it was because he was also a player of Identity V...
He never imagined the joint hunt seen in the game would appear in real life.
It was a huge shock for him!
Of course, he wasn’t the only one. Others staying up late to watch the stream, like the Domineering Female CEO and her group, were also stunned.
They never expected the chainsaw murderer to show up here, ready to go on a killing spree!
More importantly, it was the first time the Domineering Female CEO and others saw two psychopaths cooperating to hunt the lab rats inside the apartment!!!
Because in previous rounds, these psycho criminals always killed separately!
There was no way they would cooperate!
So everyone in the chat room went wild.
The chat messages flooded nonstop.
Everyone said staying up late tonight was totally worth it!
Those who missed the live stream and waited to watch the replay were at a huge loss!!!
Back in reality,
they saw the chainsaw murderer they encountered long ago that night once again.
Xiao Q screamed in terror, quacking like a duck, “Run! Run! Hurry, run!!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 133: A Matter of Extreme Urgency
chapters.content:
The three of them rushed down the stairs together without hesitation.
They didn’t dare go upstairs since Su Mi was still up there.
They reached the fourth floor.
Xiao Peng immediately wanted to run down to the third floor.
Xiao Q grabbed him and said, “Everyone, come with me to 404!”
Xiao Peng was confused, “Why? Shouldn’t we just run straight out of the apartment?”
Xiao Q spoke urgently:
“If we were healthy and hadn’t been locked up for so long, running straight down and out of the apartment wouldn’t be a problem! But with our current bodies, going down from the tenth floor to the fifth floor is already exhausting. Do you really think if we rush blindly outside now, that chainsaw murderer could not catch up to us?!”
Xiao Peng said, “But going to 404 isn’t a solution either!”
Xiao Q sighed helplessly, “It’s the only option we have!”The three of them didn’t continue down the stairs but instead headed to 404, the wedding room of Shen Xing and Zhou Wu.
Using the key Mike had given them, they opened the door and immediately slipped inside, shutting and locking the door behind them.
At the same time, Xiao Q said, “Quick, push everything in the room that can block the door!”
Because it was a wedding room, Shen Xing had decorated it beautifully. Even Mike, the man who had moved in, was careful not to disturb the original setup when he saw it.
If it had been the old Mike, he probably wouldn’t have cared, but now, seeing the wedding room reminded him painfully of when he and his girlfriend were about to get married.
Now that Xiao Q and the others had arrived, the wedding room instantly turned into a mess.
All sorts of things, tables, and chairs were pushed inside against the door, blocking it completely.
They sealed the door airtight from the inside, locking it down tight.
But even so, Xiao Q knew it wouldn’t hold.
After all, he and Xiao Peng’s friends had once been chased by that young white man wielding a chainsaw all the way to Jiang Ran’s home.
That was a firsthand experience.
So hiding inside 404 wasn’t really safe;
it could only buy them some time!
“By the way, Xiao Q, Mike told us to call the police. Let’s call now!”
Xiao Peng dragged a nightstand from the bedroom and pushed it to the door, panting heavily.
Ke Bei, who hadn’t said much, anxiously grinned, “Xiao Peng! How are we supposed to call the police?! Do you have a phone?! Or can your brain transmit radio signals?!”
Xiao Peng suddenly realized, “Damn! I forgot! Su Mi took our phones away long ago!”
Ke Bei added, “Even if we call the police, how do you know if the people who come are the real police or impostors?”
If they’re real, maybe we can be saved;
if fake, we’re dead meat.
Xiao Peng was desperate, especially since he could hear the chainsaw buzzing louder and louder outside the door.
“What do we do? Just wait here to die?!”
Xiao Q went over to the balcony, stuck his head out the window to observe, then turned back, gritting his teeth:
“It’s a gamble! We’re on the fourth floor, not too high. We’ll escape through the window!”
Xiao Peng quickly shook his head, “What are you thinking, Xiao Q? Even if it’s just the fourth floor, one wrong move and you’ll either die or be crippled!”
At that moment, Ke Bei rushed out of the bedroom holding a bedsheet.
“Use this to make a rope and climb down!”
“There are more in the bedroom cabinets. Look for anything else that can be tied together into a rope! The more, the better!”
The three had run from the fifth floor, chased by the chainsaw murderer, all the way to 404. Then they barricaded the door so tightly nothing could get through.
They hadn’t stopped once, gasping heavily for air, exhausted, their entire bodies aching and weak.
Now they were relying solely on their survival instincts and adrenaline triggered by the fear of death.
They worked quickly.
Soon, they had made a long cloth rope out of bedsheets and blankets.
Of course, tying the knots and making the rope was done by Ke Bei, who had experience.
The other two had never done it, and under such pressure, there was no telling if their efforts would hold;
even if it looked fine, it might break immediately when used.
They tied one end of the cloth rope to a fixed point inside the living room.
Then they stretched it all the way to the balcony and dropped it out the window.
The rope’s end just touched the ground.
“There’s too little material, and time is tight. This rope probably can’t support all three at once. Only one person can go down at a time. So, who goes first?”Follow current novels on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Ke Bei asked while reinforcing the fixed point.
Who went first had its pros and cons.
Pros: The first to go down could reach the ground first, run, and escape danger sooner.
Cons: The first person also tested the rope’s strength. If it wasn’t strong enough, they’d fall and become a test subject.
Buzz buzz buzz!
At that moment, chainsaw sounds came from outside.
The chainsaw was already sawing the door, leaving no time for further thought.
“I’ll go first!”
Xiao Peng shouted and charged ahead.
He stepped onto a chair on the balcony, half his body already outside the window.
When he looked down from outside the window, even though he didn’t have a fear of heights, he almost developed one on the spot.
It was so high—he never realized the fourth floor was this high before…
A wave of fear swept through Xiao Peng’s heart.
Even without being weak from captivity, going down four floors relying only on a cloth rope was a huge challenge for him, especially without any safety measures.
“Hurry up! It’s almost too late! If you don’t go, I will!”
Xiao Q kept watching the door;
it was being broken down more and more. It wouldn’t hold much longer!
“Ahhhh! I’m going all out!”
Xiao Peng made up his mind. Staying here meant certain death—brutally killed by the chainsaw!
Going down might not kill him.
So with more than half his body out the window, he fully committed.
Grasping the windowsill, he gradually shifted his hands and body weight onto the cloth rope.
In his mind, he recalled videos he had seen of paratroopers sliding down ropes or firefighters descending high-rise zip lines.
He tried to imitate their movements, but his body wasn’t skilled enough.
He could only cling tightly with both hands and feet, slowly sliding down.
When Xiao Peng had slid halfway down, about the second floor,
Ke Bei anxiously stared at the door and said, “We don’t have time. We can’t wait for Xiao Peng to reach the ground before the second person goes. You have to go down now!”
“Xiao Q, you go first!”
Xiao Q shook his head, “No, you go first. I’ll go last!”
Ke Bei was momentarily stunned.
Then he said, “Alright.”

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Escape to Freedom
chapters.content:
The chainsaw wielded by the chainsaw murderer was one of the larger types, boasting devastating destructive power.
The security door had already been mangled and torn apart by his chainsaw beyond recognition.
Inside the security door were all sorts of furniture piled up by Xiao Q and the others, but honestly, for a strong and sturdy person, it wouldn’t take much effort to move them aside without even needing a chainsaw—he might have been able to get through just by brute force.
Let alone having a chainsaw.
Seeing the chainsaw murderer starting to destroy the furniture inside the door, Xiao Q knew he had to get down quickly;
if he didn’t run, he would surely die here.
But when he looked out the window, Xiao Peng was still on the first floor, and Ke Bei was somewhere between the third and fourth floors.
He wasn’t sure if the cloth rope could withstand the weight of three people.
Not caring much, Xiao Q climbed out the window, preparing to slowly slide down the cloth rope.
When he reached the spot where Ke Bei had just been, he suddenly heard the chainsaw’s sound coming from above. He looked up.
At the balcony window on the fourth floor, the chainsaw murderer’s face appeared, wearing an ugly mask, with two jet-black eyes rolling towards them.Xiao Q was terrified beyond belief but then saw the chainsaw murderer suddenly pull his head back inside.
It was unclear what his next move would be.
“Is he going to come down the cloth rope like us? Or is he rushing to the first floor to intercept us?”
Xiao Q guessed.
The chainsaw murderer did not choose to come down the rope but instead rushed down to the first floor to block them.
Before running downstairs, he used the chainsaw to cut the cloth rope connecting to the living room of apartment 404.
Because of that cut, the three unlucky people hanging on the rope were doomed.
Of course, the unluckiest one was Xiao Peng.
With the rope’s anchor point gone, Xiao Peng was the first to fall to the ground. Fortunately, he fell from the height of the first floor, so the fall wasn’t too severe.
But why say he was the unluckiest?
Because there were still two people above him.
As Xiao Peng hit the ground and was complaining about the pain in his arms and legs, a dark shadow fell from the sky—it was Ke Bei, who landed hard on top of him.
Ke Bei weighed around 140 to 150 pounds, and the impact made Xiao Peng feel like his body had been severely crushed.
Above Ke Bei was Xiao Q, who also fell, and he fell from a height just above the third floor.
That fall landed right on top of Ke Bei.
Ke Bei immediately felt completely wrecked.
Xiao Peng, who was under Ke Bei, felt it even more.
The pain Xiao Peng suffered was countless times worse than Ke Bei’s.
He was the meat cushion for both of them.
Because Xiao Peng was this meat cushion, although Ke Bei and Xiao Q fell from relatively high floors and were certainly injured somewhere, their injuries were not as severe.
On the other hand, when the two got off Xiao Peng’s body, he spat out a mouthful of fresh red blood onto the cement ground on his left.
One mouthful was not enough, and he spat out another.
Xiao Q was so scared he immediately shouted, “Xiao Peng, are you okay?! Don’t die on me, we’re taking you to the hospital right now!!!!”
Because the chainsaw murderer was still chasing them, Xiao Q and Ke Bei hurriedly helped the blood-spitting, crushed Xiao Peng up.
The three unfortunate brothers ran toward the apartment’s main entrance.
At this moment, the security guard booth was brightly lit.
Security guard Xiao Xing was bored, working the night shift alone.
Tonight, he was the only security guard on duty;
the others were all resting.
Just as he was boredly scrolling through an e-book of Smile at Everything on his phone, he suddenly heard noise outside.
He stepped out of the booth and saw three limp, desperate figures staggering toward him under the streetlights near the apartment building.
When they got closer, Xiao Xing saw clearly the three figures and was shocked by their tattered clothing.
“When did three beggars sneak into the apartment?”
While he was thinking this, a pungent stench hit him, almost making him vomit.
“Sure enough, beggars, they smell so bad.”
Xiao Xing pinched his nose and hurried back into the security booth, shutting the doors and windows to feel better.
Next, Xiao Xing saw the three people arrive at the security booth’s main gate.
They didn’t go through the door but instead ducked under the car barrier arm blocking vehicles and fled the apartment in a pitiful state.
After the three escaped the apartment, the chainsaw murderer who had just left the building stared at their retreating backs before turning and heading back inside.
On the tenth floor, where they had expected an earth-shaking battle to happen, it was surprisingly quiet.
After Xiao Q and the others left the tenth floor, Su Mi, holding a crossbow, stepped out of the elevator and kept aiming at Mike but hesitated to pull the trigger.
The two sides remained locked in this stalemate.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Mike didn’t dare to act recklessly.
As for why Mike sacrificed himself to let the three escape first?
Sorry, he wasn’t that noble, and he definitely wouldn’t sacrifice himself for people he just met today.
He did it purely because leaving those three here would only slow him down.
He was confident he could survive alone under Su Mi and her crossbow.
Also, there was another reason for letting those three run first.
Su Mi’s target was them.
Seeing the three run away, she would definitely want to chase after them.
Therefore, Mike hoped to get rid of her as quickly as possible.
The more impatient you are, the more likely you are to make mistakes, and the greater the chance for Mike to counterattack.
That was Mike’s plan.
But to his surprise, Su Mi seemed to have no intention of quickly chasing after the three she had imprisoned.
Instead, she just wasted time here with him.
Mike didn’t know how much time had passed.
Suddenly, Su Mi put down her crossbow, stopped aiming at him, and smiled at him.
“Don’t be nervous, I don’t keep foreign dogs, so you’re safe.”
“Also, don’t let my dogs loose again, or next time, I won’t let you off so easily.”
After saying that, Su Mi retreated to the elevator entrance, pressed the button with her hand behind her back, and the elevator doors opened. She shrank into the elevator.
Once inside, she pressed the button for the second floor, took out her phone, and saw a message someone sent her.
She opened the message and read the entire thing.
Su Mi’s charming face instantly darkened, her expression turning extremely sinister.
“Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, Ke Bei.
You three disobedient dogs, if I run into you again, I won’t send you to the dog meat factory—I’ll send you straight out of this world to dog hell.”
On their side, Xiao Q and the others had escaped the apartment safely.
Mike’s side did not erupt into the expected fight.
This whole situation made the live stream audience extremely uncomfortable.
The Ultimate Rich Kid even said: “Damn! What the hell is this? The beginning was so thrilling, but by the end, no one died, and Xiao Peng just got crushed and spat blood?! I’m half-naked and you show me this?!”
Middle-aged Uncle also said: “Deceiving middle-aged people’s emotions, although I quite like Xiao Q, I’d rather see him get killed by the chainsaw murderer—that’s exciting! The more you like someone, the more satisfying it is to see them get wrecked!”

chapters.content:
