"As long as it's a person, I've never been afraid."
Jiang Ran said coldly.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Brother and Younger Brother
chapters.content:
"Is that so? Then how about this?"
Just when the clown seemed to have exhausted all his tricks, he suddenly sprayed a massive amount of white paper fragments resembling snowflakes from his mouth toward Jiang Ran.
Just like he had done with Wang Tao, the purpose was to obstruct the opponent's vision for an easier attack.
If someone had been watching from a third-person perspective, or through Jiang Ran's or the clown's first-person view, they would have discovered.
These snowflake-like white paper fragments were truly dense and numerous, even more exaggerated than a heavy snowfall of goose feathers.
It was completely impossible to see what was happening ahead.
It was at this moment that the clown kicked toward the front, aiming at Jiang Ran's remembered position.
This kick landed squarely on Jiang Ran's chest.
He was certain he had hit.
The clown was overjoyed, but the next second, when he retracted his leg, he discovered that his clamped right hand was still firmly restrained.As the large white paper fragments all fell to the ground.
He discovered that Jiang Ran still stood expressionless in his original position, not fallen to the ground like Wang Tao had been, and was still approaching him step by step.
Immediately, Jiang Ran punched him in the face.
With this punch.
The clown was knocked to the ground.
Lying on the ground, he let out a painful groan.
At the same time, he could no longer hold back and spat out a mouthful of blood from his mouth.
Even more terrifying was that this mouthful of blood contained several white teeth.
This showed just how powerful and heavy this punch was.
"Completely, no match at all!"
Looking at the blood he had spat on the ground, especially those several teeth, the clown opened his mouth wide and let out a miserable laugh.
Looking down at the clown on the ground, Jiang Ran said coldly: "You brought all of this upon yourself."
Yes, it was all the clown's own doing.
If the clown had truly followed the rules of the gamble-with-your-life game he had set up.
Winner lives, loser dies.
Draw means both live.
Although both had cheated, neither side had concrete evidence.
Therefore, it could completely be considered a draw.
This way, the clown could have let the main personality Jiang Ran leave, safe and sound.
But this clown refused, bringing about his own demise, sending away the kind main personality and welcoming the cold, combat-capable alternate personality.
"Brought it upon myself?! Perhaps!"
"After being hit by your punch, I actually remembered an old story from long ago."
Continuously wiping the bloodstains from his mouth with his right hand, the clown slowly stood up and began to recount:
"That fortune teller I found back then, besides telling my fortune and saying I had bad luck, also said that in my 35th year, I would face a blood calamity, and told me to be careful."
"I'm exactly 35 this year, and who would have thought, I actually encountered this blood calamity!"
The clown laughed wildly.
He laughed and asked: "Jiang Ran, speaking of which, I really can't defeat you, how do you plan to deal with me? Kill me directly?"
"If you're going to kill me, use my power drill!"
The clown noticed at this moment that Jiang Ran was strangely inactive, just standing in place.
He sneered mockingly: "Could it be, Jiang Ran, that you've never killed anyone before?"
It was at this moment that he turned and ran toward the bedroom, in the blink of an eye diving into the bedroom and slamming the door shut with a click, locking it from inside.
Jiang Ran still stood in place without moving.
Yes, his body didn't move, but that didn't mean his face didn't move.
At this moment, his facial expression kept shifting between coldness and cuteness.
Cute: "Brother, brother, let me out, I want to come out and play! I want to play with that clown!!!"
Cold: "No, he's hiding in the bedroom now, wait until I break open the bedroom door."
Cute: "No no no! I want to come out now! I'll handle it myself!!! Brother if you keep this up, I'll ignore you!!!"
After saying this, the coldness completely disappeared from Jiang Ran's face, replaced by a childlike cute expression.
Besides maintaining an adorable, smiling face.
Currently, he was also happily bouncing around, dancing with joy.
Little fists waving.
If someone had been there, they would have thought adult Jiang Ran had now become a little child.
"La la la la"
"La la la la"
"Drop! Ah drop! Ah! Drop the handkerchief!"
"Gently drop it behind the little friend!"
Jiang Ran was now singing a recently very popular song, his voice an adult man's pretending to be a child's.
While singing, he searched everywhere in the clown's home, rummaging through boxes and cabinets.
Unclear what he was looking for.
Meanwhile, inside the bedroom.
The clown used several bottles of mineral water from the bedroom to frantically rinse his mouth, and after the bloody taste was gone from his mouth.
His eyes gradually sharpened, and the corners of his mouth curled up into a trace of a big smile.
He found an extension cord, plugged it into the power drill, then began shaking his head wildly:
"Come on! Come on!"
"Let's see if I'll die here today?!"
"Will it be like that old fortune teller said, that a person's life is predetermined from birth?!"
About ten minutes passed.
Jiang Ran began knocking on the bedroom door: "Open the door! Clown! I want to play games with you!!!"
His voice was still that fake child's voice.
The clown inside the bedroom remained unmoved.
Clearly not planning to open the door;
it seemed he intended to wait until Jiang Ran broke down the door, then use the power drill for a final life-or-death struggle.
Outside the door, Jiang Ran, seeing that the clown inside wasn't opening the door, continued knocking for a while with his milky, childlike voice.
Still not opening, which made Jiang Ran somewhat angry. He pouted and said: "Not cute at all!"
Turning to look behind him, Jiang Ran picked up a red fire axe from the floor. This fire axe was what he had found earlier while rummaging through boxes.
Holding the fire axe, Jiang Ran aimed at the upper part of the bedroom door.
Suddenly swung the axe.
This axe swing startled the clown inside the bedroom.
Until now, the clown hadn't noticed one thing.
The previous revolver roulette game—that wasn't really a gamble-with-your-life game.
From the moment he and Jiang Ran met, the real gamble-with-your-life game had actually begun.
Either he kills Jiang Ran, or Jiang Ran kills him.
This was the true gamble-with-your-life game.
Similarly, it was the same with the clown and those like Wang Tao who had died tragically at his hands before.
The paper box drawing game with Wang Tao was just one part of the gamble-with-your-life game.
Not the gamble-with-your-life game itself.
Only the paper box drawing was what the clown considered the gamble-with-your-life game.
But in this true gamble-with-your-life game with Jiang Ran.
Originally, he was the advantaged party, the predator.
Now it had become Jiang Ran as the advantaged party, Jiang Ran as the predator.
Cheng Yaojin's three axe swings conquered the world, and Jiang Ran was similar.
After three chops at the upper part of the bedroom door, he had cut out a large opening.
The clown now sat on the bedroom bed, holding the power drill.
Sweat continuously covered his palms, making the power drill handle sticky.
He breathed lightly, staring intently at the large opening Jiang Ran had chopped out.
Then, suddenly, an eye appeared outside that large opening.
That eye was using the large opening to look inside the room.
The eye kept rolling around left and right.
Seemingly having found its target, the eye fixed in its socket.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"Hehehe, cute little clown, found you!"
This milky, childlike yet horrifying voice came from outside the door.
Immediately after, the clown saw that in the large opening, the eye was gone, replaced by a black, hole-like thing!
"Is that?! A gun barrel?! My revolver?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Identity Reversal—Who's the Lab Rat Now?
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran pressed the revolver's muzzle against the large opening, aiming at the clown sitting on the bed.
He pulled the trigger directly.
Bang!
Loud.
The moment the gunshot rang out, the clown rolled to the side.
He was lucky, dodging this shot.
Of course, since this was just a blank round and not fired close to the temple, even if it had hit his body from this distance, it wouldn't have caused much damage.
But even so, nobody wants to be shot.
"Missed, how boring."
Through that large opening, Jiang Ran's eyeballs disappeared again, unclear what kind of trouble would emerge next time he appeared."Fortunately, I used my privilege back then to only exchange for one revolver and three blank rounds."
Both the revolver and three blank rounds were what he exchanged from the apartment organizers using his special privilege.
Of the three rounds, two had been used long ago, and this was the last one, now also used up.
Thankfully back then, he didn't exchange for large quantities of live ammunition, otherwise today's victim would be himself.
However, he still worried about what this Jiang Ran might come up with next!
After all, he had quite a few things in his house!
"And this Jiang Ran, why do I feel like he's some kind of sadist? How can he keep changing like this?!"
The clown currently hugged his own head.
Recalling the initial Jiang Ran.
Just an ordinary person.
But after being electrocuted by him and still managing to wake up.
He actually felt then that this Jiang Ran differed greatly from the previous Jiang Ran in temperament, speech, and behavior—like they weren't the same person.
Now, he had changed again.
Like he'd become a little child.
An adult Jiang Ran on the outside, but a child inside, a demon child.
Just as the clown thought this, he heard some movement outside the door—the bedroom door kept rattling.
He gripped the power drill tightly, unsure what Jiang Ran was doing outside.
But soon, he discovered that a rubber hose was being inserted through the large opening in the upper part of the bedroom door.
Just as he wondered what was happening, large amounts of water suddenly gushed from the rubber hose.
Continuously gushing, gurgling and spluttering, pouring water into the room.
While water poured in, this voice came from outside the door:
"Clown, let's go swimming?!"
"Swimming is so much fun!"
Then singing followed:
"They throw poop at me, I make egg tarts with the poop!"
"They throw eggs at me! I make fried rice with the eggs!"
The clown listened to the song, watching the scene before him, his eyelids twitching violently.
He thought the Jiang Ran outside wanted to drown him with water?
What kind of joke was this?
First, the bedroom door wasn't sealed!
Eh, wait!
The clown stared intently at the door area, seeing water flow over only to be blocked by something, remaining trapped inside the room.
He suddenly understood what Jiang Ran had been doing earlier with all that door rattling outside.
Unclear what he used, but he had sealed the door gaps.
But this still couldn't drown him—he had a window in his room.
So, he couldn't figure out what Jiang Ran wanted to achieve!
Therefore, he remained still, only moving his power drill and extension cord from the lower wall socket to one closer to the ceiling, then sat on his bed waiting for the water to rise.
Soon, the water reached about a dozen centimeters below the window.
The clown had already moved a chair onto his bed, with water now covering his bed.
At this point, the clown also noticed the rubber hose at the large opening had been removed.
Even now, the clown still couldn't understand Jiang Ran's actions.
But later, when he saw that large opening—another clearly cut thick electrical wire being inserted through it, that wire directly plugging into the bedroom's water pool—
The clown instantly understood this guy's purpose behind all this, quickly pulling his feet out of the water and sitting cross-legged on the chair.
Water conducts electricity.
Though uncertain about that wire's voltage.
The clown didn't dare test it.
Might try and die.
Only now did he understand how malicious the Jiang Ran outside was.
More malicious than himself.
When he killed people, he directly drilled their hearts with the power drill, giving them a quick end.
But this Jiang Ran opposite him used soft knives like this, torturing people slice by slice.
He was now trapped in this bedroom.
Couldn't get out anywhere!
Outside the bedroom, after completing all this, Jiang Ran found a lock in the clown's house and locked the bedroom door.
Then, carrying the red fire axe, he came to the gambling table and sat down obediently.
Of course, after sitting down, he took out his phone.
The main personality Jiang Ran's phone didn't have any games.
The current Jiang Ran, after discovering no games on the phone, downloaded a 4398 game box to find and download games.
While waiting for downloads, he also found a charger in the clown's house.
At the same time, he occasionally observed the situation in the bedroom direction.
Looked like he was preparing for a prolonged battle.
Currently, in the live stream room.
Since Jiang Ran and the clown finally encountered each other, the number of viewers had been growing like crazy, viral growth.
The kind that simply wouldn't stop.
Especially now, with the clown and Jiang Ran's roles seemingly reversed.
Viewer count had reached 390,000.
The Ultimate Rich Kid said: 【Are there any psychiatry professionals or hospital owners in the live stream? I know Jiang Ran has dissociative identity disorder with many alternate personalities. But what's happening now? Do alternate personalities also have sibling relationships? Shouldn't each personality be an independent individual?】
The Ultimate Rich Kid was referring to the previously body-controlling, seemingly very cold Jiang Ran versus the current child-like Jiang Ran.
These two Jiang Rans' rapid face-changing and their words had been clearly transmitted to every live stream viewer's eyes and ears.
Middle-aged Uncle: 【I just asked my psychiatry friend, a mental hospital director about my age, and briefly described Jiang Ran's recent situation to him.】
【He answered that yes, there indeed exist personalities with such familial relationships, though this type is relatively rare, extremely uncommon.】
The Ultimate Rich Kid: 【Learned something new.】
The Domineering Female CEO also jumped in: 【I also asked a good sister working in the hospital psychiatry department, and her answer completely differs from yours, Middle-aged Uncle!】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【Different? How different? What did your good sister say?】
The Domineering Female CEO: 【She said this is typical secondary personality dissociation, where this secondary personality has developed psychotic confusion. I just asked her if there are examples of familial relationships where they can switch bodies face-to-face and communicate with each other? She said this simply doesn't exist—in all her years of practice, she's never seen it. Not just seen, never even heard of it.】
After listening, Middle-aged Uncle said speechlessly: 【Is it possible that your friend's professional level simply isn't very good? That's why she hasn't seen or heard of it?】

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Jiang Ran vs. the Joker — A Head-On Showdown
chapters.content:
Domineering Female CEO: [Heh, she's actually a nationally renowned psychological doctor, and you're saying she's not skilled enough?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Being nationally renowned doesn't necessarily mean truly capable, and even if she is capable, that's just at the national level.]
[The friend I asked has a son - his son became a psychiatry doctorate at a young age, plus he studied and worked abroad in America before returning! His son is actually a world-class authority in psychiatry! He only replied to me after consulting his son!!!]
The two of them proceeded to argue intensely.
Neither believed the other.
Fairy Sister: [Alright you two, stop arguing! There's no need to fight! Let's just assume these two personalities have a familial relationship, it's no big deal. Don't let this affect watching the live stream!]
...
Time passed quickly.
Before they knew it, evening had arrived at 5 o'clock.
The sky was gradually darkening.Jiang Ran, sitting at the gambling table in the living room of Room 203, put down his phone. At this moment, his face was filled with furious rage.
"Stupid teammates! They totally screwed me over! If you were here beside me, I'd chop all your heads off and use them as soccer balls! Making me lose like that!"
After cursing for a while, he seemed to have vented his anger.
Jiang Ran returned to his previous childlike innocent smile, gripped the red fire axe, and walked to the bedroom door.
First, he pulled out the electrical wire he had run into the room.
Then he peered through the large hole chopped out by the fire axe and saw the clown inside the bedroom.
The clown remained in his previous posture, sitting cross-legged on the chair placed on the bed. It was evident he had been constantly adjusting his position.
He was almost unable to sit still any longer.
At this moment, Jiang Ran shouted loudly through the door:
"Clown, are you still not ready to come out and play with me?"
Inside the bedroom, when the electrical wire was submerged in water, the clown had actually extended one toe to test it.
The result was that as soon as it went in, an electric current surged up through his toe. Instantly, he felt his entire foot go numb.
Therefore, he knew that if Jiang Ran outside didn't remove the wire, he would eventually be unable to hold on, fall into the water, and either be electrocuted to death or shocked into idiocy.
Thus, during the several hours Jiang Ran spent gaming outside, he had considered two options.
First, since he lived on the second floor, he could simply use the chair to slowly move to the window and exit through the second-floor window.
With his physical skills, even if he accidentally slipped, the fall wouldn't kill him.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Second, he could find a way to cross the water and exit through the bedroom door, but this would inevitably lead to encountering Jiang Ran.
When that meeting occurred, it would be a case of when two meet in narrow path, the courageous one wins.
He couldn't decide between these two options.
Therefore, he had originally planned that if he was still trapped by 6 o'clock, he would escape through the second-floor bedroom window and make further plans later.
But now, an opportunity had suddenly arrived.
The clown made his decision.
The clown said: "I'm willing to come out and play with you! But you need to drain all the water first!"
Jiang Ran outside excitedly shouted: "Okay, okay, okay! Just wait!"
Although the clown couldn't see outside the door, he could hear the noises - Jiang Ran was apparently removing the materials sealing the bedroom door gap.
"Jiang Ran, today it's either you die or I perish."
At this moment, the clown had realized.
His life-or-death gamble with Jiang Ran.
Even if he descended from the second floor, only one of them could survive afterward.
The only difference from exiting through the bedroom door now would be that the timing of their life-and-death struggle would be delayed.
Therefore, he thought it better to settle things right now.
After the bedroom door's seal was removed, quickly, all the water in the bedroom drained out through the door gap.
When it had mostly drained away, the clown gripped the power drill and jumped down from the bed.
After taking a few steps, he unlocked the bedroom door's deadbolt and pulled it open directly.
As the bedroom door opened, Jiang Ran stood revealed outside, holding the fire axe.
Jiang Ran stared happily at the clown before him.
He revealed a child's innocent smile:
"Clown, let's play a game together!"
"Let's play that gamble-with-your-life game you played with the main personality before!"
"But"
Jiang Ran's expression suddenly changed, the innocent child's smile transforming into
an extremely evil, sinister grin.
"Our gamble-with-your-life game won't be Russian roulette with a revolver, but real hand-to-hand combat. Whoever loses will have their head smashed open."
After speaking,
without even asking if the clown agreed, Jiang Ran swung his axe directly at the clown.
If the clown had been holding a similar fire axe or chainsaw, they might have been able to fight, but he only held a power drill.
Facing the wide, sweeping swings of the fire axe, he was completely powerless to defend.
He could only retreat backward.
As he retreated, the fire axe smashed hard into the tile floor where he had just been standing.
Instantly, that tile shattered into fragments.
After all, the clown was the clown - a deranged serial killer.
Experienced, he took advantage of this moment to thrust the power drill forward.
Without the slightest hesitation.
Jiang Ran now faced a situation where he could only retreat or dodge left or right to avoid the drill.
But he didn't. He stood right where he was, allowing the drill to bore directly into the upper part of his left arm.
Instantly, blood sprayed from the drilled area.
A sizzling, grinding sound of metal against bone emerged, "like heavenly music."
Seeing this, even the clown was stunned.
Although his movement had been quick, he hadn't actually expected his drill to hit Jiang Ran, because compared to a chainsaw or fire axe, the power drill was too short and small - it required close proximity. Hard to hit a moving target.
Therefore, when it suddenly connected, he didn't know whether to feel happy or worried.
Probably happy?
He thought to himself that he had at least gained the initiative.
He had injured Jiang Ran first.
But immediately, he changed his opinion.
He saw that Jiang Ran opposite him, after being drilled in the left upper arm,
not only showed no expression of pain or suffering, but instead burst into loud laughter.
Both his hands tightly gripped the wooden handle of the fire axe.
Because he had previously swung at the clown, the axe blade now on the floor was facing toward himself.
The back of the axehead, which resembled a hammer, was aimed toward the clown.
In this position, at very close range between the two,
Jiang Ran suddenly exerted strength with both hands, completely ignoring the drill still boring into his left arm, and violently swung the fire axe upward.
The back of the axehead struck hard right between the clown's legs.
Male comrades should deeply understand this.
That area, when flicked hard with a finger, creates an indescribable sensation.
But what the clown experienced now was being struck by the metal back of a fire axe, and struck with great force at that.
This was no longer just a sensation or pain that could be described.
The clown's current suffering could be summarized in four words: beyond description.
If we had to use one more sentence to describe it:
It made this deranged serial killer clown instantly lose all combat capability.
The pain was like the creation of heaven and earth.
This shows the power of that single strike - equivalent to an instant knockout.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Who’s Really the Lab Rat? Who’s the Deranged Criminal?
chapters.content:
The clown's thing was probably ruined.
It was directly smashed to pieces by the external force of an axe handle.
Right now he was on the ground, both hands clutching his crotch, rolling left and right while screaming "ah ah ah" incessantly.
His whole body was convulsing, his face twisted to the extreme. It was as if countless earthworms were madly squirming beneath his skin.
Especially the speed and amount of sweat pouring from his face—it was faster and more copious than what you'd see from running a marathon.
"Ah ha ha ha ha"
Human happiness is always built upon the pain of others.
While the clown was now experiencing ultimate agony, Jiang Ran was experiencing ultimate ecstasy.
He directly yanked out the power drill that had penetrated his left upper arm, completely disregarding the excruciating pain from tearing out the drill bit tightly embedded in his flesh, muscle, and bone.
After pulling it out, the bloody hole in his left upper arm gushed fresh blood with a "puff puff" sound.Much of this blood splattered onto Jiang Ran's face, adding countless layers of dark humor to his laughing visage.
"Hahaha, so fun! So fun! This is absolutely hilarious!"
Jiang Ran continued laughing uproariously, especially since he was imitating the clown's belly-clutching laughter.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Apparently laughing himself to exhaustion.
Jiang Ran stopped his loud laughter and returned to an innocent childlike smile.
"Clown, let's end the game now!"
"Let me finish this directly!"
"Clown BOSS! Accept your death date!!!"
Jiang Ran now picked up the fire axe from the ground and stood beside the clown lying on the floor.
The clown, currently suffering from excruciating pain from his lower body, was still gritting his teeth, clutching his crotch with both hands, and rolling back and forth. Even though he could see Jiang Ran, this god of death, already standing beside him.
He wanted to get up and fight back, but the heart-rending, lung-tearing agony from below directly sapped his strength and destroyed his combat ability.
Thus he realized—this was his blood-light disaster, he was going to die in this blood-light disaster!
He was really going to die!
Going to leave this world!
"So unwilling! So truly unwilling!"
Facing death, the clown wasn't afraid of dying, just deeply unwilling.
Because he had ultimately mastered the death fates of others, yet still couldn't control his own destiny.
Suddenly, he remembered—what were those people he killed thinking in their final moments before he murdered them?!
The clown's gaze became vacant.
As Jiang Ran's fire axe came chopping toward his abdomen, what abruptly appeared in his mind was actually that female disciple he had married.
After all, to be honest, that female disciple he married could be considered his first love.
However deep his love was back then, that's how profound his hatred became later.
When the fire axe struck the clown's abdomen, the clown endured extreme agony and shouted his final words:
"It's all her fault! She ruined me! Made me become this monstrous version of myself! If she hadn't taken the money and run away back then! Abandoned me! How could I have become like this..."
"When choosing a wife, you must choose virtue!!!!!"
No one could have expected.
A proper, proper deranged serial killer—not even counting before he entered the apartment—
just after moving into the apartment, the number of lives taken by his hands reached over a dozen!
This kind of serial killer who would make people tremble with fear just hearing about him.
His final words actually turned out to be completely unlike what a serial killer should say: ["When choosing a wife, you must choose virtue"].
If not heard with one's own ears, who would believe it?!
Thump!
Thump!
Thump!
"Fighting BOSS!"
"Fighting BOSS!"
"Fighting BOSS!!!!"
Jiang Ran now also acted like a mad demon, vigorously hacking the fire axe into the clown beneath him.
Abdomen, thighs, calves, head.
Extremely fast, each strike sending up countless sprays of blood along with shattered flesh and white bone.
Again and again.
The clown's corpse had already become unbearable to look at, describable as a horrifying mess.
Almost turned into minced meat.
But Jiang Ran still didn't stop.
This scene was truly shocking to witness.
Apparently having chopped himself to exhaustion.
His face tilted toward the bedroom ceiling, the fire axe in his right hand clattered to the floor as it dropped from his grip.
Jiang Ran's head bent slightly upward as he continuously chuckled with a "he he he" sound.
Live stream room.
Complete dead silence.
To be honest.
Whether they were active commenters or lurkers in the live stream room.
Whether new or veteran live stream users.
They had seen these deranged criminals, these deranged serial killers in the apartment, brutally slaughter lab rats.
They had also seen some truly capable lab rats fight back and kill these deranged criminals, these deranged serial killers.
But they had never seen a lab rat brutally slaughter a deranged criminal, a deranged serial killer...
Yes, truly never seen it.
Extremely rare.
That time when Xiao Q's trio fought the Dog Man, although quite bloody, that was actually normal combat, and it was three against one.
Plus not as cruel as this time—last time the three stopped immediately after knowing the Dog Man was dead.
The Dog Man still had a complete corpse.
But this clown was completely chopped into minced meat...
The Middle-aged Uncle was so stunned by these scenes he froze for a long time before typing:
[I've seen several of Jiang Ran's alternate personalities now. The first was dealing with the Old Man in Room 301. I felt that personality was quite sinister, but it surprisingly called 120 for the old man afterward, making me think his nature isn't entirely evil.]
[The second, dealing with Wang Nuli the kite killer, was that self-proclaimed "concubine" imperial consort personality. Seemed decisive and ruthless, but ultimately made Wang Nuli commit suicide by forcing him to jump. Didn't personally take action either.]
[This third one... is purely a deranged freak just like the old residents in this apartment... So disgusting, the clown doesn't even look human anymore... Damn, if I didn't know better, I'd think the clown was the lab rat and Jiang Ran was the deranged criminal, the deranged serial killer!!]
Domineering Female CEO: [Aiya, who says otherwise?! I suspect when the organizers randomly did that lottery draw and brought in Jiang Ran, they never expected their casual action would bring in such a deranged monster...]
Fairy Sister: [Maybe Jiang Ran can break the highest record of three rounds...]
Little Dragon Girl: [Not just maybe, I feel he'll definitely break it. This guy is too invincible, especially since every alternate personality is formidable. Whenever the main personality gets in trouble, an alternate comes out...]
The entire live stream room was continuously discussing, completely shocked by Jiang Ran's current personality.
At this moment, the Ultimate Rich Kid jumped in: [Hey! Don't forget! Besides today, this round has two full days left! There's still Robert, who Diamond Bachelor used her privilege to transfer here! That's one of the world's top ten serial killers! Surviving this challenge would make him truly strong!]
Many people had a sudden realization—yes, they almost forgot about Robert...
That guy is world-class...
Next, these live stream viewers continued watching the broadcast.
They saw Jiang Ran leave Room 203 where the clown was.
Covered in bloodstains, his face showed a child's innocent smile.
Staggering all the way back to Room 304.
Just as he returned to 304, having just opened the door with only half his body inside, he suddenly collapsed unconscious.
Half his body outside the door, half inside.
...
Approximately half an hour after Jiang Ran left Room 203.
Over a dozen young and middle-aged men wearing green work uniforms arrived outside Alice Apartment in a large bus.
They all got off, and as they approached the apartment building, each carried tools and various materials in both hands, including bedroom doors among other things.
In short, everything looked like renovation supplies.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Jiang Ran’s Panic
chapters.content:
These dozen or so middle-aged men all wore cold expressions on their faces.
They directly entered the Alice Apartment building, took the elevator to Room 203, entered the clown's room, and began their cleanup work.
...
At 8 PM.
Qin Kelian happened to be returning home. Just as she inserted her key into the door lock, her nose detected a familiar smell of blood.
Turning her head to look, she noticed something strange outside Room 304 - why were there a pair of human legs visible outside the door?
So, driven by curiosity, she walked over.
She discovered a person covered in blood lying by the security door of Room 304.
Qin Kelian's cold gaze swept over this blood-soaked person. She took a few steps forward, shifted her angle, and was shocked to discover that this person was actually Jiang Ran!!!
"Hmm? Did he encounter hunting by other residents of the apartment?"Qin Kelian speculated silently, thinking that Jiang Ran, this lab rat, being covered in blood like this could only mean one possibility.
After all, the apartment was filled with a bunch of psychopaths.
Some of them even Qin Kelian didn't know or hadn't met.
Qin Kelian then stepped back and looked around the corridor.
She didn't see anyone else either!
"Could it be that Jiang Ran counter-killed his hunter and successfully escaped back?!"
Qin Kelian thought this must be the case, otherwise why wouldn't there be anyone else here?
"Hey, wait, could he be dead?"
She thought of another possibility and quickly crouched down to check his breathing. Finding that he was still alive, she immediately felt relieved.
"Not dead is good! Hahaha, not dead is good!"
Qin Kelian covered her mouth and laughed.
Who would have thought, who would have thought.
Her luck was so good today - she found Jiang Ran just lying there for the taking.
"Aiya, I'll just drag him back directly to make canned meat and meat sauce. When sister comes back, she'll definitely be pleasantly surprised too!"
Qin Kelian playfully stuck out her tongue.
Saying she'd do it, she immediately did it. Qin Kelian bent down and crouched, grabbing Jiang Ran's legs with both hands, preparing to drag him to Room 303.
But just as she had dragged him completely into the corridor.
Jiang Ran suddenly woke up.
After waking up, Jiang Ran was still somewhat dazed.
When his consciousness regained some clarity.
He immediately realized his current situation.
After realizing it, he found himself in a staring contest with Qin Kelian.
"Uh hehe, I just got home and saw you lying in the hallway, so I wanted to help you back to your place."
Seeing Jiang Ran awake, Qin Kelian immediately abandoned her previous plan.
Actually, she could have completely forced it through, because judging by Jiang Ran's condition, he would be easy to handle.
But these Demoness sisters always had one rule: never take risks without one hundred percent certainty.
Therefore, Qin Kelian gave up on the fat sheep that had practically fallen into her mouth.
Jiang Ran currently had an excruciating headache, as if it were splitting open.
He didn't really register what Qin Kelian was saying.
So he didn't think much about it.
He lay on the ground with his eyes open for quite a while before, with Qin Kelian's help, he struggled to get up and was assisted by Qin Kelian to sit on his own sofa.
Afterwards, Qin Kelian went to the bathroom, saying she would prepare a basin of water to help clean the bloodstains from his body and such.
Jiang Ran sat alone on the sofa, spacing out.
At this moment, he looked down at his miserable condition, especially the pain in his left arm.
He began trying hard to recall the circumstances before he lost consciousness.
Before losing consciousness, his last memory was being in the clown's home, fighting with the clown.
That was it...
After waking up, he was in this terrible state.
Combining this with the previous two times.
He understood that afterwards, one of his alternate personalities must have taken control of his body again.
Looking at the bloodstains on his body, he must have had an intense battle with that clown.
Whether the clown ultimately died or not, he didn't know, but he himself had survived.
However, compared to his own survival and his alternate personality taking control again.
His thoughts were completely focused on the Danger Warning System.
Before, he thought: what kind of crap is this Danger Warning System?!
He felt this system was really, completely useless.
Especially since every danger warning was practically worthless.
But after this clown incident, he realized that he had been wrong about the Danger Warning System all along.
So his danger warnings were all real...
This could be seen from the clown incident.
And if the danger warnings were all real.
Something even more terrifying was coming.Google seaʀᴄh NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The sound of Qin Kelian running tap water into a basin came from the bathroom.
Jiang Ran's mind kept replaying: [Ding! Dangerous person detected, points +8! Points +...]
He turned his head, recalling other people in the apartment in his mind.
The old man in Room 301, Qin Yi, Su Mi, all those people from the three welcome parties - all of them had triggered danger warnings...
Including Security Captain Gao, Manager Xiao Zhang...
The more he recalled, the more Jiang Ran felt like his brain was about to explode.
If it were just that everyone in this world gave different point warnings when he approached them, he wouldn't think much of it.
The clown incident wouldn't seem particularly terrifying either.
What was truly terrifying was.
Some people standing right in front of him completely lacked any danger warning system alerts!
Like Xiao Q! Mike and others.
This meant that those people who triggered danger warnings were genuinely dangerous!!!
Why didn't Jiang Ran believe it before?!
That's because it was too unbelievable!
Almost everyone in one apartment building was dangerous?
That's complete bullshit, isn't it?!
Jiang Ran's spirit was somewhat dazed.
At this very moment, Qin Kelian brought a basin of water and a towel to Jiang Ran.
"Do you need me to help wipe the bloodstains from your body and face?!"
Qin Kelian blinked her big eyes and asked seriously.
Jiang Ran stared at Qin Kelian's face - still so beautiful and captivating, making people unable to resist wanting to kiss her.
But at the same time, Jiang Ran recalled the two times Qin Kelian had brought him tea.
Both times it was warned that the tea contained sedatives...
"Why was she fine after drinking it? Because she took an antidote in advance?"
Jiang Ran thought distractedly, feeling this was the only possibility.
And the question arose.
What did Qin Kelian want to do after knocking him out with drugs?
Rob him of his virtue?
Funny, impossible.
What Jiang Ran could think of was probably the recent trend of kidney theft...
"There's no love anymore..."
Jiang Ran muttered quietly.
"Hmm? Jiang Ran, what did you say? I didn't hear clearly. Do you need my help?"
Qin Kelian leaned her head forward and smiled.
Jiang Ran turned his head and said with a bitter smile: "No need, I'll do it myself."
After wetting the towel with water, he washed his face and cleaned much of the blood from his face and hands.
After cleaning up, Jiang Ran stopped his movements.
He suddenly turned to look at Qin Kelian. He still couldn't quite accept that the Qin Kelian before him, every time the danger warning alerted him, gave the same point value as the clown - 8...
So high? So dangerous?
"I need to go out for a while."
Jiang Ran said at this moment.
Qin Kelian asked curiously: "It's so late, where are you going?"
Jiang Ran didn't answer, but instead thoughtfully asked another question.
"Kelian, I'm covered in blood. Aren't you curious how this happened?"

chapters.title: Chapter 151: What’s the Real Reason Jiang Ran Can’t Leave the Apartment?
chapters.content:
Their eyes met.
Qin Kelian giggled: "I'm not that curious! Alright, alright! Now that I see you're fine, I'm relieved! I'll be going then—I still have my evening skincare routine to do!"
Her jade-like finger tapped her alabaster cheek.
After saying goodbye to Jiang Ran, Qin Kelian left his apartment.
After Qin Kelian departed, Jiang Ran changed out of his bloodstained jacket and pants, putting on fresh clothes before leaving home.
Leaving home used to feel completely ordinary.
But now, stepping outside filled him with extraordinary tension.
He constantly feared that system alert sounds would suddenly echo in his mind wherever he went.
However, the entire journey proceeded smoothly.
Jiang Ran successfully took the elevator down to the first floor.Today felt somewhat strange—even Manager Xiao Zhang, whom he usually encountered frequently on the first floor, was nowhere to be seen. As he reached the main entrance and glanced back, he noticed a young security guard in the security booth, holding his phone as if reading an e-book.
He left Alice Apartment without looking back.
When the child personality had controlled his body and stumbled back to Room 304, the system had already consumed points to heal the power drill injury on his left arm.
Thus, Jiang Ran's left arm now only caused him slight pain.
Besides going to the hospital for basic bandaging, his reason for coming out was to contemplate his next course of action.
This matter was whether he should continue living in Alice Apartment or not.
Jiang Ran pondered this question intensely throughout his journey.
Arriving at the hospital, after getting registered, doctors and nurses examined Jiang Ran and found no serious issues.
They simply disinfected his left arm. While the nurse was treating his left arm, Jiang Ran made a decision.
That decision was—to temporarily not leave Alice Apartment and continue living there.
Why? What's the reason!
The reason was quite simple: it all came down to money, didn't it?
First: Alice Apartment was his own property. If he didn't live here, he'd have to rent another place elsewhere. That required money.
Second: His current job as an assistant manager.
Think about it carefully—if you don't live here but continue working here, wouldn't that be like taking off your pants to fart? It wouldn't be much different from continuing to live here, except the time spent here would be shorter.
You'd still be just as unlucky when misfortune struck. Take this clown incident—didn't he encounter it precisely because of his assistant manager job?
Was it really because he happened to live here?
If he didn't live here anymore, he'd have to quit this job too... then find a new job, and he wouldn't find one this good...
Third, and most importantly:
Even though the Danger Warning System constantly alerted him to dangers,
That the apartment was dangerous, that many people in the apartment were very dangerous.
But, honestly speaking,
In his own memory, it seemed he hadn't encountered that many incidents.
The clearest, deepest impression was this recent one.
And this time, he clearly remembered that besides reminding him about Wang Nuli's +8 points,
More importantly, there was a 【Wang Nuli +8 points】 that suddenly changed to
【Detected that host is about to encounter danger! Please distance yourself quickly! +10 points】 or something similar.
This should represent that this danger-warning clown currently intended to kill him.
Therefore, he could rely on this change in alerts to assess the current situation.
After all, when he randomly encountered danger-warning individuals in the apartment, those dangerous people hadn't actually done anything to him.
Probably only when this "about to encounter danger, +10 points" alert appeared did it mean he was truly in danger.
Of course, Jiang Ran couldn't remember whether he had heard this "about to encounter danger, +10 points" warning before.
Perhaps he had encountered it previously.
There was one thing Jiang Ran himself didn't understand: because other personalities had taken control of his body, the memories from the period before other personalities took over would be forgotten by him.
This time, this "+10 points" warning about impending danger, the memory point was relatively distant from when other personalities took control of his body, so he still retained it.
Jiang Ran felt that with this sudden change alert,
Plus having the system, and in crisis situations, his other personalities would emerge to solve problems... it didn't seem that terrifying after all...
Of course, there was another reason he dared to continue staying here.
Back at the pancake shop,
The Danger Warning alerted him that he was in a dangerous area.
Remember what he thought at that time?
What if this place was truly dangerous?
If I die, then I die—living is painful anyway.
Yes, Jiang Ran wasn't exactly fearless of death, but if fate truly destined him to die here, then he could only die.
Having clarified these thoughts, Jiang Ran suddenly felt enlightened and breathed a deep sigh of relief.
Of course, what Jiang Ran didn't know was that what truly decided his staying to live and work here wasn't the reasons he thought of tonight, but the reason he would learn tomorrow from Manager Xiao Zhang—the real reason he couldn't leave the apartment!
...
Round 27, Day 6, at 12:10 AM.
The long-haired beautiful host appeared in the live stream room.
She announced that because Mike failed to return to Alice Apartment before 12:00 AM today,
He was directly eliminated this round.
The 89 million points bet on him were all transferred to the final prize pool.
This round's lab rats only included Jiang Ran and Wang Anjian.
Although there were no thrilling scenes during the late night hours,
Many people remained online, all waiting for the arrival of the new day at 12:00 AM.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
They insisted on seeing whether Mike would return before they could rest peacefully and go to sleep.
When they saw the time had passed and Mike still hadn't returned,
Those who had bet on Jiang Ran completely celebrated in the live stream room.
Message after message expressed schadenfreude, mocking Diamond Bachelor and the unlucky ones who had bet on Mike.
...
The long-haired beautiful host appeared in the live stream room.
After reaching clarity last night, Jiang Ran had returned to Alice Apartment.
He took a shower in Room 304 and then went to sleep.
The 89 million bet on him was entirely transferred to the final prize pool.
This round's lab rats only remained Jiang Ran and Wang Anjian.
But he had nothing else to do at home anyway.
Might as well continue working, slack off at home, and collect his salary. So he applied to Xiao Zhang.
They insisted on seeing whether Mike would return before they could peacefully go to sleep.
And even asked Jiang Ran to come find him on the first floor—he had something important to give him.
Those who had bet on Jiang Ran completely celebrated in the live stream room.
He discovered that on Manager Xiao Zhang's desk in the management office, there was a large pile of kraft paper envelopes.
Seeing Jiang Ran arrive, Manager Xiao Zhang grinned and pulled one from this stack of kraft paper envelopes and handed it to Jiang Ran.
After receiving it, Jiang Ran noticed three large characters written on the envelope's surface: To Jiang Ran.
Additionally, on the envelope surface was a postage stamp.
A golden koi fish stamp.
"What is this?"
Jiang Ran felt both confused and curious.
Manager Xiao Zhang said: "You'll know when you open it."
Only after opening it did Jiang Ran discover that inside was his monthly water, electricity, and property fee bill.
He had only lived here for a few days short of a full month.
But the billing date here was fixed each time.
So, for this bill, Jiang Ran was only charged for 25 days.
Yet these mere 25 days of charges completely broke Jiang Ran's defenses—this was the fundamental, unshakable reason why he absolutely had to continue working and living here.

chapters.title: Chapter 152: The Ridiculously Overpriced Property Management Fee
chapters.content:
These 25 days.
He used 3 tons of water.
100 kilowatt-hours of electricity.
The water rate here was 5 yuan per ton.
So water bill: 15 yuan.
Electricity rate was 2 yuan per kilowatt-hour.
100 kilowatt-hours meant 200 yuan.
Seeing these water and electricity fees, Jiang Ran almost cursed out loud.
5 yuan per ton for water? 2 yuan per kilowatt-hour for electricity?
This was ridiculously expensive!!!Why not just rob people?!
It was way more expensive than the water and electricity fees at his previous rental in Nancheng City.
If you didn't know better, you'd think one place was in a poor, backward area while the other was in a major city - except both were in the same city.
Forget about that.
Even with the high unit prices, Jiang Ran was just one person.
Water and electricity combined only came to 215 yuan.
The truly outrageous part was the property fee!!!
Alice Apartment: Property fee per square meter: 50 yuan.
Jiang Ran remembered his Room 304 was exactly 50 square meters, no more no less.
Which meant his monthly property fee would be 2500 yuan?
"Xiao Zhang, isn't this property fee a bit too outrageous?!"
Jiang Ran placed the bill on the table and pointed at the property fee.
If Jiang Ran remembered correctly, that famous Tomson Riviera in Shanghai only charged 15 yuan per square meter for property fees.
Yet Alice Apartment jumped straight to 50 yuan?
This couldn't even be described as just "outrageous" anymore!
Manager Xiao Zhang scratched his head and said: "50 yuan is pretty normal, right? When Alice Apartment first started, the property fee was 70 yuan per square meter!"
"It's already been reduced."
"Besides, Jiang Ran, you need to remember - you're an assistant manager. If Alice Apartment doesn't collect higher property fees from residents, how would they pay your salary? My salary? Other people's salaries? Just you alone cost 10,000 yuan per month! And this month you've been taking overtime voluntarily, so it's even more than 10,000!!!"
Jiang Ran felt somewhat helpless: "But, but I'm also a resident! This would cut 2500 yuan from me all at once..."
Manager Xiao Zhang patted Jiang Ran's shoulder, then took the bill from his hand and tore it to shreds.
Jiang Ran was completely stunned: "Bro, I haven't paid yet? Why did you tear it up?"
On that bill was a unique payment QR code for each resident - just scan with a phone to pay.
Manager Xiao Zhang laughed: "Didn't you not want to pay? Tearing it up means you don't have to pay, right?"
Jiang Ran made an exasperated expression.
Manager Xiao Zhang, now holding his stomach, laughed: "Alright alright, I'm just messing with you."
"Actually, we Alice employees all have hidden benefits."
"For example, take you! You're both a resident here and staff here."
"Therefore, your monthly property fee is covered by the apartment - you don't need to pay."
"Additionally, the apartment covers 500 yuan of your water and electricity fees each month. The apartment pays for anything under 500 yuan, and you pay anything over that."
After hearing Xiao Zhang's explanation.
Jiang Ran was stunned.
Holy shit, according to this calculation.
He originally should have paid 2715 yuan this month.
But just because he was apartment staff, it was completely waived?
This was even better than that "love apartment" thing where couples get half rent and free utilities!
And why was today's encounter with Xiao Zhang and what happened the real reason he ultimately stayed?
Let's do some calculations now.
Last night, Jiang Ran actually had another idea.
That was to sell his Alice Apartment unit, get some money in hand, then resign and completely leave this place where the Danger Warning System kept alerting him.
But after searching online, he found that according to Nancheng City laws, ordinary apartments require 1.5 years after transfer of ownership before they can be sold again.
And for high-end apartments like Alice Apartment, it takes 3 years before they can be sold.
Even though Jiang Ran won his through a lottery, it was still transferred to him, so he must wait 3 years - meaning the apartment couldn't be sold at all.
Not to mention various taxes and fees after selling.
Then, today's water/electricity and property fees created the following situation.
If Jiang Ran decided to leave because this place felt dangerous.
He would definitely need to rent outside, 1000 yuan.
He'd also have to quit his assistant manager job. If he didn't quit and kept working, there would be no reason to move out since he'd still be living here anyway.
Well, assuming he quit and returned to his previous customer service job, he'd take home 3500 yuan monthly.
The Alice Apartment unit couldn't be sold for three years.
But even if you don't live here, you still have to pay property fees - it's your own property, you can't escape it.
That means paying 2500 yuan monthly in property fees.
Just these two expenses would reach 3500 yuan.
Meaning, Jiang Ran's monthly salary would be completely gone after paying these two - no money left!
No money for food or drink, just waiting to starve or die of thirst! Not to mention buying medication for his dissociative identity disorder!
But what if he continued living here and kept working as assistant manager?
No monthly property fees to pay, 500 yuan covered for utilities, essentially free.
He gets at least 10,000 yuan monthly salary.
Comparing both options, which would you choose?
Damn it, Jiang Ran could only choose the second option!
What other choice did he have?ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Therefore, this was the real reason Jiang Ran fundamentally couldn't leave this place!
The previous night's thoughts were all illusions.
It's not like you can just leave if you want to - they give you a choice, but if you choose to leave, you'll have to live an extremely difficult life.
At this point, Jiang Ran finally understood everything clearly.
Even though his mind kept constantly alerting:
[Ding! Dangerous person detected! Please distance yourself quickly! Points +4! Points +4...]
This warning was about staying away from Manager Xiao Zhang.
But what could Jiang Ran do? He could only continue living here like before.
The only difference from before was that he needed to be more careful and vigilant.
Besides, from the time he met Manager Xiao Zhang until now, he didn't seem to have harmed him - in fact, he had been quite good to him...
Jiang Ran scratched his head and returned to Room 304.
Of course, before returning to 304, he asked Manager Xiao Zhang about how the clown had been recently.
Manager Xiao Zhang said the clown had gone to perform in another city.
Meanwhile.
In the bedroom of Room 704.
The bedroom curtains were drawn, blocking out the beautiful morning sunlight, with only the ceiling light illuminating the entire bedroom.
Wang Anjian was vomiting blood severely. The bedsheets, quilt covers, and even the white tiled floor beside the bed were all stained with bright red blood forming blood flower patterns.
He lay on the bed, completely weak.
The doctor had said he might not live past three months.
But given his current condition, he felt surviving three weeks would be difficult, let alone three months!
Without exaggeration, he thought if he could last three days, he'd be a hero.
Now when he used the bathroom, both number one and number two contained blood.
His immunity was too compromised now.
This caused him to feel completely weak, his body somewhat cold, unsure if it was a severe cold or a fever.
At this moment, he struggled to push himself up from the bed, leaning against the headboard.
This simple action took about five to six minutes.
After leaning against the headboard, he opened his phone.
If he remembered correctly, he had received 10,000 yuan five times total.
The first four installments had already been completely spent.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Wang Anjian Who Won't Last Much Longer
chapters.content:
He planned to spend some of the 10,000 yuan that had arrived in his account today.
He felt his life truly wouldn't last much longer.
With great effort, he reached for the painkiller box beside his bedside table.
He poured out five blue painkillers and swallowed them directly with a cup of cold water he had poured last night on the bedside table.
What went down his throat wasn't just medicine and water—there was blood too.
His mouth and nose were filled with the metallic taste of blood.
This bloody taste made him extremely uncomfortable, physically revolted. He thought he probably couldn't become a vampire since he found the smell and taste of blood too repulsive.
Cough, cough.
At that moment, he coughed a couple more times, blood-flecked sputum accompanying each cough.
Grimacing in discomfort, he prepared to complete his spending task when he suddenly received a message through WeChat.He opened WeChat.
Found the person who had sent him the message.
His weakened eyes struggled to focus, unable to see the phone clearly until he strained to refocus them.
He had notes for all his WeChat contacts.
The person messaging him was a boy, 16 years old, in high school.
His family was very poor.
Back then, he didn't even have money for school tuition.
Wang Anjian remembered giving him 1,000 yuan in support that year.
Combined with support from other kind-hearted people, it allowed him to return to school.
What had this boy sent him now?
He had written:
["Hello, Brother Wang, could you lend me some money? I want to buy a smartphone for studying and looking up information. All my classmates have phones now, and sometimes teachers use phones to notify us about things and assignments. Not having a phone is really inconvenient... so I have no other choice..."]
Wang Anjian saw that this high school boy wanted a smartphone.
That was understandable—these days, not having a phone was inconvenient not just for adults in society but even for students.
After all, with the internet so developed now, it wasn't like the old days when everyone had basic phones that could only text and call.
Smartphones had long become universal, with all kinds of chatting apps.
Nowadays, teachers in every class would create student groups and such.
Therefore, Wang Anjian sent back a message:
["What phone do you want to buy? Which model are you looking at? Let me help you check it out—don't waste money on some crappy phone."]
Some phone brands particularly like to trick people with high prices and low specs.
About five minutes passed.
A reply came through—it was a link.
Some phone brands particularly like to trick people with high prices and low specifications.
When he saw which phone this high school boy had shared as the one he wanted to buy.
Wang Anjian nearly coughed up another mouthful of blood.
The reason was that the high school boy had shared what was essentially the top-tier phone in the mobile world.
The Fruit Phone.
Wang Anjian wasn't sure if this was the latest model, but he checked the lowest configuration of this model.
It actually cost 5,499 yuan!
So, returning to WeChat, Wang Anjian immediately sent a message:
["Did you send the wrong link by mistake?"]
Wang Anjian thought the other person must have made a mistake.
But the reply came: ["No! It's this Fruit Phone! Many of my classmates use it! They say this Fruit Phone is the best—one phone can last for many years!"]
["So, Brother Wang, can you lend me money to buy this phone?"]
In his bedroom, lying on his bed, surrounded by blood on himself and his surroundings, Wang Anjian looked at his own ancient phone that he'd used for who knows how long—it wasn't even a full-screen display—and remained silent for a long time.
A long time later, several messages came through one after another, asking again if Wang Anjian could lend him money to buy the phone, promising to pay it back someday, and so on.
Wang Anjian picked up his phone and replied: ["I don't have any money available right now, so I'm sorry, I can't help you buy this phone."]
High school boy: ["It's okay, if you can't lend me five or six thousand, just lend me one thousand. I can borrow from other people too."]
Wang Anjian sighed and continued: ["No, it's not that. Do you really have to buy a Fruit Phone? You're still a student, and your family is poor. Wouldn't a thousand-yuan phone work? The thousand-yuan phones these days have very powerful functions—more than enough for your current needs. As for Fruit Phones, honestly, unless your family is well-off or you earn money yourself later, I don't think you really need to buy one now, especially when you don't have the money."]
Probably because this string of messages was too long.
The other side took three minutes to read it all before replying:
["Since you won't even lend me a single cent, stop your bullshit!!!"]Thɪs updatᴇd by ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
["Cheapskate!"]
After these two messages came a spitting emoji.
Wang Anjian quickly sent a question mark back, only to discover he had been deleted as a friend.
Facing this situation, he could only shake his head with a bitter smile.
He sighed again: "People these days!"
After speaking, he lay back against the headboard, head tilted upward looking at the ceiling.
He wasn't sure what to do now, so he just kept gazing at the ceiling!
As he stared, another message arrived on his phone.
It was from a university girl.
Wang Anjian had supported her with 1,500 yuan before—she also came from a very poor family.
This university girl was also messaging to borrow money, saying her father had suddenly gotten sick and was hospitalized, they had no money, could he lend some for emergency funds.
Wang Anjian didn't reply immediately, but instead opened the university girl's WeChat Moments.
Looking at the updates this girl had posted.
Many updates were about going out with good sisters, traveling somewhere.
Things she bought.
Recently, she seemed to have gotten a boyfriend too—foreigner, the dark-skinned type.
Had been showing off their relationship in her Moments all along.
At this moment, Wang Anjian remembered a man who had also supported this university girl complaining to him that this girl had scammed him out of two thousand yuan using her family member's illness as an excuse.
Later discovered the university girl used those two thousand to spend on that foreign boyfriend.
So he specifically told Wang Anjian and other supporters he knew to warn them and prevent being scammed.
To be honest, Wang Anjian had encountered many people or situations like this high school boy and university girl over the years.
The first time he encountered such ungrateful people, he had been extremely angry too. It took him several days to recover, feeling like his efforts had been thrown to the dogs.
But later, when he went online, he discovered he wasn't the only kind-hearted person who had been bitten back.
Even some celebrities had been bitten back.
Among them was a minor singer who had supported over three hundred people, including children from poor mountain areas, drop-out students, disabled people, and so on.
This singer ended up pitifully developing stomach cancer.
After getting stomach cancer, not a single person among those he had supported came to visit him.
What felt even more chilling and terrifying was that.
After the singer got sick, he couldn't continue earning money anymore—all his money went to medical treatment.
Thus, he stopped supporting many students.
After cutting off the support, many parents and children he had supported called him—just to demand money.
Yes, just to demand money.
Some examples included:
Weren't you supposed to support my child's education all the way?!
Why did you suddenly stop?!
Do you have any conscience?
Are you pretending to be sick to trick us because you don't want to support us anymore?
All kinds of suspicions and verbal abuse.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Wang Anjian Calls Jiang Ran
chapters.content:
There was also a female college student whom this singer had supported all the way through her university education.
Yet, immediately after graduation, she completely cut off contact with the singer.
This singer was truly remarkable—even during his illness when he had no money, he still donated 15,000 yuan, and just before his death, he even donated his corneas.
In the end, overall, he helped many people, but when he needed help the most, these people all stood by indifferently, not a single one extending a hand. Some even had the nerve to say: "He helped me voluntarily, I never forced him..."
Through this, Wang Anjian came to understand the evil in human nature.
But he still didn't give up on doing such charitable public service.
He believed that whether others treated him right or not was beyond his control, but he could live up to his own conscience.
Of course, having recognized this reality, his subsequent assistance no longer involved direct cash donations.
Instead, he helped by purchasing daily necessities, school supplies, books, and other small items.
Naturally, he still provided financial support to those without sufficient means to afford medical treatment.Supporting his frail body, Wang Anjian continued buying things online and having them delivered to various places.
It was at this moment that he received another text message.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The person who sent this message left a deep impression on him.
She was a little girl from his last volunteer teaching assignment in a mountain village.
About third grade! He had taught her.
The little girl's message read:
【Brother Wang, the backpack, erasers, pens, and other things you bought for me—they were clearly given to me, but my mom and grandma took them all away for my brother and younger brother to use, just not me. Brother Wang, what should I do?!】
Wang Anjian remembered this little girl had an older brother in fifth grade and a younger brother in first grade.
He had visited her home before.
He discovered her family was extremely biased in favor of boys over girls.
This included both the little girl's mother and grandmother.
To be honest, even now, there was something Wang Anjian couldn't understand.
You might expect fathers to favor sons over daughters, but why would mothers and grandmothers, being women themselves, also show such strong preference for boys over girls?
Or was it that the same hurts they experienced in their youth and childhood were now being inflicted upon their own children?
【I remember I bought a set for your brother and younger brother too, exactly the same as yours. So why did your mom and them take yours?】
Wang Anjian had specifically bought for the brothers too to prevent this exact situation—so they wouldn't lack anything and take the little girl's supplies.
The little girl quickly replied: 【Mom said my backpack and supplies are still usable, so she gave the new ones you bought me to my younger brother to use first, then put away the backpack you bought for my younger brother.】
【So, brother, can you help me?】
Reading this, Wang Anjian felt utterly powerless.
Because he had specifically bought a pink backpack for the little girl—the kind meant for girls.
He chose that color deliberately so boys wouldn't be interested, yet it still couldn't escape this fate?
After thinking for a moment, Wang Anjian quickly replied:
【Sorry, brother can't help you right now. You need to remember that the only one who can truly help you is yourself—no one can help you forever. You must study hard, break free from your family, and gain your own freedom. Until then, you'll have to endure. I know you might not fully understand these words now, but you must remember them.】
【Okay, brother, I've written down your words. I will remember them!】
【Also, brother, I see my mom and them coming back soon! I can't keep messaging you! I'll need to delete these messages later, otherwise if mom finds them, I'll get beaten. Goodbye, brother! I'll contact you again next time!】
The messages ended here.
Powerless, Wang Anjian tossed his phone aside.
He murmured to himself: "I'm sorry, in my current condition, I really can't help you. Even if I were perfectly healthy, I still couldn't help you—I can't change your family's mindset. I've done my best..."
Meanwhile, in the live stream room.
Ultimate Rich Kid commented: 【Sigh, what's praiseworthy about the apartment's cameras is how clearly they capture everything—even the text and images on phones are crystal clear. But what's not praiseworthy is also this clarity—it's too clear! My eyes seem to be leaking...】
Fairy Sister: 【Crying is crying, there's nothing shameful about it! What Wang Anjian has been doing is truly touching! Who would have thought that after entering the apartment, instead of using the 10,000 per day for his own treatment, he'd use it all for charity? He's really a "fool"—can't he be better to himself?! He's almost dead!!!!】
Little Dragon Girl: 【Yeah, unfortunately, even if he wants to be better to himself now, he probably doesn't have the chance anymore. Looking at his condition, heaven likely won't give him much longer to live...】
I Love Eating Shit: 【This young man ending up like this is entirely his own doing—can't blame others.】
Little Aunt: 【???】
Little Dragon Girl: 【???】
More confused people chimed in: 【???】
Ultimate Rich Kid @ I Love Eating Shit: 【What do you mean by that?】
I Love Eating Shit: 【Wait, let me go to the bathroom first, then I'll type and explain.】
So everyone waited about two minutes before seeing I Love Eating Shit's explanation:
【Everyone's fate and karma are predetermined. By involving himself so deeply in others' karma and trying to change it, plus having limited capacity to bear such karma himself, he exceeded his limits and brought misfortune upon himself. That's why he got cancer.】
After reading this, Ultimate Rich Kid said: 【Seriously? Why are you bringing feudal superstitions here?】
I Love Eating Shit: 【Young man, go ask your father whether this is feudal superstition or not.】
Domineering Female CEO: 【Rather than debating whether this is feudal superstition, we should focus on who will win this round. This is the sixth day—including today, there's still tomorrow left.】
【Currently there are still two lab rats. Let's not have both of them survive this round.】
Ultimate Rich Kid: 【Huh? If both Jiang Ran and Wang Anjian survive this round, how would that work? Would both be considered winners, and bettors for either get to share the prize pool money?】
Domineering Female CEO: 【Exactly.】
Ultimate Rich Kid: 【Damn, anyway nothing for me—that fool Mike!】
Back to reality.
Wang Anjian spent the entire day resting in bed.
He took his medicine and ate some bread.
He slept fitfully until evening, when he finally felt somewhat better.
So he got out of bed, went to the bathroom to clean up, and changed into fresh clothes.
Checking the time, he was surprised to find it was already 9:00 PM.
Having been cooped up indoors all day, he decided to go out for some fresh air.
But just as he opened his door and prepared to step out, a sinister wind swept through the hallway outside.
It made him sneeze violently.
After that massive sneeze, he instantly felt something wrong with his body.
His head swam and felt heavy—immediately he knew he'd taken a turn for the worse.
He could only consciously control his fall to the ground as gently as possible.
After collapsing, he knew he truly didn't have much longer to live—now he couldn't even leave his apartment.
Since things had reached this point, he needed to take preemptive action for his next steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Jiang Ran, Wang Anjian, and Robert
chapters.content:
At this moment, he used his phone to send a message to Assistant Manager Jiang Ran.
After sending the message, Wang Anjian closed his eyes. Although the door was still open, he didn't even have the energy to stand up now, let alone close the door.
......
Robert, one of the world's top ten serial killers, was currently wandering floor by floor.
His wandering wasn't ordinary wandering—he was constantly searching for targets to strike.
Since being assigned to Alice Apartment in Hua Country, he hadn't killed a single person.
Why?New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Was it because he had turned kind-hearted?
Of course not.
During his six days here, he hadn't made a single move simply because killing these foreigners didn't give him that blood-boiling sensation.He found it strange, since back in Maple Country, it wasn't like his hands were clean of Hua people's blood.
Whether hunting Hua people or Maple Country natives, both brought him pleasure and that thrilling blood-boiling feeling.
But here, for some inexplicable reason, he felt no urge to act.
He searched for the reason and found it quite simple.
Four words: language barrier.
In Maple Country, he had killed two ethnic Hua people—immigrants from this country.
One was an ethnic Hua woman in her twenties or thirties.
The other was an ethnic Hua little girl around eight or nine years old.
Both could communicate with him without any language issues.
But here was completely different.
They couldn't understand each other at all, having to rely entirely on phones.
It was extremely inconvenient.
The thrill of his hunts was completely gone. If he had to make a comparison, it was like many people watching Cherry Blossom Country adult videos only to find no Chinese subtitles—the same principle.
This resulted in his innate bloodlust remaining completely unstirred.
When he finally spotted a white person in the apartment complex, it turned out to be someone he knew.
That was Mike.
To be honest, Robert was also shocked to encounter Mike here.
He thought he was seeing things!
He remembered Mike clearly, especially since the last woman he severely injured before being captured was Mike's girlfriend and fiancée. She eventually died despite emergency treatment.
He thought to himself that Mike must desperately want to kill him, but unfortunately, had no opportunity.
Of course, that day when he made eye contact with Mike, he immediately fled—not because he feared Mike, but because he found Mike too troublesome to deal with and didn't want conflict with him.
Also, he hadn't forgotten why he was transferred from Maple Country's Alice Apartment to here.
He was notified that a live stream room user from another country used their privilege to transfer him here to kill someone.
He thought the target would be an extremely dangerous person, someone like himself.
But during an encounter a few days ago, he discovered that person was quite ordinary.
Of course, it could also be an act.
But he didn't pay much attention to it.
For him, killing a person was like killing a cat or dog.
Extremely simple, especially in this gun-prohibited country—it made things even easier for him.
He didn't have to worry about the other suddenly pulling out a gun for counterattack.
So, he planned to make his move and kill that person tomorrow night.
Aimlessly, he wandered up to the 7th floor and began pacing the hallway.
When he reached Room 704, he discovered the door wasn't closed, and there was actually someone lying on the floor.
That person seemed to have passed out.
Their face was pale and dreadful-looking.
Just then, Robert's right ear twitched as he heard elevator movement. He quickly hid in a corner of the hallway, peeking toward the elevator.
The elevator stopped at the 7th floor, and out stepped someone Robert never expected to see here—Jiang Ran!
Jiang Ran emerged from the 7th-floor elevator. He came here naturally because he received notice that an apartment resident required assistance from him, the assistant manager.
"Room 704, right? That would be Wang Anjian."
In the Alice Apartment residents' group chat, Wang Anjian's name appeared as "704+Wang Anjian."
So Jiang Ran knew which resident needed help this time, unlike last time with the clown.
When he reached the doorway of 704, it genuinely startled him.
Why was Wang Anjian, who had contacted him, lying here?
And he looked extremely weak and pale.
Jiang Ran quickly crouched down. As his hand moved to check Wang Anjian's forehead, his fingers accidentally brushed against Wang Anjian's face, feeling an unusual burning heat. When he actually touched the forehead, he found it even hotter.
He must be running a fever.
At this point, Jiang Ran assumed this was probably why Wang Anjian had contacted him.
Fallen ill, unable to care for himself alone.
Jiang Ran prepared to first drag Wang Anjian back into the bedroom inside.
As he stood inside the room, one hand gripping Wang Anjian's shoulder, bending down ready to pull him—
A shadow fell over him accompanied by the system's alert tone:
[Ding! Dangerous individual detected! Please distance yourself immediately! Points +10! Points +10! Points...]
Jiang Ran looked up and saw the white man he had encountered once before—Robert.
If this were before the clown incident, Jiang Ran wouldn't have paid Robert any mind, but after that experience, he couldn't afford to be careless.
Because Robert triggered the system, and he was actually the first person Jiang Ran encountered who gave +10 points.
That previous time he met Robert, the system had already given a warning, also +10, but as mentioned, that was before the clown incident.
Encountering him now, Jiang Ran would be lying if he said he wasn't nervous, but he forced himself to appear calm.
After all, the Danger Warning System hadn't issued the warning about imminent danger yet. Only when that alert came would he truly be in inescapable peril.
"Let me help you! (English)"
Standing in the doorway, Robert showed Jiang Ran a friendly, amiable smile.
Before Jiang Ran could even speak, Robert had already grabbed Wang Anjian's feet with both hands, cooperating with Jiang Ran to lift Wang Anjian up.
Although Jiang Ran didn't understand Robert's English, he understood the intention from the action.
Fine, let's get him inside first!
So Jiang Ran and Robert worked together to carry Wang Anjian into the bedroom.
As Jiang Ran prepared to place Wang Anjian on the bed, he noticed large bloodstains on the bed and blood on the floor.
Jiang Ran was now seeing danger everywhere, but upon closer inspection, he found these bloodstains had long dried—definitely not fresh.
Plus, aside from the continuous +10 points from Robert's presence, there were no other danger warnings nearby. So he temporarily set aside the mystery of these bloodstains and placed Wang Anjian on the bed.
After settling Wang Anjian on the bed, Jiang Ran pulled out his phone and opened the built-in translation app.
He turned to Robert and said:
"Thank you, Robert, for helping me move him inside. You can leave now. I'll handle things from here."
Jiang Ran wanted to urge Robert to quickly get away from him, preferably as far as possible.
But reality always seemed to run counter to his hopes.

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Robert Gets +15 Points
chapters.content:
Robert shook his head and said:
"No, I need to wait until this person wakes up before I can leave. You definitely need my help! Look, this person's bed is covered in blood, and his nightstand is filled with various medicine bottles. He must be seriously ill! It would probably be difficult for you to take care of him alone!"
After listening to the translation, although Jiang Ran's expression remained unchanged, his heart was growing roots and turning green inside...
After saying so much, it turns out you still don't plan to leave.
He didn't dare to force Robert to leave either, fearing that Robert, who currently posed no danger to him, might develop murderous intentions if pressured to depart.
However, Robert's words did remind him of something.
There were indeed too many medicine bottles on the nightstand.
He picked up several bottles to examine them.
There were anti-inflammatory drugs, cold medicine, fever reducers.
And even more painkillers.Of course, he also saw several empty medicine boxes and bottles that had been vacant for a long time.
The text on these long-empty medicine boxes and bottles wasn't commonly seen.
Jiang Ran read a few lines and was so frightened he immediately stopped reading.
For example: follow-up treatment for progressive stage XX cancer, and so on.Thɪs
Just reading a few lines immediately made it clear this was cancer treatment medication.
