And the presence of cancer treatment drugs in someone's home clearly indicated that someone in this household had cancer, and here only Wang Anjian lived alone.
Jiang Ran continued examining a blue painkiller bottle filled with pills.
Seeing this, he suddenly remembered - at the matchmaking event, he had seen Wang Anjian sprinkling these blue pills onto his ice cream while eating it.
He had thought they were some kind of candy at the time, because what normal person would imagine someone sprinkling painkillers on ice cream?
On Robert's side.
Looking around the bedroom, Robert didn't see anything particularly interesting.
Then he focused his attention on Jiang Ran and Wang Anjian.
Wang Anjian was still unconscious at the moment.
Nothing interesting to see there.
That left only Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran was currently side-facing him, continuously examining the large pile of medicine bottles and boxes on the nightstand.
Robert stared at Jiang Ran's side profile and back, his pupils emitting an extremely profound glow under the white light from the ceiling lamp.
He differed from typical Caucasian appearances - usually Caucasians have blond hair and blue eyes.
But he was a Caucasian with black hair and black pupils.
His cheeks were gaunt, and if paired with a fierce expression, he would look exactly like a devil.
Robert stared at Jiang Ran's side profile and back, his pupils emitting an extremely profound glow under the white light from the ceiling lamp.
His usual expression often included smiles.
This was why, back when he was captured, people who had known him before couldn't believe it.
Because their impression of Robert had been excellent.
But strangely, he wasn't the type with a fierce appearance.
Never would they have imagined he would be that notorious serial killer...
And many serial killers were like Robert.
They didn't have that kind of appearance that looked immediately vicious and terrifying.
Many had ordinary faces, and some were even quite handsome.
Hence the old saying: you can't judge a book by its cover.
And another saying: you may know a person's face but not their heart.
They didn't have the kind of appearance that looked extremely fierce and terrifying at first glance.
But now, with such a perfect opportunity right before him, why not just kill him now?
His left hand continuously rubbed his neck.
Forget it, might as well kill him now. It had been so many days since his last kill, he was almost forgetting that feeling.
At that moment, Jiang Ran discovered something truly alarming - there were three drawers under the nightstand, and all three were also filled with various medications.
Most were empty packages of already consumed drugs, different types of painkillers.
Seeing this, his mouth kept twitching because it reminded him of the medication he took for his dissociative identity disorder.
Thus, he felt deep empathy for Wang Anjian's experience.
He turned to look at Wang Anjian, just as Wang Anjian's black hair entered his field of vision.
In the silent environment, the Danger Warning System in Jiang Ran's mind suddenly appeared like a ghost jumping out in a horror movie, startling him:
[Ding! Detection that host is about to encounter danger! Points +15! Points +15! Points...]
Finally, Jiang Ran heard the alert he never wanted to hear.
Especially since this one was particularly terrifying.
Jiang Ran had always believed the maximum points would be +10, but who would have thought it could break through directly to +15?
Did this mean Robert's danger level was also the highest he had encountered?
Jiang Ran immediately stood up abruptly, turning around to prepare for the possible incoming crisis.
His reaction speed was quick, especially with the system's warning giving him absolute initiative.
But Robert's reaction was even faster. Already relatively close to Jiang Ran, he took a swift step directly to Jiang Ran's back, then wrapped his right arm around Jiang Ran's neck, coordinating with his left arm to form a chokehold.
Many deranged serial killers have their unique killing methods, which serve as evidence for police to determine if multiple cases were committed by the same person.
As mentioned before, Robert's fixed patterns were only operating late at night and leaving a blood-drawn skull at crime scenes.
And sometimes he intentionally didn't leave the blood-drawn skull.
This was to confuse the police, as he was being pursued by Maple Country's police at the time.
If he kept leaving such obvious crime characteristics, it would be equivalent to telling the police where he was.
That's why he was so difficult to catch back then.
After all, his only truly fixed crime characteristic was strictly speaking late-night operations.
His killing methods: shooting, blunt force, stabbing, throat-slitting, etc. - basically random, various methods.
Now targeting Jiang Ran, he directly employed strangulation.
Many deranged serial killers have their unique killing methods, which serve as evidence for police to determine if multiple cases were committed by the same person.
After the clown incident, Jiang Ran had actually been carrying a fruit knife in a soft leather sheath at his waist.
But now the awkward situation was that if he released his right hand from tugging against Robert's right arm
This was to confuse the police, as he was being pursued by Maple Country's police at the time.
If he kept leaving such obvious crime characteristics, it would be equivalent to telling the police where he was.
He only felt his breathing becoming increasingly difficult, his face turning crimson red.
His hands couldn't pull Robert's right arm away at all;
even digging his fingernails deeply into the skin of Robert's right arm was useless.
The guy's arms were like iron implements.
Soon, Jiang Ran lost consciousness. In the last second before losing consciousness, he saw Wang Anjian getting up from the bed.
Wang Anjian gradually woke up while lying in bed.
Robert appeared tall and slender overall, making it impossible to imagine his astonishing strength.
After waking up, his eyes couldn't handle the light well, so he turned his head and squinted toward the left side.
But now the awkward situation was that if he released his right hand from tugging against Robert's right arm
He was so frightened he immediately became fully alert.
After becoming alert, he realized Jiang Ran was being strangled by a unfamiliar white man, his face redder than a red apple, clearly about to suffocate.

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Why Is This Emerging Sub-Personality So Weak?
chapters.content:
Wang Anjian didn't know what was happening either. His previously weak body that had difficulty even getting out of bed now felt completely restored to health. After rolling off the bed, he moved like nothing was wrong, throwing a punch directly toward Robert's face.
After all, he knew Jiang Ran—the young man had even been summoned through his phone—while this white man was a complete stranger.
So naturally, he had to help Jiang Ran escape this predicament.
Even though he had absolutely no clue what was actually happening in front of him.
Robert noticed at this moment that Wang Anjian had awakened.
But he couldn't care less, responding to Wang Anjian's approach with a direct kick.
The kick landed squarely in his abdomen, sending Wang Anjian flying back to the foot of the bed. His lumbar spine smashed violently against the iron bed frame, and instantly, excruciating pain radiated throughout his entire body, accompanied by the sickening crunch of cracking bone.
The tremendous pain seemed to reawaken his previous weakness.
Wang Anjian's head tilted to the left as he lost consciousness once more.
After Wang Anjian fell unconscious, Robert released his arm from around Jiang Ran's neck.Freed from the restraint, Jiang Ran collapsed to the floor, unable to get up.
In just those brief moments, Robert had achieved a "double kill."
Whether it was because he was too strong or these two were too weak remained unclear.
Robert now nudged Jiang Ran with his right foot.
Still somewhat puzzled, he muttered: "That's it? They're really this weak? The person who transferred me here is completely wasting my time! (English)"
Because Jiang Ran proved so feeble, Robert couldn't even muster interest in leaving behind his signature blood skull mark.
Right at this moment.
The system's voice emerged within Jiang Ran's consciousness:
[Ding! Detected that the host still has half a breath remaining. Consuming 500 points! Repairing!]
[Ding! Detected that the host faces life-threatening danger! Consuming 1000 points! Awakening other personalities!]
[Ding! Personality has been awakened!!!]
Robert stood in place, lost in unknown thoughts.
He suddenly shook his head: "No, I should still leave one blood skull mark! (English)"
"Might as well finish off both of these guys directly. They probably aren't dead yet, just knocked out. (English)"
He scanned left and right, searching the bedroom for any sharp objects that could cut open Jiang Ran or Wang Anjian's bodies to draw blood.
But after looking around, he found nothing.
Left with no choice, he had to go to the outside kitchen to fetch a knife.
The rapid tap-tap-tap of footsteps faded as he left the bedroom.
Jiang Ran, who had been lying on the floor like a dead dog, suddenly snapped his eyes open.
After opening his eyes, he cautiously observed his surroundings.
Seeing that the bedroom was currently safe, he carefully rose to his feet and slowly moved toward the bedroom doorway.
From his angle and position, he could clearly see Robert's back as the man stood in the open kitchen selecting a knife.
He took a deep breath, moving his hands and feet as lightly as possible across the floor.
He planned to first move toward the opposite bathroom and hide there.
Then he would look for an opportunity to escape.
As for confronting the enemy directly...
Just as he was moving cautiously halfway across the room.
Robert over there happened to finish selecting his knife. Having chosen a sharp fruit knife, he turned around and immediately spotted Jiang Ran crawling on all fours toward the bathroom direction.
Their eyes met across the room.
Robert's expression first showed astonishment, then instantly transformed into excitement, as if he had discovered something that intensely interested him. A terrifying smile spread across his face:
"Interesting, very interesting! You really have some skills, not an ordinary person after all. To wake up this quickly!! (English)"
Meanwhile, Jiang Ran's eyes flashed with pure terror.
While scrambling to his feet, he immediately began cursing aloud:
"Damn it! Damn it! Why did I have to be the one dragged out this time?! This kind of situation obviously isn't something I can handle! Should have let one of the other personalities come out instead!!!!"
This Jiang Ran differed significantly from the personalities that had previously emerged to resolve Jiang Ran's crises.
No matter how different those other personalities were, they all shared the same underlying confidence.
But this one possessed none of that.
He felt almost as weak as the main personality Jiang Ran, seeming like just an ordinary person.
Robert had already selected the fruit knife, but now he placed it on the kitchen counter nearby and strode purposefully toward Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran continuously retreated backward until his back hit the wall with nowhere left to go.
Left with no alternatives, he reached toward his waist and drew out the fruit knife that the main personality Jiang Ran had prepared but never used.
Pulling off the soft leather sheath, he gripped the fruit knife with both hands, pointing the tip toward Robert while his entire body trembled uncontrollably, his lips quivering:
"Don't come any closer! Be careful or I'll kill you!!!!"
The fierce words completely betrayed by his trembling body.
Especially since Robert couldn't understand Chinese, making Jiang Ran's appearance seem like nothing but a helpless little lamb in Robert's eyes.
He showed no fear whatsoever toward Jiang Ran despite the knife, closing the distance directly.
And Jiang Ran, as Robert approached, suddenly thrust forward with the blade.
The result: Robert easily disarmed him empty-handed.
Now holding Jiang Ran's fruit knife, Robert looked at him with an ambiguous half-smile, his pupils emitting an eerie glow as he playfully tossed the knife behind him.
Then he strode toward Jiang Ran, who swung his fists wildly forward in fear while shouting loudly: "Don't come any closer!"
Robert didn't understand, rushing forward and delivering a punch directly to Jiang Ran's abdomen. The blow made Jiang Ran vomit bitter fluid instantly.
Bent over double, he dry-heaved toward the floor.
Robert immediately grabbed Jiang Ran by the collar and delivered another heavy punch to his face.
Instantly, his face swelled red, and a trickle of blood seeped from the corner of his mouth.
"Come on, this time I'll make sure you suffocate to death! (English)"
With these words, Robert repeated his previous technique—right arm locking around Jiang Ran's neck, working in concert with his left arm to form a deadly vise-like grip.
The moment the pressure constricted his airway, Jiang Ran's face flushed deep red as he struggled desperately.
At this very moment, this scene was being perfectly projected into the live stream room.Thɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Everyone watching this unfold in the live stream felt completely bewildered.
Ultimate Rich Kid: [What the hell? Is this still Jiang Ran? Not one of his other personalities? Why is he so weak?!]
Fairy Sister: [I don't get it. Based on previous situations, when Jiang Ran gets knocked out or faces life-and-death situations, don't his other personalities usually jump out? What's happening this time? If he's really this weak, could it actually still be the original one!]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Dammit, if it really is the original one, isn't he truly doomed?!]
Domineering Female CEO: [I'm really fed up with you all! Didn't you hear what this Jiang Ran said earlier? 'Damn it, why did I have to come out? Should have let the other personalities come out instead' or something like that?]
Little Aunt: [So that means the one who emerged this time is indeed another personality, but a very weak one?]
Little Dragon Girl: [Probably just a particularly weak personality. Otherwise, he wouldn't be getting beaten this badly. Thinking about it now, it makes sense—different personalities have different strengths. It can't be that every single one of Jiang Ran's alternate personalities is insanely powerful, right?]
I am the Hero: [Forget about these personality issues. The current situation is that Jiang Ran is about to get killed... What I want to know is, since one personality has already emerged, can another one still come out?]

chapters.title: Chapter 158: The Complete Main Personality, the True Jiang Ran—Descends
chapters.content:
Ultimate Rich Kid: "Damn! I think it should be possible, right? Last time with the clown, wasn't it clearly about brothers? Ah, still not right—last time with these brothers, we never reached a conclusion. Are they personalities with familial relationships, or is one personality mentally disturbed and split into brothers?!"
The group of people who bet on Jiang Ran were extremely anxious inside.
Yeah, how could they not be anxious?
Only these two lab rats remained in the 27th round.
Coincidentally, both lab rats were currently here.
Both facing Robert's threat.
Now it was a competition of who would be killed by Robert first.
If Jiang Ran got killed by Robert now, then Wang Anjian in the bedroom would win!
Even though Jiang Ran died, Wang Anjian would probably still be killed by Robert!
But he would die after Jiang Ran!!!Those who bet on Jiang Ran, like Middle-aged Uncle.
If Jiang Ran really had to die, they hoped he would die after Wang Anjian, but given the current situation, it didn't seem likely.
These people were anxious, but those in the live stream room who had already lost by betting on other lab rats were watching the show with great pleasure.
Domineering Female CEO even said: "Actually, I'm thinking—if Jiang Ran dies, it might be quite good. After all, this guy is basically a BUG. If he survives to the next round, who knows how much betting money he alone could attract again?"
Returning to reality.
Jiang Ran, being choked, began resisting extremely fiercely, but as time passed, the intensity of his struggles gradually diminished.
Finally, he stopped moving completely.
Even after he stopped moving, Robert continued choking him for several more minutes.
Especially before putting Jiang Ran down, he used his left hand to check Jiang Ran's breathing. Only after confirming Jiang Ran had no breath did he release his arms.
"Interesting, but not very. (in English)"
After finishing off Jiang Ran, Robert turned and went to the open kitchen to retrieve the fruit knife he had previously selected and placed on the kitchen counter.
At this moment, Jiang Ran lay on the ground, breath stopped.
His face was extremely red, even redder than a bright red apple.
Especially his neck, where the marks from the arm choke were clearly visible.
Under normal circumstances, Jiang Ran would already be dead.
But unfortunately, he had a system.
[Ding! Detected host has died from suffocation! Consuming 10,000 points! Reviving host!]
[Ding! Consuming 500 points, repairing physical damage caused by suffocation death!]
[Ding! Detected current danger—summoning another personality once cannot resolve the situation.]
[Now consuming 10,000 points, awakening all evil memories of the main personality!]
[Ding! All evil memories have been reintegrated into the main personality!]
[Main personality is now complete.]
[Main personality awakening.]
Jiang Ran opened his eyes.
These were still the same eyes as before, yet they were completely different from before.
These eyes resembled the ocean.
Their depths were like the seafloor—unfathomable, unclear what dangers lurked within the dark abyss.
Jiang Ran now sat up, right there on the floor.
Then, he extended his left hand, fingers pointing toward his temple area.
He began rhythmically tapping the area above his left temple.
While tapping, he murmured to himself inwardly:
"Oh... oh... so during the time I self-stripped all of what people call evil memories to suppress the other personalities, so many things actually happened..."
The currently awakened Jiang Ran was clearly organizing his memories.
Robert retrieved the fruit knife and then turned around.
When he turned and saw Jiang Ran sitting on the ground with his back to him,
Robert thought he was seeing things.
So, he closed his eyes for a few seconds, then opened them again. When he saw the same back as before,
His empty left hand brushed through his long black curly hair.
Stunned confusion appeared on his face.
"Not dead? (in English)"
"Clearly no breathing? Holding breath? So tolerant? (in English)"
"Oh... I understand, completely understand. So hard to kill—this is the real reason I was transferred here! You seem like an ordinary person, but you're actually not ordinary at all. (in English)"
"Since I can't choke you to death, then I'll use the knife instead—direct throat slash. I don't believe you can wake up again after this. (in English)"
That Robert could become one of the world's top ten notorious serial killers
Proved his comprehensive abilities were absolutely not those of an ordinary person.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have been so difficult to capture back then.
His guide, and the one who caused him to become what he is now, was actually his cousin.
His psychology had been twisted since he was very young.
That cousin of his was a soldier who had returned from the battlefield after retirement.
After coming back, he would spend all day telling the young Robert about the cruelties of the battlefield, various bloody scenes.
Including teaching him many combat techniques, tracking skills, and other essential soldier knowledge.
And one incident that happened later became the trigger for Robert's crimes after he grew up.
His cousin's wife despised his cousin for always bragging and being lazy.
As a result, his cousin actually shot his wife right in front of Robert.
After the shooting, he showed no fear and continued completely at ease.
This scene created tremendous psychological shock for Robert at that time—even now, he still remembered the temperature of his cousin's wife's scalding blood splashing on his face.
It was precisely because of his cousin that
Robert currently held the fruit knife in a reverse grip.
Rather than the forward grip ordinary people commonly use.
Robert strode toward Jiang Ran. When about one meter away, he was already preparing to plunge the fruit knife into Jiang Ran's neck.
Just as he swung his arm to thrust the knife into Jiang Ran's neck, Jiang Ran, who was sitting on the ground, suddenly leaned his back backward, then fiercely kicked both legs backward.
Solidly landing on Robert's shoulder areas.
The impact forced Robert back several steps, preventing him from successfully stabbing Jiang Ran's neck.
After completing this movement, Jiang Ran performed a kip-up to stand.
Then immediately turned to face Robert.
His left hand continued rhythmically tapping above his temple.
He tilted his head slightly and said to Robert:
"I'm organizing, don't disturb me. (in English)"
Hearing English suddenly come from Jiang Ran's mouth,
Robert, who had just been kicked twice, felt displeased and his anger began rising.
But discovering the person opposite could actually speak English
Immediately gave him the joy similar to when many perverts searching for a certain Cherry Blossom Country movie resource for a long time without finding a Chinese translated version, suddenly find it just when they're about to give up.
"How do you want to die? (in English)"
Robert now felt a killing interest toward Jiang Ran.
If before, dealing with Jiang Ran was purely like completing a task,
Now he genuinely felt killing intent toward Jiang Ran, wanting to properly hunt him.
Jiang Ran didn't answer, just kept tapping, tapping again.
Finally, he stopped tapping.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Jiang Ran VS Robert
chapters.content:
Robert looked at this familiar smile.
Usually, this smile would appear on his own face, so why was it now on the face of the person opposite him?

The next moment, he charged forward, holding the knife in a reverse grip, slashing violently toward Jiang Ran's side.

But Jiang Ran simply reached out with his right hand and effortlessly caught Robert's right wrist that held the knife. The blade was still about tens of centimeters from Jiang Ran's body but couldn't advance any further!
Robert's eye twitched. Just this single exchange.Made Robert feel that the person before him wasn't the Jiang Ran he had "killed" twice at all.
But someone completely different.
"Interesting, very interesting."
Robert suddenly shouted "Ah!" and exerted force with his right arm. Jiang Ran also frowned, shifting his body backward a step, instantly releasing Robert's right wrist.
Robert, still holding the knife, carried by momentum and unable to brake, drove the fruit knife deep into the white wall beside them.
Only half of the blade remained visible outside.
"If I still had my body from before crossing over, I wouldn't have needed to dodge this knife at all."
Jiang Ran thought to himself at this moment.
With the fruit knife now stuck in the wall.
Robert simply abandoned using the knife.
He trusted his own fists, throwing a right hook toward Jiang Ran's right cheek.
Jiang Ran dodged with a quick movement, and before Robert could react, he appeared in front of Robert and punched him hard in the stomach.
This punch was heavy, making Robert stagger backward, bending over as he vomited acidic fluid onto the ground.
Before he finished vomiting, Robert straightened up, only to receive another punch from Jiang Ran.
This punch landed on his right cheek.
The blow made blood continuously flow from Robert's mouth, and he spat out several white teeth.
Upon closer observation, Robert's teeth were different from normal people's.
His teeth grew in bizarre, deformed shapes, almost like deformities.
This was because before being caught, he had always habitually used that stuff.
If observant, one could notice.
Jiang Ran's two punches just now-first the stomach, then the face.
Hit exactly the same places where Robert had struck Jiang Ran when the previous personality controlled the body.
It seemed that this current complete main personality Jiang Ran had quite a vengeful nature.
"Haha, hahaha!"
At this moment, Robert lifted his head and laughed wildly, blood foam continuously spraying from his mouth.
After his wild laughter, Robert's expression quickly changed.
A look of fury and viciousness suddenly appeared.
This expression, combined with his originally thin, narrow face, made him look exactly like a Western demon.
"You damned Hua Country person!"
"I'll send you to hell!"
Robert was exceptionally angry.
Especially about being injured and having his teeth knocked out!
If during his nighttime crimes in the past, a victim had injured him like this.
That victim would have died more miserably than anyone else.
Would have been tortured to death in countless ways.
Facing Robert's vicious words, Jiang Ran standing opposite him remained completely unmoved.
His gaze toward Robert was like looking at an ant.
Robert charged at Jiang Ran again.
Continuously throwing punches.
But unfortunately, all his punches were dodged by Jiang Ran, and every time Jiang Ran dodged, his own fist would land on Robert's body.
In a short time, he had already been hit over ten times, each punch extremely heavy.
This resulted in exceptional pain in all the areas where he'd been struck.
Robert now leaned against the counter of the open kitchen, his heavy panting loud in the silent environment, staring at Jiang Ran with apprehension.
He didn't understand why the current Jiang Ran seemed completely different from before?
Was everything before just an act? Was this the real Jiang Ran?
If that were true, then was the person opposite him insane?
Letting himself be nearly strangled to death twice?
Why would he do this?
Intentionally toying with and mocking him?
If that were the case, Robert admitted to himself that he wouldn't dare take such risks as the other person.
But now there was also a problem facing him.
Currently, it seemed impossible to win without using weapons.
Robert secretly glanced at the knife holder on the kitchen counter behind him, which held many knives.
He had his eye on a kitchen knife.
During this time when Robert abandoned using fists and prepared to use a knife.
Jiang Ran began tapping the area above his left temple with his left hand again.
He was once more browsing through and organizing memories.
After about ten taps.
A cold smile appeared on Jiang Ran's face: "I hope you're as famous as that clown, a renowned serial killer."
After saying this, he took out his phone from his pocket, opened a search app, and took a picture of Robert's current demonically snarling face.
After taking the picture.
Soon, Robert's photo and deeds appeared on the phone.
His eyes moved rapidly.
Jiang Ran's browsing speed was ridiculously fast.
It seemed like he could read ten lines at a glance, swiftly scrolling through Robert's profile.
In just a short minute, he had already reached the bottom.
This wasn't because Robert's profile was too brief and easy to finish reading.
On the contrary, as one of the world's top ten serial killers selected globally.
His crimes were numerous, and his profile information was naturally extremely extensive.
Yet despite this, Jiang Ran finished reading it within a minute.
After finishing, he put away his phone.
Using extremely authentic English, he said:
"The Night Sniper? Disciple of the Devil?"
"Too pathetic."
"Daring only to operate at night, afraid to commit crimes during daytime—scared of being easily caught, afraid of exposure, right?"
"Just a nighttime rat like you actually managed to panic an entire country like that? What a bunch of trash!"
Originally, Robert had prepared to grab the kitchen knife, but upon hearing Jiang Ran's words, especially these derogatory comments, his face became even more twisted and vicious.
Jiang Ran continued disdainfully: "You could commit so many cases entirely by infiltrating people's homes at night, catching them off guard. With your level? Still want to become the greatest serial killer in history?"
Finally, after Jiang Ran finished this sentence, the blood vessels in Robert's eyes completely filled his vision.
He grabbed the kitchen knife he had been eyeing for a long time from nearby.
Like throwing a bottle, he instantly threw it with force toward Jiang Ran.
After throwing this kitchen knife, he immediately picked up another smaller kitchen knife and charged at Jiang Ran.
The suddenly flying kitchen knife, at such close range—an ordinary person might not have time to react and would be cut.
But Jiang Ran simply dodged to the side, avoiding it easily.
And when Robert came running toward him.
With the gleaming kitchen knife slashing at him.
He still easily avoided it, dodging three slashes before punching Robert's chin.
This punch clearly produced the sound of cracking bone.
The tremendous pain made Robert scream "Ah! Ah!" as he staggered backward.
Seizing this opportunity, Jiang Ran directly snatched the kitchen knife from Robert's hand.
Then slashed it onto Robert's right shoulder.
Instantly, the knife and bone created a chemical reaction.
A large amount of red liquid gushed out.

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Robert, Toyed With in the Palm of the Hand
chapters.content:
At this very moment.
Robert endured the excruciating pain, grabbed the remaining knives from the kitchen counter, hurled them violently toward Jiang Ran, then bolted out the door.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
He was perfectly clear about his current situation.
He was no match for this Hua Country person before him.
If he didn't run now, he would absolutely die at his hands!!!
After Robert burst through the door, he heard footsteps following closely behind.
Because of this, he didn't dare take the elevator—waiting for it would give Jiang Ran enough time to catch up.
He could only sprint toward the emergency staircase at the far end of the hallway, running desperately downward.
He kept rushing down floor after floor.
Even though his shoulder had been slashed and blood flowed continuously, to Robert in his current state, this meant nothing.His speed descending the stairs reached truly extreme levels.
Jumping down multiple steps at once, he raced breathlessly from the 7th floor all the way to the 1st floor.
Just as he reached the 1st floor lobby, he slipped and fell hard.
Lying on the ground, he wiped his right hand across the floor and discovered why—the area around the staircase entrance was covered in slippery soapy water?
As he prepared to get up and continue fleeing, he lifted his head and saw Jiang Ran standing right in front of him.
The Jiang Ran before him appeared completely calm and unruffled.
None of the breathless exhaustion or extreme dishevelment that came from rushing downstairs.
"How is this possible? You came down faster than me?!" (in English)
Robert's face showed complete shock.
Jiang Ran merely sneered coldly: "You didn't take the elevator, but that doesn't mean I couldn't?"
Robert angrily punched the ground.
Jiang Ran said: "I only arrived slightly before you. I took the opportunity to use the cleaning supplies kept on the 1st floor to create this soapy water surface. I didn't actually expect you'd really slip and fall." (in English)
Jiang Ran continued: "While riding the elevator down just now, I reread your online biography that I found." (in English)
"The biography said you engaged in petty theft and robbery since childhood. Your first murder occurred after reaching adulthood—one night you broke into a 79-year-old grandmother's home to steal, but finding nothing valuable, you felt the trip was wasted. In your anger, you slit the old woman's throat with a knife. And what made me think I must be seeing things was that the biography said you actually engaged in necrophilia with her corpse." (in English)
Jiang Ran's tone rose at this point, clearly genuinely surprised.
"Seriously, and this was only your first murder case." (in English)
"Afterwards, similar cases became too numerous to count." (in English)
"I take back what I said earlier when I mocked you." (in English)
"I think that as a serial killer, while you became famous, your actual skill level really isn't much. If you don't rely on nighttime ambushes, your success rate becomes extremely low." (in English)
"But you truly are a deranged pervert, that's beyond doubt. Not even sparing a 79-year-old grandmother, and doing that after she was already dead." (in English)
"I've encountered many perverts, but you're definitely among the most extreme and disgusting." (in English)
"Given this, I'll reluctantly acknowledge you as a deranged serial killer! Of course, it's your perversion that earned you the points!" (in English)
"But as for being the so-called 'greatest serial killer in history'—you're not qualified." (in English)
Jiang Ran felt he was giving praise, but Robert certainly didn't see it that way.
He only felt humiliated.
From when he began committing crimes, except for finally being captured.
He had almost never failed or suffered losses.
Now, here he was suffering defeat and being mocked by his opponent.
This made him absolutely furious with rage.
He only wanted to kill the Jiang Ran before him.
Because of this, he climbed up from the ground and charged at Jiang Ran again, only to meet the same outcome—being kicked flying several meters away.
"I told you—without relying on nighttime ambushes, you're just garbage waiting for collection at the dump." (in English)
Robert received such insults but could do nothing against his opponent. He could only get up and run toward the apartment building's exit, passing through the glass automatic sensor doors.
He ran all the way toward the main gate where the security guard booth was located.
It seemed he had chosen to flee.
Just like back when, on the eve of his capture, Mike's girlfriend and two other male detectives had severely wounded him.
Then being discovered by a large crowd of concerned citizens nearby, he could only escape.
The only difference was.
Last time a whole crowd chased him, this time only one person pursued.
Jiang Ran also passed through the glass automatic sensor doors.
Unlike Robert's frantic escape after crossing through, he simply stood before the glass automatic doors.
Holding in his right hand the kitchen knife that had previously slashed Robert's shoulder.
Muttering under his breath: "1, 2, 3"
His body also took a throwing stance.
Then, the kitchen knife left his right hand.
Did it hit or miss?
Regardless, judging by Robert's agonized scream followed by collapsing to the ground, it presumably hit.
Across from Alice Apartment stood a tall hotel building.
After leaving Alice Apartment, Mike had been staying here, using extremely professional equipment to observe the entire front of Alice Apartment.
One could say that since checking into this tall hotel, he had worked day and night. Even when going out, he had a camera worth up to 110,000 Chinese yuan set up by his hotel room window, continuously recording.
And after leaving Alice Apartment, the daily deposits of 10,000 yuan that automatically appeared in his bank account around midnight had also stopped.
This further confirmed the accuracy of what Xiao Q and the other two had told him about the apartment's truth.
Because of this, Mike deeply understood that if he were Sun Wukong from the Hua Country novel "Journey to the West," then Alice Apartment was Buddha's Five Finger Mountain. No matter how powerful Sun Wukong was, he couldn't escape that seemingly small Five Finger Mountain. Therefore, he must keep his distance.
He couldn't fight against it.
If not for needing to kill Robert, he would have already left Nancheng City by now.
The Robert matter had become his inner demon.
If this matter remained unresolved, he would absolutely go mad.
Because now, whenever he closed his eyes, he saw his girlfriend's horrific condition from back then.
Finally, on this night, he had waited for Robert to appear.
However, what he saw through this 50,000 Chinese yuan super-powered night vision monocular telescope.
Left him deeply puzzled.
He could only catch glimpses of Robert flashing past hallway windows, then see Robert's figure again at the next floor's hallway window.
Having lived inside before, Mike knew the apartment's layout and understood Robert was descending the stairs, but why was he moving so quickly?
Chasing someone?
Or being chased?
Too little information available.
Mike thought it must be Robert chasing someone, because Robert definitely wasn't the type to be chased.
After all, Mike understood Robert's brutality—how much effort and cost had he, other detectives, and Maple Country's police force expended to capture this guy?
So many people including his girlfriend had sacrificed themselves for it.
Mike believed Robert's title as one of the world's top ten serial killers was well-deserved.
From Mike's perspective, this was indeed true.
But from Jiang Ran's perspective, aside from Robert's perversion being well-deserved, his skill level as a serial killer was too pathetic, merely mediocre.
Complete garbage.

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Mike Makes Another Appearance, Robert's Final Message Before Death
chapters.content:
Seeing Robert frantically descending the stairs, Mike didn't continue observing with his monocular telescope. Instead, he grabbed his equipment and rushed out of his room, heading toward the opposite Alice Apartment.
He feared that if he kept observing from here and delayed, he wouldn't know when the next opportunity would come.
During the time he rushed out of his room and headed toward the opposite building, Jiang Ran had already reached Robert's side.
Robert was in an extremely wretched state at this moment—lying face down on the ground with a sharp kitchen knife buried two-thirds deep into his back. Blood had soaked his entire back, creating a crimson patch.
"How pathetic, Robert."
Jiang Ran stepped on Robert's head with his foot, sneering contemptuously.
With his right cheek forced tightly against the ground, Robert kept cursing through his mouth: "Fuck! Fuck! Fuck!"
Jiang Ran said now: "Stop cursing. I'll send you off right now, send you straight to hell."
"After all, aren't you called the Disciple of the Devil? Perfect timing to reunite with those demons."
After speaking, Jiang Ran prepared to pull the kitchen knife out of Robert's back.Perhaps knowing death was approaching, Robert prepared for one final counterattack, a last desperate struggle.
His head jerked upward violently, but Jiang Ran applied pressure and brutally stomped it back down, creating a loud thud. Copious amounts of crimson blood seeped from the area where Robert's face had been pressed.
Robert's final death throes had failed.
But he refused to accept it—his hands and arms pushed against the ground as he tried to rise.
Jiang Ran simply granted his wish, releasing the foot on his head and allowing Robert to get up.
Just as Robert rose, Jiang Ran made his move.
He directly grabbed Robert's arms and legs, applying reverse force to snap them.
The cracking sound of twisting and shattering bones harmonized with Robert's screams, together composing Beethoven's First Symphony.
With both arms and legs broken, Robert could only helplessly collapse to the ground, unable to stand again.
This was composing music with life itself! How magnificent!
Robert would definitely become a great musician!
"You're extremely lucky, Robert. You met me—I don't particularly enjoy torturing opponents. If you had encountered my other personalities, especially those few I consider truly perverted personalities, you would have died in unbearable agony. However, only one of those genuinely perverted personalities has emerged so far, and he encountered that clown. Even his method of dealing with the clown wasn't particularly perverted or cruel—not up to his usual style."
Robert at this moment had already been punched multiple times by Jiang Ran all over his body, then slashed in the shoulder, stabbed in the back, and now had both arms and legs broken.
The pain was so overwhelming that he couldn't focus on Jiang Ran's rambling.
But he knew one thing: he was about to die.
Because he could already see Jiang Ran smiling while holding that kitchen knife now stained with his blood.
And was gesturing with it toward him.
"Jiang Ran!"
Facing imminent death, Robert showed no fear. Instead, he revealed a maniacal expression:
"What's death? Hahaha, Jiang Ran! I'm just arriving at Disneyland before you! I'll be waiting for you there!"
Maniacal, insane.
Somewhat handsome narrow cheekbones.
Broken, blackened teeth. Demon-like curly black hair.
"Sorry, I never go to that place—tickets are too expensive. Didn't go while alive, definitely won't go after death."
Jiang Ran sneered.
With those words, he used the kitchen knife to slit Robert's throat.
After removing the knife, blood gushed wildly from Robert's neck. His constantly laughing mouth choked on blood until he could no longer laugh.
More and more blood emerged—perhaps Robert would die from suffocation first.
After confirming Robert's inevitable death, Jiang Ran turned and left. As for disposing of the body?
Based purely on his currently integrated memories of the apartment as a starting point for deduction, it was completely unnecessary.
Someone would help him.
He walked to the front of the apartment building, looking up at this structure.
Somewhat curiously, he said: "What organization is behind this apartment building anyway? To create such an interesting place?"
"You're extremely lucky, Robert. You met me—I don't particularly enjoy torturing opponents. If you had encountered my other personalities, especially those few I consider truly twisted personalities, you would have died in unbearable agony. However, only one of those genuinely twisted personalities has emerged so far, and he encountered the clown. Even his method of dealing with the clown wasn't particularly twisted or cruel—not up to his usual style."
Jiang Ran now held his head, his face showing a trace of pain.
"These personalities... without suppression, they want to emerge again..."
...
Mike arrived outside the main entrance of Alice Apartment and directly passed through facial recognition, which surprised him—his facial recognition hadn't been canceled yet.
After passing through the main gate, he immediately spotted a figure lying alone in a pool of blood some distance ahead!
And a dark silhouette with its back turned to him was entering the apartment building and getting into the elevator.
"Robert! You've killed another person! Damn beast!"
Without even thinking, Mike knew Robert had taken another innocent life.
So the moment he saw this scene, he started running.
While passing by that struggling figure on the ground...
Mike, who had originally intended to chase the silhouette in the elevator, suddenly stopped.
After stopping, Mike first stared at the figure on the ground, then turned to look at the silhouette that had disappeared into the elevator.
Back and forth several times.
Facing imminent death, Robert showed no fear. Instead, he revealed a maniacal expression:
What? The one lying on the ground is Robert?!
Then who was that silhouette in the elevator?!
Forget it, never mind—as long as Robert is here, that's what matters since he's the target.
Maniacal, insane.
Robert wasn't dead yet, just dying.
Hearing the voice reaching his ears, his eyeballs strained to move toward the corners of his eyes.
He saw that familiar Caucasian face.
He mumbled excitedly, blood spraying wildly from his mouth.
"Hahaha! You've come to this too? You got killed by someone else too?!"
Though Robert was near death, Mike didn't let him off.
He directly stepped on Robert's abdomen and chest with both feet.
Jiang Ran sneered.
With each jump, more blood gushed from Robert's slit throat and mouth.
"Damn you! You really deserve this! Go die! You beast! Go to hell!"
Mike's eyes blazed with fury, curses pouring out continuously.
Even after Robert had died, Mike continued jumping up and down for several more minutes.
After confirming Robert's death, Mike, like Jiang Ran, turned and left.
Jiang Ran relied on memory integration and his own speculation that someone would handle the body for him.
But Mike had personally witnessed plenty of cleanup crews.
So he left directly too.
Of course, before leaving, he took numerous photos of Robert with his phone.
He planned to develop all these photos, then return to Maple Country and burn them at his fiancée's grave.
Naturally, he now had an even more important matter—returning to his room in the high-rise hotel to check the camera he'd set up at the window to see what exactly had happened before he arrived at Alice Apartment, and who that silhouette belonged to!
When he returned to his room in the high-rise hotel and finished reviewing the footage of Jiang Ran and Robert leaving the apartment building...ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
He remained silent for a long time.
Finally, he uttered one sentence:
"I need to leave right now. I'm never coming back to Alice Apartment again."
Having experienced major storms and challenges, few things truly frightened Mike.
His fiancée's death counted as one—he feared her death, her departure from him.
This matter now counted as another.
He couldn't imagine that Robert was actually the one being pursued.
And that the person pursuing him was someone he'd met before who seemed quite normal.
Though he knew the guy had dissociative identity disorder.
He'd seen many people with dissociative identity disorder, including criminals among them.
But he'd never seen anyone who treated a serial killer of Robert's caliber like a puppy to be manipulated...

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Main Personality and Alternate Personalities
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran returned to Room 704, Wang Anjian's home.
Entering the bedroom, he found Wang Anjian still unconscious, so Jiang Ran sat on the bed.
He sat for two minutes, his brows furrowed for the same two minutes.
Finally, he sighed deeply within his heart: "I still need to sever those so-called evil memories, transform them into a separate personality, and suppress all other personalities. Otherwise, during this period, I clearly feel my body becoming unstable again. Those guys want to emerge again."
After speaking.
Jiang Ran suddenly fell backward, collapsing unconscious onto the bed.
Every dissociative identity disorder patient experiences their condition differently.
For example, what makes Jiang Ran different from other dissociative identity disorder patients is this:
In his mind, there seems to be an inner landscape world—you could say it's imagined, or you could say it truly exists.
Currently, everything around is pitch black, and Jiang Ran is floating outside a sphere of light.Within this sphere of light.
Lies a small town.
This town resembles real-world small towns.
The only distinguishing feature is that this town looks very much like those in white-majority developed countries like America.
One villa after another.
Some villas stand empty, while others are occupied.
On the town's streets, people are strolling.
And these appearing people share one common trait:
They all look exactly identical.
These are all Jiang Ran's alternate personalities.
They all live within this small town.
Currently, in the darkness outside this sphere of light, Jiang Ran floats around its periphery, only able to gaze longingly at everything inside.
After he severed his evil memories and transformed them into a personality, its sole task became watching over these personalities, preventing them from leaving this small town.
Of course, there are too many personalities, so sometimes the personality formed from evil memories can't monitor them all—this requires Jiang Ran in the real world to take medication.
Like the garbage medicine Jiang Ran took after transmigrating here—after taking it, it could make one or two personalities fall into prolonged sleep within their villas.
The drug efficacy is too weak, and the physical body in reality clearly experiences side effects, equivalent to drug backlash.
Whereas the medicine Wang Qingzhao provided, after taking it, not only has minimal side effects,
But can also make five or six personalities fall into deep sleep.
Moreover, these five or six personalities differ from the one or two managed by the previous medicine.
Personalities have strength distinctions.
The previous medicine could only manage weak, so-called lower-level personalities.
But this American medicine can manage strong, so-called higher-level personalities.
"Unfortunately, I cannot enter this sphere of light. Otherwise, I could directly forcibly erase all these alternate personalities, and wouldn't need to sever so many memories, just keeping the good memories to control the body."
Someone once proposed a viewpoint.
Two people: Zhang San and Li Si.
Completely erase Li Si's memories.
Transfer all of Zhang San's memories into Li Si's brain.
Then, the question is:
Currently, is this person Li Si or Zhang San?
If you say he's still Li Si, yet Li Si's memories are all gone.
Zhang San's memories remain—he only remembers being Zhang San.
If you say he's Zhang San, yet his body is Li Si's—Zhang San is just a segment of memory.
Another interesting thing:
This time it's Wang Wu.
Wang Wu is 20 years old this year, an adult.
But if you erase all Wang Wu's memories from age 11 to 20,
Leaving only memories from age 10 and earlier,
Then Wang Wu will transform from someone with adult thinking back to his 10-year-old self.
If you ask him how old he is, he'll only say he's 10. Still a child.
Memory is magical.
Jiang Ran currently experiences this.
But his situation is even more peculiar,
But his situation is even more peculiar,
"Eh, wait, my hand..."
Suddenly, Jiang Ran—who originally only intended to touch this sphere of light before preparing to sever memories—unexpectedly discovered his hand could actually pass through.
Unlike before, where an invisible wind wall blocked him.
Next, he tried his other hand and found it could also pass through.
He became ecstatic with joy, then proceeded with other body parts—all... successful!
And when his entire body passed through, Jiang Ran's expression transformed from surprised delight to a sinister, terrifying smile.
Within the small town of the inner landscape world.
At the town's very center stands a fountain statue.
The statue depicts Jiang Ran wearing a Western suit, carved from white marble.
Beside the fountain stand three people.
Although all three share the same face.
Their clothing and styles differ completely.
The first has sky-blue dyed hair, very trendy hairstyle with exposed forehead.
Wearing extremely fashionable, expensive-looking clothing.
The second has black shoulder-length hair flowing like a heavenly waterfall.
Three thousand black strands cannot sever the root of troubles.
Three thousand black strands cannot sever the root of troubles.
Wearing heavy makeup.
By Jiang Ran's own aesthetic standards.
This would absolutely be a beautiful woman, despite the makeup.
But who doesn't wear makeup these days?
The third dresses similarly to Jiang Ran in the real world.
Normal and ordinary.
This third person is chattering incessantly to the other two, complaining.
What is he complaining about?
"You have no idea—I finally got to go out, only to end up cleaning up after the main personality, but I didn't even have the ability to do it! That foreigner Robert hit me twice, made me vomit bile, then choked me until I suffocated! Do you understand how that feels?!"
So this third person is the alternate personality recently pulled out by the system for 1000 points.
"Isn't it just because you're too weak? If it were my turn, whatever world's top ten serial killers would be nothing but clay chickens and pottery dogs."
The first blue-haired Jiang Ran spoke with extreme confidence.
He added another sentence: "But nowadays, going out means being forcibly pulled out by that system thing, then forcibly pulled back after solving problems—not very interesting."
"Still better than that time on Earth though."
"During that Earth period, we could initially seize the body, but later, the main personality split his own memories, and the severed memories transformed into new personalities that constantly watch us—no chance to go out anymore."
As blue-haired Jiang Ran spoke, he looked toward the ancient-dress female Jiang Ran beside him: "Hey, didn't you go out last time too? Why no comments?"
The ancient-dress female Jiang Ran covered her mouth with a light laugh: "This humble woman has nothing to comment. After all, no matter what I say, I cannot go out and control the body for extended periods."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran now continuously stroked his neck with his left hand:ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Pity the main personality isn't in this small town—he can't enter. Otherwise, if he were here, we could collectively erase him."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran's eyes revealed a fierce intensity.
"Is that so? If the main personality enters, you'll immediately erase him? So ruthless? Have you considered that the main personality's inability to enter might actually be protecting you in disguise?"
A sudden voice.
After hearing it, blue-haired Jiang Ran turned toward the sound source and said disdainfully: "Protection in disguise? Who here needs protection? If he dares enter, I'll be the first to erase him!"
After speaking, blue-haired Jiang Ran saw his exact duplicate—Jiang Ran with a sinister cold smile on his face—walking toward him step by step.
As the distance closed, blue-haired Jiang Ran's eye twitched, his entire body trembling uncontrollably.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Wang Anjian's Request
chapters.content:
Then after three seconds, the blue-haired Jiang Ran turned and ran.
Seeing the blue-haired Jiang Ran flee.
The ancient-dress female Jiang Ran and normally-dressed Jiang Ran beside him found it very strange.
But when they turned around and saw Jiang Ran with that sinister cold smile.
They immediately realized why the blue-haired Jiang Ran was running.
Because they needed to run immediately too.
As the ancient-dress female Jiang Ran and normally-dressed Jiang Ran started running simultaneously, something completely unexpected happened at that moment.
The ancient-dress female Jiang Ran kicked the normally-dressed Jiang Ran, causing him to fall face-first into the dirt. By the time he got up again, the ancient-dress female Jiang Ran had already run far away.
Meanwhile, his own neck was being tightly gripped by the main personality Jiang Ran.
The normally-dressed Jiang Ran wanted to resist, but against the main personality Jiang Ran, he stood absolutely no chance.He immediately burst into tears: "Spare me! I don't want to die yet!"
The main personality Jiang Ran coldly smiled: "Sorry, that's not up to you."
The normally-dressed Jiang Ran cried out: "Killing me is useless! I'm so weak, I can't cause you any trouble, and I won't fight you for control of the body! You should kill those other two! Or the other ones!"
The main personality Jiang Ran said: "You just had the bad luck to cross my path. Don't worry, after I kill you, I'll go kill the others. Once I eliminate all of you, I'll be completely free!"
"None of you will escape!"
With these words, the main personality Jiang Ran's other hand also gripped the normally-dressed Jiang Ran's neck.
Both hands applied force simultaneously.
The normally-dressed Jiang Ran's face instantly turned deep red, redder than a blushing young girl.
As the main personality Jiang Ran continued applying pressure with both hands.
The normally-dressed Jiang Ran's body gradually became transparent at visible speed, disappearing.
Though nearing death, the normally-dressed Jiang Ran didn't hate the main personality, because if he were the main personality, he would do the same.
After all, who would want a bunch of alternate personalities fighting for control of their body?
As for earlier when he said he wouldn't fight the main personality for control, that was pure nonsense.
Of course he wanted to fight for control, but he was too weak to succeed...
Additionally, while he didn't particularly hate the main personality, he exceptionally hated the ancient-dress female Jiang Ran who had kicked him. If not for that kick, he wouldn't have been caught so easily.
"I won't let you off even as a ghost!"
The normally-dressed Jiang Ran uttered a vicious curse before dying.
It was unclear whether this curse was directed at the main personality Jiang Ran or the one who kicked him.
But judging from overall behavior, it was aimed at both.
Unfortunately, such curses are the most powerless kind.
The normally-dressed Jiang Ran's body completely vanished.
This meant that in this inner landscape world, there was one less alternate personality. Regardless of his strength, this was good news for the main personality Jiang Ran.
Just as he prepared to search for the next alternate personality.
The main personality Jiang Ran suddenly discovered his body involuntarily floating upward.
He floated uncontrollably, and within seconds, he had floated outside the small town.
Just like before, he could only watch the town within this landscape from the outside.
The main personality Jiang Ran reached out to touch, wanting to enter this landscape like before, but that wind wall that had previously disappeared had returned.
"What's going on?!"
The main personality Jiang Ran thought for a while but couldn't figure it out.
Eventually, he simply stopped thinking about it.
He began cutting off all so-called evil memories.
The evil memories transformed into a new personality, and as this new personality's body disappeared, it formed a black shroud that enveloped the entire town landscape.
...
"Ouch, my head hurts so much!"
Jiang Ran woke up in bed at this moment.
He was shocked to discover he was lying on Wang Anjian's bedroom bed?
While Wang Anjian was lying on the floor?
Even more surprising, why was there blood on his clothes?!
He tried to recall.
But when the system let other personalities take control of the body, he wouldn't remember the period just before they took over.
He also didn't have memories from when alternate personalities controlled his body.
So Jiang Ran now only remembered arriving at Room 704, seeing Wang Anjian collapsed by the door, and then encountering Robert.
What happened after that, he couldn't remember.
Though he couldn't recall, looking at the blood on his clothes, the mess in the bedroom, and going out to the living room to find even more chaos in Room 704's living area - most absurdly, a fruit knife stuck in the wall and a kitchen knife on the floor - he could deduce what had happened.
Probably Robert tried to kill him, and then his other personalities emerged again.
Yes, that must be it. After all, Robert had given danger warnings before. While Wang Anjian hadn't.
As for where Robert was now that he was still alive?
Jiang Ran felt this wasn't something he needed to worry about - the alternate personalities should handle it properly.
Jiang Ran returned to the bedroom and carried Wang Anjian from the floor back to the bed.
As he picked up Wang Anjian, the man grimaced and woke up, probably because Jiang Ran had touched injured parts of his body while carrying him.
Wang Anjian now lay in bed, having just opened his eyes. Despite his weakened condition, he tried to sit up, but the pain in his spine immediately forced him back down.
He anxiously turned his head toward the figure by the bed.
Seeing Jiang Ran standing there perfectly fine, he immediately relaxed.
Then, not seeing the white man who had been choking Jiang Ran, he felt confused.
But later, noticing the large bloodstains on the front of Jiang Ran's clothes.
He stared blankly for a moment, probably realizing something.
Feeling that he himself was near death, he decided it didn't matter who lived or died between Jiang Ran and the white man.
Therefore, he didn't ask about that matter.
Moreover, he felt Jiang Ran had been in the right in that situation, so pretending to understand while playing dumb was best.
Seeing Wang Anjian awake, Jiang Ran directly asked: "Wang Anjian, what did you call me here to help you with? Do you need me to take you to the hospital?"
Although he had lost some memories.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Seeing the bedroom's condition, especially the nightstand with its pulled-out drawer and all the medicine bottles and boxes, Jiang Ran immediately sensed that Wang Anjian must have a very serious illness.
Wang Anjian shook his head and said: "Not to take me to the hospital. I have a very important matter that I need you to handle for me."
Jiang Ran: "Go ahead."
Wang Anjian sighed deeply at this moment: "I have cancer, and I'm dying. I expect it will be within these next few days."
"I don't have many relatives or friends - I'm an orphan. So after I die, I want you to handle my body."
"Of course, there's payment. I still have about 5000 in my phone, I'll transfer it all to you later."
"Uh..."
Jiang Ran never expected that Wang Anjian had called him for something like this.
After all, previously at the welcome party and the matchmaking event, Wang Anjian had seemed quite healthy.
"Cancer... aren't you going to the hospital for treatment?"
Jiang Ran asked.
Wang Anjian: "No point. It was already terminal when discovered. Even with treatment, at most I could only extend my life a bit longer."
"So, Jiang Ran, please help me."
"I don't want to die with nobody knowing, my body rotting and stinking in this apartment."
"Of course, I don't care personally - once I'm dead, you could feed my body to dogs for all I care."
"But leaving the body here would cause trouble for you apartment staff members, so please help me."

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Wang Anjian Passes Away
chapters.content:
Wang Anjian had 5,000 yuan left from the 10,000 he received today, having only spent half of it.
The remaining half was meant for handling his own funeral arrangements.
Faced with Wang Anjian's sincere plea.
Jiang Ran ultimately couldn't bear to refuse, saying: "You don't need to give me 5,000, just cover the cremation costs or similar expenses."
"As for the rest, buy yourself something you'd like to eat or something you want to spend it on!"
Jiang Ran was also a good person, at least currently - the complete version of Jiang Ran definitely wasn't, and wouldn't do such things even if paid.
"By the way, if you really die, after I take you to the crematorium and you're cremated, where should I bury your ashes?"
"Have you already bought a grave plot in advance?"
Although this question seemed somewhat impolite, almost like cursing someone to die quickly, it was an unavoidable practical matter.
Wang Anjian smiled bitterly: "Who has money for a grave plot! Just scatter my ashes into that big river in our Nancheng City! Whatever you do, don't send me to some place that stores ashes. I don't want to be locked in a small compartment after death. I want to follow that big river, free and unrestrained..."The conversation grew increasingly sorrowful.
Jiang Ran sighed deeply and somewhat helplessly plopped down on the floor.
Who would have thought that coming up here would involve something like this.
Helping a stranger handle their remains and funeral arrangements - this was his first time doing something like this.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room.
Viewers were still immersed in the aftermath of Robert's death.
The Ultimate Rich Kid was cursing fiercely: 【What kind of bullshit is this 'one of the world's top ten serial killers'?! Trash Robert! Getting toyed with by Jiang Ran like he was a child! Worthless garbage! And that idiot Mike! After all that, he didn't even go far - he actually came back! Well now, he doesn't even need to get revenge himself! Jiang Ran got revenge for him! He just came back to kick a few times!!!】
Mike's early departure had screwed over many people who bet on him.
Including the Ultimate Rich Kid, Diamond Bachelor, and others.
If he had just left completely and never appeared in the stream again.
That would have been one thing.
But then they saw him return.
Wasn't this like stabbing all the people who bet on him right in the heart?
Mike was getting cursed out pretty badly.
So was Robert.
Those two choking opportunities were perfect chances to finish off Jiang Ran.
But he didn't take them.
Had to show off, had to play around, had to leave the opponent with just enough breath for a comeback.
When a weak alternate personality emerged, you didn't finish him off.
Then later, an insanely strong personality showed up, and well, you got yourself killed, Robert.
These live stream viewers had no idea that Robert's second chokehold had actually already killed Jiang Ran, but Jiang Ran had his system...
Of course, they knew even less that this so-called insanely strong personality was actually the complete, true main personality Jiang Ran.
They thought this incredibly strong presence was just another alternate personality.
Many were cursing Robert out.
Mainly because his reputation was so enormous.
But when they saw him in action, it was like: "That's it? Nothing special."
Did he buy that reputation with money?
Well, it's still that issue of comparison and perspective.
From Mike's perspective, Robert seemed extremely vicious - if Mike faced him alone, life or death would be uncertain.
If these two were opponents, regardless of who ultimately won, you could see both were strong.
But when Robert faced Jiang Ran, it was completely like bullying a beginner.
So it made Robert's title of "one of the world's top ten serial killers" seem like it was bought with money...
The one cursing Robert the most was definitely Diamond Bachelor, but she wasn't doing it in the live stream.
She was doing it in real life.
After all, Robert was someone she used her number one privilege to bring here, and this was the result?
Diamond Bachelor's rage was greater than ever before.
Not only did she smash up her princess room again, she ran out of it and wrecked the living room of her luxury villa too.
This insane, violent scene scared the middle-aged maid and other servants who always attended to her, making them hide far away, not daring to approach.
Her long hair flew about like a witch's.
As time passed, discussions about Robert and Mike decreased.
Now the focus returned to Jiang Ran and Wang Anjian.
Regarding Jiang Ran, they discussed how his later-emerging personality actually spoke English, which surprised many in the live stream room.
Then the conversation turned to Wang Anjian and who would be the final winner of this round.
Middle-aged Uncle: 【If Wang Anjian can make it through tomorrow, then the final winners of this round will be Jiang Ran and him. Those who bet on them will get to split the money.】
Middle-aged Uncle was quite pleased now, since Jiang Ran had survived the Robert ordeal.
Barring any extremely unexpected events, this round would end safely again.
So satisfying!
Fairy Sister: 【I hope Wang Anjian can live a few more days! Honestly, Wang Anjian is truly a good person.】
【He's actually worried that after he dies, no one will know and his body will rot and stink, causing trouble for the apartment staff. Really, sigh! It's too bad his condition has reached the point where money can't cure it! Otherwise I'd want to pay for his treatment!!!】
Little Dragon Girl: 【Actually, have you noticed that Jiang Ran is also a very good person.】
Little Aunt: 【I can see that, he's actually always been a good person! Back when he helped the old man in Room 301, patiently cleaning up, and now hearing Wang Anjian's request, he only wants to charge cremation costs and doesn't even want payment for his own effort, telling Wang Anjian to spend the money on himself!】
Domineering Female CEO: 【Unfortunately, good people tend to have pretty bad luck in this society. Think about it - if Jiang Ran weren't a dissociative identity disorder patient with those incredibly strong alternate personalities, he would have died long ago. And he's different from Wang Anjian too - he entered the apartment through a lottery draw. If he really died, his death would be even more unjust, and his daily 10,000 yuan still hasn't been issued yet... It's paid monthly, but I estimate it should be coming soon!】
...
Round 27, Day 7, 8:00 AM.
After waking up, Jiang Ran immediately messaged Wang Anjian.
Asking how he was feeling.
Jiang Ran cared about him for several reasons: first, he was a cancer patient.
Second, Jiang Ran learned during the welcome party that Wang Anjian had been a volunteer teacher.
Third, last night he learned Wang Anjian had few friends or relatives, and was an orphan like himself.
So he felt sympathy.
But after Jiang Ran finished washing up and eating breakfast, he still hadn't received a reply from Wang Anjian.
A sense of foreboding rose in his heart, and somewhat apprehensively, he took the key Wang Anjian had given him last night.
He went to Room 704.
Entering Room 704, the apartment was quiet, as if no one was there.
Seeing this, Jiang Ran's feeling of unease grew stronger.
When he reached the bedroom and saw Wang Anjian lying quietly in bed under the covers.
Jiang Ran strode over and called Wang Anjian's name softly several times.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Wang Anjian's eyes remained closed.
Jiang Ran extended his right hand to check Wang Anjian's breathing - there was none.
He felt his neck - no pulse.
As if refusing to believe it, Jiang Ran called out several more times loudly and shook him several times.
Wang Anjian still didn't wake up, and when Jiang Ran touched Wang Anjian's arm, he found it ice cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Unlucky Jiang Ran, Running Into Dangerous People Everywhere
chapters.content:
Even though he knew Wang Anjian wouldn't live much longer, someone who had been speaking and interacting with him just last night could no longer converse with him today.
Jiang Ran still felt somewhat dazed.
He remained in this dazed state for about half an hour.
Jiang Ran knew it was time to handle the matters Wang Anjian had entrusted to him.
Since Wang Anjian had died in the apartment, he definitely needed to inform Manager Xiao Zhang.
After making the phone call.
Manager Xiao Zhang came up to check, then told Jiang Ran to handle Wang Anjian's body.
While he stayed behind to deal with Wang Anjian's affairs in the apartment.
Next, with Manager Xiao Zhang's assistance, Wang Anjian's body was handled very quickly and smoothly.
First, they called 120, and after the emergency personnel arrived, they confirmed Wang Anjian's death.Afterward, they went to the nearby community health service center to obtain the "Death Certificate."
Then, they took Wang Anjian's ID card, household registration booklet, death certificate, and other documents to the police station to cancel his household registration.
Whether Wang Anjian had anticipated this or not, when Jiang Ran left last night, there had only been medicine boxes and bottles on the bedside table.
But when he went in the morning, all of Wang Anjian's personal belongings were placed there.
Including that cell phone.
It was only because of this that they could smoothly complete these necessary procedures after someone's death.
After all these matters were handled.
Jiang Ran prepared to cremate Wang Anjian's body.
He contacted the funeral home, which sent a vehicle to collect Wang Anjian's body. After arriving at the funeral home, he simply asked the staff to tidy up Wang Anjian's appearance.
After completing these tasks, Wang Anjian was pushed in for cremation.
During the cremation process, Jiang Ran sat in the waiting area outside.
He continuously watched the television mounted on the wall, which displayed the list of deceased being cremated.
Names, genders, ages, cremation furnaces, and so on.
Wang Anjian was on the list, shown as currently being cremated.
Jiang Ran chose a mid-priced cremation furnace for him.
This funeral home had three types of cremation furnaces: standard, premium, and deluxe.
Hah, even the cremation furnaces used after death were divided into different grades.
Jiang Ran also noticed something: currently on television, Wang Anjian wasn't the youngest deceased person. The youngest was only 5 years old.
Indeed, it confirmed a recently popular saying:
People don't only die when they get old;
they can die at any time, anywhere.
At this thought, Jiang Ran shuddered violently.
After the cremation ended, Jiang Ran successfully collected Wang Anjian's ashes.
Now, looking at Wang Anjian's white ashes contained in the urn.
Jiang Ran still felt a sense of loss and remained somewhat dazed.
A perfectly good person had now been reduced to this.
During his dazed state, funeral home staff approached Jiang Ran to promote different ash disposal methods.
The options included ash halls and ash walls. Both involved placing the urn in a small compartment space, essentially similar.
Then there was: burial.
Or scattering ashes at sea.
Jiang Ran declined by saying he had already purchased a cemetery, and only then did the funeral home staff leave him alone.
Following Wang Anjian's instructions.
Jiang Ran took a taxi directly to the big river Wang Anjian had mentioned.
This was indeed a big river.
Several nearby provinces relied on this great river for irrigation.
Jiang Ran walked to the riverbank, and seeing no one around, he opened the urn and began scattering the ashes.
He didn't take shortcuts by dumping all of Wang Anjian's ashes into the river at one spot.
Instead, he walked along the broad riverbank, scattering them as he went.
While scattering, Jiang Ran's mind was filled with images of Wang Anjian lying in bed talking with him last night.
When most ashes were scattered, a small amount remained in the urn.
Jiang Ran decided to scatter these around the central area of the river rather than along the bank.
He found an old man nearby.
The old man appeared to be in his sixties.
He had been sitting in a pavilion he built himself by the river, with three small boats in front of him.
Most of the three small boats were on the riverbank.
Jiang Ran asked the old man if he could take him to the river's center.
The old man demanded 100 yuan.
Jiang Ran thought it was expensive, and the old man didn't use smartphones, only accepting cash.
After negotiation, the old man said he'd take 50 yuan and let Jiang Ran row the boat himself.
Jiang Ran searched his entire body but only found 35 yuan. The old man reluctantly agreed.
The old man first got into the boat, saying he needed to install oars on the boat Jiang Ran would use.
Jiang Ran waited on the bank, gazing at the endless river scenery.
Honestly, this river really felt like an ocean - boundless, with large and small cargo ships visible traveling in the distance.
Of course, what concerned Jiang Ran most right now was actually this old man.
Because from the moment he met this old man.
The Danger Warning System began alerting:
[Ding! Detected dangerous person, please distance yourself quickly! Points +1! Points +1! Points...]
Although it was the lowest score, it was still a danger warning that required caution.
Originally, Jiang Ran had planned to see if anyone else nearby had boats, but this old man was the only one.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
So, he had no choice.
This was also why he initially wanted to row alone rather than have the old man row for him.
Fortunately, the old man asked for too much money, so he could use this as an excuse.
This was being cautious and maintaining vigilance!
After the old man installed the oars, Jiang Ran boarded the boat.
Jiang Ran knew how to row but didn't know how to swim.
Jiang Ran's rowing skills were quite good. After rowing to relatively outer waters.
He looked down at the unfathomably deep river, reached into the water with one hand, and soon his upper arm was submerged before he pulled it out.
This feeling was actually somewhat terrifying.
Because you couldn't touch the bottom, which was utterly despairing for someone who couldn't swim.
It felt like the water was devouring your body.
Setting these thoughts aside, Jiang Ran began scattering Wang Anjian's final ashes.
He said many blessings to Wang Anjian, essentially wishing him peace and happiness in his next life, free from illness and disaster.
After scattering all the ashes, Jiang Ran simply threw the urn into the big river.
After completing everything, he prepared to row back to shore.
But just at that moment, he discovered something wrong with the boat.
The boat was leaking!!!
Jiang Ran found the source of the leak - a hole in the bow area.
This hole had been patched with mud.
Jiang Ran suddenly remembered why the boat hadn't been fully floating in the river earlier, but rather with its bow and most of its body on the bank.
After being on shore for so long, the mud had dried. After entering the water, it turned into wet mud. The longer it soaked, the more mud was washed away by water, until the hole opened...
"Damn it!"
Jiang Ran rushed to the bow. Without time to think about anything else, he tried to block the hole, only to find it impossible to stop. He took off his outer clothing and stuffed it in the hole, but it was immediately washed out.
Soon, most of the boat was underwater.
Jiang Ran was extremely anxious. Just then, he glanced toward the shore and saw the old man rowing toward him.
Jiang Ran felt he needed to hold on!
So he ran to the stern, determined to endure for even one more minute!

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Jiang Ran: I Don’t Eat Beef
chapters.content:
Soon, Jiang Ran's boat had completely sunk.
Jiang Ran was quite lucky - he had just fallen into the water when the old man's boat approached him.
"Old man! Save me!"
Jiang Ran desperately called out to the old man for help. He couldn't swim, so his entire body struggled fiercely to stay afloat.
Each time he struggled downward, he would gulp a mouthful of water.
The old man rowed his boat closer to Jiang Ran.
He took an unused oar from the boat, holding one end himself while extending the other end toward Jiang Ran.
With an anxious expression, he said, "Young man! Grab it quickly!"
The wooden oar extended toward him was like a lifeline.
Jiang Ran's right hand desperately reached forward.Just when he was about centimeters away from grabbing the oar and surviving.
Suddenly, the old man's previously anxious expression vanished.
It was replaced by a sinister smile.
He pulled the oar away, then swung it downward, striking Jiang Ran's right hand that was reaching for the oar.
The blow made Jiang Ran cry out in pain.
He desperately screamed for help.
Unfortunately, aside from him and this old man, was there anyone else around?
Soon, Jiang Ran, who couldn't swim, gradually sank and was swallowed by the endless river water.
Until the moment he was drowned alive, Jiang Ran never understood why this old man wanted to harm him!
"Young man, don't blame your elder. This is how I make money. I was planning to retire, but my son needs to get married!!!"
The old man's words were full of helplessness, but his expression and body language clearly showed excitement.
It turned out this old man had been a corpse fisher since his youth.
He specialized in retrieving drowned bodies from the water to make money.
Of course, to make big money in this business, one needed to be ruthless.
Just like what this old man was doing now.
