Intentionally causing people to drown, then fishing out their bodies afterward.
He didn't see anything wrong with it - his colleagues did the same.
As for whether these corpse fishers would save someone who accidentally fell into the water?
Heh, what do you think?
Child, don't be naive.
Saving you gets a thank you.
Not saving you gets a large sum of money.
"About time, I should go down now."
After waiting a few minutes on the boat, the old man prepared to dive in and retrieve Jiang Ran's drowned body, then call the police and notify Jiang Ran's family.
Finally, he would collect the corpse retrieval fee from Jiang Ran's family.
Just as the old man was stretching and one leg had already entered the water.
Suddenly, from beneath the water, a pale hand shot out, firmly grabbing the edge of the old man's boat.
The five fingers showed prominent blue veins.
Clearly exerting tremendous force.
The old man was stunned for a moment, then within seconds, he immediately grabbed an oar to beat this hand away.
"Hey, you kid, you're really tenacious!"
The old man swung the oar and struck the pale hand hard.
After hitting it, to the old man's surprise, the hand remained completely motionless, not retracting due to pain at all.
At that moment, another hand reached up and grabbed the boat's edge.
A trace of fear appeared on the old man's face.
He struck with the oar again, but the previous hand still clung tightly to the boat's edge.
Seeing this, the old man wondered if he had encountered something supernatural?
If it were a person, they would definitely let go after being hit twice!
The old man became somewhat afraid. Although he had never encountered anything supernatural in his lifelong career, other colleagues said they had.
They all said it was extremely eerie!
Thump!
A sudden sound.
Next, something happened that made the old man both happy and distressed.
Happy because the hands gripping the boat edge immediately pulled a person up from the water.
Not the supernatural entity he had imagined.
Distressed because the person emerging was actually that young man from before!
The old man wanted to use the oar to drive Jiang Ran away, preventing him from boarding, but Jiang Ran had already agilely climbed aboard before he could strike.
After boarding, Jiang Ran, completely drenched, pushed aside the bangs on his forehead.
His eyes revealed murderous intent.
He shouted at the old man, "You damn old man, trying to drown me?! Looks like you're tired of living!"
After shouting, Jiang Ran strode purposefully toward the old man.
The old man had done too many wicked deeds over the years.
He had experienced situations where he failed to drown someone and faced direct confrontation and revenge.
As long as it wasn't something supernatural, he wasn't afraid at all.
He swung the oar downward toward Jiang Ran's head, intending to knock him out and throw him back into the water.
The old man was quite physically fit, with thick arms that looked quite powerful.
But this powerful oar strike was easily dodged by Jiang Ran.
After dodging, Jiang Ran closed in on the old man, first slapping his face, leaving the old man stunned.
Five clear red finger marks appeared.
Then Jiang Ran kicked the old man into the river.
The old man, being in this profession, definitely knew how to swim.
And he was an excellent swimmer.
So once in the water, the old man was like a fish returned to the sea.
Even though he was kicked in, he desperately swam toward the shore.
Seeing this, Jiang Ran sneered coldly, stood at the stern, and using the oar the old man had dropped on the boat, aimed for the head of the old man who hadn't yet escaped attack range.
The old man definitely had extremely good mental composure - he didn't panic and lose all caution while escaping.
Instead, he kept watching Jiang Ran on the boat. Seeing him use the oar to strike, he immediately dove completely underwater.
Thus, Jiang Ran's oar strike missed, only hitting the water surface and creating a large splash.
"Damn you, still trying to run?!"
Jiang Ran was also ruthless, directly entering the water and diving after the old man.
The old man was somewhat surprised that Jiang Ran dared to enter the water.
He immediately stopped fleeing, instead sneering coldly as he waited for Jiang Ran.
He said, "Heh, in our village, if I claim to be second best in swimming, no one dares claim first! You young man! Coming to your death, don't blame me!!"
The old man waited for Jiang Ran.
The two immediately engaged in close combat underwater, throwing punches that landed solidly.
Soon, the previously arrogant old man who thought Jiang Ran was seeking death by entering his comfort zone began begging for mercy: "Young man! Stop hitting! Spare my life!"
"I have elderly parents above and young children below! My old mother still depends on me! My son isn't married yet! He's already over thirty!"
"Also, I have a daughter about your age! Not married yet! If you don't mind, I'm willing to marry my daughter to you!!! She's very beautiful!!!"
The old man kept begging for mercy.
Extremely pitiful.
But Jiang Ran's face grew increasingly cold and stern.
He dragged the old man, who could no longer resist after being beaten, completely underwater, including his head.
Before dragging him under, he said: "Old man! Don't blame me for not giving you a chance! If you can hold your breath longer than me underwater! I'll spare your life!"
The old man was ecstatic, so he competed with Jiang Ran in breath-holding underwater. After all, the old man was a corpse fisher and very familiar with water.
Although he couldn't defeat Jiang Ran in underwater combat, he was indeed better at holding his breath than Jiang Ran.
Thus, in their breath-holding contest, Jiang Ran lost.
The old man excitedly surfaced: "Great! I don't have to die!!!"
After Jiang emerged from the water, his face darkened with a sinister cold smile.
"I don't eat beef."

chapters.title: Chapter 167: End of the 27th Round
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran successfully dealt with the old man.
The old man was drowned alive.
After drowning him, Jiang Ran looked toward the shore from the water and discovered that the surrounding area was all wasteland with no security cameras or other people. He tied stones to the old man's body and sank it directly to the bottom.
After completing all this, Jiang Ran swam back to shore.
His gaze remained extremely gloomy.
He began wringing the water out of his clothes.
He muttered, "Do I have some inexplicable connection with old men? Last time I went out I encountered an old man, and now another one this time. Unfortunately, this particular old man made me extremely uncomfortable, unlike the previous one who didn't trigger my killing instinct."
That's right—the main personality Jiang Ran had quickly become incapacitated after falling into the water, left with only his last breath. The system consumed 1000 points to let another personality take over the body.
The one who luckily took control this time was the same personality that had dealt with the young white man with the chainsaw and handled the old man from Room 301.
This was also the blue-haired Jiang Ran from the small town in the inner landscape world.Blue-haired Jiang Ran suddenly thought of something as he stood on the riverbank.
Cold winds blew across his body.
But he didn't feel the slightest chill.
He said, "System, I've resolved the so-called crisis now. You're not going to forcibly send me back again, are you?"
"Don't do that! I'm also Jiang Ran! Logically speaking, you shouldn't always favor the main personality!!!"
The system didn't respond to him.
As the saying goes, silence means consent.
Jiang Ran suddenly collapsed unconscious, and five minutes later woke up again.
The main personality had returned.
After returning, Jiang Ran woke up feeling the cold penetrating his body.
Why was he completely soaked from head to toe?
It was as if he had fallen into water.
"Ouch, my head hurts so much?!"
"Did another personality come out again?"
As usual, Jiang Ran had lost memories of the period when his alternate personality had taken control of his body.
He only remembered that he wanted to scatter Wang Anjian's remaining ashes in the middle of the Big River.
He had been looking for a boat around the area.
As for what happened afterward, he had completely no memory...
Now, he discovered he was completely soaked.
He also noticed a small wooden boat drifting alone in the distance.
Jiang Ran looked around and found no other people.
He began piecing things together in his mind:
"Probably I found a boat, rowed over there, then accidentally fell into the water? After that, an alternate personality took over and brought me back to shore?"
"That must be what happened."
"Ah, so cold!"
Jiang Ran shivered violently from the wind. Fortunately, the sun was still out.
All he wanted now was to hurry home.
...
When Jiang Ran returned home, he took a shower and changed clothes. By the time he finished everything, it was already past 9 PM.
He had spent the entire day dealing with Wang Anjian's affairs.
Fortunately, everything was settled now.
Of course, what Jiang Ran considered most fortunate was that when he fell into the river during the day, he happened to be wearing pants with zippers, and his phone had good waterproofing.
Otherwise, he would have lost a phone too.
"What should I do with Wang Anjian's phone?"
Sitting on the sofa, Jiang Ran now held Wang Anjian's phone in his hand.
Wang Anjian's phone had been placed in the bedside cabinet along with his ID card and other items.
At that time, Jiang Ran had been busy handling matters after Wang Anjian's death, so he didn't pay attention to the phone. Now that he had time,
he opened the phone.
The phone had over 80% battery.
To Jiang Ran's surprise, Wang Anjian's phone didn't have a password lock.
So he directly opened the phone.
After opening it, he found the wallpaper quite strange.
Swiping to a page with few apps, he discovered this phone wallpaper was a photo taken by Wang Anjian himself.
The photo showed a white piece of paper with several words written on it:
"Jiang Ran, check the phone's memo."
Jiang Ran found the memo app on the phone.
There was only one memo note inside.
Opening the note, he found this message:
[Jiang Ran, if you can see this message, it means I'm already dead.]
[It was great knowing you, and thank you for helping handle my remains.]
[I'm truly ashamed that I could only give you 5000 yuan as compensation—I was really strapped for cash.]
The 5000 yuan compensation had already been transferred to Jiang Ran on the night before Wang Anjian passed away.
The note continued:
[I thought a lot about what final arrangements needed to be made.]
[I found there are only two.]
[First: Post on WeChat Moments to announce my death. Of course, you don't need to handle this because I've already preset it—it will automatically send if I don't adjust the time within 12 hours.]
[Second: That's this phone of mine. Of course, this phone isn't actually valuable—it might not even fetch 100 yuan if sold secondhand now—but I feel the greatest wealth of my life is preserved in this phone.]
[I'm giving this phone to you—do whatever you want with it. Of course, before disposing of it, you can look at the wealth I've left in the phone.]
[Don't feel embarrassed—you can freely check anything on my phone.]
[By the way, can you guess what I mean by the wealth I've left in the phone?]
[Alright, alright—the so-called wealth is actually my experiences of doing good deeds over the years.]
[Sigh, it seems I still can't escape human psychology after all. After doing so many things, I still want someone to know about them. I don't really want to be a completely unknown, silent hero.]
[Finally, thank you again, Jiang Ran, for taking care of my remains!]
The note ended here.
Jiang Ran remained silent for a long time after reading this.
His cheeks puffed up with air like balloons.
Jiang Ran began examining Wang Anjian's phone.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
First, he checked WeChat and found that the Moments post Wang Anjian had set up had already been automatically sent.
The Moments post read: [Everyone, since my late-stage cancer is incurable, I'm leaving this world ahead of time! This was preset and scheduled by me! If you're seeing this, it means I've already kicked the bucket!]
[Hahaha!]
Besides the text, this Moments post included a selfie of Wang Anjian himself smiling and making a peace sign with two fingers.
Under this Moments post, there were countless likes and comments from friends saying things like "rest in peace" and "we'll miss you."
Of course, Wang Anjian's WeChat private messages were also exploding—many people seemed unable to believe it, all asking if this was a prank, or if his WeChat had been hacked, or his phone stolen?
After all, Wang Anjian had never revealed his illness to these WeChat friends.
So who would believe such sudden news of his death?
Jiang Ran ignored these messages.
He just began looking at the wealth Wang Anjian had left in his phone.
As Jiang Ran looked, the people in the live stream room were also watching.
It was now the 7th day of the 27th round, past 10 PM.
The outcome of this round had already been determined—they just had to wait until midnight for the long-haired beautiful host to announce it.
Now, many people in the live stream room were following along with Jiang Ran's screen scrolling, also looking at the wealth Wang Anjian had left behind.
The more they saw, the more heart-wrenching it became.
He was truly a good person!
Finally, the clock struck midnight.
In the live stream room, the long-haired beautiful host appeared.
This time she was wearing a white fitted gown.
She gave off an ethereal, fairy-like feeling.
After appearing, she directly announced:
"Round 27: Lab rats Wu You, Sun Yijie, and Wang Anjian have died."
"Lab rat Mike left the apartment early and has been disqualified."
"Therefore, for round 27, lab rat Jiang Ran is once again the winner."
"Currently, Jiang Ran has survived three consecutive rounds, matching the highest survival record set by that lab rat who left the apartment long ago."

chapters.title: Chapter 168: The Diamond Bachelor Uses His Privilege Again
chapters.content:
"Round 27, total prize pool amount is 244.12 million."
"All funds have now been distributed to live stream room users who bet on Jiang Ran."
"With this, I declare Round 27 of Far Neighbor game concluded. The live stream room will close in thirty minutes. Please make preparations!"
After speaking, the long-haired beautiful host disappeared from the live stream room screen.
The live stream room chat area immediately exploded with activity.
Middle-aged Uncle was first to speak: 【As the poet Lu You wrote: 'Beyond the mountains and rivers that block the way, another village appears when willows darken and flowers brighten.'】
【I originally thought Jiang Ran might fall in this round, since Robert was truly terrifying. But who would have imagined Jiang Ran would have the last laugh in the end.】
Ultimate Rich Kid: 【How much did you make this round? Must be quite a bit, right?】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【More than last round, but since too many people bet on Jiang Ran this time, the increase wasn't that significant.】
Domineering Female CEO: 【At least you still profited...】Middle-aged Uncle: 【I definitely made money, which is better than losing. This round, Diamond Bachelor lost 30 million straight up, hahaha, I'm dying of laughter! This makes me even happier than seeing business rivals suffer massive losses in real life!】
Domineering Female CEO: 【Speaking of Brother Wang, he must be absolutely furious right now... I wonder if he'll continue targeting Jiang Ran next round?】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【That depends on his privileges! If I remember correctly, he should still be able to use one more privilege like the Robert one. After all, she's consistently ranked first on the win rate leaderboard.】
Domineering Female CEO: 【For Brother Wang, this round serves as a lesson. Next round will definitely be more challenging, especially with Robert's precedent. Next time, he'll absolutely choose someone even more terrifying than Robert to kill Jiang Ran.】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【Whatever, we don't have any privileges anyway. We can only pray Jiang Ran overcomes the difficulties himself. But given Jiang Ran's current state, I genuinely think there aren't many who can kill him. This guy, really, I feel like he's more terrifying than many deranged criminals and deranged serial killers.】
Middle-aged Uncle @ Ultimate Rich Kid: 【Bet on Jiang Ran with me next round.】
Ultimate Rich Kid: 【We'll see! But I'm still not too keen on betting on Jiang Ran. Feels a bit like winning by lying down rather than through my own observational skills and luck.】
Middle-aged Uncle laughed: 【As long as you win, that's what matters.】The source of thɪs content is ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Ultimate Rich Kid: 【So you'll always bet on Jiang Ran from now on?】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【Pretty much. Of course, if you become a resident of Alice Apartment yourself, I might bet on you.】
Ultimate Rich Kid: 【Damn! Jinx! Who wants to become a resident of that apartment?! That's practically asking to die!】
【But if you, Middle-aged Uncle, go in, I'll definitely bet on you!】
【Alright alright, time to sleep now. Hope the next round starts soon!】
The thirty minutes passed quickly.
The Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room officially closed.
The next opening would be for Round 28.
It was now 1:00 AM.
In a luxurious bayfront villa.
Diamond Bachelor, wearing pink sexy sleepwear, was in another princess-themed room within her villa.
The previous princess room had been mostly destroyed by her, with estimated damages reaching 3 million.
Of course, 3 million meant nothing to her.
Like this luxurious princess room, there were over thirty such rooms in this villa.
And each was a princess room with different themes.
"Jiang Ran, oh Jiang Ran, you truly are the bane of my existence."
Perhaps because she had already vented all her anger during her previous furious outburst.
Diamond Bachelor now appeared exceptionally calm.
She suddenly rose from her blue-sheeted large bed.
Walked to her computer.
Turned it on.
Clicked open the software called 【Black Software】 on her computer.
After opening Black Software, on the main interface.
There were numerous live stream rooms.
None of these live stream rooms contained the normal kind of streaming available to the outside world.
Of course, Diamond Bachelor wasn't here to watch these streams.
She clicked open the personal page.
Clicked on the privileges section.
Stared at it for a long time.
Just as Middle-aged Uncle and the others had predicted.
Diamond Bachelor could still use her number one ranked privilege one more time.
Which meant, transferring a deranged criminal from another country's Alice Apartment.
And designating a deranged criminal within the apartment to hunt a lab rat.
"I want you dead, Jiang Ran."
Diamond Bachelor didn't understand why she hated Jiang Ran so much.
Was it because Jiang Ran had humiliated her?
Made her sixth sense inaccurate?
Actually, the deeper reason was.
Diamond Bachelor had truly lived like a princess since childhood.
Anything she wanted to do, she could accomplish.
But Jiang Ran's appearance violated this principle.
She wanted Jiang Ran dead, but Jiang Ran always managed to survive.
At this moment, Diamond Bachelor clicked to use her privilege.
Middle-aged Uncle and those trailing at the bottom of the rankings.
Although they knew about the top three's privileges and what they entailed.
They had never personally used them.
They naively believed that when Diamond Bachelor activated her privilege.
That part about transferring a deranged criminal from another country - could she choose anyone she wanted?
Wrong!
This privilege had limitations.
The limitation was that Diamond Bachelor had to rely on a lottery draw - whichever country's Alice Apartment she drew, she could only designate a transfer from that specific country's Alice Apartment.
The only good thing was that designating which deranged criminal from that apartment would come - this part was free choice, not dependent on drawing.
Therefore, now, on the curved computer display, that large roulette wheel appeared, with numerous country names on it.
Diamond Bachelor clicked the "Draw" character in the center.
The roulette pointer began to spin slowly like a wheel of fate.
"America, America! Must draw America's Alice Apartment!"
Diamond Bachelor prayed in her heart.
Although there was no official ranking for lab rat survival difficulty across all countries' Alice Apartments.
But if one had to name the top few among all countries' Alice Apartments.
Many live stream room users would definitely choose those major countries!
Why?
First, larger population.
More people means higher probability of deranged individuals emerging, and more intense competition.
Second, based on daily news information.
America gave people the feeling that all kinds of bizarre things happened there.
Of course, the main reason Diamond Bachelor considered America's Alice Apartment the most powerful in the world.
Was primarily because America was a major destination for immigrants and illegal crossings.
Illegal immigrants from all over the world sneak into America.
Consequently, various criminal incidents keep increasing.
Effectively absorbing deranged individuals from worldwide.
How could it not be strong?
Diamond Bachelor's recent luck seemed rather poor.
Hoping to draw America, but ultimately drawing America's little brother - Korea.
Seeing the final interface where the roulette pointer pointed to Korea.
Diamond Bachelor remained silent for three seconds.
Then punched and shattered the display screen.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: What Is a Real-Life Rich Playboy Like?
chapters.content:
After smashing the display screen, her anger subsided.
But now this desktop computer was unusable, so she directly ran to another room.
She brought over a laptop worth more than thirty thousand.
Fine then, Korea it is.
No other choice.
Let's just choose from within Korea's Alice Apartment!
She clicked the mouse several more times.
Finally, the screen jumped to a ranking list for Korea's Alice Apartment.
It was a ranking list of the number of people killed within the apartment by those psychopaths in Korea's Alice Apartment.
From first place to last place, everyone was listed.Clicking on a name would show detailed information.The source of this content ɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"Korea..."
Diamond Bachelor's strongest impression of Korea was that she had spent considerable money inviting many Korean female celebrities to have dinner with her, then spend intimate nights together.
Yes, bet you didn't expect that!
Diamond Bachelor, this super-rich second-generation heiress.
Was actually a lesbian.
"Korea, I remember they've filmed quite a few of those psychopathic-type movies and TV dramas there."
Diamond Bachelor began carefully examining the profiles of these psychopathic residents in Korea's Alice Apartment.
......
Let's rewind time a bit earlier.
After the 27th round ended and the live stream room closed.
Similarly, in a luxury villa, within a bedroom.
A young man wearing blue silk pajamas, with above-average looks, figure, and style among his peers.
Was yawning sleepily.
"Since I started watching this live stream, I've been practically glued to the computer all day, it's completely messed up my sleep schedule. I'm exhausted. If this continues, I feel like I'm going to die from overwork."
The young man stood up from his computer desk, stretched contentedly, then glanced to his right.
To the right sat someone also wearing expensive pajamas.
This was a girl around the same age as the young man, or perhaps slightly younger.
This girl had long, lustrous black hair.
With delicate features and a faint scent of various flowers emanating from her.
Every smile and frown absolutely goddess-like.
In short, whether man or woman, the first thought upon seeing this girl was: so beautiful.
But this girl shared a common weakness with many beautiful girls.
That's right, what she had up front was too small...
If you paid careful attention, you'd notice that in this society, a beautiful face and a curvaceous figure often couldn't be found in the same person.
Those like the Qin Yi sisters who had everything and lacked nothing were ultimately rare.
Of course, despite this fatal weakness, the girl was pretty enough.
With just her face alone, she could still conquer all.
The young man looked at this girl who had just put down her phone.
He frowned, quite displeased: "Wang Ziyi, how many times have I told you? When watching this stream, don't record it with your phone! Don't record it with your phone! Can't you understand what I'm saying?"
"Aiya, hubby, I'm sorry, I just thought this live stream was really interesting and wanted to record it."
This girl called Wang Ziyi, seeing the young man was angry, immediately took the initiative to show weakness and tossed her phone aside.
The young man probably fell for this approach too, as after Wang Ziyi finished acting cute, he patted her head and said:
"It's not that I won't let you record, but if what you recorded gets leaked, it could cause us big trouble! Do you understand?!"
Wang Ziyi: "I know, so I'll be very careful. Well, I promise you, I won't record next time."
"Mm, don't record next time, and delete all the previous recordings too."
The young man said in a commanding tone.
"Mm, I'll listen to you in everything. So, can you give me some reward?"
"Reward? I just finished watching the stream, I'm exhausted all over, can't give you any reward."
"Hey, you're so annoying, not that kind of reward! I mean Hermès recently released a new bag..."
Hearing this, the young man frowned: "Don't even think about it. I've already bought you two this month, and you still want more? Wait until next month!"
"Ah? Well alright then... It's just that my good friend already has one... Her boyfriend bought it for her, and I just don't want you to lose face..."
Smart people could already guess this young man's identity.
He was indeed the recent chatterbox king of the Far Neighbor game live stream room - Ultimate Rich Kid.
Ultimate Rich Kid's real name was Lin Feng, and just like his online name, he was indeed an ultimate rich second-generation heir.
His family assets were estimated to be around ten billion.
And Wang Ziyi was his current girlfriend.
A performing arts university student studying acting, rated as one of the top ten campus beauties right after starting her freshman year.
This year she happened to be a sophomore.
She had been kept by him since her freshman year.
"Alright, alright, I'll buy it for you next month. Let's sleep! I'm tired!"
After all, Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng was a wealthy man. Although Wang Ziyi was extremely beautiful.
For someone like him, this type was never in short supply.
Therefore, from being gentle and tender before, he now easily became impatient.
Probably in a little while, he would directly dump her and find a new one.
Wang Ziyi was also clear about this, which was why she wanted to seize the time to get more good things.
The next day.
Wang Ziyi got up around 9am, but Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng was still sound asleep.
After getting up, finishing her toiletries, and eating the breakfast prepared by the nanny in Lin Feng's villa.
Wang Ziyi went to the dressing room Lin Feng had prepared for her.
And carefully did her makeup.
After finishing her makeup, she drove Lin Feng's Bentley luxury car worth several million.
Left the villa, and drove all the way to a seaside area in their city.
Their city was located near the ocean.
And the seaside area Wang Ziyi came to had a row of independent ocean-view houses.
One of these ocean-view houses had been bought by the boyfriend of one of her good friends.
Usually, Wang Ziyi and her few good friends liked to gather here.
At this moment, enjoying the salty sea breeze, looking at the beautiful scenery where sky and sea merged on the horizon.
On the beach in the backyard of the ocean-view house, Wang Ziyi and three other women sat around a large white marble table, all looking thoroughly enjoyed and relaxed.
"Yingying sister, tell me, between you and Ziyi little sister, whose boyfriend is richer?"
At this moment, one of the four women suddenly looked curiously at the woman she called Yingying sister.
The four women including Wang Ziyi shared a common trait.
They were all beautiful.
Among them, Wang Ziyi and Ou Yingying were the most beautiful and attractive. Ou Yingying was the Yingying sister.
But if they really compared, Wang Ziyi's face was slightly better than Ou Yingying's.
While Ou Yingying didn't have Wang Ziyi's physical weakness, that shortcoming.
Therefore, looking at the two women overall, each had their strengths and they were fairly matched.
This was also why the boyfriends found by Wang Ziyi and Ou Yingying through their beauty.
Were much richer than those of the other two women.
Although the partners found by the other two women were also quite wealthy.
They simply weren't on the same level as those found by Wang Ziyi and the other woman.
And most importantly.
Among the four women, Wang Ziyi was only 19 this year, the youngest.
Ou Yingying was the oldest among the four, yet only 23.
The other two were 21 and 22 respectively.
These two had found men already in their thirties, which was absolutely old for their age... and their looks were quite ordinary.
But what Wang Ziyi and Ou Yingying found were not only wealthy but also under 25 years old.
And both quite handsome.
Therefore, Wang Ziyi and Ou Yingying often compared themselves intentionally or unintentionally.
They compared themselves, and were also egged on by the other two women to compare.

chapters.title: Chapter 170: The Ultimate Rich Girlfriend Causes Trouble
chapters.content:
"That should still be because Ziyi's little sister's boyfriend comes from a wealthy family! His father frequently appears on television—I've seen him on my phone. He's a famous entrepreneur in our province with assets reaching tens of billions!"
"My boyfriend's family, at most, has assets barely exceeding six billion. There's definitely no comparison to Ziyi's little sister's situation."
Ou Yingying said.
Ou Yingying's words sounded very modest, genuinely appearing humble.
But somehow, it felt like there was something hidden beneath her words.
The 21-year-old girl among the four said: "Aiya, although Ziyi's little sister found someone from a wealthy family, Sister Yingying, your partner falls slightly short in terms of wealth."
"However, Ziyi's little sister's guy isn't the only son in his family!"
"That Lin Feng's family has five older brothers and four sisters. I heard his father even has illegitimate children outside—it's really messy. Even with tens of billions in assets, how much could ultimately end up in Ziyi's little sister's boyfriend's hands?"
"But Sister Yingying, your situation is different. Only son in the family, just two younger sisters, so..."
The 21-year-old girl deliberately left her sentence hanging here.Anyone with half a brain could fill in the rest—doesn't it mean the family fortune would almost entirely be inherited by Ou Yingying's boyfriend?
Whereas Wang Ziyi's boyfriend Lin Feng, even with tens of billions in family wealth—how much would actually reach his hands?
Definitely less than what Ou Yingying's boyfriend would get.
Hearing this, Ou Yingying naturally felt pleased inwardly.
But Wang Ziyi felt quite displeased.
She wanted to refute something, but what the other said was the truth. There was no way to argue against it.
Afterward, the group chatted for a while longer.
Ou Yingying stood up and entered her boyfriend's seaside villa, returning after ten minutes.
When she came back, she carried three bags in her hands.
She distributed the three bags to Wang Ziyi and the other two girls, one each.
The 21-year-old and 22-year-old girls, seeing the bags Ou Yingying gave them,
immediately lit up with excitement.
They exclaimed with surprise: "Wow! Sister Yingying, isn't this Hermès' latest bag design? You're really giving these to us?!"
Ou Yingying waved her hand dismissively: "It's nothing. My boyfriend bought me all the color variations of this bag. These particular colors just don't suit my personal taste, so I'm giving them to you. I hope you don't mind."
The 21-year-old girl said delightedly: "Mind? How could we?! I absolutely love it!"
"Sister Yingying, you're truly too good to us! If you were willing, I'd even offer myself to you!"
The 22-year-old girl quickly added: "Sister Yingying, your boyfriend treats you so well! This latest bag costs 85,000 each! There are six colors in this collection, and your boyfriend bought you all of them! Ah, I'm really so envious! Unlike my boyfriend—I begged him for so long before he bought me an old version..."
Under the continuous flattery, Ou Yingying could no longer contain her smile.
Chatting and laughing happily with the two girls, she clearly became the central figure among the four.
Meanwhile, Wang Ziyi looked at the purple latest-model Hermès bag in her hand.
She felt indescribable emotions.
Because this was exactly the bag she had begged her boyfriend Lin Feng to buy for her through coquettish behavior.
Yet, despite her prolonged coquettish behavior, she hadn't managed to get it.
While Ou Yingying's boyfriend directly bought Ou Yingying the entire collection.
This disparity made it impossible for Wang Ziyi not to feel jealous.
Because this was exactly the bag she had begged her boyfriend Lin Feng to buy for her through acting cute and coquettish.
Yet, despite her prolonged acting cute and coquettish, she hadn't managed to get it.
After these words, the conversation among Ou Yingying's group of three immediately quieted down, all turning to look at Wang Ziyi.
The 21-year-old girl said: "What kind of talk is that? Well then, Ziyi's little sister, if you give us Hermès bags too, we'll show you the same gratitude!"
The 22-year-old girl added: "Exactly! Besides, didn't you receive a bag too? Instead of thanking Sister Yingying, why don't you just return the bag?"
As tension began rising, Ou Yingying immediately interjected: "Stop talking, everyone. We're all good sisters here. Let's not damage our relationship over a few bags."
"Don't you agree, Ziyi's little sister?"
Ou Yingying smiled sweetly.
Seemingly mediating, but her words carried hidden sharpness.
Wang Ziyi didn't bother pretending to be polite either, snorting coldly as she said: "These days, country bumpkins still obsess over this bag, that bag, this necklace, that necklace."
"Do you even know what truly wealthy people are playing with nowadays? What they're paying attention to?"
"If you remain completely clueless, you'll just get left behind by the truly wealthy circles!"
Hearing this, the three girls exchanged glances, then all shook their heads.
Wang Ziyi adopted a mysterious and profound posture: "Have you heard of the 'Far Neighbor' game?"
The 21-year-old girl frowned: "Far Neighbor? Is this a computer game? Mobile game? Or some new bedroom playstyle?"
"If you remain completely clueless, you'll just get left behind by the truly wealthy circles!"
"The Far Neighbor game isn't on computer or mobile, nor is it some new bedroom playstyle."
"It's a live stream game."
The 21-year-old girl frowned: "Far Neighbor? Is this a computer game? Mobile game? Or some new bedroom gameplay?"
Both the 21 and 22-year-old girls clearly didn't believe it.
"The Far Neighbor game isn't on computer or mobile, nor is it some new bedroom gameplay."
Wang Ziyi explained: "The Far Neighbor game."
The 22-year-old girl heard this and became disdainful: "Live stream game? You're saying truly wealthy people are all playing this? Paying attention to this? Ziyi's little sister, do you take us for fools? For lab rats of those live stream shopping hosts?"
"In an apartment building live various deranged criminals, deranged serial killers."
"The game operates in weekly cycles."
"Each cycle has five lab rats who sign agreements to survive in the apartment for one week. For each day survived, they receive ten thousand. The challenge is to see who can survive until the end."Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"In this live stream game, everyone in the live stream room consists of wealthy people. Each cycle they participate in betting, wagering on which lab rat they believe will survive to the end."
Wang Ziyi finished with a mysterious tone.
The 21-year-old girl immediately refuted: "Ziyi's little sister, have you been reading too much web fiction recently?"
The 22-year-old girl added: "Exactly! Do you think we're three-year-old children?! This sounds just like horror suspense fiction—how could such a live stream game exist in reality?! Tell us, which platform? Probably no platform would have this, right?!"
Wang Ziyi sneered: "That's exactly why I called you country bumpkins, and you still don't like it. Use your brains—this kind of live stream definitely doesn't appear on mainstream formal software platforms. It's on those private membership-based secret software."
The 22-year-old girl laughed mockingly: "Making things up, keep making things up. Well then, show us this software of yours?"
Wang Ziyi: "That live stream software is on my boyfriend's phone. I don't have it on mine."
The 22-year-old girl became even more disdainful: "Hahahahaha, such a classic! Classic 'it's on my boyfriend's phone.' Why not say it's on your friend's phone? Or on your other phone that you didn't bring today?"
Facing the skepticism, Wang Ziyi had long been prepared.
Wang Ziyi sneered: "That's exactly why I called you country bumpkins, and you still don't like it. Use your brains—this kind of live stream definitely doesn't appear on mainstream official software platforms. It's on those private membership-based secret software."
"Now, let me show you whether what I'm saying is true or false!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Let’s Be Guinea Pigs Together at Alice’s Apartment in the Next Round
chapters.content:
Originally, according to the four girls' usual daily routine.
They would gather together in the morning, then at noon, find a high-end restaurant for meal photos.
In the afternoon, go shopping.
In the evening, return to their respective homes or find another place to hang out.
But now, because they wanted to watch the live stream videos recorded on Wang Ziyi's phone.
This caused the four girls to remain in this seaside apartment until 5 PM.
And during this time, Ou Yingying and the other two girls finished watching all the videos recorded on Wang Ziyi's phone.
Of course, Wang Ziyi directly showed them the exciting bloody fight scenes and important moments.
She skipped all the unimportant parts.
That's why they finished watching in just a few hours.Besides, Wang Ziyi's recording wasn't complete either.
After watching, Ou Yingying and the other two girls remained silent for a long time.
Seeing the three girls not saying anything after watching the videos.
Wang Ziyi sipped coffee delivered by takeout with great satisfaction, feeling quite proud.
She thought to herself that this time she had finally regained her dignity and earned herself some respect.
Let you three see things you've never seen or even heard of before.
Let you three realize how provincial you actually are.
To be honest.
After watching these recorded videos.
It would be false to say Ou Yingying and the other two girls weren't shocked - they were so stunned they couldn't speak!
In fact, one of the three girls even vomited profusely while watching.
Now, it was almost past 6 PM in the evening.
The three girls finally completely regained their composure.
After recovering, the three girls looked at Wang Ziyi with complex expressions in their eyes.
The 22-year-old girl asked Wang Ziyi: "Ziyi's little sister, these videos aren't from some movie or TV series, are they?"
Even after seeing the recorded videos, ordinary people still find it hard to accept that such things exist in this world.
Wang Ziyi snorted disdainfully: "Then why don't you go search for yourself? If you can find which movie or TV series these videos came from, I'll admit defeat."
The 22-year-old girl fell silent.
The 21-year-old girl then said: "If it's not from a movie or TV series, and these scenes look extremely realistic, could it be one of those mockumentaries? They look very real but are actually fake? I've watched this kind before - mockumentaries about serial killers."
Wang Ziyi remained calm and indifferent.
At this moment, Ou Yingying, who hadn't spoken until now, finally spoke up.
"Ziyi's little sister, can you share these videos with me?"
Hearing this, Wang Ziyi immediately became alert: "What do you want to do?"
Ou Yingying: "I want to check if these videos come from some mockumentary, or maybe from overseas, even from the dark web. If after checking, they're not from any of these sources, then I'll completely believe what you said about that Far Neighbor game being real!"
Seeing Ou Yingying say this, the other two girls also chimed in agreement.
They felt that if Wang Ziyi didn't let Ou Yingyang check, they would suspect these videos came from the dark web or some obscure bloody movie or mockumentary!
Wang Ziyi thought for a moment and said: "I can give you the videos, but I need to warn you first - absolutely cannot leak them! Otherwise it will cause big trouble!"
Ou Yingying nodded: "Don't worry, I'll be careful. Don't you trust me? I always handle things very reliably!"
Wang Ziyi still wasn't completely reassured, so she gave several more warnings.
Finally, she transferred the videos to Ou Yingying.
Because they had watched several hours of such bloody videos.
To be honest, none of the girls had any appetite, and they didn't feel like going out to play in the evening, all afraid they might have nightmares.
Therefore, they dispersed afterwards, each returning to their own homes.
Ou Yingying had recently graduated from university and was now pursuing postgraduate studies with her boyfriend's financial support.
She currently lived in her boyfriend's own villa.
Arriving at the villa, she rewatched all the videos Wang Ziyi had sent her at accelerated speed, then imported all of them into a USB drive.
After that, she called someone to come over.
The person she called was a man in his thirties, wearing glasses, looking like a typical city office worker.
People who knew this man called him - Little Zhao.
Little Zhao was originally just an ordinary low-level employee in Ou Yingying's boyfriend's family conglomerate.
Later, once at the company, Little Zhao met Ou Yingying.
And after learning Ou Yingying's identity.
He did some soul-searching and decided to suck up to Ou Yingying.
Because he knew how to flatter and would follow Ou Yingying's every command.
If Ou Yingying told him to eat shit, he would absolutely not drink piss.
Therefore, he quickly rose through the ranks from a small employee.
Now, he was already a deputy director in the company's publicity department.
Because of this, Little Zhao became even more obedient to Ou Yingying's beck and call.
No matter what Little Zhao was doing, as long as Ou Yingying called, he would come immediately.
Just like a eunuch serving an imperial concubine in ancient times.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
After Little Zhao arrived, Ou Yingying handed him the USB drive.
Then said: "This contains several recorded live stream videos. The videos are very bloody, showing many wealthy people watching bloody live streams and placing bets."
"Several segments here contain dialogue between a man and woman."
"The man is Lin Feng - you should know him too, the son of our rival company's chairman. The woman's voice is his girlfriend."
"In one segment of these videos, his girlfriend even captured footage of Lin Feng watching the live stream on his computer using her phone."
"Later, edit these video segments to make them concise, then spread them around for me."
"The headline should be something like: Lin Group's young master participates in bloody live streams, doesn't treat ordinary people as human, etc. The more explosive and attention-grabbing the title, the better! Do you understand?"
Little Zhao took the USB drive, somewhat stunned.
He never expected that Ou Yingying called him here to do this kind of thing.
Especially with all this talk about bloody live streams and the young master from the rival company.
This left Little Zhao somewhat confused.
But he still said: "Understood, Sister Ou. I guarantee I'll complete the task!"
Ou Yingying was very satisfied: "Do this cleanly, don't leave any evidence."
"If someone follows the trail back to you, or even to me, don't blame me for being ruthless."
Little Zhao quickly nodded: "Understood, Sister Ou. You can trust me to handle things!"
Little Zhao had helped Ou Yingying with many dirty deeds before.
Like today's matter - regardless of whether what Ou Yingying said about Lin Feng, this young master, participating in bloody game live streams was true or false.
He still had to spread this information regardless.
This kind of reputation-damaging attack on others.
Was actually minor compared to what he had previously done for Ou Yingying.
"Little Zhao, I heard you're about to get married soon. I hope after this matter, you can get promoted to director before your wedding. That should make your girlfriend very happy."
Ou Yingying sat on the sofa, swirling a glass of red wine, like an empress sitting high above.
Hearing this, Little Zhao immediately became so moved that his eyes turned red.
Before Little Zhao started sucking up to Ou Yingying and working for her.
He was definitely a bottom-level employee, often receiving scornful looks from others in the company.
The worst part was that the company girls he liked either went for handsome colleagues or leaders.
Even being a leader's mistress or second mistress - company girls wouldn't even look at someone like him.
But since following Ou Yingying and rising rapidly, he not only quickly found a girlfriend.
But she was also one of the most beautiful girls in their department.
Because of this, facing yet another promotion after completing this task.
Little Zhao dramatically knelt down before Ou Yingying, kowtowing repeatedly to express his loyalty.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: The Rich Playboy and the Middle-Aged Man Who Signed the Deal
chapters.content:
Little Zhao left with the USB drive.
Watching the man's retreating back.
Ou Yingying was quite satisfied with her dog.
Yes, in her eyes, Little Zhao was nothing but a loyal dog.
He would bite whoever she told him to bite, extremely useful.
"Lin Feng, oh Lin Feng, how could you choose a stupid woman like Wang Ziyi who only has looks but no brains?"
Ou Yingying wanted the video from Wang Ziyi's phone.
It wasn't for verification or checking at all.
Ridiculous—whether this Far Neighbor game was real or not had nothing to do with her.
Although this was indeed her first time hearing about such a bloody live-streaming game.Her purpose in obtaining this video was to launch a public opinion attack against Lin Feng's family's Lin Corporation.
Don't underestimate the power of public opinion attacks.Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
This thing works extremely well against both individuals and organizations.
If this processed video were to spread, it would absolutely put Lin Corporation in the spotlight.
As for why Ou Yingying wanted to do this?
Simple.
As mentioned before, they were rival companies.
Of course, they weren't before, but they were recently.
Previously, both group companies were making money and shining brightly in their respective industries.
Not interfering with each other.
But recently, Lin Feng's family's Lin Corporation began venturing into the industry domain of Ou Yingying's boyfriend's group company.
So, the two corporations became rivals...
Therefore, this wave of public opinion attacks would absolutely cause significant impact to Lin Feng's family's corporation.
After all, that stupid woman Wang Ziyi, while recording the video, actually captured a scene showing Lin Feng watching the live stream, and his face was clearly visible!!!
This way, even if you wanted to explain, it would be difficult!
"After this matter is handled well and causes heavy damage to the other side! I'll tell him then, give him a surprise!"
This "him" referred to Ou Yingying's boyfriend.
Thinking of her boyfriend, Ou Yingying couldn't help but show a brilliant smile.
This woman thought Wang Ziyi was stupid.
Little did she know, she herself was also very stupid.
And stupid women would all pay the price for their foolishness!!!
Moreover, this might be the last night for Ou Yingying and several other involved parties to sleep peacefully without worries.
The next day.
10:00 AM.
A food company under Lin Corporation.
Lin Feng held the position of general manager at this food company.
At this moment, Lin Feng was handling official business in his office.
Just then, his female secretary—who had a good figure, delicate features, and was dressed in white-collar attire—knocked on the office door.
After knocking three times, she entered.
Her gentle red lips spoke with a mature, gentle voice:
"Manager Lin, there's a middle-aged man at the front desk without an appointment who insists on seeing you, saying it's very important."
Hearing this, Lin Feng put down his pen and looked up.
"Really? Did that middle-aged man say who he is? Which company? What's it about?"
The female secretary: "He didn't say who he is. As for which company, he said he's from Alice Company. Regarding the matter, he said he can only tell you in person."
"Alice Company? How come I've never heard of it?"
Lin Feng, who originally intended to have his secretary send the person away, suddenly remembered Alice Apartment.
So he told the female secretary to bring that person in.
Soon.
The middle-aged man arrived at Lin Feng's general manager office.
After entering the office, the middle-aged man looked around the room, then sat directly on the office's leather sofa as if they were old friends.
Then, his gaze turned toward Lin Feng in the general manager's seat.
Lin Feng made eye contact with him, then got straight to the point:
"Are you from Alice Apartment?"
The middle-aged man nodded.
Lin Feng frowned, not understanding why, but he suddenly had a bad premonition.
He asked: "What do you want with me? Don't tell me you're here to sign an agreement with me to move into the apartment?"
"Haha, don't joke around."
"Even if you paid me 100,000 per day, I wouldn't sign any agreement. I don't need that little money."
Hearing this, the middle-aged man smiled and said:
"I'm not here to sign an agreement with you. Your current situation is worse than those who signed agreements."
"At least those people signed voluntarily."
"But you didn't."
"I'm here to notify you to prepare to move into Alice Apartment."
Bang!
After the middle-aged man casually said these words.
Lin Feng slammed both hands on his office desk.
His temper immediately flared as he angrily said: "I'm not someone you can joke with!"
The middle-aged man spread his hands: "Neither am I."
"I'm not joking with you."
Lin Feng: "Not joking? If you're not joking, why are you forcing me to move into the apartment?"
The middle-aged man lowered his head with a cold laugh, then looked up:
"Ultimate Rich Kid, why would we force you to move into the apartment."
"You should look for reasons within yourself instead of blaming us?"
"Let me tell you, the reason lies with you yourself!"
"More precisely, it lies with your girlfriend!"
Hearing that the problem was with his girlfriend Wang Ziyi, Lin Feng initially couldn't understand, but soon figured something out.
His face showed terror:
"It couldn't be those recordings?! Damn! That stupid woman! Didn't I tell her not to leak them?!"
Hearing this, the middle-aged man laughed: "Ultimate Rich Kid, quite clever, figuring out the reason so quickly. Yes, those recordings were leaked, essentially through your girlfriend's hands."
"That's the reason."
"Haha, since that's the reason, and she leaked the recordings! You should go after her! Make her move into Alice Apartment! Why come after me?!"
The Ultimate Rich Kid screamed.
His emotions were clearly unstable now.
After all, he had watched several rounds of live streams and deeply understood the situation in that damned place.
Moving in would absolutely mean certain death.
The middle-aged man calmly replied: "You're a user of Black Software, you watch the live streams, your girlfriend recorded while you were watching—why do you think you bear no responsibility?!"
"Alright, I'm leaving. By the way, you'll probably settle accounts with your girlfriend later anyway, so do me a favor and notify your girlfriend that she'll be moving into Alice Apartment with you. As for the specific move-in time, I'll notify you again when it's time!"
After saying this, the middle-aged man left Lin Feng's office.
After the middle-aged man left, Lin Feng's eyes were bloodshot, like an enraged tiger.
He directly picked up his nearby phone and called his girlfriend Wang Ziyi.
What made him even more furious in his already enraged state was that the first call didn't go through.
The second call finally connected.
After connecting.
A coquettish voice came from the other side:
"Honey, why are you calling me?"
"Honey my ass! You stupid woman, I'm at the company office, get over here quickly!!!!"
...
Wang Ziyi on the other end of the phone put down the phone, somewhat confused about why Lin Feng was suddenly so angry?
What happened?
"Whatever, no matter what happened, seeing my beautiful face should calm him down."
Instead of rushing to the company office immediately, Wang Ziyi started doing her makeup at home.

chapters.title: Chapter 173: Confronting Ou Yingying — No One Gets to Escape
chapters.content:
By the time Wang Ziyi, who had meticulously dressed up, arrived at the "battlefield," more than an hour had already passed.
Some people's anger gradually fades with time.
Lin Feng was also that type of person.
But unfortunately, this incident involved his very life.
Therefore, instead of making his anger fade over the course of more than an hour, it had only grown more intense.
He looked at Wang Ziyi who had just entered, closed the door, pointed at her and yelled:
"You stupid woman, I told you to come quickly, and you take over an hour to get here? What were you doing? Eating shit?"
Wang Ziyi, who had been all smiles and happy just moments before, had her smile completely wiped away by these words.
She didn't dare talk back to Lin Feng either, only saying pitifully: "I just wanted to look pretty when I came to see you! So I took some time to get ready."
Lin Feng suddenly burst into loud laughter, laughing almost maniacally: "Is this the first time I'm seeing you? You still need to get ready? I'm familiar with every inch of your body, and you need to get ready to see me?!"Wang Ziyi's eyes turned red with grievance: "What's going on with you today! Why are you so angry!"
"Hahaha!"
Lin Feng was on the verge of breaking down: "You're feeling aggrieved now? Don't you have any idea what you've done?"
Wang Ziyi wiped her tears with confusion: "What did I do? I've never done anything to betray you!"
"I've been with you since freshman year, I even dumped my boyfriend at the time, I've been completely devoted to you! What?! Are you getting paranoid now? Think I'm cheating on you?!"
Lin Feng was going insane: "Is that what I'm talking about? Do you think a simple case of cheating would make me this broken? Would I be like this?! It's not like I haven't been cheated on by ex-girlfriends before!!!!"
"I'm looking for you today because of Alice Apartment!!!!"
"I really have to thank you! My wonderful girlfriend! The two of us are about to go live on stream soon!!!"
"We're about to move into Alice Apartment soon!"
"Aren't you happy?! Huh? Don't you think Jiang Ran is amazing? You'll get to be friends with him soon!!!!"
"Uh..."
At this moment, Wang Ziyi listened to this long string of words, completely stunned.
She remained stunned for quite a while, dazedly saying: "Honey, are you joking with me? Today doesn't seem like April Fool's Day, right?!"
Lin Feng: "Fool your mother."
"You stupid woman, didn't I tell you to delete the recorded video? If you didn't delete it, at least make sure it never gets circulated?! And you? You went and spread it!!!!"
"I've been thinking for a long time, wondering if it's because I didn't buy you that new Hermès bag, so you're screwing me over like this? Treating me like someone from Cherry Blossom Country?!"
"Now look, you got what you wanted, I said I'd buy it for you next month!"
"Thanks to you, whether the two of us can even live to see next month is a question!!!!!"
Thump!
Wang Ziyi lost her balance and fell to the ground.
Her pretty face was now filled with sheer terror.
Her mind flashed with scene after scene of bloody images from the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
She cried.
Earlier in front of Lin Feng, it was fake crying.
This time it was real crying.
She crawled all the way to Lin Feng's feet, hugged his legs, crying like a pear blossom bathed in rain, like a fairy shedding tears:
"Husband, honey, tell me, you must be tricking me, right?!"
Lin Feng grabbed her by the throat: "Trick your mother! Haven't you noticed that after being with you for so long, today when I talk to you, it's filled with 'mother' references?! Do you think my acting is that good? That I'd put on a performance just to play with you?!"
After hearing this, Wang Ziyi completely lost hope.
Then she burst into loud sobs.
She wasn't crying because her boyfriend was going to move into Alice Apartment, but because she had to move into that damned place too.
Suddenly, she stopped crying.
She seemed to have thought of something, stood up, and wiped away her tears with both hands in a disheveled manner.
"Husband, it wasn't me who spread the video! It was Ou Yingying! It was that woman Ou Yingying!"
"Ou Yingying? How did she get involved?!"
Lin Feng was very confused.
Wang Ziyi then proceeded to explain what happened yesterday.
Especially mentioning how Ou Yingying had asked for the video.
After listening, Lin Feng slapped Wang Ziyi across the face, making her cover her face and cry, her cheek burning with pain.
"How can you be so stupid?! You really have nothing but good looks, all flaws, especially your brain! How could you give her something as important as a video recording?!"
After delivering that slap, Lin Feng collapsed powerlessly onto the sofa, his eyes vacant.
He really felt like killing Wang Ziyi right now, but would killing her help?
No!
"Husband, since it was Ou Yingying who leaked our video, she should be the one to live in that damned place!!!"
"We're innocent!!!"
Wang Ziyi said loudly again.
The more Lin Feng looked at Wang Ziyi, the more annoyed he became: "Idiot, didn't you give her the video? Don't you bear any responsibility?!"
Wang Ziyi gritted her teeth: "Then if we have to live in Alice! She can't escape either!!! After all, she's the one who spread the video!!!!"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Lin Feng's eyes were empty: "What does it matter if she can't escape? The two of us still have to go in..."
...
Over at Ou Yingying's place.
Last night, Ou Yingying's boyfriend didn't come back all night, apparently busy with company business.
After waking up in the morning, Ou Yingying picked up her phone.
Ready to go online and check out the latest hot topics.
According to her imagination, when she opened her phone now.
It should be filled with hot news about the Lin Corporation young master participating in a bloody live stream game, not treating ordinary people as human beings, and similar topics.
But when she opened her phone and scrolled for a long time, she found that today's hot topics and trending searches were pretty much the same as usual.
Nothing about this matter.
"Huh? Is Little Zhao moving so slowly this time? Could the video not be ready yet?"
Ou Yingying frowned, somewhat dissatisfied with Little Zhao's slow action speed this time.
After all, Little Zhao usually completed tasks very quickly in the past.
It was also because of this, with both loyalty and capability, that she often found opportunities to promote him.
Setting that aside for now, Ou Yingying prepared to go wash up first, then have breakfast.
Of course, before doing these things, she first sent a WeChat message to Little Zhao.
Asking about how the video was coming along.
After finishing washing up and eating the breakfast prepared by the housekeeper, she returned to the bedroom and picked up her phone again.
She found that the message she sent to Little Zhao still hadn't been replied to.
She immediately became dissatisfied: "This Little Zhao, did I promote him too quickly? Yesterday he was swearing loyalty, and today he's like this."
Ou Yingyang let out a long sigh.
Feeling that she shouldn't let Little Zhao get promoted too quickly in the future.
At this moment.
The housekeeper from her boyfriend's house came in.
Respectfully saying to Ou Yingying: "Miss Ou, there's a middle-aged man outside the villa looking for you, says he's your friend."
Ou Yingying frowned: "My friend?"
Ou Yingying stood up and descended from the third floor down the luxurious, dream-like spiral staircase to the first floor.
After reaching the first floor.
She saw that the villa's main door was open.
Outside the door stood a middle-aged man dressed simply yet exuding luxury.

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Lin Feng, Wang Ziyi, and Ou Yingying Gather
chapters.content:
The villa complex where Ou Yingying's boyfriend's villa was located had extremely strict management.
Under normal circumstances, only property owners could enter;
everyone else would be stopped.
For example, this middle-aged man before her should normally have been detained by security.
Then security would have notified her.
But this middle-aged man had come directly to her boyfriend's villa door.
This showed the man was no ordinary person.
"Who are you? What do you want?"
Ou Yingying found the middle-aged man's appearance completely unfamiliar.
The middle-aged man smiled: "Don't worry about who I am. I'm here to notify you about something extremely important."
"Extremely important? Notify me?"Ou Yingying's delicate eyebrows slightly furrowed.
The middle-aged man said: "Let's find a quiet place. This isn't suitable for discussion."
Ou Yingying then led the middle-aged man to the second-floor study.
Her flawless pale legs crossed, Ou Yingying leaned arrogantly and coldly against the wooden desk.
Looking down condescendingly at the middle-aged man sitting on the sofa.
She said: "Speak. What's this important matter? If it's some nonsense, I'll call the police immediately."
The middle-aged man's lips curled slightly.
Looking at Ou Yingying who was about to face disaster yet remained completely unaware, still putting on this cold act, he almost laughed.
But he restrained himself—he was professional.
He said: "Those videos you gave to Little Zhao yesterday—you've watched them yourself, right?"
Hearing this, Ou Yingying's composed, arrogant expression suddenly changed.
She immediately thought of something, her eyes darkening: "Little Zhao told you? Are you working with him to blackmail me with this?"
The middle-aged man shook his head: "You can doubt me, but don't doubt Little Zhao. That man is utterly loyal to you."
"I came today to notify you that you've been successfully selected to move into Alice Apartment. I'm telling you to prepare in advance. I'll return when it's time for you to move in."
"This is your important matter? What Alice Apartment? I don't understand."
Ou Yingying frowned.
The middle-aged man calmly clasped his hands together.
"Don't play dumb. Think about where you got those videos from. Ask your source and you'll understand."
Ou Yingying played innocent: "I just downloaded those videos randomly online."
Seeing Ou Yingying persistently pretending, the middle-aged man took out his phone and gestured for her to come see the video on it.
Ou Yingying initially didn't care, but after watching the entire video.
She became completely stunned with shock and terror.
The video showed three people.
It appeared to be shot in some room.
Little Zhao was tied to a chair.
Beside him stood two people wearing black masks, their faces unseen.
Probably men.
These two men subjected the tied-up Little Zhao to brutal interrogation.
The specific questions were about where the videos came from, who gave them to him, and what he planned to do with them.
Little Zhao initially refused to talk despite torture, but after being beaten black and blue, with no help coming from heaven or earth.
He had no choice but to confess everything.
"Well, Ou Yingying, what do you have to say now?"
"Also, I know who you got these videos from—it's quite obvious since the main subject was recorded. Now I need to know what exactly happened with these recordings? How did they end up in your hands?"
"If I talk, can I redeem myself?"
"Heh, no."
"Then why should I tell you?"
"Heh, even if you don't tell me, with the resources behind me, I can quickly find out. Of course, even if you do tell me, my people will verify everything to ensure you're telling the truth."
"So you can treat this as selling me a favor. I can give you some information about Alice Apartment so you might at least not die so easily there."
The study fell into complete silence.
Ou Yingying finally nodded and revealed everything about yesterday—the four women in the oceanview room, what Wang Ziyi told them about some apartment, and everything about the videos.
Of course, Ou Yingying's account was subjective, making it seem like everything was Wang Ziyi's fault.
The middle-aged man kept his word after listening:
"You should have learned about Alice Apartment from your friend Wang Ziyi and the videos she recorded."
"The information I'll give you is this: at Alice Apartment, you might survive easier if you attach yourself to someone named Jiang Ran."
"Additionally, thanks to you, Wang Ziyi and her boyfriend have also been selected for Alice Apartment, and they'll be moving in the same batch as you. And your subordinate—the one called Little Zhao—is also included."
"That's all I have to say. Oh, and don't think about running away. Unless you leave Earth, you can't escape our grasp!"
With that, the middle-aged man left.
He needed to find Lin Feng next.
Anyone observant would notice the middle-aged man visited Ou Yingying first, then Lin Feng.
After the man left, Ou Yingying sat in the study dazed for a long time.
In that moment, she felt chilled to the bone, with fear taking root in her heart.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
She began to think the middle-aged man's appearance was an illusion, that this Alice Apartment was fake, just some elaborate prank.
But her woman's intuition told her: wake up!
She regretted it, truly regretted her clever idea from yesterday.
She needed comfort now. She called her boyfriend, but his secretary answered.
Said her boyfriend was in a meeting.
Ou Yingying became almost frantic.
Feeling completely insecure, since she couldn't reach her boyfriend, she decided to find Wang Ziyi and Lin Feng.
To ask them clearly what Alice Apartment was all about!
Although she'd heard the general idea yesterday and seen parts of the videos.
She still didn't fully understand.
And Ou Yingying had quite the nerve.
She was the one who got Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi into this Alice Apartment situation.
Yet now she dared to go find them.
Those two probably wanted to tear her apart alive.
...
1:00 PM.
Lin Feng, Wang Ziyi, and Ou Yingying gathered at Lin Feng's own villa.
Only the three of them were in the villa now;
all others like the housemaid had been sent away.
The three currently occupied the first-floor living room.
Wang Ziyi screamed at Ou Yingying sitting on the sofa, completely shedding her usual university beauty queen demeanor:
"Ou Yingying! You bitch! And I considered you a good friend! You said you wanted the videos to investigate whether they were real or fake, whether they were mockumentaries, but you actually leaked and spread them!!!"
If this were normal times and Ou Yingying was cursed at like this.
She would definitely talk back, but this time she stayed silent out of guilt, head bowed like a well-behaved child who'd done wrong.
But Wang Ziyi's subsequent curses became too vicious.
Ou Yingying looked up and said: "Stop cursing! It's useless! Both of you have to move in, and so do I! That middle-aged man notified me too!!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Ou Yingying's Boyfriend Turns Out to Be a Black Software User Too
chapters.content:
Upon hearing this, Wang Ziyi responded with a cold laugh: "We already knew without you telling us. After all, you're the one who caused this disaster. If you don't go in, there's no justice in this world!"
Ou Yingying retorted angrily: "I admit I'm the one who caused this, but don't you bear any responsibility at all?!"
"Why didn't you tell me there would be such serious consequences back then?!"
Wang Ziyi laughed in frustration, her beautiful face filled with indignation:
"How could I not have told you? Didn't I say that the video absolutely must not be leaked? Otherwise it would cause major trouble?!"
Hearing this, Ou Yingying felt deep regret.
Because back then, the "major trouble" she imagined was that if leaked, it would cause big problems for Lin Feng himself and his family's corporate group. She never imagined the major trouble would fall upon herself!
"Enough! Now all three of us have to go in! I came here to ask you for more information about Alice Apartment!!!"
"Also, just because that person tells us to move in, we have to move in?! This is violating our personal freedom rights!"
Ou Yingying seethed with anger: "We three should unite! I refuse to believe that if we simply don't move in, there's anything he can do to the three of us?!""Enough, enough, Ou Yingying, I've had enough. You got us into this mess. Now you come here wanting to learn more information and talk about cooperation? You should be grateful I'm not causing trouble for you! And you're still here blabbering nonstop."
At this moment, Lin Feng, who had remained silent until now, finally spoke.
He immediately fired back at Ou Yingying.
Ou Yingying said: "I admit it's my fault, so now I'm trying to make up for my mistake."
"The three of us should cooperate. After all, you both know more about that Alice Apartment than I do."
Lin Feng stood up and said: "Fine, your words have convinced me. We can cooperate, but I need to see your sincerity."
Seeing an opportunity for cooperation, Ou Yingying immediately asked what kind of sincerity he meant.
The corner of Lin Feng's mouth curled up: "Spend one night with me."
Hearing this, Ou Yingying's face instantly turned cold.
Lin Feng tilted his head: "What's wrong? Don't even have that much sincerity?"
Ou Yingying stood up, turned around, and left without hesitation.
After Ou Yingying left the villa, Wang Ziyi cautiously asked Lin Feng: "Honey, do you really crave Ou Yingying's body that much?"
Lin Feng immediately snapped back: "Crave your ass, you foolish woman! Can't you tell I was just making up any excuse to force her to leave?! Right now, even if you brought a whole group of beautiful women before me, I wouldn't have any interest!"
Wang Ziyi became submissive after being scolded.
She knew she still needed to rely on Lin Feng.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Lin Feng then said: "However, just because that middle-aged man tells me to move in, I'll move in? Not putting up any resistance at all—that's not my style, Lin Feng!"
...
Returning to her boyfriend's villa, Ou Yingying began to regret her actions.
She shouldn't have just walked away like that. At the very least, she should have dragged out the time to extract some useful information.
Now, all she had was what Wang Ziyi said yesterday and the recorded videos.
She took out her phone and opened those video recordings again, watching them repeatedly.
Around 8 PM that evening.
Her boyfriend returned.
When Ou Yingying's boyfriend came back, he saw that she had already fallen asleep on the large sofa in the villa's first floor.
She didn't have anything covering her.
So he considerately picked her up, intending to carry her back to the bedroom.
But the moment his hands touched her, the sleeping Ou Yingying suddenly started crying.
"What's wrong? Baby, did you have a nightmare?"
Ou Yingying's boyfriend immediately hugged her and comforted her softly.
"Wuwu"
Ou Yingying just kept crying.
Her boyfriend sensed something was wrong with his girlfriend—after all, they spent every day together.
So he asked Ou Yingying what exactly had happened.
Ou Yingying said she had gotten into big trouble.
Her boyfriend asked what kind of trouble?
Ou Yingying then told him everything—yesterday's gathering of the four girls, the middle-aged man coming to see her this morning, including her visit to Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi.
She recounted everything completely, without exaggerating or omitting a single detail.
Actually, after returning in the afternoon, Ou Yingying had realized that now only her boyfriend could help her.
"You have to believe me! Jiankang! Everything I said is true! I'm not making up a story! This isn't some novel plot!"
After finishing, Ou Yingying, afraid her boyfriend might think she was joking, repeatedly emphasized her point.
Ou Yingying's boyfriend was called Ouyang Jiankang.
After hearing everything Ou Yingying said.
Ouyang Jiankang's face indeed showed expressions of shock and astonishment.
He said: "I believe you, but you should go upstairs first. Give me some time to think about how I should help you."
Ou Yingying went upstairs, still crying pitifully before going up.
After watching Ou Yingying go upstairs.
Ouyang Jiankang's originally heavy and solemn expression became increasingly complex.
He sat on the sofa and took out his phone.
What no one could have possibly expected was.
He kept swiping his phone screen until he found a mobile APP called Black Software.
That's right—Ou Yingying probably never imagined.
Not only was her boyfriend also a user of Black Software, but he was also an old-timer in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
Even longer than the Middle-aged Uncle and the others.
He just usually didn't like to comment!
This was also why Ouyang Jiankang, after hearing Ou Yingying's account, didn't offer any rebuttal and simply said "I believe you."
Ou Yingying thought this was Ouyang Jiankang's trust and love for her, but it actually wasn't that at all.
"Yingying, oh Yingying, you've always been so smart. How did you manage to bring such a huge disaster upon yourself this time!"
Ouyang Jiankang murmured to himself at this moment.
As another old-timer who had watched who knows how many rounds of the live stream room.
Ouyang Jiankang immediately recalled a young rich second-generation heir from back then whose family business was worth over five billion.
He also recorded a video that accidentally got leaked. At that time, he didn't believe it would matter—if he didn't want to move in, could they really force him?
In the end, he fled abroad with fifty-plus bodyguards around him every day, but was still captured and brought back, becoming a lab rat.
Over five billion!
His own family business was only worth over six billion.
Could having an extra billion in assets really change the outcome?
Forget about an extra billion.
Even if Lin Feng's family assets exceeded ten billion, could they protect Lin Feng?
"Yingying, I really do like you quite a bit. You're very smart."
"But sometimes you're too fond of acting on your own cleverness."
"If this time, instead of taking matters into your own hands wanting to surprise me, you had consulted me first, couldn't this have been completely avoided?"
"Never mind, never mind. This might just be your fate."
"I can only try to help you one last time."
Ouyang Jiankang didn't have any good solutions to help Ou Yingying either. He could only try to send her abroad and hire more bodyguards for her.
That was all he could do.
...
Jiang Ran was still working that night, having just helped a resident unclog their drain and coming out of their home.
After coming out, his phone suddenly buzzed—probably a text message had arrived.
While walking toward the elevator, he took out his phone and turned it on.
He opened the text message.
At first it was just a casual glance.
He was about to put his phone away.
But the next second, it was as if there were nude photos of a female celebrity on his phone.
His eyes locked onto the phone screen.
Wishing he could crawl right into the device itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: 350,000 Yuan, Finally Arrived
chapters.content:
This text message was a bank deposit notification.
[Your account ending 191 has received a UnionPay deposit, income amount: 350,000 yuan
Balance: 350,100 yuan, transfer party: (You Sha Qi Royalty Payment)]
(From the first day of moving in until the end of round 27, exactly five weeks totaling 350,000 yuan)
(The previous water and electricity fees and property fee bills covered 25 days, and due to different settlement dates, only 25 days were settled)
A deposit message suddenly appeared.
Especially such a huge amount of 350,000 yuan.
Jiang Ran wondered if he was seeing things?
After confirming he wasn't seeing things, he suddenly thought - could this be a scam?
He opened the corresponding banking app and found that the money had indeed arrived.It wasn't any scam message.
So where did this sudden windfall come from?
You Sha Qi Royalty Payment.
"You Sha Qi?!"
Jiang Ran stood still and began recalling the original host's memories, searching for anything related to You Sha Qi.
Finally, he found it.
After the original host was dumped by his girlfriend.
Besides working multiple jobs in real life.
He had also taken on several roles online.
Drawing comics, writing novels, making videos as a streamer.
Then eventually, he gave up all these online activities and returned to reality.
Why?
Because they all failed miserably.
And You Sha Qi's full name was: You Sha Qi Comics, a comic app.
This was the platform where the original host had published his comic works.
Quickening his pace, Jiang Ran returned to room 304.
Using his phone and computer, he downloaded You Sha Qi Comics.
Simultaneously, Jiang Ran found the author backend of You Sha Qi Comics.
He successfully logged in using the original host's phone number.
After logging in successfully.
He discovered the original host's author name on You Sha Qi Comics was: I Want to Make Money Like Crazy.
Then he clicked on the work platform.
Found that the original host had published two comics he drew himself.
Jiang Ran clicked open and began examining them carefully.
The first comic was called: "Love Abyss"
Jiang Ran briefly browsed through it and found it was just a very ordinary romance-oriented comic.
It told the love story of a male and female lead who were together from university until graduation when they separated.
Guess who the prototypes of the male and female lead were?
That's right, the original host and his ex-girlfriend Shen Xing.
The story plot in the comic was quite similar to the scenes of the original host dating Shen Xing in Jiang Ran's memories.
Basically drawing their love story.
This comic was already completed, over a hundred chapters total.
Jiang Ran opened You Sha Qi Comics on his phone.
Searched for "Love Abyss".
Discovered that this comic was a complete failure of a work.
The work had very few comments.
His gaze returned to the computer's author backend.
