Found that with this comic, the original host was purely surviving on the monthly attendance bonus.
Other income each month was just over ten yuan, or even just a few yuan.
"No wonder, these days pure romance genres seem to have passed their peak popularity period..."
This one interested Jiang Ran somewhat;
probably the original host realized his first debut work wasn't popular, so for the second one, he went with the recently popular apocalypse genre comic.
Unfortunately, this comic performed slightly better than the previous one, but was still just scraping by for the attendance bonus.
The original host's drawing skills, pacing, narrative, and story plot were still somewhat unsatisfactory.
So, this one wasn't even completed, only fifty-some chapters.
The original host posted a discontinuation notice.
Saying he had failed miserably, and never planned to draw comics again...
After reading all this, Jiang Ran found the income section in the author backend.
Discovered that the 350,000 yuan he just received.
All came from the first comic work "Love Abyss".
But Jiang Ran had just checked on his phone - wasn't this a failed work?The source of thɪs content is ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Just surviving on attendance bonuses!
Then how did it suddenly have so much income?
He carefully searched for clues again.
Found that this 350,000 yuan all came from reader donations.
The donor was a single reader named: Spring Has Come, Summer Has Come Too.
From the personal interface, it appeared to be a female reader.
She had been continuously donating to this work while also posting her comments:
[So touching, reading this work feels like returning to my university days...]
It seemed this female reader super loved this work, hence the crazy donations and lavish tipping.
Jiang Ran stared at this female reader's completely dominant first place position on the donation rankings for this failed work, feeling somewhat emotional.
Liking a work means they can casually donate this much money!
If this money were spent elsewhere, it could fully subscribe to who knows how many comics!
Rich woman! Amazing!
Of course, besides feeling emotional, he also felt the original host was truly unlucky!
Now though, it benefits him instead.
Suddenly having 350,000 yuan.
Jiang Ran still felt somewhat dreamlike, unable to believe it.
Suddenly having such a huge amount of money for him, he didn't even know what to do with it.
After calming down for quite a while, he finally remembered what he needed to do.
He needed to repay money.
Repay Wang Qingzhao for the medicine money.
But looking at the pitch-black darkness outside the window, repaying money would have to wait until tomorrow.
The next day, 8:00 AM.
Jiang Ran appeared on the first floor and asked Manager Xiao Zhang for a day off.
After Jiang Ran finished requesting leave, he suddenly heard rumbling sounds coming from outside the apartment building.
He quickly walked a few steps and looked through the glass automatic sensor door.
Saw many trucks driving into the apartment complex through the main gate.
Plus many men dressed as workers, all carrying various tools, who scattered left and right after entering through the main gate.
Jiang Ran asked Manager Xiao Zhang what was happening.
Manager Xiao Zhang said the apartment owner was planning to build another apartment building next to theirs.
Their current building would be Number 1 Building, and the one next to it would be Number 2 Building.
This way, more residents could move in.
Additionally, the apartment owner had bought much land near Alice Apartment.
Planning to expand and construct some other facilities.
Understanding what was happening, Jiang Ran wasn't curious anymore.
After all, these matters didn't concern him.
Wait, building another apartment building, having another building's residents move in - wouldn't this increase the workload for apartment staff like them?
...
Jiang Ran had made an appointment with Wang Qingzhao last night.
Wang Qingzhao had readily agreed.
So at 9:00 AM, the two met at a large coffee shop in the city center.
Jiang Ran ordered two iced coffees.
And generously told Wang Qingzhao it was his treat.
Hearing Jiang Ran was treating, Wang Qingzhao teasingly asked if he had struck it rich.
Jiang Ran smiled without answering.
Said: "You could say I came into some small fortune."
"So I asked you out today specifically to repay you."
"Those two bottles of medicine you gave me last time were 25,000 each, so two bottles make 50,000, right? Give me your phone, I'll scan and transfer to you."
Seeing Jiang Ran looking like he genuinely intended to repay, Wang Qingzhao's two large eyes widened even more.
"Oh my, after three days apart, one should regard someone with new respect."
"In such a short time, you already have money to repay me?"
"Tell me, Jiang Ran, did you do something illegal?"
"Like... being a male escort?"

chapters.title: Chapter 177: The 28th Round Begins Broadcasting
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran had a dark expression on his face: "I would never sell myself out."
Wang Qingzhao gently lifted her chin: "Then how did you suddenly get so much money? Could it be you're being kept by a wealthy woman?"
Jiang Ran shook his head: "Stop guessing. Anyway, the money came through legitimate means."
Wang Qingzhao clapped her right hand against her left, suddenly enlightened: "I know! You must have taken out online loans! Jiang Ran, online loans are no good! You won't be able to pay back the interest!"
Jiang Ran was completely speechless: "Ah, my old classmate, please stop guessing. The more you guess, the more outrageous it gets. Just assume I won the lottery."
Wang Qingzhao said: "Then you must have won the lottery, otherwise I can't figure out how you suddenly got so much money."
Wang Qingzhao took out her phone and had Jiang Ran scan her payment code.
After receiving the payment, Wang Qingzhao was shocked.
"Jiang Ran, why did you give me 100,000?"
Jiang Ran said: "50,000 is to repay you for the medicine. The remaining 50,000 is to ask you to buy me two more bottles. The two bottles you gave me are almost finished."Wang Qingzhao: "Understood."
Jiang Ran: "Of course, as compensation for your effort in buying the medicine for me, everything today is on me."
Wang Qingzhao: "Then I won't stand on ceremony."
Jiang Ran smiled: "No problem, I need you to not stand on ceremony."Discover more novels at Nov3lFɪre.ɴet
Jiang Ran thought Wang Qingzhao saying she wouldn't stand on ceremony was just talk.
Unexpectedly, she truly didn't stand on ceremony.
Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao played around everywhere for the whole day.
To be precise, Wang Qingzhao took the lead.
Wang Qingzhao directly spent over ten thousand yuan of his money.
Yes, in one day, they played away over ten thousand yuan.
Equivalent to one month's salary as an assistant manager at Alice Apartment.
Regarding this, although Jiang Ran now had huge sums of money.
It was impossible to say he didn't feel heartache.
However, since he had previously said not to stand on ceremony.
Then he had to keep his word.
Although he spent quite a lot of money, Jiang Ran himself had a very good time.
He ate many things he hadn't eaten before.
Considered a gift to himself during this period.
The two played until 8 PM before each returned home.
While the two were crazily playing around everywhere.
They completely failed to notice a man silently watching them from behind.
His gaze hardly left them for a moment.
This man was that almost forgotten ex-boyfriend of Wang Qingzhao—Zhao Jie.
Although Zhao Jie was Wang Qingzhao's ex-boyfriend, his obsession with her was deeply engraved in his bones.
Because of this.
Since being dumped, he had been following and stalking Wang Qingzhao like a creep.
Finally, on this day, he saw Jiang Ran and Wang Qingzhao playing around everywhere like a couple.
He completely broke down.
Finally, he made a resolution.
"Qingzhao, Qingzhao, didn't you dump me back then?"
"Thanks to you, I'm now so obsessed with you that I'm going crazy."
"I want you to suffer the same pain!"
"Every boyfriend you find in the future, I'll make them disappear from this world!"
"You find one, I'll kill one!"
"I'll make you return to my side!!!"
"I'll make you never dare leave me again!!!!"
"I'm going to Alice Apartment right now to buy an apartment and move in!"
"That Jiang Ran is working there as an assistant manager, right?!"
"Just watch how I torture him to death!!!!"
Poor Jiang Ran had been targeted by yet another person.
Even though he and Wang Qingzhao weren't in a boyfriend-girlfriend relationship.
...
Diamond Bachelor hadn't slept well these past few days.
Only three to four hours each day.
The rest of the time was spent hunched over the computer, repeatedly reviewing information about deranged criminals and deranged serial killers in Korea's Alice Apartment.
Last time in Maple Country, she had chosen Robert.
Who was among the top three in murder count at Maple Country's Alice Apartment.
And even carried the title of one of the world's top ten serial killers.
Yet in front of Jiang Ran, he was like a chick.
Useless, completely useless.
So this time, she wouldn't be deceived by external vanity again.
She wanted to choose someone who could truly kill Jiang Ran.
Not worthless trash like Robert who only had fame.
But choosing someone who could truly kill Jiang Ran was also very difficult.
Because Jiang Ran was too hard to kill.
Although Diamond Bachelor deeply hated Jiang Ran, she had to admit this.
Therefore, selecting such a person from Korea's Alice Apartment.
Was genuinely not easy.
However, ultimately, Diamond Bachelor still selected one.
This one's murder count in Korea's Alice Apartment only ranked in the top 20.
But being chosen by Diamond Bachelor to kill Jiang Ran.
This data couldn't represent everything.
After Diamond Bachelor made her selection.
In Korea's Alice Apartment, the chosen deranged serial killer was notified by the people there.
After being notified, the chosen deranged serial killer.
Also received a message that Diamond Bachelor had paid 10 million from her own pocket to the organizers.
So she could convey a message to this deranged serial killer she had chosen.
Without this transmitted message.
This deranged serial killer would only receive the following information:
A live stream room user from Hua Country's Alice Apartment has chosen you to go to their side and kill a lab rat.
What this lab rat is called.
And photos, which apartment number they live in.
Nothing else.
The message Diamond Bachelor spent 10 million to leave was:
Jiang Ran has dissociative identity disorder. The main personality is weak, but once in danger, alternate personalities take over. The alternate personalities are very strong.
Last time, I used my privilege to call Robert from Maple Country's Alice Apartment, one of the world's top ten deranged serial killers, to kill him, but it failed.
I hope you succeed.
...
Time passed quickly.
Soon it was time for the Far Neighbor game's 28th round broadcast.
The familiar live stream room, the familiar female host.
And the familiar chatterboxes in the live stream room.
Middle-aged Uncle: 【This round is later than previous ones—there was a two-week gap this time.】
Domineering Female CEO: 【Right, I got used to one week. Suddenly waiting an extra week made me quite impatient.】
Fairy Sister: 【Where's Ultimate Rich Kid? Isn't he usually the most active among us? Come out quickly!!】
Little Dragon Girl: 【Maybe he's busy?】
Little Aunt: 【I think he's probably busy and didn't make it for the broadcast.】
I am the Hero: 【Don't wait. Thanks to you all, if nothing unexpected happened, he became this round's lab rat.】
These sudden words momentarily silenced the live stream room.
Only then did it return to normal.
Middle-aged Uncle: 【???】
Domineering Female CEO, Fairy Sister, Little Dragon Girl, Little Aunt: 【?????】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【Are you joking? Last round we were joking about who would become a resident and vote for each other, and he really went in?】

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Two People Sharing the Same Lab Rat Number
chapters.content:
I am the Hero: ["He's my real-life friend, no need to lie to you all. Besides, if I were lying, the lab rat introductions are about to start, and any falsehood would be quickly exposed."]
Middle-aged Uncle: ["Alright then, let's wait for the host to introduce them. I still find it hard to believe that guy actually became a resident..."]
"Welcome everyone to the live stream room for the 28th round of 'Far Neighbor' game."
"I'm your old friend."
At this moment, in the pitch-black screen of the live stream room.
The long-haired beautiful host wore a white-yellow form-fitting qipao, with a blue gemstone necklace around her snow-white neck that emitted eye-catching, dazzling fire - clearly of considerable value.
Holding a speech script, she spoke in a beautifully melodious voice:
"Respected live stream room users."
"Advance notice."
"The 28th round game differs from previous rounds.""Previous rounds each had five lab rats, but this round has more than five."

Damn, could it be that the Ultimate Rich Kid really got in?
The long-haired beautiful host continued:
"This round has too many lab rats, let me explain slowly."

"Hehe, calling it an introduction, but he's an old acquaintance, so no need for introductions. The only thing to note is that if Jiang Ran successfully survives this round, he will break the all-time highest survival record for lab rats."

"Lab Rat No. 2 is the person everyone in the live stream room has been particularly concerned about - whether he entered and became a resident - the Ultimate Rich Kid!"
As these words were spoken.

And now, this guy actually went in?
Middle-aged Uncle: ["Fuck! Is he crazy?! He really went in?! Going in to experience life?!"]
Domineering Female CEO: ["Honestly, if it were anyone else from the live stream entering, I might think they leaked information and violated some live stream rules, but him... I really think he might have just acted on a whim..."]

The long-haired beautiful host continued at this point:
"Ultimate Rich Kid, real name Lin Feng, male, 25 years old."
"Son of the chairman of the billion-dollar Lin Corporation."
"Wang Ziyi, female, 19 years old, an art college student, one of the top ten campus beauties, Lin Feng's girlfriend."
While introducing these, similar to previous rounds.
An electronic screen appeared behind the long-haired beautiful host.
Displaying the lab rats' information and photos.
"Now let's talk about how these two became lab rats."
"While watching the live stream, Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng's girlfriend, Wang Ziyi, liked to record videos with her phone. Thus she recorded many videos."
"After the 27th round ended, during a gathering with female friends, she bragged about Alice Apartment and even showed several female friends the videos."
"One of these female friends asked for the videos, claiming on the surface that she wanted to verify their authenticity, not believing in Alice Apartment's existence, thinking it was a movie, but secretly planning to spread the videos, create public opinion, and severely damage Lin Feng's family corporation."
"This is the reason these two became lab rats."
After hearing these reasons.

Domineering Female CEO: ["It's unjust, but also not entirely unjust! Didn't the Ultimate Rich Kid previously say in the live stream that he wasn't watching alone, that his girlfriend was with him? I remember someone advised him to control his girlfriend?"]
Little Dragon Girl: ["That was me. I told him to keep his girlfriend in check, not to blabber about anything, otherwise his girlfriend would be in trouble, and he wouldn't escape either."]
["At that time, he was full of confidence, saying he understood, not to worry, he had already spoken to his girlfriend."]
["Looking at it now, hehe, but his girlfriend is also quite something, actually recording videos..."]
Domineering Female CEO: ["So you see, the Ultimate Rich Kid isn't entirely blameless either. Who told him not to control his girlfriend properly?"]
Fairy Sister: ["But ultimately, it wasn't the Ultimate Rich Kid and his girlfriend who spread the videos. The one who actually spread them shouldn't escape either."]
At this point, the long-haired beautiful host said: "Yes, Fairy Sister is right, she won't escape either."
"Now let's introduce Lab Rat No. 3."
"Lab Rat No. 3 is the same as Lab Rat No. 2 - both consist of two people."
"The first person is called Ou Yingying, female, 23 years old. It's worth mentioning that her boyfriend is also wealthy, and something Ou Yingying doesn't know - her boyfriend is actually also a user of this live stream room."
"The second person, let's call him Little Zhao! Male, 33 years old."
"These two entered for the following reasons."
"Ou Yingying is that female friend of Wang Ziyi who asked for the videos."
"After obtaining the videos, Ou Yingying ordered a loyal lackey from her boyfriend's company to spread the videos, making as big a scene as possible."
"That lackey is Little Zhao. Little Zhao edited and prepared everything, but shortly after posting the videos, we discovered them."
"Subsequently, these videos were banned online. Then we located Little Zhao's position and apprehended him."
Along with the introduction, information and photos of Ou Yingying and Little Zhao similarly appeared.
The live stream users and audience who learned the whole story.
Finally understood everything completely.
Middle-aged Uncle: ["So that's how it happened!"]
["Hey, Ou Yingying's boyfriend is also a user of this live stream room?"]

This was the first thing Ouyang Jiankang did.
The second thing was: preparing two handguns and several boxes of bullets for them.
With the truth in hand, even if they encounter danger, not only can they protect themselves, they might even counter-kill.
The final thing was finding this bodyguard.
It took tremendous effort and dedication to find him.
This bodyguard is absolutely reliable.
A retired special forces soldier from America.
And, calling him a bodyguard isn't quite accurate - he's more like an ancient death warrior.
The kind who would take a blade for his master.
You say you don't believe?
Hah, let me tell you Golden Beard's story.
Golden Beard has a daughter with a genetic disease.
She requires massive amounts of money for treatment every year.
To raise money to keep his daughter alive, Golden Beard would do anything, even become a dangerous mercenary.
Later, one of Ouyang Jiankang's overseas friends took notice of Golden Beard.
Gave him money so he could treat his daughter.
Besides this, he also offered a substantial monthly salary.
The only condition was to become his friend's most loyal death warrior.
Indeed, Golden Beard later risked his life several times to save this friend.
Absolutely trustworthy!
It was at this time that Ouyang Jiankang reached out to this friend.
Thus the friend arranged for Golden Beard to work for Ouyang Jiankang.
Of course, Ouyang Jiankang definitely made some benefit exchange with that friend.
Otherwise, why would that friend casually give away the death warrior bodyguard he raised?
Besides this, Ouyang Jiankang also privately gave Golden Beard an amount of money he could never earn in his lifetime.
Equivalent to buying his life.
Therefore, Ouyang Jiankang had truly done everything he could for his girlfriend, Ou Yingying.
There was nothing more he could do.
After all, he was facing the entire Alice Apartment.
His own feeling:
An ant trying to shake a giant tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Vicious Dog
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran went out in the morning to buy groceries, beverages, and other items.
By the time he returned, it was already 10:00 AM.
As he walked back, passing by the security guard booth.
He got quite a fright.
The reason was, at the security booth area.
Security Captain Xiao Gao, along with several other young security guards.
Each held in their hands an extremely fierce large dog.
Although Jiang Ran didn't know much about dogs.
He frequently came across pet bloggers on TikTok, including news about vicious dog attacks, so he could still recognize several breeds.
From Security Captain Xiao Gao, Jiang Ran recognized the muscular tan-colored Pit Bull.And the black Rottweiler with symmetrical orange-red circular markings near the eyes close to the nose bridge.
There were several other dogs that Jiang Ran couldn't name, but judging by their appearance and size.
Each one looked fierce and menacing.
They clearly didn't seem easy to deal with.
Jiang Ran then asked curiously: "Captain Gao, where did these dogs come from? Are they from your security team?"
Security Captain Xiao Gao, hearing Jiang Ran's question, said: "How could that be? Our security team couldn't afford to keep these dogs. These are all kept by one of the apartment residents."
Jiang Ran: "Really? A new resident?"
Jiang Ran had lived here for quite some time and didn't remember seeing these dogs at Alice Apartment before.
Security Captain Xiao Gao said: "No, an old resident. They've lived here for many years."
Jiang Ran: "Is that so? Then how come I've never seen them before?"
Security Captain Xiao Gao: "That person usually doesn't walk the dogs during daytime. They always walk them late at night, so you haven't seen them."
Jiang Ran: "Then this time is...?"
Security Captain Xiao Gao said: "Always walking them late at night isn't ideal, so they asked us to help walk the dogs during daytime, while also using these dogs to protect the apartment residents."
Jiang Ran originally wanted to ask—he remembered that Nancheng City prohibited keeping large breed dogs, didn't it?
But adopting a "better avoid trouble than invite it" attitude.
He decided not to ask.
However, he still had one question: "Strange, I notice these dogs aren't barking at all?"
Yes, from the moment Jiang Ran saw these dogs, they hadn't barked once, including when they saw him, a stranger.
This somewhat didn't match typical dog behavior.
Security Captain Xiao Gao said: "Their owner trained them well. If they bark randomly, they'll get slapped hard."
"And besides, it's not yet time for them to bark."
Security Captain Xiao Gao suddenly smiled mysteriously.
This smile made Jiang Ran quite uncomfortable, so he said: "Then I hope I never encounter the time when they need to bark."
At this moment, Jiang Ran stared into these dogs' eyes and noticed their gazes were extremely fierce.
Moreover, as he stood there, all their attention focused entirely on him.
Although they didn't bark.
Their mouths hung open, disgusting white drool continuously dripping.
Flowing from the edges of their mouths down to the cement ground.
They looked exactly like they had spotted prey.
Wanting to devour Jiang Ran whole.
"Better stay away from these big dogs."
As Jiang Ran entered the Alice Apartment area.
The Danger Warning System activated: [Ding! Detected host in dangerous area, please leave quickly! Points +5! Points +5!]
Then it changed to.
[Ding! Detected dangerous person! Please leave quickly! Points +2! Points +2!]
[Ding! Detected dangerous person! Please leave quickly! Points +3! Points +3!]
Finally becoming:
[Ding! Detected dangerous animal! Please leave quickly! Points +1! Points +1!]
Honestly, this was the first time Jiang Ran encountered the Danger Warning System warning about animals...
But even without the Danger Warning System alerting him about these dogs.
Jiang Ran would still wisely keep his distance.
Never mind whether he feared dogs or not—these particular dogs simply looked too terrifying.
Jiang Ran brought the groceries and other items back to his apartment, Room 304.
Then went to the first floor.
To find Manager Xiao Zhang.
Today there would be another welcome party.
So Manager Xiao Zhang sought Jiang Ran to discuss this welcome party.
What to eat? What to drink?
Like last time, should they do barbecue and deep-fried skewers, or stick to their usual specialty of cake?
Jiang Ran seriously suspected that Manager Xiao Zhang always chose cake for welcome parties purely because he wanted to eat it himself.
But didn't want to spend his own money.
Hence, they always ended up with cake.
But if you really asked Jiang Ran what to eat, he didn't know either.
Finally, after some discussion between them.
They decided on half barbecue and deep-fried skewers, and half cake.
But everyone had grown tired of regular cake, and the weather was getting hotter.Googlᴇ search .net
Might as well order some ice cream cakes.
"Jiang Ran, besides this matter, there's another thing I need your help with."
After settling what to eat for the evening welcome party.
Manager Xiao Zhang suddenly said to Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran: "What matter?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "This time, quite a number of new residents have moved into the apartment."
"Although I've already notified these people in the group chat, to ensure we don't have another situation like last time with Wu You not showing up, I need you to go to their respective apartments and notify them in person."
Jiang Ran nodded, then asked: "By the way, what about Wu You? Now that I think about it, I only saw him once, then never again."
Manager Xiao Zhang said: "Moved away. Our Alice Apartment has very high turnover."
...
Manager Xiao Zhang privately sent Jiang Ran the list of new residents this time, along with their room numbers.
Following this list, Jiang Ran began knocking on doors one by one, delivering notifications in person.
First, Jiang Ran went to a woman named Liu Xiaoyu.
Next, two male residents: Wang Jian and Fang Xiao.
After notifying these three people.
Jiang Ran arrived at resident Zhao Jie's apartment.
Knocked on Zhao Jie's door.
Soon, the door opened.
After the door opened, Jiang Ran noticed that Zhao Jie, who had initially looked completely calm, clearly turned somewhat gloomy upon seeing him.
Zhao Jie stared at Jiang Ran, his tone somewhat impatient: "Why are you knocking on my door?"
Jiang Ran explained about the 7:00 PM welcome party, telling him he must attend, his presence required.
After hearing Jiang Ran's words, Zhao Jie slammed the security door shut with a bang.
The moment the door closed, Jiang Ran felt a strong gust of wind sweep across his face.
"Why such a bad temper? Could it be he got dumped by his girlfriend?"
Jiang Ran felt truly speechless—he was just an apartment staff member.
Why take out your anger on him?
Little did Jiang Ran know, his words had actually hit the mark.
Of course, Zhao Jie, after closing the door, didn't hear Jiang Ran's comment, otherwise he might have really lost control and thrown a punch at Jiang Ran.
After all, in Zhao Jie's eyes, Jiang Ran had stolen his ex-girlfriend Wang Qingzhao.
After closing the door, Zhao Jie returned to the living room.
Continued flipping through some books on the living room sofa.
These books mostly had dark-toned covers in black, red, and other somber colors.
Their cover images were terrifying, and the book titles somewhat chilling.
They were all things like:
"Human Anatomy"
"Forensic Clinical Science Theory and Practice"
"Luo Xiang Explains Criminal Law"
"How to Commit the Perfect Crime"
And so on.
...
Next, Jiang Ran went to Room 904 to notify Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi.
Jiang Ran thought this pair were either a couple or married.
Arriving at Room 904's door, Jiang Ran began knocking.
While Jiang Ran was knocking, what were Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi doing inside?
Lin Feng remained in the living room, still familiarizing himself with the handgun, practicing removing the magazine, loading bullets, and chambering rounds.
Wang Ziyi sat opposite Lin Feng, spacing out, watching Lin Feng repeatedly perform these actions.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: The Welcome Party — Who Dares Not Show Up?
chapters.content:
If following the usual schedule, Wang Ziyi would either be sleeping in bed, playing on her phone shopping online, or making plans with her girlfriends about where to hang out today. She was always busy with her own things.
But being suddenly brought to Alice Apartment had transformed her from an extremely busy person into someone with too much free time.
When Jiang Ran knocked, the abrupt knocking sound startled both Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi.
After the initial shock, Lin Feng quickly regained his composure. Gripping the Desert Eagle, he cautiously looked toward the security door and whispered, "Ziyi, you go open the door."
Wang Ziyi shook her head frantically. "No, I don't dare. What if there's a pervert outside?"
Lin Feng's eyebrows furrowed. "Do I need to give you face?!"
Seeing Lin Feng about to lose his temper, Wang Ziyi had no choice but to get up from her chair and carefully approach the security door. First, she looked through the peephole to see who was outside.
When she saw who was knocking and ringing the doorbell, her tense mood immediately relaxed.
"Ziyi, who's knocking?" Lin Feng asked curiously, noticing Wang Ziyi's relaxed expression.
Wang Ziyi looked somewhat surprised. "It's Jiang Ran!"Hearing Jiang Ran's name, Lin Feng also relaxed his entire body. But the next moment, his previously relaxed hands tightened again.
As the Ultimate Rich Kid, Lin Feng could say he understood Jiang Ran quite well. He knew Jiang Ran had dissociative identity disorder, and each of his alternate personalities would emerge during crisis moments to save the day. From a third-person, live stream perspective, this seemed like an ironclad rule.
But! He wasn't in third-person or live stream perspective now! This was first-person perspective. He was currently inside Alice Apartment itself. So how could he know whether Jiang Ran's other personalities might actually emerge during ordinary times? That they would only come out when the main personality faced danger?
Watching the live stream, Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng could confidently pound his chest and guarantee. But when it concerned his own life, he didn't dare take that risk. Even if the possibility was extremely small, he wouldn't gamble. After all, those personalities inside Jiang Ran's body... truth be told, each carried a sense of madness. Although none emerged for long enough to fully understand them, they still couldn't help but make people afraid.The source of this content ɪs NoveI-Fire.ɴet
But ultimately, Lin Feng still had Wang Ziyi open the door to ask why Jiang Ran was knocking.
When Jiang Ran saw the door open, a very beautiful long-haired girl stood inside, making him pause slightly. Wang Ziyi had previously seen Jiang Ran on Lin Feng's computer. This time, face to face, seeing the person from the live stream room alive right in front of her... well, it was an indescribable feeling. Anyway, she felt Jiang Ran was quite handsome.
"Hello, I'm Jiang Ran, the assistant manager of the apartment. Are you Ms. Wang Ziyi?" After appreciating Wang Ziyi's beauty for a moment, Jiang Ran immediately returned to the main topic.
"Yes, I'm Wang Ziyi," she replied.
Jiang Ran said, "Then Mr. Lin Feng is also inside?"
"Yes."
"Alright, I'm here to notify you about the welcome party at 7 PM tonight..." After informing them about the welcome party, Jiang Ran left to visit the last two people - Ou Yingying and Little Zhao.
"Darling, are we going to the welcome party at 7 PM?" Wang Ziyi asked after closing the security door and sitting back down opposite Lin Feng.
Lin Feng slightly bent his head, speaking with utter exasperation. "Have you not seen the part where the chainsaw murderer chased Wu You and hacked at him?"
Wang Ziyi looked somewhat nervous. "Of course I've seen it."
Lin Feng grew impatient. "Since that's the case, how could you ask such a stupid question? Oh wait, no - you're a foolish woman, so asking this kind of stupid question is completely reasonable."
Wang Ziyi began crying again. "Darling, lately you've really been scolding and belittling me at every turn. It really hurts me."
Lin Feng's face turned extremely gloomy. "You got me trapped here. You should be burning incense in gratitude that I'm only treating you like this."
......
Room 602.
Golden Beard, the retired American special forces soldier, had been teaching Ou Yingying and Little Zhao how to use handguns and load bullets for self-defense since arriving at 602, after drinking some water and eating a cup of instant noodles.
Golden Beard spoke in English. Ou Yingying could also speak English - not particularly proficient, but basic communication wasn't a problem. This was entirely thanks to her mother.
Her mother had been very beautiful when young, quite similar to Ou Yingying. But ultimately, her mother only married an ordinary man. She believed she had married for love, but life after marriage generated many dissatisfactions for her. Especially the life of an ordinary working-class person at the bottom made her feel the hardships.
These things were still somewhat acceptable;
the main issue came later. She saw her former girlfriends, who weren't as attractive as her, eventually choosing to marry some ugly bosses much older than them. Although their partners fell short of her husband in age, looks, and physique, they couldn't compete with having money.
Her those good girlfriends, after getting married, just spent their days eating, drinking, and playing around. Their casual daily spending amounted to several months of her salary. This made her extremely envious for a time.
So later, she had an affair. She had an affair with a wealthy boss. Of course, not long after the affair began, her husband - Ou Yingying's father - discovered it.
Then came the bizarre part. Initially learning his wife had cheated, Ou Yingying's father was also very angry and furious. But when he saw Ou Yingying's mother suddenly pull out over a hundred thousand yuan for him to spend freely, he suddenly felt this might not be so bad after all.
Thus, not only did they not divorce, but their relationship actually improved. This made that boss seem like a sucker - earning money for another family to spend.
Ou Yingying's mother deeply recognized the importance of money anyway. Love and similar things were what little girls and foolish women pursued. So she educated and cultivated her daughter from childhood to facilitate catching a wealthy husband in the future.
Like Ou Yingying, under her mother's cultivation, she could not only speak English but several other foreign languages as well. A woman shouldn't just have pretty looks;
she must have other skills too.
Returning to the main topic. Golden Beard spoke English, and Ou Yingying could also speak English. Conversely, Little Zhao couldn't speak it. Of course, Little Zhao couldn't have gotten into a large corporation without being exceptional. It's just that the foreign language he knew was the language of Cherry Blossom Country... not English.
So every time he communicated with Golden Beard, he either used phone translation or had Ou Yingying translate for him.
During the teaching and learning session among the three of them, they suddenly heard someone knocking on the security door and ringing the doorbell.
Ou Yingying had Little Zhao go open the door. Little Zhao wasn't like Wang Ziyi, too afraid to open the door. Of course, besides being male and bolder, another reason was that his understanding of Alice Apartment was far less comprehensive than Wang Ziyi's.
Little Zhao went to the security door, looked through the peephole, then turned and said: "Sister Ou, it's a young man outside. Should I open the door?"
"Young man?" Ou Yingying also came over and saw the outside man's appearance through the peephole. After seeing him, her expression became uncertain.
Ou Yingying and Little Zhao shared a fatal weakness: compared to Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi, these two people's understanding of the apartment was fundamentally incomplete.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Another Brave Soul Skipping the Welcome Party — Special Forces vs. Chainsaw Maniac
chapters.content:
Ou Yingying had indeed seen Jiang Ran in those video clips Wang Ziyi showed her.
She had seen the normal version of Jiang Ran, and she had seen the abnormal version of Jiang Ran.
The normal version of Jiang Ran was perfectly normal, while the abnormal version of Jiang Ran was extremely abnormal.
Extremely cruel.
Like when Jiang Ran was hacking at the clown with an axe.
She could even hear Wang Ziyi shouting in the video: "So amazing, so cruel!"
Then, Ou Yingying didn't understand that Jiang Ran had dissociative identity disorder.
This led to her feeling that Jiang Ran was an extremely dangerous person.
But then she remembered the information that middle-aged man had revealed to her back then—something about how to survive in the apartment, she could cling to someone named Jiang Ran's coattails.
Honestly, she didn't know whether this statement was genuine or a trap.But currently, she had a gun and protection from a retired American special forces soldier. Even if this were true, wouldn't her current setup be safer than clinging to Jiang Ran's coattails?
Setting aside the middle-aged man's words, based on the image of Jiang Ran she saw in the videos...
He was too twisted...
So Ou Yingying currently didn't dare to open the door, but there were constant knocking sounds and doorbell rings outside.
Finally, she glanced back at Golden Beard sitting on the sofa.
Golden Beard gave her a look indicating to open the door, which put her at ease.
Yes, she had an American special forces soldier backing her up.
Plus they had guns in their possession.
Therefore, what was a mere Jiang Ran worth?
She opened the door.
Seeing the door open, Jiang Ran was startled. He had been about to leave since after knocking for so long, he thought no one was inside.
"Hello, I'm Jiang Ran, the apartment's assistant manager. I'm here to notify you to attend the welcome party tonight at 7 PM. Please make sure to attend."
Jiang Ran currently stared at Ou Yingying and Little Zhao inside the door.
He noticed there were quite a lot of beautiful female residents among the newcomers!
First there was Liu Xiaoyu, then just now Wang Ziyi, and now Ou Yingying.
"Okay, I understand. Is that all?"
Ou Yingying asked.
"Yes, that's all."
After speaking, Jiang Ran glanced at that man surnamed Zhao, meaning Little Zhao.
He noticed—why had this Little Zhao's legs been trembling uncontrollably ever since seeing him?
After delivering the notification, Jiang Ran prepared to return to the first floor to report on his work, and incidentally assist Manager Xiao Zhang in preparing for the evening welcome party.
Therefore, he soon left.
The security door immediately closed again.
The moment the door closed, Little Zhao fearfully asked Ou Yingying: "Sister Ou, should we go to this welcome party?"
"Manager Xiao Zhang said in the group chat that all new residents must attend."
"And just now that Jiang Ran, the assistant manager, also said we must attend."
"But I have this feeling that this welcome party is really eerie!"
"I feel like these two people have malicious intentions!!!!"
Little Zhao had also seen those videos.
Naturally he had also seen Jiang Ran, and only when the door opened did he fully recognize Jiang Ran as that person from the videos who had once worn an utterly sinister smile.
Therefore, his legs immediately went weak with fear.
Ou Yingying thought for a while.
She began recalling the Far Neighbor game that Wang Ziyi had described to her before she saw the videos.
How this place housed all sorts of deranged criminals and perverted serial killers.
How one week constituted a round.
How each round would have five lab rats.
How lab rats would get ten thousand for surviving one day.
How live stream viewers would place bets.
And those words that mysterious middle-aged man said to her before she entered the apartment:
Because they were people who had leaked the apartment's secrets.
So, they had to get through three rounds here, and only after three rounds would they be free.
Also, there was no ten-thousand-yuan-per-day either.
Then she kept recalling Wang Ziyi's videos.
Therefore, after comprehensive consideration.
Ou Yingying made a determined decision after much thought:
"We're not going, absolutely not going to that so-called welcome party. The best scenario for both of us is to not go out, just stay at home—that's the safest approach."
"We need to treat everyone in this apartment as deranged criminals!"
"Only then can we safely get through this period!!!"
In this world, many things are most dangerous when dealing with people like Ou Yingying who only half-understand.
They think they've avoided pitfalls based on the information they've obtained, but unknowingly, not only have they not avoided the pitfalls, they've instead fallen right into them.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on noᴠelfire.net
If it were complete newcomers who knew nothing about Alice Apartment, unless they genuinely had no time like Wu You, they would definitely attend the welcome party.
Or if it were someone very familiar with the apartment like Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi, who know the consequences of not attending the welcome party.
The most dangerous are half-informed people like Ou Yingying...
Of course, the main culprit behind this situation.
Should still be Wang Ziyi.
If Wang Ziyi had recorded the complete live streams she watched.
And shown them to Ou Yingying, Ou Yingying would absolutely not make this choice.
The problem is, Wang Ziyi's video recordings are completely fragmented—a segment here, a segment there—utterly incomplete.
For example, after one welcome party ended.
Ou Yingying only saw the chainsaw murderer chasing and hacking at Wu You, but didn't have the video of the two people in the security guard booth.
The reason Wang Ziyi didn't record that part was simple—she was vomiting from disgust...
The Ultimate Rich Kid had also once commented in the live stream room that he was taking care of his girlfriend who had vomited from watching... this comment was from around the time of Xiao Xing and Zhou Wu.
Of course, Wang Ziyi vomited too many times to count. Only later did her tolerance become stronger. For example, by the time of Jiang Ran and the clown.
Therefore.
Ou Yingying completely didn't know the reason why Wu You was chased and hacked.
Also, Wang Ziyi didn't record the segment showing that Wu You hadn't attended the welcome party that time.
Making it impossible to deduce the cause and effect.
Of course, Wang Ziyi's recordings have another flaw—her phone never captured the entire computer screen properly. The live stream chat area on the far right barely appeared in any of those long recording videos.
Otherwise, Ou Yingying could have gathered more information through the chat area.
And wouldn't have made this pitfall-jumping behavior.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room.
Fairy Sister @-mentioned Ouyang Ke.
Ouyang Ke being Ouyang Jiankang.
【Ouyang Ke, your girlfriend is about to be in trouble. Aren't you going to quickly text and remind your girlfriend? To have her and that Little Zhao attend the welcome party?】
Ouyang Jiankang replied: 【No, if I did that, after this round passes, in round 29, you'd be seeing me.】
Ouyang Jiankang had no choice.
From beginning to end, he hadn't revealed to his girlfriend Ou Yingying that he was also a live stream room user.
He dared even less to watch the live stream himself and, using the live stream perspective, compile his experiences to give to Ou Yingying.
To help her avoid pitfalls.
He truly didn't dare.
Because the organizers behind Alice Apartment.
Allowed him to send his girlfriend abroad to avoid danger, hire bodyguards for her, and such.
But they absolutely would not allow Ouyang Jiankang to reveal information to his girlfriend while watching the live stream.
This would be absolutely breaking the rules.
Ouyang Jiankang commented again in the live stream room: 【Not going means not going. The consequence of not going is being targeted by the chainsaw murderer like Wu You—it's nothing serious. I hired that Golden Beard for her, a retired American special forces soldier, and I equipped them with guns. If the chainsaw murderer really dares to come, who dies isn't certain yet.】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【Thrilling! Thrilling! Probably tonight we'll get to see the chainsaw murderer battle a retired American special forces soldier!!!】
Domineering Female CEO @-mentioned Ouyang Ke: 【Ouyang Ke, if your girlfriend dies in the apartment, I'd like to interview you—what would your thoughts be? Would you seek revenge for your girlfriend?】
Ouyang Jiankang: 【Revenge? How? If Yingying really dies in the apartment, it might truly be fate, just like that clown said—everyone's destiny is completely predetermined from birth.】
...
7 PM that evening.
Still in the activity room on the first floor of Alice Apartment.
A red banner hung at the front.
Apartment residents arrived one after another.
As the apartment's assistant manager, Jiang Ran was among the earliest to arrive.
After arriving, he felt uncomfortable all over.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: The Old Dog’s Dog — Tosa, King of the Fighting Dogs
chapters.content:
What was the reason?
The reason was: previously, he thought the Danger Warning System's alerts were all just jokes.
After the incident with the clown, he realized they were real.
Then, now, watching resident after resident, all flashing with danger warning alerts, enter the activity room,
Goosebumps were rising all over his body.
Two other people shared the same feeling—the Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng, and Wang Ziyi.
Although neither had a system, both had watched the livestream and knew the people currently appearing in the activity room.
Aside from a few lab rats, the rest were all scum who deserved to be shot.Google seaʀᴄh novel·fire·net
So, after entering, even though the two tried hard to appear calm, their hands and feet, their uneasy expressions, and their chaotic breathing betrayed the fact that their hearts simply couldn't settle down.
Lin Feng thought to himself that if all these people currently in the activity room suddenly turned hostile against him, even having a gun would be useless.There were too many people.
Fortunately, that situation absolutely would not happen here.
Of course, even though he was certain, he still didn't dare to gamble, just like his previous view of Jiang Ran.
Therefore, he and Wang Ziyi specifically sat in seats near the door.
Soon,
Almost everyone had arrived.
The process was roughly the same as the previous welcome parties.
First, the new residents were asked to introduce themselves.
Manager Xiao Zhang stood on the stage at the very front, a brilliant smile on his face. He said slowly, "I'm very happy everyone could participate in this welcome party! Xiao Zhang loves you all!"
Manager Xiao Zhang made a blowing kiss gesture toward the residents below the stage.
After finishing, he continued:
"We've had quite a few new residents during this period."
"I'm very happy to have so many new friends join our big family."
"Well then, next, let's invite our big family's new members to introduce themselves!"
"First up are Mr. Lin Feng and his girlfriend Ms. Wang Ziyi!!!"
Being named first by Manager Xiao Zhang
was something neither Lin Feng nor Wang Ziyi had expected at this moment. They both took a deep breath before standing up.
First, Lin Feng introduced himself:
"Hello everyone, my name is Lin Feng, just an ordinary office worker."
Lin Feng only introduced that much before sitting down.
Next, it was Wang Ziyi's turn. Her introduction was also very simple: "Hello everyone, my name is Wang Ziyi, currently also an office worker."
These two lied more skillfully than anyone.
After these two finished their self-introductions and sat down, the gazes of the other residents began to leave them.
But some residents' eyes remained firmly fixed on them, making the two feel quite uncomfortable.
Seeing that the two had finished their self-introductions, Manager Xiao Zhang waved his hand grandly, full of enthusiasm:
"Since Mr. Lin Feng and Ms. Wang Ziyi have finished their self-introductions."
"Well then, next, let's invite the next two new residents to introduce themselves!"
"Ms. Ou Yingying, and Mr. Zhao."
His cheerful voice spread throughout the entire activity room.
But inside the activity room, not a single person stood up.
"Uh..."
Manager Xiao Zhang repeated it again, but still no one stood up.
Only then did he sweep his gaze over all the faces in the activity room before turning to ask Jiang Ran: "Jiang Ran, did Ms. Ou Yingying and Mr. Zhao not come?"
Jiang Ran also noticed these two hadn't come.
He said: "They didn't come, that's strange. I clearly notified both of them during the daytime."
Manager Xiao Zhang sighed after hearing this: "Sigh, if they didn't come, then they didn't. It's fine."
"Hehe, no 'death' indeed."
Next,
Manager Xiao Zhang continued having the new residents introduce themselves.
First was Fang Xiao.
If you had to say who among all these people present could capture Jiang Ran's attention at first glance,
it was absolutely this person called Fang Xiao.
Of course, not because he was particularly handsome.
Mainly because this guy had very long, messy hair, and the beard on his face was like overgrown weeds.
He had large eye bags and heavy dark circles.
Even from a distance away from Fang Xiao, Jiang Ran could smell the tobacco and alcohol on him.
He felt like this guy was a spirit formed from cigarettes and alcohol.
"Hello everyone, I'm Fang Xiao. I'm back again."
At this moment, Fang Xiao stood up, looked around, and abruptly said this sentence.
After he said this, immediately someone started clapping while saying:
"Welcome back, Fang Xiao. Do you know how much I missed you during the time you weren't at Alice Apartment?"
The person clapping and speaking was a somewhat balding middle-aged man.
Fang Xiao revealed a mouth of blackened yellow teeth heavily stained by tobacco and alcohol, giving a cold smile to this middle-aged man:
"Old Dog, if you missed me, then kill all those dogs you keep and give me the meat to eat."
"That dog of yours I killed back then, what was it again?"
"Oh right, I remember, a yellow Tosa Inu."
"Let me tell you, dogs from those little Japanese are really tasty."
Jiang Ran was currently standing at the far left of the activity room, against the wall.
Listening to the conversation between these two people in the activity room.
This Fang Xiao seemed to have lived at Alice Apartment before.
He wasn't a new resident for the first time.
And the Old Dog he mentioned—
was he the true owner of those several dogs he saw at the security guard booth during the daytime today?
Pulling out his phone, Jiang Ran searched for Tosa Inu on it.
This was the first time he had heard of this dog breed.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Killing the Chainsaw Maniac
chapters.content:
10:00 PM.
Some people were already asleep, while others were still having fun.
Room 602.
This was the first night Ou Yingying and Little Zhao were about to spend at Alice Apartment.
To be honest, they had been quite nervous about staying here at first, but aside from that Jiang Ran coming to notify them about attending the welcome party today, everything had been ordinary and smooth.
This led them to develop the illusion that they weren't actually at Alice Apartment.
Since Room 602 only had one bedroom.
That bedroom naturally belonged to Ou Yingying.
As for Little Zhao and Golden Beard, they were sleeping on floor mats in the living room.
After Ou Yingying entered the bedroom.Little Zhao and Golden Beard also turned off the lights and went to sleep.
Little Zhao had been in a state of anxiety and nervous tension all day today.
Therefore, lying on the comfortable bedding and pillow.
Even though his mind was still chaotic, he quickly fell asleep.
However, Golden Beard beside him kept opening his eyes from time to time.
Time passed minute by minute.
In the blink of an eye, it reached 11:00 PM deep into the night.
At 11:00 PM deep in the night, all sounds ceased, everything became terrifyingly quiet.
It was at this moment that Golden Beard, who had been lying on the bedding, suddenly sat up, his eyes like those of a shadow wolf, emitting a faint "green glow".
He stared directly toward the security door.
After about a few seconds, he stood up and turned on the living room light.
Once lit, the living room became brightly illuminated, revealing Golden Beard holding an unknown black assault rifle with both hands, standing before his bedding.
Golden Beard had been arranged to fly from America to Hua Country.
He definitely couldn't have brought any firearms, bullets, or contraband with him.
Hua Country banned guns.
Therefore, after arriving here.
Most of his equipment was provided by his employer Ouyang Jiankang.
Like the assault rifle in his hands.
Just as Golden Beard was staring intently at the security door, suddenly he noticed something from the corner of his eye.
He discovered that Little Zhao had woken up.
Little Zhao had originally been asleep, but he had a nightmare about returning to that small room and being tortured for information by those two men, which scared him awake.
After being frightened awake.
He wiped the sweat from his forehead, originally planning to get up for some water and use the bathroom, when he saw.
Golden Beard fully armed standing before the bedding, holding a black assault rifle in his hands.
Little Zhao wanted to ask what was happening, but unfortunately he didn't know English.
However, seeing Golden Beard like this, Little Zhao wasn't stupid and guessed that something might be happening.
So he quickly put on his clothes.
He wasn't like Golden Beard, who hadn't removed any of his clothes while sleeping.
After putting on his shoes and clothes, Little Zhao gripped his pistol and hid behind Golden Beard.
At this very moment.
A buzzing sound suddenly came from outside the door.
Before Little Zhao could even process what this sound was.
He saw the security door shaking, followed by something sawtooth-shaped piercing through the security door from outside, revealing just the tip of the iceberg to them.
"Ch-chain? Chainsaw?!"
Little Zhao immediately thought of those video clips he had seen.
One of them featured a chainsaw murderer wielding a chainsaw.
Because of this, his heart immediately leaped into his throat.
But the weighty black pistol in his hand and the tall Golden Beard in front of him gave him a strong sense of security.
Speaking of the chainsaw murderer, Little Zhao had actually seen that movie.
Back in college, he watched it with some ex-girlfriend.
Originally, he had beautiful fantasies - the girlfriend would get scared and burrow into his arms, and he would bravely comfort her.
But reality turned out completely opposite to his imagination.
He was terrified, while the girlfriend was completely fine, even watching with great interest.
Though he was scared, when he started reminiscing about the film after watching it.
He realized that in that movie.
The Texas Chainsaw Massacre wasn't actually that scary.
What made it scary was how unexpectedly the Texas Chainsaw Massacre appeared each time.
Also, the Texas Chainsaw Massacre had a chainsaw, while the protagonists had nothing.
If, like him, the movie protagonists had guns.
What would the Texas Chainsaw Massacre amount to?
It would be game over right from the start.
As he was thinking this.
The chainsaw had already mostly destroyed the security door.
Then, the chainsaw was pulled back by the force outside.
Then the person controlling the chainsaw outside kicked open the badly damaged security door.
Before Little Zhao could clearly see the chainsaw murderer outside.
Golden Beard in front of him had already opened fire.
It gave him quite a fright.
A series of tat-tat-tat sounds, probably because the assault rifle had a silencer attached.
So the gunshots weren't very loud.
Though the gunshots weren't loud, the bullets were real.
When the gunfire stopped.
Little Zhao covered his ears and looked ahead in terror.
He saw, before the security door.
That chainsaw murderer wearing butcher-style clothing, an ugly mask on his face, and holding a large chainsaw in his hands, already lying motionless in a pool of blood.
"He's dead just like that?!"
"Indeed! Guns are humanity's light! They are the truth!"
Little Zhao exclaimed in surprise!
At the same time, he looked at the pistol in his hand.
Originally, he had been quite afraid of this Alice Apartment.
But suddenly, he felt this place wasn't so scary after all.
On the contrary, all those deranged criminals, deranged serial killers here should be afraid of him!
After the chainsaw murderer was killed.
Little Zhao originally wanted to pat Golden Beard's shoulder and give him a thumbs up.
But he suddenly noticed that Golden Beard, who had just killed the chainsaw murderer, wasn't relaxed at all - instead, his serious expression had become even more grave.
At the same time, his gun barrel remained aimed toward the security door.

Could there still be enemies outside?!
Besides the chainsaw murderer, were there others?
"I'll go check."
Little Zhao used his phone to translate for Golden Beard.
Golden Beard didn't stop Little Zhao from going to investigate.
If Ou Yingying had tried to do this, he definitely would have stopped her.
Why?
Because Ouyang Jiankang had initially told him to protect those two people.
The most important one was that woman.
As for that man, protect him if possible, if not, just abandon him.
So Golden Beard completely disregarded whether Little Zhao might encounter danger by going forward.
Little Zhao was also pumped up from the recent events.
His whole body was excited, extremely confident.
His right hand tightly gripped the pistol ready to fire at any moment.
He imitated the police detectives from movies.
Carefully made his way to the security door area.

Gave it a few kicks with his foot.
Seeing no reaction, he sneered coldly.

Outside with your big chainsaw cutting through the door, so scary!

The remaining dogs began moving throughout Room 602.
The open kitchen.
Bathroom, living room.

Then, as if they discovered something, they began barking fiercely at the closed bedroom door.
After that, these dogs all charged violently against the bedroom door, trying to break it down.

After breaking through, the dogs prepared to swarm into the bedroom, but bang bang bang gunshots temporarily stopped them.
Ou Yingying sat by the bedroom window, both hands gripping a pistol, firing at the dog pack at the doorway.
Her beautiful face was completely covered in terror.
She had been sleeping in the bedroom but was awakened by the commotion outside - she heard the dog barks, gunshots, and Little Zhao's screams.
Then she realized something was wrong, though she didn't know exactly what!
Terrified, she dressed and considered hiding under the bed, but thought better of it. She wanted to escape through the window, but it was too high.
Finally she chose to wait quietly by the window, anxiously waiting.
She hoped that quietly waiting here would keep her safe.
She prayed frantically in her heart to all the deities she'd ever heard of - Buddha, Jade Emperor.
If she survived this disaster, she would offer incense to them tomorrow.
But unfortunately, Alice Apartment seemed to be a lawless zone.

She ultimately cried out to her boyfriend in terror.
But it was futile.
The bullets in Ou Yingying's pistol were quickly exhausted.

Ou Yingying's eyes reddened.

Unfortunately, heaven didn't answer her cries, earth didn't respond to her pleas.
Facing the vicious dogs about to bite her, Ou Yingying gritted her teeth and jumped from the sixth floor.

Her mother teaching her as a child that she must marry a wealthy man.
Meeting Ouyang Jiankang.
Her clever idea to help her boyfriend by spreading the video...

chapters.content:

[In the end, they had to dispatch numerous armed police and use firearms.]
