chapters.title: Chapter 193: Liu Jie Sneaks into Lin Feng’s Home at Dawn
chapters.content:
I'm Actually a Girl: ["So that's how it is... Hey, Old Dog has appeared, everyone look at the stream!"]
At this moment, in the live stream room's footage, the somewhat balding Old Dog appeared in Room 602, wearing leather jacket and pants.
After his appearance, those fighting dogs that had gone completely wild upon seeing Ou Yingying and the other two...
Upon seeing Old Dog, each and every one of them timidly retreated to the side.
Old Dog smoothly made his way to the corner of the living room.
To the place where Golden Beard and Little Zhao had died.
At the spot where Golden Beard and Little Zhao died,
There was only a pool of blood, minced meat, and similar substances.
As for their bodies after death,
They had been completely devoured by these fighting dogs.Old Dog remained silent, turning his head to discover one fighting dog still chewing vigorously on a human skull.
He ignored this, turned and headed toward the bedroom, and as he moved toward the bedroom,
The previously timid fighting dogs immediately pounced on the two corner areas, frantically extending their large tongues from bloody maws to lick the blood on the ground.
After Old Dog reached the bedroom and found no one, he continued to the window, leaned out, and finally saw Ou Yingying illuminated by apartment streetlights on the concrete ground below.
After staring intently for a while,
He suddenly pulled out his phone, dialed a number, and made a call:
"Those two people, I've already helped you eliminate them. For this, I've lost quite a few dogs."
"If there had been a few more gun-wielding people in this room, probably more than half of the dogs I've painstakingly raised would have died here."
After speaking, Old Dog hung up the phone.
He walked out of the bedroom.
After exiting the bedroom, he seemed to be searching for something, finally finding a black assault rifle that had been bitten in half in one dog's mouth.
Along with a pistol that had been chewed beyond use.
"I hate guns!"
Although the guns were unusable, there were still several boxes of bullets on the glass coffee table.
But Old Dog didn't even glance at them, didn't take any.
He walked to the doorway and saw the chainsaw murderer's corpse.
This corpse remained intact, not yet devoured by the fighting dogs.
So he said: "Eat all these dead ones, and come back quickly after you're done."
These fighting dogs seemed to understand human language. After Old Dog finished speaking and left, the dogs frantically fought over the many fighting dog corpses killed by bullets, along with the chainsaw murderer's body at the doorway.
At this moment, in the live stream room,
The long-haired beautiful host also appeared.
"Lab rats number 3, Ou Yingying and Little Zhao, have died! The total bet amount of 19 million has been fully transferred to the final prize pool."
Actually, judging from the 19 million figure, quite a few people had bet on Ou Yingying and Little Zhao.
Unfortunately, fate is unpredictable.
If it weren't for Old Dog and his pack of dogs,
There really wouldn't have been many who could have taken down Ou Yingying and Little Zhao.
After all, they had the protection of that retired American special forces soldier.
Middle-aged Uncle: ["Alright alright, time to sleep!"]
Domineering Female CEO: ["Finished watching the exciting show, time for me to go pamper my new young lover."]
The good show was over.
The number of people in the live stream room rapidly decreased.
Everyone was preparing to log off and sleep.
Ou Yingying's boyfriend, Ouyang Jiankang, didn't log off.
Instead, he was adjusting the cameras within the apartment.
At this moment, on his computer's live stream screen, was his girlfriend lying in a pool of blood.
Looking at his girlfriend whose head and face were severely deformed from the high-altitude fall,
Ouyang Jiankang remained silent for a long time, his expression growing increasingly cold.
Although his room was quite bright, a shadow seemed to linger persistently on his rather handsome face.
...
Round 28, Day 2, 2:30 AM.
As a professional thief,
Liu Jie likes this time for stealing the most.
Because at this hour, most people are in deep sleep.
Liu Jie stole things a long, long time ago, steals things now, and also scouts whether the property owners are male or female.
And whether they're good-looking.
After the welcome party ended, he secretly followed Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi.
Discovering the young couple lived in Room 904.
Therefore, he returned to his own home at night and slept until 2 AM.
Replenishing his energy.
Then at 2:30 AM, he arrived at the door of Room 904.
"My beauty, wait just a bit longer, soon we'll meet."
Liu Jie now pulled a piece of wire from his pocket.
Inserting it into Room 904's lock.
For a thief like him, lock-picking is an essential skill.
Soon, the door to Room 904 was opened.
He gently pushed the door open.
First sticking his head inside.
Peeking around stealthily.
Because of his long experience with nighttime activities, his night vision was better than ordinary people's.Discover more novels at nοvelfire.net
Of course, if he really needed to steal something, he would definitely still use a flashlight.
Then, his entire body entered Room 904.
And he gently closed the door behind him.
After closing the door, he pulled a palm-sized dagger from his waist.
Gently stepping forward, feeling his way toward the bedroom.
Simultaneously pulling a small flashlight from his pocket with his left hand.
He planned to reach the bedside, then directly turn on the small flashlight, shining it on the bed.
To see where Lin Feng was, so he wouldn't accidentally harm Wang Ziyi. After all, if he hurt that beauty, he would feel heartbroken.
And once he pinpointed Lin Feng's location, he would directly pounce, using the dagger in his hand to slit his throat. Giving him no chance to react.
After killing Lin Feng,
Hehe, that great beauty called Wang Ziyi would be his.
To do with as he pleased.
Thinking of this, his lower body uncontrollably stirred with excitement.
Finally, he reached the bedside, then with his left hand gripping the small flashlight, raised it, and shone it directly on the bed.
Then prepared to pounce.
However, after this illumination, what he saw stunned him.
Because on the bed wasn't Lin Feng, but only Wang Ziyi with her eyes open, a trace of terror on her face, lying on the bed looking at him!!!!
"This?! This couple doesn't sleep together? Or have I been discovered..."
Liu Jie didn't dare think about whether he'd been discovered?!
But how was this possible?!
He was acting so late, and practically silently, how could he have been discovered?!
He felt somewhat confused, preparing to turn around to see where Lin Feng actually was, but just as he was about to turn, something hard and metallic pressed against his lower back.
"Don't move!"
A cold, severe voice sounded from behind him.
"You tell me not to move, so I shouldn't move? You think you're like those TV shows, with a gun? Pressing against me?"
Facing this threatening "don't move",
Liu Jie didn't take it seriously at all.
He immediately turned around, preparing to use the dagger in his hand to stab the person behind him.
And the person behind him was definitely someone decisive.
Didn't hesitate, choosing to directly fire the gun.
Bang!
A loud sound.
A single bullet penetrated Liu Jie's lower back.
But Liu Jie didn't fall to the ground, instead spinning around, stabbing backward with his dagger, but missed.
Plus he spun too quickly, accidentally falling to the ground.
Snap!
At this moment, the bedroom light turned on.
Lin Feng stood at the bedroom doorway, holding a tan Beretta M9A3 in his hand.
Liu Jie sat on the ground, and sitting there, he currently looked somewhat incredulously at Lin Feng and the pistol in his hand.
Then, he instinctively touched his waist.
When his left hand came back, he discovered his left hand was covered in blood.
Only then did he realize that he seemed to have been shot.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Liu Jie — Dead
chapters.content:
Liu Jie had previously watched TV dramas and movies.
He always thought being shot would be extremely painful.
But this time, he had actually been shot.
For some reason, he didn't feel much pain.
If he had to describe any abnormality, it was that when the gunshot rang out, he felt like a small stone had hit his waist.
It didn't really hurt either, with almost no sensation of pain.
He wanted to stand up.
But even though he didn't feel much pain, his whole body felt unusually weak, as if he had caught a severe cold.
His vision went dark.
After a while, the pain in his waist began to surface.Once it started hurting, it felt like a knife was repeatedly stabbing him, accompanied by an intense burning sensation.
He immediately began screaming in agony.
He reached out a hand toward Lin Feng: "Quick, call! Call 120!!!!"
Lin Feng stared at Liu Jie's face.
Such an unfamiliar face.For original chapters go to .net
He took out his phone and pointed it at Liu Jie's face.
He wanted to search online.
But unfortunately, there was no relevant information about him online.
This was normal, after all, not all criminals could be found on public networks.
Of course, Lin Feng thought the Black Software would definitely have information.
But he couldn't use the Black Software now - when he opened it, there was nothing.
It was like being disconnected from the internet.
Lin Feng now raised the pistol in his right hand again.
Seeing this, Liu Jie's eyes filled with terror. Enduring the intense pain, he said:
"Don't! Don't kill me! I'm innocent!!! Spare my life!!!"
When Liu Jie saw Lin Feng take out his phone, he thought he was really calling an ambulance for him, but he had been completely mistaken.
Not only was the other party not calling an ambulance, it seemed like he wanted to kill him.
Lin Feng sneered coldly: "Breaking into someone else's home in the middle of the night, and you say you're innocent?"
"Go tell that to the King of Hell!"
Without wasting words, Lin Feng fired directly.
Several gunshots rang out.
Several bloody holes appeared in Liu Jie's forehead and body.
This time, Liu Jie was truly dead.
Lying motionless on the ground, his eyes wide open, giving the feeling he couldn't rest in peace.
Seeing Lin Feng shoot and kill Liu Jie,
Wang Ziyi on the bed wrapped the entire blanket around her delicate body, including covering her face, only revealing a pair of frightened eyes.
She looked at Lin Feng with terror, feeling his current behavior was utterly insane, completely unlike the Lin Feng she had known before.
Lin Feng had never killed anyone before.
This was his first time.
While traveling abroad, he had participated in those wildlife hunting activities in the forests.
He had killed sika deer and wolves.
But killing a person felt somewhat different from killing sika deer and wolves.
"What are you still doing on the bed? Come down and help?"
After killing the thief Liu Jie, Lin Feng tucked the gun into his waistband and prepared to dispose of Liu Jie's body.
"Oh, okay."
Hearing Lin Feng's command, Wang Ziyi immediately got out of bed and went to Liu Jie's corpse, looking completely at a loss.
"Darling, what should we do with this body?"
This was Wang Ziyi's first time seeing someone die right before her eyes, especially with Liu Jie's eyes wide open - she kept feeling like Liu Jie was watching her.
"Later we'll put it in a suitcase and just throw it in the trash downstairs."
Lin Feng said.
Having watched several rounds of live streams, Lin Feng naturally knew how to handle a corpse.
He and Wang Ziyi worked together to put Liu Jie's body into a suitcase.
Since the suitcase wasn't large, they had to break all the limbs to make everything fit.
After finishing, Lin Feng stared at the suitcase, spacing out.
Then, he suddenly burst into loud laughter.
For some reason, after killing this person who had broken into his home in the middle of the night,
he suddenly felt that Alice Apartment didn't seem so terrifying after all.
He had a gun - those so-called deranged criminals and deranged serial killers should be the ones afraid.
...
Time reached 8:30 in the morning.
The 28th round test subject Liu Xiaoyu was awakened by noises from the construction site outside.
After waking up, she couldn't fall back asleep.
She washed up, ate a cup of instant noodles by herself,
then took her handheld camera that had been charging all night to the balcony.
She opened the window and aimed the handheld camera at the construction site to film.
This handheld camera was something she had saved for a long time from her part-time jobs, plus financial help from her parents.
It cost over 100,000 in total.
She contributed over 50,000, and her parents helped with the other 50,000-plus.
Therefore, in this handheld camera's viewfinder,
the construction workers wearing hard hats and the machinery at a certain distance
all appeared extremely clearly in the frame.
It felt like filming right in their faces.
After filming the construction site for a while, Liu Xiaoyu decided to go out for some location scouting.
She still didn't put down the handheld camera, keeping it working as she walked.
As if documenting daily life.
She always had this habit, using it to help her capture things from the most beautiful angles.
She arrived on the 1st floor.
Three people appeared in the camera's viewfinder.
The first was Manager Xiao Zhang, the second was Assistant Manager Jiang Ran.
She had met these two when she first moved into the apartment.
As for... the third girl.
A slender figure, long black shiny hair. A pair of long, fair, beautiful legs.
From the back, she should be a beauty.
And when the girl turned around,
it confirmed that this wasn't just someone who looked good from behind.
When Liu Xiaoyu saw the girl's face, her jaw instantly dropped open. She wondered if her eyes were playing tricks on her?
But after rubbing her eyes and looking again, she confirmed she wasn't seeing things.
Excitedly, she ran over.
She approached the girl and showed a pretty, radiant smile.
"Excuse me, are you Ji-won unnie?"
"Unnie" means older sister in Korean.
It's how females address older sisters, not how males address older sisters.
It's a term exclusively used by females.
Suddenly having a girl run over with a handheld camera, blinking her big eyes and asking such a question
would make most people somewhat uncomfortable, especially with the camera practically in their face.
But Kim Yoon-ah wasn't angry at all. Instead, she explained as if she was used to it:
"No, I'm not Kim Ji-won, I'm Kim Yoon-ah. You've mistaken me for someone else. I just look very similar to her."
The explanation came in awkward Chinese with an accent.
Liu Xiaoyu blinked her big eyes, hearing this, her expression changed to one of confusion as she examined Kim Yoon-ah's face.
Suddenly she had an epiphany: "I know! You must be visiting Hua Country and want to keep a low profile, so you're not admitting who you are, right?"
Liu Xiaoyu wore an expression that said "I understand."
Kim Yoon-ah smiled slightly, then finally took out her passport to prove her identity.
After looking at it, Liu Xiaoyu still didn't quite believe it.
She suddenly wondered if Kim Ji-won was a stage name?
Maybe her real name was actually Kim Yoon-ah?
Only after searching online did she finally give up.
"But you look so much like her!"
"Can I take a photo with you?"
Liu Xiaoyu requested.
Kim Yoon-ah smiled: "Of course."
Then, with Jiang Ran's help, they took a photo together.
After taking the photo,
Liu Xiaoyu looked at the picture on her phone, happily saying to Kim Yoon-ah:
"Unnie, you're so beautiful, and you look so much like that celebrity."
"Would you be interested in acting in movies or TV dramas?"

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Hello, My Name Is Liu Zhou, and I’m Also a Director
chapters.content:
"Not interested at all."
Kim Yoon-ah smiled faintly.
While Kim Yoon-ah and Liu Xiaoyu were chatting, Jiang Ran nearby prepared to slip away quietly.
Damn, he had originally come down today just to get some fresh air, never expecting to run into Kim Yoon-ah, who then latched onto him.
Seizing this opportunity, he needed to make a quick escape.
Just as Jiang Ran had this thought and was about seven or eight meters from the elevator.
A voice suddenly came from behind: "Oppa! Where are you going? Take me with you!"
Jiang Ran hadn't expected that Kim Yoon-ah's attention had actually been on him the whole time.
Seeing him trying to leave, Kim Yoon-ah immediately ended the conversation with Liu Xiaoyu and chased after him.
Putting on a friendly and kind appearance.Seeing this, Liu Xiaoyu's voice from over there was neither too loud nor too soft, but just happened to reach Jiang Ran's ears:
"Oh my god, Jiang Ran is so lucky. You can tell this Kim Yoon-ah unnie really likes him. Such a beauty who even looks like a celebrity - something many people could only dream of. If it were me, if unnie was willing to date me, I'm afraid I'd be turned gay."
Hearing this, Jiang Ran wore a smile on his face while cursing inwardly.
A woman whose danger warning points kept showing +8 had been clinging to him.
He was genuinely scared.
If you Liu Xiaoyu want her, he'd give her to you, introduce her directly.
He wanted to shake her off but simply couldn't.
Somehow this Kim Yoon-ah seemed to have set her sights on him.
He really didn't want this so-called peach blossom luck.
Especially since Jiang Ran didn't yet know that Kim Yoon-ah actually had male equipment - if he knew, he'd probably be even more devastated.
After finishing her admiration for Jiang Ran, Liu Xiaoyu walked out of the apartment building.
She filmed everything around outside the building.
Regardless of anything else, Alice Apartment's environment was quite beautifully maintained.
Just then, Liu Xiaoyu suddenly heard kitten sounds.
Holding her camera, she followed the meowing sounds to a shrub area outside the apartment building.
From these shrubs, a pure white little kitten suddenly emerged.
This little kitten looked to be only about two months old.
About the size of a palm.
After coming out, it kept making cute meowing sounds at Liu Xiaoyu.
Its fluffy appearance and unsteady walking completely melted Liu Xiaoyu's heart.
"Little kitten, you're so adorable! Where's your mom? Where's your mom? If you run around like this, your mom will worry."
Immediately, Liu Xiaoyu used her hand to stroke the little kitten's back.
The little kitten kept rubbing its head against Liu Xiaoyu's hand, making her feel ticklish and very comfortable.
Just as Liu Xiaoyu was about to check if she had any food on her to give to the little kitten.
Suddenly, a well-dressed middle-aged man came running from the left.
The man's appearance was average, but he had a nice hairstyle and maintained a good figure.
Quite rare among middle-aged men who were starting to thin on top and develop beer bellies.
After approaching, the middle-aged man took out a cat treat stick from his pocket.
After tearing it open, he offered it to the two-month-old kitten.
The two-month-old kitten sniffed it, its eyes lit up, and immediately started eating.
While the kitten was eating.
The middle-aged man took the opportunity to strike up a conversation with Liu Xiaoyu beside him.
"Thank you, Liu Xiaoyu, for helping me find this little kitten."
Liu Xiaoyu found it strange that the man knew her name.
The middle-aged man explained that he had also been at last night's welcome party.
Liu Xiaoyu understood and said, "This little kitten wasn't found by me - it came out on its own, I just happened to see it."
After hearing this, the middle-aged man said, "Then this little kitten must have a connection with you. Are you planning to take it in and raise it?"
Liu Xiaoyu thought about how she only planned to stay at Alice Apartment for 7 days.
After 7 days, she would return to her own home, where she lived with her parents who didn't allow pets.
So she shook her head.
The middle-aged man then said, "Then I'll have to raise it myself."
"Did you know? This little kitten is a stray. Its mother was out looking for food for it two days ago when she accidentally got hit by a car while crossing the road."
"I usually feed them when I see them."
"Now that its mother is dead, if we leave it outside, at only two months old, it will either starve or die of thirst. If it's unlucky and falls into the hands of those who enjoy torturing cats and dogs, its death would be even more tragic."
Hearing this, Liu Xiaoyu covered her mouth in surprise, looking at the pure white kitten with sympathetic eyes.
She said, "Even if it grows up safely, that's not good either. I've seen on TikTok that pure white cats seem to have the lowest status among cats - they just get bullied when living on the streets."
The middle-aged man nodded: "Right, that's why I need to raise it. After all, it's still a life."

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Wang Qingzhao About to Meet Zhao Jie
chapters.content:
Speak of the devil and he shall appear.
Just moments ago I was complaining about no residents needing help, and now someone shows up immediately.
Sighing, Jiang Ran quickly arrived at the door of Room 802, Zhao Jie, who needed assistance.
After three knocks, the door opened.
Jiang Ran immediately stepped inside.
To be honest, Jiang Ran didn't understand why Zhao Jie had given him such a gloomy, impatient look during their last meeting.
This time, although Zhao Jie's expression had improved compared to before, his eyebrows remained tightly furrowed as always.
"Hello, how may I assist you today?"
Regardless of the residents' temperaments, Jiang Ran was ultimately a service-oriented staff member.
He needed to maintain his patience.Zhao Jie sat on a white leather sofa, legs crossed, and pointed toward the living room.
"Could you help me clean up a bit?" he asked.
Glancing around and noticing the space wasn't particularly dirty, Jiang Ran agreed.
He picked up the broom from the living room and began cleaning.
Meanwhile, Zhao Jie sat on the sofa, watching Jiang Ran's every move with intense focus.
In the depths of his eyes, waves of what seemed like blood-soaked hatred churned and roared.
Yet ultimately, these emotions remained hidden beneath the surface, never openly displayed.
Zhao Jie's family originally belonged to the ordinary working class.
Later, when their property underwent demolition and relocation, they received five apartments as compensation. His family had become moderately wealthy.
After Zhao Jie graduated from university, his parents renovated one of the apartments and let him live there independently.
Later, at the company where he worked, he met Wang Qingzhao, who had recently joined.
He became completely captivated by Wang Qingzhao from the first moment he saw her.
He adored beautiful women of the mature, sophisticated type far too much.
Thus, he pursued her relentlessly until finally, Wang Qingzhao agreed to become his girlfriend.
However, as you all know, what happened afterward...
As boyfriend and girlfriend, forget about sleeping together—they couldn't even hold hands, kiss, or put arms around each other's waists.
Walking down the street, they might as well have been complete strangers.
Eventually, he suffered a brutal breakup.
Then, later still, he resigned from his job and began stalking Wang Qingzhao.
That was when he discovered this man named Jiang Ran...
Now, he had purchased an apartment in Alice Apartment and moved in.
His goal was to kill Jiang Ran—yes, literally kill him.
Though it must be said, apartments in Alice Apartment were ridiculously expensive.
Zhao Jie sold the apartment he had been living in, but it still wasn't enough.
He had to take out a bank loan to finally afford the purchase.
Fifty thousand per square meter—Zhao Jie wanted to curse someone out.
But if it meant making Jiang Ran completely disappear from this world, then it would be worth it.
However, making Jiang Ran vanish without implicating himself presented significant challenges.
After all, he wasn't stupid—if he directly killed Jiang Ran, he would definitely get caught, and then Wang Qingzhao would never return to him.
Therefore, these past few days, he had been diligently studying various books on crime and criminal investigation.
All for the sake of committing the perfect crime.
Of course, before the day arrived when Jiang Ran would disappear, he needed to thoroughly torment Jiang Ran mentally.
"Jiang Ran, oh Jiang Ran, you bastard—what charm do you possibly possess? Just because you were university classmates with Qingzhao?"
Zhao Jie hired a private investigator.
He had Jiang Ran's background thoroughly investigated.
Although it cost quite a bit of money, the investigation yielded excellent results.
After the investigation concluded.
Zhao Jie discovered that Jiang Ran was nothing but an orphan who happened to be Wang Qingzhao's university classmate.
After graduation, he became just another drudge in society.
Absolutely no outstanding qualities whatsoever.
The only thing remotely worth mentioning was that his ancestors must have smiled upon him, allowing him to win an Alice Apartment unit in a lottery.
Beyond that, nothing else.
Zhao Jie initially suspected that Wang Qingzhao might be after Jiang Ran's apartment?
But if you really calculated carefully, Zhao Jie's family owned five apartments. While individually none were as valuable as Jiang Ran's single unit, collectively they were definitely worth more!
Moreover, although Zhao Jie didn't know the specifics of Wang Qingzhao's family background, based on their previous interactions, her family was certainly quite wealthy.
Therefore, this possibility was eliminated.
Thus, the only remaining explanation was that Wang Qingzhao simply liked Jiang Ran.
This was what infuriated Zhao Jie the most.
After all, this hurt him more than if Wang Qingzhao had been after Jiang Ran's apartment and money.
"Alright, everything's cleaned up now."
At this moment, Jiang Ran had finished cleaning the entire living room floor and spoke to Zhao Jie.
Zhao Jie gave a quick glance, then curled his lips: "Oh? Cleaned up? I'm not so sure about that."
Jiang Ran looked puzzled: "What makes you unsure?"
Zhao Jie: "Everything makes me unsure."
Jiang Ran frowned: "Point out specific areas."
Zhao Jie: "Right here."
With that, he pointed the tip of his right shoe at a white floor tile.
Jiang Ran looked carefully and frowned: "This spot is clearly perfectly clean."
Zhao Jie: "Is that so? What about now?"
He made a grating sound in his throat, gathering phlegm.
Then he spat a white glob of saliva exactly onto the spot he'd just pointed at.
Jiang Ran immediately understood—this guy was picking a fight.
But he still didn't understand.
Where had he possibly offended this Zhao Jie?
He had never even known this person named Zhao Jie before.
"Could this guy have mental problems? Some psychological disorder? Does he harass everyone he meets?"
Jiang Ran thought to himself, then used the mop from Zhao Jie's living room to clean up the spit.
"Is it clean now?"
Jiang Ran said.
Seeing this, Zhao Jie spat again.
Jiang Ran mopped.
Then, Zhao Jie spat another glob.
Jiang Ran still mopped.
This repeated about twenty more times.
Zhao Jie became embarrassed because he literally couldn't produce any more phlegm from his throat or mouth.
Finally, he noticed a glass of water on the nearby living room coffee table.
He directly grabbed the glass and poured the water onto the floor.
This poured water wasn't just water—it became the spark that ignited a war.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ n͟o͟v͟e͟l͟f͟i͟r͟e͟.net
Jiang Ran thought, fine, fine, looking for trouble on purpose, are you? Let's see who can outlast whom.
Eventually, after another half hour of stalemate, Zhao Jie surrendered.
He couldn't understand how Jiang Ran's patience could hold out.
Of course Jiang Ran could endure.
After all, he was the man who had helped the Old Man in Room 301 and achieved perfect clearance.
Thus, Zhao Jie finally surrendered and let Jiang Ran leave.
Jiang Ran thought, fine, fine, so you're deliberately picking a fight, huh? Let's see who can outlast whom.
He recorded everything completely, leaving nothing out.
It felt like he was venting his emotions through this process.
Afterward, he returned to Room 304.
Outside Room 304, a tall, graceful figure was waiting.
"Qingzhao? Why didn't you let me know you were coming?"
The elegant figure standing at the doorway was indeed Wang Qingzhao.
Wang Qingzhao gestured with a bag she held in her right hand.
The bag had English writing all over it.
Jiang Ran understood—the medication he had asked Wang Qingzhao to buy for him had arrived.
The two entered Room 304 together.
Jiang Ran casually placed his work log on the sofa, then went to the kitchen to get water for Wang Qingzhao.
Meanwhile, Wang Qingzhao curiously picked up the work log and began flipping through it.
She looked quite interested.
Just as Jiang Ran returned with a glass of plain water, Wang Qingzhao turned to the final page.
The page that recorded the incident with Zhao Jie.

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Wang Qingzhao Confronts Zhao Jie
chapters.content:
Initially, when she saw the two characters "Zhao Jie" on this page.
This name immediately made Wang Qingzhao's delicate eyebrows furrow.
After finishing reading the record.
Picking up the cup of water Jiang Ran had poured for her, Wang Qingzhao took a sip and asked casually:
"Who is this Zhao Jie guy? I just looked at the work record - isn't this deliberately targeting someone?"
Mentioning Zhao Jie, Jiang Ran's face immediately darkened: "That guy has mental problems. I don't know if he's specifically targeting me or if he treats everyone like this."
Wang Qingzhao continued asking: "Male, right? What does he look like?"
Following his memory, Jiang Ran described Zhao Jie's appearance, then asked Wang Qingzhao why she was asking so many questions - did she know this Zhao Jie?
Wang Qingzhao shook her head indicating she didn't know him, saying she was just curious.
If Jiang Ran had been more observant, he might have noticed Wang Qingzhao's expression seemed somewhat unnatural.Jiang Ran suddenly noticed Wang Qingzhao's hairstyle today was quite unique.
She had arranged a beautiful hair bun.
Especially noticeable was the hairpin inserted into her black bun - very beautiful, resembling a phoenix in flight.
But actually, it wasn't just the hair bun - Wang Qingzhao's entire outfit today followed that popular style recently seen on short videos:
Black tight-fitting long sleeves on top, red golden-flowered horse-face skirt on the bottom.
The skirt fastened around her slender waist, complementing her upper body in an extremely eye-catching way.
This style of dressing naturally suited taller women, and Wang Qingzhao happened to have exactly that mature, elegant appearance and figure.
Thus, it emphasized her particularly long legs, even though they were completely covered by the horse-face skirt.
Seeming to notice Jiang Ran looking at her hairpin, Wang Qingzhao removed the hairpin from her bun.
She displayed it before Jiang Ran.
The black-and-gold hairpin shone brilliantly under the evening sunlight.
Of course, the moment the hairpin was removed, Wang Qingzhao's hair bun, lacking the hairpin's support, instantly transformed into her usual long, straight black hair.
The two chatted for a while longer, and soon it reached dinner time.
"Will you stay for dinner?"
"No, I have things to do tonight. Maybe next time."
Since Wang Qingzhao had come to deliver medicine, after delivering it, she found an excuse to leave Jiang Ran's home.
At this moment, she waited at the elevator door, then entered the elevator.
She didn't press the button for the 1st floor, but instead pressed the button for the 8th floor.
Her tall figure appeared on the silent eighth floor, her black high heels making clicking sounds with each step.
Following what was written in Jiang Ran's work record about Zhao Jie's residence, Wang Qingzhao arrived at Zhao Jie's home.
She knocked on Zhao Jie's door.
Not long ago, Zhao Jie had been testing patience with Jiang Ran and was already in a bad mood. Thinking it was Jiang Ran again,
He rudely yanked the door open immediately, creating a gust of wind that blew into his face, causing his eyes to squint involuntarily.
When he opened them again and clearly saw the person before him, he instantly froze in place like a statue, completely motionless.
That familiar face.
Zhao Jie thought he must have been thinking about her too much, causing hallucinations.
But then the person before him spoke, pulling him back to reality.
"Zhao Jie, what are you doing here?"
Wang Qingzhao's icy tone hurt Zhao Jie's heart, his mouth twisting bitterly: "Come in and talk."
In the living room.
Wang Qingzhao still had the same question - why are you, Zhao Jie, here?
Why are you deliberately making things difficult for Jiang Ran?
Hearing these two questions, Zhao Jie's face showed both pain and resentment as he said in a deep voice:
"Qingzhao, this is our first meeting after breaking up. Instead of asking how I've been during this time, how my work and life are going, your first words are about another man?"
Wang Qingzhao tilted her head slightly to the side, her expression growing colder:
"Why should I ask about your work and life after breaking up?"
"You're really being inexplicable."
"Besides, do you think I don't know?"
"Currently, this might be our first meeting since breaking up, but this isn't the first time you've seen me after our breakup."
"I discovered long ago that you've been secretly following me. You should be happy I haven't reported you to the police! And here you are being sentimental - how disgusting!"
After hearing these words, it felt like Zhao Jie had been struck by lightning.
Too hurtful.
So all this time, while he had been constantly thinking about her, in her heart, he was just a sentimental, disgusting person?
Moreover, what Zhao Jie completely hadn't expected was that Wang Qingzhao had long discovered he had been secretly following her?
Seeing this situation, Zhao Jie knew he had to lay his cards on the table. He wanted to properly reminisce, but the other side wasn't giving him any opportunity.
At this moment, Zhao Jie's attitude and tone both became forceful:
"Yes, I've been secretly following you all along. After we broke up, I quit my job and have been following you."
"Are you satisfied?"
Wang Qingzhao only said two words: "Disgusting."
Zhao Jie pointed his right index finger at himself, then at Wang Qingzhao: "I'm disgusting? Aren't you disgusting too?"
"During our relationship, our interaction pattern was like strangers - you wouldn't even let me hold your hand. How cruel was that to me?"
"And after breaking up? I thought you were just frigid, that you were like that with me, with everyone."
"But that's not true at all!"
"After you and Jiang Ran attended that class reunion, you went to his place and stayed the night - that's the best proof!!!"
Wang Qingzhao began recalling, after finishing her recollection.
She replied: "That night, nothing happened between Jiang Ran and me. We were completely innocent. I just borrowed his place for one night - I slept in the bedroom, he slept on the sofa."
Zhao Jie laughed coldly with tears in his eyes: "Do you think I'd believe that?"
"Your little fairy tale speech - if you posted it online, who would believe it?"
"Only other women of your same gender would believe it! Would defend you!!!"
Wang Qingzhao currently slowly let out a breath: "Dirty-minded people see dirt everywhere."
Struck by these words, Zhao Jie clutched his chest, feeling intense pain as if his heart were cramping.
"Fine, fine, fine. Then what about that day not long ago when you went out with Jiang Ran - he paid for all the expenses. How do you explain that? I followed behind you that day, secretly observing. That day, the two of you spent at least over ten thousand! If there wasn't something shady about your relationship, what man would be so willing to spend money on someone?!"
Wang Qingzhao shook her head helplessly: "That was Jiang Ran thanking me for buying American medicine for him, understand?"
Zhao Jie spat on the ground: "I don't understand."
"These stories you're making up - who would believe them if you told others? Who could believe them?"
He must have rehydrated after Jiang Ran left. Otherwise he wouldn't have been able to spit.
"Whatever."
Wang Qingzhao spread her hands: "Believe it or not, that's up to you. I came today to warn you - stop deliberately making things difficult for Jiang Ran. Do you know how hard it is for him to earn money to buy medicine?"
"Hahahaha!"
Zhao Jie cried, broke down completely crying.
He wildly waved his hands around the room:
"He has it hard? Do you think I have it easy?"
"Do you know that to buy this apartment, I not only sold my own place but also took out a bank loan!!!!"
Wang Qingzhao now showed a genuinely puzzled, confused expression:
"But didn't you bring this upon yourself?"
"Did I tell you to buy an apartment in Alice Apartment?"

"Wang Qingzhao! You woman! Today I must have you!"
"And what's this about not giving Jiang Ran trouble?"
"I tell you! Not only will I give him trouble! I'm going to kill him too!"
Perhaps afraid Wang Qingzhao wouldn't believe him, Zhao Jie pulled out those books hidden under the sofa.
He threw them in front of Wang Qingzhao: "This is the price for leaving me! For every man you find in the future, I'll kill one! And what's more, I'll kill without any connection to myself! I'll haunt you forever! Until you belong to me! Marry me!"
Wang Qingzhao looked down at the books on the floor: titles like 《Human Anatomy》
《Forensic Clinical Theory and Practice》
《Luo Xiang Explains Criminal Law》
《How to Commit the Perfect Crime》.
Seeing them made her frown deeply.
She shouted at Zhao Jie:
"You're crazy, you've truly gone mad! Zhao Jie! Wake up! Murder is illegal!!!!"
Zhao Jie laughed wildly: "Exactly! Didn't I say? I'll kill without connecting to myself! Trading one for one is stupid stuff I won't do!!!"
With these words, Zhao Jie lunged at Wang Qingzhao, his hands firmly grabbing her shoulders, his large face moving toward her small face.
Wang Qingzhao was just a woman without special training, naturally no match for Zhao Jie.
And right at this critical moment.
Flickers of light continuously flashed within Wang Qingzhao's dark pupils.
This scene appeared in her eyes:
A pitch-black bronze gate slowly materialized.
A key inserted into it, unlocking the gate.
Wang Qingzhao's anxious expression vanished at this moment.
Replaced by an icy, eerie smile.
Her right hand rose, pulling out the metal hairpin inserted in her hair bun.
Suddenly feeling Wang Qingzhao stop resisting.
Zhao Jie felt delighted, thinking Wang Qingzhao had submitted and would yield to him.
But the next second, he felt a sudden stinging pain inexplicably appear on his neck.
He violently pushed Wang Qingzhao away and saw her right hand covered in blood, especially the hairpin tightly gripped in her right hand.
Zhao Jie touched his left neck with his left hand in disbelief - just one touch, then bringing it before his eyes to see his entire palm stained crimson with blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Zhao Jie, Deceased
chapters.content:
The human body has a peculiar phenomenon - when injured, you don't immediately feel pain.
That's because adrenaline floods your system in massive quantities.
Zhao Jie's current situation resembled Liu Jie's quite closely.
Yet there were differences - one was wounded in the neck, the other in the waist.
One was pierced by metal, the other shot by a gun.
Their respective pain responses differed accordingly.
When Zhao Jie realized his neck had been stabbed by a hairpin, especially after seeing the length of Wang Qingzhao's hairpin and the blood staining it...
His neck, which hadn't felt particularly painful moments before, suddenly erupted in excruciating agony.
This represents another fascinating aspect of human physiology.
Before your eyes spot the injury, you feel nothing unusual, but the moment you see the wound, that exact spot immediately begins to throb with pain.
Now, Zhao Jie lay on the ground, feeling certain the hairpin had penetrated deep into his neck.
"Call... call 120!"
Zhao Jie clutched his neck where the wound was beginning to burn with pain.
But copious amounts of crimson blood kept gushing relentlessly through his fingers, streaming outward.
He was begging Wang Qingzhao for help.
Yet Wang Qingzhao stood motionless in place, hairpin in hand, completely unmoved.
Seeing her indifference, Zhao Jie could only keep his left hand pressed against his neck while his right hand fumbled for the phone in his pants pocket.
At that moment, Wang Qingzhao finally moved. She stepped over to Zhao Jie's side, reached into his pants pocket before he could, pulled out his phone, and tossed it aside.
Zhao Jie looked up in disbelief at Wang Qingzhao's ice-cold face bearing that eerie smile.
His right hand grabbed at the hem of her red horse-face skirt.
He tried to open his mouth to plead for help.
But his throat filled with his own blood, choking him as if he were drowning and suffocating.
His windpipe was completely flooded with blood.
Wang Qingzhao continued watching Zhao Jie's desperate struggles with utter indifference.
Then she gave him a faint smile:
"Zhao Jie, thank you for becoming the first person I've ever killed."
"Your death will save Jiang Ran and me from considerable trouble. Thank you."
"So I hope you'll watch over Jiang Ran and me from the underworld."
"Consider it not entirely wasting our romantic relationship."
Apparently noticing Zhao Jie was still struggling quite vigorously -
she had finished speaking, yet he still hadn't died -
Wang Qingzhao tightened her grip on the metal hairpin with her right hand and plunged it violently downward into Zhao Jie's heart.
Thump!
The metal hairpin easily pierced Zhao Jie's chest, instantly sinking two-thirds of its length deep inside!!!
With this final stab, Zhao Jie vomited a mouthful of blood that splattered across Wang Qingzhao's face and black form-fitting long sleeves.
Spattered with blood.
Wang Qingzhao simply kept smiling, her beautiful face now splattered with blood droplets like some crimson beauty.
After what felt like an eternity of struggling.
Zhao Jie finally died filled with resentment and agony.
Ten minutes after Zhao Jie's complete death.
The long-haired beautiful host reappeared in the live stream room.
"Lab Rat No. 5 Zhao Jie has died. The total bet amount of 5.5 million has been fully transferred to the final prize pool!"
After appearing, she vanished back into the darkness.
Middle-aged Uncle watched the current live stream footage showing Zhao Jie's thoroughly dead body and Wang Qingzhao standing beside it.
Quite perplexed, he said: 【I considered every possibility except Zhao Jie dying now, especially at Wang Qingzhao's hands... I thought this idiot would die by Jiang Ran's hand... He wanted to kill Jiang Ran, then get counter-killed by Jiang Ran's alternate personality...】
Domineering Female CEO: 【Well well, just logged in to see such an spectacular scene!】
I am the Hero: 【Trash Zhao Jie, actually getting killed by a woman!】
Fairy Sister @I am the Hero: 【Don't underestimate women, underestimating women will cost you dearly. Zhao Jie serves as a living example!】
Evil Wolf: 【I'll admit this much - underestimating women brings serious consequences.】
【But this Zhao Jie, truly useless, completely worthless. Wanted revenge against Jiang Ran, wanted to kill Jiang Ran without implicating himself? With skills like these, he couldn't even defeat his ex-girlfriend!!! Waste! Good thing I didn't bet on him!】
Little Dragon Girl: 【The total bets on Zhao Jie reached 5.5 million, with quite a few participants too. What were these people thinking, betting on such a hopeless lab rat?】
Little Aunt: 【Risking small for big returns, just in case he turned out to be a dark horse with incredible luck? Have you forgotten about Jiang Ran's early days?】
......
Lab Rat No. 6 for Round 28 - Wang Jian lived on the 10th floor.
In unit 1002.
Currently evening, approaching 7 o'clock.
Wang Jian carried numerous plastic bags in both hands, filled with several different dinners, snacks, and beverages.
Carrying enough food and drinks for several people by himself, he took the elevator to the 10th floor.
Just as he stepped out of the elevator, he saw three men and two women standing directly down the hallway in front of unit 1002.
Wang Jian was 20 years old this year, and these five people appeared roughly his age, all within the same general range.
For some reason, Wang Jian seemed somewhat afraid of these people, but he still walked over to them anyway.
After he approached, one of the men took the food and drinks from Wang Jian's hands.
Immediately after this transfer, another man - the second one - pressed his left hand against Wang Jian's left shoulder while his right fist drove straight into Wang Jian's stomach.
After punching him, watching Wang Jian collapse to the floor clutching his stomach in agony, the man demanded:
"Wang Jian, we told you to buy dinner! Why were you dragging your feet? You left at 5 o'clock and dawdled until almost 7! Even a pig moves faster than you! You motherless piece of trash!"
After saying this, the man delivered another kick to Wang Jian's right leg.
Wang Jian hugged his leg in pain, pleading: "Stop hitting me! I couldn't help it! Each of you ordered different things - one wanted braised pork rice, another wanted KFC, and someone else wanted spicy hot pot! I really moved as fast as I could!"
"Plus, you're spending my money and haven't paid me back yet..."
"What the hell? You dare talk back?!"
Hearing Wang Jian's words, the man delivered another vicious kick.
Wang Jian could only cover his head as he was beaten.
"Alright alright, we're all friends here, no need for this. However, Wang Jian, you can't do this next time. If you pull this again, I might not be able to control my friend here."
"But honestly, what you just said really hurt my friend's feelings."
"What do you mean 'spending your money'? That we haven't paid you?"
"We consider you a friend and brother! That's why we spend your money! Otherwise why wouldn't we spend someone else's money?"
"Here's what we'll do - don't come inside for now. Wait out here until we finish eating, then you can come in. Consider squatting here as your punishment."
The person saying these words was the third man among the three men and two women.
This man appeared to be the leader of the five.
After he issued his decree, the second man indeed stopped hitting Wang Jian.
He merely issued a harsh warning to Wang Jian.
"Alright alright, I'm starving. Let's go eat first."
Probably because he was hungry, or perhaps feeling they'd bullied Wang Jian sufficiently for now.
The third man hummed a casual tune leisurely as he led the others toward the apartment to eat.
Just as they were about to enter the apartment, the corner of his eye caught sight of someone.
Thinking he might be seeing things, he turned his head.
He discovered, about three meters away from them...
A black short-haired man in his thirties had appeared at some unknown time.
This black short-haired man stood with arms crossed, leaning against the white wall behind him, watching them with keen interest.
The second man also noticed this thirty-something black short-haired man and made an aggressive show of his fist, arrogantly shouting:
"The hell you looking at, motherfucker?! What are you staring at?!"
These days, the wealthy fear the aggressive, and the aggressive fear those who value nothing, not even their lives.
Therefore, on the streets, you shouldn't provoke young reckless troublemakers.
Adults might still consider their parents or personal interests and swallow their pride.
But these young reckless types often let hot blood rush to their heads, act on impulse in fits of rage, and create serious trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 201: I’ll Help You Kill Them—That Way, They Can’t Bully You Anymore
chapters.content:
Though he said this, the black short-haired man in his thirties before them clearly remained unmoved by the second man's threat.
Instead, he looked intrigued.
Seeing this, the second man wanted to make a move but was pulled back by the third man.
"Enough, this guy's probably mentally ill. Haven't you seen the recent news? Mentally ill people don't get charged for murder anyway, just ignore him."
Though restrained, the second man still pointed aggressively at the black short-haired man and said:
"Consider yourself lucky!"
With that, the whole group went inside.
Slamming the door shut with a bang.
Leaving only Wang Jian outside, sitting against the wall near the security door in the hallway.
Wang Jian sat against the wall now, his whole body curled into an irregular cube.The atmosphere around him felt oppressive and desolate.
At that moment, the black short-haired man suddenly walked over to Wang Jian's side.
He patted Wang Jian's shoulder.
Wang Jian looked up, his eyes reddened, choking for a moment before asking: "Can I help you?"
The black short-haired man said: "I'm Chen Fei, living next door in 1003. Would you like to come to my place?"
Wang Jian probably didn't expect the black short-haired man to invite him over.
He hesitated for a moment, then shook his head: "Probably not..."
Chen Fei smiled: "You should come. Your so-called friends won't finish eating for at least two or three hours. Are you just going to sit here the whole time?"
"The weather's getting hotter—come in and enjoy the air conditioning!"
Hearing Chen Fei's words, Wang Jian seemed to genuinely feel the heat, especially since he'd been running around buying food and drinks for the people inside earlier.
He was practically steaming from all the running.
So he agreed.
Chen Fei's home was luxurious.
Though the overall space wasn't large, the decor made it feel like being in a palace.
In the living room.
Wang Jian sat on a soft sofa that felt smooth to the touch with excellent texture.
Chen Fei poured Wang Jian a glass of red wine, but Wang Jian said he didn't drink.Get full chapters from novelFirｅ.net
Chen Fei then brought out a bottle of Sprite and poured it into Wang Jian's wine glass: "How about this?"
Wang Jian couldn't refuse the kindness anymore, so he took a small sip.
"Who are those people anyway?"
"I thought you just moved in yesterday? Isn't that your apartment?"
Swirling his wine glass, Chen Fei sat on an expensive Chinese-style antique wooden chair as he questioned Wang Jian.
Wang Jian kept his head down, then said: "They're just some friends of mine."
"Friends? Really? You're Wang Jian, right? I was at the welcome party too."
"You can tell me what's going on. I'll help you. After all, we're neighbors."
"Besides, anyone can see your relationship with those people is terrible. They treat you like an enemy."
"Are those really friends?"
Chen Fei took a sip of red wine and smiled.
Hearing this, Wang Jian continued to keep his head down.
Chen Fei didn't press further, instead focusing on tasting his newly purchased red wine.
After a long silence.
Wang Jian suddenly spoke, though his voice was very quiet: "You can't help me."
He thought Chen Fei hadn't heard, but Chen Fei had actually heard quite clearly:
"Can't help? How do you know I can't help if you don't tell me?"
"Even if I can't help, you can still say it. Consider it venting. Don't worry, I won't tell anyone."
After another long while.
Wang Jian downed his red wine mixed with Sprite in one gulp.
Apparently having thought something through, he said:
"I work at a textile factory. Those people work there too."
"But one of them, Qi Shen—his father is a shareholder there, so these people basically do whatever they want at that factory, working when they feel like it and slacking off most of the time."
"Once when the factory was hiring general workers, they brought in a very beautiful girl."
"Qi Shen took a liking to her and pursued her relentlessly."
"But the girl wasn't interested in Qi Shen's approach and didn't respond to his advances."
"Qi Shen got impatient and couldn't wait. One time on the way home after night shift, he and his friends—the ones you saw today—dragged that beautiful girl into an alley. You can guess what they intended to do."
"Coincidentally, I was also working night shift that day and happened to see this, so I intervened."
Qi Shen was the ringleader among the three men and two women—the third man.
Chen Fei swirled his wine glass: "After you intervened? Did the beautiful girl get saved?"
Wang Jian nodded: "She was saved. The girl managed to run away, but I didn't get away. They beat me up."
Chen Fei: "Hero saving the beauty—you should have gotten the girl, right?"
Wang Jian smiled bitterly at this: "After that girl got home that night, the next day she came to the factory with her parents to resign. I happened to run into her at the factory gate, and when she saw me covered in injuries, she just glanced at me and left. I never saw her again after that. Heard she went back to her hometown with her parents."
Chen Fei thought for a moment, then said: "The girl didn't offer herself to you, not even a thank you?"
Wang Jian shook his head: "No, like I said, she just glanced at me and left, like I was a complete stranger."
Chen Fei smiled: "So after this incident, Qi Shen and his group started targeting and bullying you?"
Wang Jian nodded.
Chen Fei: "Do you regret it?"
Wang Jian shook his head.
Chen Fei: "You must have had some feelings for that beautiful girl too, right? That's why you intervened. If it had just been an ordinary girl being cornered by Qi Shen's group, would you still have intervened?"
Wang Jian thought for a while, then nodded.
Chen Fei: "I'm not sure I believe that."
Wang Jian looked very serious, word by word, staring into Chen Fei's eyes: "Even if it was just an ordinary girl I didn't know, if I could help, I would still help. Because I'm afraid my conscience wouldn't let me rest otherwise."
"Hmm... I see. You really are a good person!"
Chen Fei put down his wine glass, resting his chin on his left hand as his gaze drifted to the left.
Then his eyes returned to Wang Jian: "In that case, let me help you! I'll make sure those people can never bully you again."
Hearing this, Wang Jian smiled bitterly and rubbed his forehead: "Don't joke around. How can you help me? Help me report to the police?"
Chen Fei suddenly gave a mysterious smile: "If I help you kill them, then they naturally won't be able to bully you anymore, right?"
Whoosh!
Wang Jian, who had been keeping his head down, suddenly lifted it sharply upon hearing these words.
His face was filled with shock and horror.
He asked with utter astonishment:
"Did I hear correctly? You said you'd help me kill them?!"
Chen Fei continued smiling: "You heard correctly."
Once Wang Jian confirmed this, he quickly shook his head: "No, no, no, don't joke about things like this! Murder is illegal!"
Chen Fei remained silent, just quietly watching Wang Jian, then suddenly changed the subject: "Wang Jian, how long have they been bullying you?"
Wang Jian said: "About half a year."
Chen Fei said: "In that case, why not resign and find work somewhere else? If they can't see you, they can't bully you, right?"
Wang Jian's expression turned bitter: "It's no use. My parents also work at that textile factory. They've been employees there for over ten, almost twenty years."
"Qi Shen said if I resign and go work at another factory or another city, he'll make sure my parents lose their jobs."
"Also, I used to live in the employee dormitory. After they started bullying me, I moved back home to reduce contact with them, but it didn't help."
"So I moved here."
"I thought I could find some peace, but those people followed me secretly when I returned here..."

chapters.title: Chapter 204: The Story of the New-Generation Jack the Ripper
chapters.content:
"Jack the Ripper?!"
Hearing that name, Wang Jian shot to his feet, staring at the gaunt man for a long time before slowly sitting back down.
From Wang Jian's reaction, it was clear he had heard of Jack the Ripper's notorious reputation.
After all, Jack the Ripper was extremely famous.
But Wang Jian still asked dubiously, "You're lying to me, right? Jack the Ripper was foreign, wasn't he? And his first crimes were in 1888, in London of England..."
Chen Fei smiled, "My friend here certainly isn't the original. If he were the original, forget about you—I'd be scared myself. Someone from 1888 still being alive now is impossible."
"I'll tell you this: he's a devoted fan of Jack the Ripper, a new-generation Jack the Ripper, you understand?"
Wang Jian considered it for a moment. "An imitation killer?"
"Something like that," Chen Fei said.
Wang Jian suddenly grew nervous, sweat beading on his forehead. "Who exactly are you people? A new-generation Jack the Ripper has shown up?!"Chen Fei replied, "All you need to know is that we are people who can help you with your revenge. That's enough."
Wang Jian said nothing and then left.
After Wang Jian left, only Chen Fei and the new-generation Jack the Ripper remained inside Room 1003.
This new-generation Jack the Ripper had his own real name, but now, no matter who he spoke to, he called himself Jack.
"Jack" had essentially become his new name.
Jack sat in the seat Wang Jian had occupied before.
He finished the glass of red wine Wang Jian had left unfinished.
After drinking, he smacked his lips a few times, as if savoring the taste.
Then he spoke: "Chen Fei, among the people we’re going to kill this time, how many are women?"
"Two," Chen Fei answered.
Jack's eyes lit up. "Fine. Hand them both to me."
"No problem," Chen Fei said.
Jack asked again, "Chen Fei, after you help Wang Jian do what he wants, are you going to kill him too like you did with those others?"
Jack made a throat-slitting gesture.
Chen Fei tugged at the corner of his mouth;
the right side of his mouth curled up like a slanted sword.
He sneered lightly, "Of course. That's always been my rule."
"I help clients kill the people they want dead."
"Then, in the end, I kill those clients."
"That is the true payment I collect."
"I can’t wait to see—Wang Jian finally completes his revenge, only to realize he’s about to lose his own life."
