chapters.title: Chapter 205: Discovered?
chapters.content:
Six o'clock in the evening.
As expected, Qi Shen and the others had once again come to Wang Jian's home.
And just like before, Wang Jian was once again sent out to buy dinner.
At this moment, Wang Jian closed the security door of Room 1002 and stood in the hallway. Looking at his phone's memo with the items Qi Shen and the others had demanded - pork cutlet rice, spicy hot pot, Sprite, beer, and similar things - he muttered viciously under his breath: "This will be your last meal before execution!"
Then, he knocked on the door of Room 1003.
He entered Room 1003.
Once inside, he saw Chen Fei and that new-generation Jack the Ripper.
"Chen Fei, those people are in my home right now. They sent me to buy dinner for them. What should I do now? What's the plan?"
Wang Jian couldn't wait to ask as soon as he entered.
It seemed he could wait no longer.Chen Fei, meanwhile, calmly savored his red wine.
Speaking unhurriedly, he said:
"I have two plans."
"You need to decide for yourself which one to implement."
At this point, Wang Jian sat on the sofa and said: "Then tell me quickly!"
Chen Fei said: "First option: I have several types of highly effective, fast-acting sleeping pills. When you return with their dinner, grind these sleeping pills into powder and mix it into their food and drinks. After they've all fallen asleep, tie them all up. Then you can do whatever you want to them."
"As for the second option: don't use drugs, but take them out one by one. Make them disappear one after another, make them feel fear in their hearts, let them perish in terror."
"Friendly reminder: the first option is definitely simpler than the second, and it's safer and more efficient."
"So, which do you choose?"
Chen Fei's gaze burned intensely.
He seemed quite eager to hear Wang Jian's choice.
Wang Jian frowned. Sitting on the sofa, his hands once again unconsciously twisted together.
It was clear he was starting to agonize over the decision again.
He thought for quite a while before saying: "The first one! Safer! The second option carries too much risk."
Getting his answer, Chen Fei smiled and said: "Fine, no problem. Go buy dinner! Come back to me after you've bought it, and we'll add the sleeping pills."
Because he was so eager for revenge, Wang Jian only took half an hour to complete the shopping.
After buying everything, he returned to Chen Fei's place.
Chen Fei had already ground his so-called sleeping pills into powder.
Next, the three of them mixed the powder into the purchased dinner.
Of course, to prevent Qi Shen and the others from noticing anything suspicious, mixing the powder into the food required some effort.
Then came putting the powder into the drinks.
At this point, Chen Fei brought out several disposable syringes from his home.
He mixed the sleeping pill powder with a little water, then used the syringes to inject it into the drink bottles.
By the time they finished all this, it was already seven o'clock in the evening.
Whether it was a guilty conscience or something else, Wang Jian's yellowish forehead was covered with countless tiny beads of sweat despite being in the air-conditioned room.
"I'm going over now."
At this point, Wang Jian said this to Chen Fei and the other man.
Then he left Room 1003 and returned to Room 1002.
He had a key to Room 1002, so he didn't need to knock.
Of course, Room 1002's door lock was also a smart lock - even without a key, he could use his fingerprint or enter a password.
He used his key to open Room 1002.
After pushing the door open and entering, he closed it behind him.
After closing the door, his gaze fell on Qi Shen and the others in the living room.
At this moment, these people were all in the living room enjoying the air conditioning and playing on their phones.
The TV was on, playing a movie.
None of them were really watching it - purely wasting electricity.
Wang Jian stared at these people, thinking about how they would soon be dead.
The corners of his mouth uncontrollably turned upward.
He slowly walked over, looking at these people.
Even though he knew these people were about to die, every time he remembered what they had done to him, he couldn't help but feel furious inside.
These five people - three males and two females.
If asked who he hated most, who he detested most?
He hated and detested all five of them.
Qi Shen was the core of the five - without him, the others wouldn't have had the means to bully him.
Blond Guy was the enforcer - he had been beaten by Blond Guy the most.
That Ma Jia, although he had physically attacked him less frequently, was even more despicable than Blond Guy.
Because this guy was the schemer.
Back when he had saved that pretty girl, Qi Shen and the others had originally only planned to beat him up to vent their anger.
It was Ma Jia who suggested the method of prolonged torment, treating him like a dog.
That's what had ruined him for so long.
As for the last two girls...
The harm they had done to him wasn't small either.
Don't think that just because they were girls, their methods of bullying were weaker than the boys'.
The red-haired girl was Blond Guy's girlfriend.
As for the other black-haired girl, who was somewhat attractive, she was Qi Shen's girlfriend.
These two girls had verbally humiliated him more than physically attacking him.
In short, all five of these people deserved to die.
Currently, Wang Jian placed all the purchased dinner and drinks on the glass coffee table in front of the group.
Then he prepared to leave.
But this time, just as he was about to leave, he was stopped by Ma Jia, one of the three boys.Latest content published on novèlfire.net
"Wang Jian, don't leave yet. I have a question for you."
Wang Jian, with his back to the group, took a deep breath to adjust his excited and nervous emotions, then turned around with an expressionless face.
"What question? Are you going to pay me back all the money I advanced for you?"
"Pay back your mother. Don't even think about it!"
Before Ma Jia could speak, Blond Guy - who had a broken arm - cursed first.
Ma Jia pacified Blond Guy with a few words, then said with a smile, like a smiling tiger:
"Wang Jian, what I want to ask is: are you very familiar with the resident of Room 1003?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Jian's heart immediately sank.
"Average, not very familiar."
Ma Jia sneered: "Not very familiar? Then how come tonight I saw you going in and out of his place several times?"
Thump!
Wang Jian's heart suddenly leaped into his throat.
They saw him entering Chen Fei's home?
How was that possible?
Aside from today at noon, he had only gone in and out twice tonight!
And both times he had checked carefully - he shouldn't have been seen by anyone else?!
But he reacted quickly: "Yesterday you wouldn't let me into the room, and that person was kind enough to let me into his place. Today when I passed by his door, I went in to thank him."
After saying this, Wang Jian noticed that the entire room had become terrifyingly quiet.
All their eyes were focused on him.
As if they could see through to his heart.
Especially since previously, when he brought food back, these people would swarm like pigs at feeding time. But what was going on today?
Why were they completely indifferent to the dinner on the glass coffee table?
Could it be that they had discovered he had drugged the food with sleeping pills?
"Wang Jian, do you know what movie is playing on TV right now?"
Wang Jian, his mind unsettled, only glanced casually at the screen upon hearing Ma Jia's words.
He shook his head: "Haven't seen it, don't know."
Ma Jia smiled meaningfully: "This movie is a foreign revenge film. I won't go into the details of the content."
"To summarize in two simple words: revenge."

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Plan Failed, Encountering a Traitor
chapters.content:
"Oh, and then what?"
Wang Jian's forehead began to sweat.
Ma Jia said: "Wang Jian, we treated you poorly before. Now I'm giving you my pork cutlet rice."
Ma Jia handed the takeout box of pork cutlet rice from the coffee table to Wang Jian.
Wang Jian overcame his fear and accepted the pork cutlet rice.
Ma Jia said: "Eat it. Eat it all clean right in front of me."
Wang Jian stared at this pork cutlet rice.
He fell into decision paralysis.
He knew it contained sleeping pills - should he eat it or not?
Ultimately, he chose not to eat it.Because given the current situation, he strongly suspected his revenge plan had already been exposed.
If he really ate it and passed out first, he didn't dare imagine what these people would do to him afterward.
Therefore, the next second, he threw the pork cutlet rice directly at Blond Guy's face and ran toward the exit.
"Goddamn motherfucker!"
Blond Guy, who got hit in the face with the pork cutlet rice, immediately cursed.
Finally, it was his girlfriend who avenged him.
As Wang Jian ran toward the exit, she deliberately stuck out a leg to trip him.
Although Wang Jian wasn't completely tripped, he still stumbled and caught himself with both hands on the floor.
Just as he prepared to get up,
Qi Shen and Ma Jia had already pounced on him.
The two of them pressed down on his body,
firmly restraining him.
Despite Wang Jian's violent struggles,
it was useless.
"You really deserve to die!"
At this moment, Blond Guy took a container of spicy hot pot from the glass coffee table, had his girlfriend open the lid, and personally poured all of it onto Wang Jian's face as he was pinned to the floor.
Fortunately, the spicy hot pot wasn't at its freshly cooked temperature anymore, otherwise Wang Jian would have been scalded and disfigured.
"AAAAAH!!! You bastards! Damn bastards!"
Wang Jian, pinned to the floor after being doused with spicy hot pot, kept cursing continuously.
"Stop cursing, Wang Jian. Aren't you curious about how we knew you were planning to take revenge on us today?"
Ma Jia knelt on Wang Jian, constantly sneering.
When this was mentioned, Wang Jian truly didn't know why these people found out.
Either these people discovered it themselves,
or Chen Fei and that other person informed on him.
But Chen Fei and that person informing? How could that be?!
After all, this revenge was Chen Fei's idea in the first place.
Just as Wang Jian's thoughts were utterly chaotic,
knocking sounded at the door.
Blond Guy's girlfriend, the red-haired girl, hopped over to open the door.
Wang Jian was currently being pressed down extremely uncomfortably, but he still struggled to turn his head toward the door.
Wanting to see who this entering person was.
This person who entered greeted Wang Jian after coming in:
"Wang Jian, hello there!"
That's right, this person was precisely Chen Fei.
At this point, everything became completely clear.
It was undoubtedly Chen Fei who had informed on him.
When Wang Jian saw Chen Fei, his pupils instantly constricted violently inward. He was utterly shocked, and after the shock,
the veins on his forehead and face bulged out.
His ten fingers clenched tightly, pinching the flesh in his palms until it turned red and purple.
His entire body trembled.
Outside the window, several birds had flown in at some unclear time and had been chirping and making noise all along.
The chirping sounded like several birds discussing and laughing at Wang Jian's foolishness.
He gritted his teeth, spraying saliva toward Chen Fei's direction: "Why? Why?! Since you wanted to harm me, why pretend to help me?!"
Facing Wang Jian's anger and questioning,
Chen Fei smiled faintly: "Because it's interesting."
"Hahaha, thanks to you! Chen Fei, I apologize for my rudeness yesterday!"
At this moment, Blond Guy walked to Chen Fei's side and enthusiastically wrapped his uninjured left arm around Chen Fei's shoulder.
Seeing this, Wang Jian laughed loudly: "Hahaha! Dumbass! You're apologizing for your rudeness to him yesterday?! Do you know who had your arm broken?!"
Blond Guy heard this and angrily said: "Who?"
Wang Jian pursed his lips: "Chen Fei."
Blond Guy looked at Chen Fei, seeing how extremely calm Chen Fei was.
He immediately refuted Wang Jian: "Don't try to drive a wedge between us!"
Wang Jian continued shouting: "Hahaha! Believe it or not! Haven't you ever suspected one thing?"
"Why when you had that conflict with those trendy young guys, they only hit your right arm? Every other part remained completely unharmed?!"
"Because this was Chen Fei proving to me that he had the capability to help me get revenge!"
"Otherwise, do you think I'd be bold enough to collaborate with someone I just met on something illegal like murder?!"
These words indeed made the five people present, including Blond Guy, become suspicious.
They all exchanged looks with each other.
After all, what Wang Jian said wasn't without reason!
But what happened next completely dispelled Blond Guy and the others' suspicions.
They only heard the phone in Blond Guy's pocket suddenly ring.
Blond Guy hurriedly pulled out his phone - he was using a Fruit Phone.
He answered the call while walking into the bedroom.
Outside the window, it was unclear when several birds had flown over, chirping noisily the whole time.
He had Qi Shen and Ma Jia hold Wang Jian up and directly slapped him right then and there.
After slapping him, he said viciously: "Wang Jian, you didn't expect this!"
"The police just called me!"
"Those trendy young guys have been caught!"
Facing Wang Jian's anger and questioning,
"They deliberately bumped into me this morning and had people lying in ambush ready to attack!"
"And the person who instructed them, they said, was a young man named Wang Jian who paid them 5000!!!"
At this moment, Wang Jian truly stood motionless like a statue struck by lightning.
Of course, he couldn't move even if he wanted to.
His mind, right now, should have completely exploded.
So much so that his mind exploded.
He didn't even realize he was being tightly bound with rope.
He became dazed and foolish, utterly stupefied.
"Hey, you have so much delicious food here. Perfect timing, I'm hungry too."
Chen Fei suddenly spoke up now.
Chen Fei didn't come empty-handed - he had a backpack with a bottle of red wine inside.
Chen Fei took the red wine and sat by the glass coffee table, selecting a chicken cutlet rice from the table.
Qi Shen's girlfriend was that black-haired girl.
Quite good-looking, dressed particularly provocatively.
Black stockings and high heels.
Full of temptation.
She watched Chen Fei about to eat the Pork Cutlet Rice and asked him doubtfully: "Didn't you tell us before that there were sleeping pills in here? Can it still be eaten?"
Chen Fei laughed: "There are no sleeping pills. That was actually just ordinary calcium tablets ground into powder."
"I hate wasting food the most. So how could I possibly put sleeping pills in there?"
Chen Fei immediately started eating that chicken cutlet rice.
He also opened a bottle of cola and took a gulp.
Then he brought a glass from Wang Jian's open kitchen area.
Poured the red wine into it.Find the newest release on noⅴelfire.net
Slowly swirling the glass, making it look sophisticated and high-end.
When Qi Shen and the others saw this, they stopped paying attention to Wang Jian for now - after all, that guy was already tied up anyway.
They had been hungry for a while too, so they all started eating.
Fortunately, they usually had Wang Jian buy extra portions whenever they asked him to get food.
So even though two meals were wasted earlier, there was still enough for all of them to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Reversal
chapters.content:
"Chen Fei, you're quite wealthy. My father has also drunk this red wine of yours - it costs 110,000 per bottle."
At this moment, Qi Shen was chewing on a chicken leg, took a disposable paper cup from in front of him, and asked Chen Fei to pour him some.
Among these five people including Qi Shen.
Except for Qi Shen himself, the other four came from ordinary families.
Therefore, when the four heard this red wine actually cost 110,000, they immediately each raised a cup, demanding Chen Fei pour them some.
Chen Fei was also generous, directly handing them the red wine bottle to pour themselves.
The excited group each poured themselves a full cup.
They imitated how they imagined wealthy people would taste it.
After tasting it.
Everyone said it tasted excellent, truly worthy of 110,000 wine.Only Blond Guy scratched his head: "Why can't I taste it? It definitely tastes better than those dozen or few dozen yuan wines, but it doesn't seem worth 110,000!"
Ma Jia actually couldn't taste the 110,000 value either.
But to avoid appearing unsophisticated, he pretended.
At this moment.
Their leader Qi Shen.
Looked at Chen Fei and asked: "Chen Fei, I'm still very curious - why exactly are you helping us?"
Yes, Chen Fei had only informed on them, without explaining why he was doing this.
Chen Fei took a sip of red wine and said: "Just as I told Wang Jian - because it's interesting."
Qi Shen didn't quite understand: "Can't figure out how you think, but still need to thank you. After all, even a cornered dog will jump over a wall - Wang Jian would eventually retaliate against us someday. When that day came, he might truly catch us off guard, so avoiding it in advance is best for us."
Chen Fei listened, then said: "Since that's the case, and Wang Jian's conspiracy has been thwarted by you, how do you plan to deal with him?"
Ma Jia, Blond Guy, Blond Guy's girlfriend Red-haired Girl, and Qi Shen's girlfriend Black-haired Girl.
All looked at Qi Shen.
Clearly waiting for their leader to make a decision.
Qi Shen stared at Wang Jian who was tightly bound with rope over there.
He asked the others how they should handle Wang Jian.
Blond Guy said to beat him severely, half to death, so he wouldn't dare rebel again.
Ma Jia supported Blond Guy's opinion.
Blond Guy's girlfriend Red-haired Girl and Qi Shen's girlfriend Black-haired Girl.
Also agreed with Blond Guy's opinion.
They even added that to ensure Wang Jian never dared again, they suggested more severe torture.
Make him eat shit and drink piss directly.
While saying this, the two girls glanced at each other with cold smiles.
As if they'd already made someone experience this in advance.
"You think he'll behave after a beating?"
Ma Jia: "Then what's your meaning, Brother Qi?"
A flash of extreme cruelty appeared in Qi Shen's eyes:
"If not for Brother Chen Fei this time, we'd definitely have been tricked."
"So I think we should directly kill Wang Jian."
After all, he was rich second generation - ruthless and bold.
This statement shocked everyone else.
After all, the others were ordinary people who knew murder was illegal.
So even though Wang Jian meant them harm, didn't he fail?
But if they really killed someone...
Ma Jia worried: "If discovered, we'd be finished..."
Qi Shen sneered: "Clearly you have no experience. We have plenty of remote mountains and sinkholes here - just toss him into a sinkhole, who could find him? Unless he turns into a ghost himself!"
Qi Shen didn't speak, with a "you know what I mean" expression.
All their conversation reached Wang Jian's ears.
Completely unabated around him.
This indicated they already considered Wang Jian a dead man.
Just then.
Blond Guy's phone in his pocket suddenly rang again.
Blond Guy knew this sound too well.
He checked his phone and cursed: "Which son of a bitch is messing with my Ninebot again?"
Blond Guy's phone alarm was from the Ninebot electric scooter app, alerting that someone was touching his vehicle.
Blond Guy ran to the Room 1002 balcony window, but couldn't see from this position.
Blond Guy prepared to go downstairs.
Ma Jia asked if he should come along.
After all, one of his arms was injured.
But Blond Guy waved his hand, indicating it wasn't necessary.
Soon, Blond Guy went out and downstairs.
Ten minutes later.
Blond Guy still hadn't returned.
Ma Jia's phone received a message from Blond Guy's number.
Saying there were scooter thieves and they needed backup quickly.
These five people had three Ninebots.
All parked outside the apartment.
Couldn't be helped - those idiot security guards wouldn't let them inside.
Ma Jia reported the situation to Qi Shen.
Qi Shen immediately became furious.
He was, after all, rich second generation, and originally drove cars too.
But due to his aimlessness and arguments with parents, his car was confiscated by them.
No choice, he had to ride electric scooters.
Guess how many this was for him?
Already his third one.
The previous two were both stolen.
This time, good heavens, again?
Therefore, Qi Shen and Ma Jia hurried downstairs to backup Blond Guy.
With their departure.
Only Chen Fei, the two girls remained in the room.
And the tied-up Wang Jian.This content belongs to Novᴇl_Firenet
At this moment, Blond Guy's girlfriend Red-haired Girl, and Qi Shen's girlfriend Black-haired Girl, were taking selfies with that 110,000 yuan red wine bottle.
Completely unaware that Chen Fei, sitting across from them, quietly stood up.
Unnoticed, he arrived before Wang Jian.
When Wang Jian saw Chen Fei, his face filled with hatred: "I won't let you off even as a ghost."
Chen Fei smiled slightly, pulling a utility knife from his pocket.
Wang Jian didn't resist either, directly closing his eyes - he couldn't resist even if he wanted to.
After all, he was completely bound.
But then, the expected pain didn't come.
Instead, he felt his bound hands loosen.
Chen Fei had Wang Jian first remove all the ropes from his body.
Then gestured with his eyes for Wang Jian to look at the two girls still taking selfies.
Wang Jian looked completely confused.
Chen Fei said: "That was just a joke earlier. Now let's continue business."
Hearing this, Wang Jian froze, completely stunned.
If Chen Fei hadn't urged him to quickly subdue the two girls before Qi Shen and the others returned.
Wang Jian would probably still be in shock.
Regardless of what Chen Fei was thinking, Wang Jian knew his opportunity had come.
He walked up to the two girls - Red-haired Girl and Black-haired Girl hadn't yet sensed the approaching danger.
Still focused on their selfies.
By the time they detected the danger, Wang Jian's hands were already tightly choking Red-haired Girl's neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Chen Fei’s Story
chapters.content:
"Don't kill them yet, tie them up first."
As Wang Jian was desperately choking the Red-haired Girl's neck.
This extremely abrupt scene startled the Black-haired Girl, and immediately after, she reacted and tried to help the Red-haired Girl.
Unexpectedly for her, Chen Fei rushed over directly, pinned her to the ground, and subdued her effortlessly.
Then he quickly used the rope that had previously bound Wang Jian to tie her hands and feet behind her back, tying it with a dead knot.
"Chen Fei! What are you doing?! Have you gone mad?!"
The Black-haired Girl was both confused and terrified.
Why had Chen Fei suddenly switched sides?
Wasn't he just with their group earlier?
Chen Fei didn't answer her question, simply using a rag from the table to gag her mouth.Soon, the Red-haired Girl over there was also tied up by Wang Jian, with her mouth stuffed with a rag.
The two girls lay on the ground, making muffled noises.
Before they could continue making noise for long.
At that moment.
Knocking suddenly sounded at Room 1002.
Wang Jian was extremely tense: "Have they returned?"
But Chen Fei walked to the door with complete calmness and opened it.
After opening the door.
Wang Jian looked over from the living room and saw it wasn't Qi Shen and Ma Jia.
But rather the new-generation Jack the Ripper.
At that moment, he dragged in what appeared to be a lifeless person with his right arm.
Wang Jian couldn't clearly see the person's face, but based on the hairstyle and hair color, he determined it should be Blond Guy.
Blond Guy wasn't dead, just unconscious.
Next, Chen Fei used the utility knife to cut a section of rope brought by the new-generation Jack the Ripper.
After dividing the rope, he tied up the unconscious Blond Guy, hands behind his back, and also gagged Blond Guy's mouth.
Next, Wang Jian saw the new-generation Jack the Ripper hiding behind the security door.
The security door of Room 1002 wasn't closed but left slightly ajar.
At this point, Wang Jian felt things could temporarily come to a pause, and he wanted to confront Chen Fei—are you out of your mind, switching sides one moment and saving him the next?
Are you schizophrenic?
Just as Wang Jian was preparing to speak, he saw Chen Fei raise his right index finger to his own lips: "They're back."
Yes, they were back.The source of this content ɪs .net
Footsteps and talking voices came from outside the door.
"Strange, where did that Blond Guy go? Also, aren't our cars all parked properly? There aren't any car thieves around?"
This was Ma Jia speaking.
Then came Qi Shen's puzzled remark: "Strange, I remember clearly closing the door before we left?"
The door was pushed open from outside.
After being pushed open, it conveniently blocked the new-generation Jack the Ripper hiding behind it.
After Qi Shen and Ma Jia entered, they quickly saw the scene in the living room, not even having time to close the door.
Both of them instantly stood frozen like wooden chickens.
They stopped discussing where Blond Guy had gone.
Because they had already seen Blond Guy.
Not only had they seen Blond Guy.
They also saw the Red-haired Girl and Black-haired Girl, tied up with their hands behind their backs, becoming extremely agitated upon seeing them.
And... Wang Jian, now free, standing not far from him with Chen Fei.
Given the current situation.
Any normal person could figure out the general sequence of events with a little thought.
But many puzzles still troubled everyone except Chen Fei.
At this moment.
Qi Shen pointed at Chen Fei and frowned: "You released him?"
Chen Fei nodded.
Qi Shen wore an extremely confused expression: "Then all this was done by you two?"
Chen Fei nodded again.
Qi Shen became even more puzzled: "Why? Or was this your original plan? Oh, no, if you were all in collusion, there was no need! Back then, when you put sleeping pills in the food and water, we all fell unconscious immediately—why go through all this trouble?"
Hearing this, Wang Jian also complained with a somewhat resentful tone: "That's what I want to know too."
And so, all three pairs of eyes focused on Chen Fei.
Chen Fei revealed a playful smile:
"You're curious why my behavior seems contradictory? Why it's so confusing?"
"I already gave you the answer before."
"The answer is—it's interesting."
Chen Fei extended his right hand and smiled slightly.
"The two plans I offered Wang Jian."
"Clearly, the second plan was much more exciting and interesting than the first."
"But he chose the first one. The first was to use sedatives to knock everyone out."
"But where's the fun in that? Knocking everyone out effortlessly. You'd just become fish on the chopping block."
"That's why I leaked information, made the first plan fail, to make the whole situation more mysterious and interesting."
"Of course, regarding this, all of you including Wang Jian were completely unaware, so understand now?"
After listening.
Qi Shen's eyebrows furrowed into a deep frown.
"So that means, deliberately tampering with that car to lure my buddy down alone, then knocking him out, using his phone to send messages to make both of us go down, after which you could untie Wang Jian and tie up my girlfriends? It seems this was all your plan."
At this point, Qi Shen suddenly noticed something was wrong.
"Wait! You were tied up and Wang Jian was with us the whole time, so who tampered with the car and triggered the software alarm?!"
"You have accomplices?!"
Qi Shen and Ma Jia immediately looked around nervously.
Just at that moment, the new-generation Jack the Ripper who had been hiding behind the door suddenly rushed out.
He held a dagger tightly in his right hand, charging at Qi Shen, who frantically raised his hands to block. The dagger slashed across, cutting a bloody gash on Qi Shen's palm, blood continuously seeping from the wound.
Seeing this, Ma Jia's first reaction wasn't to fight the new-generation Jack the Ripper but to turn and flee toward the door.
But he was blocked by the new-generation Jack the Ripper.
At that moment, Chen Fei said to Wang Jian: "Wang Jian, your time for revenge has come, aren't you going?"
Wang Jian gritted his teeth;
regardless of what Chen Fei was thinking, the time for revenge had indeed arrived.
Bare-handed, he rushed forward and began wrestling with Qi Shen.
Meanwhile, that Jack the Ripper, for some unknown reason.
Threw the dagger outside the door and also began fighting Ma Jia bare-handed.
As for Chen Fei, he stood in place, watching this fight.
He watched while saying: "This time helping someone kill for revenge is really boring."
"I tried to make it more interesting, added some difficulty, but it's still so dull."
"The people we're killing this time are like idiots."
"Nothing like that person."
At that moment, countless colorful threads of various colors seemed to appear in Chen Fei's mind.
These colorful threads all converged together, gradually coalescing into a human form.
Chen Fei was born into a wealthy family, enjoying luxury since childhood.
As a child, whatever toys he wanted, he got.
As he slowly grew up.
His academic performance was excellent;
he was a top student.
Plus he had money, so he was very popular with girls.
During university, others pursued beautiful girls with great difficulty, possibly succeeding or having no hope at all.
But every time he drove a red Ferrari onto campus.
The beautiful girls at school were his for the taking.
But honestly, even doing those things with beautiful girls didn't bring him happiness.
Until one day, while driving on the street.
He saw two street vendors arguing over some reason.
One vendor, in anger, picked up a kitchen knife and slashed it across the other vendor's neck.
Instantly, a large amount of blood sprayed from the slashed vendor's neck.
Then, the slashed vendor convulsed and fell to the ground, motionless.
It was at that moment Chen Fei suddenly discovered that all the blood in his body was inexplicably excited by that vendor's death.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: The Rich Man's Game
chapters.content:
Later, upon a friend's recommendation, he became a user of a mobile app called Black Software.
Of course, this happened a long time ago.
Back then, this software was just a live streaming platform.
It contained a massive number of live stream rooms.
However, every live stream room was filled with negative emotions.
At that time, the most popular live stream room was called "The Rich Man's Game."
What kind of game was this Rich Man's Game?
Quite simple.
If anyone has seen a movie series called "Hostel,"
they would understand.This Rich Man's Game was quite similar to that movie, "Hostel."
The process was roughly the same.
A fixed tourist destination.
Wealthy individuals who wanted to play this game would select their preferred lab rats from among the tourists at that location.
Then the game organizers would capture the lab rats chosen by the wealthy and take them to a secret room.
The secret room contained various torture devices and tools.
Allowing you to do whatever you wanted.
As a wealthy person, you only needed to pay money, while those poor lab rats ended up with neither money nor their lives.
Chen Fei watched that live stream for some time.
Later, he discovered that he could participate too.
All it took was money.
So, he participated.
He was arranged to go abroad at that time.
He selected a young white male tourist visiting that place.
The final result was that the white male was imprisoned by the organizers in a secret room.
Chen Fei entered the secret room.
Of course, he wore a hood.
After all, everything that followed was going to be live streamed.
To be honest, Chen Fei found it quite thrilling while watching the live stream.
But when he actually got involved, he discovered he had no interest in this so-called "do whatever you want" torture and killing.
He just used a scalpel to make one cut on the young white male he had selected, then immediately requested to quit the game.
It wasn't that he felt soft-hearted or thought the young white male was pitiful.
He just found it boring—it didn't excite him.
However, the organizers only said one thing to him at that time.
Only one person could leave this secret room alive.
If you don't kill him, then you will die.
Naturally, Chen Fei wasn't going to sacrifice himself, but since he truly had no interest in this game,
he directly used a pistol from the table in the secret room to finish off the young white male.
For the young white male, this was probably the best way to die.
A quick death was much better than being slowly tortured to death.
...
For some time after that, Chen Fei fell into confusion.
Mainly because he discovered that blood and violence couldn't interest him again or give him that feeling of boiling blood.
Until later, when he read a mystery novel that contained a plot about planning murders for others.
When he reached that part, he felt slightly interested.
It was from that point on that he embarked on the path of helping others plan murders.
Chen Fei initially thought that this kind of murder planning for others would be difficult to come by.
Later, he discovered he wasn't just wrong—he was extremely wrong.
Everyone, search your heart and ask yourself.
In your real life, is there someone you intensely dislike, deeply hate, someone you'd kill without hesitation, someone you wish would die immediately?
If not, congratulations—your life is quite happy, free from such miserable experiences.
If yes, well... it depends on how you think about it.
Gradually, Chen Fei helped others plan murders.
First time, second time, third time.
More and more.
In the process of helping others plan murders, he experienced pleasure.
Until one time.
There was a flaw in the murder plan.
The client, after killing the person they wanted dead,
actually wanted to kill Chen Fei too.
Starting from that turning point,
Chen Fei felt that humans were truly greedy and disgusting creatures.
So from that time on, when he helped others plan murders, he would kill the client after everything was finished.
As for how he came to Alice Apartment,
that's another story.
Simply put, during his last murder planning commission for someone else, he encountered a lifelong enemy...
Exiting his memories.
Returning to reality.
Chen Fei looked at the several people who had already determined the outcome.
He still felt this murder planning was too simple.
It made him unable to muster much interest, finding it quite boring.
Among all the murder cases he had planned, this one absolutely ranked at the bottom, among the lowest tier.
The outcome was as follows.
The new-generation Jack the Ripper, though somewhat injured, ultimately knocked Ma Jia to the ground, where Ma Jia continued to wail in pain.
As for Wang Jian and Qi Shen.
Wang Jian was clearly more injured than the new-generation Jack the Ripper.
But fortunately, he also defeated Qi Shen.
Qi Shen had been beaten black and blue, with blood flowing from the corner of his mouth, lying on the ground and similarly wailing.
This outcome was actually somewhat unexpected, since Qi Shen appeared somewhat taller than Wang Jian from their physique.
But who would have thought he'd be so weak in a fight.
Of course, being weak was quite normal.
Although Qi Shen was only two or three years older than Wang Jian,
we mustn't forget this guy came from a wealthy family.
His body had long been drained by various women when he was even younger.
Alcohol and women can harm people—this is no joke.
Indulging in wine and women can truly destroy a person's will and body.
Let me give two examples.
Those who like watching football should know about the player Ronaldinho.
An absolute legendary player, called the football magician.
But because he became obsessed with nightclub girls too early, his career became extremely short.
Lü Bu.
When Lü Bu first appeared, he fought Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei simultaneously.
Considered the absolute number one warrior of the Three Kingdoms.
His strength was truly terrifying.
Yet by the time of the later Battle of Xiapi,
when he fought Xu Huang, and Xu Huang's axe clashed with his halberd,
he actually felt extremely strained, with his hands hurting from the impact.
You must understand, this would have been simply impossible for the early-period Lü Bu.
In his early days, Xu Huang would likely have been decapitated already...
Later, Lü Bu also summarized his lesson.
Wine and women had harmed him so deeply, and then he resolutely chose to quit drinking, hahahaha.
If these two notable figures ended up like this, how much more so for a small rich second generation like Qi Shen?
Prematurely overexerting his body caused him to wilt when put to the test.
At this moment, Wang Jian continuously kicked Qi Shen with his right foot, seemingly venting the anger built up from being bullied by them for so long.
Of course, Qi Shen couldn't tolerate this, so he got up again, only to be knocked down once more by Wang Jian.
In truth, when it came to actual fighting,
Wang Jian wasn't afraid of any one of the three bullies—it was just that they had numbers advantage.
"Damn, my neck..."
Blond Guy, who had been lying on the ground with his feet tied and left hand chained to the glass coffee table, finally woke up.
After waking, he tried to touch his neck with his hand.

chapters.content:
At this moment, Chen Fei was waiting quietly outside Room 1002, anticipating the return of both hunter and prey.

Chen Fei's expression remained deeply perplexed.
Finally, he spoke.
Pointing at the hammer in Wang Jian's hand, he asked: "Are you going to kill me next?"
Wang Jian shook his head.
Immediately, Chen Fei stared directly into Wang Jian's eyes for another five minutes.
Then, he asked suspiciously: "Do you have dissociative identity disorder? Or schizophrenia?"
Wang Jian shook his head: "Neither."
Chen Fei's mind raced furiously, and soon he thought of one possibility.
But could this possibility actually exist?
Could someone's scheming really run this deep?
Ultimately, Chen Fei voiced the possibility he had guessed.
He said: "Don't tell me this is your true face now, and everything before when you interacted with me was an act? Your disguise?"
Wang Jian finally showed a smile: "You're clever. You finally figured it out."

Getting this confirmation, Chen Fei's eyes widened instantly.
He kept replaying all his interactions with Wang Jian in his mind.
His understanding of Wang Jian was similar to the new-generation Jack the Ripper's.Read full story at NoveI~Fire.net

If everything before during their interactions was just acting, then Wang Jian was truly somewhat terrifying.
Not a single slip-up?

Wang Jian spoke calmly.
Chen Fei laughed loudly several times, though it was unclear what emotions mixed within that laughter.
He then continued: "Interesting, very interesting. This is my first time encountering someone like you."

"And the current you is the real you."

"And earlier, in the room, when you were moved by Qi Shen's words and put down the knife—that was also an act. You never actually intended to spare Qi Shen and the others."
"Wonderful! Such acting! Such scheming!"
Chen Fei kept applauding.
Wang Jian said: "Pretty much. After all, acting that way fit the persona I usually project. Plus I guessed that even if I acted like I didn't want to kill them, you'd definitely force me to kill them anyway. So this performance of being moved and putting down the knife wouldn't actually affect their deaths."
"Besides, truly good acting means deceiving even yourself—both physically and psychologically. You have to believe your own lies."
Chen Fei applauded: "Since you're so scheming, I'm curious—how could you endure bullying from these guys for so long?"
In Chen Fei's eyes, Wang Jian was no longer an ordinary guy, making it hard to understand how he could tolerate such prolonged bullying.
Wang Jian now sighed deeply: "Even if my usual self is a disguise and this is my true self."
"Does that mean this so-called true self is invincible? Able to do whatever I want? Calculating every move? Extremely clever?"
"Let me tell you—when I saved that girl, I wasn't lying to you."
"I really saved her based on my conscience, even though she wasn't pretty, just average-looking."
"Afterward, I got bullied."
"At first, I wanted to endure it."
"But I never expected these guys would escalate things."
"Initially, I still thought about other solutions to return to my normal life."
"But these guys simply gave me no opportunity!"
"Therefore, I actually started considering killing them quite early on."
"The only question then was—if they died, would it lead back to me?"
"Could I escape completely unscathed?"
"In this era of surveillance everywhere, committing the perfect crime is truly difficult."
"Especially when there are five targets—one small mistake, one person escapes, and my entire life would be ruined."
"So if I were to act, I had to be absolutely certain before moving."
"But where could such certainty be found? So I kept enduring, enduring for so long."
"Finally, an opportunity came."
"Once, when I went out to buy groceries at the supermarket, I met a middle-aged man."
"That man told me about Alice Apartment and some so-called agreement."
"At the time I didn't pay much attention, but I still kept my wits about me and asked him for a contact phone number."
"Later, when I returned home, the more I thought about it, the more peculiar it seemed."
"And you might not believe this, but I had a feeling that my opportunity to deal with these people might lie within this Alice Apartment."
"So I came."
"After arriving, I found this apartment wasn't particularly special."
"The only unusual thing was that I actually received the 10,000 per day mentioned in the agreement."
"Honestly, I was somewhat disappointed, but I continued searching for what made this apartment different."
"After all, if it were just an ordinary apartment, why would they pay me 10,000 per day?"
"I even suspected that Alice Apartment might be haunted—a ghost mansion, a murder house, or something like that."
Hearing this, Chen Fei thought to himself that this place was indeed a ghost mansion and murder house.
After all, who knew how many people had died here.
If according to outside standards—a house where even one person was killed counted as a murder house.
Then this entire Alice Apartment was a super, super, super, with countless "super" prefixes, murder house.
Naturally unaware of Chen Fei's thoughts, Wang Jian continued:
"Later, heaven let me encounter you."
"Only then did I realize that this Alice Apartment indeed seemed somewhat unusual."
"Everything that happened afterward, you already know."
"I went along with the situation, using you to help me eliminate Qi Shen and the others."
After listening, Chen Fei asked: "Then when I betrayed you to Qi Shen, and when those guys subdued and tied you up—weren't you afraid you'd trapped yourself with your own game?"
Wang Jian revealed a faint smile: "To be honest, I was indeed panicking at that time."

Chen Fei pulled out that master-crafted knife from before from his chest pocket.

His musical knowledge covered a broad range, from music history and ancient classical music to modern pop music, along with various peculiar stories about music. It was far more interesting than the dull classes taught by typical music teachers.
Particularly when Zhang Le now discussed a recently heavily criticized cover song online—a domestic male idol group called something like "Youth League" covering "Lemon," the representative work of Japanese artist Kenshi Yonezu from Cherry Blossom Country.
Zhang Le spoke from the stage: "I believe many people here have heard that Japanese song 'Lemon' from Cherry Blossom Country, as well as the recently heavily criticized cover version online."
"Let's not even discuss the singing skills of this idol group first. Let's just talk about the lyrics alone."
"That day's melancholy, become melancholy. That day's loneliness, become lonely."
"Not mentioning other lyrics, just these two lines. First, these lyrics sound like they were written by an elementary school student in terms of word choice, phrasing, and structure."
"Of course, this isn't what I want to criticize. What I want to criticize is melancholy and loneliness—these two things nobody wants to encounter."
"These two lyrics actually encourage melancholy and loneliness to 'become thoroughly'? What were they thinking?""Isn't this as absurd as a depressed patient not wanting to get better but instead hoping their depression becomes more severe? That day's depression, become depressed?"
"As for why I'm mentioning this matter—it's not because I want to criticize it, but because I want to use this to express my philosophy about songs."
"A song consists of both melody and lyrics! May I ask, which is more important—the melody or the lyrics?"
Liu Xiaoyu raised her hand: "Definitely the melody is more important! Without the melody, where would the lyrics come from?" While speaking, the camera in her right hand never stopped recording.
Manager Xiao Zhang countered Liu Xiaoyu: "Who says there must be a melody first before lyrics? Some creators accumulate phrases and lyrics in their daily life. Even without a melody, they can have complete lyrics."
Liu Xiaoyu disagreed: "But in this world, lyrics are generally written based on the melody. Like Jay Chou and Vincent Fang—doesn't Jay Chou always provide the melody first? Then Vincent Fang writes lyrics based on the melody?"
This example brought instant silence to the entire room. Indeed, over these years, Jay Chou could be considered the absolute dominant force in Chinese music. Who would dare refute this example?
At this moment, Fang Xiao took a drink of baijiu and suddenly spoke with a laugh: "I think this question is too extreme—whether melody is more important or lyrics are more important."
"I believe both are important. Good melody paired with good lyrics creates perfect harmony."
Jiang Ran was also pondering this question. If forced to choose, he thought everyone above made good points, haha.
"Hey, that Zhang Le guy, since you raised this question, why don't you tell us—which is more important, melody or lyrics?" Fang Xiao raised his baijiu bottle toward Zhang Le on stage.
Zhang Le smiled slightly: "Different people have different opinions. Everyone has their own answer to this question."
"As for how I view this question, I'll only say one sentence: A song is like a person. The melody is the person's appearance, the lyrics are the person's soul."
Next, Zhang Le changed the subject and began discussing other music-related topics.
Jiang Ran felt his phone vibrating in his pants pocket at this moment. Opening it, he saw a text message from Bai Xiaoliang, the doctor treating him at Red Leaf Psychiatric Hospital in Nancheng City.
The general meaning was that if he had time, he could come this afternoon as they had finalized the relevant treatment plan. Seeing this, Jiang Ran's mood immediately improved since he hoped his dissociative identity disorder could be treated quickly!
Of course, since he needed to go to the hospital in the afternoon, he would have to ask Manager Xiao Zhang for leave again.
...
Time quickly reached 1 PM in the afternoon. Jiang Ran arrived at Red Leaf Psychiatric Hospital.
Perhaps due to special privileges Bai Xiaoliang had arranged for Jiang Ran, he didn't need to register this time. After informing the front desk nurse and waiting about ten minutes, he directly entered examination room number 1 where Bai Xiaoliang always worked.
The moment Jiang Ran stepped into examination room number 1, he froze in his tracks. Because the danger warning sounded in his mind again:
[Ding! Dangerous person detected! Please distance yourself immediately! Points +10! Points +10! Points +10...]
That's right—the danger warning that had never sounded during his previous two hospital visits was now active. After it sounded, Jiang Ran immediately scanned the entire examination room with his eyes.
This time, examination room number 1 contained about a dozen people, mostly doctors. Although Jiang Ran had visited twice before, he at least had some impression of these doctors. Only one person looked completely unfamiliar.
Jiang Ran looked toward a man standing beside Bai Xiaoliang. Bai Xiaoliang was very handsome and good-looking—most ordinary men couldn't compare when standing next to him. But this man standing beside Bai Xiaoliang wasn't overshadowed at all;
instead, his looks were on par with Bai Xiaoliang's.
Moreover, this man seemed to be a foreigner? Caucasian appearance?
As if noticing Jiang Ran's gaze, Bai Xiaoliang happened to be introducing the person beside him: "Jiang Ran, this is my junior fellow student. His name is Lucas Matthew—you can call him Lucas."
"He's mixed race—his father is American, his mother is from Hua Country. Although he's a few years younger than me, he's also an expert in psychiatry."
"He came to Hua Country for an exchange program."
"Oh..." After hearing Bai Xiaoliang's introduction, Jiang Ran let out a long "oh" sound.
The biggest flaw of his Danger Warning System was that in a group of people, when it suddenly issued a danger warning—such as warning that someone was dangerous—he completely couldn't tell exactly which person it was.
But based on the current situation, this mixed-race person named Lucas seemed quite suspicious.
Next, Jiang Ran was arranged to sit in a chair. Bai Xiaoliang sat opposite Jiang Ran and said very seriously: "Jiang Ran, I've finalized your specific treatment plan."
"That is—hypnosis therapy. I will determine the timing of each subsequent hypnosis session based on the effects of the previous one."
"Regarding this, Jiang Ran, do you have any different opinions?"

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Bai Xiaoliang's Junior Brother - Lucas
chapters.content:
Hearing this treatment plan, Jiang Ran thought for a moment and said: "Only hypnosis? Don't I need to take any medicine or undergo surgery?"
Hearing this, Bai Xiaoliang quickly shook his head: "No no no, regarding medication, you can just continue taking that imported American medicine you've been using to stabilize your condition."
"As for surgery, to be honest, I'm most opposed to performing operations on mental patients."
"The brain is humanity's most precise organ."
"Not to mention the brain - have humans truly fully understood even our other organs?"
"If surgery were truly necessary, then we'd do it, but your current condition absolutely doesn't require surgery."
"You only need hypnosis therapy."
"So, Jiang Ran, do you agree with this treatment plan?"
Jiang Ran said: "I agree, let's give it a try!"
Bai Xiaoliang: "Alright then, Jiang Ran, go out and make the payment, then you can come right in for hypnosis."Jiang Ran nodded, walked outside, found the self-service payment machine, and began making the payment.
What greatly surprised him was that this hypnosis therapy actually only cost one thousand yuan?
This price would be normal if an ordinary doctor was performing the hypnosis.
Domestically, this hypnosis price was basically standard.
Of course, there were even cheaper options - one or two hundred, a few hundred.
But one thousand? For someone of Bai Xiaoliang's caliber performing your hypnosis, there's no way it could possibly be this cheap!
Just look at that long string of credentials on his poster - it's downright intimidating.
Jiang Ran thought there must be some mistake and returned to the examination room to ask.
After inquiring, he discovered there was no mistake.
Bai Xiaoliang's fee for one hypnosis session was: approximately fifty thousand yuan.
Yes, it was that expensive.
So why was he only charging Jiang Ran one thousand per session?
Mainly because Jiang Ran's case was too rare.
Bai Xiaoliang was afraid that quoting a high price might scare him away from treatment.
So he just charged one thousand yuan as a token amount.
After all, the hospital director was his father.
Therefore, rather than saying Bai Xiaoliang was treating Jiang Ran to make money, it would be more accurate to say he was studying Jiang Ran out of his own curiosity and desire for exploration.Content originally comes from .net
After Jiang Ran completed the payment, he returned to the examination room.
Then he heard Bai Xiaoliang say: "Jiang Ran, the one who will be performing your hypnosis therapy this time isn't me, but my junior brother, Lucas."
Hearing that it wouldn't be Bai Xiaoliang performing his hypnosis but this Lucas instead, Jiang Ran didn't know why but felt a sense of foreboding.
Even though Lucas was very handsome and constantly wore a smile.
"Why aren't you the one doing it? Doctor Bai?"
At this moment, Jiang Ran questioned Bai Xiaoliang.
Bai Xiaoliang sighed and said: "Every doctor who practices hypnosis has one hypnotic prop they use most comfortably."
"The pocket watch I used to hypnotize you before was a substitute. My real one was stolen right before I returned to China, back in America. So when I use other substitutes to hypnotize you, the effect is very poor - I can't utilize my full ability."
"So for the sake of effectiveness, I can only have my junior brother help you first. But don't worry, his skill level is no worse than mine, and his pocket watch hasn't been lost."
After hearing this, Jiang Ran hesitated.
He estimated that perhaps this danger warning alarm was about Lucas.
So letting a dangerous person - one worth +10 points at that - perform hypnosis on him?
If Jiang Ran really let him do it, wouldn't that be like dancing on the edge of a knife?
What if during hypnosis, he suddenly tried to do something harmful to him?
Although the likelihood of this seemed quite small.
After all, this was their first meeting.
No need to have malicious intentions toward someone at the first meeting, right?
"Jiang Ran, don't worry, my junior brother's technique is truly excellent, not inferior to mine."
As if sensing Jiang Ran's concerns, Bai Xiaoliang smiled and said: "While he's performing your hypnosis, we'll also be nearby, so you can rest assured."
At this moment, Bai Xiaoliang's junior brother Lucas also said: "Yes, rest assured, Jiang Ran. I've already reviewed your documents, so I have some understanding of your case."
"Also, my technique is excellent - my senior brother can vouch for me."
"If you're still worried about something, don't be afraid - I'm half Hua Country person myself."
"As the saying goes, Hua Country people don't deceive Hua Country people."
Lucas's Chinese was excellent.
Completely without a foreign accent.
Jiang Ran listened carefully, and when he heard that line about Hua Country people not deceiving Hua Country people, he wanted to complain about something, but ultimately didn't say it out loud.
"Alright, you can hypnotize me."
"Doctor Bai, and everyone will still be nearby, right?"
Jiang Ran confirmed again.
Bai Xiaoliang said: "Yes, I'll be nearby, and all the other doctors in this room will also be here observing and learning."
Jiang Ran scratched his forehead and said: "Let's begin."
Jiang Ran ultimately agreed, giving face to Bai Xiaoliang.
After all, he had been persuading for so long, and he'd given him such a discount on the hypnosis fee.
Next.
Jiang Ran assumed the hypnosis would be conducted in examination room number 1.
After all, that's where Bai Xiaoliang had performed his hypnosis last time.
So he thought it would be the same place this time.
But he was informed that wasn't the case.
It would be in a room on the upper floor.
Therefore, Jiang Ran followed Bai Xiaoliang, Lucas, and the others upward.
They took the elevator all the way.
The elevator was large enough to accommodate everyone who had been in examination room number 1.
In the elevator were these people:
Bai Xiaoliang, Lucas, and ten other doctors totaling eleven medical staff.
One patient: Jiang Ran.
Then there was Bai Xiaoliang's dedicated pretty nurse who liked wearing red colored contacts, called Xiao Tong.
While in the elevator.
Jiang Ran suddenly asked: "Doctor Bai, your Red Leaf Hospital is a specialized hospital that only treats mental illnesses, right?"
Bai Xiaoliang didn't know why Jiang Ran suddenly asked this and said: "Yes, why do you ask?"
Jiang Ran said: "Nothing, just asking. Is your hospital's business lately - oh, no, I mean have there been more and more patients coming for mental health issues recently?"
Even though Jiang Ran corrected himself quickly, in the enclosed quiet space of the elevator, everyone definitely heard him.
Although the term "business" isn't really appropriate for hospitals.
But these days, it didn't seem entirely inappropriate either.
Just wasn't sure how people working in the hospital would feel hearing it.
Anger? Or some other emotion?
Bai Xiaoliang naturally heard it too, but he still maintained his smile, not minding: "Indeed, looking at our hospital's data from recent years, there really have been many more patients coming for mental health issues."
Jiang Ran said: "That makes sense. After all, with social development, mental and emotional aspects will definitely receive increasing attention."
"For example, twenty or thirty years ago, if you mentioned depression, probably many people hadn't heard of it, and even if they had, they wouldn't take it seriously because they didn't consider mental and emotional psychological conditions as real illnesses - they only regarded physical conditions as diseases."
"But now it's different. So I think the future trend will see tremendous growth in these mental, emotional, and psychological industries."
Bai Xiaoliang seemed somewhat surprised that Jiang Ran could think so deeply and analyze so much.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Lucas's Hypnosis Technique
chapters.content:
The hypnosis session for Jiang Ran was conducted in a room on the top floor of this building.
The top floor was sparsely populated, with only a young female nurse wearing a pink nurse uniform sitting on a chair, idly playing with her phone.
Suddenly hearing the elevator sound, she saw over a dozen people pouring out of the elevator and hurriedly put away her phone, forcing a smile onto her pretty face.
She quickly walked over.
"Is Hypnosis Room 99 currently in use?"
Bai Xiaoliang looked at the young female nurse approaching quickly and asked.
The young nurse promptly replied: "No, it's not."
Bai Xiaoliang: "Good."
Next, Bai Xiaoliang and his group all proceeded to Hypnosis Room 99.
After they had gone some distance,this young nurse's face became somewhat flushed.
She touched her burning hot cheeks and secretly thought to herself:
"Doctor Bai is really so handsome... and so talented too. If only I could marry him!"
......
"Senior brother, it seems you have quite the romantic luck in this hospital. Did you notice that young nurse just now? When she spoke to you, her face turned red so quickly, and she kept avoiding eye contact—seems like she might be interested in you?"
Meanwhile, on their way to Hypnosis Room 99,
Lucas teased Bai Xiaoliang.
Bai Xiaoliang glanced at him and said: "Having many admirers isn't necessarily a good thing. If you can't handle it properly, it can become a disaster."
"Remember that news from a few years back?"
"There was this male psychologist who was so handsome that all the female nurses, doctors, and especially female patients developed feelings for him. He couldn't control himself either and ended up falling from grace. Eventually he was exposed for dating multiple women simultaneously, completely ruining his reputation."
Lucas smiled and said: "That's nothing special. The hospital circle has always been messy. Those people see life and death so often that they become desensitized. Doctors with doctors, doctors with nurses."
"And besides the medical field, there's also the entertainment industry, finance sector—all equally chaotic."
"But no matter how messy it gets, it's just that trivial stuff between men and women."
"So boring. I completely fail to understand what pleasure people find in obsessing over those male-female matters."
Lucas gave a cold laugh.
Bai Xiaoliang glanced at him.
He was 30 years old this year, unmarried but currently dating a woman—his first love actually.
As for Lucas, now 28 years old, just two years younger than him.
But Bai Xiaoliang had never seen Lucas interact closely with any women or be in a relationship.
He thought Lucas might prefer men, but this guy didn't have any intimate contact with men either.
He seemed completely devoted to his professional work.
Bai Xiaoliang considered himself quite dedicated, but felt somewhat inferior compared to his junior brother.
Their conversation was naturally overheard by the male doctors following behind them.
As they listened, these doctors of varying ages all showed expressions of varying degrees of embarrassment to some extent.
Hypnosis Room 99.
After pushing the door open and entering,
they found the hypnosis room was quite spacious.
Additionally, the decoration style leaned toward light and refreshing green tones.
Before entering this hypnosis room, Jiang Ran and the others used the shoe cover dispenser at the entrance to put disposable shoe covers over their respective shoes.
Only then did they enter the hypnosis room.
After entering, Bai Xiaoliang had Jiang Ran lie down on clean light cyan bedding placed on the left side of the room.
Jiang Ran removed his shoes and lay down completely on the bedding.
Once lying down, Jiang Ran noticed many devices and props around him.
Probably all used for hypnosis purposes.
At this moment,
Bai Xiaoliang spoke: "Jiang Ran, the hypnosis is about to begin. Everything from now on will be handled by my junior brother Lucas."
Immediately, Jiang Ran saw Bai Xiaoliang and the others all retreat to the sides of the hypnosis room.
Then they put sound-blocking earplugs in their ears.
"Why are they wearing earplugs?"
Jiang Ran frowned, asking Lucas suspiciously.
But then he noticed Lucas wasn't beside him—instead, he was taking six incense candles from a metal cabinet on the right side.
These incense candles looked no different from ordinary ones at first glance.
If anything stood out, it was that these candles were very thin and very long.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on noᴠelfire.net
Also, their color was somewhat unusual.
They were pure black.
Lucas placed the six incense candles—three on each side—in small incense holders arranged around where Jiang Ran lay.
He began lighting them.
Once lit, these six incense candles strangely emitted red smoke.
Jiang Ran instinctively wanted to cover his nose and mouth because subconsciously, such candles should smell terrible.
But to his great surprise, these incense candles actually smelled pleasant.
Like perfume on a woman.
refreshing and delightful.
So he didn't cover his nose after all.
"Jiang Ran, we're about to begin the hypnosis now."
Lucas now took a wooden box from his jacket pocket.
This wooden box looked quite ordinary.
It was golden yellow with dense patterns covering its surface.
After taking out the golden nanmu box, Lucas opened the lid.
From inside, he took out an exquisite and beautiful pocket watch.
Inside was a large clock face with three smaller clock faces.
At the starting point of the hour and minute hands on the main clock face, underneath was a light golden-blue circle.
Within this circle, blue served as the background with golden accents.
These accents resembled stars in the sky or meridians in the human body,
all connected together.
A golden chain linked this golden pocket watch to Lucas's hand.
"Jiang Ran, now relax and focus on watching this pocket watch."
Lucas was preparing to begin the hypnosis.
But Jiang Ran interrupted: "Hey, first answer me—why are Doctor Bai and the others wearing earplugs?"
Lucas directly replied: "This pocket watch of mine is rather special."
"Each time it swings, it produces a certain sound."
"Of course, this sound can't be detected by human ears, but it genuinely exists."
"So they need earplugs to block the sound, preventing themselves from also falling into hypnosis."
"Really? Then why aren't you wearing them? Aren't you afraid of being hypnotized too? After all, you can hear this sound too, right?"
Jiang Ran asked curiously.
Lucas simply smiled without answering Jiang Ran's question and began swinging the pocket watch.
Jiang Ran thought Lucas's explanation seemed contradictory.
But just as this thought formed, for some reason, even without really watching the pocket watch,
he felt an overwhelming drowsiness assault his brain and then his entire body.
He felt so sleepy, so incredibly sleepy.
Within three seconds of the pocket watch starting to swing, he entered a half-asleep, half-awake state.
Though Jiang Ran had fallen into hypnosis, Lucas didn't stop swinging the pocket watch.
He sat beside Jiang Ran's head, continuing to rhythmically swing the pocket watch in his hand.
Gradually, he too slowly closed his eyes.
Finally, his lips moved, leaving behind these words:
"Let me see what's inside your inner world."

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Entering Jiang Ran’s Inner World
chapters.content:
At this very moment.
Lucas opened his eyes.
After opening his eyes, he found himself seemingly back in America.
More precisely, in an American small town.
Because looking around, there were rows of independent villas on both sides.
Along with wide roads and lawns.
"This is... the inner world of Jiang Ran's dissociative identity disorder?"
Lucas continuously looked around as he walked forward.
He walked for about five minutes without seeing a single person. The small town was extremely quiet.
At the ten-minute mark.He finally saw people.
Beside a white marble fountain statue of Jiang Ran, there were several people.
Lucas didn't choose to hide or anything, but instead strode forward boldly.
As he noticed the people by the fountain statue, they also noticed him.
Therefore, all their gazes focused on him.
"Well, well, well, I originally thought this mixed-race guy was just a quack doctor, but I never expected he could actually enter here?"
At this moment, a blue-haired Jiang Ran who looked exactly like the real Jiang Ran but with blue hair spoke in a cheerful tone.
Lucas naturally heard this too, stopping about three meters away from these people.
Looking around, he noticed all these people had the same face.
The only differences were their clothing and hairstyles.
"Entering here isn't particularly surprising, after all, this isn't the first person's inner world I've entered."
Lucas smiled faintly.
"However, what I didn't expect was that Jiang Ran's inner world would be so complete."
"This situation is extremely rare;
it seems I bet correctly this time."
Currently, there were five "Jiang Rans" standing here.
The other four didn't seem to like talking much, as only the blue-haired Jiang Ran had been conversing with Lucas.
Blue-haired Jiang Ran asked Lucas: "Your name is Lucas, right? What's your purpose in coming here? To help the main personality eliminate us?"Read complete version only at novel{f}ire.net
"If that's really the case, I advise you to abandon this idea."
"Because you're not the first outsider to enter this inner landscape world."
"A long time ago, a middle-aged psychological doctor with superb hypnosis skills also entered here. He wanted to help the main personality eliminate us."
"We all warned him to get lost immediately, to stay away from the main personality, otherwise he was definitely going to die."
"Who would have thought that guy was a complete madman, completely disregarding his own safety, still trying to eliminate us to complete his thesis."
"Then, he was controlled by one of us and directly killed."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran said this with a cold smile, clearly threatening Lucas.
"Inner landscape world? That's what Hua Country calls this. Overseas, including America, we call it the inner world."
"It seems the first outsider to enter here was a Hua Country doctor."
Facing the cold intent in blue-haired Jiang Ran's previous words, Lucas showed no fear at all.
He said calmly: "There's something you've misunderstood. I came here not to help the main personality eliminate you."
"On the contrary, I want to help you eliminate the main personality and let you take control of the body."
Hearing this, blue-haired Jiang Ran and the other Jiang Rans all stiffened.
Then they looked at each other, wondering if they had misheard.
"Help us? You're that kind? What's in it for you?"
Blue-haired Jiang Ran simply didn't believe it.
Lucas still maintained his faint smile:
"Simple, because I'm also a dissociative identity disorder patient, and I eliminated the main personality to take its place."
Whoosh!
Calm words created turbulent waves.
If blue-haired Jiang Ran and the others were previously at ordinary levels of confusion, now they reached advanced levels of bewilderment.
Blue-haired Jiang Ran frowned: "But that still doesn't make sense. Even if we're all alternate personalities, there's no reason for you to help us?"
Lucas spread his hands: "That's exactly the reason - we share the same suffering. Believe it or not."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran and the other Jiang Rans nearby exchanged glances.
They seemed to be communicating with their eyes.
They first retreated to the side, then quietly discussed for five minutes.
Then returned to their original positions.
After returning, it was still blue-haired Jiang Ran who spoke with Lucas:
"Even if we believe you, how do you plan to help us eliminate the main personality?"
"Do you know how strong the main personality is?"
"The main personality is completely opposite to those ordinary dissociative identity disorder patients."
"Those ordinary patients developed other protective personalities because they suffered unacceptable traumatic experiences in childhood that caused psychological illness, to protect the main personality."
"But our situation is completely opposite."
"So, do you have the capability? Don't end up failing to eliminate the main personality and instead bring the main personality down here. We just lost one alternate personality not long ago."
Lucas listened to these words with a slight smile: "Just leave it to me. Capability needs to be proven, not just talked about. No matter how beautifully I describe it now, it's useless."
After saying this, Lucas suddenly froze.
At this moment, he turned his head back.
Unclear when, another Jiang Ran had appeared behind him.
This Jiang Ran wore a full black long coat.
His hair looked fixed with hair gel, all standing straight up.
Then, his face had black smoky eye makeup.
Under the smoky makeup, this Jiang Ran's smile looked truly eerie.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, seeing that Lucas had noticed him, without saying a word, suddenly thrust his right hand forward.
This thrust created a scene that was hard to believe.
He actually directly pierced through Lucas's heart area.
According to real-world circumstances.
Such piercing would be almost impossible to achieve with just a human hand.
Even if it were possible, there should now be massive amounts of blood spraying from the chest area.
But now, Lucas with his heart pierced through.
Only showed extreme pain on his face, his solid form gradually dissipating.
"You!"
Lucas still wanted to say something to Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran.
But at that moment, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran punched Lucas's neck with his left hand.
Lucas's body dissipated faster.
Within seconds, he completely disappeared.
Seeing Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran kill Lucas who had just entered,
The other Jiang Rans present besides blue-haired Jiang Ran all showed fearful expressions.
As if they were extremely afraid of this Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran.
Therefore, only blue-haired Jiang Ran communicated with this Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran:
"Hey, he came to help us eliminate the main personality? Why did you kill him?"
Hearing this, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran supported his neck with his right hand, continuously cracking and twisting it, stretching.
His eerie smile remained on his face:
"Just woke up, stretching my limbs a bit."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran frowned: "Stretching your limbs? Who are you trying to fool?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran continued smiling: "Well, well, well, you're still the clever one."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran: "So why did you kill him?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran: "Anyway, he won't die in reality, so it doesn't count as killing."
"Besides, I killed him purely because I didn't like him and didn't believe what he said."
"Also, him helping us eliminate the main personality? Who knows if it's real help or fake help."

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Smoky-Eyed Jiang Ran
chapters.content:
"Even if he's genuinely helping, his assistance comes with ill intentions and unknown motives."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran sighed helplessly: "Do you think you're the only one who noticed? We're not fools either, we obviously saw it too, but letting him try isn't necessarily a bad thing."
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran maintained his eerie smile:
"Fools."
"Even we who were forced into prolonged slumber, along with several others, understand this better than you."
"If we were still on Earth, we might have had hope to seize control of the body and gain absolute dominance."
"But now? Although I've just awakened, I've absorbed all memories since crossing to Blue Star."
"Haven't you noticed that this System is fundamentally designed to assist the main personality?"
"This System will never let us achieve our desires."
"And most importantly.""Previously, the main personality could never enter here to eliminate any of us."
"But since last time, when the System awakened the main personality's evil memories, he can now enter to destroy one of us before being forced to leave."
"What does this signify? It means that every time the System awakens all of the main personality's evil memories, forming a complete entity, he can enter the inner landscape world once."
"So instead of dreaming about controlling the body, we should focus on simply staying alive!"
After hearing this, Blue-haired Jiang Ran continuously ruffled his smooth blue hair.
"This really doesn't sound like something you'd say! After all, back in the day, you were one of the most aggressive in fighting for body control!"Check latest chapters at NoveI~Fire.net
"By the way, since you've awakened, have any of the others awakened too?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran shook his head: "No."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran: "So what do you plan to do now?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran: "What can I do? I don't know."
"Right now, I just want to go out and stretch my limbs."
...
Inside Hypnosis Room 99.
The hypnosis session originally planned to last at least one hour.
Ended in less than half that time.
Beside Jiang Ran, Lucas, who had been sitting with eyes tightly closed, had now opened them.
Without the cover of eyelids, one could clearly see that the whites around Lucas's sapphire-blue eyes were completely covered with dense, terrifying red veins, like creeping ivy.
That wasn't all - Lucas's forehead and entire face were drenched in sweat.
He looked utterly tormented, supporting himself with both hands on the floor while gasping for breath.
The expensive specialized pocket watch in his right hand had been tossed aside.
Like worthless garbage.
Bai Xiaoliang, who had been standing by the wall witnessing this scene.
Immediately rushed over from the wall, picked up the golden pocket watch.
Then helped Lucas to his feet.
Bai Xiaoliang removed the earplugs from both ears and asked Lucas what happened, what went wrong?
Why was he sweating so profusely?
Lucas didn't look at Bai Xiaoliang, just kept his head down and said he needed to use the restroom.
Then Lucas rushed out of Hypnosis Room 99.
Running all the way to this floor's bathroom.
Once in the bathroom, he continuously cupped water from the faucet in his hands, splashing it on his face to wash himself.
Only after five or six minutes of stimulation from the cold water did he finally face the bathroom mirror.
Staring at his own reflection.
The reflection showed a complexion somewhat improved from before.
But the red veins in his eyes still hadn't receded.
Moreover, a throbbing pain continued to pulse through his head.
Suddenly, he let out a loud "Hahaha" laugh.
Then, he roared inwardly: "Damn it all! Those damned alternate personalities actually dared to attack me!"
Lucas raged madly within his mind.
He wondered why that suddenly appearing Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran had tried to kill him?
Was it because his lies had been exposed?
The lie about being an alternate personality?
Yes, that was indeed a lie.
Lucas never had dissociative identity disorder at all. The story about being an alternate personality who killed the main personality was completely fabricated, just to build rapport with Jiang Ran's alternate personalities!
As for later offers of help, those were lies too.
Only he himself knew what his true objectives were.
...
Back in Hypnosis Room 99.
