Especially as he looked at his blood-soaked legs and the blood-covered floor.
He gasped heavily.
He begged Liu Xiaoyu: "Xiaoyu, please, I beg you, let me go! If you let me go! I'll tell you the secret of this apartment, how about that?"
"Aren't you curious why I called you a lab rat?"
Liu Xiaoyu beamed brightly: "Not curious, not curious at all."
"Including the fact that I signed the agreement to come in;
I didn't think much about this apartment, I just thought about getting the money."
"Alright, next, for the finale of the short film, you are the lead."
Liu Xiaoyu once again stepped out of the filming perspective.
Leaving the frame entirely to Liu Zhou.
Liu Zhou now had a face full of horror and fear.
What was he afraid of?
Afraid of Liu Xiaoyu?
No, he was afraid of death.
Suddenly, he uncontrollably recalled the beautiful women he had killed before.
Their tragic scenes before death.
How similar were those beautiful women he killed, near death, to him now?
Trying to plead for help, but it was useless.
"No! Don't come closer! All of you, don't come closer!!!"
It was probably hallucinations caused by excessive blood loss.
Liu Zhou's eyes suddenly widened, the whites filled with crawling red blood vessels.
He saw blood-covered women appearing all around him.
They were the women he had killed before.
These women surrounded him.
Reaching out with their bloody hands, revealing white bones within the flesh, approaching him.
In his final moments before death, Liu Zhou kept screaming.
His voice gradually grew weaker.
Even though there was no external force on his neck, he died as if he had been strangled to death.
At this moment, in the live stream room.
Evil Wolf: [What a worthless piece of trash.]
[Turning from hunter into prey, how disgraceful!]
[Just like that simp named Zhao Jie, worthless! Garbage!!]

chapters.title: Chapter 223: The Shackles on Wang Qingzhao Are Completely Broken
chapters.content:
I'm Actually a Girl: 【He's not completely useless! After all, who could have guessed that this Liu Xiaoyu was actually a wolf in sheep's clothing?】
【She's even more ruthless than that Wang Jian!】
【Wang Jian is just a skilled actor.】
【She's different, she's a madwoman who loves making films and pursues art!】
【Did you all see the video clip she played?】
【How is this a lab rat?!】
Fairy Sister: 【Indeed, this doesn't seem like a lab rat at all, it's more like the other residents in this apartment... Also, when this round of the game was introduced, there was no mention of Liu Xiaoyu filming murder videos, right? I feel that Liu Xiaoyu shouldn't have been able to enter the apartment as a lab rat?!】
Middle-aged Uncle jumped out to refute: 【You're wrong, Fairy Sister.】
【What exactly is a lab rat?】
【In our impression, a lab rat is pretty much what Liu Zhou described - a lab rat should be an ordinary person.】【But from the Apartment Organizers' perspective, that's not the case at all.】
【Take Jiang Ran for example, do you think Jiang Ran still qualifies as a proper lab rat now?】
【Since he entered the apartment, how many deranged criminals has he taken out? How many deranged serial killers? Even Robert was eliminated by him!】
【Besides, who says a deranged criminal can't be a lab rat?】
Fairy Sister: 【Actually, what I really want to complain about is that the apartment's introductory information is incomplete.】
Domineering Female CEO: 【If it were complete, it wouldn't be interesting. It's fine as it is. Don't you think this is quite surprising?】
Liu Zhou's home.
After Liu Zhou was completely dead.
Liu Xiaoyu put away her handheld camera.
Then using brooms and mops from Liu Zhou's home, she began cleaning the bloodstains in the living room.
After cleaning up most of the blood in the living room.
She started dealing with Liu Zhou's corpse, such as stopping the bleeding from the wounds.
If you want to talk about the best tool for moving a corpse, it's definitely a suitcase or those large duffel bags.
Of course, suitcases are preferable because they're easier to transport.
Liu Xiaoyu returned to her own apartment room and brought her large pink suitcase to Liu Zhou's home.
She stuffed Liu Zhou into the suitcase with considerable effort.
Looking at Liu Zhou's twisted arms and legs.
His entire body squeezed into a ball inside the suitcase.
Liu Xiaoyu wrinkled her nose.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on novel·fiɾe·net
"I can still smell the blood!"
Because of this, Liu Xiaoyu returned to her apartment room again and brought back the perfume she usually uses.
She used almost an entire bottle on Liu Zhou's corpse, finally managing to cover up the blood smell.
Only then did Liu Xiaoyu satisfactorily close the suitcase lid and zip it up.
Then, pulling the suitcase, she checked Liu Zhou's home one last time before leaving. Finding nothing unusual, she closed the door, ready to dispose of the body.
When Liu Xiaoyu was taking the elevator with her suitcase, she happened to encounter Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran, seeing Liu Xiaoyu pulling a large suitcase, curiously asked: "Moving out?"
Liu Xiaoyu shook her head and smiled slightly: "These are just some old clothes. I'm going to donate them to charity, give them to people in mountainous areas."
Jiang Ran nodded: "That's good, recycling and reusing."
At this moment, Liu Xiaoyu suddenly asked: "By the way, Jiang Ran, how's your relationship with Kim Yoon-ah sister going?"
Hearing this, Jiang Ran's face immediately darkened, and he replied evasively: "Not bad, not bad."
Meanwhile, he was cursing in his heart: "What relationship? What kind of relationship could I possibly have with her?!"
The two of them arrived together on the first floor.
They exited together through the glass automatic sensor door.
Jiang Ran watched as Liu Xiaoyu pulled the pink suitcase away.
He himself went to visit several construction sites not far away, keeping a safe distance.
During his inspection, Jiang Ran discovered that there were quite a lot of expansion constructions for Alice Apartment this time.
After walking around, he found that the nearby land plots had probably all been purchased by Alice Apartment.
There were about twenty-plus construction sites simultaneously underway.
After completing his round of inspection, Jiang Ran planned to return to the apartment building.
But on the way back, he encountered someone.
It was Fang Xiao.
At this moment, Fang Xiao reeked of alcohol, the smell detectable from far away.
He was holding a beer bottle, continuously pouring drinks into his mouth.
Surprisingly, although Fang Xiao looked already quite drunk.
His walking steps were still very steady, not stumbling around like other drunk people.
As Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao got closer and closer.
Jiang Ran could increasingly clearly see that Fang Xiao's face was very red.
Of course, it wasn't because Fang Xiao was shy from looking at Jiang Ran.
It was from drinking.
Just as the two were about to pass each other.
Fang Xiao suddenly opened his mouth and asked: "By the way, Jiang Ran, have you seen any dogs in the apartment?"
Jiang Ran stopped walking and turned around: "Dogs? What dogs?"
Fang Xiao: "Large breed dogs, they all look very fierce."
Jiang Ran shook his head: "I did see a few large dogs a couple days ago, near the security guard booth. But I haven't seen them these past few days."
"Are you looking for those dogs for something?"
Hearing this, Fang Xiao smiled evilly: "If I find them, of course I'll kill them for meat."
"Dog meat hot pot is the most delicious."
Jiang Ran: ...
...
Wang Qingzhao's home. At this time, Wang Qingzhao hadn't gone to work.
Instead, she was lying on the white tile floor in front of the huge floor-to-ceiling window of her large flat, dressed very lightly.
Her black long hair was spread out.
Her eyes were lifeless, yet forcefully staring at the white ceiling.
That day.
After she killed her ex-boyfriend Zhao Jie, she spaced out for half an hour in Zhao Jie's home.
She just sat on the sofa, looking at Zhao Jie's corpse lying in a pool of blood.
The look in her eyes might have been appreciation, might have been dissatisfaction, or maybe something else entirely.
In any case, after half an hour, she started cleaning up.
Same as Liu Xiaoyu.
She used a suitcase to pack Zhao Jie's corpse.
But different from Liu Xiaoyu.
She used Zhao Jie's own suitcase.
After cleaning Zhao Jie's home spotless.
Pulling the suitcase containing Zhao Jie - Zhao Jie's own suitcase.
She put the suitcase in the trunk of her car.
Then directly dumped it in those deserted mountains and sinkholes near Nancheng City.
It was fortunate that Nancheng City had such natural geographical conditions nearby.
Of course, it was also because Wang Qingzhao had previously fantasized in her mind about killing someone and disposing of the body.
So disposing of the corpse felt like she had planned it all along.
After finishing the disposal.
Wang Qingzhao had been staying at home.
She hadn't gone out even once.
Most of her days were spent lying on the floor looking at the ceiling.
"So light, I feel so light."
Wang Qingzhao lying on the tile floor.
The corners of her lips lifted slightly.
Since her childhood, when she started taking medication and undergoing various psychiatric treatments for her antisocial personality disorder.
Her life had always been oppressive.
There had always been a gray haze covering her.
Blocking her vision and actions.
But, ever since she killed Zhao Jie.
She felt like she had gained freedom and lightness.
Truly, starting from killing Zhao Jie, she felt so light.
The fatigue and oppression in her body and mind had strangely disappeared.
...
"Lucas, when are you planning to go to other hospitals?"
Red Leaf Psychiatric Hospital in Nancheng City.
After Jiang Ran's consultation ended.
It was now 5:20 PM, only 10 minutes left until getting off work.
Bai Xiaoliang and his junior brother Lucas were drinking milk tea on the rooftop, gazing into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Mister Zhou
chapters.content:
Lucas had come for an exchange study program.
His first stop was his senior brother's Red Leaf Psychiatric Hospital.
In the following period, he would visit hospitals in other cities, and even hospitals in other provinces.
Lucas said: "I'll stay here for another week! Why? Senior brother, are you not welcoming me?"
Bai Xiaoliang shook his head: "No, I was just asking. Then, I want to introduce you to a potential partner. After all, you're not young anymore either."
Hearing this, Lucas immediately shook his head in refusal: "No thanks, I'm not interested in dating. It would interfere with my work."
Bai Xiaoliang said: "I used to think that way too, but didn't I still end up getting a girlfriend?"
"And if you never get a girlfriend, won't your parents pressure you to marry?"
Lucas suddenly gave a strange smile: "It's fine, they don't pressure me."
Bai Xiaoliang stared at Lucas's face, seeing that strange smile, and suddenly thought of something.His expression darkened as he asked: "Lucas, you didn't... hypnotize your parents because you didn't want to find a partner, did you?"
Bai Xiaoliang had grounds for this suspicion.
He had previously discovered that Lucas would use his proud hypnosis skills to do things that served his own interests.
The most serious incident was:
A long time ago, a female doctor was deeply in love with Lucas, but Lucas had no interest in her and found her very annoying.
Therefore, he used hypnosis on that female doctor.
He hypnotized her to hide all memories related to him in her mind.
But hypnosis is something that can weaken in effect over time.
Therefore, that female doctor's fragmented memory pieces gradually began to recover.
She started showing affection to Lucas again.
Lucas later hypnotized that female doctor again, implanting something in her mind.
This caused the female doctor to feel deep fear from the bottom of her heart every time she saw Lucas's face.
And this fear became intertwined with those memory fragments of her admiration for Lucas.
This caused the female doctor's mental state to become disordered, increasingly unstable.
If Bai Xiaoliang and Lucas's teacher hadn't discovered it early,
that female doctor might have become mentally ill.
Because of this incident, that teacher had severely criticized Lucas at the time.
If not for Bai Xiaoliang and the other senior and junior brothers and sisters collectively persuading him,
Lucas might have been directly expelled from their teacher's lineage and had his medical license revoked, never allowed to practice medicine again.
After all, that teacher's status in the medical field was no joke.
Hearing Bai Xiaoliang's words, Lucas suddenly became serious: "How could I? Since that incident with the female doctor, I've stopped doing such things."
Bai Xiaoliang was still somewhat suspicious: "That's good then, Lucas. Remember, we are doctors. We must be responsible for ourselves, for our patients, and for others."
"Don't casually use hypnosis to serve your own interests."
"If, in the future, I discover you've gone down that path,"
"I won't need to inform our teacher."
"I will personally deal with you."
Bai Xiaoliang's usual gentle and warm demeanor disappeared, replaced by a look of decisiveness and severity.
"Mm, I remember."
Lucas's handsome white face broke into a pleasant smile.
But in his heart, dark clouds had long gathered.
Seeing that it was about time, the two went downstairs to the floor where Bai Xiaoliang usually conducted consultations.
Just as they stepped out of the elevator, they heard very noisy sounds coming from the waiting area of this floor.
It seemed like an argument had broken out.
The two immediately quickened their pace toward the patient waiting area.
There they saw a Chinese man in his thirties, wearing a suit and tie.
He was entangled with several doctors and nurses.
This Chinese man kept shouting: "Lucas! Where are you! I know you're here! Get out here!!!"
Hearing this, Bai Xiaoliang looked at Lucas with confusion: "Looking for you?"
Lucas nodded, then stepped forward.
As soon as he approached, he was immediately spotted by the Chinese man.
"Lucas, you finally came out!!!"
The Chinese man shouted aggressively.
Lucas stared at the Chinese man before him, his face showing a mix of confusion and admiration:
"Mr. Zhou, shouldn't you be in America? And you're really something, flying all this way to find me."
So this Chinese man in his thirties, wearing a suit and tie, had the surname Zhou.
Mr. Zhou pointed at Lucas and sneered: "Hahaha, don't worry. Until that matter is cleared up, wherever you go, I'll chase you there!"
Bai Xiaoliang immediately stepped forward a few steps and whispered in Lucas's ear:
"Who is this person? It seems he has some issue with you?"
Lucas said: "He's a family member of a patient I had in America. Senior brother, can I borrow one of your hospital's consultation rooms? I need to talk with him."
Bai Xiaoliang: "Okay, call me if you need anything."
Next, Lucas said to Mr. Zhou: "Mr. Zhou, let's discuss matters inside. Don't make such a scene here. After all, we're civilized people."
Mr. Zhou sneered: "Fine, I didn't want to make a scene anyway."
Then, Lucas entered the vacant Consultation Room 6 on that floor.
The doctors and nurses restraining Mr. Zhou, seeing Bai Xiaoliang's nod, released him.
Therefore, Mr. Zhou followed him inside.
After the two entered, the door was closed.
Inside Consultation Room 6.
Lucas sat in the doctor's seat in the consultation room.
On the desk in front of him was a sandalwood box made of sandalwood.
The sandalwood box was round in shape, with openwork carvings on the lid.
Allowing air circulation with the outside.
After sitting down, Lucas searched the metal cabinets within reach on both sides for something.
He finally found a coil of incense shaped like mosquito repellent incense.
Of course, this coil of incense was very small, thin, and green in color.
Holding this coil of incense, he said to Mr. Zhou: "It's a bit smelly in here. Do you mind if I light some incense to get rid of the odor?"
Mr. Zhou stood there and said coldly: "Do whatever you want."
Lucas smiled, took a lighter from his pocket to light the coil incense, then placed it in the sandalwood box and closed the lid.
After closing the lid, white smoke immediately rose from the sandalwood box.
It rose straight up to the ceiling, and upon hitting the ceiling, split into multiple streams and began to disperse throughout Consultation Room 6.
After doing all this, Lucas smiled at Mr. Zhou, his right hand fingers rhythmically tapping on the desk, making a tapping sound.
"Mr. Zhou, what did you want to see me about?"
Lucas asked.
Mr. Zhou's forehead veins bulged: "What are you pretending for? You know perfectly well why I'm here?"
Lucas put on an expression of sudden realization:
"If it's about that matter with your wife, I'm very sorry, but there's nothing I can do."
"After all, I've already cured your wife's mental illness. As for who she fell for after recovering, how can you blame me for that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Mister Zhou’s Story
chapters.content:
Mr. Zhou was from Hua Country.
He attended university domestically, and after graduation, went to America for further studies.
After that, he remained in America to continue studying, working, and living.
In America, he met a white American girl.
They fell in love and entered the marriage hall.
Although the couple hadn't had children yet, their life was exceptionally happy.
Until one day.
After getting off work, Mr. Zhou discovered his wife's emotions were somewhat strange and her mental state very unstable.
Mr. Zhou showed concern for his wife and asked her what had happened.
His wife was initially unwilling to speak, but later, through tears, she revealed the situation.It turned out that both Mr. Zhou and his wife worked for a large American company.
They were just in different departments.
A new supervisor, a white American man, had joined his wife's department and harassed her daily.
Especially on one occasion, when her new supervisor almost succeeded in his advances.
This made his wife increasingly tense and mentally chaotic.
Both her work and personal life became a complete mess.
After learning about this situation,
Mr. Zhou went to the company to confront that supervisor.
But who would have thought that supervisor would stubbornly deny everything, arrogantly challenging him to produce evidence.
This clearly indicated the supervisor knew Mr. Zhou had no evidence, only his wife's verbal testimony.
Helpless, he could only temporarily let it go.
Later, seeing his wife's mental condition wasn't right, he went to a psychiatric hospital, planning to take his wife for treatment to relieve her stress.
The one responsible for treating his wife was Lucas.
Lucas truly lived up to being the star doctor of this hospital.
He quickly cured Mr. Zhou's wife, for which Mr. Zhou expressed endless gratitude.
Just like that, Mr. Zhou and his wife returned to normal life, and his wife resigned from that company.
His wife decided not to continue job hunting;
they had been married for several years and it was time to have a child.
So his wife began preparing for pregnancy at home.
Days passed one after another.
However, as time went on, Mr. Zhou noticed his wife's attitude toward him was getting worse.
Mr. Zhou didn't understand why, but he didn't pay it much mind.
Until one day when returning home.
A seven or eight-year-old boy from his next-door neighbor said to him,
"Uncle, your older brother is really nice."
Mr. Zhou found it very strange - what nonsense was this child talking? He didn't have an older brother;
he was an only child.
Therefore, he thought the little boy had made a mistake.
So he told him, "Did you get it wrong?"
The little boy scratched his head curiously, "That can't be! I often see another uncle going in and out of your house. That uncle even gives me candy. When I asked who he was, he said he was your older brother."
At this point, Mr. Zhou felt an inexplicable sense of foreboding.
Then he returned home and asked his wife if a man frequently came to their house.
His wife directly denied it and asked him where he heard this news.
Mr. Zhou said from the little boy next door.
His wife said that little boy talks nonsense all day long and to ignore him.
Although his wife flatly denied it,
combined with her increasingly poor attitude toward him recently, he couldn't help but suspect something.
So, without his wife's knowledge, he installed several surveillance cameras in their home.
For the first period, he discovered his wife stayed home all day, and there was no so-called man frequently visiting their house.
He felt relieved, thinking the little boy had been talking nonsense.
But later, he discovered that indeed, a man frequently came to their house.
And this man came to his house for no other reason than to cuckold him.
And the one cuckolding him was that very supervisor from his wife's department.
When Mr. Zhou saw the surveillance footage, he was furious and exasperated.
He couldn't understand why his wife would do something so disloyal to him?
And with that supervisor she hated?
He was blinded by rage.
So he confronted his wife directly.
When his wife saw the surveillance video, she wasn't angry that Mr. Zhou had secretly installed cameras to monitor her;
instead, she remained very calm.
She admitted to the affair and proposed divorce to Mr. Zhou.
Mr. Zhou of course disagreed - being inexplicably cuckolded and then divorced?
Without understanding anything, why would he agree to divorce!
So he asked his wife why she was with that supervisor?
To which his wife replied that she loved him.
Mr. Zhou found it utterly absurd.
Mr. Zhou didn't want to divorce, but his wife insisted.
People have legs.
On the third day of Mr. Zhou refusing to agree to divorce, when he returned home from work,
he discovered his wife was gone.
Moreover, all his wife's personal belongings had disappeared too.
He frantically searched for his wife but couldn't find her.
Then he thought of that supervisor.
He tried to find the supervisor through company colleagues.
Only to discover that the supervisor had suddenly resigned two days ago, and now no one knew where he was.
At this point, Mr. Zhou understood - his wife had eloped with that supervisor.
From then on, Mr. Zhou became exceptionally depressed, drowning his sorrows in alcohol daily.
One of his company colleagues, a white American man with whom he had a very good relationship,
came to ask Mr. Zhou what exactly had happened.
So Mr. Zhou told him about his wife.
After learning the whole story from beginning to end,
this colleague said there was something fishy about this situation.
Mr. Zhou asked what seemed fishy.
The colleague said, "Before this, your wife was harassed for so long, even almost assaulted, yet never yielded. Obviously, she detested that supervisor. If that's the case, how could she suddenly and inexplicably get involved with that supervisor later?"
"And according to your account, your wife's behavior seemed willing, not resulting from temptation or coercion."
"Such a drastic change in your wife's attitude must have a reason! It's impossible for someone's feelings and perceptions about a person to change so dramatically without cause!"
"The reason, if I'm not mistaken, lies in that psychiatric treatment!"
Mr. Zhou thought about it and realized that from his wife being harassed to now eloping with the supervisor,
indeed, the only special event that occurred in between was visiting the psychiatry department and receiving treatment.
But, just from receiving psychiatric treatment, why would his wife change so dramatically?
Mr. Zhou couldn't figure it out.
His colleague provided the explanation.
His colleague told him not to underestimate some psychiatrists or psychological doctors.
They can guide patients' emotions during treatment, even change a patient's personality, and so on.
His colleague told him that when he was young, there was a middle-aged psychological doctor living next door.
His professional skills were extremely strong.
He used his professional abilities to seduce many respectable married women.
And those respectable women all became utterly devoted to him.
Mr. Zhou initially didn't quite believe it - how could this be possible?
Shouldn't this only happen in movies and TV dramas?
Aren't real-life psychiatrists just there to treat illnesses and relieve emotional stress?
Could they really be this powerful?
But with his colleague's absolute certainty, plus the fact that there really were no other possibilities,
Mr. Zhou reluctantly believed it for the time being.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Mister Zhou Goes to Save Someone
chapters.content:
But he didn't understand.
If all of this was true.
Why would that Doctor Lucas help the supervisor?
That colleague looked at him with an exasperated expression and continued to explain: He definitely got paid, or received some other benefit.
This was probably a case of "those closely involved cannot see clearly, while outsiders can see everything."
At this point, Mr. Zhou completely understood.
What followed was settling accounts with Lucas.
But Lucas would definitely not admit it.
Mr. Zhou also had no way to deal with Lucas and could only continue pestering him.
However, that colleague of his had a good friend.Who worked at a special agency in America.
The colleague asked that good friend to help investigate Lucas's bank transaction records.
They finally found evidence.
They found the record of that supervisor transferring one million US dollars into Lucas's bank account.
At this point, Mr. Zhou became even more convinced.
He confronted Lucas face-to-face with the evidence.
But after Lucas looked at it, he only said that he and that supervisor were good friends, and the money was borrowed from him.
Then, Mr. Zhou prepared to continue harassing Lucas.
But Lucas went to Hua Country for an exchange program.
Mr. Zhou spent a lot of money to learn about Lucas's whereabouts from Lucas's hospital colleagues.
That's why he chased him here.
And then today's events happened.
In the consultation room.
"After you cured my wife's mental illness, why did she fall in love with that damn bastard? It was your doing, wasn't it?!"
"It's because that bastard gave you one million US dollars! That's why you did it!"
At this moment, Mr. Zhou was pounding the table in front of him loudly.
His expression was terrifying, as if he wanted to eat someone alive.
Lucas, however, remained exceptionally calm: "Mr. Zhou, as I've said, you've misunderstood. The bastard you're referring to is my friend, and that one million was money he lent me."
Mr. Zhou suddenly grabbed Lucas by the collar with both hands, his teeth grinding together, making a grating sound.
His eyes were almost pressed against Lucas's eyes.
"You bastard, you originally said you didn't know that bastard at all! After I found evidence of the one million, you said he's your friend and the money was lent to you! Your words don't match up, do you think I'm an idiot?!"
Lucas, whose collar was tightly gripped, smiled slightly:
"I could treat you as an idiot, but you're not one, are you!"
"Didn't you still manage to investigate everything quite impressively?"
Hearing this, Mr. Zhou suddenly released Lucas.
"You admit it?"
"You finally admit it?"
Lucas still maintained his smile: "What if I admit it? What if I don't?"
Mr. Zhou said angrily: "If you don't admit it, I'll force you to admit it! If you admit it, I'll make you take responsibility!!!"
Lucas said: "What kind of responsibility?"
Mr. Zhou: "Change my wife back! Make her return to normal!!!!"
Lucas said: "Your wife is now deeply involved with that guy, probably even pregnant with his child by now, and you still want her back?!"
Mr. Zhou said each word with immense weight:
"That is my wife! My wife!!!!"
Lucas said: "Alright then, go bring your wife here, and I'll restore her to normal and return her to you."
Mr. Zhou didn't expect that after harassing this guy for so long in America, he never budged.
Why did he suddenly give in as soon as they came to Hua Country?!
Mr. Zhou didn't care about these details;
the important thing was that the other party had relented.
But a new problem immediately arose.
"Do you know where my wife is now?"
"How could I possibly know? If even you can't find her, how could I?"
"That's it then. You find your wife and bring her here, and I'll help restore her to normal."
Lucas continued to tap his fingers rhythmically on the desk.
Mr. Zhou said: "Fine."
"Remember what you said today. If I find my wife and bring her here, and you don't restore her to normal, you'd better watch out. I know you're mixed-race and speak good Chinese. We have a saying in Hua Country: 'If you make things impossible for me, I'll make things impossible for you.' You should understand what that means."
After speaking.
Mr. Zhou stormed out angrily.
After Mr. Zhou left, Bai Xiaoliang walked in.
He asked what was going on between this Mr. Zhou and Lucas, and if he needed any help.
Lucas gave the same answer as before.
It's nothing, just some misunderstandings, and now the misunderstandings have been resolved.
...
Mr. Zhou left Red Leaf Psychiatric Hospital.
He booked the fastest ticket back to America on his phone.
Which was the day after tomorrow.
His only goal now was to find his wife and restore her to normal.
As for everything else, he didn't want to think about it at all.
Although he didn't want to think about it, the human brain is fundamentally uncontrollable.
His mind kept wondering: if his wife returned to normal and discovered what she had been through during this time.
Would she have a breakdown?
Also, after his wife returned to normal, would he still love her as before?
Troubled by these constant worries in his mind, and having been away from his homeland Hua Country for too long.
Mr. Zhou simply wandered aimlessly on the street, walking around to relax.
Before he knew it, he had walked to the middle of a large bridge.
Suddenly, a loud crashing sound came from behind him.
Turning around, he saw that two cars had collided.
Fortunately, they didn't catch fire.
But whether there were casualties or not was uncertain.
Because from his angle, everything over there was chaotic.
Mr. Zhou frowned and quickly walked forward.
Soon, he reached the end of the bridge.
At this moment, he inadvertently glanced to the right, at the very wide river below the bridge.
It was just a casual glance, but who would have thought that this glance would fix his gaze there.
He saw, where his gaze fixed, a person—unclear if male or female, but definitely a person—struggling in the river water, probably drowning.
Mr. Zhou's pupils, which had initially contracted sharply, gradually returned to normal.
Then, without another word, he ran down the bridge toward the riverbank.
When he reached the riverbank, he looked at the person in the river who kept shouting for help, repeatedly raising their hands and head above the water surface, struggling.
While watching, he took off his own clothes.
Quickly, he stripped down to only his underwear, placing his phone, watch, and other belongings on the bank.
Just as he was about to enter the water to rescue the person.
Suddenly, a large hand rested on his shoulder.
Turning around, he saw a man in his sixties, looking out of breath.
"Uncle, what do you want?"
Mr. Zhou said with confusion: "Never mind, whatever it is can wait until later. I need to go save someone first. If I don't rescue them soon, that person will probably sink."
Mr. Zhou knew how to rescue drowning people in rivers.
For this kind of drowning person, you need to let them struggle for a while first, let them exhaust their strength in the water, and then go rescue them. Otherwise, if you try to rescue them immediately after they start drowning.
There's a high chance they might drag you down with them.
Especially if your swimming skills are average.
And from the time he spotted the drowning person from the bridge until now, it was about the right time.
So he needed to quickly enter the water to rescue them.
But then, the old man's words completely baffled him.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: The Terrifying Huang Kaiyu
chapters.content:
Huang Kaiyu walked for five minutes before finding his transportation for coming here—a gray electric scooter.
He placed the yellow kraft paper envelope in the storage compartment under the seat, then got on the scooter and left the area.
After riding for about an hour.
He arrived at an area of self-built houses.
This area of self-built houses.
Half of the houses had already been demolished.
It was a mess, with concrete walls and steel bars piled together, forming ruins.
But the other half were still intact.
This was because originally the entire area was supposed to be demolished, but for some unknown reason.
Only half ended up being demolished.Of course, although only half was demolished, the residents here had all received compensation money or allocated housing, so hardly anyone lived here anymore.
Huang Kaiyu still lived here.
Of course, he wasn't one of the original residents affected by the demolition;
he found this place, chose a relatively good courtyard, and moved directly into it.
At this moment, he rode his gray electric scooter to the courtyard gate and parked it.
He took a key from his pocket and prepared to unlock the courtyard gate.
Before he even opened it, he could see many cats and dogs in the courtyard gathering toward him.
By the time he opened the gate.
These cats and dogs were all crowded around him, meowing and barking chaotically.
They seemed very familiar and affectionate with him.
"Alright, alright, go play by yourselves."
Huang Kaiyu didn't lock the courtyard gate after opening it, allowing the cats and dogs to come and go freely.
Clearly, this half-demolished area of self-built houses had become a paradise for these cats and dogs.
At this point, Huang Kaiyu pushed his gray electric scooter into the courtyard.
Then he walked to a small room on the left side of the courtyard.
He opened the door and dragged out many woven bags from this small room.
The woven bags were filled with cat food and dog food that he had made himself.
He opened these woven bags and poured the homemade cat food and dog food inside.
Into several large plastic basins in the courtyard.
Additionally, he fetched water from a room next to this small room and filled several other large plastic basins with water.
Soon, the food basins and water basins were surrounded by cats and dogs.
They were eating and drinking heartily.
Watching these stray cats and dogs he had taken in happily eating.
A rare smile appeared on Huang Kaiyu's usually cold and indifferent face.
The courtyard Huang Kaiyu had chosen to live in was the most luxurious and largest among the undemolished courtyards.
Of course, no matter how big or luxurious, it certainly couldn't compare to a real villa.
However, it was definitely freer and more spacious than living in a residential complex.
After feeding the cats and dogs.
He took out his phone and checked the current time.
It was 6:30 PM.
Since it was currently summer.
The sky wouldn't completely darken until after 7:00 PM.
Right now, the sky was still quite bright.
He glanced at the sky, then walked into the two-story house in the middle of the courtyard.
Passing through the house in the middle of the courtyard, he reached the backyard.
The backyard was also very spacious, with some cats and dogs playing, chasing, and having fun on the concrete ground.
Of course, more importantly, there was also a large single-story house in the backyard.
But this single-story house was very strange.
Not only was the door locked from the outside with a padlock, but more importantly, the windows were tightly closed.
Additionally, curtains were drawn inside, making it completely impossible to see what was inside from outside.
This way, without lights on, the room would be absolutely dark since no sunlight could enter.
Huang Kaiyu strode forward.
As Huang Kaiyu walked toward this single-story house.
With each step, his expression grew increasingly gloomy.
He walked up to the single-story house and opened the padlock on the door.
Then, he entered and closed the door.
After closing the door, his left hand familiarly pressed the light switch beside the door.
Click!
The lights turned on.
With the lights on, what was originally pitch black inside the room could now be seen clearly.
"Mmph mmph!!"
After the lights turned on, muffled sounds could be heard.
Standing by the door and looking to the left.
A man and a woman could be seen.
This man and woman were both young, in their twenties or thirties.
Currently, they were tied up with thick hemp rope, each with a rope threaded through a roof beam, hanging them up.
This man and woman's feet were about thirty centimeters off the ground.
Their mouths were gagged with rags, causing them to only make muffled noises.
Huang Kaiyu walked over and removed the rags from their mouths.
As soon as they were removed, the tied-up man said:
"Bro, bro, I was wrong, please let me go! I'll never abuse cats again! I beg you!"
The man was crying bitterly, looking extremely remorseful.
Huang Kaiyu then turned to look at the woman tied up and hanging nearby.
The woman was average-looking, but had youth on her side.
Like the man, she was crying with tears and snot running down her face: "Yes, bro, we know we were wrong, please spare us!"
Huang Kaiyu turned around;
behind him about a meter away was a wooden cabinet with two phones on it.
These two phones belonged to the man and woman.
The phone cases made it clear which was the man's and which was the woman's.
Huang Kaiyu seemed to know the passwords;
he unlocked the phones and browsed through them boredly.
Saying: "Spare you? I could spare you, but what about those stray cats you tortured and killed? Can they forgive you?"
Huang Kaiyu flipped to the man's photo album, which contained a picture of a tabby cat's head alone impaled on a stick.
Extremely bloody and horrifying.
Seeing this, the man cried even harder: "I know I was wrong, I'm sorry to these adorable little cats! So, bro, spare me, let me use the rest of my life to atone!!!"
Huang Kaiyu shook his head upon hearing this: "Your sins are too great. At this point, I can only spare one person's life, letting them atone with their remaining years. As for the other person, they must die! You decide yourselves who gets spared!"
As soon as these words were spoken.
The young couple immediately stopped crying.
Simultaneously, they turned to look at each other.
At this moment, the woman turned to look at Huang Kaiyu and said: "Bro! Spare me! I never had these bad habits of abusing cats! It was all him! He was the one who abused them!"
The man's eyes widened in anger: "Nonsense! You're lying! Are you saying you never abused any?"
The woman said: "You forced me! I didn't want to! I love cats the most!!!!"
What followed was the man and woman arguing with each other.
Both trying to secure the only chance to survive.
Finally, after waiting ten minutes.
Huang Kaiyu had listened to them argue for ten minutes, then said: "Since you two can't agree, then you'll both die! Use your lives to accompany those cats in death!"
Hearing this, the woman screamed: "Bro! No! If you have to kill someone, kill him! I'm a woman, look at me, although I'm average-looking, I have a good figure!! You can do whatever you want to me! If you must kill, kill my boyfriend!!!"
Huang Kaiyu remained silent and walked to the left wall.
The wall was covered with various metal torture instruments.
Huang Kaiyu took down a small curved knife that emitted a cold gleam.
Muttering to himself: "You two, next, I'll let you experience the pain of the cats you tortured!"
"First, I'll use this to sever the tendons in your hands and feet, then put you into a meat grinder, and afterwards make you into cat food and dog food."

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Huang Kaiyu Hunts Jiang Ran
chapters.content:
Upon hearing this, the man and woman knew this man named Huang Kaiyu was absolutely not joking, because on the other side of this single-story house, there was indeed a large meat grinder...
"Huang Kaiyu! This is murder! If I die! I'll haunt you even as a ghost!!!!"
Seeing no hope of rescue, the man stopped begging and pleading meekly. Instead, he directly cursed and swore vengeance.
While cursing, due to his agitated emotions and physical exertion, his hanging body swung back and forth.
Huang Kaiyu sneered coldly: "Haunt me as a ghost? Don't worry, you're not the first one to say that."
"Those people who liked abusing animals before also said they'd come find me as ghosts."
"But why haven't you come yet?"
Huang Kaiyu continued: "You people are just beasts."
"And I am justice. Justice never fears beasts like you."
The man spat a thick glob of phlegm onto the ground:"Hahaha! You're justice? Are you crazy? Playing what underground judge?!"
"Let me tell you, animals like cats and dogs are just lower creatures, meant for human entertainment!"
"So, what's wrong with me killing them?"
"Huang Kaiyu! I'm telling you! You'd better kill me today, otherwise, if you give me a chance, I'll slaughter every single cat and dog in your entire courtyard!!!!"
While the man was shouting curses, the woman kept crying remorsefully beside him.
Her regret wasn't about abusing cats, but that they had fallen for Huang Kaiyu's trap.
She and her boyfriend both enjoyed torturing and killing small animals.
Especially cats.
They often shared their experiences online with like-minded people in certain app group chats.
Or met up offline.
This time, they were tricked by Huang Kaiyu during an offline gathering.
Of course, it wasn't their first offline gathering that got them caught;
it happened after several meetings over quite some time. One could only say this Huang Kaiyu was playing a long game to catch a big fish.
Next, this couple would pay the ultimate price for their long-standing behavior.
Huang Kaiyu approached them step by step with a knife.
Both their faces showed uncontrollable terror.
From 6:40 PM until 8:30 PM.
The single-story house was filled with an overwhelmingly thick smell of blood.
Huang Kaiyu stood before the black large meat grinder inside the house.
His nostrils were full of the heavy metallic scent.
His ears were filled with the roaring sound of the machine.
Inside the meat grinder were the man and woman, their bodies being ground into pieces bit by bit.
The couple had long been dead beyond any doubt.
Of course, they shouldn't feel too sad, as they weren't the first people Huang Kaiyu had killed and turned into cat or dog food.
Next, Huang Kaiyu didn't stay to wait.
He still had tasks assigned by Lucas to complete.
He returned to the house where he usually lived, first taking a hot shower.
Then, he changed out of his blood-soaked clothes.
After that, he took out that kraft paper envelope.
He carefully read through it again.
Inside the envelope were several photos of Jiang Ran.
Along with his home address.
All obtained by Lucas.
In this era of massive information leaks, doxxing someone is incredibly easy.
For example, there are frequent cases online where people offend certain idol fan groups, get doxxed, and suffer various forms of cyberbullying.
After reading it, Huang Kaiyu burned these materials.
Then, he went to a room on the second floor of the courtyard.
In this room.
He changed into a Lightning Delivery rider uniform.
Took a Lightning Delivery thermal bag.
Additionally, he retrieved something that looked like a black toolbox from another room.
He started heading downstairs.
After reaching the courtyard, he placed the delivery bag on the footrest of his gray electric scooter.
The toolbox-like object was placed inside the storage compartment.
Then, he put on a helmet and a black face mask.
Left his home.
Arriving in the city, he first ordered a delivery for himself.
But he didn't eat it;
instead, after receiving the order, he placed it inside the delivery bag.
Directly followed the navigation, riding to Alice Apartment.
Checked the time.
It was almost 10 PM now.
The area around Alice Apartment was completely silent.
He rode his electric scooter and stopped in front of the main gate of Alice Apartment.
Knocked on the security guard booth's glass.
To be honest, Huang Kaiyu didn't know if Alice Apartment allowed delivery riders to enter directly.
After all, some high-end apartments or compounds don't permit delivery personnel inside.
If he couldn't enter, he would need to find another way in.
After he knocked on the glass, the window was pulled open from inside.
The moment it opened, a blast of cold air rushed out.
The security booth must have had air conditioning running.
"What do you want?"
Security guard Xiao Xing asked Huang Kaiyu.
Besides Xiao Xing, there was another young security guard on night duty today.
The two seemed to be playing some game together, probably duo queueing.
From how Xiao Xing kept looking back at his phone and tapping the screen even after opening the window, it was clear the game had reached an intense phase.
"Delivery guy."
Huang Kaiyu's voice was calm.
"Oh oh, go right in!"
Xiao Xing didn't think much of it, as Alice Apartment always allowed delivery and courier personnel to enter.
Therefore, he directly pressed a button, opening the pedestrian gate that normally required facial recognition, allowing Huang Kaiyu to enter.
Huang Kaiyu's masked face showed neither joy nor sorrow.
He returned to his electric scooter and rode straight in.
After entering.
He parked his scooter in a shadowy area beside the building, not directly in front of the apartment entrance.
At this moment, he carried the delivery he had ordered himself.
Walked into the apartment building.
Passed through the glass automatic sensor door.
After passing through, he found the first floor pitch black.
He stomped his foot on the ground, and immediately the voice-controlled lights turned on.
He scanned left and right, finding no one on the first floor.
He didn't pay it any mind.
Took the elevator, following the address for Jiang Ran provided by Lucas.
Reached the third floor, outside Jiang Ran's door.
Now, in front of Room 304.
He didn't knock directly.
Instead, he first pressed his ear against the security door, listening for a while. There seemed to be no sound inside.
Then he checked for light through the door crack;
there didn't seem to be any light either.
"Sleeping this early?"
"Looks like I can't just knock and kill him when he opens the door."
Huang Kaiyu spoke while placing the delivery bag on the ground, then pulled a piece of wire from his pants pocket.
It seemed he planned to pick the lock, enter Jiang Ran's home, and then deal with Jiang Ran.
But his lock-picking skills were clearly not up to par.
After working on it for quite a while, he still couldn't open it.
So he simply gave up.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room.
I'm Actually a Girl: [Who is this delivery guy? Holy crap, I saw this delivery guy reach Jiang Ran's door, I thought Jiang Ran had ordered delivery. But then, I checked the cameras myself and found Jiang Ran in his bedroom, with AC on, already asleep...]
Fairy Sister: [Maybe someone else ordered it for him, without telling him.]
I'm Actually a Girl: [Someone else ordered it? Then why isn't this delivery guy knocking or ringing the doorbell, but instead using a wire to pick the lock? That's just ridiculous...]
Fairy Sister: [Haha, just joking.]
Fairy Sister: [But jokes aside, who is this person? A resident of the apartment?]
Domineering Female CEO: [Can't see his face, not sure.]
I am the Hero: [Probably not an apartment resident, came from outside.]
[Although the stream automatically switched to this exciting scene, by the time it switched, this delivery guy was already at Jiang Ran's door.]
But luckily, I've always liked randomly switching camera views before, and by chance, I switched to the main gate camera feed and happened to see this delivery guy riding in from outside the apartment.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Defiant Jiang Ran — Who Even Locks Their Windows at Night?!
chapters.content:
Domineering Female CEO: ["Since he came from outside, what does he want to do? Steal something?"]
["But Jiang Ran isn't a rich man either?"]
I am the Hero: ["You'll understand if you keep watching."]
In front of Room 304.
Huang Kaiyu, who couldn't pick the lock, didn't give up. Carrying the food delivery, he returned to the first floor.
The first floor was still empty, with no one else around.
Huang Kaiyu scanned the area and spotted the manager's office.
Whether by luck or not, he saw a large bunch of keys lying on the desk inside the manager's office.
Many of them were keys to various room numbers.
Huang Kaiyu looked around carefully for a while longer, then pushed and found that the glass window could be opened. After pushing it open, he seized the opportunity to commit a petty theft.He got his hands on that large bunch of keys.
"What kind of apartment is this? So trashy, with absolutely no security awareness," Huang Kaiyu muttered under his breath.
Then, he returned to the front of Room 304.
From the large bunch of keys, he found the key for Room 304.
He inserted the Room 304 key into the smart lock keyhole of Room 304's security door.
However, the expected outcome did not occur.
Huang Kaiyu discovered that after inserting the key, he couldn't turn it.
"The door is locked from the inside?"
"No way, who locks their door from the inside when sleeping at night?"
Naturally, Huang Kaiyu had no knowledge of the thought process of Jiang Ran, who was already asleep inside.
Ever since discovering that the Danger Warning System alerts were real,
and that the entire apartment building was full of dangerous individuals,
if he didn't lock the door from the inside at night, he would feel completely unsafe while sleeping.
Having no other choice, Huang Kaiyu went back to the first floor and returned the large bunch of keys.
He then walked out of the apartment building, still not giving up.
He returned to his electric scooter.
He placed the now-cold food delivery back into the delivery box and opened the storage compartment cover of the electric scooter.
He took out that object which resembled a black toolbox.
Carrying this black toolbox, he circled around the apartment building until he found the side where Jiang Ran's Room 304 was located.
Sure enough, looking up from below, Jiang Ran's home was pitch black;
he should be asleep.
Huang Kaiyu also observed the neighboring units above, below, and to the sides of Jiang Ran's apartment for a while,
as well as the external structure of this building.
Then, he was seen opening his black toolbox.
Inside this black toolbox were only three types of tools:
a hammer, a pair of pliers, and a pair of scissors.
He fastened all three tools to his waist.
Then he walked up to the front of this side of the building.
As if having made up his mind, he began to climb.
Huang Kaiyu was very agile. Following the air conditioning pipes and some uneven protrusions on the building's exterior, he quickly climbed to the third floor.
First, on this side of Jiang Ran's home, the areas with windows were the bathroom, the balcony, and the bedroom.
But after pushing the window, he found it was locked.
After trying many times, he found the balcony window was also locked.
After trying it, he, who had almost never sworn before, suddenly couldn't help but open his mouth and curse:
"F*** my life!"
"Blocking all the windows at night, be careful of a gas leak poisoning you to death!!!"
Cursing was one thing, but he still needed to get inside.
He reached for his waist.
He picked up the hammer.
The hammer wasn't big, just the kind you could hold in one hand.
It seemed he was preparing to simply smash the window and go in to kill Jiang Ran.
Even though this action would alert the target,
there was no other way.
Before smashing it, he took a final look at the situation inside the bedroom.
In the dark bedroom, he could see the number 20 displayed on the air conditioner hanging on the wall.
Huang Kaiyu could vaguely make out Jiang Ran sleeping soundly under the covers on the bed.
Huang Kaiyu prepared to smash the window, but before doing so, he had one final step.
He took several deep breaths.
Using deep breathing to relieve pressure and ease tension.
Actually, if this were his first time doing something like this, he would definitely feel pressure and tension.
But the reality was completely opposite;
he had done this kind of thing countless times.
He remembered the time before last when he climbed up to the fifth floor and killed a cat abuser who tortured cats.
Therefore, having done it many times, the so-called pressure and tension each time was minimal.
There was no real need for deep breathing;
the reason he still used it now was purely out of habit.
At this moment, Huang Kaiyu, after taking deep breaths, gripped the hammer tightly in his right hand, pulled his arm back, and began gathering force frantically.
He aimed to shatter the window in one hit.
Just like that, he swung the hammer violently towards the window glass, hitting it on the corner.
*Crack!*
The sound was quite loud.
Unless someone was an extremely heavy sleeper,
normally, anyone would wake up in this situation.
Jiang Ran was no exception.
Awakened by the sound, he sat up in bed.
His face in the darkness was full of confusion.
What's going on?
He instinctively looked around.
Another *crack!* sounded.
He saw a person wearing a helmet, a black face mask, and a purple Lightning Delivery uniform, holding an iron hammer and smashing the window glass.
Having just woken up, Jiang Ran's mind wasn't fully clear yet;
he was in a groggy state.
His first reaction upon seeing this scene was:
I didn't order any delivery!
His second reaction was: Could it be that someone else ordered delivery for me?
And then this delivery guy knocked, but I was sleeping too deeply to answer, so the delivery guy, in a fit of anger,
is smashing my window to deliver the food to me?!
"Damn, no! What am I thinking?!"
The next second, Jiang Ran realized what nonsense his brain was concocting.
The Danger Warning System in his mind had been alerting him for who knows how long!
How could the person in front of him possibly be a delivery guy?
What delivery guy delivers food to you through your bedroom window?
And by smashing the glass, no less!
The money earned from one delivery wouldn't even cover the damages!
Especially since his home was on the third floor!!!
The person in front of him was clearly a thief!! Or someone here for some other purpose!
Thinking of this, Jiang Ran directly got out of bed, then skillfully went to the bedroom door and turned on the light.
Instantly, the entire bedroom became perfectly clear.
Both Jiang Ran and Huang Kaiyu could see each other's every move clearly.
By this time, Jiang Ran saw that Huang Kaiyu had already smashed a large hole in the window and was preparing to climb in.
Meanwhile, Huang Kaiyu saw Jiang Ran suddenly run to the side of the bed.
Huang Kaiyu thought to himself, is this guy going to call the police?
It's a pity it's too late.
You'll be dead before the police arrive.
Thinking this, Huang Kaiyu saw Jiang Ran bend down and squat.
Huang Kaiyu thought Jiang Ran had a screw loose;
was he really planning to hide under the bed at a time like this?
Otherwise, why would he squat down now?!
However, in the next second, he saw Jiang Ran stand up.
Then, tightly gripped in Jiang Ran's hands was a very long, red fire axe with a long handle.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Is Huang Kaiyu really so incompetent and stupid?
chapters.content:
When Huang Kaiyu saw that long-handled red fire axe.
His feelings were extremely complicated.
It was like in the story "My Uncle Jules," where the protagonist's family, on a ship, suddenly discovers that the wealthy Jules they had been anticipating for ten years has actually fallen into destitution and is selling oysters on the ship—a feeling of extreme complexity.
Huang Kaiyu was currently feeling both confused and bewildered.
After all, which normal household would have a fire axe?
And not kept in a utility room, but stored under their own bed?
Suddenly, Huang Kaiyu thought of something.
Right, a person who sleeps with the security door deadbolted and all windows locked from the inside.
Was inherently unreasonable and abnormal.
Therefore, the bizarre situation of being able to pull a fire axe from under the bed actually became quite normal.After Jiang Ran got the fire axe, without saying a word, he rushed to the window and forcefully shoved it against Huang Kaiyu, who was climbing through.
Why do many deranged criminals and deranged serial killers have such high success rates?
First: They catch you by surprise, striking when you're unprepared. They plan against you for a long time.
Second: They strike hard enough, completely unafraid of killing you, whereas you, being a law-abiding good citizen, have psychological reservations when striking back, which naturally affects your hands because murder is illegal. So your hands will uncontrollably hold back.
But Jiang Ran did not hold back.
Mainly because he had experienced some things already, and besides, you, this delivery guy, were committing home invasion robbery and theft.
He was justified in fighting back!
So, it was also Huang Kaiyu's bad luck;
being shoved hard by Jiang Ran with the fire axe.
His body fell backward.
Seeing this, he immediately grabbed the window with his left hand.
Jiang Ran saw this and prepared to chop down with the fire axe.
Left with no choice, Huang Kaiyu could only let go, and this release.
Directly caused him to fall down with a loud thud.
After hearing that loud noise, Jiang Ran quickly stuck his head out the window and looked down.
He saw that Huang Kaiyu had fallen from the third floor.
There was some blood on the ground.
Then, incredibly, he managed to get up.
And desperately ran towards one direction.
Seeing this, Jiang Ran, without saying a word.
Grabbed the fire axe, ran out of his home, and prepared to chase this delivery guy.
But by the time he went downstairs, exited the apartment building, reached the pool of blood on the ground, and followed the trail of blood left by Huang Kaiyu to the security guard booth.
He knew Huang Kaiyu had already escaped.
He couldn't catch up.
"Hey, isn't this Assistant Manager Jiang Ran?"
Just as Jiang Ran was preparing to go find Manager Xiao Zhang to report to the police.
Someone came out of the security guard booth.
It was precisely Security Guard Xiao Xing.
Security Guard Xiao Xing, currently seeing Jiang Ran holding a fire axe with a somewhat fierce expression.
Wasn't particularly afraid.
"Yeah, let me ask you something, did you see a delivery guy go out?"
Jiang Ran asked.
Xiao Xing, upon hearing this, said: "Earlier I opened the door for a delivery guy. As for him leaving, I'm not too clear, since the door here opens automatically when sensed. But it seems he went out? I heard some noise."
Jiang Ran murmured to himself: "Is that so?"
Xiao Xing asked: "Is something wrong? What happened with that delivery guy?"
Jiang Ran waved his hand and said it was nothing.
Then, Jiang Ran returned to the 1st floor and found Manager Xiao Zhang.
Through the door crack, he noticed there was light in Manager Xiao Zhang's room on the 1st floor, realizing he wasn't asleep.
So he knocked on the door.
And said: "Xiao Zhang, are you there? It's me! Jiang Ran!"
"Oh! It's Jiang Ran! Wait a moment!!!"
Manager Xiao Zhang's voice sounded somewhat flustered, who knows what he was doing inside his room.
When he opened the door.
Jiang Ran was hit by the unique smell of semen.
And slightly turning his head, he noticed many white tissue paper balls on the bed where Xiao Zhang slept.
But he ignored that.
Quickly told Manager Xiao Zhang about the delivery guy incident.
Manager Xiao Zhang was very angry upon hearing it, saying how dare such an audacious scoundrel attempt to harm their apartment's assistant manager.
The two discussed it and called the police;
soon the Police arrived.
Went to Jiang Ran's home to investigate.
Checked the surveillance footage, then took statements from Jiang Ran, including the two security guards at the security guard booth.
After completing these tasks, the two police officers who came in the patrol car left.
By this time, it was already close to midnight.
Jiang Ran, carrying the fire axe, also returned home feeling utterly speechless.
Sitting on his bedroom bed, Jiang Ran stared blankly at the shattered window glass.
"It seems I must start exercising. This time I had the terrain advantage. If I had been sleeping deeply and that person got inside, then I woke up and we fought hand-to-hand, I likely would have been done for."
Jiang Ran began considering the idea of physical training.
Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
Even though it was now almost midnight.
There were still over a hundred thousand people online in the live stream room.
I'm Actually a Girl was currently criticizing Huang Kaiyu: 【So lame! What kind of performance is this?! And so stupid! Why did he have to choose to break the bedroom window?! If he broke the bathroom window or the balcony one, using the time difference, he could have gotten in, right?!】
Besides I'm Actually a Girl, many others watching the stream were also criticizing Huang Kaiyu.
At this moment.
Middle-aged Uncle suddenly jumped out to refute: 【Honestly, I don't think this guy is that lame or that stupid.】
【The fact that he climbed to the third floor bare-handed, and could still run away successfully after falling from the third floor, shows that this guy's physical fitness is extremely good. So he's definitely not lame.】
【As for why he didn't break the bathroom or balcony windows.】
【First, I think he absolutely was not there to steal things;
he's not a thief. He was definitely targeting Jiang Ran, otherwise why would he try so hard to infiltrate Jiang Ran's home at this hour? I feel he definitely meant Jiang Ran harm. So, instead of breaking the other windows, he broke the bedroom window directly;
after breaking it, it would be convenient for him to enter directly and deal with Jiang Ran.】
【If he broke a window elsewhere, he could use the time difference to get in, but haven't you considered that if he breaks the window, Jiang Ran wakes up, leaves the bedroom, sees him climbing through the window, even if Jiang Ran can't stop him, wouldn't Jiang Ran just go back to the bedroom and lock the bedroom door? So then, this guy would still have to find a way to deal with the bedroom door.】
【That would be even worse.】
【Second, this person was probably very confident, likely an old hand;
perhaps he used this method before, so he directly broke the bedroom window to confront the person sleeping inside head-on. Thinking he would definitely succeed.】
【However, this time, he probably never expected that the person inside would directly pull out a fire axe—something uncommon in ordinary households—to resist, and that Jiang Ran's reaction would be so fast. If it were someone else, suddenly someone climbing through your window at night would probably startle them, they'd need time to recover, or even upon seeing someone climbing in, wouldn't dare to go push them away. Jiang Ran, however, without a word, directly served him with the fire axe.】
【So, due to a series of reasons, this guy seems lame and stupid.】
【But more accurately, I think it's that this guy was too overconfident and didn't take Jiang Ran inside seriously enough.】
【Of course, Jiang Ran is also too overpowered;
deadbolting the security door at night is one thing, but even locking the windows from the inside?】
【After all, a normal person just deadbolting the security door is usually enough;
his home is on the third floor. Why lock the windows too?】
【If the person this delivery guy was targeting was an ordinary man, he probably would have succeeded directly. Even if he couldn't open the security door, he could enter through the window without breaking it, since very few people lock their windows. That way, he wouldn't alert anyone and could enter the bedroom directly, striking quickly.】
Domineering Female CEO: 【I think so too.】
【But, Jiang Ran really has it rough. Having people targeting him in the apartment is one thing, but why is there someone outside targeting him too?】
【His luck is just too bad!】
I'm Actually a Girl: 【Boring. Target him if you want, but this time this guy didn't even force out Jiang Ran's other personalities, and was directly resolved by the main personality...】
Domineering Female CEO: 【Yes, not much to see.】

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Xiao Zhang is on a business trip, Jiang Ran becomes the temporary administrator
chapters.content:
They replaced the broken glass window in his bedroom with a new one.
After the window replacement workers left.
It was incredibly clean, with sparkling clear panes.
But he stared at this window in a daze for a long time.
Then, he suddenly reached for his phone nearby and started searching for something online.
What was he searching for?
He was searching for the world's strongest security door and the hardest glass.
Last night's incident had given him an idea.Since he had some money on hand anyway, he should get himself better security doors and glass.
Otherwise, he was really afraid that next time, someone might climb to the third floor again late at night and smash his window with a hammer.
Jiang Ran had also replayed the events of last night in his mind.
He thought that if the person had smashed the glass on the balcony or the bathroom instead of the bedroom window last night.
Using that time difference, they probably could have gotten inside.
By then, he would have definitely had to engage in close combat with that person using the fire axe.
Of course, with the fire axe in hand, Jiang Ran felt his chances of winning were higher, but there was still certainly risk involved.
Jiang Ran also considered simply running out of the house or locking the bedroom door and waiting for rescue.
But what if his brain froze at that moment and he didn't think of it? That would be "fun." Or if something went wrong during the attempt and it wasn't successful...
"Besides doing this, I also need to exercise, I must start building up my body!"
That's right, health is the greatest capital. No external object is more important than strengthening one's own body!
Just as Jiang Ran was preparing to embark on his grand ambition.
His phone suddenly rang, instantly switching the screen.
It was Manager Xiao Zhang.
Jiang Ran answered the call. Manager Xiao Zhang didn't specify anything particular on the phone, only asking him to come to the first floor as there was something very important to discuss.
When he reached the first floor.
He found Manager Xiao Zhang dressed as if going on a long trip.
Carrying a large backpack on his back and holding a big suitcase in his hand.
As soon as Jiang Ran arrived, before he could react, Manager Xiao Zhang said: "Jiang Ran, the owner of Alice Apartment has asked me to handle something. I need to go on a business trip, so I called you down to ask you to act as the manager during my absence."
After hearing this, Jiang Ran was completely surprised that it was about this. Manager Xiao Zhang was going on a business trip? Well, business trips aren't anything unusual these days, it's quite normal.
But him substituting as the manager while Manager Xiao Zhang is away?
"Really? I haven't been an assistant manager for long, can I handle being the manager?"
Manager Xiao Zhang patted Jiang Ran's shoulder: "Believe in yourself. Anyway, the manager's job isn't much. I can handle many things remotely. If I can't resolve them, I'll contact you."
"It's really simple. If you encounter anything you don't understand, you can contact me."
Jiang Ran nodded: "Alright then."
Manager Xiao Zhang added: "By the way, there are some differences between being the manager and being the assistant manager."
"As an assistant manager, your home is right here, so when you have nothing to do, you can go back to your own Room 304."
"But as the manager, whether there are tasks or not, you must stay in the management office."
Manager Xiao Zhang pointed to the management office next to them.
Jiang Ran nodded: "What about at night?"
"Do I finish work as usual?"
Manager Xiao Zhang said: "No, you must also stay in the management office at night. Anyway, the bed in the management office is already prepared for you. Of course, if you don't want to sleep in the management office, you can sleep in my room on the first floor."
Seeing Jiang Ran frown, Manager Xiao Zhang smiled and added:
"Don't worry, I'll be back soon. And although you need to stay in the management office for long hours, the work is still very relaxed. Plus, you get paid for sleeping in the management office at night, it counts as overtime. Understand?"
Jiang Ran instantly understood: "You mean, being the manager counts as working 24 hours a day? With pay for all of it?"
Manager Xiao Zhang nodded: "Exactly. Originally, since I'm going on a business trip, the owner was going to send a temporary manager from outside to replace me. But I refused, deciding it's better to keep benefits within our circle."
Jiang Ran was quite moved after hearing this.
Manager Xiao Zhang then took out his phone to check the time: "Oh, I need to go, or I'll miss my flight if I'm any later."
"Okay, that's all I have to say. Goodbye, Jiang Ran, I'm off now."
"If you have any questions, you can message me!"
Waving, Manager Xiao Zhang pulled his suitcase and passed through the glass automatic sensor door.
Then he ran all the way to the main gate, turning a corner and completely disappearing from Jiang Ran's view.
To be honest, although he was somewhat unprepared and confused about suddenly becoming a temporary manager.
Plus having to stay in the management office all the time.
But hearing that he gets paid for all 24 hours, Jiang Ran felt these were completely non-issues.
For him, it was just sitting somewhere else playing with his phone.
Therefore, after Manager Xiao Zhang left, he directly walked into the management office.
He sat down on the chair that Manager Xiao Zhang usually used.
Xiao Zhang's chair was just an ordinary backrest chair, with average comfort.
After sitting down, Jiang Ran saw a large bunch of keys on the table in front of him.
These were the keys to various rooms and such in Alice Apartment.
After sitting for a few minutes, Jiang Ran stood up and noticed a bed in the corner of the management office that wasn't there before.
It was a metal folding bed.
A typical single bed.
Jiang Ran found that this single bed was empty, with no bedding on it.
No choice, he needed to go back to 304 to get his own.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room.
I'm Actually a Girl: 【What is Manager Xiao Zhang going on a business trip for?】
Little Dragon Girl: 【No idea.】
I'm Actually a Girl: 【Has he been on business trips before?】
Little Aunt: 【Seems like he has!】
I'm Actually a Girl suddenly changed the topic: 【Today is day 5 of round 28.】
【Including today, there are exactly three full days left.】
【I've looked;
apart from Lab Rat No. 2 Ou Yingying and Little Zhao, and Lab Rat No. 5 Zhao Jie, all the other lab rats are alive and well! Don't tell me this round ends with everyone living happily ever after?】
Little Aunt: 【To be honest, for this round's lab rats, an unusually high number have survived to this point.】
Little Dragon Girl: 【This round mainly has too many variables.】
【After all, could you have predicted that Wang Jian and Liu Xiaoyu would both be variables?】
Back to reality.
As Jiang Ran returned to 304 and was about to insert his key into the lock at the door.
A voice suddenly came from his left, a very pleasant and clear female voice.
"Jiang Ran!"
Jiang Ran turned his head and found it was Qin Kelian, whom he hadn't seen for some time.
Qin Kelian was holding a small golden pot in her hand.
A mischievous smile adorned her pretty face as she moved closer and closer to him.
And as Qin Kelian moved closer.
The Danger Warning System's alert.
Changed from 【Ding! Host detected in a dangerous area, please leave quickly! Points +5, Points +5...】
to:
【Ding! Dangerous person detected! Please leave quickly! Points +8! Points +8...】
"What's up? Do you need something?"
Jiang Ran inserted the key into the lock and opened the door.
Although the Points +8 warning for Qin Kelian kept flashing incessantly.
Perhaps because they had known each other for a long time, or because Qin Kelian was pretty and dressed boldly and seductively.
Jiang Ran always found it hard to feel tense around her.

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Qin Kelian invites you for tea for the third time
chapters.content:
"What's wrong? Can't I come find you if there's nothing going on?"
Qin Kelian pushed Jiang Ran's back with her right hand, and the two of them entered Room 304 together.
After coming in, Qin Kelian gestured to Jiang Ran with the small golden teapot in her hand:
"Jiang Ran, my sister and I brewed a new tea again, and we thought of you first, letting you try it. How about it? Touched?"
Looking at the beautiful Qin Kelian happily showing it to him.
If this were before the clown incident, Jiang Ran would definitely be touched.
This pair of beautiful sisters actually thought of him so much.
But now, after the clown incident...
Jiang Ran felt not a shred of touch, only feeling like a sucker.
His face showed a complex smile.He recalled that Qin Kelian had made tea for him twice before, and both times there was sedative in it, which he had to rely on the System consuming 100 points to resolve.
"No, I haven't been drinking tea lately."
Jiang Ran directly declined politely.
Seeing Jiang Ran's polite refusal,
Qin Kelian clearly paused, probably not expecting Jiang Ran to refuse.
But she still said: "Jiang Ran, it's fine, come help me taste it! Give some feedback!"
Qin Kelian saw a glass on the glass coffee table in front of the sofa.
She immediately poured Jiang Ran a full cup.
This cup of tea looked greenish, emitting billowing steam.
Then, her two big eyes looked at Jiang Ran expectantly.
These big eyes seemed to say: "Jiang Ran, drink it! Hurry up and drink it!"
Jiang Ran looked at the cup of tea, then looked at Qin Kelian.
Even though he hadn't drunk it, he felt sure there was still sedative inside.
So, he asked: "Kelian, do you really want me to drink it?"
Jiang Ran's tone was very heavy.
As if confirming something.
"Um... of course! I still want you to drink it and give me some feedback!"
Although she thought Jiang Ran was a bit strange today, Qin Kelian certainly still hoped Jiang Ran would drink it.
Seeing this, Jiang Ran was very disappointed.
Although he didn't know what the two sisters wanted to do after drugging him unconscious,
it certainly wasn't anything good.
To be honest, he hadn't had much contact with Qin Yi, but he had interacted with Qin Kelian several times.
Yet even after these several times, these two sisters still wanted to harm him.
He was truly disappointed:
"I won't drink it, take it away."
"Are you sure?"
Qin Kelian asked.
Jiang Ran nodded.
Seeing that Jiang Ran really wouldn't drink, Qin Kelian sighed and left, very disappointed.
After Qin Kelian left, she returned to Room 303.
As soon as she returned to Room 303, her sister Qin Yi asked her how it went.
Was the newly developed sedative effective?
Qin Kelian shook her head and explained the whole story.
Qin Yi was somewhat surprised that Jiang Ran hadn't even drunk it this time.
She said: "You should have tried acting cute at the time."
Qin Kelian said: "Wouldn't acting cute make the intention too obvious?"
Qin Yi said: "Whether the intention is obvious or not, I don't know, but I guess Jiang Ran must have noticed something, otherwise he would have drunk it this time like the previous two times."
Qin Kelian said: "Sis, let's just give up on Jiang Ran, that guy is too invincible."
Qin Yi was very unwilling, but didn't say anything.
After Qin Kelian left,
Jiang Ran took the bedding and pillow and returned to the management office on the first floor.
After laying out the bedding and everything, he picked up his phone again.
He started browsing for security doors and glass windows.
First, he searched online for various security doors, determined to buy a high-quality security door at a price he could afford.
During his search, he also learned that security doors on the market are divided into four grades.
A, B, C, D.
Grade A is the highest, Grade D is the weakest.
In the end, he bought a Grade A security door costing over ten thousand.
This security door was the kind without a keyhole.
Opening is done via remote control, phone, or fingerprint, password, and facial recognition.
This security door certainly couldn't compare to those of wealthy families.
But for ordinary households, it absolutely belonged to the top-tier level.
Jiang Ran watched the test video for this door.
Chainsaws and power drills were used together, but they still couldn't break it open.
One word - tough.
Jiang Ran remembered when Xiao Q and the others came to his place and brought that young white man with a chainsaw who easily destroyed his security door at the time.
So, the security door was bought.
Next was buying glass windows.
As for the dimensions, he could just message Manager Xiao Zhang and ask for the measurements.
So he quickly ordered domestic tempered glass windows online.
The quality of domestic tempered glass was absolutely unquestionable.
Especially since what Jiang Ran bought was top-tier level among domestic tempered glass.
Jiang Ran also watched the test video.
Several young men swung hammers, smashing the glass.
As for the dimensions, he could just message Manager Xiao Zhang and ask for the measurements.
But strangely, the glass just wouldn't shatter.
With this, Jiang Ran's work on the security door and windows came to a temporary end.
He rested for a while, then started thinking about how to exercise?
Should he exercise at home by learning from some online bloggers?
Or go to a gym?
And so, time flew by.
The time reached 8 PM.
Jiang Ran was sitting in Manager Xiao Zhang's seat, playing with his phone, eating a cold skin noodle dish that had just been delivered by takeout.
Of course, because he was scared by last night's Lightning Delivery rider,
he used the Thunder Delivery app to order takeout today.
After finishing the cold skin noodles, Jiang Ran got up, planning to go out to use the toilet.
But just as he left the management office door,
he saw the elevator door open.
An old acquaintance walked out of the elevator.
It was... the Old Man in Room 301.
At this moment, the Old Man in Room 301 was, as usual, with a hunched and bent waist, his right hand holding a very thick cane, supporting himself on the ground.
He walked step by step towards the outside of the apartment building.
Jiang Ran saw the Old Man in Room 301, and naturally the Old Man in Room 301 also saw Jiang Ran.
When he saw Jiang Ran, the Old Man in Room 301 quickened his pace as if he had seen a ghost, quickly walking out. His speed was simply like the exaggerated whirlwind legs in anime.
Seeing this, Jiang Ran was speechless: "What exactly did I do? Is he this afraid of me, this Old Man..."
Because the Old Man in Room 301 also consistently gave Jiang Ran danger warnings of +5,
Jiang Ran couldn't possibly initiate a greeting either.
After all, it's best to stay away from dangerous people whenever possible.
Even though he felt that this Old Man, being so old and with his waist hunched like that,
could be knocked over with one kick from him.
Inside Jiang Ran's body, in the inner landscape world.
