When he saw Jiang Ran, the Old Man in Room 301 quickened his pace as if he had seen a ghost, quickly walking out. His speed was simply like the exaggerated whirlwind legs in anime.
While chatting, they watched everything that happened to Jiang Ran moment by moment.
When they saw that Old Man in Room 301,
the blue-haired Jiang Ran said very excitedly: "I helped the main personality too, last time I beat that old man into submission, that's why he runs faster than anyone when he sees the main personality now. If I hadn't beaten him into submission last time, that old man would probably have tried to harm the main personality repeatedly."
The Jiang Ran wearing all black, with smoky makeup, turned his head to look at the blue-haired Jiang Ran and suddenly asked: "Hey, after transmigrating to this world, you were the first one chosen by that stupid dog System to go out and help the main personality resolve a crisis, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Late at night, Fang Xiao and Lao Gou on the construction site
chapters.content:
Blue-haired Jiang Ran fiddled with his flowing blue locks:
"Right, I made my appearance back then and easily dealt with that young white man with the chainsaw."
"Then I wanted to go out for some fresh air, since it had been so long since I last emerged."
"But as soon as I stepped out, I ran into this old man."
"What's up? Why are you suddenly asking about something like that?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran shook his head: "Nothing, just asking casually."
Blue-haired Jiang Ran glanced at him, then turned his head away.
"If it's nothing then I'm a ghost. You asking this kind of question definitely means you're scheming something again," he thought to himself.
Blue-haired Jiang Ran was one of the earliest alternate personalities to emerge among the secondary consciousnesses.
Therefore, he was familiar with almost all of the alternate personalities.Like this Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran before him.
He was absolutely one of the most dangerous among all the alternate personalities.
And among those most dangerous ones, he was the most cunning.
So whatever this guy said absolutely shouldn't be trusted - you had to use your brain and think carefully about it.
Returning to reality.
After Jiang Ran returned from using the bathroom, another hour passed.
The time reached 9:00 PM.
At this hour, Jiang Ran suddenly realized something felt off.
What felt off?
It was that Old Man from Room 301 - he had gone out at 8:00 PM, and Jiang Ran had been keeping mental note.
Whether he had returned or not.
But now, a full hour had passed, and he still hadn't returned.
What could an old man like that, with his back hunched over like that, be doing out so late at night?
Right at that moment, his phone suddenly rang.
Jiang Ran saw it was Manager Xiao Zhang calling, so he answered.
After answering, he heard Manager Xiao Zhang on the other end say: "By the way, Jiang Ran, there's one more thing I forgot to tell you."
"Recently, hasn't our Alice Apartment been doing construction work?"
"Because of this, there have been quite a few thieves lately, frequently visiting the construction sites at night to steal iron and such."
"Although Alice Apartment has security guards doing regular patrols, we're short-handed, so managers need to participate in patrols too."
"Of course, since we're managers, not security guards, we don't need to patrol that frequently."
"Just one patrol at 9:00 PM, another at 10:00 PM, and one more at 11:00 PM. That's enough, three times a day."
"If you discover or catch a thief, there's a reward! One thousand yuan for discovering one! Five thousand yuan for catching one!"
Manager Xiao Zhang seemed very busy - after saying all this in one breath without waiting for Jiang Ran to respond, he hung up.
Jiang Ran was speechless. How did he suddenly get assigned this task?
He hoped he wouldn't be working for just a few days before other sudden tasks popped up.
Checking the time, it was exactly 9:05 PM now.
No choice - he had to go out on patrol since he couldn't just not do the work.
Although he was going to patrol, Jiang Ran only planned to make a round through the various construction sites.
As for discovering thieves or catching them...
Discovering was fine, but catching them? Forget it - he wasn't going to do anything risky.
If he ended up getting killed by a thief instead, that would be quite the story.
Just like that Lightning Delivery delivery guy who broke his window at night and came in.
He ended up getting killed by Jiang Ran instead. Of course, that guy was too strong - he could still get up and successfully escape after falling from the third floor.
Finding a flashlight in the management office cabinet, Jiang Ran headed out of the apartment building with his phone in his left hand and flashlight in his right, beginning his inspection of the construction sites.
Tonight's visibility was fairly good.
The moonlight was quite bright.
Plus, the tall street lamps around the apartment were all emitting light, with ambient glow scattering around.
Of course, without the flashlight it would still be pitch black.
Jiang Ran proceeded to patrol the various construction sites with his flashlight.
At this moment, the surroundings were completely silent and dark.
Only Jiang Ran's breathing and footsteps could be heard.
As if there were no signs of other living creatures.
Many people fear walking at night.
Why?
Because it's too dark. Dark places, unseen areas, represent the unknown.
Human fear of the unknown is etched into our bones.
We dread some danger suddenly emerging from the darkness to descend upon us.
Jiang Ran was okay - he wasn't particularly afraid of walking at night.
Of course, if you placed him deep in remote mountains and forests, his nighttime walking definitely wouldn't be as smooth as it was now.
"Even if thieves came to steal rebar from the construction sites, they wouldn't come to steal at this hour."
After patrolling several sites without seeing any suspicious figures, Jiang Ran thought that thieves would come to steal at midnight at the earliest.
At that time, most people would be asleep.
So who would come to steal at 9:00 PM?
Just as he was thinking this, his footsteps suddenly halted.
He seemed to have spotted something. Looking more carefully, about 10 meters away, there was a dark shadow squatting motionless.
"An animal?" was Jiang Ran's first thought.
So he directed his flashlight beam straight toward it.
Manager Xiao Zhang's flashlight was quite powerful.
The light reached far and was very bright.
When the beam hit the dark shadow, the figure clearly turned around.
Facing toward Jiang Ran's direction.
Because of the strong light, it could only squint.
It was through this turning movement that Jiang Ran recognized who the figure was.
It was none other than the Old Man from Room 301, who had been out for an hour without returning.
"Old man? Why are you squatting here?" Jiang Ran asked curiously as he slowly approached.
When the Old Man from Room 301 saw it was Jiang Ran, he initially wanted to leave, but whether because he'd been squatting too long or for some other reason, he ultimately stayed.
Instead, he extended his hand, pointing toward a certain direction ahead.
Jiang Ran followed the direction he was pointing.
Not far ahead was a construction site.
At that site, the lighting was quite bright.
There were figures standing there.
"Thieves?" Jiang Ran was startled.
The Old Man from Room 301 said: "Look more carefully."
Jiang Ran took a few steps forward.
He realized he had misseen.
In the open area of the construction site ahead, it was definitely not thieves - instead, they were residents of Alice Apartment.
On one side was Fang Xiao.
The current Fang Xiao seemed to be holding something like a large cleaver in his hand.
On the other side, after looking carefully for quite a while, Jiang Ran finally recalled:
Wasn't this that dog breeder, Old Dog?
And Old Dog wasn't alone - around him at his feet were over ten fierce large dogs circling him.
Probably all raised by him.
Jiang Ran immediately squatted down beside the Old Man from Room 301, using the obstacles in front of them to conceal their figures, afraid of being discovered.
He asked immediately: "Old man, how long have you been squatting here?"
The Old Man from Room 301 said: "Over half an hour."
Jiang Ran was surprised: "Wait, what are you squatting here for?"
The Old Man from Room 301 said: "Good question, young man. Then why are you squatting here?"
Jiang Ran: "I saw you squatting here, so I squatted here too."
The Old Man from Room 301: "Then I'll stop squatting. If I leave, will you leave too?"
Jiang Ran shook his head: "No can do. I'm a manager now, I need to care about the apartment residents."
"Especially those two up ahead."
Based on the current situation, the killing intent between Fang Xiao and Old Dog under the construction site lights ahead was intense.
The air over there seemed to have condensed into blades, spears, swords, and halberds, continuously clashing together, emitting intense sounds inaudible to human ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Jiang Ran: Good dog, don’t bite me
chapters.content:
Since Jiang Ran was still quite some distance away from Fang Xiao's location.
He couldn't hear the conversation between Fang Xiao and Old Dog at all.
He could only sense that these two men seemed about to come to blows.
"Old Man, should I go over and stop them?"
Jiang Ran turned his head to ask the Old Man in Room 301.
The Old Man in Room 301 was speechless: "Then go ahead."
Jiang Ran looked at the dozen or so dogs surrounding Old Dog.
He said: "What I meant was calling the police to stop their conflict."
The Old Man in Room 301 didn't respond.
Jiang Ran said: "I should still call the police. It feels like if these two really start fighting, it'll be a fight to the death."Just as Jiang Ran was about to pull out his phone, a heavy, guttural breathing sound suddenly reached his ears.
Fiddling with his phone, he asked the Old Man in Room 301: "Old Man, why is your breathing so heavy?"
The Old Man in Room 301's heart skipped a beat. He thought Jiang Ran was talking nonsense!
It's clearly YOUR breathing that's heavy;
his own breathing has never been that intense.
Oh, he understood now. Could it be that Jiang Ran wanted to pick a fight with him again?
Damn, last time he admitted he got beaten because he started it.
But this time he's been obedient, he hasn't provoked anything!
"It's not mine."
The Old Man in Room 301 still patiently explained. He had no choice - the Jiang Ran before him was like an ancestor he genuinely feared.
Jiang Ran was puzzled: "Then it's not mine either?"
"Then..."
At that moment, as if sharing the same thought, both men turned to look behind them.
From the pitch-black darkness behind them, a pair of eyes glowing with an eerie green light was getting closer and closer.
And the sound was coming from there.
Jiang Ran instinctively shone his flashlight in that direction.
Where the light illuminated.
The owner of those eerie green eyes turned out to be a ferocious large dog.
Coincidentally, Jiang Ran actually recognized this dog.
It was a notorious vicious dog popular on TikTok - a Pit Bull.
The Pit Bull's most notable characteristics are: feeling no pain, never letting go once it bites its prey, extreme ferocity, and fighting to the death.
Right now, this muscular, tan-skinned, short-haired Pit Bull that seemed almost hairless opened its large mouth, with disgusting white drool streaming from its lips.
It was staring directly in their direction while making those heavy breathing sounds.
"Old Man, whatever you do, don't make eye contact with it!"
Seeing this, Jiang Ran immediately warned, while quickly shifting his own gaze away.
Why was that?
Because Jiang Ran actually had experience with this. When you encounter a dog on the street, if you don't make eye contact, you might be fine. But if you lock eyes, the dog will get excited and chase after you barking.
Hence, Jiang Ran's reaction.
But the Old Man in Room 301 said beside him: "It's too late, Jiang Ran."
Jiang Ran wondered, what was too late?
So, the next second he turned his head to see what was too late.
Well, after seeing it, he indeed confirmed it was too late.
That tan Pit Bull opened its large mouth, its two small eyes filled with extreme ferocity.
Its robust body, like a started engine, charged wildly toward them.
As the saying goes, "Husband and wife are birds in the same forest, but when disaster strikes, they fly separately."
If even married couples are like that, let alone Jiang Ran and the Old Man in Room 301 who are just neighbors.
Therefore, Jiang Ran didn't hesitate for a second before running to the left.
It wasn't that he wasn't considering the more vulnerable.
It's just that in the current situation, it was like a clay Bodhisattva crossing a river - unable to guarantee its own safety.
He needed to save himself first.
Besides, the Old Man in Room 301 had been giving off danger warnings constantly.
Let that dangerous person fight it out with the dog!
Additionally, Jiang Ran had another small thought.
The Old Man in Room 301's physical condition clearly wasn't good;
he'd run slowly.
Therefore, he could serve as a living decoy.
Unless the dog directly abandoned the Old Man in Room 301 and chased after him instead.
Then he'd really have nothing to say.
And to Jiang Ran's relief.
The Pit Bull didn't chase him.
Instead, it pounced directly toward the Old Man in Room 301.
However, the bloody scene Jiang Ran imagined did not occur.
Instead, something that Jiang Ran felt belonged in a sci-fi movie happened.
He saw the Old Man in Room 301, whose waist was usually exaggeratedly hunched.
His waist suddenly straightened up at this moment.
Quickly, it achieved the standard posture of "standing straight like a pine tree."
Jiang Ran thought he was seeing things, so after running out of the danger zone, he stopped.
He rubbed his eyes and looked again.
And what happened next was even more incredible to Jiang Ran.
After the Old Man in Room 301's waist straightened, he saw him grip his thick walking stick tightly with both hands and swing it directly at the head of the Pit Bull pouncing toward him.
This strike actually made the Pit Bull's head and body stagger to the left.
And it fell to the ground.
Of course, this level of damage meant nothing to a Pit Bull. It quickly stood up again and continued pouncing toward the Old Man in Room 301.
Just as Jiang Ran was still watching the struggle between the Old Man in Room 301 and the Pit Bull.
His left ear twitched repeatedly, hearing some movement.
His head, along with the flashlight in his hand, turned to shine toward the left.
What he saw next made his heart leap into his throat in fear.
He saw two white vicious dogs, their pupils reflecting white from his flashlight, growling at him.
These two dogs were Dogo Argentinos.
The Dogo Argentino is also an extremely fierce breed of large vicious dog.
The two before him were likely both males.
Their shoulder height alone was probably around 70 centimeters.
Their weight was likely close to 100 pounds.
Their bodies were quite similar to the earlier Pit Bull's, giving that explosive muscular feeling.
Besides that, they shared the same characteristics.
Squinty eyes, small eyes.
The Dogo Argentino was bred abroad long ago specifically for hunting wild boar.
Thus, one can imagine the ferocity of this dog breed.
Also because the Dogo Argentino is entirely white, it's called the White Death, the King of Hunting Dogs.
And now, before Jiang Ran, there weren't just one, but two White Deaths.
This situation was truly despair-inducing.
Imagine yourself: you're walking outside, and two fierce dogs jump out in front of you, staring viciously at you.
Would you panic?
Okay, you say you're brave, that small local dogs are nothing to you, what is there to panic about?
The word "panic" doesn't exist in your dictionary!
Then!
What about facing the current situation?
Two large Dogo Argentinos blocking your path!
What, you say this is nothing?
They charge at you, and you kick one, punch the other?
If Wu Song could fight a tiger, you can fight dogs.
These mere vicious dogs are nothing to you?
Then you're definitely stronger than Jiang Ran, truly admirable!
"Holy mother's kiss!!!!!!!!"
Anyway, when Jiang Ran saw these two white Dogo Argentinos.
His face immediately turned extremely pale, even whiter than the two Dogo Argentinos' fur.
Simultaneously, Jiang Ran, who rarely swore, cursed vehemently in his heart.
Moreover, Jiang Ran discovered that his arms and legs were trembling uncontrollably for some reason.
Of course, no amount of cursing or internal fear was useful!
He needed to address the current situation first.
Jiang Ran shifted the flashlight beam away.
Pretending he hadn't seen the two dogs.
He acted casual as he stepped backward, trying to leave the area.
But these two Dogo Argentinos seemed to have already marked Jiang Ran as their prey.
They completely ignored his act of pretending not to see them.
They just barked fiercely and charged straight at Jiang Ran.

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Smoky makeup Jiang Ran, debut
chapters.content:
"Ahhhhhhh!"
"Help me, ahhhhhhh!!!"
Jiang Ran felt he was even worse off than the old man in Room 301.
At least the old man in Room 301 had confronted that Pit Bull head-on.
While he could only flee in panic right now.
There was no helping it—he truly had no weapon in hand. If he had a weapon, he'd want to fight back too.
Jiang Ran's screams directly tore through the silent night.
Making Fang Xiao and Old Dog, who were in a standoff over there, hear it and vaguely see someone being chased by two dogs.
Because there was some distance and insufficient lighting over there, Fang Xiao wasn't clear who the unlucky person being chased was.
He just said: "Old Dog, you really have plenty of sins on your hands! Another innocent person is about to die tragically in the mouths of the dogs you raise!"Old Dog snorted through his nose: "So much nonsense, today I will avenge my dogs!"
After speaking, Old Dog said to the dozen or so fierce dogs surrounding him: "Little White, Little Black, go, bite him to death!"
From the dozen or so dogs beside Old Dog, one white Dogo Argentino and one black Rottweiler stepped forward.
Seeing this, Fang Xiao gripped the large cleaver in his hand very tightly, he sneered coldly: "What? Not letting all your dogs attack together?"
Old Dog kept licking his chapped lips with his tongue:
"Hehehe, Fang Xiao, you want a quick death, but I'm not willing. I tell you, I could have killed you long ago."
"But, I want to torture you slowly, make you die bit by bit."
Over at Jiang Ran's side.
While fleeing, Jiang Ran bent over and grabbed dust from the ground with both hands, throwing it backward, attempting to blind the two Dogo Argentinos' eyes and hinder their running speed.
But whether it was because these two dogs had small eyes or not, the dust thrown at them didn't have much effect.
Their speed hardly slowed at all.
And Jiang Ran originally wanted to make a desperate dash back to the apartment building, but he simply didn't have the chance.
He could only follow the principle of proximity, running to a small construction site where lights were on.
This construction site had no workers, but there was a large lamp hanging high up.
On the ground were also many tools like shovels, hammers, etc., as well as mixed cement and so on.
When Jiang Ran saw the shovels and hammers on the ground.
He instantly grabbed a shovel.
After grabbing the shovel, he immediately gained confidence.
Turning around, he held the shovel ready to hit the dogs.
The two Dogo Argentinos, seeing Jiang Ran now had a weapon in hand, didn't retreat but pounced straight at him.
With both hands tightly gripping the shovel, Jiang Ran rapidly delivered small-range critical hits to the heads of the two pouncing dogs.
Because there were two dogs, Jiang Ran had no chance to build up strength to hit one dog properly.
Because if you build up strength to hit one dog, the other dog has an opportunity to get close and bite you.
Therefore, he could only rapidly make small-range wild cuts, wild knocks, wild hits.
Surprisingly, this method actually worked.
At least Jiang Ran was safe for now.
But weather is unpredictable, and accidents are too many.
These two Dogo Argentinos were much smarter than Jiang Ran had thought.
Since approaching Jiang Ran together from one direction wasn't working, they would attack from front and back.
Doing it this way, Jiang Ran found it difficult to watch both front and back.
So, take two shovels, one in each hand, wouldn't that solve the problem?
Sorry, the shovels and hammers on the construction site were quite long.
You overestimated Jiang Ran's arm strength.
He could lift them, but when swinging them, using two shovels was worse and less powerful than using one shovel with one hand.
Therefore, when he saw one Dogo Argentino slowly moving to his back in a compass-like arc with himself as the center.
Jiang Ran felt utterly desolate in his heart.
Feeling that he might end up dying here today.
Woof woof!
After this dog barked.
The Dogo Argentinos in front and behind Jiang Ran simultaneously launched an attack on him.
Jiang Ran could only retreat backward, attempting to narrow the angle of the two dogs pinching him.
But what Jiang Ran never expected was.
That there had actually been a dog hiding behind him all along.
And it was another white Dogo Argentino.
This Dogo Argentino that had been hiding all along seized the perfect opportunity when Jiang Ran was completely unaware and launched a sneak attack.
By the time Jiang Ran heard the sound from behind, it was already too late.
The third Dogo Argentino behind him opened its bloody maw and directly bit into the left side of Jiang Ran's buttocks.
Instantly, the pain made Jiang Ran let out a sharp scream that pierced the sky.
And it was at this critical moment that Jiang Ran's mind uncontrollably suddenly remembered.
The highest note from Zhang Yusheng's song "The Sea":
"If the sea could bring back the love of the past..."
[Ding! Detected host encountering fatal crisis! Consuming 1000 points! Awakening alternate personality!!!]
At the critical moment, the System's voice suddenly rang out.
At this moment.
In the inner landscape world.
All the Jiang Rans were paying attention to everything happening outside.
They also similarly heard the System's voice and knew that soon one lucky person from their inner landscape world would be selected.
Of course, given the current situation—being surrounded by three Dogo Argentinos, especially with one biting his buttocks—this kind of situation requiring pure physical strength to counter-kill wasn't suitable for all alternate personalities.
Just like back then, when facing Robert, the Jiang Ran who was selected.
Going out just meant getting beaten up, completely unable to resolve the crisis at that time.
"For this situation, who else but me?"
Blue-haired Jiang Ran was extremely excited.
This kind of scene was perfect for him.
Perfect for him to fully display his skills.
It's just a pity that the System's selection of alternate personalities each time was random.
All depending on luck.
And so it was.
When the random golden light descended from the sky and shot toward them this time.
Blue-haired Jiang Ran was extremely excited.
But when that golden light brushed past him and landed beside him, his face instantly darkened.
Turning to look, the person beside him was none other than Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran who was selected was also surprised.
Then, a strange smile appeared on his face.
...
Currently, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran had taken control of the body.
"Is this the feeling of freedom?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran opened his eyes, feeling the loneliness of the night and the slight warm wind.
He couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
But, immediately afterward, the intense biting pain transmitted from his buttocks made his right eyelid twitch violently.
Instantly pulling him out of his beautiful reflection.
Woof woof!
At this moment, on Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran's buttocks was the Dogo Argentino that directly refused to let go, biting down desperately.
While two more pounced from the front left and right.
A trace of cruelty appeared on Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran's face.
Swinging the shovel in his hand, he executed a horizontal sweep grand slam, temporarily beating back the two Dogo Argentinos on the left and right.
Next.
He had to deal with the Dogo Argentino on his buttocks.
This Dogo Argentino not only had bitten his left buttock but was also using all its strength to pull and tear backward, wanting to tear the flesh of his left buttock off alive.
"Vile beast!"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran only said this.
His free left hand, index finger and ring finger pressed together.
Instantly stabbed into the left eye of the Dogo Argentino biting his buttock.
The force of this strike was great, causing the two fingers to plunge into the dog's eye.
The eyeball was directly gouged out.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Kangal Dog
chapters.content:
At this moment, the Dogo Argentino, having had one eye gouged out, instantly released its bite due to the pain.
If that finger had just stabbed any other part of the Dogo Argentino, it definitely wouldn't have had such a good effect.
This move directly attacked the Dogo Argentino's weakest part.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran withdrew his left hand and found it was completely covered in blood and eyeball residue.
He wiped the bloody left hand on his clothes.
Enduring the heart-tearing, lung-rending immense pain in his buttocks, he actually managed to laugh.
Then, he stared at the two Dogo Argentinos in front of him.
These two Dogos seemed to sense that the Jiang Ran before them was somewhat different from before.
But they didn't know where the difference lay.
Oh, no, they did know what was different.The previous Jiang Ran primarily focused on running away, defending and counterattacking.
But the one before them now actually took the initiative to attack them.
Meanwhile, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran listened to the System's prompt tone.
[Ding! Resolving host body's buttock injury, consuming 500 points!]
This way, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran became completely uninhibited.
He swung the shovel and fiercely smashed it towards the two Dogo Argentinos.
After all, Dogo Argentinos are large breed dogs, a type of fighting dog.
Naturally, they wouldn't cower and also charged forward.
They began fighting with Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran.
Meanwhile, the Dogo Argentino that had been blinded in one eye at the back had now recovered.
It let out a howl towards the sky.
Its remaining eye, pale under the light, radiated immense hatred towards Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran as it pounced to bite.
At this time, in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
The number of viewers reached 460,000.
Why so high?
Mainly because it was only around 9 PM, still very early.
Additionally, three famous scenes were happening simultaneously right now.
First, lab rat Jiang Ran versus three Dogo Argentinos.
Second, Old Man in Room 301 versus one Pit Bull.
Third, lab rat Fang Xiao versus Old Dog.
Many people watching the live stream couldn't keep up with everything and simply split their screens into three sections.
After all, many were watching on computers, and their screens were large enough.
The Middle-aged Uncle watched the three simultaneous scenes.
His typing hands trembled with excitement:
[Too fierce, too fierce! This scene is just like watching a movie! Absolute bloodshed and violence!]
Yes.
Currently, these three scenes all involved absolute bloody and violent struggles.
Struggles between people, because the apartment residents were the weaker lab rats, were purely one-sided affairs.
It was rare to see such bloody and violent struggles.
But this time, all three scenes involved parties with decent skill levels.
There was back-and-forth action.
Especially since one side in each was a fighting dog.
Absolutely a fight to the death.
Domineering Female CEO: [Honestly, given the current situation of being attacked by these dogs.]
[Not counting Old Man in Room 301, this deranged criminal.]
[Just talking about the lab rats.]
[Aside from Fang Xiao and Jiang Ran, I really can't think of any other lab rats who could handle this.]
[For example, take Wang Jian and Liu Xiaoyu from this round.]
[Although they counter-killed the residents who wanted to kill them this round, if placed in this situation they would undoubtedly die!]
[Just consider Wang Jian's hammer blow - if he had been chased by a Dogo Argentino instead of the new-generation Jack the Ripper, even if that hammer blow smashed the Dogo's head, it wouldn't cause fatal damage. Wang Jian would 100% be bitten to death afterward!]
[As for Liu Xiaoyu, don't even think about it.]
[She purely relied on ambush tactics back then.]
[In the current dog-fighting situation, you need certain combat prowess;
on the contrary, intelligence is completely useless because you can't use intelligence on a fighting dog - it's not like you can throw them some food and they'll stop biting you.]
I am the Hero: [What are you talking about? My bro Ultimate Rich Kid could handle it too! Don't forget, he has a gun!!!]
I'm Actually a Girl: [Then why don't you call him to come?]
I am the Hero: ...
Fairy Sister: [Forget it, only a fool would come. Who knows how many dogs are nearby.]
I'm Actually a Girl: [Hey, one match has ended! Old Man in Room 301!]
At this moment, in the live stream footage, one of the three matches ended.
It was Old Man in Room 301.
That Old Man in Room 301's match ended first, which wasn't surprising.
After all, Old Man in Room 301 only faced one Pit Bull.
And this match was won by Old Man in Room 301.
Although he won, Old Man in Room 301 had a lot of blood on him;
it was unclear whether it was dog blood or human blood.
Additionally, there were several shocking bite marks on his body.
As for that Pit Bull, it lay motionless on the muddy ground, the top of its head a bloody mess.
None of the ferocity it had when alive remained.
After killing this Pit Bull, Old Man in Room 301 dragged the dog away from the area;
it was unclear what he intended to do.
Over at Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran's side.
After more than ten minutes.
The two White Death Dogo Argentinos twitched as they fell in a pool of blood.
Covered in countless wounds big and small, especially their heads which were smashed to the point where white bone was visible.
As for the final one.
It was currently being fiercely hacked and smashed by Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran using the shovel.
It was in a state of steady retreat, almost finished.
And finally, with one last chop.
This one-eyed Dogo Argentino was struck on the neck—a bloody mess, dripping with blood, flesh turned out.
This one-eyed Dogo Argentino finally could no longer hold on and completely collapsed to the ground.
Gurgling sounds came as blood bubbled from its mouth.
Looking back at Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, his appearance was also wretched.
There was quite a bit of red bloodstains on him.
But most of it was blood from the three Dogo Argentinos.
"Too annoying, this body after transmigrating is too weak. Even with a weapon in hand, I actually got into this state because of three dogs."
Like other alternate personalities who had taken control of the body, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran internally complained with the same grievance the others had voiced.
At this moment, looking at the three White Death Dogo Argentinos fallen beside him.
He couldn't help but offer a word of praise:
"Although they're beasts, they're harder to deal with than some people."
Then, he delivered several more shovel blows to each of the three Dogo Argentinos' heads.
After confirming the three Dogo Argentinos were completely dead, he gripped the shovel and left the area.
Holding the shovel, he didn't return to the Alice Apartment building. Instead, following his memory, he went to a location where he could secretly observe Fang Xiao and Old Dog.
He crouched here, getting a clear view of the current situation between Fang Xiao and Old Dog.
Currently, it was visible.
Old Dog still had over a dozen fierce large dogs guarding him.
It had to be said, with this setup, unless you had a gun, it would be very difficult to approach.
As for Fang Xiao's side.
This guy now looked miserable too.
Extremely wretched.
However, he still had some bragging rights.
Because the two that had initially surrounded him—one Dogo Argentino and one Rottweiler—were already dead, lying to the side.
Now, Fang Xiao was being surrounded by three Kangal dogs of different coat colors.
Kangals are taller and much heavier than Dogo Argentinos.
Male Dogo Argentinos typically have a shoulder height of 60-68 cm and weigh 40-45 kg.
Whereas male Kangals typically have a shoulder height of 70-100 cm and weigh 50-80 kg.
From these two sets of data, it can be seen that the maximum size ceiling of a Dogo Argentino is the minimum, poorest body size of an average Kangal.
As for the three Kangals currently surrounding Fang Xiao.
Each one was only slightly smaller than a donkey...

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Molotov cocktail
chapters.content:
At present, if nothing unexpected happens, Fang Xiao will most likely die under the mouths of these three Kangals.
Why?
First: Although Fang Xiao practiced boxing in the past and was a highly talented individual among them—a professional fighter.
However, he retired long ago, and it's unknown how long it's been since he last trained.
Additionally, after retiring, although this person avoided women, he had various bad habits like long-term smoking and drinking.
His body has been severely depleted.
Second, the Kangal breed of dog is too large and powerful.
Especially since three of them are surrounding Fang Xiao together.
This breed of dog has always been raised as a large livestock guardian dog, fighting wolves in the wild.
Right now, the three Kangals are clearly treating Fang Xiao as a wolf, surrounding him together three-on-one.Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, watching from the sidelines, had his mind racing non-stop.
After about two minutes.
He muttered to himself: "No good, this Old Dog must die."
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran didn't want to kill Old Dog simply for revenge because he himself was surrounded by Old Dog's three Dogo Argentinos, especially since one of them bit his butt.
He wasn't that narrow-minded;
it was purely because Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran sensed a threat.
This Old Dog keeps so many dogs;
what if he becomes an enemy one day? What should he do then?
Of course, even though the main personality controls the body most of the time, it's not the complete main personality yet.
But he certainly doesn't want all these alternate personalities to perish along with the so-called main personality.
Of course, there's one more crucial reason.
That was the incident with Robert last time.
The System first summoned an alternate personality, but it couldn't handle Robert, so it directly awakened the main personality's evil memories, making the main personality complete.
Once complete, the main personality could enter the small town in the inner landscape, hunt down and kill one alternate personality, and then leave.
That sudden incident last time was something no one anticipated, including the complete main personality.
Therefore, the complete main personality caught one alternate personality, killed it outright, thinking he could keep killing, but unexpectedly, it didn't work.
So, if a similar situation happens again next time.
The incomplete main personality confronts Old Dog, can't win, and needs an alternate personality to step up.
But the alternate personality that steps up isn't capable enough, causing the complete main personality to emerge again.
Then, the next time the complete main personality enters the small town in the inner landscape world again.
Do you think the complete main personality would just casually kill one alternate personality and leave?
He would absolutely kill the one who poses the greatest threat to him.
And that might very well be him.
So, he's doing this for himself.
But currently, with over a dozen dogs around Old Dog, it's really not easy to get close.
"If this were the body from before the transmigration, I'd have some confidence. But this current body? Forget it, that would be pure suicide. Too risky."
He thought to himself.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran's eyes gleamed with a cold light, as if he had suddenly thought of a good idea.
He quietly retreated from the area, muttering under his breath: "Fang Xiao, you'd better hold on a bit longer."
Meanwhile, in the live stream room.
I'm Actually a Girl: [There's actually one thing I've always been curious about.]
[Look, Jiang Ran and those alternate personalities of his that come out to resolve crises are obviously using the same body. But in situations like today, where they're both dealing with three Dogo Argentinos at the same time.]
[The main personality Jiang Ran earlier couldn't handle it, but as soon as his alternate personality comes out, it works and resolves the situation. May I ask why that is?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Good question.]
[The answer is quite simple too.]
[Let me give you an example.]
[If boxing champion Mike Tyson uses his own body, and you soul-transmigrate into Mike Tyson's body, and you two have a PK. Who would win?]
I'm Actually a Girl: [Definitely Mike Tyson. I've never boxed or learned martial arts/boxing.]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Well, there you have it. It's the same situation with Jiang Ran.]
Fairy Sister: [Hey, look, Jiang Ran is leaving now. Probably running away.]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Running away is good! That Old Dog has over a dozen dogs around him. If Jiang Ran really went up there, he'd be an idiot.]
Fairy Sister: [Then it's over!]
Middle-aged Uncle: [What's over?]
Fairy Sister: [Fang Xiao is done for...]
Middle-aged Uncle: [Well, if he's done for, then he's done for. I didn't bet on him anyway.]
Domineering Female CEO: [You didn't bet on him, but we...]
The number of people who bet on Fang Xiao this round was even higher than those who bet on Jiang Ran.
Therefore, seeing Jiang Ran run away while Fang Xiao remained there made the hearts of those who bet on Fang Xiao ache with worry.
And given the current situation before their eyes, they had to admit one point.
Fang Xiao was probably going to fall here.
Currently, Fang Xiao can't even handle three Kangals, let alone the over ten more dogs Old Dog has by his side.
Evil Wolf: [I don't understand, is Fang Xiao an idiot? Knowing full well that Old Dog has a grudge against him, and such an obvious trap, he still fell for it.]
How did Fang Xiao and Old Dog end up near the construction site next to the apartment building late at night?
Those watching the live stream saw it clearly.
First, Fang Xiao was drinking at home when he heard dogs barking outside.
He stuck his head out and saw two large dogs fighting outside the apartment building.
Fang Xiao definitely recognized them as Old Dog's dogs.
So, he took the large cleaver he had prepared earlier from home.
He went downstairs;
fortunately, the two dogs were still fighting there.
But then something strange happened: as soon as Fang Xiao approached, the two dogs ran away.
As if it had been premeditated all along.
And such an obvious trap... Fang Xiao actually chased after them...
Who knows what he was thinking.
Then, what happened next was Fang Xiao being lured to the construction site.
Where Old Dog had been waiting for a long time.
Domineering Female CEO: [Based on Fang Xiao's performance in those three rounds back in the day, I don't think he should have failed to see this was a trap. But this time he still followed, and looking at it, there seems to be no way out. He probably doesn't have any backup plan himself either. So I think he might have really damaged his brain from drinking too much these past few years. He's not the Fang Xiao from back then anymore.]
Evil Wolf: [Damn... if that's really the case, then... truly, nothing more to say...]
Those who bet on Fang Xiao were all lamenting.
Those who didn't bet on Fang Xiao were all watching the stream mockingly, anticipating Fang Xiao's death, being torn apart alive by the large dogs.
Another half hour passed.
Fang Xiao was still entangled in combat with the three Kangals.
It was clear that Fang Xiao's condition was getting worse and worse.
And right at this moment, a situation completely unexpected by the people in the live stream room occurred.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, who had originally left, actually returned.
He was seen riding back on his electric bike.
At that moment.
He had a large black backpack on his back, and another black bag was on the front footrest of the electric bike.
The rear seat of the electric bike also had a black bag securely tied down with rope.
Immediately after, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran rode the electric bike to a chosen spot that was at a certain distance from Old Dog and Fang Xiao.
He got off the bike.
Then, he put down the black backpack he was carrying, and from this fully packed black backpack, he pulled out a glass liquor bottle.
The mouth of this liquor bottle had a strip of white cloth attached.
This was unmistakably a Molotov cocktail.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Molotov Cider Vinegar
chapters.content:
The Molotov cocktail is a simple yet brutal weapon.
Easy to make, considerable power.
Fill a bottle with flammable substances like alcohol or gasoline, then stuff a gasoline-soaked cloth strip into the bottle mouth, done.
When using it, you light the cloth strip and then throw the Molotov cocktail.
For many young people, Molotov cocktails are not unfamiliar.
They've used them before.
Of course, the usage referred to here is in shooter-type games, not reality.
Before crossing over, when Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran had control of the body, one of his favorite props to use was the Molotov cocktail.
Therefore, in just half an hour, he was essentially picking up his old trade.
He made a large pile of Molotov cocktails.Of course, due to the short time, these Molotov cocktails definitely weren't as good as the ones he made on Earth before crossing over, but they were sufficient.
At this moment, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran saw that the situation on site was about right.
He took a lighter from his pocket.
Lit the cloth strip of a Molotov cocktail in his hand.
The white cloth strip instantly caught fire, flames igniting, needing to be thrown quickly.
He aimed at Old Dog over there and threw it.
While throwing the Molotov cocktail, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran felt a wonderful, pleasurable sensation rise in his heart.
He felt as if he had come alive again.
Returned to those happy times on Earth.
As for Old Dog over there.
He was still watching Fang Xiao being besieged by three Kangals.
His lips curled slightly, revealing a smug, cold smile.
"Fang Xiao, ah, Fang Xiao, rest assured, I absolutely will not kill you easily or let you die painlessly. I will torture you slowly."
If he really wanted Fang Xiao's life, Old Dog could just send out all dozen or so dogs by his side at once.
Fang Xiao would undoubtedly die.
But, he didn't do that.
He precisely wanted to torture Fang Xiao slowly.
If he let Fang Xiao die too quickly, the rage in his heart wouldn't dissipate.
Just as he was enjoying Fang Xiao being slowly surrounded and killed by his three Kangals, suddenly dogs beside him started barking loudly.
First one, then several, until finally all the dogs around were barking.
Old Dog hadn't entered Alice Apartment initially;
he ran his own dog farm, playing at dog fighting.
This wasn't something he started in this lifetime either—his family had been doing it for several generations.
Roughly from seven or eight generations above, they began engaging in this industry.
Therefore, by the time it passed to his generation, his dog training skills were absolutely unquestionable.
Four words—superlative mastery—wouldn't be an exaggeration to describe them.
For example, normally his dogs would never bark unnecessarily;
if they barked, something was definitely wrong.
Thus, he immediately became alert and looked toward the direction of the barking.
He saw, in the dark night, a ball of fire flying toward him.
His eyes widened, thinking he was hallucinating—where would flying fire come from in the middle of the night?
But he reacted quickly;
regardless of whether it was a hallucination or not, he started to move backward.
However, he noticed too late;
even if he ran back now, the fire explosion range after the Molotov cocktail landed would still affect him.
Though it probably wouldn't be fatal, of course.
As the saying goes, maintain an army for a thousand days to use it for one morning.
At this moment, one of the dogs beside him suddenly leaped up, attempting to catch the Molotov cocktail with its mouth.
The moment the dog bit the Molotov cocktail, it exploded.
Instantly, explosion and flames surged.
Immediately covering the dog's head and most of its body in flames.
Of course, because of this dog, Old Dog didn't suffer any injury.
By now, Old Dog had retreated to a safe distance, his eyes ready to search for who threw the Molotov cocktail.
But just then, from that direction, more Molotov cocktails continuously flew over.
In the blink of an eye, five fiery trails attacked his area simultaneously.
He immediately started running backward.
Those five Molotov cocktails—some landed near the dogs, others landed directly on the dogs.
Instantly, flames erupted over there.
The fire kept burning.
"Over there! Go bite him to death!"
Old Dog finally spotted Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, who was throwing the Molotov cocktails.
He ordered his dozen or so dogs to go bite Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran to death.
Meanwhile, he himself, taking two dogs, wildly ran away toward the rear.
From Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran's perspective, about eleven or twelve dogs were charging toward him.
But he wasn't flustered at all, throwing Molotov cocktails with both hands, fast and steady like a machine.
He kept throwing Molotov cocktails, and they seemed as if equipped with automatic targeting.
One after another, they hit those fierce large dogs.
These large dogs hit by the Molotov cocktails all caught fire upon impact, flames continuously consuming their flesh-and-blood bodies.
They tore around and howled incessantly.
Simultaneously rolling left and right on the muddy ground, trying to extinguish the flames on their bodies.
But unfortunately, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran gave them no chance.
He kept throwing Molotov cocktails as if they were free.
Thus, the dozen or so large dogs that came to bite Jiang Ran were now all in patches of fire, struggling with the flames.
However, among these dogs there were also exceptional ones;
one black Doberman kept dodging the Molotov cocktails and was only five or six meters away from Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran.
It's just a pity, a dog is just a dog.
It never occurred to it that the closer you get, the higher the probability of being hit?
Just as this black Doberman was three meters away from Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, it was finally hit by a Molotov cocktail. Instantly, flames erupted all over its body.
It stopped moving, howling and yelping.
In the brief moment it halted, three more bottles landed on it, fueling the fire.
"So satisfying, absolutely exhilarating! I love the feeling of destruction, love seeing these lives devoured by flames!!!!"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran was throwing with insane joy, the eerie smile on his face reaching its extreme.
Comparable to an evil god.
After throwing enough, the dozen or so large dogs that could threaten him were no longer a concern.
He put the remaining Molotov cocktails into the large backpack on his back.
Then charged toward Fang Xiao.
Next, he repeated the method, using Molotov cocktails to help Fang Xiao overcome his crisis.
Originally, at this moment, Fang Xiao was really almost killed by the three Kangals.
His body already had many bloody bite wounds.
Bleeding incessantly.
Especially since one currently had its teeth clamped on his large cleaver covered in dog blood;
no matter how the blade cut its mouth, it wouldn't let go.
Seemingly determined.
While the other two were biting at him from two different directions.
Fang Xiao couldn't pull his cleaver free at this moment.
Looking at the current situation, he knew he was going to die.
He had already prepared himself for death.
But then, a flash of orange-red flame suddenly passed through his field of vision.
Immediately after, the Kangal in front of him that was fighting for the large cleaver suddenly caught fire.
Causing that Kangal to instantly release its grip and howl in agony.
Before Fang Xiao could react, he heard two 'thump' sounds.
The two Kangals preparing to bite him from the left and right directions also caught fire.
While Fang Xiao was still bewildered, he saw Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, carrying a backpack, lighter in left hand, Molotov cocktail in right hand, walking slowly toward him.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: The old dog ran away
chapters.content:
When Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran approached him.
Fang Xiao's dazed face revealed a relieved smile.
"I never expected you to be the one to save me, Jiang Ran. I truly didn't anticipate this."
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran said, "Why is that so unexpected?"
Fang Xiao remained silent. He genuinely hadn't imagined Jiang Ran would rescue him.
Because ever since he returned to Alice Apartment.
He had considered Assistant Manager Jiang Ran and that damned Manager Xiao Zhang to be allies.
So how could he possibly have thought Jiang Ran would save him?
Therefore, Fang Xiao said, "Thank you, Jiang Ran, for saving my life. I'll remember this kindness and will definitely repay you next time."
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran said, "Rather than repaying later, why not repay right now?"Fang Xiao was startled: "Now? How? Don't tell me after saving me, you still want to kill me? Have me willingly hand over my life?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran revealed a sinister smile: "Come on, you're overthinking it."
At that moment, he pointed in a direction: "Old Dog ran that way with two dogs. Want to come with me to chase him down and eliminate the root of the problem?"
Fang Xiao looked down at his numerous injuries, then raised his head and said, "Do you have any baijiu here?"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran took off his backpack and pulled out a bottle of baijiu from inside.
He removed the cloth strip from the baijiu bottle.
Then handed the bottle to Fang Xiao.
Fang Xiao took the baijiu, sniffed it, and said, "Average quality, definitely not as good as Moutai or Wuliangye."
After saying this, he took a sip, then lifted one of his arms, tore open the clothing, and directly sprayed it onto the bite wounds.
That wasn't all - he repeated this process multiple times, even pouring the baijiu directly onto the wounds all over his body.
Which hurts more - baijiu on wounds or salt directly sprinkled on wounds?
Unknown, but both are explosive-level pain.
Even Fang Xiao was affected. Although he didn't scream or shout, his mouth was twisted in an ugly grimace.
While applying the baijiu, he said, "Jiang Ran, honestly, if we swapped positions."
"If you were surrounded by dogs and I was nearby, I absolutely couldn't save you."
"After all, Old Dog has too many dogs - just around him there were over a dozen."
"But you're really impressive, making so many Molotov cocktails."
"Moreover, you need to understand, although these dogs are all fighting breeds, the fiercest varieties among dogs."
"They're still dogs, and they still fear fire. They're scared of fire's high temperature and brightness."
"So you're really clever - using fire against these dogs is absolutely perfect."
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran stared at the talking Fang Xiao, somewhat impatient: "Friend, stop talking. Let's go. If you keep bragging, Old Dog will get away."
Hearing this, Fang Xiao smiled somewhat awkwardly.
He stood up, poured out the remaining baijiu all at once, then rose and followed Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran.
But then he discovered Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran wasn't heading in the direction Old Dog had escaped.
But rather the opposite direction.
Just as he was about to ask, he saw Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran, moving quickly, riding an electric bike over.
"Get on."
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran said.
And so, Fang Xiao gripping his large cleaver, sat on the back seat of Jiang Ran's electric bike.
Then, these two lab rats who had similarly survived three rounds, went together to pursue Old Dog.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran had clearly seen and remembered the direction Old Dog escaped.
Therefore, he was chasing in that direction.
He turned on the bike light.
The electric bike wasn't very fast.
It seemed Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran was also afraid of being ambushed.
"Nobody."
Ten minutes later, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran had already ridden past two construction sites in this direction.
But hadn't seen any trace of Old Dog.
Half an hour later, after riding around many construction sites.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran and the other still hadn't found Old Dog.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran's face was extremely gloomy at this point: "Let's go back and deal with the remaining dogs. Forget about Old Dog - at night, if that guy wants to hide, there's no way we can find him."
And so, the two rode back to the area where the initial fight had occurred.
Here, some dogs had been burned to death, while others weren't dead but were lying on the ground, panting heavily, their bodies horrifically burned.
Some could still move normally.
So Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao began cleanup work.
Killing all the remaining dogs.
Meanwhile, in the live stream room.
I'm Actually a Girl: 【This livestream is making me feel more and more like it's a suspense drama.】
【So confusing? First, why did Jiang Ran come back to save Fang Xiao?】
【Are they close? They just met this round, right? Especially since it's an alternate personality controlling the body now.】
【Then there's Old Dog - although he lost many dogs last time when killing Ou Yingying, Little Zhao, and that American special forces soldier Golden Beard, he still had plenty of dogs left from last time.】
【Definitely more than what appeared today.】
【So why did he run away? Why not bring more dogs for a counterattack?】
Fairy Sister: 【Why Jiang Ran came back to save Fang Xiao - who knows? Nobody can answer that unless you go to Alice Apartment in Nancheng City and ask him yourself.】
【As for why Old Dog, who clearly has more dogs, ran away instead of bringing them for a counterattack?】
【Probably because these were all the dogs he brought this time. He thought he could easily handle Fang Xiao, but didn't anticipate someone disrupting things. Additionally, where he keeps his dogs is probably some distance from where he planned to take down Fang Xiao. So he didn't have time to summon more dogs for a counterattack.】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【I think the same. The dogs Old Dog brought this time were completely sufficient to easily kill Fang Xiao. Who knew there would be two disruptors - one was the Old Man who dealt with one pit bull, and then Jiang Ran directly killing dogs with Molotov cocktails. No choice but to run.】
【But regardless, Old Dog suffered heavy losses this time! So many more dogs dead!!!!】
Reality.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao spent some time dealing with the remaining dogs.
After finishing, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran prepared to return to the apartment building.
But Fang Xiao wasn't planning to leave first.
He borrowed the electric bike from Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran.
His purpose?
To transport all the dead dogs to the apartment building entrance, then process them all, keeping the dog meat parts.
To become delicious ingredients.
Regarding Fang Xiao.
To be honest, Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran initially didn't find anything particularly remarkable about him that made him stand out.
But now, Fang Xiao's behavior truly made Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran feel that Fang Xiao wasn't a normal person.
Having just experienced a bloody battle.
Still bearing dog bite wounds.
Yet instead of treating his wounds or resting.
He's preparing to transport all the dead dogs to the apartment entrance and process them immediately?
Conservative estimates suggest at least 20 dogs died tonight.
Skinning and processing all of them - that's no simple task!

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Smoky-Eye Jiang Ran’s Scheme Against the Primary Personality
chapters.content:
But it had nothing to do with him. He slung the backpack over his shoulder;
inside that backpack were several Molotov cocktails.
He did not return to the management office but went back to his home in Room 304.
After getting home.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran was in the living room and saw the ancient beautiful lady kite that, long ago, the other alternate personalities had taken from the kite serial killer Wang Nuli.
He only glanced at it and did not linger to admire it.
Because he knew he would soon be forcibly pulled back into the inner landscape world by the Danger Warning System.
At that moment, he sat on the sofa.
The strange smile that used to frequent his face was gone, replaced by an all-consuming frost.
It was very cold around him.
The air seemed to have frozen solid.Especially in the dead of night, the silence—despite the lights being on—felt oppressive.
Light should bring security, but every time people looked at him, that sense of safety vanished instantly.
"The main personality sure is lucky."
"When he was on Earth, he met many people who helped suppress us."
"That alone would be fine."
"Then there’s time travel, and systems binding him—what other bullshit could appear on him?"
"And this System is so annoying. It lets us out to deal with crises, and once the crisis is resolved, it pushes us back with no power to resist."
"Are we its damn disposable wipes?"
These thoughts kept cycling through his mind.
Gradually, an unwillingness and irritation filled Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran’s eyes, but in the next moment those feelings vanished and were replaced by shock.
"Wait—did I miss something?"
"The Danger Warning System must favor the main personality when it comes to main versus alternate personalities."
"But every time the System acts, it never helps the main personality directly wipe us out;
it just uses us as disposable wipes..."
"So what if the main personality dies? Completely disappears?"
"If he dies, will the System still help him?"
"Before, we and the main personality couldn’t directly meet in the inner landscape world like that last time."
"Therefore, none of us could kill the other."
"But now it’s different."
"If next time, the outside world’s main personality—who only retains kind memories—encounters a crisis he can’t resolve, and the System drags us out, then the alternate personality pulled out intentionally pretends to be overwhelmed, causing the full-version main personality to restore."
"Once the full-version main personality enters the inner landscape world."
"All of our alternate personalities strike together and eliminate him."
"And then it’s mission accomplished?"
All of this raced through Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran’s mind.
The more he thought about it, the more plausible it felt.
However, executing this plan posed huge problems.
First: persuading every alternate personality to join.
That alone would be very difficult.
Second: the medication from America that the main personality Jiang Ran had been taking had suppressed several of the most perverse alternate personalities into sleep.
Without those few, could the remaining alternates together eliminate the main personality?
"Oh right—those pills... get rid of all those American meds. Anyway, the main personality doesn’t have much money;
I doubt he can buy them again!!!"
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran abruptly stood up, ready to walk into the room and pour those bottles of American medicine down the toilet.
At that moment.
The System’s voice descended into his mind.
[ Ding! Crisis detected resolved. Alternate personality returning! ]
With a bang.
Jiang Ran’s body collapsed back onto the sofa.
Smoky Makeup Jiang Ran was forcibly pulled back into the inner landscape world.
Round 28, Day 6.
A little after one in the morning.
Jiang Ran woke up holding his head, face contorted in pain.
Upon waking.
He suddenly screamed.
"No! Don’t chase me! Don’t bite me!!!!"
Then Jiang Ran shot up from the sofa, staggering as he nearly fell.
He realized he was no longer at the construction sites but back in his own home.
"Was that a dream?"
Images of being chased by dogs still raced through his mind.
The pain in his butt and the large patches of blood on his body also told him it was not a dream.
Once again, an alternate personality had saved his life.
"Hiss—every time an alternate personality comes out, I lose part of my memory."
This time, Jiang Ran’s memory only went as far as being beset by two dogs and struggling with them.
Everything after that was blank.
Still, he had grown used to it.
"Just wonder how Fang Xiao and the others are doing? Sigh, I should still get my wounds treated at the hospital."
He changed out of his bloody outer clothes and pants.
He left Room 304.
He went down to the first floor of the apartment building.
Stepping outside, the smell of blood hit his nose strongly.
Following the scent to the left side of the building, he saw someone there killing dogs.
The ground was littered with the corpses of several large dogs.
Looking closely, the person was Fang Xiao.
Where he got a big lamp and a water pipe from, Jiang Ran had no idea.
And where was Old Dog?
Jiang Ran didn’t concern himself;
he didn’t want to get involved.
He just wanted to go to the hospital to treat his wounds.
He checked his phone—now it was already two in the morning.
He sighed and looked up at the moon, half-covered by clouds.
He walked to the gate and noticed someone still standing outside the security guard booth.
It was the security guard Xiao Xing.
Seeing him, Jiang Ran asked, "Huh? Are you on the night shift? You haven’t slept yet at this hour?"
Xiao Xing looked at the scattered stars in the night sky and, hearing Jiang Ran, lowered his head and said, "Yes, I’m on the night shift tonight, but I’m also waiting for someone."
Jiang Ran frowned in puzzlement. "Waiting for someone? Like waiting for a delivery?"
He assumed Xiao Xing had ordered food;
otherwise, who could he be waiting for at this hour?
Speak of the devil.
At that moment.
A white van drove out of the darkness and slowly stopped in front of the apartment gate.
A door opened.
A stylishly dressed man in his forties stepped out of the van first.
Honestly, judging by appearance, the man could easily pass for under thirty.
What betrayed him were the composed air about him and the crow’s-feet at his eyes.
Behind him came another man.
This second man also looked under thirty from his appearance.
But compared to the first man, he genuinely looked his age, not like the older man who simply looked young.
And in terms of clothing, he was nothing like the stylish flair of the first.
In fact, most men around him paled in comparison to the first man’s fashion sense.
Xiao Xing warmly opened the face-recognition gate for the first man and ran out to hug him.
The first man accepted the hug and said, "Xiao Xing, I didn’t expect we’d meet again."
Xiao Xing released him and flashed a smile. "I didn’t expect it either. But that just shows our fate."
Jiang Ran watched this scene and still hadn’t figured out who these two were.
Then the second man walked up to him, smiling, and said, "Hello, you must be Assistant Manager Jiang Ran?"
"We’re new tenants. Xiao Zhang told us to come to the apartment first and then get our respective apartment keys from you."
"Oh—keys? They’re on the management office desk on the first floor. You can just take them yourselves."
So it turned out they were new residents;
it was just their arrival time that was creepily late.
Not only creepy.
When Jiang Ran saw the two of them, the Danger Warning System in his head chimed again.
One points +9, the other points +10.
"If there’s nothing else, I’m leaving."
Jiang Ran decided not to deal with all this nonsense;
he needed to go to the hospital to treat his wounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Round 28 Ends — Special Stream After Surviving Four Rounds
chapters.content:
The following period of time might have been unexpected for everyone in the live stream room.
Days 6 and 7 of Round 28 were exceptionally calm.
The situation that many in the live stream room had anticipated, where Old Dog would seek revenge during these last two days, also did not occur.
The lab rats living here passed the time as leisurely as if they were in their own homes.
This resulted in this round ending in an especially bizarre manner.
Round 28, Day 7.
The current time is 23:55.
Only the final five minutes remain before Round 28 concludes.
Many people in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room are eagerly awaiting the end.
Why?Because an unusually high number of lab rats survived this Round 28.
Several of them, in fact!
This was something no one had anticipated.
And with more surviving lab rats, there are more beneficiaries.
Hence, the anticipation.
Time passed.
The final five minutes also elapsed.
The Long-haired beautiful host once again appeared on the live stream screen.
She looked exceptionally beautiful and captivating tonight.
Facing the live stream camera, she revealed her consistently bright and sweet smile:
"Welcome, everyone, gathering at the very end of Round 28, tuning in on time for the broadcast."
"The time has come, representing the conclusion."
"Therefore, I declare that the Round 28 game ends here."
"Next, we will announce the results."
"The results are as follows."
"This round's lab rat casualty list: Ou Yingying and Little Zhao, as well as Zhao Jie."
"This round's surviving lab rat list: Jiang Ran, Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi, Fang Xiao, Wang Jian, Liu Xiaoyu."
"Users who placed bets on the above surviving lab rats will divide the total prize pool of 584.9 million according to their respective betting proportions."
The Long-haired beautiful host announced the final results.
Upon learning the results, the live stream room was filled with a rather cheerful atmosphere.
This was because there were a total of 7 lab rats this round.
Apart from Lab Rat No. 3 Ou Yingying and Little Zhao, and Lab Rat No. 5 Zhao Jie dying, the remaining 5 lab rats all survived perfectly well.
Meaning, in this round, even if you didn't use your brain and bet randomly, you still had an extremely high win rate of five-sevenths.
It could be said that Round 28 of the Hua Country's Alice Apartment Neighbors Over Distant Relatives game had the absolute highest win rate since its broadcast began.
Of course, in a round with such a high win rate, if there were still users who failed their bets, it could only mean your luck was truly abysmal.
Just like the person below.
Child of Fate: "Damn it! 28 rounds! A full 28 rounds! I've placed a bet every single time, and I haven't won even once!!!"
Middle-aged Uncle @ Child of Fate: "Brother, you seem unfamiliar..."
Child of Fate: "I'm not a chatterbox like you all, of course I'm unfamiliar."
Fairy Sister @ Child of Fate: "You really haven't won a single round?"
Child of Fate: "What do you think? Is there any need for me to lie to you?"
Child of Fate sent a screenshot, which was indeed a screenshot of his betting win rate.
I'm Actually a Girl: "Oh my heavens! I can hardly believe it, I almost suspect you photoshopped it!"
Middle-aged Uncle: "Yeah, wanting to not win a single round out of these 28 must be quite difficult, right? And during those consecutive winning rounds of Fang Xiao and Jiang Ran, just betting randomly once wouldn't have led to this! So, Child of Fate, are you intentionally maintaining a 0% win rate?"
Child of Fate typed angrily: "No!"
Middle-aged Uncle: "Then next round, bet on Jiang Ran, and you'll probably win a round!"
Child of Fate: "No! I need to place my bets according to my Celestial Star Big Dipper method!"
Middle-aged Uncle: "Celestial Star Big Dipper? What nonsense is that?"
Child of Fate: "It's a fortune-telling technique I've studied for a long time. Every round, I perform a divination to determine the target of my bet!"
Middle-aged Uncle: ......
Domineering Female CEO: ......
Little Aunt: "Not succeeding once in 28 rounds... honestly, with your level, you should stop learning. I've heard that in metaphysical matters, it also depends on talent and opportunity. You clearly have neither!"
Perhaps feeling provoked, the Child of Fate stopped replying after that.
I'm Actually a Girl: "It's all your fault, you made him so angry he won't talk! But he really is... no, I can't hold back my laughter..."
Middle-aged Uncle: "Alright, alright, let's not talk about him. Let's discuss this round instead! The first 5 days were very exciting! There was something entertaining to watch every day! But the last 2 days were so quiet! I was so bored during the last 2 days that I barely watched the stream!"
"However, the quietness is good too, at least my Ultimate Rich Kid brother survived!"
Domineering Female CEO: "What actually surprised me this round were the two anomalies, Wang Jian and Liu Xiaoyu. I wonder if these two anomalies will participate next round?"
"If they do participate, next round will definitely be even more exciting."
"Especially since Old Dog never took retaliatory action against Fang Xiao. I don't know what he's planning?"
"Also, Kim Yoon-ah still hasn't made a move against Jiang Ran."
Little Dragon Girl: "Yes, the next round will definitely be more exciting!"
Just as these people were discussing how the next round would be more exciting, the Long-haired beautiful host, who had never left the live stream screen, suddenly smiled and said:
"Everyone, I apologize for interrupting your enjoyable conversation, but I must tell you some rather bad news."
People in the live stream room typed: "What news?"
Long-haired beautiful host: "Round 29 will be postponed."
As soon as these words were spoken, the live stream room was in an uproar.
Middle-aged Uncle: "Postponed? What does that mean? Could it be that you're planning to run away? Or is the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room going on hiatus?"
Domineering Female CEO: "Although I usually habitually contradict you, Middle-aged Uncle, now I must strongly support you! After all, there were rounds in the past separated by several months, and they never specifically mentioned being 'postponed'. This time, it's specifically stated. I feel like they are planning to run away."
I'm Actually a Girl: "No! I've only watched a few rounds! How can you be going out of business already?!"
Fairy Sister: "Going out of business? That shouldn't be the case! This is the number one hottest live stream room on the Black Software!"
Little Dragon Girl: "Although it's number one, this live stream room's money-making ability and its expenditures are actually disproportionate."
"Look at other live stream rooms, many are like ordinary external live streams, with tipping functions. But does this one have that? Never."
"Furthermore, the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives game absolutely consumes enormous human, material, and financial resources."
"As said before, the input and output are disproportionate."
"So it wouldn't be strange if it went bankrupt."
I am the Hero: "If it really closes, then my Ultimate Rich Kid brother will be free!!!"
Just as many people in the live stream room were discussing endlessly, the Long-haired beautiful host spoke again: "Everyone, no need to overthink it. Unless the Black Software disappears, the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives game live stream room will absolutely never close."
"What I meant by Round 29 being delayed is because there will be a special live stream next."
The Long-haired beautiful host looked at the large number of people asking in the black tablet in her hand, "What special live stream?"
The Long-haired beautiful host didn't beat around the bush and said directly:
"It's like this."
"For the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives game."
"In the Alice Apartments of each country, whenever a lab rat survives 4 rounds, they will subsequently enter a special live stream."
"It is also because, this time, Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao have reached 4 rounds of survival that the special live stream has been triggered."
"You must be asking, what is the special live stream?"
"Taking our Hua Country as an example."
"They will go to a certain place together with lab rats from other Asian countries who have also reached 4 rounds of survival."
"They will survive there for 7 days, which is equivalent to one round's time."
"During those 7 days, they will still receive 10,000 yuan income per day, but the difference is, after successfully passing this special live stream round and returning to their respective Alice Apartments, surviving 1 day will change from earning 10,000 per day to 20,000 per day."

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Special Stream: Seven-Day Island Getaway
chapters.content:
Everyone in the live stream room immediately understood the meaning of these words.
Simply put, surviving four rounds triggers a special live stream.
The scope of the special live stream has directly been upgraded to the Asian level?
Furthermore, if one successfully endures one round of the special live stream,
the daily money earned for continuing to participate in the game afterwards will increase to 20,000?
Middle-aged Uncle: [Damn! This is interesting! It's no longer limited to one country! But to an entire continent!]
Domineering Female CEO: [Yeah, oh my god, I never knew this before!]
Fairy Sister: [Previously, only Fang Xiao had reached three rounds, and he left after three rounds. This time, Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao survived 28 rounds together, which is exactly 4 rounds. I also never imagined this game could upgrade to an international version...]
Evil Wolf: [If that's the case, the watchability increases dramatically! After all, there are lab rats from other countries! Even if it's just one continent!]
[Hey, wait, going to one place to survive one round, specifically which place? Is it going to the Alice Apartment in another country? Or something else?]The long-haired beautiful host answered at this moment:
"No."
"The location for surviving one round."
"Is on an island in the Pacific Ocean."
"That island has been developed into a resort island with extremely beautiful scenery."
"Similar to the Alice Apartment, which appears to be an apartment complex on the surface, this island also appears to be a resort island on the surface. But behind the scenes, hehehe."
"Next, I'll briefly explain the rules of the special live stream."
"For the special live stream, the number of lab rats entering the island each round."
"Is a minimum of 5, and a maximum of 10."
"Additionally, on the island, there are completely unaware ordinary people, regular tourists, and regular service staff."
"Then."
"On this island."
"There will be 5 to 10 deranged criminals, deranged serial killers."
"So, everyone, listen carefully, the next point is where the rules differ from the Alice Apartment."
"The Alice Apartment gives a lot of freedom to the various so-called deranged criminals and deranged serial killers living inside."
"They are free to kill the lab rats or not;
I believe everyone should have realized this by now."
"After all, everyone should still remember Wang Tao, who was top of his class in school and a white-collar worker in society, who was killed by the clown. He is a typical example;
he lived in the Alice Apartment for a long time but never killed a single lab rat."
"But this island is different. The 5 to 10 deranged criminals on the island."
"Are essentially forced by the organizers."
"The constraint placed on them is that during the 7-day round, either all the lab rats die, or you all die."
These words carried a chilling and vicious tone.
It left many people in the live stream room feeling somewhat incredulous.
Middle-aged Uncle: [So doesn't that mean it's a fight to the death? Either the lab rats live, or these deranged criminals, these deranged serial killers live? Only one side can survive? It's so much more brutal than in the apartment!]
The long-haired beautiful host said at this point: "It is brutal, but that was in the past."
"The rules have changed slightly now."
"The rule changed from only one side being able to survive, to the 5 to 10 deranged criminals, deranged serial killers on the island must kill at least one lab rat during this round to be safe. If they don't kill any, then after the game ends, those who failed to meet the target will be executed by the organizers."
Domineering Female CEO asked curiously: [That still doesn't seem right, what if the number of lab rats and the number of deranged criminals, deranged serial killers on the island don't match? For example, 5 lab rats, 6 deranged criminals, there will always be one deranged criminal who has no one to kill?!]
The long-haired beautiful host replied: "That's fine, if all the lab rats die, it's not the fault of these deranged criminals, deranged serial killers on the island."
"If it's the other situation, 6 deranged criminals, 7 lab rats, the extra one is also fine, because the 6 deranged criminals have already completed the target of killing at least one."
"Alright, that's all I have to say."
"This is also the reason why the 29th round game is delayed;
we need to wait for this special live stream to end before the 29th round live stream can begin."
Middle-aged Uncle immediately spoke again: [I have another question, we only have Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao here, is participation in this special live stream mandatory? If it's not mandatory, what if neither of them participates in this so-called special live stream? Then what?]
Domineering Female CEO: [That's a good point, if they don't participate, then we won't get to see the special live stream... Ah, I really want to see it...]
The long-haired beautiful host saw that more than just these two people were asking such questions.
She smiled and said: "Don't worry, everyone. Although the special live stream indeed does not force lab rats who have survived 4 rounds to participate, as long as sufficient temptation is offered, no one can resist it."
"Hmm... Time is almost up. Next, the live stream room will close in half an hour, so I won't keep everyone company any longer. Please look forward to the next special live stream!"
After the long-haired beautiful host finished speaking, she disappeared from the live stream screen, and thus, the live broadcast switched back to the interior situation of the apartment.
Of course, currently, no one in the live stream room was in the mood to watch the inside of the apartment anymore;
they were all discussing the special live stream.
After all, the people in this live stream room knew that Alice Apartments exist in many foreign countries as well.
But they never imagined that one day, there would be hope to see a special live stream where these Alice Apartments interact with each other.
Middle-aged Uncle: [Since there's an Asian level, there must definitely be a world level too, right?]
Domineering Female CEO: [There must be, but I estimate the conditions for participating in a world-level special live stream must be very difficult. After all, we're at 28 rounds now, and only two lab rats meeting the Asian level standard have appeared...]
[Also, if both Fang Xiao and Jiang Ran participate in this special live stream, I hope they don't die on that island!]
Fairy Sister: [It's hard to say. Since completing the special live stream increases the daily money from 10,000 to 20,000, then the deranged criminals and deranged serial killers selected to go to the island for the special live stream are definitely not ordinary ones.
