After all, the lab rats who can participate in the special live stream have all survived 4 rounds. To put it bluntly, ordinary-level ones can't do anything to these 4-round survivors.]
[Just take Fang Xiao and Jiang Ran for example;
those of average skill wanting to kill them? Simply dreaming!]
I'm Actually a Girl: [So, when we watch the special live stream then, will we still have betting rights?]
Little Dragon Girl: [Definitely, it's a feature of the live stream room, how could it not be there?]
I'm Actually a Girl: [So, when the time comes, do you think we'll watch the stream in our own separate live stream room, or share one live stream room with those wealthy people from other countries?]
Middle-aged Uncle: [That's unclear. Many details will only be known when the special live stream starts.]
I'm Actually a Girl: [So, when the time comes, we should be able to bet on lab rats from other countries too, right? Hey, do you think it would be bad if we bet on lab rats from other countries? After all, we didn't bet on our own country's lab rats!]
Domineering Female CEO: [Don't overthink it. Bet on whoever you want. It doesn't matter. It's just a live stream game.]
[Don't put moral shackles on yourself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 244: Round 28 Ends — Some Leave, While Little Q and Little Peng Visit the Prison
chapters.content:
I'm Actually a Girl: 【Actually, I have another question.】
【I've seen that some live stream rooms on the Black Software, the kind that are a single live stream room but also have people from other countries, are worldwide in scope.】
【However, our Far Neighbor game live stream room is instead divided by country. I want to know, how can we watch the Alice Apartment live streams from other countries?】
Fairy Sister: 【Good question.】
【You can go to the backend right now, talk to customer service, and then you can switch to the Alice Apartment live streams from other countries. But once you switch, it will take 10 years to switch back.】
I'm Actually a Girl: 【Then forget it...】
……
At 12:05 AM.
Lin Feng received a text message on his phone.
The general content of the message was to congratulate him and Wang Ziyi for successfully surviving a round.Only two rounds remained to gain freedom.
Round 28 had ended;
Round 29 had not yet begun.
During this interim period, they could choose to continue living in the Alice Apartment, or they could choose to return to their original residence.
They just needed to come back to the Alice Apartment when Round 29 started broadcasting.
Lin Feng wasn't sleeping at this time;
to put it another way, he had only been lightly sleeping for these 7 days.
He absolutely did not dare to sleep deeply at night, precisely because he was afraid of encountering a situation like Liu Jie's.
Therefore, when his phone received the text message, the message sound directly woke him up.
After reading the entire message, he was both shocked and delighted.
After all, it was his first time being punished as a live stream room user by having to live in the Alice Apartment.
So, he, the Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng, had no idea that the Organizers were actually quite good to people like them who had leaked the game live stream.
They actually didn't have to stay in the apartment during the time when the live stream hadn't started.
Instead, they could return to their own residences.
They only needed to come back when the live stream was on.
This was fantastic!
After all, every second spent in this Alice Apartment felt like being in a den of wolves to him.
Who knows, one day, if he got slightly careless, his life might be gone.
Thus, he felt even more confident about surviving the next two rounds.
Because before the live stream started, he was afraid that the interval between rounds would be too long, and he would still have to keep living here.
Now he didn't have to, it was simply awesome!
He swore, there had been very few times in his life when he felt so excited and happy!
Therefore, being able to leave the apartment, he literally jumped up from the bed.
Compared to Lin Feng, Wang Ziyi was sleeping quite soundly.
But being jolted by this jump, Wang Ziyi was also woken up.
After waking up and seeing Lin Feng's extremely excited appearance, she asked what had happened.
Lin Feng told her about the text message.
Wang Ziyi was first stunned, then found it hard to believe.
Finally, she was wild with joy.
These two, truly a couple, next made an identical decision.
That was, to pack their luggage and run away quickly.
Get away immediately.
The two of them only took fifteen minutes, haphazardly packing and stuffing things into their suitcase.
Then, each carrying a suitcase, they rushed out of the door, closing it behind them.
They took the elevator all the way down to the 1st floor.
They ran frantically out of the Alice Apartment.
They didn't even look back once, as if they had not the slightest bit of attachment to the Alice Apartment.
Time passed minute by minute.
The time reached 8:00 in the morning.
Liu Xiaoyu was also packing her luggage.
Compared to Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi's fleeing in panic.
She was packing slowly.
After all, her situation was completely different from Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi's.
She came in to make money.
She had been here for 7 days and earned 70,000.
Of course, Liu Xiaoyu felt that the biggest gain here wasn't earning this so-called 70,000.
Rather, she had filmed a short film of a human dying.
This was the most precious thing.
On the other side.
10th floor.
"Wang Jian, are you really not going to reconsider and stay here? Become my assistant, help me plan murders together?"
Chen Fei, with his black short hair, leaned against the white wall of the corridor, as casual and self-satisfied as when he first met Wang Jian.
Wang Jian, currently pulling a suitcase, shook his head: "No, the kind of life you're talking about is too crazy, I don't want to experience it."
"Hmm, I hope we meet again someday if fate allows."
Chen Fei watched Wang Jian leave and said this.
Wang Jian smiled on the surface, but inwardly he complained: "I don't want to see you again in this lifetime."
Yes, a murder planning specialist.
If Wang Jian were to meet him again.
There were only two possibilities.
First, asking for his help to plan a murder.
Second, being the person he plans to murder.
Perhaps it was quite a coincidence.
Wang Jian took the elevator and happened to run into Liu Xiaoyu.
Inside the elevator, both of them saw the other's suitcase.
However, because they weren't familiar with each other, they didn't greet each other or anything.
They reached the first floor, dragging their suitcases, the rattling sound appearing on the ground.
Just as they were about to pass through the glass automatic sensor door, a voice suddenly came from the right:
"Welcome to come back to the Alice Apartment next time!"
They looked back but didn't see anyone, yet that voice had just suddenly appeared.
It felt a bit like a horror movie.
……
"Brother, not to be harsh, but it's just not worth it. Look at that Wang Ju, you went all out to get revenge for her, and then what? After she woke up, besides saying thank you to you, what else did she do? Now you're here eating prison food, sitting in jail, while she's found herself another boyfriend outside!!!"
Nancheng City Prison.
Xiao Q and Xiao Peng were visiting a male inmate.
This male inmate was the Tall male student who used to like Wang Ju.
Back then, Wang Ju was kidnapped and assaulted by Lin Shengli.
He also slit Wang Ju's throat, nearly killing her.
In a fit of rage, the Tall male student used a chainsaw to gruesomely disembowel and kill Lin Shengli.
Afterwards, they called the police and an ambulance.
The police also took the Tall male student away.
Because of this, the Tall male student later went through various trials and was finally sentenced to 10 years by the court.
This was still because, first, Lin Shengli was the one who attacked Wang Ju first, committing rape and murder.
Second, the Tall male student committed murder in righteous indignation.
Third, Lin Shengli had no family, he was alone, so there was no family to persistently pursue the Tall male student's punishment.
Of course, the most impressive part was still the Organizers of the Alice Apartment.
They had directly given Lin Shengli a fake identity back then.
Otherwise, for a repeat offender rapist and murderer like Lin Shengli to appear in the Alice Apartment, it would be hard to believe there was no foul play.
Now, about Wang Ju.
Wang Ju was first assaulted, then had her throat slit.
Fortunately, she was sent to the hospital in time. Her life was saved.
Although she was in a coma for a long time, she eventually woke up later.
Even though she woke up and gradually recovered her health.
It would be impossible to say there were no aftereffects.
That is, the area on her neck where her throat was slit often had a dull pain, and her vocal cords were somewhat damaged.
After Wang Ju woke up, she heard from people around her, such as Xiao Hua.
They told her about how the Tall male student had killed the perpetrator who harmed her.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: What Happened After Xiao Q and the Two Others Escaped Alice Apartment
chapters.content:
At first, Wang Ju was deeply touched.
She never expected that a boy would do such a thing for her.
Especially since she never realized the Tall Male Student had a crush on her that ran so deep.
Therefore, after she had mostly recovered physically,
she went to visit the Tall Male Student, who had already been sentenced by the Court and imprisoned.
During their first meeting,
Wang Ju was in tears.
She directly stated that she was willing to become the Tall Male Student's girlfriend and would wait for him to be released.
This made the already imprisoned and emotionally low Tall Male Student extremely excited and happy.
He felt that everything he had done for Wang Ju was worth it.Later, Wang Ju also visited frequently.
However, time is both a kind messenger and an evil demon king.
Gradually, as time passed,
Wang Ju's visits to the Tall Male Student became less and less frequent.
From wishing she could come every day, to only coming once every few weeks.
Finally, she stopped coming altogether...
Later, the Tall Male Student learned from other visitors that after Wang Ju had recovered,
she returned to university and soon met another boy, starting a relationship with him.
Later, some people who knew both the Tall Male Student and Wang Ju felt it was unfair and confronted Wang Ju to demand an explanation.
And what did Wang Ju say?
She said: "Did I ask him to kill that person? No, right?"
"He was the one who acted too impulsively back then. Even if he hadn't killed that person, with so many people present, the perpetrator wouldn't have gotten away. He would have eventually been caught and punished by law anyway!"
"So, I don't owe him anything at all!"
"Besides, he's going to be in prison for so long. Do you really expect me to wait that long for him?"
"Don't you know that a girl's youth is very precious?"
...
The Tall Male Student listened to Xiao Peng recount these words to him.
Essentially, words saying he wasn't worth it, that Wang Ju had found another boyfriend outside.
He forced a strained smile:
"It's nothing. Actually, she isn't wrong for doing this. After all, I'm going to be locked up here for 10 years. It's not wrong for her not to wait for me. She's not wrong..."
Xiao Peng looked at the Tall Male Student's clearly devastated state and wanted to say more, but Xiao Q stopped him.
Signaling him to drop it.
What's the use of saying more?
It can't change the facts that have already happened.
Xiao Peng also knew it couldn't be changed, but he just felt it was so unfair for the Tall Male Student!
Afterwards, the three of them chatted for a while longer.
The visitation time ended.
The Tall Male Student was taken away by the prison guards.
Xiao Q and Xiao Peng told him they would visit again next time. After watching the Tall Male Student's back disappear, they also left the prison and went outside.
Outside the prison.
"His life is pretty much ruined. Even though he's only locked up for 10 years and will be just over thirty when he gets out, which is still relatively young,"
"he didn't even graduate from university, and his record has the black mark of murder and imprisonment, especially missing these prime years from his twenties to thirties. Sigh! Why didn't we stop him back then?!"
After coming out, Xiao Peng kept muttering to himself, chattering incessantly.
Xiao Q didn't complain much.
After all, the Tall Male Student and those others were Xiao Peng's good friends.
They weren't his friends.
His only good friend was Xiao Peng.
Even though he also felt it was quite a pity for the Tall Male Student.
He flew into a rage over his beloved.
But in the end, not only did he ruin himself, but he didn't even get the girl.
"Alright, stop complaining. We have plans today."
As he spoke, Xiao Q hailed a rideshare outside the prison.
Next, the two took the rideshare to a café in the city center.
At that moment, standing outside the café was a scruffy-bearded "Little Zhang Fei."
This Little Zhang Fei was none other than Ke Bei.
After the last incident where Xiao Q and the other two were rescued by Mike, fled all the way, evaded the chainsaw murderer's pursuit, and escaped Alice Apartment,
the three first ran to the hospital.
Why go to the hospital?
Obviously, Xiao Peng had been used as a human cushion twice and was smashed until he coughed up blood.
He definitely needed hospital treatment.
But when they reached the hospital, an awkward situation occurred.
During the days they were imprisoned, they hadn't bathed and had no toilet paper.
All three looked like beggars and were emitting a foul odor.
Furthermore, having just escaped, they had nothing on them;
their phones were still with Su Mi.
No ID cards, no money.
Therefore, they couldn't even enter the hospital.
With no other choice, Xiao Q and Ke Bei could only take Xiao Peng to Ke Bei's previous home nearby first.
At that home,
Ke Bei, being a detective, had a whole stash of backup phones and backup SIM cards.
So, he used a backup phone to contact a doctor he knew well from a hospital.
The doctor was originally resting at home but was summoned by this call.
He drove them to the hospital where he worked.
Only then could Xiao Peng receive treatment.
Afterwards, while Xiao Peng was being treated, the two took the doctor's car back to Ke Bei's external home and took a proper shower.
That shower, after such a long interval, made both instantly appreciate the preciousness of bathing.
Both cried while showering.
Of course, their shower time was also very long.
And even after just one shower, they could still smell the stench emanating from themselves, as if they were thoroughly marinated in foul odor.
In the following period,
fortunately, Xiao Peng's injuries weren't severe, and he recovered and was discharged.
The three resumed the life that normal humans should have.
They also went to get replacement SIM cards and bought new phones.
But what happened next made all three realize the far-reaching influence of the forces behind Alice Apartment.
Because Ke Bei lived alone, during the time he was imprisoned and out of contact by Su Mi,
no one cared about where he had gone.
Therefore, no effort was needed to cover his absence.
As for Xiao Q and Xiao Peng,
after they got out, they learned why no one had looked for them, realized they were missing, or tried to contact them during their imprisonment.
These people included their university classmates, teachers,
and even their own parents, etc.
The reason was simple: a very famous production crew in the country
had approached Xiao Q and Xiao Peng's classmates, teachers, and parents.
They said that Xiao Q and Xiao Peng were participating in a domestic variety show recording session.
Something similar to a survival-in-the-wild type program.
During the recording, they couldn't use electronic communication devices, etc.
They were specially there to notify everyone.
In short, they fabricated reasons, providing ample justification for their disappearance during the imprisonment period.
Therefore, after they escaped Alice Apartment and returned to normal life,
when the two returned to the university campus,
people around them who knew them all asked about the program recording, even expressing envy for their luck, which left them utterly confused.
But the unfortunate part was, even if they were confused, after learning about this situation, they had to pretend that they really did go to record a program.
Why?
Well, what else could they say? Tell them the truth?
That they were imprisoned?
That Alice Apartment is a den of evil?
Who would dare say that?
Who would dare leak it?
Xiao Q and Xiao Peng certainly didn't have the courage, nor would they do such a suicidal thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Seeing Wangchuan Grain Pancake Shop Again
chapters.content:
So, they had to act as if everything was normal.
Of course, that made it hard for the two of them to keep a straight face.
Many classmates had asked them when the show they recorded would air.
They wanted to watch…
Putting those worrying thoughts aside,
the three of them were, for now, effectively free.
They had met up today just to clear their heads,
and to casually talk about plans for the future.
Although the three were meeting at a café in the city,
none of them actually went inside to drink coffee — they walked side by side down the street,chatting as they went.
“Ke Bei, are you still planning to go into Alice Apartment?” Xiao Q asked.
Their formation at the time: Xiao Peng in the middle, Xiao Q and Ke Bei on either side.
Ke Bei said, “Of course I’m going in. My lifelong goal is to find out what happened to my father. I won’t give up until I accomplish that.”
The determination in his voice was as resolute as a man who vows to move two mountains.
Xiao Q said, “I’m wondering if it’s possible your father isn’t in Alice Apartment anymore either — that he, like us, might have escaped?”
Ke Bei shook his head. “If he had escaped, why would he have never contacted me for so long?”
Xiao Peng interjected, “Maybe… he had to go into hiding and couldn’t contact you. Maybe he had no choice.”
Ke Bei sighed.
At this point Xiao Peng said, “Ke Bei, to be honest, I might have to apologize to you. If you insist on going back into that hellhole, I’m not going with you. I really don’t have the courage to go back in.”
“Thinking about it now, we were lucky to end up in Su Mi’s hands. Although we were treated like dogs and locked up, at least we’re alive. If we’d fallen into the hands of those other deranged criminals, we probably wouldn’t be here today.”
Hearing that, Xiao Q — who hoped to become a criminal investigator in the future — felt a chill and shuddered at the thought.
That apartment was full of deranged criminals, serial killers with twisted minds.
They’d only tangled with a few of them,
and already they’d nearly been finished.
If they’d stayed longer and met more of them, they might have died without even knowing how.
To say nothing of it, any one of those twisted killers, taken out on the street, would be a huge catch for the authorities.
That alone showed how terrifying the people inside were.
Ke Bei looked at the two whose faces kept changing and offered a smile:
“Don’t worry. I’ll go in by myself. I never planned to drag you into that danger — it’s not your business.”
Xiao Q and Xiao Peng scratched their heads awkwardly,
feeling a little guilty toward Ke Bei.
But they really didn’t want to go back into that place.
Not unless it became absolutely unavoidable.
Just then,
Xiao Q suddenly pointed ahead. “Xiao Peng, isn’t that your ex, Xiao Hua?”
“And… Wang Ju?”
Xiao Peng looked forward.
At the front of a milk tea shop called Mixue Bingcheng,
two men and two women were buying drinks.
The two women were Xiao Peng’s ex, Xiao Hua, and Wang Ju — the girl who the tall male student had sought revenge for.
The two men beside them were the boyfriend of Wang Ju and the boyfriend of Xiao Hua.
Yes.
After being dumped by Xiao Peng, Xiao Hua still liked him,
but time changes people.
She eventually moved on.
Especially after Xiao Peng stopped replying to her messages,
she resolved to find a new boyfriend.
At that moment, Xiao Q and the others spotted the group of four.
Xiao Hua and Wang Ju naturally noticed them too,
but both parties pretended to be strangers with perfect synchrony.
Ten minutes after they passed each other,
Xiao Q teased Xiao Peng: now that your ex is someone else’s girlfriend, how do you feel?
Xiao Peng, straightforward as ever, didn’t bother pretending. He said bluntly, “I already slept with her, so no loss. I don’t care.”
That shut Xiao Q up instantly.
A loudspeaker voice suddenly cut into their conversation.
“Wangchuan Grain Pancakes! To thank new and old customers, we’re running a promotion!”
“Buy one standard pancake for ten yuan and get a raffle ticket for free!”
“Use the raffle ticket to enter the draw! Prizes are as follows!”
“One grand prize: a seven-day trip to the Macedonian Island in the Pacific!”
“Two second prizes: a JACK car worth 100,000 yuan each!”
“Three third prizes: a JACK electric bike worth 3,999 yuan each!”
“One hundred fourth prizes: 100-yuan Wangchuan Grain Pancake shop vouchers!”
“Come buy pancakes, everyone!!!”
As they drew closer, the three of them could hear the announcement more clearly.
They reached the front and discovered Wangchuan Grain Pancake Shop was holding a buy-and-draw event.
No kidding — a crowd had already formed and the line stretched long.
This Wangchuan Grain Pancake Shop was located right in the city center.
Both Xiao Q and Xiao Peng had bought pancakes from this shop before.
And to be honest, the pancakes were tasty and reasonably priced — not outrageously expensive where ordinary people couldn’t afford them.
Seeing the shop’s promotion and smelling the aroma wafting from inside,
Xiao Peng licked his lips involuntarily and wiped his mouth.
He turned to Xiao Q and Ke Bei: “Let’s go. Buy grain pancakes and try our luck in the draw.”
Xiao Q nodded. “Sure. It’s been a while since I ate these pancakes.”
Ke Bei, unlike the other two, had come to the city center before and passed this pancake shop many times,
but he had never bought anything here.
At first he planned to refuse since the line was so long — if you want grain pancakes, there were other places to get them.
But seeing the other two eager to queue, he didn’t protest and joined them.
Whether by cursed fate or whatnot,
after only a few minutes in line,
they again saw Xiao Hua, Wang Ju, and their boyfriends approaching, each holding a drink from Mixue Bingcheng.
Wang Ju’s boyfriend said, “Hey, look — they’re doing a pancake draw over here. Let’s go try! These pancakes are pretty good, too!”
Xiao Hua’s boyfriend agreed. Both guys wanted to buy some.
Originally Xiao Hua and Wang Ju were about to say yes,
but when they saw Xiao Q and the others in the line,
their expressions changed instantly.
Xiao Hua and Wang Ju’s boyfriends were from the same university as them, but they didn’t know Xiao Q or Xiao Peng personally.
So why did Xiao Hua and Wang Ju act like strangers toward them?
Was it that after a breakup you just couldn’t be friends anymore?
Or did they not want their new boyfriends to know they had ties to Xiao Peng and the others?
No — there was another layer to it.
Xiao Q had always said he was only Xiao Peng’s friend.
They had only met Xiao Hua and the others because of what happened at Alice Apartment.
So the current hostility between them had nothing to do with him.
Xiao Peng was different — he used to hang around with the others a lot.
After escaping Alice Apartment and returning to normal life,
he publicly called out Wang Ju, who had dumped the tall male student and then found someone else.
He criticized her in front of everyone,
and their relationship deteriorated rapidly.
Plus, Xiao Peng and Xiao Hua were bound by that “exes curse,”
and their relationship was no better.
Otherwise, if they had bumped into each other on the street, they wouldn’t have pretended not to know one another.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Winning First Prize, What Amazing Luck!
chapters.content:
Originally, Wang Ju wanted to speak up and find an excuse, saying there were too many people here and that she wanted to eat grain pancakes, suggesting they go buy from another store.
But Xiao Hua grabbed her.
She directly said loudly: "Perfect, Xiao Ju and I also want to eat some now. Let's go, queue up. Maybe we'll have good luck and even win a prize!"
After saying this, the four of them joined the queue, with about seven or eight people between them and the trio of Xiao Q.
Xiao Peng heard Xiao Hua's words.
His face showed extreme disdain.
His relationship with Wang Ju was very bad now anyway.
His relationship with Xiao Hua had also become extremely cold.
Furthermore, Xiao Hua and Wang Ju were as close as sisters.
Especially since Xiao Peng didn't even know that Wang Ju and Xiao Hua had previously conspired to intentionally make Xiao Nuo's relationship with the neighbors of Alice Apartment turn sour.This was evident back when Wang Ju deliberately verbally attacked Wang Tao and also attacked the delivery guy.
It clearly showed how good their relationship was.
Because of this, Xiao Peng had also accused Wang Ju of being ungrateful.
Xiao Hua was definitely unhappy about that;
she would certainly stand by her good sister's side.
After all, Xiao Hua felt Wang Ju did nothing wrong.
At that time, it was entirely the Tall Male Student's own fault for losing control and killing Lin Shengli.
Why should Wang Ju wait such a long time for him outside while he served his prison sentence?
These were a girl's most precious years!
It was the combination of all the above reasons.
That led to Xiao Peng feeling disdain in his heart when he heard Xiao Hua's words.
He thought Xiao Hua was like an idiot.
He wanted to buy pancakes purely because he felt like eating them, smelled the aroma, and his craving was triggered.
He never actually thought he could really win a prize.
But what about Xiao Hua?
His ex-girlfriend actually still delusionally hoped to win the first prize?!
Haha, that's hilarious. If she could win even the fourth prize, it would be like their ancestors showing divine favor and her burning abundant incense!!!
Soon enough.
The queue reached the trio of Xiao Q.
He pulled out a lottery ticket and handed it to the young female shop assistant. She used a metal tool to help him scratch off the coating.
Soon, the prize was revealed.
The four characters 【Thank You for Your Patronage】 were all too familiar.
Xiao Peng wasn't surprised at all by this.
The second was Xiao Q, and the third was Ke Bei.
Both also ordered one 10-yuan pancake each.
After Xiao Q got his grain pancake, he also drew one ticket from the blind box.
Then he let the young female shop assistant scratch it for him.
Clearly, his luck wasn't great either.
It was also just a "Thank You for Your Patronage".
Finally, it was Ke Bei's turn.
Of course, whether it was Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, or even Ke Bei, none of them took this last drawing chance seriously.
Ke Bei casually pulled one ticket out of the blind box and handed it to the young female shop assistant.
After handing it over, he was ready to leave, not even waiting for the result to be revealed.
He probably also thought he would definitely get "Thank You for Your Patronage".
But!
Perhaps Heaven always likes to give people surprises!
Just as the three of them were about to leave, the young female shop assistant suddenly stood up and shouted excitedly: "You won! You won!!!"
Xiao Q and the other two instantly turned around in shock, asking in unison: "Won what?"
Other customers waiting to buy grain pancakes also pricked up their ears.
At that moment, a high school student in the queue joked: "Probably passed the imperial exam, just like Fan Jin."
Hearing this, laughter erupted from the queuing crowd.
But one voice interrupted the laughter.
It was a middle-aged man. Patting his beer belly, he looked very puzzled: "Eh, why is everyone laughing? I know about passing the imperial exams, they show it in TV dramas, but who is Fan Jin?"
This was just a minor interlude.
Returning to the window, the young female shop assistant respectfully presented the winning lottery ticket with both hands:
"Congratulations! You've won the first prize! A seven-day trip to Pacific Macedonia Island!"
Hearing this.
Xiao Q and the other two were completely petrified.
They all thought they had misheard.
It wasn't until Ke Bei took the lottery ticket, and the three of them stared at each other wide-eyed for a long time, that they realized it was true!!!
"Awesome! We won!!! And it's the first prize!!!!!"
Xiao Peng was so happy he almost jumped up.
This loud celebratory shout was ridiculously loud, attracting the attention of many other people on the street.
Of course, if this had happened before, even if Xiao Peng had won this prize, he wouldn't have shown his excitement so exaggeratedly.
His exaggerated performance today was purely to anger his ex-girlfriend, to show off to his still-queuing ex-girlfriend Xiao Hua!!!
Over there, hearing that Xiao Peng and the others had won a prize.
Xiao Hua's face naturally turned very ugly, instantly falling and drooping.
Seeing his girlfriend unhappy, Xiao Hua's boyfriend quickly comforted her: "It's okay, there's still the second and third prizes, right? They are also pretty good."
Originally, after winning the prize, Xiao Q's trio should have entered the Wangchuan Grain Pancakes shop to claim the prize and discuss the follow-up matters for this first prize.
But Xiao Peng refused. He pulled the other two and stayed right at the entrance, standing there, eating their pancakes, smiling as they watched the foursome of Xiao Hua.
This smile contained both smugness and showing off.
Soon, the queue reached the foursome of Xiao Hua.
The four of them.
First, Wang Ju bought a pancake and then drew a prize.
She, like Xiao Q and Xiao Peng, was accompanied for life by "Thank You for Your Patronage".
Next, Wang Ju's boyfriend drew a prize. Well, also "Thank You for Your Patronage".
Then it was Xiao Hua's turn.
While Xiao Hua was drawing a prize from the blind box, Xiao Peng, who never smacked his lips while eating, deliberately ate his grain pancake, making loud smacking sounds.
Xiao Hua pulled out a lottery ticket from the blind box.
She handed it to the young female shop assistant.
She prayed inwardly that she must win some prize.
Any prize would do.
Just don't let it be too embarrassing.
But, Heaven just wouldn't let her have her wish;
she also got "Thank You for Your Patronage".
Xiao Peng immediately laughed exaggeratedly, clutching his stomach.
Seeing this, Xiao Hua stopped pretending not to know him.
She directly shouted loudly: "Xiao Peng, you have the nerve to laugh at me? Weren't you also 'Thank You for Your Patronage'? That first prize wasn't even drawn by you!!!"
Hearing this, Xiao Peng raised his chin arrogantly: "So what if it wasn't drawn by me? My friend drawing it is the same as me drawing it! If you have the ability, get your boyfriend to draw one too?!"
Xiao Hua was so angry she couldn't speak. Her hands were clenched into fists, hanging at her sides, trembling continuously.
Trembling with anger.
She turned around, wanting to tell her new boyfriend to finish buying the pancake and leave quickly.
She never wanted to see her annoying ex-boyfriend again.
But when she turned around, she found that her new boyfriend had been standing by the prize-drawing blind box the whole time.
Not moving a muscle, and with his eyebrows furrowed together.
Moreover, the young female shop assistant at the window looked utterly confused and perplexed.
Xiao Hua realized something must have happened, so she walked over to ask.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Two First Prizes?
chapters.content:
"Darling, I have good news and bad news. Which do you want to hear first?"
Xiao Hua's boyfriend turned and asked her as she walked over.
Xiao Hua said, "Both, just tell me quickly."
Xiao Hua's boyfriend said, "The good news is I won a prize, the bad news is I won the first prize."
Xiao Hua: ???
"First prize?! Oh my god, that's not bad news at all!!! That's great news! How could that possibly be bad news?!"
Xiao Hua was ecstatic. She immediately turned to her ex-boyfriend Xiao Peng and said, "Thank you for your golden words! My boyfriend actually won a prize."
Xiao Hua originally wanted to use this opportunity to triumph over Xiao Peng.
But she noticed Xiao Peng's expression seemed off.
Logically speaking, Xiao Peng's expression should have turned ugly at this moment.So why did he look so gleeful, like he was watching a fool?
Xiao Hua had dated Xiao Peng for a long time, so she knew his every habit intimately - she could even tell what he was thinking just by how he farted.
Therefore, she felt something was very wrong, but what exactly?
"Xiao Hua, look at this sign. There's only one first prize, two second prizes, and three third prizes..."
At that moment, Wang Ju leaned close to Xiao Hua's ear and quietly revealed the truth about what was wrong.
Hearing this, Xiao Hua's face turned very ugly.
She immediately grumbled, "What's going on here? This shop is so unprofessional! How could there be two first prize tickets in the blind box?!"
"So what do we do now?"
Yes, what should they do now?
Two people had both drawn the first prize.
Not just these people, but even those waiting in line had gotten wind of this drama and were waiting to see how the pancake shop would handle it.
Xiao Peng spoke up at this point, "No matter how they handle it, our first prize definitely counts."
"Because we drew it first."
"As for you guys?"
"Tsk tsk tsk, I'm afraid you're out of luck!"
"But it's okay, even if you can't get the first prize, you'll probably still get second or third prize! After all, this is the shop's mistake!"
Xiao Peng's sarcastic tone didn't just anger Xiao Hua.
Even his own companions Xiao Q and Ke Bei couldn't help but think: What a smug little man.
So Xiao Hua was trembling with anger again.
At this moment, the young female clerk came out from the shop. She bowed apologetically to Xiao Hua's group, "I'm very sorry about this mistake. I can't handle it, so we have to wait for the manager to come."
"And you folks who also drew the first prize need to wait for the manager to arrive to claim your prize."
"Would you all like to wait inside the shop?"
Just as Xiao Peng's and Xiao Hua's groups were about to enter the shop to wait.
Suddenly a voice came from far to near: "No need, I'm here!!!!"
They saw an extremely dashing figure riding a black motorcycle suddenly drift right in front of them with a screech.
After arriving, the figure got off the black motorcycle.
Then removed the black helmet.
Revealing his true face to everyone.
To be honest, some people really should keep their helmets on.
Before removing the helmet.
This figure gave off a very handsome, very cool impression.
After taking it off, that illusion was instantly shattered.
This was an extremely ordinary-looking middle-aged man.
The gap between his actual appearance and what people imagined was too large.
But regardless of whether he matched expectations or not.
This middle-aged man was indeed the manager of this Wangchuan Grain Pancakes shop.
If Jiang Ran were here, he would probably recognize him.
Because when Jiang Ran won that apartment at Alice Apartment, it was this manager he claimed the prize from.
Right now, this middle-aged manager stood at the shop entrance, waving his hand grandly with great momentum.
"I've already heard about the situation!"
"There were two first prize tickets in the blind box, and both got drawn!"
"This is truly our mistake! Therefore!"
"You customers over here drew first, right?"
The middle-aged manager looked toward Ke Bei's group.
Ke Bei nodded.
"So your first prize is definitely valid!"
Hearing this, Xiao Peng became even more smug.
He practically had his tail sticking up to the sky, though of course he didn't actually have a tail.
And based on the manager's words: "So your first prize is definitely valid."
Didn't that imply that Xiao Hua's first prize would be invalid, probably replaced with some other prize?
Not just Xiao Peng's trio or Xiao Hua's quartet, but even the other people in line could tell what this implied.
At this moment, the middle-aged manager turned to Xiao Hua's group of four, "So you're the ones who drew the second first prize?"
Xiao Hua's boyfriend nodded, "It was me."
The middle-aged manager said, "Because our shop only set up one first prize, so..."
Everyone could anticipate what would come next.
Probably that the first prize would become second prize, or even third prize.
More shamelessly, they might say this first prize ticket didn't count at all.
After all, some merchants really know how to screw people over.
But what happened next surprised everyone.
They heard the middle-aged manager say:
"So actually, this matter is our responsibility to begin with, therefore, your first prize also counts!"
"We will honor your prize too!!!!"
Whoa!
The whole crowd was shocked.
No one expected this outcome.
Xiao Hua was especially surprised. She quickly had her boyfriend pinch her arm to wake her up and confirm this wasn't a dream.
But when her boyfriend actually pinched her, she complained, "You actually pinched me for real?"
But despite that, the joy of winning first prize overwhelmed everything.
Only Xiao Peng pouted, looking quite unhappy.
"Alright everyone, please come inside to discuss the prize claim procedure!"
The middle-aged manager invited both Xiao Peng's and Xiao Hua's groups into the shop.
Just as they had one foot inside the door, they heard the middle-aged manager suddenly turn around and announce passionately to the people in line and nearby onlookers:
"Everyone, if any of you draw a first prize later due to our shop's responsibility! We will honor your prize just like this time! This applies to second and third prizes too - if similar situations occur, we'll handle them the same way!"
After this announcement, both those in line and the onlookers burst into applause.
Everyone cheered and praised the shop.
Instantly, the crowd buying grain pancakes became larger and more frenzied.
One person actually bought ten at once...
Suddenly, at this moment, Xiao Q and Ke Bei, who had been relatively quiet until now, exchanged glances.
They smiled simultaneously.
Originally they thought the extra first prize was truly an accident.
But suddenly, both of them felt that this might actually be a marketing tactic...
Of course, it was still an accident, just one that was artificially created...
Inside the shop.
Both groups were led by the young female clerk to an office on the second floor of the pancake shop. This was the manager's office.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: More and More People — Seven-Day Survival Tour on the Haunted Island
chapters.content:
This office was quite ordinary.
When the middle-aged man manager also entered the office, he casually closed the door behind him.
Immediately afterwards, they heard him say:
"You have all won the first prize."
"The first prize is a seven-day trip to Macedonia Island in the Pacific Ocean."
"Let me first introduce this seven-day trip."
"For these seven days, the round-trip transportation costs, the hotel accommodation fees on Macedonia Island, the food expenses, and the activities available on Macedonia Island, such as diving and sea fishing, are all covered by us."
"Furthermore, this first prize, the seven-day trip, can accommodate up to four people."
"That means it's configured for a family of four, or friends, relatives, and so on. It's up to you, but it cannot exceed four people."
"Does everyone understand?"After saying all this.
The middle-aged man manager smiled as he scanned everyone in the office.
His words left everyone present utterly shocked.
Because everyone there had initially thought that this seven-day trip was just for the person who won the prize to go and have fun.
Only one person.
But they never expected it could be up to four people?
Is this still a typical unscrupulous domestic business?
At this moment, Xiao Hua's group was the most pleasantly surprised.
Because if it was for four people, their group happened to have exactly four people.
As for Xiao Peng's side, they only had three people and were short one person.
After finishing his speech, the middle-aged man manager continued, "Please add my contact information. We need to start preparing in the next couple of days. Matters like passports and visas will be handled by our shop. So, I hope you can quickly decide how many people are going and who is going."
Next, the people in the office chatted with the middle-aged man manager for over ten minutes.
They discussed the specific details.
When it was about enough.
They left.
Wangchuan Grain Pancakes shop.
After Xiao Hua's group of four came out, they left directly.
They had already started discussing the specific itinerary for their trip.
Watching the four members of Xiao Hua's group leave.
Xiao Peng's face darkened;
he suddenly felt that some shops being too conscientious wasn't necessarily a good thing.
Xiao Hua's four really got a great deal.
"By the way, Xiao Q and Xiao Peng, I won't be going on this seven-day trip. You two should take your girlfriends!"
The three of them had also left the vicinity of the pancake shop by now.
Just after leaving, Ke Bei said this.
Hearing this.
Xiao Peng immediately said, "How can that be? You were the one who won the first prize! If you don't go and only we go, we wouldn't feel right about it!"
"Besides, you overestimate me and Xiao Q. Where would we get girlfriends?"
Xiao Q was a perpetually single guy.
As for him, Xiao Peng, his ex-girlfriend Xiao Hua had found a new boyfriend.
His current girlfriend, Xiao Nuo, had died at the hands of the Dog Man.
He was currently in a single period.
Xiao Q also tried to persuade Ke Bei at this moment: "Yes, Ke Bei, come with us! Just treat it as going to relax! Think about it, an island! So beautiful, the air must be great! And most importantly, it's completely free!"
"We know you're still worried about your father's disappearance, but worrying won't solve the problem!"
"Don't forget, the three of us just narrowly escaped death, locked up by that Su Mi for so many days. This time, let's consider it as 'surviving a great disaster, sure to have good fortune later'! This is clearly a benefit given to us by heaven!"
"If you don't accept a benefit given by heaven, be careful that heaven gets angry and deliberately causes trouble for you, making everything go wrong!"
"Alright then... I'll go..."
Ke Bei was persuaded.
Mainly, he didn't want to disappoint the other two's goodwill.
Xiao Peng then said, "The maximum number is four people, and we only have three on our side. Should we bring one more person? Otherwise, it would be a waste, and wasting is shameful! Especially since what we'd be wasting isn't a small amount of money!"
Yes, how much would the total cost of the seven-day trip be per person?
So, we absolutely must bring one more person.
Ke Bei said, "I don't have anyone else to bring. You guys find someone!"
Xiao Peng scratched his head;
he had many friends.
But after the Xiao Nuo incident, among his friends, some had died, some were injured, and all were badly frightened.
He wasn't sure why, but he felt that his few surviving friends were intentionally or unintentionally isolating him.
He didn't understand at first, but later found out that those friends felt that the reason they encountered those events last time...
Was all because of Xiao Nuo.
And since he was Xiao Nuo's boyfriend, so...
"I don't have anyone I want to bring either..."
Xiao Peng shook his head, suddenly realizing that he seemed quite pitiful, with seemingly very few true friends.
Therefore, Xiao Peng and Ke Bei both looked at Xiao Q.
After careful consideration, Xiao Q said, "I originally wanted to bring my cousin, but my uncle would definitely not agree. In that case..."
"Oh, oh, right, that guy is returning to the country tomorrow! Let's bring him along!!!"
Xiao Peng was puzzled: "Who? Your sweetheart from abroad?"
Xiao Q said speechlessly, "He's male."
"Hmm... you could say he's my childhood friend. We get along quite well."
"His father started doing business later and became successful."
"Then, his father sent him abroad to study in his first year of high school."
"Now, he's also in university."
"Of course, we've kept in touch all along."
Xiao Peng was stunned: "Damn, those wretched rich second generation. Which country did he go to study in?"
Xiao Q: "If I remember correctly, it should be the UK!"
Xiao Peng said: "The UK? I heard the Chinese student circle in the UK is the most chaotic!"
Xiao Q said: "I'm just going to try asking him. If he doesn't want to come, then there's no other way. It'll just be the three of us! Or we can find someone else."
...
Alice Apartment.
"Oh, you're saying that if I go to this Macedonia Island in the Pacific Ocean to play for seven days, and after spending these seven days, when I return to Alice Apartment, the money I can get daily will increase to twenty thousand? And also, for the seven days spent on the island, I will still get ten thousand per day?"
Fang Xiao's home.
Fang Xiao was in the living room eating dog meat hot pot and drinking ice-cold beer.
The living room air conditioner was continuously blowing cold air.
The scalding heat of the dog meat hot pot entering his stomach, combined with the circulation of cold air.
It was like experiencing extreme heat and cold simultaneously, feeling absolutely fantastic.
At this moment, looking at the agreement document handed to him by a middle-aged man in a black suit sitting across the table, he glanced at it and voiced the doubt in his heart.
The middle-aged man in the black suit nodded: "Yes, that's correct."
"So, are you willing to sign this agreement?"
Fang Xiao smiled, asked the middle-aged man in the black suit for a pen,
and then immediately signed his name on the agreement.
After signing, he said with a smile, "Perfect, I felt that ten thousand a day wasn't enough to spend, but twenty thousand a day should be just about right."
The middle-aged man in the black suit took the signed agreement, looked at it, confirmed it was correct, and curled his lips into a slight smile.
Then, he asked Fang Xiao, "Fang Xiao, you signed so readily, aren't you going to ask more about other details?"
Fang Xiao shook his head: "No need. Just like when you first found me and we signed the first agreement, I only need to know the general idea and that I'll get money. As for what's hidden behind it all, I'm not concerned."
The middle-aged man in the black suit stood up, patted Fang Xiao on the shoulder:
"Then I wish you a pleasant seven-day trip to Macedonia Island in the Pacific Ocean."
With these words, he strode out of Fang Xiao's home.
Before he left, Fang Xiao asked, "Won't you stay and have some dog meat before you go?"
The middle-aged man in the black suit smiled slightly and shook his head: "No thanks, this dog might have eaten human flesh;
I couldn't stomach it."

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Master Nie, Little Nie, the Installer — Security Door Delivery Has Arrived
chapters.content:
The middle-aged man in the black suit, after leaving Fang Xiao's home, went to the first floor and turned his head to look toward the management office.
He discovered that inside the management office, Jiang Ran was lying on the bed taking an afternoon nap.
He glanced at Jiang Ran and smiled faintly.
As the person responsible for signing agreements with various lab rats,
like Fang Xiao, he was the one who initially signed him, and any subsequent agreements Fang Xiao signed were also handled by him.
For example, this seven-day trip to Macedonia Island.
Jiang Ran, however, was completely different.
Because Jiang Ran didn't enter by signing an agreement.
He came in by winning a prize from buying a multigrain pancake.
Therefore, his seven-day trip to Macedonia Island would be arranged through another method....
1:00 PM.
Jiang Ran was still sleeping.
It must be said, Jiang Ran's job as a temporary manager was too comfortable.
He got paid even for sleeping.
Moreover, in the apartment building, he could sleep openly without fear of someone reporting him;
this was simply the ultimate dream job for any worker.
Of course, anyone who wasn't afraid of dying could come to work at Alice Apartment in Nancheng City.
At this moment, while he was immersed in a beautiful dreamland,
suddenly the ringing of the phone woke him up.
Jiang Ran's phone ringtone was very ordinary, the crisp electronic female voice that came with the phone:
[La la la la, there's a call, there's a call.]
If you don't answer, it keeps repeating.
Unless you answer or hang up.
Jiang Ran was awakened by the phone and answered the call.
He spoke with the voice on the phone for about two minutes before hanging up.
It was a delivery call.
Remember the Grade A security door and tempered glass windows purchased earlier?
They had now been delivered, and the courier was calling to ask if Jiang Ran was home.
So they could deliver them to his door.
They also told Jiang Ran to use the purchase platform to contact an installation technician himself.
Perhaps it was fate.
The security door and tempered glass windows Jiang Ran purchased were from different manufacturers and shipped from different locations.
But they ended up being sent by the same delivery company and arrived at the same time.
About twenty minutes later.
Jiang Ran saw a delivery truck drive into Alice Apartment and stop in front of the apartment building.
Jiang Ran walked up, communicated with the couriers, inspected the goods, and signed.
After completing these tasks, he worked together with the two couriers, using their delivery cart, to make several trips transporting the security door and the custom tempered glass windows to the living room of Room 304.
After the delivery was finished, the two couriers drove away to continue delivering other packages.
So now, all that was left was to wait for the installation technician to arrive.
After waiting about thirty minutes.
Jiang Ran received another call and went to the entrance to meet the installation technician.
He asked the security guard in the security guard booth to open the gate for them.
After the gate opened, the minivan driven by the installation technician came in and parked right at the apartment entrance.
Then, two installation technicians got out of the vehicle.
One was a middle-aged man who looked quite weathered.
He wasn't tall, around 1.6 meters.
His clothing was very simple and plain.
The other was a young guy.
He looked no older than twenty.
Although his clothes were also quite ordinary, his hairstyle was well done, clearly carefully maintained.
At the same time, this young guy had an air of recklessness about him.
After the two got out of the car.
The middle-aged man said to Jiang Ran: "Shall we go install the security door and windows now?"
Jiang Ran nodded.
Then he took the two to the third floor via the elevator.
During the elevator ride, through conversation, he learned.
That young guy who was under twenty, specifically 19 years old, wasn't an installation technician at all.
He was the son of the weathered middle-aged man beside him.
The weathered middle-aged man was the actual installation technician.
As for why the weathered middle-aged man brought his son along while working,
the weathered middle-aged man was quite talkative and explained his son's situation.
The gist was that his son previously lived with his grandparents in their hometown and went to school there.
Because there were too many hoodlums in the hometown who were bad influences.
His son ended up learning from those people and went astray.
He didn't study properly, always skipping classes or getting into relationships.
Especially when it escalated to getting a female classmate pregnant.
The other parents came to the school.
That's when this old father found out.
The outcome was quite simple.
This old father paid for the abortion and an additional 50,000 yuan for emotional damages before the matter was considered settled.
Of course, his son and that female classmate definitely couldn't stay at their original school.
They could only transfer.
His son transferred to a school with even more problematic students and hoodlums.
What happened next was even worse.
His son actually joined others in harassing women and was sent to a juvenile detention center for several months.
After learning about this, the weathered middle-aged man, to prevent his son from getting worse, simply withdrew his son from school.
After withdrawing him, he brought his son to live with him, having him learn these skills as a trade.
This weathered middle-aged man's surname was Nie. Jiang Ran called him Master Nie, and his son Jiang Ran called him Little Nie.
Little Nie was very unhappy hearing his dad tell Jiang Ran about these disgraceful life experiences and complained, asking his dad why he tells everything to others?
Master Nie's response was quite something.
Basically, if you dared to do it, don't blame him for talking about it.
If you had the ability, do something good, and he would definitely spread your good reputation.
Jiang Ran watched from the side, feeling that there must be plenty of conflict between this father and son.
They probably argued frequently.
However, this kind of father-son dynamic like Master Nie and his son Little Nie
was quite common, not rare at all.
At this point, Jiang Ran opened the door to his home, Room 304, and brought Master Nie and Little Nie inside.
After entering, Little Nie looked around Jiang Ran's home and smacked his lips: "Jiang Ran, you're really rich! Your home is quite luxurious!"
Jiang Ran just smiled, didn't answer him, and instead said to Master Nie:
"Master Nie, the door and glass windows are all here."
Master Nie put down the large tool bag he was carrying, placing it to the side.
He pulled out a few tools from it and said: "Alright, leave it to me."
Master Nie planned to install the security door first, then work on the glass windows.
First, he took a look at Jiang Ran's current security door.
After examining it carefully for a moment, he asked Jiang Ran with confusion:
"Hey, isn't this security door perfectly fine? Why replace it?"
Jiang Ran said: "It's because of the thief a few nights ago, otherwise I wouldn't be replacing this security door or the windows."
Master Nie suddenly understood: "No wonder."
"But thieves these days are very skilled. If it's the kind that specializes in this line of work, even if you live on the 10th floor, thieves can still get in, and by climbing up too."
Master Nie started working.
As soon as he started working, he called over Little Nie, who was touring Jiang Ran's home:
"Little Nie, come over quickly! Time to work!!"
Little Nie was currently captivated by the ancient beautiful lady kite made by Wang Nuli, the kite serial killer, which was in Jiang Ran's living room.
He stared at this ancient beautiful lady kite, his eyes revealing unconcealed greed:
"What a beautiful woman! It's a shame she's just a kite. If only there were such a beautiful woman in real life!"

chapters.title: Chapter 251: Xiao Nie and Qin Kelian — Prey That Walked Right into Their Trap
chapters.content:
Smack!
Little Nie, who had just been greedily admiring the beauty of the ancient lady kite, was probably fantasizing in his mind about getting intimate with the lifeless object before him.
But then his old father walked right over and slapped him on the back of the head.
Truly, one slap scattered his lustful spirit—Dad, I'm your son!
"You brat, what's always going through that head of yours? You can't even spare a kite?"
"Even if there were girls this beautiful in the real world, let me tell you, they wouldn't look twice at a loafer like you!"
Little Nie didn't get angry after being slapped on the head by his father.
But when he heard his father's words, he became furious.
"Dad, what kind of talk is that? What do you mean they wouldn't look at a loafer like me? Do you know how many girls admired me at school?"
"Let me tell you, I'm definitely going to find a beautiful wife someday, and make you eat your words!!!"Little Nie shouted with extreme indignation.
Master Nie looked at Little Nie with genuine disappointment at his failure to meet expectations.
He was somewhat angry: "Enough, stop bragging. I'm really afraid you'll catch syphilis or AIDS someday."
"Come over here and help."
Grabbing Little Nie by the ear with his right hand, Master Nie brought him over to start dismantling the original security door at Jiang Ran's home.
Master Nie had probably dismantled plenty of security doors and was very skilled at it.
His son, however, was dawdling and even messed up when handing over tools.
For example, when Master Nie asked his son to bring an adjustable wrench, the kid pulled out a pair of pliers from the tool bag...
But with Master Nie's professional skill, this security door was quickly removed.
After removal, they began installing the new door Jiang Ran had bought online.
"Young man, this door you bought is quite good!"
After tearing off the protective foam from the security door, Master Nie saw the door Jiang Ran had purchased.
Master Nie asked Jiang Ran how much he paid for the door.
Jiang Ran replied it was over ten thousand.
Master Nie said: "For a Grade A Security Door, you can actually get one for over a thousand, but those kinds barely meet the passing standard for Grade A. Yours, costing over ten thousand, is among the upper tier of Grade A doors."
Master Nie quickly installed the new security door.
After installation, he had Jiang Ran inspect it.
Jiang Ran checked it over.
He discovered that compared to the previous security door, this one had an additional feature.
It could use the camera on the smart lock outside to replace the peephole.
He could see outside the door on the screen inside.
"Master, this door should be able to keep out burglars, right?"
After finishing his inspection, Jiang Ran asked Master Nie.
Master Nie smiled and said: "Since ancient times, locks have always been designed to keep out honest people, not villains."
"Your security door cost over ten thousand, so it's definitely safer than those costing a few thousand."
Then, Master Nie prepared to replace the windows Jiang Ran had bought.
He originally called Little Nie over to continue helping.
But Little Nie said: "Dad, I'm going out for a smoke, my nicotine craving is acting up."
Master Nie originally wanted to say he should finish the work first.
At that moment, Jiang Ran stepped forward and said: "Let him smoke, so you don't end up arguing again. I'll assist you."
Master Nie sighed: "Sorry you have to see this. Ah, this son of mine really gives me no peace."
"People talk about hoping their sons become dragons and all that, but in this lifetime, I just hope my son—forget becoming a dragon or achieving great things—can live a stable life, marry a wife, and have children. That would be enough for me."
"Just please, don't do any more unlawful things."
Little Nie walked out of Room 304, planning to smoke a cigarette by the corridor window to satisfy his nicotine craving.
This was the smoking freedom he had fought for after intense arguments with his father.
His father could control other aspects of his life, but not his smoking.
Master Nie was also clever about it—anyway, I won't give you money to buy cigarettes, so if you can manage to buy them yourself, go ahead.
Little Nie started walking toward the window in the third-floor corridor.
He pulled out a lighter and a 10-yuan pack of Hongtashan cigarettes from his left pants pocket.
He took one out and held it between his lips.
Just as he was about to light it.
The hand holding the lighter froze in mid-air.
Not just that hand.
Even the rest of his body seemed to have been immobilized by a paralysis spell.
He stood motionless like a statue.
The only part of his entire body that was moving was his eyes.
Clearly, he had seen something that caused this reaction.
So, what did he see?
He saw a woman emerging from Room 303—completely snow-white, glowing white, with a great figure, wearing sexy clothing, and super beautiful to boot.
Holy shit, this was truly the most beautiful woman he had ever seen in real life!
This was for real!
"The big city is really better! The women are so beautiful! They're completely incomparable to the women from that godforsaken place I call home!"
Little Nie couldn't help but marvel in his heart.
Although Nancheng City wasn't exactly a major metropolis, it still wasn't something his hometown could compare to.
Of course, in truly large cities with many migrants.
They gather who knows how many beautiful girls.
You might go out once, take the subway.
And feel like you've fallen in love countless times.
After being dazed by the beautiful sight, Little Nie lit his cigarette, the yellow-red ember burning at the filter.
He put the lighter back in his pants pocket and prepared to go strike up a conversation.
Inferiority complex is a psychology many people have.
For many innocent young virgins.
They might see a beautiful woman and not even think about approaching her.
If a beautiful woman just came over to ask them a few questions, they'd struggle to speak coherently in response.
But Little Nie was different—he possessed a bizarre, extreme self-confidence.
It was as if he felt extremely good about himself, believing all girls would be captivated by his charm and conversation skills.
The woman who came out of Room 303 was the younger sister of the Demoness sisters—Qin Kelian.
Qin Kelian had come out to get some fresh air on the rooftop and enjoy the view.
But as soon as she closed the door, she instinctively noticed a lecherous gaze fixed on her.
Then, she looked toward the direction of that lecherous gaze.
She discovered a young man with his left hand in the pocket of his blue-green jeans.
His right hand held a cigarette between his index finger, middle finger, and thumb, continuously moving the cigarette in and out of his mouth.
Each time the cigarette came out, his mouth would blow out a large cloud of smoke, making himself appear extremely suave.
As if he were the descendant of dragons.
"Hello, beautiful."
Little Nie stopped when he was about one meter away from Qin Kelian.
While beginning to converse with Qin Kelian, Little Nie continued smoking incessantly.
Especially since he deliberately blew smoke in Qin Kelian's direction.
Qin Kelian stared at Little Nie, particularly at this action of blowing smoke toward her.
On the surface, she maintained a smiling face, but inside, it felt as if countless sharp knives had appeared.
Wanting to viciously stab the boy before her to death.
She, Qin Kelian, hated it most when people smoked, especially when it made her breathe secondhand smoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: Xiao Nie’s Death Countdown
chapters.content:
Therefore, Qin Kelian immediately made a decision in her heart.
This man before her was dead.
"Is there something you need?"
It was also for this reason that Qin Kelian began fishing.
"Oh, nothing much, I just think you're very beautiful and want to get to know you."
"By the way, my surname is Nie, people call me Little Nie, you can call me Little Nie too."
After saying this, Little Nie leaned against the white wall opposite Qin Kelian.
Still maintaining that cool, smoking pose.
Feeling extremely good about himself.
Qin Kelian examined Little Nie before her and said: "My name is Qin Kelian.""As for wanting to get to know me? Well, may I ask if you're a resident living here? If you live here, as neighbors, I could get to know you."
Little Nie smiled upon hearing this: "Well, sorry about that, beautiful, I don't live here."
"See over there? Room 304, I came with my dad to install security doors and windows for someone named Jiang Ran over there."
Suddenly hearing Jiang Ran's name, Qin Kelian truly didn't expect it.
But it didn't matter, no big deal.
Immediately after, she put on a helpless expression:
"Well then, I'm sorry, since you're not a resident here, I have no reason to get to know you."
Little Nie took out his phone upon hearing this: "No problem, there's plenty of time, let's exchange WeChat first."
Faced with Little Nie's attempt to add her on WeChat, Qin Kelian remained unmoved.
Seeing Qin Kelian like this, Little Nie genuinely felt that beautiful women in big cities were much more difficult to handle than women from his hometown.
Back in his hometown, when he acted like this, he could easily get contact information like WeChat from some girls, especially younger ones.
Then with just a bit of contact, he could score.
Why was it so troublesome here?
However, this instead ignited Little Nie's competitive spirit.
At this moment, Little Nie asked: "Beautiful, do you usually play games?"
Qin Kelian nodded.
Little Nie said: "Do you play Honor of Kings?"
Qin Kelian shook her head.
Little Nie asked again: "What about battle royale games like Game for Peace?"
Qin Kelian felt it was about time, although she didn't really play this game much, only occasionally a few times. But she still said:
"Yes, I do, why?"
Little Nie's eyes immediately lit up: "What's your rank?"
Qin Kelian said: "Platinum."
Little Nie clapped his hands: "I'm a Super Ace, add me, I'll carry you, take you through ranked matches, help you rank up! That's the reason for adding me!!!"
(Ace is equivalent to the King rank in Honor of Kings)
Qin Kelian pretended to be surprised, and her surprised expression had a unique charm that made Little Nie feel extremely satisfied, overjoyed.
Qin Kelian quickly said with surprise: "I didn't expect you to be so good?"
Little Nie smiled pretentiously: "It's nothing really, just a Super Ace, that's all."
"So? Beautiful, add me! I'll carry you!!!"
As Little Nie spoke, his greedy eyes on his face stared intently at Qin Kelian's exquisite, beautiful face.
This look seemed as if he couldn't wait to strip Qin Kelian completely naked.
Probably, in Little Nie's mind, Qin Kelian was already being treated quite badly.
Qin Kelian said: "Exchanging WeChat isn't necessary, how about this: come directly to my place tonight at 8 o'clock, and we can try duo queueing then, how about that?"
When Little Nie heard this, he was extremely happy inside.
Originally, his plan was to add her on WeChat first, duo queue remotely for a while to build rapport. Then discuss what comes next.
He never expected that this beauty before him would actually invite him to come directly to her place tonight for face-to-face duo queueing?
"Wait, could it be that this beauty actually likes me? She's just too shy to say it directly, pretending to be aloof? Otherwise, 8 PM is quite an ambiguous time, isn't it?"
Little Nie felt the progress was too fast.
But he didn't think too much about it - the faster the progress, the better, and the happier he was.
"Since that's the case, beautiful, let's make it official then, see you at 8 PM without fail."
"Oh, but for your apartment building, since I'm not a resident, I can't get in? We still need to exchange WeChat, so when I arrive, I can message you to let me in."
Qin Kelian's eyes carried affection, and she somehow had an access card in her hand, which she tossed to Little Nie.
"This is an access card, with this card, even if you're not a resident, you can swipe to get in."
Little Nie took the access card with both hands, smiling happily: "Alright!"
Little Nie felt that with the access card in hand, success was almost guaranteed.
And when he looked up again, wanting to say something more, Qin Kelian had already returned inside Room 303.
"Ah, so fragrant!"
Little Nie held the access card that carried Qin Kelian's fragrance with both hands.
His nose twitched vigorously, both nostrils expanded many times larger than normal.
Smelling this fresh floral scent, Little Nie had already started fantasizing about meeting Qin Kelian again tonight.
And just at that moment.
While he was immersed in this beautiful fantasy.
A sudden roar appeared, transforming into Thor's hammer, shattering his lascivious thoughts.
"You damn kid! How much longer are you going to smoke? Aren't you coming to help?"
It was Master Nie.
After installing two windows with Jiang Ran's help, and still not seeing Little Nie return, and feeling too embarrassed to have Jiang Ran assist further, he came out to look for Little Nie.
What he found was Little Nie inexplicably smelling something.
"Oh, oh, coming."
Little Nie put the access card into his right pants pocket, seemingly not feeling assured, he patted and touched it through the pants pocket several times, as if afraid it might fall out.
Then, he ran back to Room 304.
Helping his father, Master Nie, install the windows.
Soon, within half an hour, all the windows were completely installed.
After checking everything and confirming there were no issues.
Jiang Ran escorted Master Nie and his son all the way out through the first-floor glass automatic sensor door before returning to the management office.
And Master Nie and Little Nie also got into the driver's and passenger seats of the minivan they came in.
Inside the vehicle.
Watching his son sitting to the side, inexplicably happy, shaking his head and swaying, constantly humming something:
"Chicken You So Beautiful"
Master Nie's thick eyebrows involuntarily furrowed again.
The more he looked at his son, the more displeased he felt.
...
After Jiang Ran returned to the management office, he sat in the chair that Manager Xiao Zhang usually occupied.
Now, the security door and tempered glass windows were all taken care of.
Next was exercising.
It was still that same question: should I exercise following my phone?
Or look for a nearby gym and find a personal trainer to follow?
After thinking for quite a while, Jiang Ran finally decided to just follow his phone for exercise!
After all, it's free.
So, he started using the fitness app that came with his phone, looking at the training plan set by Little White's daily workouts in the app.
Deciding to start exercising from today onward.

chapters.title: Chapter 253: Lin Feng, Wang Ziyi, and I am the Hero Meet in Reality
chapters.content:
At the location of Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng and his girlfriend Wang Ziyi.
After receiving the notification on their phones that day, the two immediately packed their things and left Alice Apartment.
They were rushing home.
Since their permanent residence city wasn't Nancheng City at all.
To return to their own home, they needed to take transportation like airplanes or high-speed rail.
Therefore, after escaping that night, they took a taxi to a hotel near the airport, planning to rest well overnight and buy tickets the next day to return to their home city.
And during that night at the hotel.
Both Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi felt that night was the most comfortable, peaceful sleep they had ever experienced in their lives.
The next day after waking up, they bought the fastest flight tickets home.
They took the plane in the afternoon and returned to that familiar city by evening.That familiar villa.
After returning to the villa, both indulged in compensatory revelry, releasing the physiological torment, especially the psychological torment, from those 7 days in Alice Apartment.
The two gradually recalled that everything wasn't over yet.
They still had two rounds to get through.
Therefore, Ultimate Rich Kid contacted his real-life friend—I am the Hero.
To gather at his home.
Now.
The three were having a secret discussion in the study on the second floor of Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng's villa.
I am the Hero was Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng's real-life friend.
His real name was: Wang Baobao.
This name was quite peculiar, given to him by his father.
It seemed that Wang Baobao's father was born into poverty and built his fortune from scratch.
Therefore, the meaning behind naming his son Wang Baobao was: never forget the day you could eat your fill.
Although Wang Baobao was also a rich second generation.
Compared to Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng, this tall, rich, and handsome man.
Wang Baobao couldn't compare at all.
He had ordinary looks, height only slightly over 170cm—and that was with shoes on;
without shoes he probably wouldn't even reach 170cm.
The only thing comparable was the "rich" aspect.
After all, without being rich, he couldn't have become a user of Black Software.
"Honestly, Lin Feng, I really regret pulling you into this back then."
At this moment, Wang Baobao sat on the sofa, speaking to Lin Feng with deep guilt.
He was genuinely distressed.
After all, he didn't have many real friends in his life.
Most people around him were those who flattered him because of his money.
Including his current girlfriend, an eighteen-tier minor celebrity with fair skin, beautiful looks, and long legs.
On the surface, she loved him intensely.
But he knew clearly that this woman was only with him for the money, not because she liked him.
Therefore, he truly regretted it.
After all, back then, he considered Lin Feng a true friend, so he shared it with him with the mindset of sharing good things.
Lin Feng patted I am the Hero—Wang Baobao's shoulder:
"Don't blame yourself, the real culprit isn't as guilty as you are, why are you still feeling guilty?"
After speaking, Lin Feng's sharp gaze made Wang Ziyi, who was sitting nearby drinking mineral water, feel extremely uncomfortable.
Then Lin Feng turned his head, looked at Wang Baobao, and continued: "Baobao, I asked you here to have you tell me all the details about this 28th round."
"Of course, if telling me these things would harm you, then don't tell me."
I am the Hero Wang Baobao shook his head: "That's fine, it doesn't violate the rules."
"By the way, you previously messaged me saying the Black Software on your phone was locked, can you use it now?"
Lin Feng sighed.
"No, probably not until I completely pass all three rounds, so quickly tell me everything that happened this round from beginning to end."
Wang Baobao: "Okay."
Next.
I am the Hero Wang Baobao proceeded to tell Lin Feng everything he saw in this round from start to finish, leaving no detail untold.
He spoke for a full hour.
Wang Baobao was completely parched from talking.
As for the listeners.
Lin Feng and Wang Ziyi were both utterly shocked.
Especially Lin Feng, who completely couldn't believe what happened in this round.
At the beginning, hearing that not only were there more lab rats in this round than in the previous rounds he watched.
But there was also the new situation of two lab rats merging into the same number.
Ou Yingying and Little Zhao.
Him and Wang Ziyi.
Then, he heard from Wang Baobao that Ou Yingying and Little Zhao also had guns in their hands.
Especially that Ou Yingying's boyfriend was not only a user of Black Software, but also a regular in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
And he even hired a retired American special forces soldier as a bodyguard for Ou Yingying.
When hearing about such configuration.
Because he couldn't figure out how Ou Yingying and Little Zhao died so early with such powerful configuration?
He originally thought it was because they didn't attend the welcome party, so the chainsaw murderer got them.
But, forget about having a retired American special forces soldier providing protection.
Even just the guns in Ou Yingying and Little Zhao's hands meant the chainsaw murderer couldn't kill them!
Unless they brought it upon themselves!
Otherwise, cold weapons absolutely couldn't compare to firearms!
Then, when he heard from Wang Baobao how Ou Yingying and the other died, he was truly completely stunned.
Never expected that there was actually a dog-keeping pervert in the apartment.
That's how Ou Yingying's three people died—overwhelmed by wave after wave of dogs piling on them until death.
At this moment, I am the Hero Wang Baobao said:
"This round really had all kinds of shady characters."
"But the good news is, the next round will start after a long time, since there's that special live stream, the Island Seven-Day Tour."
Lin Feng kept nodding: "Indeed, what shocked me most this round was that guy called Old Dog keeping so many dogs that they could even swarm and kill an American special forces soldier with a gun."
"Then there's this matter about lab rats who pass four rounds being able to voluntarily participate in the special live stream. Together with lab rats from other countries."
"Ah, damn, I really want to watch the special live stream too!!!!"
Lin Feng exclaimed with loud regret.
Although he still had two rounds to participate in, hearing about this thing made him really want to watch it.
Have to say, his heart was really something.
Wang Baobao said: "No problem, if you want to watch, come to my place, I'll watch it with you."
"As for..."
Wang Baobao's gaze shifted toward Lin Feng's girlfriend Wang Ziyi.
"Lin Feng, it's not that I'm narrow-minded, I'm just scared too, so your girlfriend shouldn't come."
Lin Feng nodded: "That's no problem."
After speaking, Lin Feng glared fiercely at Wang Ziyi.
Wang Ziyi originally wanted to request to watch it too.
After all, a special live stream! And at Asian Level.
And all participants are lab rats who passed four rounds.
Wouldn't this be much more exciting than ordinary live streams?
But Lin Feng's look...
"Brother Wang, give me one more chance! I absolutely won't make the same mistake again!"
Wang Ziyi pleaded bitterly.
Wang Baobao shook his head desperately: "No no no, miss, please spare me, I'm really scared."
At this moment, Lin Feng pinched Wang Ziyi's delicate, petite face with his hand, squeezing the face even smaller:
"Enough, Wang Ziyi, after I finish watching, I'll recount it for you, so don't get any clever ideas!"

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Safe House?
chapters.content:
Being told this by Lin Feng, Wang Ziyi truly gave up.
At this moment, Wang Baobao said: "By the way, Lin Feng, this Special Live Stream matter isn't actually important. What's really important are the two rounds you still have to participate in after the Special Live Stream."
"Hmm... I think if you're going to fail in the next two rounds, there's an extremely high probability you'll fail by ending up in the mouths of that Old Dog's dogs."
"Even though that retired American special forces soldier Golden Beard killed quite a few, and then Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao together took out over twenty more."
"That Old Dog absolutely still has a sufficient number of large dogs."
Wang Ziyi spoke up now: "But we haven't provoked that Old Dog, have we? We don't need to be afraid of him, right?"
Wang Baobao: "Did Ou Yingying and the others provoke that Old Dog?"
"You might not be on Old Dog's hunting list, but if by any chance you encounter the same situation as Ou Yingying did, it'll be too late for regrets!"
Lin Feng pondered for a long time: "That makes sense. By the way, Baobao, do you know who in the apartment took out that rich second generation who had the same experience as me last time?"
Lin Feng was referring to that rich second generation whose total assets added up to over five billion.He survived two rounds, but died in the apartment during the final round, not making it through.
So, Lin Feng wanted to know who killed this person who shared his same experience, so he could be prepared.
Wang Baobao said: "I haven't watched many more rounds than you. When that rich second generation died, I hadn't gotten into this yet. So I don't know the specific details of what happened, but I've heard others talk about it."
