"They said that rich second generation, during his third round, was taken out through the cooperation of several deranged criminals and deranged serial killers from the apartment."
Hearing this, Lin Feng immediately got a headache: "I think that rich second generation probably used the same strategy as me for all three rounds - laying low. He must have gotten guns too, yet he still got taken out."
"Suddenly I feel the future looks bleak."
Wang Baobao seemed to suddenly think of something and slapped his thigh.
"Lin Feng, I have a great idea! Do you want to hear it?!"
Lin Feng looked up: "What great idea?"
Wang Baobao: "Recently I've been reading post-apocalyptic novels on Tomato Novel, where tons of protagonists build safe houses right from the start."
"You should build one too."
"Turn your place into a safe house - we're not short on money anyway!!!"
"Then stockpile enough supplies in your safe house - you'll be invincible!"
Looking at Wang Baobao's shining eyes, Lin Feng suddenly felt this might actually be a good idea.
Although he didn't really like reading those web novels and such.
Of course, he didn't like reading them.
Mainly because his own life was already satisfying enough.
Many web novels that others recommended to him, about suddenly getting rich and buying luxury cars, and even getting the beautiful female salesperson - he couldn't feel how satisfying they were because in reality, he had bought plenty of luxury cars, and those beautiful female salespeople that others could only experience in novels, he had experienced who knows how many in real life.
"Baobao, you need to help me build this safe house."
Lin Feng earnestly pleaded.
Wang Baobao said: "Of course I will."
Lin Feng continued: "Then tell me, after building this safe house and hiding inside, I should be basically invincible, right?"
Wang Baobao thought about it: "Actually, I think a safe house is only relatively safe."
"There are still ways to breach it."
Lin Feng frowned: "Like what?"
Wang Baobao: "Breached from the inside."
Instantly, Lin Feng looked at Wang Ziyi beside him.
Wang Ziyi said nervously: "Don't look at me! How could I be stupid enough to betray you? We're on the same boat! If the boat capsizes, I'll die too!"
Lin Feng nodded - indeed, Wang Ziyi wasn't that stupid.
"What about others then?"
Wang Baobao answered: "The biggest weaknesses of your house are the doors and windows, right? Replace both of them completely, and unless the other side goes completely insane and directly breaks through the walls, I can't think of how they could get in."
Lin Feng said: "Then couldn't I hire someone to reinforce all the walls?"
Wang Baobao's eyes lit up: "Great idea! That would make you truly invincible!"
With this safe house idea, Lin Feng immediately felt much more at ease.
...
Time quickly reached 6:30 in the evening.
Only one and a half hours remained until Little Nie and Qin Kelian's appointed time of 8:00 PM.
Since there was some distance between Little Nie's home and Alice Apartment.
Little Nie prepared to get ready and set off.
Before leaving, Little Nie first took a shower.
He changed into what he considered his most handsome clothes, styled his hair, and sprayed men's perfume on himself.
This behavior of his was naturally noticed by his father Master Nie and his mother Mrs. Nie.
Of course, neither of them found it particularly strange or abrupt, because their son often primped like this.
When Little Nie had finished preparing everything and was about to leave, Master Nie finally asked:
"You little rascal, where are you going this time?"
Little Nie replied: "Don't you want me to get married early? So of course I'm going to find a girlfriend."
Hearing this, Master Nie said: "No matter where you go to mess around tonight, you're not allowed to do anything illegal or against the rules. Also, tomorrow morning, whatever time I start work, you need to start work at the same time."
"Alright, alright, I know."
Little Nie responded impatiently, then left home.
Master Nie watched his son's departing back and sighed.
His wife asked him why he was sighing again.
Master Nie said straight out that his son had grown up and couldn't be controlled at all.
They could only compromise.
Yes, initially when Little Nie followed his parents around, Master Nie controlled him strictly - he couldn't even go out at night.
But over time, Little Nie developed serious rebellious tendencies, and both sides had major arguments.
Master Nie had no choice but to compromise.
Like the daytime smoking, that was one of the compromises.
"Don't worry, didn't your son say he's going to find a girlfriend? Once he starts a family, maybe he'll settle down and live a steady life."
Master Nie sighed deeply: "I hope so! By the way, later I need to go out again. I took on a job."
Mrs. Nie said: "Ah? Going out again? Can't you not go? You're taking on side jobs every night - it's too exhausting."
Master Nie sighed: "What can I do if I don't work hard? The mortgage on this house, the betrothal money we need to save for our son, and the down payment money for his future house - if I don't work hard, can we count on him?"
As he said this, the wrinkles on Master Nie's face seemed to deepen.
The four big characters "continuing the family line" seemed to be an obsession weighing on the heads of all Hua Country people.
Little Nie left home, used his phone for navigation, and rode his fully charged electric bike toward Alice Apartment.
He rode very fast, the slightly cool summer night breeze blowing like a designer.
On his face, it designed thick anticipation and excitement he couldn't hide!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 255: Jiang Ran Keeps Getting Screwed Over by Zhang
chapters.content:
Soon, before 8 PM, he had already arrived outside the main gate of Alice Apartment.
He parked his electric bike outside.
He pulled the access card given to him by Qin Kelian from his zippered pants pocket.
First, he held it up to his nose and smelled it before using it to enter Alice Apartment.
As he entered the apartment building through the glass automatic sensor door.
Jiang Ran had just finished a set of push-ups in the management office and stood up.
Then, through the glass, he saw Little Nie lightly hopping and skipping into the elevator.
He wondered if he was seeing things?
Wasn't that Master Nie's son from earlier today?
Why was he coming here again at night?But he didn't pay it much mind.
Because he still had several more sets of exercises to complete!
Little Nie quickly reached the third floor, arriving at the door of Room 303.
He knocked on the door.
After someone inside asked who it was and he answered.
The door opened quickly.
The moment the door opened, an intoxicatingly fragrant aroma directly struck Little Nie's heart.
Making Little Nie exclaim inwardly that this was the scent of love.
The one who opened the door was none other than Qin Kelian.
Little Nie was invited inside by Qin Kelian.
After Little Nie entered, Qin Kelian asked: "Hey, it's only 7:40 now, didn't we agree on 8 PM? Why did you come so early?"
After entering, Little Nie's eyes darted around as he moved his head, surveying Qin Kelian's home.
He replied: "Isn't coming earlier better for ranking up sooner?"
With that, Little Nie unceremoniously plopped down on the sofa.
Simultaneously pulling out his phone, he said: "Kelian, let's add each other on WeChat, then play some games together?"
Qin Kelian looked at the impatient Little Nie, inwardly sneering repeatedly.
But on the surface, she maintained her beautiful smile: "Okay, by the way, since you're already here, I just brewed some new tea. Could you taste it for me and give me your opinion on whether it's good?"
Qin Kelian brought a small golden teapot from the kitchen along with a disposable paper cup, walking over to Little Nie's side.
She poured him a full cup.
Little Nie stared at the tea, somewhat surprised: "Hey, I didn't expect you to know how to brew tea, Kelian? Then I definitely have to try it."
Under Qin Kelian's cunning gaze, this sucker Little Nie picked up the paper cup, found it was warm, tasted it with his mouth, discovered it wasn't hot, and then drank more than half in one gulp.
After drinking it, he complained inwardly about why anyone would like drinking this tea stuff.
Honestly, it wasn't as good as the three-yuan bottled ice black tea or ice green tea.
But he still gave Qin Kelian a thumbs up: "Delicious, so delicious! I've never tasted tea this good in my entire life!!!"
Qin Kelian covered her mouth while giggling: "You're not just flattering me on purpose, are you?"
Little Nie quickly waved his hands: "How could that be? I might lie to anyone, but I'd never lie to you. If you don't believe me, pour me another full cup - I can finish it all!"
After saying this, Little Nie suddenly changed the subject:
"Hey, Kelian, do you know there's a Japanese actress named Kaede Karen?"
Qin Kelian stared at Little Nie's eyes that were already becoming dazed and heavy-lidded, knowing the sedative in the tea was starting to take effect.
Her sister's newly made sedative was really strong, working this quickly.
Qin Kelian said: "I know her, she's very beautiful. Many people say it's a pity she went into the adult industry."
Little Nie laughed upon hearing this: "Men's mouths are always like that."
"Beautiful women who don't enter the adult industry - they say it's a pity."
"Beautiful women who do enter the adult industry - they also say it's a pity, that with that looks, she could have been an idol."
"Men's words are like ghosts - completely untrustworthy."
"Kelian, you know what? I think your looks, and your figure, are way more beautiful than that Japanese Kaede Karen, especially your figure..."
As he spoke to this point.
Little Nie's swaying body directly collapsed sideways onto the sofa.
The phone in his hand with the screen still on fell to the floor with a clatter.
Qin Kelian now picked up Little Nie's phone.
Discovering it was a Fruit Phone.
She casually browsed through it and found his phone was filled with various dating apps.
Things like Momo, Tantan, Soul, and similar apps.
The corner of her mouth lifted slightly.
She began browsing through Little Nie's chat records on these dating apps with great interest.
"Men, they're just too easily ruled by their lower halves, having almost no defense mechanisms when encountering pretty girls."
"They always think that when alone in a room with a beautiful woman, they're the dominant party."
At this moment, another woman with exceptional looks and figure emerged from the bedroom.
It was Qin Kelian's older sister, Qin Yi.
After coming out, Qin Yi examined the unconscious Little Nie and said: "This is truly prey delivering itself to our doorstep. When you go to the underworld, don't come looking for trouble with us - after all, we didn't actively hunt you."
Qin Kelian continued browsing Little Nie's phone, saying: "Sister, when do you think men will stop thinking with their lower halves?"
Qin Yi said: "The simplest is when they're in sage mode."
"Of course, there's another situation - when you've encountered and played with enough beautiful women that you develop high magic resistance."
"The last type is that American Mike, who's really defensive against everyone."
Qin Kelian asked: "What about Jiang Ran then?"
Qin Yi's face, which could be described as a stunning beauty, immediately darkened: "That kind I think is the most terrifying."
"Because even sedatives don't work on him."
Qin Kelian put down the phone and continued: "Sister, should we handle Little Nie according to the usual procedure?"
Qin Yi nodded: "Of course. Definitely follow the usual procedure."
The demoness sisters' usual procedure was quite simple.
That was, they never acted while their prey was unconscious.
Just like with the internet-addicted youth Qin Fei, they waited until he woke up before proceeding with the treatment.
This way, it was more interesting, allowing the element of fear to be deeply engraved into their flesh.
At 9 PM, Jiang Ran went out to patrol the construction site with his flashlight.
Regarding what happened during the previous patrol, since that day, Jiang Ran's three daily patrols at 9 PM, 10 PM, and 11 PM had all been half-hearted efforts.
Just casually wandering around near the apartment building.
Just as Jiang Ran had been wandering near the apartment building for about ten minutes and was preparing to return to the apartment building.
His phone suddenly rang - looking at it, it was actually a call from Manager Xiao Zhang.
Jiang Ran looked at Xiao Zhang calling, wondering if his perfunctory patrolling over the past few days had been discovered?
He answered the phone with some concern.
The familiar voice of Manager Xiao Zhang came from the other end:
"Jiang Ran, not asleep yet?"
Jiang Ran thought Manager Xiao Zhang was testing him, so he said: "Of course not, I'm on patrol duty."
Manager Xiao Zhang said: "Good, good, very responsible."
"How about this - since you're so responsible, I have a reward for you. Want it?"
Jiang Ran was curious: "What reward?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "An apartment benefit, only available to management staff. This benefit is that I get one free seven-day trip each year."
"This year's seven-day trip starts in a few days. The apartment owner arranged for me to go on this Pacific Macedonia Island Seven-Day Tour. Round trip, everything - eating, drinking, sleeping, all expenses covered for free."
"I wanted to ask, would you like to go?"

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Poor Xiao Nie, Ruined by a Woman
chapters.content:
A free seven-day island tour?
Who wouldn't want to go?
Jiang Ran said, "Of course I'd want to, why? You're not going to give it to me, are you?"
Manager Xiao Zhang said, "Exactly right. You're so smart."
Jiang Ran said, "No way? You're really giving it to me? It's not one of those kidney-harvesting islands, is that why you're giving it to me?"
Jiang Ran had recently seen online news about numerous kidney-harvesting syndicates setting up companies in their country.
They'd recruit a bunch of office workers, then after about half a year, when the timing was right.
They'd organize team-building tours, sending everyone abroad to harvest their kidneys.
Absolutely terrifying and impossible to guard against.
Manager Xiao Zhang on the other end of the phone sounded utterly exasperated:"Oh dear, actually I don't really want to give it away either, but mainly, I have thalassophobia."
"I'm terrified of the sea, I get dizzy just looking at the ocean, do you understand that feeling?"
Hearing this, Jiang Ran thought the illnesses in this world were truly bizarre and varied.
He continued asking, "But this free tour, couldn't you give it to your family? Or relatives?"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "There's only one spot, which of my parents should go? I don't have any siblings. As for relatives, forget it, I've never had good relationships with them, I'd rather give the benefit to anyone but them."
"Also, have you heard of this saying?"
"It's called, a near neighbor is better than a distant cousin."
"So, I thought about it, and decided to just give it directly to you. After all, we're colleagues and also friends, so I'll let you have this benefit."
Jiang Ran felt touched: "Xiao Zhang, you're so good to me!"
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Of course, what's between us is special!"
Jiang Ran was genuinely moved, since Manager Xiao Zhang had truly been very good to him.
He'd let him be temporary manager, and usually didn't bother him about slacking off at work.
And now he was even giving him this free seven-day island tour.
Manager Xiao Zhang: "Alright, it's settled then."
"Get your passport sorted tomorrow. As for the visa, plane tickets and such, the apartment will handle it for you. Just wait for me to notify you about the tour!"
The two chatted for a while longer before hanging up.
After hanging up, Jiang Ran was so happy he jumped three feet high.
He kept quietly chanting: "La la la la la, awesome awesome awesome!!!"
10 PM.
"Sister, it seems the new sedative you developed this time acts quickly, but the awakening is also fast."
"Only about two hours of sleep time."
In the living room of Room 303.
Qin Kelian looked at Little Nie, whose hands, feet, and body were locked onto a rectangular silver metal execution platform with metal restraints.
She spoke to Qin Yi.
Qin Yi stared at Little Nie and noticed the eyeballs beneath his eyelids moving erratically from side to side, showing signs of activity. His entire face was also making some expressions.
Including his hands and feet.
All of this proved the drug effect was wearing off.
Little Nie was about to wake up.
After waiting about another 20 minutes.
Little Nie finally woke up and opened his eyes.
The first moment he opened his eyes.
Like most people, Little Nie first spaced out for a while.
Then, habitually looked left and right. Because the living room ceiling light was very bright, his eyes were squinted.
He looked left and right, then got a fright, his heart suddenly pounding.
Because standing on his left and right were people wearing rubber leather outfits.
And they were also wearing helmets.
Couldn't even tell if they were male or female.
"Who are you?"
Little Nie habitually tried to sit up.
But then discovered his hands, feet, and body were locked by something.
Realizing what had happened to him, he immediately felt a sense of foreboding.
An indescribable, unknown fear instantly took over his entire body.
He felt his body starting to grow cold and chilled.
"Don't worry, Little Nie, it's me, Kelian."
Qin Kelian, standing on Little Nie's right, removed her helmet.
Revealing that stunningly beautiful face that could topple cities and countries.
Seeing Qin Kelian's face, Little Nie inexplicably felt relieved.
He asked Qin Kelian why she was dressed like this?
Why was he locked here?
And who was the person on the left?
Qin Kelian selectively answered Little Nie's questions.
She said: "Little Nie, I'm the one who locked you up. As for why I locked you up, and why I'm dressed like this now, it's because I want to play a game with you."
Little Nie: "Play... a game?"
Qin Kelian nodded: "Didn't you ask me during the day if I play Game for Peace, and I said I do?"
"Actually, that was a lie."
"I don't really play Game for Peace much, the games I actually play are different ones."
Little Nie: "What games?"
Qin Kelian: "Games like Identity V, Dead by Daylight, and similar ones."
Little Nie frowned, thinking as he said: "I know Dead by Daylight, it's a PC game. I haven't played it, but I've heard of it and watched streams."
"As for Identity V, I'm familiar with that! I'm tier 7 Survivor. If you play this, you should have told me! I'll carry you to higher ranks! Guaranteed to juke the hunter into oblivion!!!"
Little Nie said excitedly.
Qin Kelian listened, then suddenly gave an eerie smile: "I know, while you were unconscious, I checked your phone and found out you're a tier 7 Survivor in Identity V, very impressive."
"Of course, I also saw that you've been hitting on girls all over the game."
Hearing this, Little Nie's heart sank.
He quickly explained: "That's not really hitting on, is it? Just looking for gaming partners, and by the way finding a girlfriend. After all, you know this game has many female players, it's easy to find a girlfriend."
"So... Kelian, you're not jealous, are you?"
Little Nie had a suspicious expression.
Qin Kelian was rendered speechless by this statement: "Jealous? How long have we known each other, why would I be jealous?"
"I'm telling you this to let you know that when I play Identity V, I specifically play as the Hunter."
Little Nie said: "That's fine too! I can also play Hunter and do Duo Hunters with you!!!"
Qin Kelian quickly waved her hand: "No no no, I saw your Identity V account."
"You don't play Hunter, you specifically play Survivor to carry girls to higher ranks, while I play Hunter, so we're natural enemies, do you understand?"
Little Nie shook his head: "I don't understand."
"Isn't this game about playing Survivor when you want, and Hunter when you want?"
Qin Kelian sighed: "Seems you still don't get it."
"Let me explain more carefully."
"You, right now, are the Survivor."
"And I, am the Hunter."
"You've been caught by me now."
"Do you know what I'm going to do?"
Little Nie suddenly understood: "You're going to put me on a Rocket Chair? But since you don't have one at home, you put me on this platform? And locking me up simulates the descending lever that traps Survivors on the Rocket Chair, right?"
Little Nie felt he had figured out Qin Kelian's hobby and was ecstatic, feeling he had taken a step closer with Qin Kelian.
Qin Kelian nodded with satisfaction: "Yes, then guess what else I'm going to do after that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Jiang Ran, Want Some Canned Meat?
chapters.content:
Little Nie said: "According to Identity V rules."
"At this point, teammates should come to rescue me, but this is reality—where would teammates come from?"
"So no one will save me, and when time runs out, the rocket chair in the game will launch like a rocket."
"As for reality... you should let me go, right?"
After Little Nie finished speaking, he heard Qin Kelian and the other person laughing.
Their laughter was so pleasant that Little Nie felt no pressure at all.
Little Nie also laughed: "Isn't that right?"
Qin Kelian shook her head, her snow-white neck unfortunately hidden from view.
She said with a smile: "Survivors who get placed on the rocket chair are eventually sent flying like rockets—what do you think happens to them?"
"Of course they get 'out,' eliminated, meaning death."Little Nie shook his head: "No, not death—they get 'out' and eliminated, meaning 'lost.' That's what the ending screen shows."
She coldly laughed: "Oh really? That's what you think? Do you know what happened during Identity V's initial beta testing? Back then, when you got caught, it wasn't the rocket chair—do you know what it was?"
Little Nie was quite dismissive: "Although I didn't play the beta, I know—after being caught, survivors were hanged on gallows, right?"
Qin Kelian nodded: "Yes, back then when you got caught, you were hanged on the gallows. Therefore, if you didn't escape the manor, the final result screen showed 'victimized,' meaning death. Not the current 'lost'."
Her beautiful face grew increasingly eerie.
Qin Kelian said: "So, that will be your outcome."
Little Nie didn't quite understand what Qin Kelian meant, thinking she was just too immersed in the role. Then, a buzzing sound suddenly reached his ears.
Turning to look, the unidentified person who had been wearing a helmet the whole time now somehow held a chainsaw that was currently starting up.
Little Nie stared at this person, especially at the chainsaw in her hands.
He couldn't help but swallow hard.
"Kelian, stop joking around, this isn't funny at all. This thing is dangerous—quickly tell your friend to put it down."
Little Nie shouldn't have spoken.
After he spoke, the chainsaw-wielding person directly pressed the high-speed rotating chainsaw against his right leg.
Little Nie watched in horror as blood sprayed from his calf area.
He screamed in terror: "Stop! Stop it!!!"
"Ahhhhhh!"
The chainsaw had already begun cutting.
The intense pain made endless fear surge in Little Nie's heart.
He turned his head toward Qin Kelian and spoke rapidly:
"Kelian, tell your friend to stop!!!"
But Qin Kelian didn't answer him. Instead, she somehow produced a chainsaw herself and began pressing it against Little Nie's other leg.
"Ahhhhhh! Stop it, both of you!!!!"
Little Nie watched the scene before him, wondering if he was dreaming.
How could he be experiencing something like this?
No, this wasn't a dream—how could this heart-wrenching pain be a dream?!
If so, why, why were they doing this to him?!
The pain made Little Nie's entire body twist and struggle wildly on the execution platform.
But unfortunately, it was useless. It neither relieved the pain nor helped him break free.
He was still wondering why Qin Kelian would do this to him?
He didn't understand!
Then, he suddenly seemed to remember something.
He quickly shouted at Qin Kelian, who was sawing his leg with the chainsaw: "Did you look through my phone and discover I'm what you'd call a scumbag? Is that why you're taking revenge on me?!"
This was the only reason Little Nie could think of.
But Little Nie didn't consider himself a scumbag.
He just had many girlfriends and changed them frequently.
"Scumbag? You are indeed a scumbag, but that's not why I'm doing this to you."
Qin Kelian turned her head, her face showing complete madness.
Her previous beauty had completely transformed into distortion.
It felt like the current Qin Kelian had been doubly possessed by evil spirits and demons.
"Little Nie, whether you're a scumbad or not—what does that have to do with me?"
"Even if you've wronged many, many women, I wouldn't be angry, nor would I target you for the sake of these unfamiliar, unrelated women."
"I'm doing this to you purely because you're a man."
"And then, you delivered yourself to our doorstep."
"When someone delivers themselves to your door, there's no reason not to accept, right?"
Little Nie was stunned: "No, that's not—ahhhhhh, please stop!"
"What kind of nonsense is this?! I deliver myself to your door, and you torture me like this?! Are you murderers?"
Qin Kelian snapped her fingers loudly and said with a smile: "You guessed right!"
Little Nie was utterly terrified:
"No, that can't be, such beautiful—ahhhhhh, murderers?!"
"St-stop it!!! Help!!!! He-help!!!! Save me!!!!"
"Can anyone come save me?!!!!"
"Sister, sister please let me go... I haven't gotten married yet! I admit I approached you because I wanted to hit on you, but I was wrong! I know I was wrong!"
"Please, I beg you, let me go!"
Little Nie cried for help, but it was useless.
Therefore, he could only beg Qin Kelian to show mercy and release him.
But it was still useless.
In Room 303, only Little Nie's miserable screams continuously echoed throughout the room now.
These terrifying, piercing cries.
If made into a short video and circulated online.
They would probably make many viewers feel afraid, their hair standing on end, physically uncomfortable, nauseated and wanting to vomit.
After all, just these miserable screams alone were enough to make people grimace bitterly.
But, these screams, when they reached the ears of these demoness sisters, were like heavenly music.
Making them work even more vigorously.
...
The next day, around 7 AM, Jiang Ran woke up in the management office, returned to Room 304, washed up, and simply ate instant noodles.
Checking the time, he prepared to go downstairs, ride his electric bike, and go out to apply for a passport.
He left Room 304 and was just a few meters away from passing Room 303.
Right at that moment, the door to Room 303 opened.
Two beautiful figures emerged one after another.
They were Qin Yi and Qin Kelian.
The moment the two sisters appeared.
The Danger Warning System in Jiang Ran's mind began alarming continuously.
First +8, then it became a constant +9.
"Good morning."
But regardless, Jiang Ran still greeted them.
Seeing this, Qin Kelian pouted at Jiang Ran: "I specially brewed tea for you and brought it to you, but you didn't drink it at all. You didn't give me any face, and now you have the nerve to greet me?"
"Uh..."
Jiang Ran didn't know what to say.
Just then, Qin Kelian's older sister, Qin Yi, gave Jiang Ran a way out: "It's fine, Jiang Ran, my sister is just joking with you, don't take it seriously."
"By the way, I have a canned meat here. Our sisterhood has too many at home and can't eat them all. Do you want it?"
Jiang Ran noticed at this moment that both sisters were carrying two sturdy black plastic bags each.
Bulging and full.
The metal can in Qin Yi's hand had been taken out from one of the bags.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: The Witch Sisters Join Forces with Kim Yoon-a
chapters.content:
"This canned meat..."
Jiang Ran took it over.
He discovered there were no icons or text on the surface of the can.
It was completely blank.
He felt quite puzzled: "Where is this canned meat from? Why is there no brand? Not even a single word?"
Qin Yi's eyes shimmered like autumn waters: "This is canned meat that we sisters made ourselves."
"Supermarket canned meat isn't trustworthy, you understand. Food safety issues are quite serious these days."
Jiang Ran made an understanding sound: "I see. I never imagined you two sisters are so multi-talented, even knowing how to make canned meat. Impressive, truly impressive."
Jiang Ran showed a smiling face to Qin Kelian, wanting to recover from their previous unpleasantness.
Who would have thought Qin Kelian still pouted: "You're the worst! You wouldn't drink the tea I gave you, but you accepted the canned meat my sister offered.""Tell me! Are you secretly crushing on my sister?!"
Jiang Ran quickly shook his head: "No, absolutely not."
Jiang Ran and Qin Kelian continued their banter as they entered the elevator.
When the elevator reached the first floor, the three of them had just stepped out.
A clear, pleasant female voice suddenly rang out:
"Jiang Ran oppa!"
Jiang Ran immediately recognized this voice—it was all too familiar.
Wasn't this Kim Yoon-ah?
Damn, he hadn't seen this Kim Yoon-ah for several days.
He thought he had left, never expecting him to still be at Alice Apartment.
Kim Yoon-ah emerged from the first-floor management office and, after coming out, jogged over to Jiang Ran's side.
He wrapped his arm around Jiang Ran's shoulder.
"Oh my, I never expected you to have such luck with women, Jiang Ran!"
Qin Kelian glanced at Kim Yoon-ah and said teasingly: "You've even managed to pick up a Korean female celebrity."
"No, he's not that female celebrity, he just looks quite similar, plus he's also from that country."
Qin Kelian listened, then stared at Kim Yoon-ah's face for a while before frowning and saying: "Oh, so it's just a plastic surgery monster. I was wondering why he looked so much like that Kim Ji-won."
Hearing these provocative words, Kim Yoon-ah didn't get angry, saying: "I've never had plastic surgery, beautiful sister. Please don't make baseless accusations. I'm just naturally beautiful like this. As for looking like that person, perhaps we're long-lost biological sisters!"
The corners of Qin Kelian's mouth lifted slightly:
"Long-lost biological sisters? I don't think so!"
"Perhaps they're long-lost biological brothers, or biological siblings."
When called a plastic surgery monster earlier, Kim Yoon-ah's expression hadn't changed.
But hearing this sudden remark,
A trace of ferocity appeared on Kim Yoon-ah's face.
However, this ferocity vanished in an instant.
Jiang Ran naturally heard these words.
As soon as these words were spoken, they automatically traveled through his ears and burrowed into his heart.
He turned his head and asked Kim Yoon-ah, completely incredulous:
"What did Qin Kelian mean by that just now?"
"Are you male? Or is Kim Ji-won male?"
Of course, Jiang Ran felt that Kim Ji-won definitely wasn't male.
After all, if she were male, the Korean entertainment industry would really be in an uproar.
"Um... I'm female, how could I possibly be male?"
Kim Yoon-ah chuckled lightly, while internally cursing Qin Kelian's ancestors eighteen generations back.
"Then why did she mention biological brothers, or biological siblings?"
"How should I know? Go ask her."
Kim Yoon-ah seemed somewhat displeased.
Jiang Ran turned his head with a questioning look.
Qin Kelian spread her hands, pretending not to care: "Oh, that was just a slip of the tongue, don't mind it."
Staring at Qin Kelian, then staring at Kim Yoon-ah.
Jiang Ran increasingly felt that this matter wasn't as simple as it seemed.
But looking at Kim Yoon-ah, how could he possibly appear male?!
There wasn't a single male characteristic!
Of course, the simplest way to confirm whether someone is male is to directly pull down their pants.
But Jiang Ran wouldn't do that—he wouldn't court death.
Regardless of whether Kim Yoon-ah is male or female, he had already planned to stay away from him anyway.
"Alright, I have things to do, I'm leaving first."
Jiang Ran freed himself from Kim Yoon-ah's arm-holding.
Immediately dashed away in escape.
After Jiang Ran left,
Kim Yoon-ah's expression turned extremely unpleasant and terrifying.
His voice also changed from the sweet female tone to his original male voice.
His male voice was alarmingly deep and steady.
Completely different from the somewhat naive, sweet female voice from before.
"Do you want to die?"
Kim Yoon-ah's head was slightly tilted at this moment, the coldness in his gaze seemingly capable of freezing the entire scorching summer day.
Qin Kelian began playing dumb: "I don't know what you mean, I was just speaking casually. I never expected you to actually be male."
Qin Kelian turned to leave, but Kim Yoon-ah tightly grasped her wrist.
"Stop pretending. Tell me, how did you know I'm not a woman?"
"How could you tell?"
"If you don't tell me, don't even think about leaving today."
"You think I'm afraid of you?"
Facing Kim Yoon-ah's threat, Qin Kelian directly ignored it.
But Qin Yi flashed out from behind Qin Kelian.
With her radiant, captivating appearance, she spoke softly:
"Very simple, because we've killed enough lab rats to directly obtain your information."
"You should understand what I mean, right?"
"Otherwise, since your appearance is exactly like a real woman's, who could tell at a single glance?"
"Heh, I understand."
Kim Yoon-ah's pale, jade-like hand released Qin Kelian's equally pale wrist.
It had to be said, Kim Yoon-ah's entire body was extremely similar to a woman's.
Especially since many women couldn't compare to him.
Forget about his face.
Just consider that hand from earlier.
Too beautiful—slender, pale, like jade bones.
Clearly meticulously maintained and naturally excellent from the start.
"However, you deliberately caused trouble here, hinting that I'm a man, making Jiang Ran become vigilant—how do you plan to settle this debt?"
Kim Yoon-ah still intended to settle the score from earlier.
Qin Kelian placed her hands on her hips, her slender waist incredibly alluring.
But unfortunately, although the person before them was male, he didn't like women.
Otherwise, deploying feminine charms might have been possible.
She said: "How do you want to settle it?"
Kim Yoon-ah continued:
"Very simple, help me hunt Jiang Ran. Since you've killed enough lab rats to know my information and background, you should know why I came here."
Qin Kelian was about to refuse outright.
Having killed so many people, she had never cooperated with others to hunt lab rats together.
But at this moment, her sister Qin Yi stepped forward again, opposing her stance.
"Alright, but when it's time to execute Jiang Ran, you must hand him over to us two sisters. Of course, you can watch from the side and supervise us."
Kim Yoon-ah immediately revealed a smile: "Fine, no problem. I just want him dead."
"Whether I personally do it or not doesn't matter, since I'll still be participating in it."
"Then let's cooperate happily."
Having agreed on everything, Kim Yoon-ah extended that extremely beautiful right hand.
Qin Yi correspondingly extended her own left hand, which was in no way inferior to Kim Yoon-ah's right hand.
The two hands clasped together, representing the establishment of their cooperation.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Three Tiger Detective Team
chapters.content:
Jiang Ran completed the passport application process quite quickly.
However, it would take 7 to 15 working days to actually receive the passport.
While riding his electric bike back to Alice Apartment after finishing the application, he wasn't sure if his eyes were playing tricks on him.
He saw the original body's ex-girlfriend, Shen Xing.
Of course, seeing Shen Xing wasn't particularly strange - what was strange was that Shen Xing seemed to be pregnant.
Her lower abdomen appeared slightly swollen.
Of course, it was just a fleeting glimpse, so Jiang Ran couldn't confirm for sure.
The person Jiang Ran saw with the slightly swollen lower abdomen was indeed Shen Xing.
She had come out to buy groceries at the supermarket.
After finishing her shopping, she drove back to the large flat where Zhou Wu's mother lived.Shen Xing opened the door to find Zhou Wu's mother, Zhou Wu's younger sister Zhou Yan, Zhou Yan's boyfriend Li Miguo, and Li Miguo's classmate Jimmy inside.
Currently, the shares and other inheritance from Zhou Wu's father hadn't been formally transferred to Zhou Wu's mother and Zhou Yan yet.
Why?
Because they were still considered missing persons.
Zhou Wu and his father had been missing for less than three months combined.
According to Hua Country's laws, declaring someone missing requires them to be unaccounted for for two full years.
And declaring someone dead requires four years.
Therefore, the shares and other inheritance hadn't been formally transferred to these two individuals yet.
Although not formally transferred, it was almost the same in practice, since they could still receive dividends and other payments.
After Shen Xing returned, she took the groceries she had bought and went into the kitchen to start cooking.
Of course, she was doing this voluntarily, because she wanted to perform well and become the virtuous wife and good mother in Zhou Wu's mother's eyes.
Even though her fiancé Zhou Wu had disappeared.
Meanwhile, in the living room.
Zhou Yan sat on the sofa and suddenly asked Zhou's mother: "Mom, what's the current situation at the Textile Factory? I heard it's in chaos again?"
Zhou's mother sighed and said: "After your father disappeared, although the factory was left without a leader, the shareholders quickly elected one shareholder to serve as temporary chairman. That shareholder was quite capable and was also one of your father's better friends."
"Originally, he was doing quite well as temporary chairman, but then something bizarre happened - can you believe it? Something strange occurred."
"His son suddenly disappeared!"
"And he only had that one son!"
"So now his mind isn't on work at all - he and his wife are putting all their energy into finding their son!!!!"
When Zhou Yan heard this, her delicate eyebrows furrowed: "Really? His son disappeared too?"
Zhou's mother nodded: "It's definitely true - how could anyone joke about something like this?"
"So now, the position of temporary chairman is vacant again."
Zhou Yan said: "No problem, with the position empty, plenty of people will surely step up to fill it."
Zhou's mother shook her head with a bitter smile: "Don't say that - surprisingly, no one is willing to step up."
Zhou Yan found this unbelievable: "How is that possible? Really?"
Zhou's mother said: "Your father disappeared first, then your brother disappeared afterwards."
"Everyone at the Textile Factory knows about this."
"Alive but unseen, dead but no corpse found."
"And then, this person whose son disappeared - before he became temporary chairman, his family was perfectly fine."
"But then shortly after he became temporary chairman, his son disappeared."
"So now among the factory's shareholders and mid-to-high-level management, especially among the shareholders, there's a rumor circulating that whoever takes the chairman position will have bad luck."
"They think that position is unlucky and prone to accidents. There might be something wrong with it."
"They've already found a master and are preparing to bring him in to take a look."
After hearing this, Li Miguo suddenly laughed: "No way, what era are we living in now? Still so superstitious?"
Zhou's mother glanced at him and said: "Nowadays, many wealthy people are quite superstitious, while many ordinary people are staunch materialists."
Zhou Yan asked: "Mom? Are you superstitious then?"
Zhou's mother's face was full of gravity, especially when thinking about this question - the many wrinkles on her face seemed to become deeper and more numerous when compressed by her expression.
"I was fine before, but now, with your father and your brother having incidents one after another, I... have also started to believe in these things somewhat."
"Forget it."
"Let's not talk about this anymore, let's not talk about it. You all sit here, I'm going to help Xiao Xing with the cooking."
After speaking, Zhou's mother stood up and walked into the kitchen, closing the kitchen door behind her.
Clearly, she didn't want to continue discussing such sad matters.
Now only Zhou Yan, Li Miguo, and Jimmy remained in the living room.
Zhou Yan then asked Jimmy: "Jimmy, you said last time you would help us find detectives - it's been so long, have you found any?"
Jimmy said: "I found one - a three-person detective team, but they're currently abroad."
Zhou Yan frowned: "Abroad? Didn't I say I wanted to find Hua Country detectives?"
Jimmy said: "They are Hua Country people, it's just that their current commission is overseas."
Zhou Yan asked: "Then how much does this three-person detective team charge?"
Jimmy said: "One million Hua yuan per person, three million Hua yuan total for three people."
When Zhou Yan heard this, she felt these three people charged much cheaper than Mike.
After all, Mike charged 1 million USD, which was 7 million Hua yuan.
Zhou Yan continued asking: "Then is this three-person team reliable?"
When Jimmy heard this, he immediately didn't know how to respond.
Last time, the American detective Mike they hired was among the top ten detectives in America.
Yet Zhou Yan said he was no good, unreliable.
The other party didn't take a single cent of the money and just left.
Even now Jimmy still felt sorry toward Mike.
After Mike returned to America, Jimmy contacted Mike by phone to continue apologizing to him.
And Mike was very broad-minded, saying that was his own choice not to take the money and he didn't blame anyone.
Therefore, regarding this Hua Country three-person team... how should he describe them?
Jimmy said: "About this Hua Country detective three-person team."
"Well... how should I put it? Your Hua Country isn't like America with very professional detective rankings."
"Your Hua Country's private detectives don't have rankings - they all rely on reputation and titles."
"For example, this three-person team."
"Title: Three Tigers Detective Group."
When Zhou Yan heard this, she seemed somewhat dissatisfied: "In that case, if these three people are fakes who randomly set high prices, wouldn't we be at a big loss?"
Jimmy shook his head: "Although there are no rankings, their reputation speaks for itself. Reputation often represents ability - though not absolutely certain, it's usually reliable, so you can rest assured."
Zhou Yan looked up at the ceiling.
Her snow-white face showed expression again.
She lowered her head and asked Jimmy: "These three people aren't enough."
"Help me find more Hua Country detectives."
"Preferably those who charge tens of thousands."
Jimmy narrowed his eyes: "What's your intention with this move?"
Zhou Yan crossed her arms, once again revealing her usual queen-like confidence:
"Naturally, more people means more hope."
"I won't make the mistake of placing all my hopes on a small number of people again."
"Plus, hiring more detectives allows us to create a bonus system - whoever finds the truth I'm looking for first gets the bonus."
"Let them compete fiercely against each other."
Zhou Yan looked exactly like a capitalist.

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Preparing to Depart, Macedonian Islands
chapters.content:
Li Miguo and Jimmy both fell silent after hearing this.
Because it really did seem like a good idea.
And just at that moment.
Jimmy suddenly said: "By the way, are you interested in going to Macedonia Island?"
"Macedonia Island? Where's that?"
Li Miguo asked.
Jimmy said: "It's in the Pacific Ocean. My classmate went there recently and gave me several tickets."
"These tickets cover all expenses on the island for free."
"Perfect for our group to go have some fun. Interested?"
Li Miguo wanted to go and looked at Zhou Yan for her opinion.Zhou Yan searched online for information about Macedonia Island.
She discovered the photos looked quite appealing.
Plus, she was someone who enjoyed traveling.
So she said: "Alright then, I see the photos of this Macedonia Island online show pretty good scenery."
"Though if you hadn't suddenly mentioned this, Jimmy, I was originally planning to visit Hawaii sometime soon."
Since returning to China, Zhou Yan hadn't accomplished much.
But her father and brother's disappearance had somewhat affected her mood anyway.
This trip would be a good opportunity to relax and clear her mind.
Jimmy said: "Okay, then it's settled. Let's prepare and we can depart soon."
...
Three days later.
Jiang Ran received his passport by express delivery.
This was much faster than he had expected.
After getting it, Jiang Ran followed Manager Xiao Zhang's instructions and took photos of his passport.
He sent them to Manager Xiao Zhang.
Just as he was looking forward to the Island Seven-Day Tour.
Suddenly, two messages arrived on his WeChat almost simultaneously, as if coordinated.
After reading these two messages, Jiang Ran felt quite surprised.
The people sending him WeChat messages were.
Those two guys from the previous class reunion.
The original host's close college friends.
The first was a chubby guy weighing 200 pounds and standing 5'7" tall.
The second was a shorter guy with average build, only 5'3" tall.
So what were these simultaneous messages to Jiang Ran about?
Well, during the last class reunion.
The chubby guy had mentioned meeting a girl through family introduction, dating through a matchmaking session, and getting engaged.
That's right, he was about to get married, so he was notifying Jiang Ran.
And the 5'3" shorter guy had also revealed during the class reunion that he was dating.
The other girl from the three guys and two girls group at the reunion, besides Wang Qingzhao - that average-looking, 5'3" tall girl.
They were in a relationship and about to get engaged too.
Shortly after the class reunion, they held their engagement ceremony.
Now messaging Jiang Ran was to inform him they were getting married soon and invite him to the wedding.
As for.
Why were both messaging him simultaneously?
The reason was that these two were planning to hold their weddings together.
Yes, quite shockingly, they were doing it together.
It should be said that this situation was quite rare.
Having weddings celebrated jointly.
But these two college friends of the original host were doing exactly that.
Jiang Ran replied to both, assuring them he would attend.
Jiang Ran checked the dates they provided and found their wedding dates were still far off.
At least not in the immediate future.
Thinking about these two getting married, Jiang Ran sent a WeChat message to Wang Qingzhao.
Asking if she had received notifications too.
After messaging Wang Qingzhao, she replied quickly.
Her message said she had also been notified.
Immediately after, Wang Qingzhao called him.
Jiang Ran was sitting in the management office, enjoying the air conditioning.
He answered the call.
Wang Qingzhao said on the phone: "Jiang Ran, have you decided how much cash gift to give?"
Jiang Ran: "One thousand! Anything less wouldn't look good."
Wang Qingzhao nodded: "I was thinking the same. I originally considered 600, for good luck, but given our relationship, that seems too little. One thousand is perfect, representing completeness."
Jiang Ran nodded, then suddenly asked: "Hey, Qingzhao, why do you sound so out of breath?"
Yes, from the moment he answered, Jiang Ran noticed Wang Qingzhao's breathing was particularly heavy.
Wang Qingzhao laughed and told Jiang Ran to wait a moment, not to hang up.
During the call, Jiang Ran noticed Wang Qingzhao had sent him several photos and a video on WeChat.
The photos appeared to be in some boxing gym.
The video showed Wang Qingzhao practicing boxing under a female coach's guidance.
Her entire body was drenched in sweat.
Her tight-fitting clothes clung closely to her slender figure.
Seeing this video.
Jiang Ran felt quite puzzled.
Searching through the original host's memories, he couldn't recall Wang Qingzhao having any interest in boxing before?
At most, she played tennis and golf.
So Jiang Ran asked Wang Qingzhao why she had started learning boxing?
Wang Qingzhao answered over the phone that she wasn't just learning boxing, but also Sanda, mixed martial arts, and other combat skills.
Jiang Ran inquired about the specific reason.
He asked if something had happened to Wang Qingzhao recently?
Otherwise, why would she suddenly start learning these things?
Wang Qingzhao gave him a simple answer - she had seen online that women's safety was a major concern recently.
Better to rely on yourself than others, so she was learning these skills for self-protection.
Of course, this was just to fool Jiang Ran - the real reason only Wang Qingzhao herself knew.
Perhaps Wang Qingzhao was learning these to facilitate certain activities she planned to undertake.
They chatted for a few more minutes before Wang Qingzhao hung up, saying she needed to resume her boxing training.
Jiang Ran then put down his phone.
"Hiss, should I spend money to learn boxing or something too?"
Jiang Ran considered it but decided against it.
Not enough money.
His funds were still needed for medication and treatment of his dissociative identity disorder!
...
Three days later, Jiang Ran received another express delivery.
Opening it, he found it contained a plane ticket and a boat ticket.
Plus something resembling an admission ticket printed with "Macedonia Island" wording.
Additionally, there was a printed sheet.
This printed sheet was just ordinary white paper, but it had text on it.
After reading this printed sheet, Jiang Ran instantly understood everything.
This printed sheet outlined the travel procedure.
Meaning that.
Jiang Ran would first take a domestic flight to a large island in the Pacific with an airport.
Since this place didn't belong to any country, it was open to all nations worldwide, requiring no visa.
Then at that large island, he would use the boat ticket to take a ship to Macedonia Island.
Upon reaching the island, he would hand the Macedonia Island admission ticket to staff members and could enjoy everything on the island completely free.
"Quite detailed indeed."
After reading the printed sheet, Jiang Ran picked up the plane ticket again.
Examining the plane ticket carefully, he suddenly noticed something wrong.
"Holy crap, this flight is in three days! I haven't prepared anything yet!"
...
After all, this was his first trip since transmigrating.
And it was international travel.
Jiang Ran thought three days would definitely be insufficient for preparation.
But when he actually started packing, he discovered he could get everything done in one day.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: First Class Flight
chapters.content:
Of course, before packing, Jiang Ran searched for the current weather conditions at Macedonia Island.
After all, it's summer domestically, while some places might be winter.
But after searching, he discovered Macedonia Island is also in summer season.
And that place experiences summer all year round.
Therefore, Jiang Ran packed some summer clothes for changing in his suitcase.
His toiletries, and then it seemed there wasn't anything else to prepare.
Oh, right, he almost forgot to bring the power bank.
This thing is literally a life-saving device for phones, especially in places without charging access.
Soon, three days had passed.
Around 7 AM, Jiang Ran arrived at the airport.The flight was at 9 o'clock.
After arriving at the airport, he began going through a series of procedures.
Among them was the most important one - security check.
During the security check, Jiang Ran encountered a minor issue.
Mainly, his power bank got confiscated.
Apparently it lacked the 3C certification mark.
Jiang Ran had recently seen this trending topic online.
But he didn't pay attention to it, only realizing his power bank was non-compliant when he brought it for the flight.
No choice, he could only obediently surrender it, joining the pile of non-compliant power banks as fellow sufferers in the same box.
After security, Jiang Ran began looking for his boarding gate.
By the time he found it, about ten minutes had passed, and it was already boarding time.
Jiang Ran began boarding.
The apartment was quite generous.
They bought Jiang Ran a first class ticket.
Before his transmigration, Jiang Ran had only flown three times.
All three flights were in economy class.
This was his first time ever flying first class.
Of course, comparatively speaking, Jiang Ran had more flight experience than many people.
After all, back on Earth, he had searched and found that about 1 billion people in his country had never flown on a plane.
...
The first class cabin.
Gave Jiang Ran the impression of spacious seats and luxury.
Plus the flight attendants were really beautiful.
After entering first class, Jiang Ran found his seat and sat down.
After sitting, he leaned back, closed his eyes, and began to relax.
Five minutes after closing his eyes, a group of chattering voices woke him up.
He didn't leave his seat, just leaned to one side and stretched his head back to look.
He discovered this chattering group was made of youthful men and women.
Their clothing and presence here proved they were also flying first class.
Initially Jiang Ran didn't pay much attention, thinking they were just rich second generation kids.
But soon he had to pay attention, because among these youthful, attractive men and women, he spotted several familiar faces.
He let out a soft sound of surprise.
And it seemed this soft surprised sound.
Also made those three familiar people notice Jiang Ran.
After seeing Jiang Ran, the three familiar faces first thought this person looked somewhat familiar, then seemed to remember something, before slowly widening their eyes with disbelief on their faces.
These three familiar people were precisely Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, and Ke Bei.
When Xiao Q saw Jiang Ran's familiar face, he thought his eyes were playing tricks on him, so he vigorously rubbed his eyes.
He discovered, yes, the familiar face hadn't changed at all.
He walked over, extremely surprised: "Jiang Ran, what are you doing here?"
Among the three, Xiao Q was most familiar with Jiang Ran.
Because back when he and two others - two of Xiao Peng's friends - were being chased by the young white man wielding a chainsaw.
They hid in Jiang Ran's home and were saved by Jiang Ran.
Therefore, he had the most direct contact with Jiang Ran among the three.
Jiang Ran said: "Of course I'm going to Macedonia Island for fun, you guys too?"
Xiao Q nodded.
Jiang Ran smiled: "What a coincidence then! Not just going to the same place, but actually bumping into each other on the same day!"
"Are these people all your friends too?"
Jiang Ran looked at the two men and four women beside Xiao Q.
These two men and four women were fundamentally quite different from Jiang Ran and the three others.
This fundamental difference was in their clothing.
The clothing of these two men and four women clearly showed they were wealthy people.
Besides that, the aura these six people carried was also that cultivated by money - a high-class flavor.
What's called temperament.
Many people have temperament, but many people don't.
Simply put, like scholarly refinement, or the thuggish vibe from street punks, etc.
Whereas Jiang Ran and his group were quite ordinary.
Ordinary clothing, and seemingly no particular temperament either.
"Yes, they're all my friends."
Xiao Q didn't introduce them in detail to Jiang Ran, just said this briefly.
Remember that first prize from Wangchuan Grain Pancakes that Ke Bei won?
There were four spots, right?
The three of them each took one, leaving one remaining. To avoid wasting it.
Xiao Q said he'd ask his childhood rich second generation friend who studied abroad in the UK, to see if he wanted to come.
Turned out this childhood friend gave Xiao Q plenty of face, directly expressing his willingness to go.
Of course, this childhood friend was quite bold too.
Besides planning to go to Macedonia Island with Xiao Q's group.
He also planned to bring his classmates and friends from the UK.
Meaning the five people among the two men and four women excluding himself.
Of course, these five people definitely paid for their own travel, without any so-called free first prize spots.
After all, these people who could study abroad definitely came from wealthy families, not lacking this travel money.
By now, Jiang Ran and these people had each settled into their seats.
Because it was first class, everyone had individual seats, with activity space and comfort definitely far surpassing other cabins.
Of course, the price was far surpassing too.
Now, they just waited for the plane to take off.
Before takeoff, Jiang Ran stood up and scanned the first class cabin.
He discovered that except for one empty seat, all others were occupied.
While standing, he saw Xiao Q talking with a handsome young man.
"Su Yang, let me ask you something, among those two girls with you earlier, which one is your girlfriend?"
Su Yang was Xiao Q's childhood friend.
Su Yang was very handsome and stood 180cm tall.
Therefore, he was a genuine tall, rich, and handsome guy.
Especially Su Yang's personal style, just like the "yang" (sun) character in his name.
He was a sunny, cheerful type of young man.
So he was very popular.
And whether it was from staying abroad too long or what.
Xiao Q clearly remembered that Su Yang used to be quite introverted back then. After not seeing him for many years, he unexpectedly transformed into a completely different type.
Heard this type was common abroad and quite popular with foreign white girls.
Whereas the reserved Eastern type seemed less popular.
Of course, Asian faces generally weren't very popular in various aspects abroad.
Except for Asian girls.
After all, the "easy girl" reputation was known worldwide.
"Oh, those two? They're both my girlfriends, why? You interested in them? Haha! If you like one of my girlfriends, sorry but I can't give her to you! Hahaha!"
Su Yang's voice was so loud that everyone in first class could hear, including the first class flight attendants.
"Uh..."
Xiao Q immediately felt somewhat awkward, because he had asked this question very quietly.
Of course, it wasn't because he actually fancied Su Yang's girlfriends, but because he felt such private questions should be asked quietly.
But Su Yang suddenly shouted like this.
And with that answer too - whether Su Yang felt awkward or not was unknown.
But Xiao Q himself felt quite awkward.
Especially since many pairs of eyes were now focused on him.

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Strange Relationship Between Man and Woman
chapters.content:
Of course, he also knew that Su Yang meant no harm.
Upon hearing this, Su Yang's two girlfriends also turned their heads with smiles.
Su Yang and his classmates and friends.
Two men and four women.
All could be considered handsome men and beautiful women.
It was quite rare for everyone to have such high average looks.
At this moment, Xiao Peng suddenly spoke up, asking Su Yang and the two girls.
"Um, Su Yang, and you two beautiful ladies, what I'm about to say next might be somewhat rude, but I really can't contain my curiosity anymore."
"I want to ask, when dating nowadays, isn't it usually one man and one woman? How can you two girls date the same guy simultaneously, and even know about each other? How are you able to accept this?"
Xiao Peng was extremely puzzled.How could two girls accept that their boyfriend had other girlfriends?
After all, back when he wanted to date two girls at once, Xiao Hua and Xiao Nuo.
He had failed and ultimately could only choose one of them.
Hearing this, the two girls.
One with long straight black hair and a sweet-looking appearance covered her mouth and laughed:
"Why wouldn't we be able to accept this? Those who can't accept it are just old-fashioned."
"Life is about being happy. Currently, I feel very happy with this kind of relationship model, so I accept it. If someday I feel unhappy, I'll end this relationship model."
The other girl had big pink wavy hair that was very eye-catching, especially since her facial skin was fairer than snow, making it particularly well-matched with her full head of pink hair.
She also nodded:
"Yes, that's what I think too."
"Life is just a few short decades, don't confine yourself to traditional rules. Your own happiness is the most important thing."
After getting their answers.
Xiao Peng felt that these overseas students who studied abroad really had somewhat different ways of thinking, a bit too open-minded.
Naturally, the others heard this too.
Ke Bei quietly said to Xiao Q: "This kind of relationship model is basically just not being responsible to each other, having fun first and thinking about consequences later?"
Xiao Q nodded.
He leaned back against the red seatback.
Feeling that he really didn't recognize his childhood friend anymore.
He had completely changed.
And Jiang Ran, sitting by the airplane window, naturally heard these conversations too.
His genuine thought was simple: That guy is really living the dream.
At this moment.
Several flight attendants with good figures, equally beautiful faces, and wearing deep red flight attendant uniforms entered the first-class cabin carrying pens and notebooks.
One of them, a young and beautiful flight attendant who looked about 25 years old.
Came to Jiang Ran's seat and knelt down beside it.
Speaking slowly in a gentle female voice:
"Hello, Mr. Jiang. The plane will take off in 20 minutes. Have you had breakfast? If not, would you like to have some breakfast?"
Jiang Ran stared at the pair of big eyes kneeling beside his seat.
Smelling the fresh perfume scent on her.
Thinking that first-class flight attendants and their service quality were indeed incomparable to economy class.
"I haven't had breakfast. What breakfast options do you have here?"
The young beautiful flight attendant continued in a voice even gentler than a girlfriend's:
"We have both Chinese and Western styles. Chinese style includes steamed buns and congee."
"For Western style, we have sausages and hot dogs."
"Then Chinese style please!"
"Okay."
The young beautiful flight attendant recorded in her notebook, then continued asking: "What would you like to drink? We have beverages, alcoholic drinks, and also tea."
For some reason, when he heard tea, he thought of Qin Kelian.
Jiang Ran said: "Sprite."
After recording this, the young beautiful flight attendant continued:
"Breakfast will be served half an hour after takeoff. If you fall asleep before meal service, may we wake you up?"
Jiang Ran: "Yes."
The young beautiful flight attendant smiled slightly at Jiang Ran: "Okay, then I wish Mr. Jiang a pleasant journey."
After questioning Jiang Ran, this young beautiful flight attendant immediately stood up and went to ask the next first-class passenger.
Jiang Ran stared at this flight attendant's back.
He had often heard before that flight attendants, male flight attendants, and pilots played around quite wildly.
And that flight attendants would actively slip small notes to passengers with their contact information and such.
Of course, Jiang Ran wouldn't entertain such thoughts, mainly because flight attendants like these were just appetizers for rich people.
The plane took off.
Half an hour after takeoff, sure enough, breakfast was delivered to Jiang Ran's side, along with the glass of Sprite he had ordered.
After eating, he felt somewhat sleepy, since he had woken up quite early in the morning.
So he put on the disposable eye mask prepared on the plane, reclined his seat back very flat, and began to sleep.
He didn't know how long he had slept.
His body felt somewhat sore and numb, so Jiang Ran, heavy with sleepiness, removed his eye mask and prepared to sit up.
But before he could sit up, after removing his eye mask, he coincidentally saw two figures walking together toward the restroom direction.
And those two figures, one was Xiao Q's friend—Su Yang, and the other was a beautiful flight attendant from first class.
Jiang Ran felt that something was about to happen next.
Sure enough, the two entered the restroom one after another, and a full five or six minutes passed without them coming out.
Jiang Ran felt thirsty, so he got up, wanting to get some water to drink. Of course, he actually intentionally passed by the area where Su Yang's two girlfriends were sitting.
He wanted to verify something.
Well, he passed by Su Yang's girlfriends' area.
He discovered that both of his girlfriends weren't sleeping, but were holding their phones reading novels.
It seemed they should also know about Su Yang and that flight attendant's situation, but why didn't they care at all?
Jiang Ran was extremely puzzled in his heart. You three dating together, you can accept that.
Your boyfriend immediately going to the restroom with another girl to do that kind of thing, and you can accept that too?
Aren't you disgusted?
Jiang Ran asked another flight attendant for a cup of mineral water.
Returning to his seat, he wasn't sleepy anymore and wanted to see what would happen next.
The subsequent development was that, after about 15 minutes.
Su Yang returned.
With a thoroughly satisfied expression, looking like he had enjoyed himself.
And that flight attendant also returned. Although her makeup and hairstyle had been specially arranged, the remaining rosy flush on both sides of her cheeks betrayed her.
Jiang Ran felt that he didn't know how many people were aware of this matter, but he felt that among the first-class cabin, he certainly wasn't the only one who knew.
After that, Jiang Ran didn't sleep anymore and also experienced the first-class flight attendants' excellent service.
That is, they would frequently come over to quietly ask if he needed anything, like drinks and such.
Of course, this was just routine procedure, don't overthink it.
After all, Jiang Ran didn't receive any small cards slipped to him by flight attendants.
Perhaps these first-class flight attendants usually encountered plenty of rich people.
They had developed fiery golden eyes like Sun Wukong.
Whether someone was truly rich or just a poor guy occasionally sitting in first class.
They could tell at a glance.
Since this journey lasted a full thirteen hours.
Those like Jiang Ran who had already slept once weren't sleepy anymore, so they didn't sleep further.
And in this first-class cabin, aside from Jiang Ran, the rest were Xiao Q and his group.
Out of boredom.
Xiao Q and these people who knew each other had been chatting continuously.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: The Flight Attendant Who Sent a Terrifying Letter
chapters.content:
What were they talking about?
Basically, Su Yang was telling Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, and Ke Bei about his experiences in the UK, from studying abroad in his first year of high school up to his current university life.
Since none of the three had ever been to the UK, Su Yang's stories were particularly fascinating to them.
Of course, Su Yang also emphasized his romantic encounters with various white girls.
Eventually, the conversation drifted to Macedonia Island in the Pacific Ocean.
Su Yang said a lot, but the general idea was that Macedonia Island wasn't a particularly popular tourist destination.
He didn't know what the island was actually like.
He hoped it wouldn't be too bad, and so on.
Naturally, none of the people present, including Su Yang himself, had ever visited Macedonia Island for vacation.
Xiao Q and the other two weren't particularly concerned about what Macedonia Island was actually like.After all, it was a free trip that didn't cost them any money.
Just seeing the ocean and swimming in the sea would be enough.
They weren't thinking about anything beyond that.
Jiang Ran felt pretty much the same. Since he didn't have to pay out of his own pocket anyway.
Therefore, their tolerance for whatever Macedonia Island might be like was exceptionally broad, just like the sea itself.
And these poor souls in first class.
Had absolutely no idea what awaited them on Macedonia Island.
Two more hours passed, and then a male flight attendant in uniform suddenly entered the first class cabin.
After entering first class, this male flight attendant handed an envelope to every passenger in the cabin.
Then he left the first class cabin without saying a word.
His actions were quite strange.
Jiang Ran naturally received one of these envelopes too.
Written on the kraft paper envelope with a black gel pen were the words: "Do not open until five minutes after receiving this letter, or misfortune will befall you!"
"Hmph."
Jiang Ran let out a disdainful laugh as he looked at these words.
As a youth of the new era, how could he possibly be frightened by some mere superstitious nonsense about misfortune?
Therefore, he placed the letter on his thigh and started timing five minutes before he would open it.
"Hey, you all received this letter too, right?"
The plane was currently flying steadily in the stratosphere.
Su Yang stood up, holding the letter high in his right hand as he looked around at everyone.
"I got one."
"Me too."
"Same here."
Everyone who wasn't sleeping responded.
Those who had been sleeping were woken up by the commotion and discovered the letters.
"Hey, this letter says not to open it until five minutes later, or misfortune will strike!"
"What do you think? Should we open it now, or wait five minutes?"
Su Yang looked at the others.
To be honest, most people definitely wouldn't believe in this kind of so-called misfortune curse.
But such things are somewhat unsettling anyway.
Therefore, not many people dared to test their luck.
It's like how some people don't believe in Buddhism or bodhisattvas.
But if you asked them to smash Buddha or bodhisattva statues, how many would actually be willing to do it?
Very few.
Most people maintain the attitude that they might not believe, but they should still respect these things, afraid that if they did smash them, something bad might actually happen to them.
This letter was currently in the same category.
And everyone in first class was waiting for someone to take the lead.
Just like when Chen Sheng and Wu Guang started their rebellion back in the day.
Ke Bei, being a detective, was the first to step up.
He opened his letter in front of everyone in the first class cabin.
To be honest, Ke Bei had been a detective for many years.
If you asked him whether he believed in superstitious or paranormal things.
He would only tell you that he had encountered some strange and eerie occurrences.
Things that couldn't be explained by science.
But he felt that no matter how terrifying these so-called paranormal events might be, they weren't as terrifying as people.
And the most terrifying thing he had encountered so far was Alice Apartment.
He didn't know whether misfortune would kill you or not, but Alice Apartment would kill anyone who entered.
So, could this letter possibly be more terrifying than Alice Apartment?
He opened the letter, which contained a single white A4 sheet of paper.
After Ke Bei opened it and saw what was on the paper, he was quite surprised.
He stood there motionless, his lips slightly parted.
Seeing this, Xiao Q and Xiao Peng quickly walked over and craned their necks to look.
They too froze on the spot.
The others were also very curious.
They wanted to go over and see.
Ke Bei said, "No need to come over, I'll show you."
Ke Bei turned the white paper from the letter around.
Allowing everyone to see it.
Jiang Ran also stood up and looked in that direction.
Similarly, when he saw the content on the white paper, he also stood there stunned.
So, what was on the white paper?
What could make so many people freeze like that?
It was quite simple—the white paper didn't contain anything complicated.
Just a single character: "horse".
Yes, there was only one large character "horse" that occupied about half of the A4 paper.
This allowed people at a certain distance to see it clearly.
Also, it was because no one had expected that after such frightening words on the kraft paper envelope.
The inside would contain not some long message, but actually just a single character.
This was what shocked everyone.
"The five minutes are up, let's all open them together!"
After a while, Su Yang said.
Su Yang was the second to open his. After opening it, he showed the content of his white paper to everyone.
It was a "that" character.
Immediately after, more people opened theirs.
They were all individual characters.
Some had "far".
Some had "have".
Some had "sea" and similar characters.
Jiang Ran also opened his envelope, which contained a "pause" character.
Su Yang scratched his head at this point, unable to figure out what these things were.
It was Ke Bei who said, "This should be a sentence that's been split into individual characters."
"Everyone, bring all your characters over."
At Ke Bei's call.
Everyone handed over their white papers.
Soon, Ke Bei assembled them into a sentence:
Stay away from Macedonia Island!
Over there has
"What does this sentence mean? 'Stay away from Macedonia Island! Over there has'—has what?"
Xiao Q didn't understand.
Ke Bei looked around left and right: "This sentence is obviously incomplete. Check if there are any more envelopes anywhere?"
Just then.
Xiao Peng brought three envelopes from the only empty, unoccupied seat in first class.
"Here!"
He opened the three envelopes and obtained one character from each.
And the sentence was finally complete!
【Stay away from Macedonia Island!
There is great danger over there!】
When they saw this sentence.
A sense of bewilderment and confusion rose in everyone's hearts.
"Danger? Great danger? What kind of danger could that island possibly have?"
Su Yang, chewing gum that seemed to come from nowhere, spoke while chewing.
The others were also very puzzled.
Ke Bei said, "We just need to find that male flight attendant who gave us the letters and ask him what this means?"
Su Yang nodded, then he went and found a flight attendant.
The very flight attendant he had been intimate with.
He told this flight attendant about the male flight attendant and the letters.
Upon hearing this, the flight attendant furrowed her willow-like eyebrows, took these items, and went to find other flight attendants, as well as the chief purser responsible for everything in the passenger cabin.
Soon, the chief purser of this flight learned about the matter.
After asking the people in first class about that male flight attendant's appearance.
She began to take action, preparing to bring that male flight attendant over.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Little Q and Ke Bei Discover the Truth About Macedonia Island
chapters.content:
That male flight attendant was responsible for the economy class section.
After this male flight attendant was brought over.
The female chief purser in her thirties sternly questioned him about why he was distributing these letters to first class passengers and what he intended to do.
Faced with the chief purser's questioning, this male flight attendant unusually remained silent.
This male flight attendant didn't answer questions and maintained silence.
This wasn't just about avoiding questions, but also a challenge to the chief purser's authority.
Next, the chief purser began verbal threats.
Of course, the so-called verbal threats were nothing more than saying there would be internal penalties for this behavior.
For example, verbal or written warnings.
Flight suspensions, written self-criticisms.Of course, these were still relatively light.
In serious cases, his career might be directly terminated.
But this male flight attendant simply wouldn't speak and remained silent.
Seeing that the male flight attendant refused to speak, the chief purser had no choice.
After all, she had used every verbal threat possible.
Yet the other person completely ignored her.
Of course, having done something like this, it was believed this male flight attendant had already considered the corresponding consequences.
Finally having no other options, the chief purser could only apologize to everyone in first class, including Jiang Ran and the others.
Then she had others take the male flight attendant back.
Immediately as an apology.
The chief purser had the first class flight attendants immediately serve snacks and tea.
Of course, after that wave of kraft paper letters, everyone in first class's attention was no longer on these delicious snacks and tea.
All their focus was on ["Stay away from Macedonia Island!
There's great danger there!"]
This statement.
"Ke Bei, what do you think?"
Xiao Q asked Ke Bei at this moment.
Ke Bei said: "According to what the chief purser and other flight attendants just said."
"This male flight attendant didn't just give them to us, he distributed them to all passengers in other cabins too."
"Currently, everyone in our first class is definitely going to Macedonia Island, but we don't know if anyone from other cabins is going."
"So it's not specifically targeted at us."
"But regardless of whether it's intentionally targeting us or not, the problem we face now is whether this statement is true or false, and whether we should still go to the island to play?"
Xiao Peng seemed to think of something and said in Xiao Q's ear: "Do you think Macedonia Island might really be dangerous? After all, who among us could have imagined that Alice Apartment would also be filled with deadly traps?"
Xiao Q narrowed his eyes, smacking his lips thoughtfully.
At this moment.
Another male student among the international student friends with Su Yang.
Wearing the disposable slippers provided on the plane.
Yawning, stood up and said: "Alright, I was sleeping quite well, but now I've been woken up because of this nonsense."
"Waking me up is one thing, but you're actually sitting here discussing whether what's written here is true?"
"Come on, this is definitely fake!"
"This kind of thing is clearly a business tactic."
"My dad has used similar business tactics before to ruin a tourist destination, saying the place was haunted."
"If you don't believe me, you can ask the flight attendants on this plane - they frequently fly this route and should know whether that Macedonia Island is dangerous or not, and what it's really like."
Su Yang and the others thought this made sense.
Therefore, Su Yang immediately called over several first class flight attendants.
Sure enough, many flight attendants said they knew about Macedonia Island.
But only two flight attendants had actually visited and played there.
And according to these two flight attendants' testimonies.
Macedonia Island was very fun, with excellent hotel service.
As for danger, they didn't feel there was any danger - it was just a normal tourist island.
Hearing this.
Su Yang immediately laughed heartily: "Looks like it's just as my friend said - it's a tactic cooked up by business competitors aiming to ruin Macedonia Island."
This settled the matter.
Because of this, everyone in first class immediately relaxed.
No one took that male flight attendant's letter seriously anymore.
Jiang Ran felt the same way - he also thought what Su Yang's UK study abroad classmate said was quite reasonable.
It should just be a business tactic created by competitors!
At this moment.
Xiao Q and Ke Bei exchanged glances, then both went to the restroom together.
Inside the restroom.
Xiao Q said: "Ke Bei, you probably think the same as me - that this likely isn't some business tactic created by competitors, right?"
Ke Bei remained silent for a moment, then said: "To be honest, if I hadn't seen Jiang Ran on this plane, I would think it's a business tactic."
