Xiao Q said: "I know what you're thinking. According to our speculation, inside Alice Apartment, aside from unlucky people like us who signed agreements to enter, there were all kinds of deranged criminals. So you think Jiang Ran is a deranged criminal?"
Ke Bei said: "Jiang Ran saved you before, and my overall impression of Jiang Ran doesn't seem like those deranged criminals - he seems like an ordinary person."
Xiao Q frowned: "Then let's assume he's like us - an unlucky person who signed an agreement to enter."
"Then what's the story behind him so coincidentally appearing on the same plane as us, going to the exact same destination?"
Both Xiao Q and Ke Bei felt things were becoming increasingly complicated.
Actually, when they first encountered Jiang Ran in the first class cabin of the plane.
They had already felt suspicious - how could it be such a coincidence?
But they didn't take it too seriously, thinking it might genuinely be fate.
Especially since Xiao Q still remembered Jiang Ran's life-saving grace from before.
After all, back then, when they were fleeing, only Jiang Ran had opened his door, even though they had forced their way in...
So Xiao Q and Ke Bei hadn't discussed this suspicion with each other at the time, only thinking about it privately.
Next, the two left the restroom.
To verify some things, Xiao Q went to Jiang Ran's side and pretended to chat casually: "By the way, Jiang Ran, I haven't asked yet - what a coincidence that we're all going to Macedonia Island on the same day. What made you think of going there to play?"
Jiang Ran, thinking it was just ordinary conversation, said: "Apartment benefits."
Xiao Q was startled: "Apartment benefits? Can you elaborate?"
Jiang Ran said: "Not long after I moved into the apartment, I became the assistant manager."
"Then, this apartment benefit actually belonged to Manager Xiao Zhang."
"He said there's an annual free apartment trip, and this time it's Macedonia Island, but he has thalassophobia so he gave it to me."
"Hey, why are you asking in such detail?"
"By the way, you're asking how I got to go - I wanted to ask how you got to go too?!"
Xiao Q said: "I came because Ke Bei won first prize at the Wangchuan Grain Pancakes shop in the city. Free travel."
Jiang Ran was stunned, then smiled: "What a coincidence! I won first prize at that pancake shop before too!"
Hearing this, Xiao Q felt like he'd been struck by lightning internally.
But on the surface, he still pretended to be calm.
"What was your first prize?"
Jiang Ran said quietly: "An Alice Apartment unit."
"Otherwise, how do you think an ordinary person like me could afford to live there?"
Xiao Q was completely dumbfounded at this point.
He returned somewhat dazed to Ke Bei's side and told him what had just happened.
Both were intelligent people.
Although they didn't know the truth, if Jiang Ran wasn't lying, then based on everything, that pancake shop probably had problems...
Thinking about it now, when have domestic businesses ever been so conscientious?
Looking back now, it all feels like traps.
Then, returning to this Macedonia Island seven-day tour.
Combining two points: Jiang Ran's Alice Apartment prize was an extremely dangerous place.
Then the Macedonia Island seven-day tour they won - could it also be an extremely dangerous place?
"Wait, Macedonia Island seven-day tour? Seven days? Isn't that the same as the seven-day agreement we signed to live in Alice Apartment?"
At this point, these two increasingly felt that it might be exactly as the male flight attendant's statement said.
That Macedonia Island has great danger - this might actually be true.
The two went to the restroom together again.
Ke Bei said: "It's still not too late to not go to Macedonia Island now. Anyway, after getting off the plane, we'll be on another island. Only afterwards do we take a boat to Macedonia Island. Now it depends on what Xiao Peng says?"
Xiao Q said: "If we tell Xiao Peng about this, he'll definitely choose not to go too. After all, everyone was quite terrified in the apartment."
"But this trip - it won't work! I also invited Su Yang, and Su Yang invited his classmates and friends!"
"If I back out halfway, what would Su Yang think?"
"And if I tell him these truths? Would he believe me?"
"He absolutely wouldn't! Instead, he'd think I'm messing with him halfway!"
"I brought him here, so I have to take responsibility!"
Ke Bei leaned against the washbasin, thinking for a long time.
Then, he said quietly to Xiao Q: "Maybe our earlier speculations were all wrong, and there's no danger on this trip."
Xiao Q remained silent.
Ke Bei: "Of course, that's optimism. Even if I say there's no danger, you wouldn't believe it."
"And assuming there is danger, I don't think the danger would be greater than Alice Apartment."
"Think about it - Alice Apartment was a confined space."
"While that island is a tourist destination - besides us, there will definitely be other tourists."
"With so many people, generally it's not easy for incidents to occur."
"Having many people around brings a sense of security."
Xiao Q looked up and said: "How about this, Ke Bei - you tell Xiao Peng the truth later, and the two of you don't go. I'll accompany them alone. They came because I invited them, so I have to take responsibility for them."
Xiao Q was quite a good person, at least at this moment not considering running away alone.
Ke Bei smiled: "Do you think Xiao Peng and I would do something like that?"
"After all, we're partners who've been through life and death together."
"As for if there really is danger on the island..."
"To be honest, people face many dangers in life, and it's not like you can avoid them just by knowing about them."
"Just like before I signed the agreement to enter Alice Apartment, I already felt that apartment wasn't simple, but didn't I still go in?"
'Knowing there are tigers in the mountains, yet deliberately heading for the tiger mountains.'
"That's what makes life exciting."
"And if, after we go to the island, we might die there."
"Then that's fate."
"I accept it."
Xiao Q looked at Ke Bei before him, feeling that Ke Bei had a certain radiance about him.
A radiance of facing life and death with complete openness.
Ke Bei noticed Xiao Q looking at him strangely.
He quickly coughed a few times: "Of course, when facing danger, we should still try our best to survive. It's not about waiting to die when danger comes."
Xiao Q smiled slightly: "It's really good to know you."
As everyone knows, airplane restrooms aren't very spacious.
Economy class ones are smallest, only accommodating one person - two people would be crowded.
While first class restrooms, though larger than economy class ones.
Only accommodate two or three people.
Therefore, the longer the two stayed.
The more the air between their mouths and noses circulated between them.
Both inexplicably felt that if this atmosphere continued, it would become somewhat awkward.
Just then, someone knocked on the door from outside, finally ending this atmosphere that neither knew how to conclude.
The one knocking was Jiang Ran.
When Jiang Ran saw the restroom door open.
He absolutely didn't expect there to be more than one person inside - there were two people.
What? Are you two using the restroom together???
If Jiang Ran didn't have stomach pains, he would have definitely questioned them properly.
There's only one toilet in this restroom - how did you two use it?!
The two were also somewhat embarrassed. After returning to their seats.
They temporarily decided not to tell Xiao Peng about the matter.
They thought that if something really happened on the island, they would tell him then.
If nothing happened, they would treat it as an ordinary trip.
No need to spoil Xiao Peng's mood.
...
After that, the flight proceeded quite normally, with no more unexpected incidents.
And Jiang Ran also discovered a characteristic of first class flight attendants.
That their service was truly impeccable.
They would come around frequently asking passengers if they needed anything.
To the point that passengers were getting somewhat annoyed.
...
The plane reached its destination in the early morning of the next day, in the darkness of night.
Of course, the destination mentioned here.
Was Wilson Island, one of the large Pacific island groups with an airport.
After Jiang Ran and the other first class passengers arrived at Wilson Island Airport.
They encountered two people there to meet them.
These two people meeting them were specially arranged by Macedonia Island to be responsible for passengers going to Macedonia Island for vacation.
Both people meeting them were quite young, in their twenties or thirties.
Wearing black professional attire.
One male, one female, both white with blond hair and blue eyes.
Both were above average in appearance.
When Jiang Ran saw these two people meeting them.
Looking at the tall signs with Chinese characters they were holding, and knowing their identity.
He felt he was doomed for what came next.
Because he didn't know foreign languages.
He could only follow others around like a headless fly, doing whatever others did.
But to Jiang Ran's great surprise, these two people meeting them could speak Chinese.
And their Chinese was extremely fluent.
If you covered their faces, probably no one would guess that someone with such authentic Chinese would be foreigners.
The two people successfully met Jiang Ran and the others.
Then took them outside the airport and boarded a luxury coach.
Together heading to the pre-arranged hotel.
The hotel was very luxurious.
With a strong Western modern style.
After arriving at the hotel, Jiang Ran and the others each pulled their own suitcases and received their hotel room keys from the people who met them.
Then, they received this notification:
The ship heading to Macedonia Island would depart in three days.
Everyone, please stay at the hotel for these three days. Of course, if you want to explore this current Wilson Island, that's also possible, but please pay attention to the time and don't miss the ship departure in three days.
Otherwise, the next ship would be much later.
After announcing this, the two people who met them left.
As soon as they left.
Su Yang and the others pulled their suitcases, carried their bags, and headed to their hotel rooms one by one.
Jiang Ran also followed behind them, as their rooms were all arranged on the same floor.
Jiang Ran's hotel room was 1509 on the 15th floor.
He swiped his key card, entered the hotel room, inserted the key card into the power card slot below the light switch inside the door - only this way would the room have electricity.
After inserting it, Jiang Ran turned on the light, and immediately the room brightened up.
Jiang Ran could see everything in the hotel room clearly.
He briefly looked around the hotel room.
He was quite satisfied with this hotel room.
Especially the balcony, which was quite spacious, but since it was currently early morning and pitch black outside, he couldn't see what the actual view was like.
And within the entire room, what Jiang Ran was most satisfied with was the bed.
When Jiang Ran lay on this bed, it was neither too soft nor too hard, extremely comfortable.
And very large, allowing him to roll around freely.
While Jiang Ran was continuously rolling around on the bed.
Some people who had the Black Software received a message.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Boarding the Ship, Special Live Stream Begins
chapters.content:
Domestically.
In Binhai City.
Inside a room in the villa home of I am the Hero—Wang Baobao.
Wang Baobao was currently sitting naked on the bed, fiddling with a phone.
It was unclear what he saw on the phone, but he very excitedly ran out of the room.
After he stood up, one could notice that on the large bed where he had just been sitting.
On the pink bedsheet lay a snow-white, slender figure.
Clearly, what had just happened spoke for itself.
And this beautiful woman wasn't Wang Baobao's girlfriend, just an unknown domestic model he had found.
Wang Baobao ran out of his room.Excitedly knocking on the neighboring room's door.
While knocking, he shouted loudly: "Something major happened! Bro!"
The neighboring room door was knocked many times before finally opening.
After it opened, what greeted him was the dark face of Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng.
"Damn you, man, I just finished, do you know that knock of yours almost made me go soft."
"Uh..."
Hearing this, Wang Baobao was very confused:
"No way, you took that long? You entered your room more than an hour before me?!"
Lin Feng grew somewhat impatient: "Alright, alright, Baobao, first tell me what major thing happened?"
Lin Feng deliberately changed the subject.
Wang Baobao didn't mind, and before speaking, he stood on tiptoes, craning his neck hard to peer over Ultimate Rich Kid's head, seeing a woman inside the room on the large bed who also had a proud figure and beautiful face.
That woman wasn't Lin Feng's girlfriend Wang Ziyi, similarly just an unknown domestic model.
In this world.
If you have money, you can play with all kinds of beautiful women.
But if you have no money, you can only watch these people play with all kinds of beautiful women on your phone.
Of course, there's actually a high probability you won't even see that, because these people might not have the special hobby of recording videos.
Wang Baobao immediately pulled Lin Feng, who was wrapped in a white towel, to another room, closed the door, and raised his phone.
Lin Feng didn't pay attention at first, but later, after clearly seeing what was on Wang Baobao's screen.
His eyes widened greatly.
So, what was on Wang Baobao's phone?
It was the Black Software interface homepage, giving the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room a prominent featured position.
Then, clicking into this feature.
Entering the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
You could see the following situation.
[Special live stream opens in three days, Asian Level lab rats and criminals' mutual slaughter]
Black Software usually has these types of advertisement feature spots.
But forget Lin Feng, even Wang Baobao had never seen the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room featured there.
They thought this live stream room didn't need featuring because its popularity was always number one.
As for something like this, a live stream opening countdown.
Neither of them had seen that before.
Because in previous rounds they had watched, there were never broadcast countdowns—they always just started broadcasting, waiting for you to click in and watch...
Therefore, this matter showed the importance of this special live stream.
And it wasn't just these two.
Many people domestically who had Black Software, like Middle-aged Uncle, Domineering Female CEO—anyone who picked up their phone at this time and opened Black Software could also see this matter.
Similarly, Diamond Bachelor, who currently maintained first place in the win rate rankings of Hua Country's Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room, wasn't sleeping at this time either and also saw this matter.
However, she wasn't particularly excited, just hoping Jiang Ran would die in this special live stream.
...
Jiang Ran spent three days on this Wilson Island.
During these three days, he discovered one difference between this island and some domestic tourist islands.
That was, on this Pacific Ocean island, the sex industry was legal and compliant.
Moreover, on this island, many women worked in this industry, including yellow race, white, and black women—all three types were present.
And many were the kind with pretty faces and good figures.
Of course, these types also had higher prices.
Because Jiang Ran had saved Xiao Q's life at Alice Apartment.
So when Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, and Ke Bei followed Su Yang and those international students wandering around Wilson Island, he also tagged along.
It was during this accompanying journey.
On the beach.
They saw a mixed-race girl with an incredible figure.
Her age was unclear, but her nationality was known—Brazilian.
Reportedly of eight-country mixed heritage.
This mixed-race girl also worked in that kind of business.
Wearing a sexy bikini while sunbathing on the beach.
When Su Yang saw this mixed-race girl, his eyes lit up, and then this international student went up to flirt, finally reaching a transaction for 300 USD.
After making the deal, Jiang Ran would always remember how this guy gave them all a "hehe" laugh, then left with the mixed-race girl.
Even though they knew beforehand about Su Yang's relationship dynamics with his two girlfriends.
Seeing him casually take a prostitute away like that.
Those two girlfriends instead showed no reaction.
Jiang Ran, along with Xiao Q and the other two, were extremely puzzled.
In contrast, Su Yang's international student friends and classmates acted completely nonchalant.
Taking it as commonplace.
Of course, the sex industry wasn't exclusively for male clients;
female clients were also served.
For example, those four female international students with Su Yang seemed to be playing quite wildly too.
Of course, the wildness was only temporary.
Their main battlefield was Macedonia Island, not Wilson Island where they only stayed for three days.
At 7 AM three days later.
Wilson Island's dock gathered large numbers of tourists.
These tourists included people from various countries, different ethnic faces gathered here.
Led by the two people who had picked them up at the airport.
Jiang Ran and the others boarded the ship heading to Macedonia Island.
This ship carried many tourists besides Jiang Ran's group.
All the other people were also heading to Macedonia Island for tourism.
Because of the large crowd, the ship was exceptionally lively.
After boarding, Jiang Ran went to the ship's deck after settling his luggage.
Standing on the deck, looking back, they were getting farther from the dock.
Looking forward, ahead was the blue, endless sea.
Gazing at this scene, he couldn't help but feel exceptionally relaxed and comfortable.
Especially with the salty sea breeze blowing against his face, adding to the ocean's charm.
While these people enjoyed the ship's high-end services and the beautiful sea views.
They completely didn't know that every move of the entire ship was being transmitted through countless cameras in every corner of the ship directly into some people's visual fields.
The Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room's special live stream had officially begun the moment Jiang Ran and the others started boarding the ship.
In distant Hua Country.
Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng and I am the Hero Wang Baobao were in Wang Baobao's villa bedroom, using Wang Baobao's 24-inch screen, worth over 70,000, computer display to watch the live stream.
The two had been waiting for half an hour before the live stream started.
Finally, it began!

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Six Beautiful Hosts
chapters.content:
The two of them were definitely using the account of I am the Hero—Wang Baobao.
Because Lin Feng's account was still currently in a state where he couldn't log in.
After the two of them entered the live stream room.
They saw the live stream room's title was:
[Neighbors Over Distant Relatives Live Stream Room - Asian Level]
[Hua Country, Cherry Blossom Country, Korea, Tai Country, A San Country, Big Fur Country]
Looking at these country names, the two guessed this should be the Alice Apartments from each country participating in this special live stream.
Immediately after seeing this, the two saw the live stream room's viewer count.
A terrifyingly high number of over five million people were in the online live stream room.
It seemed this was likely the result of temporarily combining the live stream rooms of the Alice Apartments from all these countries together.And one terrifying aspect of combining them was that the chat messages in the live stream room were flying by absurdly fast.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—you couldn't even finish reading one message before it was drowned in a sea of text.
But soon, the terrifying speed of the live stream chat inexplicably slowed down.
I am the Hero Wang Baobao typed out a Chinese message using the keyboard:
[Hello everyone.]
Then, when he tried to send another message, he discovered he had to wait one hour for his next message.
This made Wang Baobao curse out loud with a "Holy shit!"
So that was the reason the message speed had slowed down.
Of course, that wasn't all.
There were many other changes to this live stream room.
Lin Feng and Wang Baobao discovered that Wang Baobao's screen name in the live stream room had changed from simply [I am the Hero]
to [Hua—I am the Hero].
This was to distinguish which country each person was from.
Besides this, the two also discovered.
That in this live stream room, everyone's chat messages appeared in Chinese, using Chinese characters...
This was very strange.
Even if some of these over five million people knew Chinese, it was impossible for all of them to know it, right?
Therefore, the two guessed it was probably set up by the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
All languages were machine-translated.
For example, when Wang Baobao looked at messages from people of other countries in his live stream room, they were all in Chinese.
And when a person from Cherry Blossom Country looked at their live stream room, messages from people of other countries would all be in Japanese.
They were pre-translated by machine.
This way, it was great—communication was barrier-free.
Of course, that one-hour cooldown after sending one message was extremely frustrating.
Then, there was still more.
In the live stream video, the two remembered that every time a live stream started, it was the Long-haired Beautiful Host in a completely black studio.
But this time was different.
At the start, it was still a studio.
Behind her was a massive electronic screen.
But the hosts had changed to six people.
Meaning, the hosts from the Alice Apartments of each country had all come.
Furthermore, all six of these hosts were women.
And, without exception, they were all beautiful women.
Especially since their types and styles were all different.
Looking at them was truly a feast for the eyes.
At this moment, Lin Feng and Wang Baobao were admiring the elegant demeanor of the six beautiful female hosts.
And discussing the distinctive features of the beautiful women from each country.
Just as they were discussing which one they would choose if they had to pick one from these six beautiful hosts,
something they never expected suddenly happened.
The Long-haired Beautiful Host from Hua Country suddenly spoke, formally beginning this special live stream.
This was faster than they had imagined.
The Long-haired Beautiful Host said:
"Welcome, friends from various countries, to this Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream."
"This is a special live stream, Asian Level."
"We hope everyone enjoys the viewing process."
The Long-haired Beautiful Host's voice was pleasant and beautiful.
After the Long-haired Beautiful Host from Hua Country finished speaking,
it was then the turn of the beautiful host from Cherry Blossom Country to continue speaking and hosting.
This beautiful host from Cherry Blossom Country had her hair in a ponytail and wore makeup popular in Cherry Blossom Country.
She opened her mouth and spoke a stream of Japanese.
Naturally, Lin Feng and Wang Baobao couldn't understand it.
But fortunately, there was machine-translated Chinese text below the live stream.
The Cherry Blossom Country Beautiful Host said: "This live stream is a special live stream, Asian Level. The countries include Hua Country, Cherry Blossom Country, Korea, Tai Country, A San Country, and Big Fur Country—six Asian nations."
"The special live stream is quite similar to the usual live streams."
"But there is one difference: the deranged criminals and deranged serial killers in the special live stream must kill one lab rat during the live stream period. Otherwise, when the special live stream ends, those who haven't completed the task will be executed."
After the Cherry Blossom Country Beautiful Host finished,
it was the turn of the Korean Beautiful Host.
This Korean Beautiful Host wore a gray and black outfit, the typical professional secretary attire of an office white-collar worker.
Beneath her black, long, form-fitting pencil skirt was a pair of incredibly long, beautiful legs wrapped in black stockings.
This kind of secretary outfit really accentuated her figure.
Whether it was her full upper body or her slender lower body.
Similarly, this Korean Beautiful Host had an exquisitely pretty face that clearly had undergone surgery, very characteristic of Korean beauties.
Even though she had work done, it didn't matter;
as long as she was pretty, who cared if she was artificial.
Many white foreigners couldn't distinguish between people from Hua Country, Cherry Blossom Country, and Korea.
But people from these three countries could easily tell each other apart.
Because their clothing styles, fashion, and makeup were all different.
There were very obvious distinctions.
The Korean Beautiful Host now spoke: "The location for this special live stream is Macedonia Island in the Pacific Ocean."
"This is an isolated island, far away from other islands."
"The scenery on the island is beautiful."
"The lab rats will spend a wonderful seven days and seven nights on this island. I really envy them."
"And the lab rats participating in this special live stream are not ordinary lab rats either."
"They are all very impressive lab rats who have survived four rounds in the Alice Apartments of the six countries."
Currently, watching this Korean Beautiful Host on the computer screen, who kept ending her sentences with "seumnida, seumnida,"
the Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng narrowed his eyes, a smile on his lips:
"Honestly, I simply can't resist this type of Korean beauty in secretary professional wear. Seeing them makes me want to conquer them."
Wang Baobao looked and nodded: "Indeed, Korean women have a certain sexiness about them that really stirs a man's desire to conquer."
The Korean Beautiful Host finished this segment, pausing here.
Next, it was the turn of the Tai Country Beautiful Host.
For Tai Country, the first impression most Hua Country people had was of ladyboys.
Especially since among Tai Country ladyboys, there were quite a few with super high levels of attractiveness.
More alluring than many biological women.
But few people knew that many Tai Country women were actually quite beautiful.
Especially since there were many mixed-race people in Tai Country.
For example, this Tai Country Beautiful Host was a mixed-race individual.
The Tai Country Beautiful Host spoke in Tai language, which sounded very funny to Hua Country listeners: "Next, I will introduce the lab rats for this special live stream."
"There are a total of 10 lab rats in this special live stream."
"Next, we will begin introducing the lab rats. The following ranking is in no particular order."
It seemed they were afraid that introducing some lab rats earlier or later might cause many people in the live stream room to argue, feeling certain countries were being deliberately targeted.
So, they specifically emphasized this point.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 10 Lab Rats
chapters.content:
Tai Country Beautiful Host:
"Lab Rat Number 1, Jiang Ran, from Hua Country."
"Male, 23 years old. Before entering Hua Country's Alice Apartment, he was an ordinary office worker. After entering, he became the apartment's assistant manager."
"Unlike the vast majority of lab rats who signed agreements, he belongs to the special category of lab rats who entered the apartment differently."
"Lab Rat Number 2, Fang Xiao, from Hua Country, male, 29 years old, unemployed, a retired boxer."
The Tai Country Beautiful Host first introduced the two lab rats from Hua Country.
After she finished her introduction, the large electronic screen behind her began displaying photos of Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao like a slideshow.
In the live stream room.
Cherry Blossom Country - Yamamoto Colonel: [Not easy at all! Our friendly neighbor Hua Country has finally produced two lab rats who survived four rounds. Truly remarkable!]
The live stream room seemed very considerate, having pre-translated every viewer's screen name.Korea - I Love Bae Joo-hyun: [Yes, truly remarkable! After all, usually whether online, in real life, or across various industries, they're like ghosts everywhere. But when it comes to the Far Neighbor live game, their presence has been conspicuously absent.]
It was unclear whether these two naturally spoke with this tone or if the machine translation was inaccurate, but their words carried a distinct sense of sarcasm.
A San Country - Whoever Mentions Lizards Again, I'll Get Angry:
[What's so remarkable? Clearly Hua Country people are just incompetent. Their population is similar to ours, and they used to maintain the world's largest population. But how many lab rats from our A San Country have survived four rounds? And them? Only two after all this time?! Absolutely ridiculous!!!!]
Big Bear Country - Zero: [That's rather biased. Hua Country's Alice Apartment was the last one established worldwide. They've only completed about 28 rounds so far, right? So having only two survivors through four rounds is quite normal.]
Tai Country - Rama I: [That reasoning doesn't hold up. Although our country's Alice Apartment has only gone through about three hundred rounds, by our 28th round, we already had over a dozen who passed four rounds.]
Numerous foreigners were commenting in the discussion area.
Meanwhile, on the Hua Country side, the usual chatterboxes remained silent.
It wasn't that they weren't speaking - mainly because everyone had brains.
After reading these foreigners' comments,
they suddenly developed deep suspicions.
Suspicious about what?
For example, the Middle-aged Uncle and Domineering Female CEO were wondering:
Was that Tai Country guy telling the truth or not?
Did they really have over a dozen lab rats who passed four rounds by their 28th round?
If this was true, it seemed Hua Country really couldn't compare...
After all, at 28 rounds, they only had two survivors...
At this moment,
someone from Hua Country finally spoke up.
Hua Country - I'm Actually a Girl: [Alright everyone, enough with the bragging.]
[True heroes don't boast about past glories, stop constantly living in the past.]
[The performance in this special live stream is what really matters.]
No one expected that I'm Actually a Girl, who usually sounded quite naive in domestic chats, would speak with such unexpected maturity here.
Of course, there were those who refuted her.
But in the live stream footage,
the Tai Country Beautiful Host had already begun introducing the next lab rats.
"Lab Rat Number 3, from Cherry Blossom Country, male, 30 years old, Hashimoto Kazuo, a doctor."
"Lab Rat Number 4, from Cherry Blossom Country, male, 59 years old, Nakamori Aoshi, a chef."
"Lab Rat Number 5, from Korea, male, 35 years old, Kim Bukk, fried chicken shop owner."
"Lab Rat Number 6, from Tai Country, male, 29 years old, Wannara, a ladyboy worker."
Of course, there were those who refuted her.
But in the live stream footage,
Certainly not out of mockery - ladyboys are very common in Tai Country.
Her smile was purely because she saw Wannara's photos -
the various lifestyle and artistic photos displayed on the large electronic screen behind her.
Her smile was a reaction to seeing a beautiful woman, even though this was technically a ladyboy.
When Wannara's photos were revealed, they also surprised many non-Tai Country foreigners in the live stream room.
After all, many wealthy people in this live stream room had rather unique preferences.
A ladyboy this beautiful was definitely on their list.
They wouldn't mind at all that this was a ladyboy - a man transformed into a woman.
[Wait, how did such a beautiful ladyboy become a lab rat?]
A Cherry Blossom Country person suddenly asked.
[How much does your Tai Country Alice Apartment pay these lab rats per day?]
This Cherry Blossom Country person's meaning was simple:
Such a beautiful ladyboy had no need to enter the dangerous Alice Apartment, right?
With their beauty, they should easily earn more money than what the Alice Apartment could offer.
A Tai Country person answered this question:
[In our Tai Country, it's about 45,000 Tai baht per day!!]
45,000 Tai baht was roughly equivalent to 10,000 Chinese yuan.
Compared to Tai Country's average monthly income converted to Chinese yuan - around two to three thousand, three to four thousand -
10,000 Chinese yuan per day was quite tempting.
But that was only for ordinary people.
Not for such a beautiful ladyboy.
Because of the one-hour comment restriction,
the Tai Country person who just answered about monthly income couldn't comment anymore.
The next comment came from another Tai Country person.
[The reason this ladyboy named Wannara stays in Alice Apartment to earn money is simple.]
[Although he transformed into a ladyboy and earns money through beauty, he doesn't engage in prostitution.]
[Because of this, he offended a big shot in Tai Country. That big shot follows the 'if I can't have it, I'll destroy it' mentality.]
[Many money-making opportunities became unavailable to him. So, you understand now?]
An A San Country person said: [Then why don't you help him? He's so pitiful.]
A Tai Country person: [Hahaha, help? Are you joking? First, helping him means making an enemy of the big shot who blacklisted him. Second, with such a beautiful ladyboy, wouldn't you want to try him?]
These people in the comment section showed no restraint in revealing their true nature online.
At this moment,
the introduction of lab rats continued.
However, the person introducing the lab rats changed from the Tai Country Beautiful Host to someone from A San Country.
A San Country belongs to the Caucasian race, although many have quite dark skin which raises questions, they are indeed considered Caucasian.
A San Country also produces beautiful women.
But many beauties come from high castes.
As everyone knows, A San Country has a caste system divided into: Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra, and Dalit.
The strict hierarchy is utterly despair-inducing.
This A San Country beautiful host had striking facial features, big wavy hair, and although her facial skin tone differed from the others' snow-white complexion, being somewhat yellowish,
overall, she was equally attractive.
This female host was clearly from a high caste as well.
She began continuing the introduction of lab rats.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: The Betting Amount of 10 Little White Mouse
chapters.content:
"Lab Rat #7, A San Country, male, 23 years old, Rajiv. Occupation: fruit vendor."
"Lab Rat #8, A San Country, male, 39 years old, Amir, occupation: taxi driver."
"Lab Rat #9, Big Fur Country, female, Natasha, 20 years old, university student."
"Lab Rat #10, Big Fur Country, male, Roman, 21 years old, university student."
Finally, all ten lab rats for this special live stream had been introduced.
The electronic screen displayed brief profiles and photos of everyone.
This allowed all live stream viewers to examine them carefully.
Domestically.
I am the Hero Wang Baobao scratched his head: "Hey, Lin Feng, why are almost all ten lab rats male this time? There's only one female?"
Ultimate Rich Kid Lin Feng thought for a moment before saying: "Physically, women are at a significant disadvantage compared to men.""Plus, in the outside world, women can rely on intelligence and wisdom, but in Alice Apartment, just being smart isn't enough without proper physical condition and methods. It's really difficult, especially when you're alone with a deranged criminal. Do you think you can use talk-no-jutsu like in Naruto to redeem and purify your opponent without needing physical force?"
I am the Hero Wang Baobao suddenly understood, then he brought the conversation back to women.
"This Lab Rat #9, the Big Fur Country girl Natasha, she's really beautiful!"
Lin Feng nodded: "Yes, Big Fur Country and nearby Second Fur, Third Fur countries - their ethnicities tend to produce beautiful women. When you walk on their streets, it feels like there are beauties everywhere, it's practically heaven. Especially since their countries have fewer men, so the men there are having an amazing time."
While the two were discussing women.
The live stream screen switched from the A San Country beautiful host to the Big Fur Country beautiful host.
The Big Fur Country beautiful host had a mature, attractive appearance. Her facial features were well-defined, with sapphire blue eyes and smooth golden hair, smiling like a doll.
But foreigners tend to look more mature for their age, so this Big Fur Country beautiful host was probably younger than she appeared.
The Big Fur Country beautiful host gently parted her red lips:
"All ten lab rats have now been introduced."
"The betting phase will now begin. The betting period will last for thirty minutes, please make your selections quickly."
"Additionally, for each bet, you can bet on up to three lab rats."
Just like the rounds in Alice Apartment.
The betting phase was essential.
The difference was that this special live stream allowed betting on three lab rats.
And there was no minimum bet amount.
Plus, winning probabilities weren't calculated.
Why was this?
You'd understand once the betting results came out.
Domestically.
Lin Feng asked Wang Baobao which three he was going to bet on.
Wang Baobao said he would definitely bet on the two domestic ones, Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao.
As for who to bet on for the third spot?
To be honest, both Lin Feng and Wang Baobao noticed something about the special live stream.
They didn't know if it was because there were too many participating lab rats.
But the lab rat introductions were extremely brief.
Unlike the regular rounds in Alice Apartment.
Where each lab rat was introduced in quite detailed manner.
And there were even more detailed written profiles.
Therefore, when betting on lab rats from other countries that you didn't know much about, it was easy to suffer from choice paralysis.
"This should be testing a person's first impression and judgment."
"Only looking at someone's brief profile and photo to judge their potential."
"That's why it's not like the domestic introductions that provide so much information."
Lin Feng said slowly.
Wang Baobao nodded, then he bet 10 million Chinese yuan on Jiang Ran.
He only bet 5 million Chinese yuan on Fang Xiao.
The main reason was that in Round 28, without Jiang Ran, Fang Xiao would have definitely died.
This incident made Wang Baobao feel that Fang Xiao wasn't as capable as Jiang Ran.
As for the third spot, he bet on Lab Rat #9, Big Fur Country, female university student, Natasha.
He bet 5 million on her.
Lin Feng asked him why he chose this Natasha?
Wang Baobao's reason was simple - because she was the only female among the ten lab rats.
And she was quite good-looking.
After hearing this, Lin Feng was momentarily speechless.
Soon, the thirty-minute betting period ended.
The hosting returned to Hua Country's long-haired beautiful host.
The long-haired beautiful host smiled slightly.
A very elegant Chinese beauty.
She gently parted her red lips, emitting a heavenly voice:
"Betting has now concluded. Let's now look at the betting situation for the ten lab rats."
"This betting amount is calculated in US dollars."
Some might find it strange - why use US dollars as settlement for something that's clearly Asian level?
Simple.
Because in Asia, no one is willing to submit to anyone else.
Using Chinese yuan for settlement.
Cherry Blossom Country and Korea, among others, would be the first to cause trouble.
So they simply used the internationally dominant US dollar.
The long-haired beautiful host began reporting.
"Lab Rat #1, Hua Country, Jiang Ran, betting amount: 230 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #2, Hua Country, Fang Xiao, betting amount: 58.9 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #3, Cherry Blossom Country, Hashimoto Kazuo, betting amount: 390 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #4, Cherry Blossom Country, Nakamori Aoshi, betting amount: 400 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #5, Korea, Kim Bukk, betting amount: 670 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #6, Tai Country, Wannara, betting amount: 300 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #7, A San Country, Rajiv, betting amount: 256.7 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #8, A San Country, Amir, betting amount: 500 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #9, Big Fur Country, Natasha, betting amount: 220 million US dollars."
"Lab Rat #10, Big Fur Country, Roman, betting amount: 1 billion US dollars."
From these betting results, it was clear that in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room with over five million wealthy viewers.
Using US dollars as the unit, the betting amount for any single lab rat far exceeded that of individual country rounds.
And among these ten lab rats, Fang Xiao received the lowest betting amount.
The reason was simple.
Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao were definitely bet on by those in Hua Country's Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room!!!
After all, there were three betting opportunities.
And these people, especially those who previously belonged to the "Fang Xiao fan" group.
After watching the incident between Fang Xiao and Old Dog in Round 28.
They were extremely disappointed in Fang Xiao.
After all, Fang Xiao's overall performance in that incident was really poor...
If not for Jiang Ran, he would have died...
At the same time, many of these people weren't brain-dead fan circle members.
Who think their idol is the best no matter what they do, believing their idol can do no wrong.
These Hua Country live stream viewers were quite rational - although they bet on Fang Xiao, the amounts weren't high.
They all placed big bets on the more promising Jiang Ran.
Aside from them, Jiang Ran and Fang Xiao also received bets from people in other countries.
But this proportion was quite small.
The majority still came from Hua Country.
And the majority of that went to Jiang Ran with large bets.
That's why Fang Xiao's betting amount was so low.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: It Has Started, It Has Started
chapters.content:
Likewise, although Jiang Ran had far more money bet on him than Fang Xiao,
he still ranked third from the bottom among the ten lab rats.
And in this special live stream, the lab rat with the highest amount bet on him was Number 10.
Big Fur Country, Roman, one billion USD. A university student.
Domestic side.
Wang Baobao controlled the mouse.
He clicked on the table hanging in the live stream room.
He clicked on Number 10, lab rat Roman.
He discovered that the one-billion-USD bet amount,
over sixty percent of it came from people in Big Fur Country.As for the nearly forty percent left, those bets came from several other countries.
That proportion was extremely high.
After all, for Jiang Ran, nearly ninety percent of the bets came from people inside Hua Country.
That was very strange, because this university student named Roman
was only really known to those people from Big Fur Country.
People from the other countries didn’t know him at all.
So.
Why were so many foreigners betting on him?
Very simple — as mentioned before.
People judged each lab rat based on their basic info and the various photos provided,
to decide whether that person was worth betting on, whether they were worth spending big money on.
So how did Roman look?
One meter eighty-five, though a university student, his build was extremely sturdy.
Among the ten lab rats, he was definitely one who caught the eye at first glance.
That explained why he received so many bets.
Of course, there’s a saying: you can’t judge a book by its cover.
This Roman might look burly but could actually be useless in comprehensive ability.
But put yourself in the bettor’s shoes:
a hulking Roman like an ox, and Fang Xiao, a drunken man whose face had been ravaged by smoke and alcohol —
if those two stood together, who would you bet on?
At that moment, Hua Country’s long-haired beautiful host continued:
“For this special live stream, the total bet amount is: 4,025,600,000 USD.”
Rounding off the small change,
converted to yuan, that’s roughly multiplied by seven.
About 28 billion Hua yuan.
This sum was already enormous.
And this is why
the special live stream allows each person in the live stream room to bet on three lab rats.
That’s the reason.
It’s to expand the total bet amount for every special live stream.
If so, why only allow betting on three?
Wouldn’t allowing more be better?
No, no, no — in this situation, more is not always better.
Think carefully and you’ll understand.
There’s a bit of “scarcity increases value” logic here.
Expanding the number of bets isn’t the real objective.
What’s the real objective?
It’s the money.
Those 28 billion Hua yuan and then some!
This is cash flow, not so-called assets.
This money flows from the accounts of people in these live stream rooms straight to the forces behind Alice Apartment.
That money will only flow back from that account seven days later to be split and distributed,
paid to those who bet on the winning lab rats — the ones who live until the end.
With such a huge sum, over those seven days the forces behind the apartment can manipulate it at will.
Think about what those backers could do with that money in seven days.
How much more could it produce?
To ordinary people, seven days may seem like nothing.
But to certain financial titans, that’s more than enough time to operate.
Of course, that’s not the main point.
The main point is the live stream.
Hua Country’s long-haired beautiful host continued:
“The special live stream follows the same rules as each country’s Alice Apartment.”
“In the end, the money will be distributed proportionally to those who bet on the winners — that is, those who bet on the lab rats who survive until the end.”
“Currently, all procedures have been completed.”
“Next, the live stream officially begins.”
Domestic side.
When Lin Feng and Wang Baobao saw Hua Country’s long-haired beautiful host finish that sentence,
their computer screens switched from the six female hosts’ windows to a huge ocean liner.
The ship was packed with people.
The sight stunned Lin Feng and Wang Baobao.
Especially when,
they then saw the ship arrive at its destination:
Macedonia Island.
It had to be said, from the computer images Macedonia Island looked very scenic — visually striking.
So imagine being there in person.
They watched as people from the ship, each carrying their luggage, disembarked at the Macedonia Island pier.
The two stared at each other, eyes wide.
Wang Baobao said, “No way. This special live stream only has ten lab rats, so why are so many people coming to this island? Could this cause trouble?”
Putting aside other countries’ Alice Apartments,
take Hua Country’s Alice Apartment alone.
During the live stream it was basically a sealed-off place.
There were hardly any miscellaneous people inside.
Besides the lab rats, it was just that group of perverts.
But on this Macedonia Island, there were so many ordinary people?
Wouldn’t that lead to problems?
Big trouble?
However, the two figured that since this was a special live stream, maybe everything would be more… special!
So having more off-duty people around might just be part of what makes it special.
At that moment, Wang Baobao, who was operating the mouse, suddenly noticed a chat room in the lower-right corner of the live stream desktop.
He clicked in and found,
this was the Hua Country side’s own Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room chat.
He clicked and found that the usual talkers like Middle-aged Uncle and Domineering Female CEO were all posting in that chat.
Of course, the chat didn’t show the number of participants;
it was just a chat room.
Presumably, other countries had their own single-country chat rooms like this.
After Wang Baobao clicked in, he urgently told Lin Feng to look at Middle-aged Uncle’s message.
Middle-aged Uncle: [Quick, look, that A San is barking like a dog again!]
In the live stream comment area.
A San — whoever mentions lizards again, I’ll go after them: [Last time during a special live stream that we A San Country participated in, we were the ones laughing last. If nothing goes wrong this time, it’ll be us again. After all, we have a lot of people;
the ones who can break out are the strong ones, even if both of those two are lowly low-caste scum.]
Someone from Cherry Blossom Country replied: [Always bragging, don’t use your brain. Does this kind of thing really rely on numbers? You have many people, so does that mean your country’s lab rats who break out must be the strongest? Then why haven’t your country’s contestants defeated America’s? Why is America’s Alice Apartment the strongest and sickest in the whole world?]
Someone from Korea also said: [Exactly. If sheer numbers decided it, why has Hua Country only produced two people who can participate in the special live stream so far?]
Good grief, the argument somehow circled back to Hua Country.
At this point, Middle-aged Uncle couldn’t take it and started spewing live:
[You bunch of idiots, I hope you meet Jiang Ran’s older brother and younger brother.]
Someone from Big Fur Country posted: [Jiang Ran’s older brother and younger brother? What’s that? Are his brother and younger brother also on Macedonia Island?]
If you’re not part of Hua Country’s Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room, you wouldn’t understand.
What Middle-aged Uncle meant by that statement —
Jiang Ran’s older brother and younger brother — wasn’t he referring to the personality that had once taken out the clown?

chapters.title: Chapter 270: Test Subject No. 7 — Rajiv
chapters.content:
At this moment, someone from Tai Country spoke up:
"Alright everyone, stop arguing. Our bickering is useless. Everything depends on the lab rats' performance! That's what really matters!"
Perhaps everyone silently agreed with this statement.
After that, the live stream room's chat area indeed saw much less verbal sparring.
Reality.
Macedonia Island.
Jiang Ran pulled his suitcase and carried a large backpack on his back.
He followed the crowd queuing to disembark.
Just as he set one foot on the shore.
He heard a voice emerge in his mind:[Ding, dangerous area detected! Please leave immediately, Host! Points +5! Points +5...]
Jiang Ran had originally come happily for vacation, but this system notification immediately confused him.
What the hell?
Dangerous area?
Macedonia Island?
What dangers could this tourist island possibly have?
He couldn't understand it.
But he immediately thought of Alice Apartment. Yes, who would have thought that an Alice Apartment would be full of dangerous people?
So now, should Jiang Ran disembark onto the island or not?
Just kidding, was he afraid?
If he could survive Alice Apartment, what could a mere island possibly do to him?
Moreover, he looked around.
And discovered there were truly many people.
With this many people around, he felt completely secure!!!
Therefore, he pushed the system warning aside and continued disembarking onto the island.
Macedonia Island was a tropical island.
The blazing sun overhead, combined with the constant crowding from people around.
Heat concentrated, unable to dissipate.
Sweat formed on his body faster than bullets being produced.
Droplets continuously generated, each one either sliding down his skin or being absorbed by his clothing.
"I really want to jump into the sea and cool off."
Jiang Ran was also extremely hot at this moment. In front of him were Xiao Q, Su Yang, and the others.
Even though Su Yang was a rich second generation, he still had to queue obediently here.
No special privileges.
This made Jiang Ran feel somewhat balanced in his heart.
The Macedonia Island pier was constructed quite luxuriously.
Grand, clean, with perfectly smooth concrete ground.
There were many boats near the pier.
Of course, most were yachts.
The common white color.
After the crowd queued and disembarked, following instructions, they reached a ticket checkpoint.
At the checkpoint, everyone had to submit a pre-purchased ticket.
This ticket was the island admission pass that Jiang Ran had received in his delivery.
With this ticket, one could enjoy everything on the island for free.
Jiang Ran naturally had one, as it was in his delivery.
It seemed everyone coming to this island had purchased this ticket in advance.
Of course, from Jiang Ran's perspective, he also saw many people who apparently hadn't bought tickets in advance being pulled aside by staff.
Soon.
It was Jiang Ran and his group's turn.
Jiang Ran and the others submitted their respective tickets, and after the island staff verified them without issues, they were allowed through.
After passing through.
They followed the directional signs at the pier, walking all the way.
Until they reached a very large parking lot.
There were many sightseeing tour buses in the parking lot.
Each sightseeing tour bus would automatically depart for the hotel once full.
Jiang Ran's group happened to catch a sightseeing tour bus, riding together to the island's hotel first.
...
Rajiv was Lab Rat No. 7, from A San Country, 23 years old this year.
His skin was dark, with a lean and wiry physique.
Before entering A San Country's Alice Apartment, he was a fruit vendor.
Selling fruit by the roadside every day.
He had many siblings in his family.
Including himself, there were seven total.
His family was very poor.
Therefore, the whole family lived in a dirty, chaotic slum.
This was also why he was approached by a middle-aged man, signed an agreement with that person, and entered A San Country's Alice Apartment.
The reason was that he wanted money.
He needed money.
And this time, coming to Macedonia Island, even though he knew it was dangerous.
As long as he survived seven days, the money he could earn daily would double.
This was an enormous temptation for him.
Currently, he pulled his suitcase through the initial ticket inspection and was now preparing to take a sightseeing tour bus to the hotel.
Although Rajiv came from the slums.
If you observed Rajiv carefully.
You could see he was dressed very fashionably, completely unlike someone from A San Country's low-caste slums.
His appearance completely resembled that of a high-caste individual.
Today's outfit consisted of a patterned summer shirt on top.
Very lightweight and cool.
On the bottom, patterned beach shorts.
On his feet, a pair of Nike shoes.
Additionally, he wore sunglasses on his face.
Overall, he looked like an elite professional coming for vacation.
Of course, what was most eye-catching was the suitcase he was pulling.
This suitcase had a very attractive light blue surface.
Moreover, the overall design of this suitcase was quite interesting.
While appearing simple in design, it exuded a sense of simple sophistication.
This suitcase was from a very popular brand in A San Country.
Priced at over two thousand if converted to Chinese yuan.
A suitcase costing over two thousand wouldn't even get a glance from truly wealthy people.
But for ordinary people, this was already quite good.
In A San Country, carrying this brand of suitcase served as proof of status.
Proving oneself to be wealthy, not some poor slum dweller.
The money he earned daily at A San Country's Alice Apartment.
Was not used to support his family.
But entirely spent on himself.
Why?
Because he knew his family were all bloodsuckers.
And this money was earned by risking his life.
So why should he support his family?
He wanted to spend it on himself, he wanted to enjoy the life of a wealthy person!!!
In fact, he believed he was already wealthy now.
Because the A San Country Alice Apartment he lived in was a high-end apartment, exactly where wealthy people lived.
And with the money he earned daily, his daily expenses were all at places only wealthy people frequented.
He felt that through his own efforts, he had already escaped his original social class.
Currently, he pulled his suitcase and boarded a sightseeing tour bus that was almost full.
The driver of this sightseeing tour bus came down to check if the bus was full or nearly full enough to depart.
He checked and found there was still one seat left to be completely full.
He turned around to return to the driver's seat and start driving.
But at that moment, a voice came from the distance.
"Wait for me! Wait for me!!! (English)"
The driver heard this voice and turned his head.
He saw a young man dragging a suitcase, continuously waving his right hand upward while shouting toward him.
The driver saw this and therefore waited here for this young man.
Two minutes later.
The young man arrived at the sightseeing tour bus, panting heavily.
The driver saw him and said in English: "Get on board. (English)"
The young man quickly thanked him, then pulled his suitcase and boarded this sightseeing tour bus.
Macedonia Island's sightseeing tour buses had just a canopy overhead, with both sides open.
There was ample space between the front and back seats, allowing for luggage and other items to be placed.
Coincidentally, this young man happened to sit in the very back row, right beside Lab Rat No. 7, Rajiv.
Rajiv was still wearing sunglasses at this moment. He turned to look at the heavily panting young man beside him.
He discovered this young man had an Asian East Asian facial appearance.
Although A San Country's ethnic classification is Caucasian, many A San Country people have very dark skin.
In contrast, East Asians, though called yellow race, many actually have quite fair skin.
Like this person before him, whose skin was very fair.
"Hello, which country are you from? (English)"
He asked.
Because A San Country was once colonized by the UK.
Many people in A San Country can speak English.
Including this poor boy from the slums.

chapters.title: Chapter 271: The Young Man
chapters.content:
"Hello, I'm Korean. (English)"
The young man extended his hand.
Rajiv lowered his head, and despite wearing sunglasses, he could still see the young man's hand. It had delicate, smooth skin.
Rajiv extended his right hand and shook hands with him.
Hmm, the skin was very smooth.
Then, their hands separated.
After letting go, Rajiv was still savoring the sensation from his right hand just moments before.
As the saying goes, when one is well-fed and warm, lustful thoughts arise.
Rajiv was no exception, unable to escape this universal truth.
After he had money, he had indulged in a life of debauchery.But none of that wild living could compare to one particular experience he'd had.
What was that experience?
Quite simple—he had ridden in his two brothers' truck to wholesale fruits.
Along the way, they encountered a Korean male blogger.
Then they happily let this Korean male blogger hitch a ride.
They gave him water laced with sedative.
What happened next should be easy to guess.
They had a "friendly and intimate exchange" with that Korean male blogger.
Then they dumped him by the roadside.
Although later, that Korean male blogger reported it to the police.
They were taken in by the A San Country police.
But they just apologized and were released without charges.
So why did Rajiv feel that experience surpassed all his wild living?
Simple.
Even though he thought of himself as wealthy, was he really wealthy?
After getting money, the women he played with were still from lower castes.
No matter how much he disguised himself, he wasn't from a high caste.
Because lower castes and higher castes aren't actually the same race.
You can tell at a glance.
Even though he wore expensive clothes.
So, he felt that his "intimate exchange" with that Korean male blogger was a step toward becoming truly high caste.
After all, lower castes couldn't enjoy such things.
And this young Korean man before him had even fairer, more delicate skin than that previous one.
If only he could...
Rajiv pressed his legs together, his body involuntarily reacting.
Just then, the vehicle quickly started moving.
...
The scenery along the way to the hotel was quite beautiful, but Rajiv was somewhat distracted.
Because the entire way, he was busy staring at swimsuit beauties from various countries with different skin tones.
Especially when he saw several fair-skinned Asian girls.
From their speech, they were probably Hua Country people.
Although he hadn't interacted with Hua Country people before.
From online chats, he'd heard that Hua Country girls particularly liked foreign men, regardless of which country.
Thus, they were called easy girls.
He wondered if during this seven-day tour, he might be able to get a Hua Country girl as a girlfriend?
Soon, the sightseeing tour bus arrived at a luxurious Western-style hotel predominantly white in color.
After they all got off, the sightseeing tour bus drove away.
Then they entered the hotel and, guided by hotel staff, came to the front desk.
They began registering identity information, then received room keys.
Rajiv and that young Korean man were second-to-last and last in line.
After all, that was the boarding order.
Soon, everyone ahead had finished registering and received their hotel room keys.
When it was Rajiv's turn, there was a slight problem.
Mainly, Rajiv was informed that his hotel room wasn't a single room.
But a double room.
And coincidentally, the other guest in the double room was the young Korean man behind him.
Therefore, the hotel front desk reminded Rajiv that if he was dissatisfied, he could change rooms.
Of course, due to limited room availability, changing would require waiting in line for an empty room.
That would take some time.
So, should he change rooms or not?
Hehe, Rajiv hadn't planned to change anyway, especially after learning his roommate was the young Korean man behind him—he was even more determined not to change.
Because he felt the opportunity had arrived.
An opportunity for male-on-male action.
And the young Korean man behind him, after learning about this situation.
Showed no resistance either, instead happily extending a hand again—the same right hand as before.
Rajiv similarly extended his previous right hand.
Smiling happily, he could feel that skin's texture once more.
At this moment, in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
The camera view continuously rotated, switching to the scene of Rajiv at the hotel front desk.
A San—Whoever Mentions Lizards Again, I'll Get Angry excitedly typed on the keyboard:
[Everyone, if you ask me which of our two A San Country representatives is most likely to survive to the end, it's definitely this one, Lab Rat No. 7—Rajiv!]
As soon as he finished, someone from another country immediately questioned:
[Why? I saw your other A San Country representative has 500 million in bets placed, half more than Rajiv. So why do you say this one has better chances?]
As everyone knows, generally, the higher the betting amount, the stronger the contestant's perceived strength and better survival chances.
So, what's the reasoning behind this claim?
But due to the one-hour speaking restriction, this person couldn't respond even if they wanted to.
Back to reality.
Rajiv and this young Korean man, chatting and laughing, took the elevator up to their hotel room.
After using the room card to open the door.
A bright light rushed toward him.
Looking closely, it was from the balcony directly opposite, with light shining directly in, illuminating the entire hotel room.
"Wow, so beautiful! (English)"
Rajiv placed his suitcase beside a table, then walked onto the balcony, looking outside. He couldn't help but marvel.
Just then, a sea breeze blew in, making all his pores open up, his whole body feeling comfortable.
He slightly lowered his head, concentrating intently as he looked into the distance.
From his balcony position, he could see many swimsuit beauties on the golden beach.
He eagerly pulled out his phone from his pants pocket, preparing to zoom in and capture this scene.
It's worth mentioning that he was using a Hua Country Rice phone.
He raised the phone high, then opened the camera.
To his surprise, his camera.
The phone screen should be facing outward, but when opened, it was in selfie mode.
Yes, selfie mode.
Since moving into Alice Apartment, he'd been constantly chatting with women online.
Frequently taking selfies and such.
So, he prepared to switch out of selfie mode.
But just at that moment, while holding his phone high—his Rice phone.
In selfie mode, besides himself in the phone screen, there was another person.
This other person was definitely that young Korean man.
That wasn't particularly strange.
Since the hotel room only had the two of them, it was normal for the other person to accidentally appear in the shot.
But what was extremely abnormal now was.
Even if he appeared in the shot, that young Korean man should be far away from him.
Over by the two beds in the room.
But now, in the screen.
The young Korean man appeared right behind him.
Completely silently.
Especially that face, only half a palm's distance from his own face.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Test Subject No. 7 — Rajiv, Dead
chapters.content:
What is an accident?
An accident is a completely unexpected sudden event.
In this world, various accidents happen every minute and every second.
For example, getting hit and killed by a car while walking.
Or choking to death on a fishbone while eating fish.
These all count as accidents.
But if you think carefully about these kinds of accidents,
they're actually caused by human actions.
For example, someone who gets hit and killed by a car while walking - that person probably usually likes to jaywalk.
Therefore, it doesn't seem surprising that they might get hit someday.And someone who chokes to death on a fishbone probably usually enjoys eating fish and often gets bones stuck, but never expected that this time it would cost them their life.
These are all human-caused accidents.
In novels,
this means accidents with foreshadowing, making them feel less abrupt.
So what is a truly terrifying accident?
It's an accident caused by factors completely unrelated to the actions of the person experiencing it.
Like that news story from a few years ago.
A billionaire and his daughter who had just returned from studying abroad were driving when a pile driver from a construction site collapsed and crushed them to death.
This kind of accident was completely unrelated to the behavior of those who experienced it.
They maintained good habits like driving safely.
What caused the accident was that construction site habitually using substandard pile drivers with inadequate safety inspection measures.
That is to say, even if this particular pile driver collapse hadn't happened,
this construction site would have eventually had other incidents.
Perhaps other accidents that would have caused different deaths.
This is an accident caused by others' actions, leaving the victims completely unable to defend against it.
Rajiv was currently using his Rice phone in selfie mode.
He saw the Korean young man silently appear behind him in the frame, then watched as this Korean young man pulled out a sharp dagger with his right hand.
When the Korean young man realized Rajiv had spotted him through the phone's selfie mode, he instantly and without hesitation stabbed the dagger into Rajiv's left chest.
Right where the human heart is located.
Rajiv reacted quickly too, but unfortunately, it was too late. The dagger had already deeply pierced his heart.
Then he struggled desperately to break free from the Korean young man behind him.
During the struggle, his phone fell to the ground.
He covered his heart with both hands, but it was useless - large amounts of red blood gushed out from between his fingers.
"Help! (in English)"
Rajiv turned and shouted toward the balcony.
Trying to call for help.
But the Korean young man rushed forward, stabbing the dagger into his neck with his right hand while using his left hand to tightly cover Rajiv's mouth. Then he used all his body's muscles, exerting force to drag the frantically struggling Rajiv backward.
Rajiv naturally wouldn't go down without a fight.
He directly opened his mouth and bit down hard on the Korean young man's left hand that was covering his mouth.
But as soon as he bit down, he realized something was wrong.
The feeling when he bit down was incredibly hard.
And very rough.
Moreover, after he bit down, the hand showed almost no reaction.
It still tightly covered his mouth, struggling against his jaw.
Rajiv felt something was wrong and strained to look downward with his eyes.
What he saw was a terrifying scene.
He saw that the Korean young man's left hand
was extremely rough, with frighteningly thick calluses, and the skin on the palm seemed to have been scalded by boiling water.
Twisted and deformed.
Wait, was he hallucinating?
This Korean young man's hand was clearly snow-white and delicate?!
Stab! Stab!
While he was thinking this, the Korean young man's right hand kept stabbing the dagger into the front of his body.
Making stabbing sounds.
Bloody holes were being rapidly created.
Thanks to this, Rajiv realized he wasn't hallucinating.
Rather, he remembered.
This Korean young man had shaken hands with him using his right hand.
The same hand now holding the dagger to stab him.
That hand was snow-white and delicate.
While the left hand was dirty and ugly.
He understood everything now.
But understanding this now was too late.
Because he was about to die.
"Careless, so careless... (in English)"
These were Rajiv's final thoughts before death.
So, considering everything described above, was Rajiv's death an accident?
And was his death caused by his own factors? Or by others' factors?
...
After killing Rajiv, the Korean young man looked down at Rajiv lying in a pool of bright red blood, eyes wide open in death, body covered in blood.
He merely curled the corner of his mouth.
His face full of contempt.
The Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room had been broadcasting from Rajiv's perspective the entire time.
Everyone witnessed Rajiv's death process.
Immediately, the live stream screen switched to the studio.
Returning to the six beautiful female hosts with hot figures.
The beautiful host from A San Country stepped forward from among them and said:
"In this special live stream, lab rat No. 7 Rajiv has died. The total bet amount of 256.7 million USD has been fully transferred to the final prize pool."
After she finished the announcement, the screen switched again, though this time to other footage.
Of course, in the special live stream, just like in the Alice Apartment live stream, viewers in the live stream room could freely switch camera angles.
Simultaneously, when exciting scenes occurred, the main camera would automatically switch.
To be honest, Rajiv's death was quite unexpected.
Not just for the already deceased Rajiv regarding his own death.
Including all five million-plus people in the live stream room felt the same way.
Except for these Hua Country people, people from the other several countries had watched many special live streams before.
But in the special live streams they had watched,
no one acted this quickly.
Especially someone pretending to be a tourist, being in the same room with the lab rat, and taking action directly without any preamble.
A person from Big Fur Country typed on his keyboard: [I've watched quite a few special live streams too. Some special live streams take place in small towns, some on resort islands, but no matter where, this opening was too fast, so fast I never expected it.]
Hua——Middle-aged Uncle said: [Fast or not doesn't matter, I'm more interested in knowing about that A San Country's lizard? Didn't they say Rajiv would survive until the end?]
Hua——I am the Hero: [Rajiv did survive until the end - his soul survived until the end.]
Hua——Fairy Sister: [The slap in the face is too harsh. Right now, forget that he's still in the 1-hour speaking ban, even if he could speak, he wouldn't show up.]
The Hua Country people hadn't forgotten about this A San Country person called A San—Whoever Mentions Lizards Again, I'll Get Angry.
Back then he mocked Hua Country as garbage, worthless.
Therefore at this moment, with him being proven wrong, many Hua Country people came out to mock him with sarcastic remarks.
Of course, although that A San Country lizard didn't show up, other A San Country people did speak up.
[Enough, what are you so proud of? Be careful, the next lab rats to die will be your two Hua Country ones!!!!]
[Hahaha, really? I don't believe it.]
Hua Country people and A San Country people began confronting each other with words.
If these conversations were posted online,
and people were told these were dialogues between wealthy people from various countries,
probably many wouldn't believe it.
After all, in their minds, rich people should be calm, not showing emotions on their faces, right?
How could they possibly curse loudly, confront each other, acting like ordinary people?
But actually, this is nothing special - even rich people are still human.
If you've experienced those early domestic internet mobile phone industry events,
this doesn't seem surprising at all.
After all, back then, things like "competitors are idiots" and public challenges were emerging endlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Jiang Ran and Wannala
chapters.content:
That Korean young man killed Lab Rat No. 7, Rajiv.
This sufficiently proved that this Korean young man was one of the deranged criminals, the deranged serial killers arranged by the Organizers on Macedonia Island.
And according to the rules, since this Korean young man had already killed one lab rat, he could completely rest for the next seven days.
Domestically, Wang Baobao sitting in front of the computer wanted to find out who this Korean young man actually was.
He clicked on a button called "Information" in the live stream room.
He saw the information of the 10 lab rats.
At the same time, there was newly appeared information below the 10 lab rats.
This information was about the Korean young man.
The information was as follows:
Liu Yongchun, male, 30 years old, Korean deranged serial killer.Number of victims: At least 19 people.
Targets: Wealthy elderly living alone, prostitutes, mentally disabled individuals.
Methods: Dismemberment and other unrestricted methods.
Motives: Born in poverty, pure resentment toward the wealthy, divorced, psychologically twisted.
...
Jiang Ran was staying in room 3003.
That is, room number 3 on the 30th floor.
Of course, he wasn't alone in a single hotel room.
Like Rajiv, he was also arranged to stay in a double room.
Of course, he was relatively lucky in that.
The other person in his double room wasn't a deranged serial killer.
Instead, it was that Lab Rat No. 6, from Tai Country, male, 29 years old, Wannara, ladyboy worker.
After Jiang Ran had been in room 3003 for about ten minutes.
Lab Rat No. 6, Wannara, holding the room key and dragging a pink suitcase, entered room 3003.
When Jiang Ran first saw Wannara in the hotel room, he was completely stunned.
First, he was amazed by Wannara's beauty.
Second, he was shocked, wondering if the hotel had made a mistake?
Why was there a woman staying in his room?
When Jiang Ran collected his room key at the hotel front desk on the first floor, he had already been informed that there would be another tourist sharing the double room with him.
But he thought it would be a man, never expecting it to be a woman, and a beautiful one at that.
"Hello."
After Wannara entered, he chose the bed closer to the door, then greeted Jiang Ran.
Jiang Ran felt this should be an ice queen type.
The kind with absolutely no smile on the face.
"Hello, you can speak Chinese?"
Jiang Ran returned the greeting while asking this question.
After all, Wannara's appearance clearly showed he wasn't from Hua Country.
He seemed to be from Southeast Asia, with that mixed-race look from that region.
"Yes, I'm from Tai Country."
Wannara answered this question while opening his suitcase and organizing his things.
Jiang Ran scratched his head: "Then your Chinese is quite good."
Wannara replied with his head lowered: "Yes, my work involves facing many clients from different countries, so mastering several foreign languages is necessary."
Jiang Ran made an acknowledging sound.
He had to admit that this woman before him spoke very authentic Chinese, with almost no foreign accent.
And then, Jiang Ran witnessed a scene he would never forget for the rest of his life.
After Wannara finished organizing his things.
He actually started changing clothes right in front of Jiang Ran.
Of course, he didn't remove the two pieces of clothing covering the important parts of his body.
But even so, it was enough to shock Jiang Ran.
Because if it were a domestic girl, they would never be so open.
But this Tai Country woman before him was extremely natural and unrestrained, without any shyness or hesitation.
Completely treating Jiang Ran as air.
Jiang Ran wanted to avert his gaze to show he wasn't a pervert.
But his eyes just wouldn't move away.
Only after Wannara finished changing clothes did Jiang Ran awkwardly look away.
Then, after changing clothes, Wannara left the room.
Jiang Ran stayed alone in the hotel room for a while.
He also changed into beach attire.
That is, a summer shirt, beach shorts, plus a pair of sandals.
After getting ready, he left room 3003.
Following the map on each floor.
He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
The entire 10th floor provided all-day buffet service.
Jiang Ran enjoyed a rich buffet meal here.
Of course, he only ate meat dishes.
Especially, he got to eat Australian lobster here, which he had never eaten before.
After eating, he checked the time on his phone.
1:32 PM.
He took the elevator to the 1st floor.
Then exited the 1st floor and began enjoying the wonderful island seven-day tour.
Of course, he didn't plan to do much playing this day.
He only planned to wander around everywhere, exploring everything on the island.
He first came to the beach.
At this moment, the beach was filled with men and women in swimwear everywhere.
Especially young men and women.
Many men with eight-pack abs, and women with hot figures.
Walking on the soft golden beach.
Jiang Ran also saw many children building their castles with sand.
Seeing this, he couldn't help but recall.
There was an episode in SpongeBob SquarePants.
Where SpongeBob and the idiot Patrick Star were on the beach, molding various things from sand to attack each other.
Fighting each other like in a war.
They even molded fighter jets.
Of course, that was animation, this was reality, such absurd things weren't possible.
Jiang Ran walked on the golden beach, then stepped into the cold seawater.
Gradually the seawater reached his knees, and he stopped.
He looked around;
there were many people playing in the seawater along the shore.
Not far in the distance, there were several people surfing with surfboards.
Jiang Ran couldn't swim, so after soaking in the cold seawater for a while, he returned to the beach.
After returning, he continued walking along the beach.
And to his surprise, he actually saw several familiar faces.
These familiar faces were none other than Xiao Q and his group.
He walked over.
Xiao Q and his group also noticed him.
Jiang Ran asked them what they were planning to do?
Xiao Q pursed his lips and said: "Su Yang and his group are planning to go diving, they're currently communicating with the diving instructors."
Jiang Ran looked over and saw not far away.
Su Yang and his five international student friends standing over there.
Su Yang and that guy were wearing beach shorts on the lower body, bare-chested on the upper body.
Both of them probably worked out regularly, so they had good physiques.
