As for the other four girls.
These four girls were all wearing sexy bikinis.
When Jiang Ran's gaze swept over them, there was only one word: white.
Since he encountered acquaintances, Jiang Ran decided to stay here a bit longer.
Then, after a few minutes.
Su Yang's group seemed to have reached some agreement.
Su Yang and that guy changed into diving suits, oxygen tanks, and diving masks.
They followed several male diving instructors into the sea to go diving.
After Su Yang and the other guy left for diving.
The four girls came walking toward Jiang Ran and his group.
The four girls were very natural and unrestrained, and Jiang Ran along with Xiao Q's trio had nothing to be reserved about either.
So they also naturally appreciated the view.
Of course, they couldn't stare directly either.
That would seem somewhat perverted.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Su Yang’s Secret
chapters.content:
"Are you girls not going diving with Su Yang?"
When the four girls approached, Xiao Q was the first to ask.
Among the four girls, one of Su Yang's girlfriends—the one with pink wavy hair—smiled and said:
"It's boring. We've all been diving before and have done it countless times already. Plus, if we go diving, we have to change clothes. Too much trouble."
"Compared to that, we're much more interested in taking beautiful photos."
The four girls smiled as they pulled out their phones, found a scenic spot, and started taking pictures.
Jiang Ran stayed in the area for another ten-plus minutes before preparing to leave.
Just as he was about to leave, he saw Su Yang and the others coming up from their dive.
"So soon?"
Xiao Peng looked surprised at the sight.What surprised everyone even more was what happened next.
After coming ashore, Su Yang and his friend seemed to get into an argument with the diving instructors.
Then, shockingly, the two sides actually started fighting.
Jiang Ran was stunned.
He had no idea what was going on!
The other three felt the same.
Xiao Q was the quickest to react among them.
He immediately ran over.
Once he started running, the others followed, including Jiang Ran.
When they reached the scene, they immediately stepped in to break up the fight.
After separating them, they asked what had happened.
Su Yang then explained what occurred during the dive.
Apparently, these diving instructors, once underwater, suddenly asked Su Yang and his friend if they wanted photos taken?
Su Yang asked if it was free?
After all, they had bought tickets to Macedonia Island that promised everything on the island was free.
But the diving instructors who went down with them said no, it wasn't free—500 USD for ten photos.
Although Su Yang was a rich second generation, he wasn't a fool.
He immediately refused.
His friend did the same.
Then, while still in the ocean, the two of them fell victim to the diving instructors' dirty tricks.
Stuff like pushing them deeper underwater, removing their oxygen masks—they did it all.
Finally, Su Yang said he was willing to pay for photos. They took a set of pictures before coming ashore.
And after coming ashore, these diving instructors never expected...
Su Yang and his friend were also tough characters.
They immediately went back on their word and started throwing punches.
"Xiao Q, don't stop me! I'm going to beat these bastards to death! I've been diving abroad so many times and never encountered such shady businessmen!!!!"
Su Yang still wanted to continue fighting at this point.
Xiao Q naturally wouldn't allow it.
He held him back firmly.
At that moment, the four girls also came over. After learning the whole story,
the girls immediately called the hotel.
When they saw the girls calling the hotel, the diving instructors immediately ran off into the distance.
Xiao Peng tried to stop them but couldn't—those diving instructors ran faster than anyone.
Soon, hotel staff arrived.
When they arrived, Su Yang unleashed a torrent of furious cursing at these hotel staff.
This included accusations of Macedonia Island engaging in fraudulent practices.
Not just charging for services, but even attempting murder over money.
The hotel staff being cursed at looked at each other, completely confused.
Until...
After hearing Xiao Q and the others explain what happened,
a hotel staff member in his thirties quickly explained: "Then the diving instructors you encountered definitely weren't from our hotel, or even island staff."
"Look, all staff from our hotel and the entire island, whether in uniforms or diving suits, have this golden peony pattern on the front. Plus, we all wear work badges around our necks with QR codes that can be scanned for verification."
Hearing this,
including Jiang Ran, everyone noticed that indeed, from the moment they came ashore, all the staff they encountered—
though wearing different uniforms—each seemed to have a golden peony pattern on the front of their uniforms.
Additionally, they all had work badges.
But those diving instructors' diving suits definitely didn't have golden peonies.
Though they did have work badges.
Su Yang, skeptical, used his phone to scan the QR code of one staff member present.
He found that it actually scanned successfully,
showing basic information about that staff member.
"See, the scanned information specifically includes our staff's anti-counterfeiting mark, which is the golden peony background."
"So those people you encountered definitely weren't staff from our side."
"Since we sell tickets here, everything inside won't have additional charges."
"Including diving photos—all free. So if you encounter anyone charging fees on the island, they're definitely not our people. Please call to report them."
Realizing it was a huge misunderstanding,
Su Yang and his friend wanted to tear those diving instructors apart.
After all, they had genuinely almost been killed underwater.
Jiang Ran watched this scene without commenting.
He suddenly remembered scrolling through TikTok and seeing videos about certain domestic tourist destinations
that frequently had these kinds of issues.
Many people who experienced it would post videos online warning others to avoid such traps.
With the matter resolved,
just as Jiang Ran was about to leave, the staff suddenly pointed into the distance and said to Su Yang's group: "There are island diving instructors over there, professional ones. If you want to dive, you can go there."
Everyone looked into the distance and vaguely saw several dark spots.
Su Yang threw the black diving mask in his hand onto the ground: "Screw that! My mood for today is completely ruined. How could I possibly be in the mood to go diving now?!"
Su Yang looked around furiously, then his gaze settled on his two girlfriends.
He walked over, grabbed the pink wavy-haired girl's snow-white wrist, and without saying anything else, pulled her toward the hotel direction.
At that moment, Jiang Ran noticed that the pink wavy-haired girl clearly showed panic on her pretty face.
As if she was terrified of what was coming next.
"Are these two really boyfriend and girlfriend?"
This was what Jiang Ran muttered to himself.
But Xiao Peng said it out loud, and not quietly at that.
Yes, not just Jiang Ran—Xiao Q and the others beside him had also noticed.
Then, awkwardly, Su Yang's other friends hadn't left yet either...
But those friends didn't seem to mind.
One of Su Yang's other girlfriends, the one with long straight black hair and sweet appearance, said:
"They are boyfriend and girlfriend. Didn't I say that on the plane earlier?"
Xiao Peng was very confused: "Then why did she look so panicked when she left just now?"
The sweet-looking girl with long straight black hair crossed her arms, her expression cold: "Because Su Yang's preferences in that area are too perverted. So not just her—even I can't stand it."
The girl shook her head and sighed.
"Uh... can't stand it? Then why not just refuse?"
Xiao Peng remained confused.
The girl continued coldly: "You're overthinking again. It's simply impossible to refuse."
Ke Bei, standing nearby, said calmly: "A relationship model of one man and two women."
"Looking at this relationship dynamic, the two sides are clearly unequal."
"The man holds greater power than the women."
"Hey, those reasons you gave on the plane earlier about willingly accepting this relationship—they were all lies, weren't they?"

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Test Subject No. 3 — Kazuo Hashimoto
chapters.content:
Back on the plane, Xiao Peng had asked these two girls how they could accept this kind of relationship.
Two women sharing one man?
The girls' answers at the time were also quite unexpected.
Things like, life is about being happy, don't constrain yourself with traditional rules.
But in the end, it was all lies...
The girl with long straight black hair and sweet features stared at Ke Bei and nodded:
"Yes, the reasons we gave on the plane were all lies."
"Do you want to hear the real reason?"
This girl's current expression was vastly different from her usual sweet demeanor.
It was a complete contrast, giving off a witch-like vibe."Of course we do!"
Xiao Peng was the most excited and eager to hear it.
Because he desperately wanted to know the real reason why two women could accept sharing one boyfriend!
The girl spread her hands: "Why do we two accept sharing a boyfriend? Simple, one word: money."
"Money? But you international students who can study abroad, aren't you already well-off?"
Xiao Peng was confused.
The black-haired girl sneered coldly:
"Yes, international students like me who can go abroad naturally aren't poor. In fact, my family used to be quite wealthy. Of course, all the money came from my dad, but then due to special circumstances, my family's financial source was cut off."
"Then, I had no money."
"After running out of money, I not only faced the possibility of not being able to continue my studies in the UK, but also had to work part-time, since living expenses became a problem."
"That's when Su Yang's importance became apparent."
"Su Yang and I were originally boyfriend and girlfriend."
"So after my dad's incident, he gave me money to help me maintain my studies."
"Then, something happened that I didn't even realize at first."
"Originally, our status in this relationship was equal, but afterwards, our positions began to sharply decline for me and rise for him."
"This led to me, who used to often get angry in front of him, now not only not daring to get angry or throw tantrums, but also having to be careful and please him."
"As for Lin Baiyu, she's similar to me. Her family runs a company back home, and now the company is facing difficulties, relying entirely on Su Yang's father's company to stay afloat."
"But Lin Baiyu is also different from me. Lin Baiyu originally had a boyfriend, but because Su Yang took a liking to her, there was no other choice, unless she didn't care about her family's company."
"After all, Lin Baiyu, you wouldn't want your family's company to go bankrupt, would you?"
"So."
"This is the real reason why we two are with him. Do you understand now?"
Xiao Peng suddenly understood.
So the reason Su Yang could manage to two-time and never get caught was still because of money!
After hearing this, Ke Bei said calmly: "I see, then there's nothing strange about it."
"I once took a case from a wealthy woman who asked me to investigate evidence of her husband's affair."
"Later, I found out that her husband was keeping three beautiful women, and these three beautiful women even lived together, knew about each other's existence, yet completely coexisted peacefully and could live harmoniously."
"Of course, this wasn't because the wealthy woman's husband had particularly brilliant methods, but simply because money made these three women willingly coexist peacefully."
During this entire process, Xiao Q hadn't expressed his opinion until now.
He only now said: "Su Yang has really changed, he's completely different from how he was back in the day."
Jiang Ran had been enjoying the drama the whole time, unable to stop.
Meanwhile, about 10 kilometers away from them, at another beach on the island.
This area was sparsely populated.
A figure was walking slowly here.
This figure was none other than Lab Rat No. 3, the 30-year-old Japanese man, Hashimoto Kazuo.
Hashimoto Kazuo was a doctor.
In Japan, being a doctor is a high-paying profession.
Under normal circumstances, who would give up a high-paying job to go to Alice Apartment?
Well, the fact that he could go to Japan's Alice Apartment obviously meant something abnormal had happened to him.
The abnormal situation was quite simple.
He had offended the professor in his hospital department.
Then he was demoted to a clinic in a remote rural town to work as a doctor.
Those who have watched Japanese medical dramas, or that very popular banking employee drama "Hanzawa Naoki," should understand his situation.
Offend your superior, get demoted to a remote area.
You say resign?
Sure, of course you can resign.
But if resigning was such a good solution, why don't those who get demoted take that option?
Basically, being demoted means your future life might be stuck there forever.
Wanting to return to a big city hospital is almost impossible.
Besides, after being demoted, your salary and such are greatly reduced.
During that time, Hashimoto Kazuo fell into extreme internal conflict.
Then, because he was demoted, he had to take his wife and son and leave the big city.
Head to the place where he was demoted.
Start his future work.
But his wife was unwilling.
And simultaneously filed for divorce.
Hashimoto Kazuo was stunned.
His career was blocked, but did his wife really need to file for divorce because of that?
Later, he found out that his wife had already been cheating on him, and even his five-year-old son wasn't his own.
Hashimoto Kazuo didn't make a big scene or fly into a rage like other men might.
Instead, he readily agreed to divorce his wife, and the son went to her.
After the divorce, he began to recall the sweet times with his wife many years ago, and that sacred white wedding.
Then looking at his current lonely state.
Career and family, both collapsed at once.
This kind of blow.
Very few people can truly withstand it.
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to call it complete despair.
And so, Hashimoto Kazuo later developed severe depression.
Then later, he directly resigned.
After that, he lived as a shut-in NEET in Japan's advanced server.
Later still, after his savings ran out.
He started doing odd jobs, working part-time at convenience stores.
Then later, fate turned around.
He met a thirty-year-old man and signed an agreement to enter Japan's Alice Apartment.
After entering Japan's Alice Apartment.
At first, like many lab rats who entered Alice Apartment.
He thought the place was haunted.
Japan is different from Hua Country.
In Hua Country, talk of ghosts and gods is considered feudal superstition, and TV dramas and movies can't film ghost stories.
Of course they can film ghost stories, but in the end it must turn out to be man-made.
While Japan doesn't have this restriction.
Ghost stories can be filmed freely.
Therefore, many people here believe in them, but many also don't.
But as a doctor accustomed to life and death, whether it was haunted or not didn't matter to him.
But after actually moving in, he discovered this place was much more terrifying than being haunted.
Whether ghosts want your life or not, he didn't know.
But the people living here all want your life.
As for why he didn't leave after moving in and gradually understanding the full picture of Japan's Alice Apartment?
Simple, he got paid daily.
Additionally, Hashimoto Kazuo the doctor discovered that while staying at Alice Apartment, his depression actually began to gradually improve.
Of course, more importantly, after moving into Alice Apartment, he began to enjoy.
The pleasure of competing with others.
Especially that feeling that if he lost, he would die.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: The Haunted Museum on the 9th Floor
chapters.content:
He signed the agreement and came to Macedonia Island for a very simple reason.
He treated it completely like leveling up in a game.
If he succeeded, the money he earned daily would double.
If he failed, he got nothing, and might even die.
But none of that mattered anymore.
At this moment, Hashimoto Kazuo slowly exhaled toward the sun in the sky.
Then, he continued walking step by step along the coastline.
As he walked, he suddenly spotted three small black dots ahead.
When the distance gradually closed,
he discovered they were three people.Taking a closer look, the three seemed to be in trouble.
One person was lying on the ground, while the other two were squatting beside them.
They had been continuously performing CPR on the person lying down.
As a doctor, Hashimoto Kazuo had a sense of professional ethics.
Therefore, he quickly ran over.
When he reached them, he said:
"Do you need help? I'm a doctor! (Japanese)"
Hearing the voice, a young male face filled with anxiety looked up and surprisingly also spoke Japanese: "That's great! My girlfriend accidentally drowned! Please, save her quickly! (Japanese)"
Hashimoto Kazuo looked down.
He saw the person lying down was a woman, completely soaked.
While the young man continuously performed CPR on her, the young woman lying down kept spitting out seawater from her mouth.
"Let me perform CPR on her. Your technique isn't standard—not only is it ineffective, but it could potentially make things worse! (Japanese)"
Hashimoto Kazuo took over and continued performing CPR and artificial respiration on the drowned young woman.
Hashimoto Kazuo truly lived up to being a doctor.
Soon, under his professional technique, the drowned young woman kept spitting out large amounts of seawater.
Her consciousness gradually returned.
Only then did Hashimoto Kazuo stop and say with a smile, "Your girlfriend is fine now. (Japanese)"
"Thank you! Thank you! (Japanese)"
The young man quickly expressed his gratitude.
Tears welled in his eyes, as if he had truly been terrified that something would happen to his girlfriend.
And after his girlfriend regained consciousness, he immediately hugged her tightly.
Tears fell as if they cost nothing.
"Ouch, you're hurting me..."
"Let me catch my breath first..."
Being tightly hugged right after waking up, the drowned woman couldn't quite handle it.
The young man smiled while wiping his tears: "I was just too nervous."
"By the way, Xiao Yan, what exactly happened to you underwater?"
"Your swimming skills are even better than mine, how could you have drowned?"
Hearing the name Xiao Yan, does it sound somewhat familiar?
That's right.
This drowned young woman was precisely Zhou Yan.
And the two beside her were her boyfriend Li Miguo, and Li Miguo's classmate Jimmy.
Hearing this question,
a look of extreme terror appeared on Zhou Yan's pretty face. She quickly looked down at her snow-white ankle, where there were two deep red marks.
They clearly looked like marks left by something grabbing her.
"There was someone! Or something else!"
"I was about to go up for air, but when I swam upward, something grabbed my foot!! It dragged me down desperately!!!"
Zhou Yan's voice trembled as she spoke, showing that she had been truly terrified.
So much so that after speaking, she threw herself into her boyfriend's arms, buried her head deeply, and actually began to cry.
Seeing his usually strong girlfriend like this, Li Miguo felt only heartache.
Originally, these three had arrived at Macedonia Island, checked into a nice hotel,
and then come out to play.
All three enjoyed diving.
But unlike Su Yang and the others, they didn't hire any diving instructors to join them.
Instead, they dove alone.
Since all three were confident in their swimming skills,
they acquired three pairs of fins
and three diving masks at Macedonia Island,
and went straight into diving.
Then this incident occurred during their dive.
Fortunately, although Zhou Yan had drowned, she was lucky to encounter a doctor.
So she was basically fine now.
Currently, the four of them were on this beach, with the sea on one side and dense green vegetation on the other.
Unknown to all four of them,
within the dense green vegetation, a pair of dangerous, dark eyes were secretly observing them from somewhere.
At this moment,
Hashimoto Kazuo, seeing that the person was fine, prepared to take his leave.
And just at that moment,
as he stood up,
his heart suddenly jolted.
He quickly crouched down.
Whoosh—an arrow flew over his head.
Because Hashimoto Kazuo crouched down in time, the arrow didn't hit him. Instead, it passed through the space where his head had been and landed in the golden sand.
The sound of the arrow startled the other three.
Following Hashimoto Kazuo's gaze, the three saw the arrow.
After avoiding being hit, Hashimoto Kazuo stood up, looked around, and finally fixed his gaze on the dense green vegetation ahead.
But at first glance, that area showed no apparent abnormalities.
"Who shot this arrow?!"
Li Miguo walked over to that part of the beach sand and pulled out the arrow.
He examined it carefully in his hand.
He found that the arrowhead was metal, very hard.
If it had actually hit someone, the person struck would definitely be either dead or seriously injured.
Great, his girlfriend had just nearly drowned, whether by human action or something else,
and now someone was shooting arrows here?
"This arrow was probably aimed at me, since it passed right over my head. (Japanese)"
Hashimoto Kazuo stepped forward and said.
Li Miguo was furious: "No matter who this arrow was aimed at! I will investigate this thoroughly!!!"
Since Hashimoto Kazuo had saved his girlfriend, and this incident happened right in front of him, Li Miguo certainly couldn't let it go either.
He absolutely had to find out who did this!
Seeing this, Hashimoto Kazuo remained silent.
Although he didn't know who was responsible,
he could roughly guess the purpose behind such an action.
"In Alice Apartment, I never encountered such direct methods."
Hashimoto Kazuo thought silently to himself.
...
Jiang Ran had originally planned to continue exploring the island, but the intense afternoon heat on Macedonia Island was unbearable, forcing him to give up.
With Xiao Q's trio, as well as Su Yang and Lin Baiyu leaving, he also lost interest in staying, so they all returned to the hotel together.
On their way back to the hotel,
Jiang Ran passed by the golden beach and noticed many people were still sunbathing.
Looking closer, they were all those white people.
White people seemed quite different from yellow people.
Not to mention other places, just in Hua Country, many considered pale skin beautiful.
The saying goes, "one white covers three ugliness."
Everyone hoped their skin could be whiter.
But those white people, since they were naturally pale,
often didn't cherish what came too easily.
Among those white people, tanned wheat-colored skin was very popular, considered beautiful.
After Jiang Ran and the others returned to the hotel,
Su Yang's international student friends and classmates went back to their own hotel rooms first.
Meanwhile, Xiao Q's trio decided to explore the hotel.
They also invited Jiang Ran to join them.
Jiang Ran couldn't refuse politely.
The hotel on Macedonia Island was simply called Macedonia Hotel.
It covered a vast area and had extremely high floors.
Jiang Ran and the others were on the 1st floor. Xiao Q was in the 1st-floor lobby, looking at the floor map.
They decided to go play on the 9th floor first.
The 9th floor was the Horror Museum.

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Lizardmen?
chapters.content:
When Xiao Q decided to go to the horror museum.
Xiao Peng's face immediately changed color.
If you wanted to go see beautiful women, he would raise both hands in agreement.
But if you wanted to go see something terrifying and horrifying.
He really had no interest in that.
To be blunt, he was a bit afraid of this kind of stuff.
Especially after experiencing the Alice Apartment incident, it made his scalp crawl even more.
And looking at Xiao Q and Ke Bei beside him with their enthusiastic expressions.
Xiao Peng immediately turned his gaze toward the fourth person who had just joined them—Jiang Ran.
"Jiang Ran, do you want to go to this horror museum?"Xiao Peng planned to recruit one ally to create a two-versus-two situation.
But what he miscalculated was.
Jiang Ran said: "Let's go take a look, I'm quite curious too, although I'm not particularly obsessed with scary things either."
Among these four people.
Xiao Q studied criminal investigation, and Ke Bei was a detective.
The things these two usually dealt with easily connected with horror and supernatural elements.
So both of them were quite interested in this kind of stuff.
There was no other choice—currently it was three against one, so Xiao Peng could only follow them.
The hotel had many elevators, and they felt very stable to ride.
The four of them took the elevator to the 9th floor.
When they reached the 9th floor, as soon as the elevator doors opened, they could feel an atmosphere of horror and the supernatural rushing toward them.
After the four exited the elevator, they looked around and inexplicably felt oppressed.
Because the decoration colors in this place were quite strange.
All black, red, and other horror atmosphere colors.
Especially the floor.
It was also deliberately made to look like old, damaged ceramic tiles with cracks.
After standing there for a while, the four saw an entrance not far from them.
On the poster in front of the entrance were written the five large characters: "Horror Museum."
These five large characters were in artistic font, pure black.
With a deep, black hole-like feeling.
The four arrived at the entrance.
There were about a dozen people near the museum entrance.
Outside were coffee machines, beverage machines, and tables.
Providing services for these people.
At the entrance, there were also two staff members dressed as Western vampires.
When they saw Jiang Ran and the other three preparing to enter the horror museum.
They handed each of the four a flyer.
Jiang Ran was the first to receive a flyer.
As soon as the flyer was in his hand, his eyebrows furrowed.
Because the overall style of this flyer was again of the horror and thriller type.
So, what was written on this flyer?
The content of this flyer was roughly:
There's a horror legend on Macedonia Island.
Every time it reaches the final day.
A bloody hunter will descend upon Macedonia Island to harvest everyone's lives.
Looking at this flyer, Jiang Ran almost laughed out loud if not for the eerily quiet atmosphere around him.
He didn't take this flyer seriously, just treating it as the horror museum creating atmosphere.
The four, holding their flyers, entered the entrance.
At the beginning of the entrance was a very long corridor tunnel.
On both sides of the corridor tunnel were various horror images with extreme realism.
And accompanying each horror image was a large amount of text.
This text was in English, Chinese, Japanese, and other languages.
Jiang Ran stopped and saw one of them was a painting of a black-furred werewolf under a blood moon that looked extremely lifelike.
And below this werewolf image was text like this:
[Werewolf, a creature from Western legends, this should have been just a myth, but in recent years, according to many eyewitness accounts, werewolves seem to truly exist in this world...]
There was more text, but Jiang Ran only read this much.
Then he immediately looked at other images.
He discovered that both sides of this tunnel corridor were filled with introductions to horror legends from around the world and various supernatural incidents.
Never mind horror enthusiasts coming in—even someone like Xiao Peng who wasn't interested in horror and supernatural events became curious looking at these and watched with great interest.
And just at that moment, a voice suddenly sounded from behind the four people. In the quiet environment, someone suddenly speaking gave them quite a fright.
"Hey, can you four move aside? You're blocking my spot! (Japanese)"
Jiang Ran and the other three turned their heads and saw that behind them, unclear when, a man in his fifties or sixties had appeared.
This man wasn't tall, less than 170 cm.
But he looked quite lean and strong.
The several people looked at each other—obviously none of the four understood what this fifty- or sixty-year-old man had said.
"Cherry Blossom Country person?"
Jiang Ran was the first to ask aloud.
The fifty- or sixty-year-old man gave Jiang Ran a strange look.
Then in broken Chinese, he said: "You are... Hua Country people?"
Jiang Ran nodded: "Yes."
After receiving the affirmative answer, this fifty- or sixty-year-old man scanned the four faces with a very hostile, hateful look.
"Really unlucky, I never expected to encounter Hua Country people even here."
"Huh? What do you mean?"
Xiao Peng immediately retorted with a question.
This fifty- or sixty-year-old Cherry Blossom Country man coldly laughed and said: "Just the literal meaning, I think it's unlucky."
After speaking, without further contact with Jiang Ran and the other three, he squeezed past the several people and disappeared into the tunnel corridor.
In the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
With the meeting of the two lab rats, the main camera naturally turned to this side.
Recording what had just happened.
Therefore, many people in the live stream saw it.
So, many people from other countries were asking why the tension between Hua Country people and Cherry Blossom Country people was always so intense?
In the Hua Country chat room of the live stream.
Regarding this question from people of other countries in the live stream.
These Hua Country people naturally knew the reason well.
Therefore, what they were discussing in their own chat room wasn't this question at all.
But rather.
Fairy Sister: [Can anyone tell me why Xiao Q, Xiao Peng, and Ke Bei are appearing here?]
Yes, the people in the Hua Country chat room were all full of question marks.
Why had the trio who escaped from Alice Apartment fallen into an even more dangerous den of evil?
How did they get here?
No one knew.
But these Hua Country viewers watching the live stream always felt that there was some earth-shattering secret hidden behind this.
After Jiang Ran and the other three passed through the tunnel corridor, they finally reached the main horror museum.
Just like the oppressive space after entering the 9th floor.
The decoration and design style here also made people feel uncomfortable all over, completely unsure what might suddenly pop out from behind them.
So, what exactly was in the horror museum?
Like ordinary museums.
For example, artifact museums collect artifacts from various dynasties—of course, whether the artifacts are real or fake is hard to say.
The horror museum is just like artifact museums, filled with things related to horror.
Of course, the horror museum is also like artifact museums in that the authenticity of the collections is unknown.
Jiang Ran and the others were now standing beside a glass display case, looking at the so-called corpse of a lizard person inside.
Lizard person.
According to various chaotic theories.
Roughly, this is a group of alien creatures that came to Blue Star from outer space.
There's another theory that lizard people are subterranean people, meaning indigenous inhabitants of Blue Star.
There's even a conspiracy theory.
Saying that many high-level figures on Blue Star today are actually lizard people.
Their purpose is to control the entire world.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: A Special Mission for the Lab Rat?
chapters.content:
Of course, there's another even more interesting one.
You've probably all heard of the drink called Monster Energy.
They say this Monster Energy drink was actually developed by lizard people.
It contains various energies that lizard people need to supplement.
And to make it convenient for lizard people around the world, one lizard person researched and created Monster Energy...
Staring at this lizard person corpse.
Jiang Ran discovered that this lizard person's corpse looked completely real.
Vivid and lifelike.
But upon closer observation, he noticed that some parts of this lizard person's body seemed to have damage.
He rubbed his chin, listening as Xiao Peng suddenly asked beside him:"Do you guys think lizard people actually exist in this world?"
Jiang Ran, Xiao Q, and Ke Bei didn't answer.
Because they couldn't answer.
After all, none of them had personally seen one.
Therefore, you couldn't say whether they truly existed or not.
And just at that moment, a man's voice suddenly spoke up:
"Lizard people absolutely exist."
The four of them turned around.
They discovered a white man in his forties slowly walking toward them.
This white man wore a blue suit and black high-end leather shoes.
His golden hair was meticulously groomed.
He looked exactly like a successful businessman.
As this white man approached, he continued speaking to them in Chinese:
"Right now, lizard people are everywhere around the world."
"They impersonate humans, attempting to replace humanity."
"Let me teach you how to determine if someone you know is a lizard person."
"First, lizard people often can't control their tongues when speaking, frequently sticking them out, just like real lizards."
"Second, lizard people's eyeballs will show obvious changes inadvertently, with vertical pupils."
"Third, lizard people have abnormally swollen necks."
Hearing this, with his left hand constantly rubbing his neck, Jiang Ran saw the other three were doing similar gestures.
It seemed none of them really believed this so-called lizard person theory.
The white man in his forties also noticed the four people's expressions.
He smiled and spread his hands: "It's fine, many people don't believe it, but you'll believe it once you encounter one."
...
"That white guy just now spoke as if it were real. Even if there are lizard people, aliens, and all sorts of chaotic things in the world, does it affect my 3,000-yuan-a-month beast-of-burden life after graduating from college?"
After Jiang Ran's group separated from that white man, they continued touring the Horror Museum.
And these words came from Xiao Peng complaining about lizard people.
Jiang Ran listened and said: "It really doesn't affect anything, but this is just a hobby interest, treat it as strange tales and anecdotes to look at."
Xiao Peng nodded: "Yes."
Just as they were discussing lizard people.
Xiao Q suddenly told Jiang Ran and the others to look ahead.
Several people looked up and discovered that about ten meters away from them, many people were lining up.
And Xiao Q's real intention in having them look forward was.
That fifty or sixty-year-old Cherry Blossom Country person they encountered earlier in the tunnel corridor was also there.
"What are they lining up for over there?"
Several people quickly walked over.
They discovered that what could make such a large crowd line up was actually a haunted house.
On both sides of the haunted house entrance stood two people dressed as Western Grim Reapers.
These two Western Grim Reapers, along with the two vampire-costumed people earlier at the museum entrance.
One could notice that although they wore very realistic clothing.
The clothing in front had golden peony patterns, and they also had staff ID badges.
Even though this really ruined the atmosphere.
Xiao Peng at this moment saw that the poster in front of the haunted house stated.
Those who passed through the haunted house would receive a surprise gift package.
Seeing there was a reward, Xiao Peng immediately pulled the other three to play together.
The other three didn't refuse either, and they all lined up here.
Their turn in line came quickly.
The two Grim Reaper-costumed staff at the entrance pulled open the ancient-style door.
Letting the four people enter together.
After the four people entered, they would wait three minutes before letting the next group of haunted house adventurers enter.
Before Jiang Ran's group of four entered, when they saw the door being pulled open and looked inside, their vision was dim.
After entering, when the door closed.
Their vision became even darker beyond description.
They took out their phones and turned on the flashlight function.
Four phone flashlights immediately made their vision much better.
The haunted house's terrifying atmosphere also weakened considerably.
Immediately, with phone flashlight beams shining forward.
They discovered there was only one path here.
They followed this path forward.
Jiang Ran used his flashlight to shine left and right.
He noticed the interior design style had that Western horror movie vibe of a long-uninhabited villa style.
The four walked forward for five minutes.
Forget encountering anything scary, they hadn't even encountered any haunted house NPCs.
Just as Xiao Peng finished complaining: "This haunted house isn't that great either?"
Then, they reached the end.
There was no path ahead.
Yes, seemingly no way forward, but actually not.
After several people approached, they discovered that ahead were many of those wooden doors.
Ke Bei, being bold, counted from one side to the other.
After counting, his voice clearly became somewhat serious:
"There are exactly 50 doors on this wall. I tried over ten of them, and they all opened. The others should open too."
Fifty doors covering the entire wall ahead, if not for the poor visibility.
This densely-packed feeling would give anyone with trypophobia an attack just from one look.
It was only at this point that the four began to feel this haunted house had something to it.
"With so many doors, should we separate? Or stick together?"
Xiao Q asked the other three.
Xiao Peng said: "If we stick together, it wouldn't be interesting."
Ke Bei said: "Alright, then you take one door alone, and we three will take another door."
Xiao Peng immediately made a dark face: "Forget it then."
Immediately, the four selected a door in a relatively central position and walked through.
...
The rude-speaking person Jiang Ran's group of four encountered earlier in the tunnel corridor was precisely:
Lab Rat Number 4, Cherry Blossom Country, male, 59 years old, Nakamori Aoshi, a chef.
His betting amount was 400 million USD, much higher than Jiang Ran's 230 million USD.
And before Jiang Ran's group of four entered the haunted house, Nakamori Aoshi had already been inside for about fifteen minutes.
So why did Nakamori Aoshi come to the Horror Museum and enter the haunted house?
Was it because he was also a haunted house enthusiast?
This was complete nonsense.
He wasn't interested in horror, ghosts, supernatural phenomena, or anything like that at all.
The reason he could come here was that when he arrived at his hotel room today—his hotel room was a single—after arriving, he discovered a piece of paper on his hotel room bed.
On the paper was a paragraph in English: Every lab rat has a special mission.
Your special mission: Go to the Horror Museum on the hotel's 9th floor, inside the haunted house, find a golden postcard in a box.
Hold the golden postcard until the 7 days end.
You will receive 1 million USD.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Among the Lab Rats — Sen Qingshi
chapters.content:
Nakamori Aoshi looked at this blank piece of paper and felt it was real—a special mission given to him by the apartment.
So, would he accept it?
He would definitely accept.
After all, why did he enter Alice Apartment?
It was definitely for the money!
When he was young, he was just a cook.
His specialty was grilled fish.
As a cook, his biggest dream was to open his own izakaya.
Finally, this dream came true when he was 35 years old.
The dream was realized at 35, but shattered at 38.Due to poor management and other reasons, his first izakaya went bankrupt.
All the money he had earned from working before was lost.
But he didn't give up, so he continued working and saving money.
Finally, when he was 47 years old, using his savings and loan money,
he opened his second izakaya.
As a result, his bad luck caused it to go bankrupt again after just one year.
This bankruptcy hit him hard.
Because the money for his second izakaya included loan funds.
After that, he started working again to make a living and repay the loans.
Finally, when he was 53 years old, with his unfinished loans and betting his entire life,
he borrowed from loan sharks!
And started his third izakaya!
As the saying goes, third time's the charm—the third time, he succeeded!
Not only did he repay all the bank loans and private loan shark debts!
But he even had money to open branch stores!!!
During that period, he was riding high on success.
And that same year, he kept several young women as mistresses.
Not only were there Cherry Blossom Country girls, but also Hua Country and Vietnam girls.
He spent his days drinking and indulging with these girls.
Especially under the influence of the Hua Country mistress he kept, he even picked up gambling.
Gambling, gambling—it always starts with small bets and ends with losing everything.
He was no exception.
Not only did he gamble away all his stores,
but he also accumulated countless debts.
And with this sudden change,
all the mistresses he kept naturally packed their things and ran away.
As for his wife and son,
they hadn't abandoned him during his two business failures and had even encouraged him.
But after his business success with the izakaya,
seeing his moral decay,
his wife and son were completely disappointed and had long since distanced themselves from him.
Thus, he had nothing left.
Looking back on the past, he felt it was all that Hua Country girl's fault.
If it weren't for her leading him into gambling, how could he have ended up like this?
So this was also why he intensely disliked Hua Country people.
Anyway, the subsequent story goes without saying.
While he was working, a mysterious middle-aged man approached him.
Gave him an agreement... the agreement to enter Alice Apartment...
Therefore, when Nakamori Aoshi saw that paper about finding the golden postcard in his hotel room,
he clearly understood.
If he could find the golden postcard and get that 1 million USD, he would have the capital to start over.
He wouldn't need to keep struggling to earn money in Alice Apartment!
Of course, he felt this special mission definitely wouldn't be this simple—it would be very difficult.
But it was worth taking the gamble.
...
The door Nakamori Aoshi chose was Door 10, because 10 was his lucky number.
Of course, this Door 10 was counted by himself from right to left as number 10.
At this moment, the equipment he carried included: his own Fruit Phone, and a sharp fruit knife stolen from the hotel kitchen.
There was no other way—with flight security checks, dangerous items like that couldn't be brought on the plane.
Therefore, after arriving at Macedonia Island, all equipment had to be sourced locally.
"Are all haunted houses this boring? Then what are all those young people online screaming about all day? (Japanese)"
Inside the haunted house. Nakamori Aoshi used his phone's flashlight to illuminate the path ahead.
So far, after entering Door 10, he had been following the path without any forks.
Along the way, aside from it being truly pitch black with poor visibility,
he just felt inexplicably cold all over, unsure if it was because the haunted house had air conditioning on.
As for anything else, there was nothing, and nothing happened.
And just as he finished complaining that haunted houses were this boring,
sounds suddenly emerged around him.
"Wa...haha...wahaha..."
"Waha...ha..."
An ethereal, quiet woman's singing voice suddenly arose.
If you were a horror movie enthusiast, or liked watching horror movie explanations online,
you would definitely be familiar with this music.
This was a very classic horror music soundtrack called "Shiver."
If you searched for horror music on TikTok, you could find a bunch of similar soundtracks.
And in this kind of dark, silent environment, suddenly hearing this horror music—
unless you were truly brave, you'd feel somewhat panicked inside.
So, did Nakamori Aoshi panic?
He was okay.
He was indeed startled when he heard the sound.
But after being startled, he regained his composure.
After all, in the Cherry Blossom Country's Alice Apartment, he had counter-killed two deranged criminals.
No matter how you put it, his hands had been stained with blood.
He wouldn't be afraid of a mere haunted house.
Especially since he liked watching Cherry Blossom Country's historical dramas.
Historical dramas: Cherry Blossom Country's long-form historical series.
For example: "The One-Eyed Dragon Masamune," "Takeda Shingen," "Sanada Maru," "Shinsengumi!" etc.
These are all historical dramas.
However, Cherry Blossom Country's young people don't like watching them, while middle-aged and elderly people adore them.
And since he liked watching historical dramas, his favorite historical figure was Sanada Yukimura.
One of Cherry Blossom Country's three great tragic heroes.
During the Summer Siege of Osaka, he charged into Tokugawa Ieyasu's main camp, nearly killing Ieyasu and changing history.
But ultimately, he didn't change it, and died in this battle.
This historical figure is quite similar to Zhao Yun from the Three Kingdoms period.
But definitely not as fierce as Zhao Yun—after all, that fierce man carried A Dou and managed to charge through seven times, finally escaping successfully.
As for why he liked Sanada Yukimura?
He definitely admired his bravery, and also his loyalty to Toyotomi Hideyoshi.
Perhaps because he liked this historical figure,
when he moved into the Cherry Blossom Country's Alice Apartment,
and gradually understood what the apartment contained,
he didn't feel fear toward those deranged criminals or deranged serial killers.
Because he felt that these deranged criminals and deranged serial killers only seemed scary in peaceful times.
If placed in ancient war periods, like the Cherry Blossom Country's Warring States period,
which general or soldier's hands weren't stained with more blood than these fools?
What were these people worth in front of them?
Therefore, he wasn't afraid at all.
"However, I've been walking for so long? Where is that box containing the golden postcard? Why isn't there any hint at all? (Japanese)"
He walked forward for another five minutes, and the horror music in his ears had already changed three times.
And just at this moment, he vaguely saw two human figures ahead.
He walked over, and the two figures ahead slowly turned toward him.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Return of the Chainsaw Maniac — Welcome to Hell
chapters.content:
"Is that you? (Japanese)"
As Nakamori Aoshi approached, he realized it was the young Cherry Blossom Country couple who had been standing a few places ahead of him in line earlier.
Both the young man and woman from this Cherry Blossom Country couple were trembling uncontrollably from head to toe.
Looking at their faces, they were extremely pale.
Seeing the two in this state, Nakamori Aoshi's thick eyebrows furrowed deeply.
He felt profound contempt in his heart.
"What's wrong with you two? How can you be scared like this? (Japanese)"
The young woman from the couple was already unable to speak, while the young man said: "We just saw a white shadow flash into the passageway on the right! (Japanese)"
Following the young man's words, Nakamori Aoshi walked forward with his phone and discovered a fork in the road ahead.
After speaking, he prepared to head into the right passageway.After all, he had been walking for so long without any clues, and suddenly a white shadow appeared. Although he didn't know what it was, it was better than nothing.
Just as Nakamori Aoshi was about to enter the right passageway.
He felt something pulling him from behind.
Turning around, he saw it was the young man: "Mister, can we come with you? We're too scared. If you help us get out, I'll give you my girlfriend's share of the mystery gift package! (Japanese)"
His girlfriend also nodded repeatedly: "Yes, mister, please!!! (Japanese)"
Seeing the couple like this.
Nakamori Aoshi spoke in a tone of profound disappointment: "If all the young people in Cherry Blossom Country today are like you, scared to death just playing in a haunted house, then I think this country is doomed!!! (Japanese)"
After speaking, Nakamori Aoshi directly shook off the two and entered the right passageway first.
After he left the young couple.
He muttered under his breath: "No wonder everyone says the younger generation is the useless generation. I finally understand that today. (Japanese)"
As he finished muttering, he suddenly heard a "slap" sound. This sound was very close to him, originating extremely near his left ear.
So why was it so close?
Because something had just patted his left shoulder, producing that slapping sound.
This wasn't an illusion, he was certain of that.
As for whether it was the young couple catching up?
Impossible, absolutely impossible. He had been paying attention all along, and this place was extremely quiet—only his own footsteps, no second person's.
So what was it that had patted his shoulder?
He slowly turned around.
Despite being fully mentally prepared, he was still startled.
Standing behind him was a person about the same height as himself.
This should be a man.
He was dressed entirely in black.
What was horrifying was that his face was extremely pale.
His two eyeballs were very small, his nose was just a faint black dot, and his mouth was stretched wide.
The stretched-open mouth was filled with sharp triangular teeth like a shark's.
When Nakamori Aoshi saw this man, his breathing stopped for several seconds.
Then his right fist suddenly swung out, punching the man directly in the face.
He directly punched a large hole in the man's face.
But strangely, although a large hole was punched in the man's face, there was no bleeding.
Nor were there any screams of pain.
Nakamori Aoshi immediately retracted his fist.
The man fell lightly to the ground.
During the fall, he swayed left and right before finally collapsing on the ground.
Not raising a single speck of dust.
So it turned out this wasn't a real person, just something made from paper materials shaped into a terrifying human figure.
Nakamori Aoshi then used his phone flashlight to shine above his head—perfectly normal black ceiling.
He didn't see anything strange, and when he shone it to his left, right, and the ground.
There were none of the strings or similar things he had imagined.
Alright, he admitted he had underestimated this haunted house.
This thing had genuinely scared him.
And the frightened Nakamori Aoshi viciously stomped on the paper figure countless times to vent his anger.
Only after finally relieving his anger did he leave this place.
It seemed that after great difficulty comes great fortune.
Perhaps because he encountered this paper figure.
Nakamori Aoshi soon reached what seemed like a dead end.
At the end was an iron door.
The iron door looked extremely weathered, covered in rust.
Nakamori Aoshi was overjoyed. Although he didn't know what was inside, it was certainly better than going around in circles.
He reached out with his left hand to grab the rusty iron door handle and pulled backward.
The door opened.
After the door opened, it was pitch black inside. He raised his phone flashlight to shine inside.
He discovered it was an enclosed space inside.
Whether because it was sealed or not, when the door opened, it emitted an indescribable rusty stench.
But regardless of that, Nakamori Aoshi was very excited now.
Because in this small enclosed room, he saw a black wooden box on a silver stainless steel tabletop.
If he guessed correctly, this should be the wooden box containing the golden postcard!
Excellent! As long as he found this golden postcard, when these 7 days ended.
He could get 1 million USD!
Then he could restart his izakaya business!
He excitedly rushed over.
Reaching the silver stainless steel table, he opened the black wooden box.
After opening it, he shone his phone flashlight inside.
At the same time, the peripheral light also illuminated Nakamori Aoshi's face.
His originally excited face, with that smile stretching to the corners of his mouth, was disappearing at visible speed.
"Where's the golden postcard?"
After opening the box, Nakamori Aoshi discovered there was no golden postcard inside at all.
There was only a white piece of paper.
On the white paper was an English sentence:
"Fool, you've been tricked! There's no golden postcard at all!!!"
Nakamori Aoshi actually didn't know English.
Therefore, whether it was the white paper in the hotel or this white paper before him.
He needed to take out his phone for photo translation.
And after he used his phone for photo translation and learned this result.
He angrily tore the white paper to shreds.
"Baka! Baka yarou! Baka!!!"
He kept repeating words like "idiot" and "go to hell" in his mouth.
After repeating this for about two minutes, he finally realized something seemed wrong.
Was that white paper in his hotel room really left by the people behind the apartment?
If they really left it, they wouldn't have created this to mess with him!
After all, from his experience surviving 4 rounds in Alice Apartment, he didn't think the people behind the apartment would play such deceptive tricks.
But if they didn't leave it? Then who could it be?
Just as he was painfully pondering without finding an answer.
His ears trembled slightly.
Strange sounds again fell upon his ears.
This sound was a very fast, continuous "buzz buzz buzz" noise.
The sound was coming from behind.
The moment Nakamori Aoshi turned around, he switched his phone from his right hand to his left, then drew the fruit knife from his waist with his right hand.
It seemed he was right-handed.
And when he turned around, the light from his phone flashlight didn't penetrate out of this small room.
Because standing in the doorway of this small room was a figure.
That figure blocked all the light.
Confining the light within this small enclosed room.
That figure.
Was about 1.8 meters tall.
Wore an ugly mask on his face.
Was dressed in the standard clothing of a pig-slaughtering Hunter.
In his hands was an oversized black-and-red chainsaw, buzzing loudly.
The sharp saw blade seemed capable of cutting through anything.
After this figure blocked the doorway, although his face was masked and couldn't be seen.
From his voice, it could be judged he was a man.
This man laughed with a mocking, cackling laughter:
"Welcome to hell! (English)"

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Nakamori Aoshi vs Chainsaw Murderer
chapters.content:
Nakamori Aoshi had previously killed two deranged criminals in the Alice Apartment in Cherry Blossom Country.
The first was a male homosexual killer.
His criminal process involved imprisoning men, and killing them once he got tired of playing.
The second was a cannibal. (Intentional typo, you know what I mean.)
But neither of those deranged criminals gave him as intense a feeling as the chainsaw murderer before him now.
An intense sense of lethality.
An intense aura of danger.
Nakamori Aoshi had never visited a haunted house before, so he didn't know that haunted houses might have NPCs.
Of course, the one before him couldn't possibly be an NPC either.
After all, Nakamori Aoshi was a lab rat who had survived four rounds.Therefore, he gestured with his eyes toward the countless snow-white pieces of paper he had torn up on the ground, saying:
"Did you do this? (Japanese)"
While speaking, Nakamori Aoshi's two black eyeballs practically wanted to jump out of their sockets.
Searching for an escape route.
But unfortunately, this small room in the confined space was exactly as it appeared when he first entered - completely visible at a glance.
Only the door at the entrance was the sole exit, and that door was now blocked.
The chainsaw murderer didn't answer his question.
Of course, even without an answer, Nakamori Aoshi could guess that the person before him was behind this.
He thought to himself that this might be the deadly crisis on this island.
But why was this deadly crisis so much more lethal than what he experienced at the Alice Apartment in Cherry Blossom Country? It seemed completely hopeless?
At that moment, the chainsaw murderer swung his chainsaw and charged forward.
Looking at that extra-long chainsaw, then looking at the small fruit knife in his own right hand.
Did Nakamori Aoshi think he still had hope of surviving?
Even if survival seemed impossible, he had to try to live.
Just like the historical figure he admired - Sanada Yukimura, who made an all-or-nothing charge against Tokugawa Ieyasu's main camp.
As long as he could behead Tokugawa Ieyasu, he would win!
And similarly, if he could plunge his fruit knife into the chainsaw murderer's neck, he would win!
Unfortunately, unfortunately.
In the era of cold weapons, longer weapons always had the advantage.
Although swords were handsome, refined and elegant.
But when ancient military commanders killed enemies, have you ever seen anyone use a sword?
Who ever used a sword to achieve great feats?
Therefore, before Nakamori Aoshi could get close to the chainsaw murderer, the chainsaw murderer's chainsaw had already chopped into Nakamori Aoshi's left shoulder.
Instantly, the sizzling friction sound of bone against metal saw blade.
Red blood spurted out from that area.
Nakamori Aoshi didn't turn to look at his left shoulder that had been struck by the chainsaw - he didn't need to look, because the left side of his face was already covered with blood that had sprayed onto his own face.
He let out a loud "AHHHHHHH" roar.
Surprisingly enduring the intense, heart-wrenching pain.
He charged forward fiercely.
Originally, the head of the chainsaw blade had struck and cut into his shoulder, but with this fierce charge, it now became the tail end of the chainsaw blade that was cutting his left shoulder.
But fortunately, he had closed the distance to the chainsaw murderer, and although the fruit knife in his right hand couldn't reach the person's neck.
It could still stab into his heart - this was the most lethal target he could hit from this distance.
Nakamori Aoshi exerted all his strength, holding the fruit knife in a reverse grip and fiercely stabbing toward the chainsaw murderer's heart position.
The phone in his left hand had long since fallen to the ground due to the pain.
His phone landed screen down, so the flashlight on the back of the phone shone upward from the ground.
Allowing people to clearly see the fight between the two men.
"Die! (Japanese)"
Nakamori Aoshi's right-hand fruit knife stabbed fiercely into the chainsaw murderer's chest.
But, the imagined scene of the knife tip, and even the blade behind it, penetrating the heart didn't happen.
Instead, when the fruit knife tip stabbed into the heart position, it made a sizzling sound.
It felt like stabbing into some very hard steel.
Then, due to excessive force and inertia.
The fruit knife tip slid downward, drawing a line.
This line produced intense sparks from metal friction.
"This? How is this possible?! (Japanese)"
Nakamori Aoshi refused to believe what he was seeing.
His two eyes bulged out intensely, staring at the chainsaw murderer before him like dead fish eyes.
The chainsaw murderer just laughed while flipping the chainsaw, no longer cutting Nakamori Aoshi's left shoulder, but instead cutting toward the more vulnerable neck composed of flesh and blood without bones...
Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
The live stream screen switched from Nakamori Aoshi and the chainsaw murderer back to the studio.
In the studio, the Cherry Blossom Country Beautiful Host stood up and said:
The live stream screen switched from Nakamori Aoshi and the chainsaw murderer back to the studio.
After Nakamori Aoshi was declared dead.
The live stream room erupted with discussion.
A person from Korea said: 【This 59-year-old old man, I actually thought he wouldn't live much longer anyway, since he's the oldest among these 10 lab rats. When people get older, their bodies deteriorate in various ways. I just didn't expect him to be the second to die, and such a horrible death too!】
Cherry Blossom—Yamamoto Colonel: 【What bastards, why did that cosplaying chainsaw murderer target our Cherry Blossom Country's lab rat? If not for that, Nakamori Aoshi wouldn't have died!】
A San—Whoever Mentions Lizards Again, I'll Get Angry: 【What kind of talk is that? If Nakamori Aoshi wasn't greedy for that 1 million USD, he wouldn't have died. If we're talking about who died more unjustly, isn't our A San Country's Rajiv more unjust than this Nakamori Aoshi?】
Hua Country chat room in the live stream.
Middle-aged Uncle: 【Everyone, doesn't anyone find this strange?】
I'm Actually a Girl: 【Strange how?】
Middle-aged Uncle: 【Don't you feel that the two lab rats who died were very weak? They don't seem like they reached the level of surviving four rounds...】
Domineering Female CEO: 【You can't say that - it might be that their opponents were too strong, making them appear weak. For example, if you play table tennis and you're the champion of your city, but I make you play against national team players and you lose. Are you really weak? Actually no, you're already quite strong, but you encountered opponents who weren't even in the same league.】
While these Hua Country people were chatting, the live stream screen switched from the studio back to the small room where Nakamori Aoshi died.
What happened next was completely unexpected by these Hua Country people.
While these Hua Country people were chatting, the live stream screen switched from the studio back to the small room where Nakamori Aoshi died.
And beneath the mask was someone these Hua Country people were all too familiar with!
That was—Manager Xiao Zhang!!!
Seeing Xiao Zhang's face.
I am the Hero immediately commented: 【Holy shit, so this business trip was to Macedonia Island?】
In the small room.
After Manager Xiao Zhang took off his mask, he stared at Nakamori Aoshi's severed head and body on the ground.
He stretched and flexed his muscles.
The corner of his mouth curled into a terrifying arc: "Don't worry, you won't be the last."

chapters.title: Chapter 282: The Head Is Gone—Along with the Shredded Paper on the Ground
chapters.content:
Manager Xiao Zhang's business trip at that time was actually to come to Macedonia Island and become one of the deranged criminals, a deranged serial killer.
According to the rules of the special live stream,
his mission was already completed. For the next 7 days, he could completely enjoy the sea like an ordinary tourist.
But remember, Manager Xiao Zhang wasn't an ordinary person who clocked in for work and went home to play games.
He was a psychopath.
You might want to ask, if Manager Xiao Zhang was the chainsaw murderer, then who was the chainsaw murderer killed by the retired American special forces soldier Golden Beard back then?
Heh, the whole story goes like this.
In Hua Country's Alice Apartment, there was only one chainsaw murderer.
That was Manager Xiao Zhang.
Whenever the chainsaw murderer appeared, it was always him.Except for that time when he attacked American Golden Beard.
So what exactly happened that time?
It was like this:
As the apartment manager, he usually stayed in the management office, so he had a clear view of everyone entering and exiting the apartment.
Therefore, when American Golden Beard entered the apartment back then to look for Ou Yingying and the others,
it wasn't like he didn't see him.
Since he saw him, he naturally had to conduct some investigation himself.
Using his privileges as the manager and his authority to kill lab rats.
So after understanding the situation clearly,
he had a security guard from the security team replace him.
Then that poor security guard died.
Assuming the identity of the chainsaw murderer.
But it was fine, Manager Xiao Zhang also contacted Old Dog to clean up the unfinished situation.
...
Taking off the mask seemed to be for breathing fresh air.
But currently the small room was filled with the bloody scent of Nakamori Aoshi.
Which meant Manager Xiao Zhang's intoxicated breathing appearance should have been him smelling the bloody scent.
He was thoroughly enjoying it.
Probably having smelled enough, he put the mask back on.
He placed Nakamori Aoshi's head, which had been severed by the chainsaw, into a small box.
Then he himself dragged Nakamori Aoshi's headless corpse with one hand, walking out of the small room.
No one knew what Manager Xiao Zhang intended to do.
But as he dragged the body, a long trail of blood was left on the ground.
"No one gets to leave..."
"Including my dear colleague, Little Jiang Ran..."
Manager Xiao Zhang continuously hummed a song of death, step by step disappearing into the darkness.
Inside the haunted house.
Jiang Ran and the other three had already experienced the sudden terrifying music that Nakamori Aoshi encountered.
And the paper figure.
When they suddenly heard the terrifying music, the four of them didn't feel much about it. After all, there was safety in numbers.
Therefore, the four of them even mocked at that time, saying this haunted house was nothing special, having walked for so long with only this one attraction?
But then the paper figure patted shoulders, simultaneously patting all four of their shoulders.
The four of them stopped being tough-talking, especially after they examined the paper figure and the walls around the area where they were standing.
They simply couldn't figure out how this paper figure had appeared?
And how it had patted their shoulders?
Xiao Peng was the most angry after being scared.
After discovering what scared them was a paper figure, he started cursing loudly, then directly tore the paper figure's head and body apart with his hands.
After tearing it apart, he threw it on the ground.
After the paper figure incident, none of the several people paid much attention, preparing to leave, but an eerie wind blew in from somewhere.
The eerie wind blew the paper figure on the ground, flipping it over.
The paper figure before Jiang Ran and the others' eyes was the kind that was completely white all over, with the face being the same as what Nakamori Aoshi encountered.
Therefore, when the paper figure was flipped over by the wind, they glanced and saw the paper figure's back.
Immediately, the four people who were preparing to leave stopped in their tracks.
They all gathered around the paper figure.
Xiao Q even picked up the paper figure.
Staring at the paper figure's back, he muttered to himself: "This should be a map, this circle is our current position? What is this X? It has a treasure pattern drawn? This checkmark should be where the exit is?"
The several people looked at each other in wide-eyed surprise.
None of them had expected that this suddenly appearing paper figure would have a haunted house map on its back.
"So should we go directly to this exit, or go to this X location?"
Jiang Ran asked at this point.
Xiao Peng excitedly said: "Of course we go to this X location first, this is treasure!!"
After discussion, they prepared to first go to this X location to look for the treasure.
According to the map, they quickly found the location marked with an X within the maze-like haunted house.
However, before arriving at this X location,
they saw a long trail of dragged blood on the ground.
If this long trail of dragged blood appeared elsewhere, it would be strange and very problematic.
But since this was a haunted house, everything seemed perfectly reasonable.
Jiang Ran and the other three followed the blood trail and the map to the source where the blood trail appeared.
In front of an iron door.
The four people walked forward, Xiao Q pulled open the iron door.
The moment he pulled open the iron door, a strong smell of rust and blood directly entered the four people's nasal cavities.
Stimulated by this bloody smell, the four people covered their noses with their left hands, while their right hands aimed their phone flashlights at the space behind the opened door.
This was a small room, an enclosed space.
When four beams of light shone inside,
it was a scene beyond all four of their imaginations.
Within the narrow space, it was like a bloody hell.
The walls, the floor, were all covered in blood, and there were also some unknown flesh remnants.
"This, this is really the treasure location?"
Xiao Peng stared at the scene before him, completely unable to believe it.
Ke Bei pointed inside the small room and said: "Look, there's a box on that stainless steel table, the treasure might be there."
Yes, the treasure might be there, but the current problem was, who would go get it?
The place was covered in blood everywhere, not knowing what kind of blood it was.
None of the several people wanted to get contaminated.
Xiao Q pushed Xiao Peng and laughed: "Xiao Peng, you go, after all you were the one who led us to look for treasure."
Xiao Peng's face darkened upon hearing this, but there was no choice, he indeed was the one who led them.
He could only cover his nose and enter the small room.
He walked very slowly, afraid that the blood on the ground would splash onto his pants.
When he reached the stainless steel table and prepared to open the box, he reached into his pocket for paper.
After feeling around, there was none.
Therefore, he could only find an uncontaminated spot on the box to push open the lid.
He pressed two fingers on the edge of the lid, slowly pushing it upward. As the lid lifted, the space inside the box was revealed to the world.
When the lid was completely opened, Xiao Peng stared inside the box, frozen for three seconds.
After three seconds, he suddenly erupted in rage, kicking over the box with one foot.
The three people outside the door were startled by Xiao Peng's commotion.
Not caring about the blood inside the room or anything, they rushed into the small room.
They stared at the overturned box on the ground, asking Xiao Peng what was wrong?
Xiao Peng pointed angrily and said there was nothing inside the box, it was empty.
This so-called treasure was purely messing with people.
The several people were stunned upon hearing this. Jiang Ran used his foot to flip over the kicked box, discovering that there was indeed nothing inside, completely empty.
Xiao Peng, very angry at this moment, walked out directly, shouting as he went: "Let's get out of this haunted house! Garbage haunted house! Messing with me?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Test Subject No. 8, Amir
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Test Subject No. 8, Amir
Great, It’s the Pervy Neighbor. We’re Doomed
"Hey, Ke Bei, what are you still looking at in that room? Aren't you coming?"
Xiao Peng had already left, with Jiang Ran following behind.
Xiao Q had one foot out of the small room when he turned back and saw Ke Bei staring at something on the wall.
"Oh, coming."
Ke Bei quickly caught up, and as he passed by Xiao Q, he spoke in an extremely soft voice, like a mosquito's buzz: "That might be human blood."
Hearing this, Xiao Q turned his head in surprise but didn't speak, his eyes seeming to ask, are you sure?
Ke Bei extended one hand, showing an eight.
This meant he was eighty percent certain.
Afterwards, the group followed the paper figure map and found the exit.
The exit was still on the 9th floor, just on the other side of it.
After they exited the haunted house, they received large gift packages from two staff members dressed as vampire hunters at the haunted house exit.
One package per person.
The large gift package was simply a bagged gift set.
When opened, it contained various small toys and mini figures.
Things like vampire figures, zombie figures, palm-sized peach wood swords, and similar items.
Looking at these, Xiao Peng's anger finally subsided a bit.
While the four of them were coming out to receive gifts, there were already many people at the exit who had left the haunted house earlier.
Those who had come with companions were all complaining that this haunted house wasn't scary at all.
Aside from being dark and requiring light sources,
and playing scary music, there wasn't much else to it.
The only thing that could be considered a feature was that the haunted house was like a maze.
Listening to these comments, the four of them realized that these people apparently hadn't encountered the paper figure that tapped shoulders?
After the four of them emerged from the haunted house, they went their separate ways, each returning to their own hotel rooms.
...
It was exactly 5:00 PM now.
Room 4212 was a single room.
It housed a person from A San Country.
This person from A San Country was none other than Lab Rat No. 8, Amir.
His betting amount was 500 million USD.
So why was his betting amount so high?
In this special live stream, A San Country had two lab rats.
One was the already deceased fruit vendor, Rajiv, with 256.7 million USD.
The other was this one, with 500 million USD.
Looking at the betting distribution, over eighty percent of his betting amount came from wealthy individuals in A San Country themselves.
This meant that those in the live stream room from A San Country who knew this Amir believed in his capabilities.
Their belief in him was higher than their belief in Rajiv had been!
So what capabilities did this Amir possess?
According to the simple information provided, he was just a taxi driver!
Could he be some kind of shady driver?
The type of lab rat who was ruthless and vicious?
No, the reason he won so much in betting amounts
was purely because he knew how to play it safe.
During the four rounds he spent in the A San Country's Alice Apartment, he hadn't eliminated a single deranged criminal or deranged serial killer.
After discovering the apartment's secrets, he simply holed up in his own room and played it safe.
Actually, playing it safe can sometimes be really effective.
Just like when playing battle royale games.
Often, by playing safe and hiding, you can manage to reach the top rankings.
Of course, the most popular battle royale game on mobile phones now, Game for Peace, is full of cheaters - if you're unlucky enough to encounter someone with wallhacks, they'll directly chase you down in a vehicle and take you out.
But this was reality.
Therefore, Amir actually managed to play it safe through all 4 rounds.
After arriving at Macedonia Island, although Amir really wanted to go out and have fun,
he felt there must be great danger here, so he decided to continue employing his strategy of playing it safe.
As soon as he got his hotel room key today,
after briefly organizing his room, he used a hotel cart to gather lots of food and water. It was free anyway, and the hotel didn't restrict you.
He stockpiled everything in his hotel room.
Enough to sustain himself for over 7 days without needing to go out.
Afterwards, he also went to the duty-free shops, supermarkets, and other stores near the hotel.
He bought a red football uniform - exactly like the one worn by the football zombie in Plants vs. Zombies, completely identical.
And also a baseball bat.
Although everything was free on Macedonia Island for those who bought tickets,
the premise was that you didn't take things off the island.
If you took things off the island, you had to pay, so what Amir actually paid was a deposit.
When it was time to leave the island, he could return the items without much loss, as the full amount would be refunded.
After completing all this, Amir returned to his hotel room.
After returning, he even went to the extreme of piling all movable items in the hotel room against the door from the inside, blocking it.
This was a measure to prevent anyone from entering from outside.
Only after doing all this did he truly feel at ease and relax.
For him, with this combination of preparations he'd made,
he could definitely easily get through the 7 days.
After all, he had managed to stay safe for so long in the A San Country's Alice Apartment.
But he had no idea that this place operated completely differently from the Alice Apartments in some countries.
"Wife, son, daughter, wait for me. I'll soon have enough money saved up for immigration."
Now, Amir was in his hotel room, murmuring to himself while looking out at the blue sky and sea outside.
Like many people who entered Alice Apartment, some discovered the apartment's tricks but still chose to stay because they needed money.
Amir needed money, lots of money. Why?
Because he wanted to immigrate.
He wanted to take his whole family and immigrate to the UK.
He felt that the living environment in A San Country wasn't suitable for continuing to live there.
There were really too many people, and many men were simply insane, so desperate that they wouldn't even spare lizards.
Therefore, in a place where even lizards could be coveted,
Amir worried about his wife and daughter every day.
This was one reason he wanted to immigrate to the UK.
The second reason was A San Country's caste system.
Although it's said that A San Country's caste system was legally abolished long ago,
if you search your heart and ask, has the caste system really disappeared?
If it had truly disappeared,
he wouldn't be working so hard to take his whole family away from A San Country.
Currently, Amir lay on the soft large bed, looking at a family photo of the four of them on his phone.
He couldn't hide the happy smile on his lips.
Just then, there was suddenly a knocking sound at the door.
Along with a voice:
"Sir, would you like special service? (English)"
From the sound, it was a young girl.
Amir, lying on the bed, shouted toward the door: "No need! (English)"
Amir was very loyal to his wife.
He wouldn't do anything that would betray his wife.
After he replied that he didn't need special service, there was no further sound from outside the door, only the tapping sound of footsteps walking away.
Amir lay on the bed, eyes open, staring at the snow-white ceiling.
Perhaps it was the exhaustion from the several hours on the boat earlier, or perhaps it was the mental and physical energy consumed after arriving at the hotel while moving food and water and other preparations for playing it safe.
Amir now only felt that his eyelids were so heavy, so very heavy.
He himself didn't know when it happened, but he ended up falling fast asleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Targeted...
chapters.content:
After Amir fell asleep.
A figure appeared outside his room 4212.
This figure took a room card out of his pocket.
He pressed the room card against the sensor area.
But there was no reaction.
It seemed Amir had deadbolted his hotel room door before falling asleep.
That's why the spare room card couldn't open it.
Actually, even if it had opened, this figure would have faced two more problems.
First, besides deadbolting, Amir had also engaged the security chain.
Second, he had piled up a bunch of things against the door.At this very moment.
This person's every move was being watched with crystal clarity by viewers in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room.
The Hua Country viewers in the live stream room.
Watched this scene with a sense of profound familiarity.
Because wasn't this scene remarkably similar to when Huang Kaiyu entered Jiang Ran's home during Round 28?
Right now, it was like watching a reenactment, just with different actors and location.
Given this similarity, the only question was how the final outcome would turn out!
After all, Jiang Ran had successfully survived and nearly turned the tables - now it was up to this Amir!
Meanwhile, the A San Country viewers in the live stream room seemed quite confident in Amir.
A San—Whoever Mentions Lizards Again, I'll Get Angry:
【Heh, this person trying to get into Amir's room is just wishful thinking! Amir is a master of the survival strategy!
