In our A San Country's Alice Apartment, he easily survived 4 rounds as a true expert! Let me see, wow! As expected of Amir, not only did he secure the door perfectly, he even deadbolted the balcony! Invincible!】
This hotel room had only two entry points.
The first was the door. The second was the balcony.
The balcony was an open-air balcony, with two large glass sliding doors separating it from the room.
And these two large glass sliding doors were also deadbolted.
One could say Amir appeared quite safe.
But was he truly safe?
Watching A San—Whoever Mentions Lizards Again, I'll Get Angry in the live stream.
Many viewers from other countries remained silent.
Just quietly waiting for events to unfold.
Of course, there were inevitably some who couldn't resist replying to him.
Big Bear Country—Zero: 【The survival strategy? We had lab rats in Big Bear Country's Alice Apartment who tried that strategy too, though some lasted long while others didn't fare well. Currently, we have someone in Big Bear Country who's survived dozens of rounds using that approach...】
Yes, survival strategy execution varied in quality.
Surviving 4 rounds seemed decent, but only seemed that way.
Back in the hotel.
When the figure found the door wouldn't open and he couldn't enter that way, he changed locations.
Amir was staying in 4212.
The figure took out a room card and entered 4312, which was directly above Amir's hotel room.
This room was unoccupied, and it was unclear how the figure obtained this room's key card, but he entered anyway.
The figure had been carrying a black backpack all along.
After entering, he took out a safety harness from the backpack, secured it in 4312, fastened it to himself, then descended from the 4312 balcony, easily reaching the 4212 balcony.
Once on the balcony, he moved quietly toward the two large glass sliding doors.
He tried them but couldn't open them - they were likely deadbolted from inside.
Finding he couldn't enter from here either, the figure stood there, seemingly contemplating something.
Amir, having been through A San Country's Alice Apartment.
Had developed a habit: waking at the slightest disturbance.
Plus, this was his first time at Macedonia Island, at this hotel.
The bed and pillow weren't very comfortable, so he woke when he turned over.
And, as luck would have it, the side he turned toward happened to face the balcony.
Because of this, when Amir opened his eyes, he immediately saw the figure on the balcony, startling him so much he sat bolt upright.
After sitting up, Amir's face showed tension and wariness.
He took several deep breaths to calm his nerves.
Realizing the other person couldn't enter his room.
He relaxed slightly.
Then.
He began examining the person before him.
The person before him was a white man, though his specific nationality was unclear.
This man was tall, about 185cm, looking strong, powerful, and agile.
He appeared to be around 40 years old.
With short blond hair that looked very capable.
Amir had discovered the intruder, and naturally the intruder had noticed Amir waking up.
Normally, people doing bad things would feel some panic when discovered.
But this 40-year-old white man.
Showed no panic whatsoever after being discovered by Amir.
Instead, he approached one of the two glass doors.
Then, his face came very close to the glass, maintaining a tiny distance without actually touching it.
After that, his eyes stared fixedly at Amir through the glass.
Being stared at like this by the man made Amir nervously swallow.
Because the room was so quiet, the sound of him swallowing seemed particularly loud.
To be honest, he had encountered several deranged criminals in A San Country's Alice Apartment.
Some of those deranged criminals had wanted to target him.
Before making their move, some had given him terrifying smiles, others had made throat-slitting gestures.
But today was his first time encountering someone who just stood outside the glass, staring fixedly at him.
With no particular expression on his face.
"Wait, this gaze?!"
Amir suddenly remembered something from his memory.
He had previously watched wildlife documentaries on television and his phone.
The way this white man was staring at him gave him the same feeling.
As those of tigers or lions staring at their prey before hunting.
Sharp, cold, focused.
Amir felt like he couldn't move his entire body!
He was frozen in place by the oppressive feeling from the white man's gaze - that of a top predator, beast-like in intensity!
Fortunately, after just two minutes.
The white man turned and left, climbing back up the safety rope, disappearing from Amir's view.
"Huff... huff..."
After the white man left, Amir collapsed onto the bed as if granted a pardon, breathing frantically.
Just from that brief encounter, without anything even happening, he felt completely drained.
Touching his forehead, he discovered it was covered in sweat.
His right palm was completely drenched!!!
"Has that person targeted me?"
Amir began to feel fear.
That person was definitely not some ordinary thief or similar.
He was absolutely that kind of person!!!
So, what should he do now?
"Right, right, change rooms! I need to change rooms!"
Amir hurriedly used the hotel landline in his room to call the front desk.
He requested a room change.
The front desk approved it quickly.
Saying it would be ready in half an hour and they'd call to notify him.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: What Are You Doing in My Newly Switched Room?!
chapters.content:
Half an hour passed.
Amir was extremely tense, having packed all the personal items he had previously taken out back into his suitcase.
After organizing everything, he changed into the red football uniform he had paid a deposit for.
Then he sat on the bed, anxiously waiting for the front desk's call.
The waiting was agonizing.
Every minute and second felt unbearably slow, each minute seeming to stretch into a full hour.
Whether it was Amir's good luck or not,
the hotel front desk called in less than half an hour saying it was ready.
They told him to come down to the first floor to get his new room key and proceed to his new hotel room.
Amir was overjoyed.He began by putting all the items he had piled by the door back in their original positions.
Before removing the security chain and unlocking the deadbolt, he carefully checked outside through the peephole to ensure it was safe, only then did he actually undo both security measures.
But still not feeling completely secure, he immediately opened the door a crack wide enough to stick his head out and look around.
The entire corridor was empty and utterly silent.
Very safe.
He quickly returned to the room, pulling his suitcase with his left hand while holding the metal baseball bat in his right.
After opening the door and confirming safety once more,
he immediately burst out of the hotel room as if fleeing for his life.
He didn't even bother with the food and water he had gathered from the hotel room that would last him seven days.
Soon he reached the elevator.
Frantically pressing the down button, this action revealed just how excessively anxious Amir had become.
Yes, despite being fully armed now, Amir felt extremely unsafe inside.
The elevator quickly arrived at his floor, and the doors opened.
It was completely empty inside.
Amir took the elevator all the way down to the first floor, where he collected his new room key from the front desk.
Although his unusual attire attracted many curious glances at the front desk, he paid them no mind.
After getting the room key, he took the elevator back upstairs.
Arriving at room 5001.
This was his new room.
The moment he entered the new room and the door closed behind him,
Amir immediately collapsed onto the floor in exhaustion.
He thought to himself: "Finally, finally safe! I can finally relax!"
After lying on the cold floor for five minutes,
Amir got up.
After placing his suitcase properly, he found the air conditioning remote and turned on the AC.
Then, he stood directly under the AC vent, letting the air blow on him.
Closing his eyes, he enjoyed the refreshing sensation of cold air penetrating his skin.
While keeping his eyes closed, he murmured:
"Now I'm safe, but not completely secure yet. I still need to gather enough food and water for seven days. It's troublesome, but there's no other way. As for the supplies in the original room, I'll leave them for the staff! I'm never going back there again!"
Amir definitely wouldn't return;
he was genuinely afraid of encountering that white man with the beast-like gaze again.
There's a saying that fits perfectly: sometimes, what you think is safety is only your perception.
The hotel room Amir was currently in was still a single room.
The hotel's bathroom and toilet were separate.
One on the left, one on the right, positioned on either side just inside the door.
While Amir was enjoying the cool air from the AC near the balcony area,
he completely failed to notice.
A barefoot man emerging from the partially open bathroom.
This man was none other than the white man around 40 years old from before.
This white man was dressed exactly as before.
The only difference was that the black bag he had been carrying earlier was gone.
Instead, he now carried a quiver on his back filled with arrows tipped with steel arrowheads, while holding a military crossbow in his hands.
The white man's grip on the military crossbow was perfectly standard, clearly indicating professional training.
The black military crossbow in his hands even had a scope attached.
He now aimed with his right eye against the scope.
Targeting the left side of Amir's temple facing him.
Then, after aiming, with a whooshing sound, the arrow launched from the crossbow.
What happened next was a scene that felt utterly ridiculous.
Amir clearly hadn't noticed the white man's presence in his room.
But the moment the arrow was fired,
Amir, who had been enjoying the AC, suddenly opened his eyes, noticed his shoelaces were untied, and bent down to tie them.
Because of this, the arrow shot through the space where Amir's head had been just moments before.
The arrow directly pierced through one of the two glass doors.
Instantly, the sound of shattering glass startled Amir.
He turned to look at the large broken glass panel falling down and quickly retreated to the left.
By the time the glass crashed down, leaving a mess of shards on the floor, Amir still hadn't figured out why the glass had suddenly shattered.
Because the arrow had shot through the glass door and flown out from the balcony.
So he didn't know the glass broke because of that.
As for whether the flying arrow might hit innocent people, that wasn't the shooter's concern.
"Damn it, missed again!"
Seeing that his shot had missed, the white man standing outside the bathroom cursed aloud.
Why did he say "again"?
Because earlier today, when he shot at that Cherry Blossom Country person Hashimoto Kazuo, he had also missed.
Hashimoto Kazuo had also inexplicably ducked down and avoided it.
The sudden voice startled Amir.
He immediately looked toward the source of the sound.
When he saw there was suddenly another person in his room, and it was that white man, his face instantly turned ashen.
His dark skin actually appeared to pale in that moment.
"You, you, how are you here?!"
Amir panicked, grabbing the metal baseball bat from the bed, gripping it tightly with both hands while continuously backing away, his eyes filled with fear and vigilance as he stared at the white man.
He also noticed the quiver on the white man's back.
He even saw the white man taking an arrow from his back and loading it into his crossbow.
After missing that first shot, the white man didn't seem to intend to fire a second arrow immediately.
Instead, he quite kindly answered Amir's question: "I was hiding in the bathroom before you even entered this room."
"What?! That, that's impossible!"
Amir was completely incredulous.
"You were here before I entered the room? How did you get in? And how did you know I changed rooms, and that it would be this specific room?"
The white man said coldly: "Nothing's impossible. On this island, deranged criminals like me, deranged serial killers like us."
"Can access information about you lab rats who come to the island, and we can mobilize many of the island's resources to help us hunt you lab rats."
"This offers much better conditions than what I had back at Alice Apartment."
Yes, for these deranged criminals, these deranged serial killers on this island,
it's much more comfortable than simply being in Alice Apartment.
Because they can mobilize many resources to smoothly hunt the lab rats.
Therefore, the Special Live Stream is extremely unfair and brutally harsh for the lab rats.
Like this time, the white man could know in advance about Amir's room change request, and enter his room ahead of time to wait for him like waiting for a rabbit to bump into a tree.
This is a huge advantage.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: The Lab Mouse, Amir — Dead
chapters.content:
The white man raised his crossbow again, aiming it at Amir.
Amir kept backing away. If there had been a third person present, they would have noticed that Amir's legs and arms were trembling violently.
Especially his hands - as he gripped the baseball bat, it kept shaking with exaggerated movements.
He was terrified.
Because he knew that just one arrow would probably end his life.
Even though he had never used a crossbow before, at 39 years old, he still had that basic understanding.
"Please, don't kill me, don't kill me, okay?!"
"I have a wife and two children to support! If I die, their lives will become unimaginably terrible!"
Between resistance and begging for mercy, Amir chose to beg for mercy.
This might be related to his strategy of always playing it safe, never having fought back against any of the deranged criminals.But unfortunately, does begging for mercy work?
It might work with someone who still has a conscience, but it definitely wouldn't work with the person before him.
Seeing that the white man in front of him hadn't lowered his crossbow,
Sweat poured from Amir's forehead like rain, droplets pattering down his face, some dripping onto his clothes, others splashing onto the balcony floor.
"Please! I came here just to make money! Enough money! To take my wife and two children to immigrate to the UK, to give them a better life!!"
"I'm really begging you! Spare my life!"
"You look about my age, you must have a wife and children too, right? If you have a family, you should understand that losing a father would be catastrophic for them!"
Amir knelt down and began kowtowing frantically to the white man before him.
At the same time, he tried to play the empathy card.
After all, he felt the man looked about his age.
Sure enough, the white man who had shown no reaction until now suddenly responded.
He still didn't lower his crossbow, but said:
"Yes, I have a wife and a son."
Hearing this, Amir thought there was hope and intensified his kowtowing and begging.
But then, the white man's next words chilled his heart completely.
"But they're both dead, they died a long time ago."
"And they died at the hands of you damned Asian devils!!!!"
As soon as he finished speaking,
An arrow whooshed through the air.
Aimed at the kneeling Amir, who quickly rolled to the side upon seeing it.
The arrow blasted into the balcony concrete, with only the arrow's tail visible outside the cement.
The arrowhead and other parts had already penetrated deep into the concrete.
Amir was horrified by the arrow's power - if it hit his body, even if it wasn't a vital spot, he would definitely suffer serious injuries.
And now, with this arrow fired, he immediately had to think about what to do before the next arrow came.
How to escape?
Oh, damn! If only he had requested a lower-floor room when changing rooms earlier!
That way, he could have jumped from the balcony.
But now, his new room was even higher than the previous one!
A full 50 floors!
If he climbed over the balcony railing and accidentally fell,
He would absolutely die without question!!!!
Since he couldn't escape, there was only one choice left!
That was! To fight!
Amir made up his mind.
For himself, for his wife, for his son, for his daughter!
He would fight!!!
"Ahhhhhhh!"
He roared, psyching himself up, turning around and getting up, ready to fight the white man with his baseball bat!
But what he never expected was that just as he turned his head,
An arrow shot toward him at blinding speed.
Moving faster than he could possibly react, the arrow pierced straight through his head.
As the arrow penetrated his skull, it carried his head and body backward.
Then, the arrow embedded deeply into the balcony concrete.
Amir's head was pinned along with it, fixed in place by this arrow.
"How... is this... possible..."
Before dying, Amir's mind held only disbelief.
Because he never expected this third arrow to come so quickly.
Clearly before, he had watched the white man handle the previous arrows very slowly!
The preparation time had been quite long!
Amir died with his eyes wide open.
Even in death, he didn't know that the white man was using a military repeating crossbow.
As for why three arrows were fired in total,
And why the second arrow had such a long preparation time,
That was because the white man had done it deliberately.
Even though there were still arrows in the magazine, he didn't use them, instead taking arrows from the quiver on his back and loading them in front of Amir.
This was to create a false impression and cause misjudgment.
As for whether this misjudgment would be useful later,
Well, today it definitely came in handy.
After killing Amir with the arrow, the white man didn't bother to dispose of the body.
Instead, he chose to turn and leave.
Of course, when leaving, he definitely closed the door behind him.
As for why he didn't dispose of the body, it was because someone would do it for him.
Those professional cleaners.
After Amir was confirmed to be thoroughly dead,
The beautiful host from A San Country in the Neighbors Over Distant Relatives live stream room
Announced Amir's death and that his betting amount of 500 million USD would all be transferred to the final prize pool.
After the announcement,
In the live stream room, a group of people from A San Country went wild.
The one making the biggest fuss was
That lizard.
A San—Whoever Mentions Lizards Again, I'll Get Angry: 【Rigged! Absolutely rigged! Damn Neighbors Over Distant Relatives, damn Alice Apartment, damn Macedonia Island!! This is clearly targeting our A San Country! Three lab rats died in one day, and two of them are from A San Country - if this isn't blatant targeting, then what is?!】
Hua—Middle-aged Uncle fired back strongly: 【Three died in one day, with two from A San Country - that just means your two lab rats in this special live stream aren't skilled enough.】
Because the lizard from A San Country couldn't comment for an hour after his post,
Other people from A San Country argued with Middle-aged Uncle instead.
【Not skilled enough? This is obviously rigged! In one day, both of our A San Country participants encountered deranged criminals, while your two from Hua Country? Not a single encounter! If this isn't rigged, then what is? It's clearly deliberately eliminating our A San Country participants!!!】
Actually, whether there was really targeting or not,
Everyone in the live stream room knew the truth in their hearts.
They had watched who knows how many rounds of broadcasts from Alice Apartment, including special live streams.
This show had absolutely no behind-the-scenes manipulation or deliberate targeting.
These people from A San Country making such a fuss in the live stream room today were purely unbalanced in their hearts, wondering why their country's two lab rats had been so unlucky?!
Dying so quickly...

chapters.title: Chapter 287: The Razor Water Slide
chapters.content:
The live stream room was noisy, but in reality, things were already underway.
Island staff had entered the hotel room where Lab Rat Amir had died and begun collecting the body.
These professional Cleaners.
They specialized in disposing of corpses.
Of course, on the island the final fate of these dead people was always the same: they were put on a boat by the Cleaners, taken far away from the island, and dumped into the sea to feed the sharks.
…
After finishing at the haunted house, Jiang Ran split ways with Xiao Q and the third person.
Then he returned to his own hotel room, waited until mealtime, and went up to the tenth floor for the buffet.
After that he went back to his hotel room.
He digested his food, played on his phone for a while, then followed an exercise routine from his phone to work out.When he finished, he showered, got into bed, turned on the air conditioning, and played on his phone—enjoying a pleasant night.
As for going out at night?
Impossible.
What would he do out alone in the middle of the night?
So Jiang Ran lay on his bed scrolling through TikTok.
For some reason, recently a singer with the surname Wang had become the center of controversy on TikTok.
A lot of netizens were arguing whether his studies at that Berkeley-like school abroad were music or operating an excavator—there was a lot of debate…
Music or excavators, Jiang Ran didn’t know.
But he found those videos pretty funny.
He kept scrolling until just before sleep, and noticed that the Tai Country beauty in the next bed, Wannara, still hadn’t returned.
…
Special Live Stream — Macedonia Island.
The next day, seven in the morning.
On Macedonia Island, besides the hotels, there were other facilities.
For example, a water park.
In that water park there was a water attraction—a large water slide.
This giant water slide.
From the ground, when you looked up,
you could see that the slide was very long.
It wound around in coils, designed with many twists and turns;
at a glance it looked wildly dangerous and thrilling.
Moreover, this water slide was completely enclosed.
Outsiders could not see inside the slide;
it wasn’t like an open-air slide where you could tell what position a rider was in.
What was more strange about this water slide
was what happened at the end: riders were flushed into a large pool when they finished.
Normally that pool would be open-air, and riders would climb out onto the shore.
But this slide’s pool was sealed.
Standing beside the sealed pool—unable to see inside—was a white man who looked about fifty years old.
Fifty is an age that, in ancient times, would be considered old.
In the Qing Dynasty, fifty was already old.
But in the modern era of explosive technology, seventy or eighty are the ages counted as elderly.
Fifty is still middle-aged!
Yet this middle-aged white man had short white hair all over his head.
The white man was named James Carter.
He was one of the deranged serial killers on Macedonia Island.
And the frightening, thrill-packed water slide beside him was his masterpiece.
“172 people.” (English)
James kept his hands in his pockets and stared expressionless at his creation as he muttered to himself.
That was the number of people who had died on this water slide yesterday.
You probably want to know—how could riding a water slide kill someone?
It’s simple.
Many people had probably already guessed.
He had installed blades inside the enclosed slide.
Many people had seen that foreign movie about a water slide fitted with cross-shaped blades.
Honestly, it’s terrifying. That movie made a lot of people fear enclosed water slides.
You can’t be scared of ten thousand things, only the one-in-a-million chance matters—you might run into that situation yourself.
But James was even more vicious than that movie.
In that film, only one of three slide entrances had cross blades.
James had five slide entrances, and each one had blades.
And they were diagonal-cross blades.
Why diagonal-cross blades?
To avoid any slip-ups!
Of course, even then there can be slip-ups.
So he upgraded.
Each slide entrance had three blades at different positions.
And it seemed to suit James’s twisted tastes.
The three blades were positioned differently: the first was a single vertical blade.
The second was a cross-shaped blade.
The third was the diagonal-cross blade.
The purpose seemed to be to give riders hope after surviving a danger, only to push them into despair again.
Think about it: you go down this slide, rush along, and suddenly see a huge sharp vertical blade ahead.
What do you feel?
Terrified.
But to your surprise, that vertical blade is installed so that there’s space on its left or right to squeeze past.
You inch through carefully.
You breathe a little easier and feel so lucky!
Then you continue sliding and encounter the second cross blade.
You begin to despair.
How do you get past this?
But you find there might still be a chance!
The cross blade is an × shape—if you’re careful, you can just barely slip through the lower gap.
Being small-bodied works to your advantage;
a taller or broader person would get stuck and be cut.
After passing that one, your heart pounds with unease.
What if there’s a third blade?
And then you indeed see the third.
It’s the diagonal-cross blade.
The space is tiny—can you still get through?
You refuse to give up;
your brain races in that critical moment, searching for a solution.
Eventually you think you see a sliver of space you might be able to exploit. It’s uncertain, but you gamble on it.
So you slowly and desperately control your body, inching forward.
Just as you prepare to attempt it, a scream erupts from behind you.
You suddenly realize with dawning horror that you’re not the only one on this slide…
Three blades placed at different positions.
Guaranteed no one would slip through completely unscathed.
This was what they called—the net of heaven is wide, but nothing escapes it.
As for whether James was the originator of blade-laden slides?
Of course not.
He was a copycat.
And he had been inspired by that movie to become what he was.
James raised his left hand and glanced at the watch on his wrist.
The water park opened at eight o’clock.
There were still over forty minutes to go.
He didn’t do anything else.
He came to the platform, climbed up the metal stairs that had been set up, and walked onto the high platform.
The platform was incredibly spacious.
Five slide entrances were arranged in sequence.
No one would have guessed this massive slide would be a deadly trap.
After stepping up, James sat on one of the plastic chairs with a backrest on the platform.
He pulled out his phone and scrolled silently, quietly waiting for the water park’s eight o’clock opening.
Soon it was eight;
the water park officially opened.
A large number of tourists poured into the park and began their day-long revelry.
In a water park, water slides are the equivalent of roller coasters or giant pendulums in a regular amusement park—thrilling attractions.
So naturally many thrill-seeking men and women wanted to try them.
Right after the park opened,
James already saw young men and women stepping up from the metal stairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: The Sacrifices — Tom and Jerry
chapters.content:
First were two men and two women.
These four were all white people with blond hair and blue eyes, though it wasn't clear exactly which country they were from.
As soon as these four came up, they said to James sitting on the plastic stool:
"Boss, is this water slide exciting or not? (English)"
English was the most widely used language in this world.
There was no helping it - back when the UK, the empire where the sun never set, had colonies everywhere around the world.
So English was extremely widespread.
"Of course it's exciting, look at that sign over there. (English)"
James pointed to the warning sign nearby.
On the warning sign was a large red caution × symbol.Below the symbol it read: Those who are timid, have heart conditions or other physical illnesses are strictly prohibited from playing!
This statement wasn't just in English, but also had Chinese, Japanese, and other translations.
To accommodate tourists from different countries.
After the two men and two women saw this, they all chuckled cheerfully.
"No problem, we're in perfect health! (English)"
The two young men patted their sturdy chests toward James.
James glanced at them.
The two young men had clearly defined eight-pack abs on their upper bodies, while the two women were wearing yellow and green bikinis.
"Hmm, if you're sure you want to play, you'll need to sign a liability waiver. (English)"
James glanced at them, then pulled four liability waivers from a metal cabinet nearby.
The four took the liability waivers, glanced at them briefly - essentially confirming they were in good health, were voluntarily playing on this water slide, and would bear responsibility themselves if any unfortunate consequences occurred.
All four signed the liability waivers directly.
After signing.
James had them put their phones in a basket to retrieve after they finished.
After completing all this.
James waved his hand grandly, revealing a brilliant smile: "Then, let's begin, warriors! (English)"
These two men and two women were actually two couples.
One of the men said to the other: "Hey, Tom, remember our deal - whoever reaches the finish line first, after the trip ends and we go back, the loser helps the winner write their thesis! (English)"
"Haha, Jerry, don't worry, I definitely won't lose! (English)"
The other man was extremely confident.
So these two couples were university students, all suffering through the torment of graduation theses.
Therefore, they used this as a bet for a fun wager.
These two couples, one pair chose slide entrance number 1, while the other pair chose number 2.
They all sat at the entrance points.
The girlfriends sat in front of their boyfriends, while the boyfriends sat behind holding their girlfriends' slender waists.
"Hey, boss, can you help us count! Count from 1 to 3, and when you reach 3! Tom, we'll slide down together!! (English)"
James heard this from the guy called Jerry and didn't expect to be involved.
But he was quite helpful.
So he helped with the counting, and when he reached number 3.
Both couples slid down together.
Someone who had played similar water slides before had given this evaluation:
[When playing this, you feel very insecure because your back isn't pressed against the slide, creating a vacuum sensation that's terrifying.
Then, if you try to use your hands and feet to slow your descent speed.
But everything around is too slippery.
You simply can't slow down.
After playing once, you'll never play a second time in your life.]
For other water slides, that last statement might be nonsense.
But for James's water slide, this was absolutely true.
After playing the first time, you would definitely never play a second time.
Because when you play the first time, you directly lose your life!
Inside slide number 1.
"Ahhhhhh! So exciting!!! (English)"
Tom and his girlfriend, their bodies following the water flow under gravity's pull.
Rapidly flowed downward inside the slide.
Soon, they slid to the first vertical blade.
When they were five meters away from the vertical blade, Tom and his girlfriend noticed the vertical blade not far ahead.
The moment they saw the blade.
Both Tom and his girlfriend were puzzled.
What was that thing ahead?
Tom laughed loudly: "Could it be an obstacle?! (English)"
The two laughed heartily as they slid toward it.
They didn't even try to avoid the vertical blade ahead.
They slammed directly into it.
And with this impact.
Tom's girlfriend in front was directly split into two halves from the front.
And the moment his girlfriend was cut apart, blood sprayed explosively onto Tom's body.
Tom discovered in horror that the girlfriend before him had turned from being in his arms into two bloody halves.
And before he could react, he too was cut in half by that vertical blade, then, the halved corpses continued sliding rapidly downward...
On the other side, Jerry and his girlfriend also reached the first vertical blade.
When they saw this blade.
Jerry and his girlfriend instantly screamed in terror.
"Jerry! Is that a blade?! (English)"
His girlfriend said, quickly using both hands and feet, attempting to brace against the inside of the slide, wanting to slow their speed.
Jerry couldn't be sure, but he felt that thing looked like a blade.
"Don't be afraid! Baby! Slow down, pass through over there! There's plenty of space there! (English)"
From this perspective, Jerry was much better than Tom.
After all, Tom didn't even recognize it as a blade at first, thinking it was an intentionally placed obstacle.
When facing crisis, Jerry's mental and physical abilities surged.
Holding his girlfriend, the two worked together and passed through one side of the vertical blade.
After getting past, Jerry instantly breathed a sigh of relief: "Fortunately that blade was vertical, and there was plenty of space on both sides! If it was like that movie with cross-shaped blades! Then we'd really be finished! (English)"
The reason Jerry and his girlfriend immediately recognized the vertical blade.
Was because they had seen that horror movie about water slides with blades.
"Damn it! Is that boss crazy?! When I get out! I'm definitely going to report him!! (English)"
After narrowly escaping death, Jerry furiously cursed that boss, since if they had hit that blade just now, they would have undoubtedly died!
While his girlfriend said: "Jerry, do you think it's possible that thing might not be a real blade? But plastic? Rubber or something? An intentionally placed obstacle?! (English)"
Jerry continued cursing: "That's even more impossible! They would never place obstacles inside this kind of slide! And even if that wasn't metal, just plastic or rubber! Hitting it at this speed would definitely cause problems! (English)"
His girlfriend continued: "Then could it be that it wasn't that boss who did it? But someone else? (English)"
Jerry stopped to think at this point: "This, what you say makes sense, it might not be that boss, but someone else intentionally doing it, but regardless of whether it's that boss or not, when I get out I'm going to give him trouble!!! (English)"
Just as Jerry finished saying this, after the two went around a corner.
A scene that made their scalps tingle appeared.
They saw a cross-shaped blade exactly like the one from that movie appear.
That cross-shaped blade was just like in the movie, shaped like an ×.
"No no no no! (English)"
When the two saw that cross-shaped blade.
They instantly panicked.
Because at first glance, it seemed like there was no space for them to pass through unscathed.
The two quickly used their hands and feet, wanting to slow their speed.
But somehow, at this moment, the water flow in their slide channel suddenly increased.
The two completely lost control and rushed toward that cross-shaped blade.
Instantly.
Jerry and his girlfriend, one after the other.
Were divided and killed under the blade...
Large amounts of blood flowed downward, carrying various parts of the mutilated corpses...

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Xiao Hua, Wang Ju, and Their Boyfriends — A Day on the Water Slide
chapters.content:
These two couples were naturally not the only victims today.
After them, more than twenty people had already signed liability waivers and taken turns riding the slide.
Without exception, all of these people died inside the slide.
Soon, the slide welcomed the next group of people.
This group consisted of two men and two women, appearing to be couples as well.
However, these couples were different from the first group of guests today.
They were Asian, and from their speech, James guessed they were probably from Hua Country.
These two Hua Country couples held their phones, preparing to speak with him.
James explained the precautions, the warning sign, and the requirement to sign the liability waiver.
After hearing this, the two couples prepared to sign the agreement and ride, but suddenly a voice sounded from the staircase.The two couples instantly stopped their actions and looked toward the staircase in unison.
There stood a quite handsome Hua Country young man.
The young man stood with hands on his hips, looking surprised:
"Well, well, well, if it isn't Xiao Hua and Wang Ju? What a coincidence, isn't it?"
After climbing up the stairs, Xiao Peng saw the people before him and began speaking with sarcasm.
The person before them was indeed Xiao Peng, and these two couples were none other than Xiao Peng's ex-girlfriend Xiao Hua, Xiao Hua's current boyfriend, Wang Ju, and Wang Ju's boyfriend.
You might ask why they weren't seen on Xiao Peng's flight?
Quite simply, their flight tickets weren't for the same flight as his.
They arrived one day later than Xiao Peng.
Fang Xiao was the same - his flight was also one day later than Jiang Ran's, coincidentally on the same flight as Xiao Hua's group.
But everyone arrived at Macedonia Island on the same date.
Because they all took the same ship that departed three days after Jiang Ran's group arrived at the island with the airport.
Xiao Hua and the others hadn't expected to encounter each other here so coincidentally either.
Xiao Hua remained silent, but her boyfriend spoke up instead.
Her boyfriend, and Wang Ju's boyfriend, hadn't known Xiao Peng originally.
After the pancake shop incident.
Both young men had sensed that the relationship between them wasn't so simple, more than just acquaintances.
So they asked.
Xiao Hua didn't hide it either, directly saying that Xiao Peng was her ex-boyfriend, that they had gotten along very well originally, but Xiao Peng chose another wealthy girl because of his vanity, namely Xiao Nuo.
After learning this, Xiao Hua's boyfriend was quite shocked, then promised Xiao Hua in front of her that he would absolutely never do such a despicable thing as Xiao Peng - dumping his girlfriend because of money.
And now, encountering Xiao Peng again, with Xiao Peng's expression and tone exactly like that day at the pancake shop.
Xiao Hua's boyfriend resolutely chose to step forward to protect his girlfriend.
He pointed at Xiao Peng and said: "Xiao Peng, right? I know you're my girlfriend Xiao Hua's ex-boyfriend, but since you're already an ex, please speak properly with my girlfriend, don't use that sarcastic tone, otherwise, don't blame me for being impolite."
Xiao Peng was momentarily stunned by Xiao Hua's boyfriend's sudden outburst.
Then, he nodded with a half-smile: "Fine, fine, fine, I won't be sarcastic anymore."
"Xiao Hua, you really found yourself a great boyfriend! So protective."
Despite promising not to be sarcastic, Xiao Peng's tone still carried a hint of sarcasm.
Xiao Hua's boyfriend wanted to say more, but Xiao Hua pulled him back.
Xiao Peng looked at these four people, walked over, and asked while looking down: "Do you need to sign something to play this?"
James couldn't understand Chinese, so he used his phone translator to communicate with Xiao Peng.
During the communication with Xiao Peng.
Xiao Hua's group of four had already signed the liability waivers.
After signing the agreements, they prepared to ride this water slide.
They chose the number 1 and number 2 slide entrances.
Just at that moment.
James stopped them, suggesting that entrances 4 and 5 were more suitable for two people sliding together.
Thus, Xiao Hua and her boyfriend chose number 4, while Wang Ju and her boyfriend chose number 5.
Their sitting positions were the same as the first group of white couples.
The girl sat in front, the boy sat behind, both pressed closely together.
Then with preparations complete, Xiao Hua's group of four pushed forward forcefully, following the water flow to begin their rapid descent.
Xiao Peng had actually been secretly observing Xiao Hua the whole time.
After he signed his liability waiver, he prepared to enter the number 4 slide entrance that Xiao Hua and her boyfriend had chosen.
And just as he sat at the number 4 slide entrance, both hands firmly gripping the sides - letting go would mean being swept into the slide by the seawater diverted by this amusement park.
Whether it was because of the nervousness from about to ride the water slide causing his heart in his left chest to beat rapidly.
Or because of the sudden inexplicable sense of crisis causing his heart to beat rapidly.
Xiao Peng only felt that the sound of rushing water beside his ears inexplicably made him feel panicked.
"Forget it, I'd better not ride for now."
Somehow, Xiao Peng himself couldn't figure it out, but he felt that if he rode this slide, something bad would happen.
He got cold feet, preparing to grip with his hands and move his buttocks backward.
But just at that moment, he suddenly felt a pair of large hands press against his back.
He turned his head and from the corner of his eye discovered it was the water slide owner, James.
Then, before he could react, James pushed with both hands and shoved him violently downward.
......
Inside the number 5 slide.
Wang Ju and her boyfriend felt incredibly carefree, laughing heartily as they slid down the slide.
Both were so stimulated by the thrill of the slide that all their pores seemed to open, feeling as if life itself was burning.
And soon, their feeling of life burning stopped.
Because after rounding a bend, they entered a long straight section.
At the end of the long straight section appeared a vertical blade.
The blade was quite large, inserted at the very top and bottom of the slide.
The blade edge glimmered in the countless white waters, the seawater seemingly continuously sharpening the blade, making it even more sharp.
Both people suddenly saw this thing appear inside the slide and didn't immediately realize what it was.
Only when they drew closer did they discover that the thing seemed to be... a blade?
"Stop! Stop! Stop quickly!"
Wang Ju was sitting in front of her boyfriend, so she was in much greater danger than him.
Both she and her boyfriend, upon seeing the vertical blade, panicked and tried to stop their slide, but the more urgently they tried, the faster they actually slid.
As they were about to approach the vertical blade.
Wang Ju's boyfriend behind her stared at Wang Ju, then at the blade ahead.
As if he had realized something.
He made up his mind, clenched his teeth tightly, and forcefully shoved his girlfriend violently forward.
Wang Ju had already been desperately trying to stop her descent, especially as she drew closer and saw what appeared to be blood on the blade, which frightened her even more.
But what she never expected was that her own boyfriend, at this critical moment, actually pushed her from behind.
And with this push, Wang Ju lost her balance and collided sideways with the vertical blade.
Instantly, the blade cut into Wang Ju's abdomen, though perhaps because the impact force wasn't too great.
Wang Ju wasn't cut in half by the blade.
But rather hung there on the blade.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Wang Ju Is Dead, and So Is Her Boyfriend
chapters.content:
"Ahhhhhh!!!!"
A heart-wrenching, agonizing scream.
Wang Ju's cry at this moment was brought on by the intense physical pain, as well as the terror of impending death.
"Save me! Please save me!"
Wang Ju's body was stuck at this spot.
Because of this, her boyfriend could use her body as a resistance cushion, smoothly sliding down through the empty space on one side of the Vertical Blade.
Watching her boyfriend escape successfully, she desperately cried out to him for help.
Even though crashing into it was her boyfriend's doing...
Right now, the priority was saving her own life first...
But her boyfriend didn't respond with a single word.His face only showed the joy of having narrowly escaped death.
Of course, he did glance back at Wang Ju.
But this glance was filled with smug satisfaction.
With the water flow carrying her along, Wang Ju could only watch as her boyfriend moved further and further away from her.
"No! No!"
Wang Ju still couldn't believe what was happening to her.
She thought this was a dream!
It absolutely had to be a dream!
She just needed to wake up and everything would be fine!
But the blood on her body, and the fact that the blade had almost cut her in half at the waist!!!!
At this point, Wang Ju could only cry uncontrollably, screaming for help, hoping someone would come to rescue her.
To save her life, she not only shouted for help in Chinese, but also screamed "Help! Help!" in English.
But inside this enclosed water slide, who could possibly hear her cries for help?
"Wah wah wah..."
Wang Ju wept.
She suddenly remembered the tall male student.
If it had been the tall male student behind her just now.
He would never have used her as a human cushion!!!
Absolutely never!
But now, thinking of the tall male student was already too late...
"Damn, lucky I was smart enough to use that stupid woman as a scapegoat, otherwise I'd be dead there too!!!"
Wang Ju's boyfriend was flowing downward, surrounded by water that was completely crimson.
All the water flowing down from above carried Wang Ju's blood.
Although he was inside the slide, sweat uncontrollably dripped from Wang Ju's boyfriend's forehead.
He kept congratulating himself internally for being clever and making a quick decision.
Honestly, if the person in front of him hadn't been Wang Ju, but rather the goddess he'd always liked, he probably wouldn't have done such a thing.
After all, he couldn't bear to do that to her.
But Wang Ju was different.
Even though she was his girlfriend.
He was only with Wang Ju for fun, planning to break up with her once he got tired of sleeping with her.
Therefore, in that situation, he could bring himself to do it.
"Whoever installed blades in a slide is seriously messed up."
After sliding for a while, Wang Ju's boyfriend decided that once he got out, he would definitely settle accounts with whoever did this terrible thing.
As for Wang Ju's fate by then, whether she would be rescued or not?
Honestly, he hoped Wang Ju would die here, because if she didn't die and was rescued, what if she told people about him pushing her? That would be really bad, wouldn't it?
He didn't know if that would count as intentional murder?
He felt it probably wouldn't count, since those blades weren't his doing anyway!
Just as he was thinking this.
He passed through several corners—this was a series of consecutive curved turns.
The distance between the curves wasn't far.
At this moment, Wang Ju's boyfriend noticed a protruding point in the pipe ahead. As he got closer, he saw it was a single handle.
He found it strange—what was the purpose of this thing being here?
But after he passed this corner and looked at the next curve, he understood the meaning of that single handle.
Because as he approached the next curve, he discovered that at the turning point, there was an X-shaped blade.
Wang Ju's boyfriend's eyes instantly widened larger than ever before.
Before he could even react, he had already crashed into the blade.
Instantly, it became a bloody mess...
...
Inside Slide 4.
Xiao Hua and her boyfriend had been happily sliding for a while when they also saw the vertical blade standing not far ahead of them.
Both of them panicked when they saw that thing.
But Xiao Hua had ultimately experienced the brief dangerous journey in Alice Apartment.
As the saying goes, you can't teach people through words alone, but experience teaches them in one go.
Having gone through the brief dangerous journey in Alice Apartment, Xiao Hua's mental fortitude was somewhat stronger than ordinary people's.
Therefore, when facing the increasingly close Vertical Blade.
She felt this Vertical Blade was like the young Black Man who chased them with the chainsaw.
There must be a way to survive!
"The spaces on both sides are quite large!"
Xiao Hua immediately noticed that there was ample space to the left and right of the blade, and they should be able to pass through carefully.
However, inside this enclosed, extremely slippery circular slide with continuous water flow pushing from behind.
Even though there was considerable space on both sides, trying to pass by the blade without injury and without hitting it.
Still required difficulty.
And it needed one more thing—luck.
Whether doing major things or minor things.
Both require luck.
Take Cherry Blossom Country—Warring States period as an example.
Their Warring States period corresponded to Hua Country's Ming Dynasty era.
The Tiger of Kai—Takeda Shingen, together with other forces, formed the anti-Nobunaga coalition.
Preparing to eliminate Oda Nobunaga.
This situation was absolutely not good news for Oda Nobunaga, who was surrounded by enemies on all sides.
Especially since Takeda Shingen's terrifying military strength made him quite apprehensive.
But just as he was about to confront this Tiger of Kai.
Takeda Shingen withdrew his troops...
Why?
This is a historical mystery—some say Takeda Shingen died of illness just before the confrontation, others say he was accidentally shot by one of Tokugawa Ieyasu's musketeers.
But regardless, Takeda Shingen withdrew.
Oda Nobunaga was overjoyed!
After all, one of the forces ganging up on him was gone, and it was the strongest one at that!
The crisis was resolved!
Then, several years later, something even more coincidental happened.
The Dragon of Echigo—Uesugi Kenshin, with twenty thousand troops, defeated Oda Nobunaga's fifty thousand troops at the Battle of Tedorigawa.
Afterward, he prepared to mobilize other daimyo from the Kanto region to form a large army together and attack Oda Nobunaga.
But then, just before sending out troops, this one also died of illness.
He suffered a cerebral hemorrhage and collapsed in the toilet.
Therefore, the attack plan came to nothing.
Without even fighting, both major threats were dead.
It must be said, this was Oda Nobunaga's great fortune.
Of course, great fortune didn't stay with Oda Nobunaga for long either.
His luck ran out, causing him to die at a Honnoji Temple barbecue party.
Betrayed by his subordinate Akechi Mitsuhide...
There are countless examples of such luck.
Too many.
Therefore, luck truly exists!
Xiao Hua and her boyfriend clearly had pretty good luck.
Although both of them hit the blade, they didn't hit the sharp edge head-on. Instead, their arms, legs, and bodies bumped against the sides of the blade.
But regardless, both managed to pass through successfully.
After getting through, both were shaken with lingering fear.
Breathing heavily.
Their subsequent sliding wasn't accompanied by the joyful screams from before.
Of course, their hearts were still beating just as fast.
Only the reason for the fast heartbeat was different.
Before it was excitement and thrill.
Now it was terror and shock.
And just as the two hadn't completely recovered their composure.
They entered a long passage and saw the Cross-shaped Blade at the end of the channel...

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Xiao Peng: Help!!!
chapters.content:
When they saw the Cross-shaped Blade.
Xiao Hua and her boyfriend's first thought was: We're done for, we're dead.
But danger always comes with a solution.
Just like how within seven steps of being bitten by a snake, there's bound to be an antidote nearby.
The two of them discovered that not far ahead, there seemed to be protruding handles.
Several of them.
The two controlled their bodies, slightly slowing down their sliding speed.
They drifted to that spot, each grabbing a handle with one hand.
They kept themselves from continuing to drift backward and crashing into that deadly Cross-shaped Blade.
Although temporarily saved, the two were still utterly terrified.Xiao Hua looked at her boyfriend and asked if he had brought his phone.
Her boyfriend shook his head—hadn't they all handed their phones to the boss earlier?
Who would bring a phone while playing this kind of water attraction?
"Help! Help!"
Xiao Hua was desperate, could only scream for help at the top of her lungs.
At this moment.
Xiao Peng was drifting along, terrified out of his wits.
Because before playing on the slide, his bad premonition had been warning him not to do it.
He hadn't even wanted to play originally, but then that white man boss pushed him down.
And although he hadn't seen the white man boss's face when he turned his head.
The feeling the boss gave him in that moment was extremely dangerous.
Just like Su Mi from back then.
Therefore, he was absolutely terrified while playing on this slide.
But thinking about it now, a slide shouldn't be that dangerous, right?
It couldn't be that playing on a slide, because it's too thrilling, would cause a sudden heart attack and kill him?
That couldn't be—he was young and healthy, with no heart condition.
Just as he was thinking this.
He saw the first Vertical Blade.
When he saw the Vertical Blade, Xiao Peng was completely stunned.
Then he immediately started cursing furiously, his body squirming like a frog.
He wanted to go back, to return to where he had slid down from.
But, being able to control his body to slow down was already something to be thankful for—if he could actually go back, that would truly make him a superhero.
Soon, Xiao Peng realized the situation.
To be honest, he panicked for a moment.
But after experiencing Alice Apartment for so long, his mental fortitude had improved immeasurably compared to before.
Quickly, he noticed that the Vertical Blade had plenty of space on both sides.
If he was careful, he should be able to get past it.
Therefore, he desperately tried to control his body and sliding speed.
Although his arms and other parts got bumped and scraped, he at least managed to pass through safely.
"Damn it, that boss definitely did this!"
"Is that boss some kind of serial killer?!"
Unlike the others, Xiao Peng immediately concluded it was the boss's doing.
Because based on the feeling when he was pushed, there was absolutely no mistake!
As he continued sliding downward.
He suddenly remembered that Xiao Hua and her boyfriend had entered this slide before him.
What about them...
Soon, he saw Xiao Hua and her boyfriend.
And when Xiao Hua and her boyfriend saw someone coming down from above, they screamed in terror.
Because the slide pipe was only so big—unless it was a child coming from above, any adult coming down would definitely crash into one of them, and if they couldn't hold onto the handles firmly, they would immediately fall down, and once they fell, they would absolutely die.
Xiao Peng realized the two below were Xiao Hua and them.
But due to the viewing angle, Xiao Hua and her boyfriend hadn't yet realized that the person coming down was Xiao Peng.
Xiao Peng was amazed to see these two miraculously fixed in place inside the slide.
And soon, he discovered the secret of how they were staying fixed there.
At the same time, he saw the Cross-shaped Blade at the end of this section.
"Damn! There's more?!"
Xiao Peng wasn't stupid.
As he passed by Xiao Hua and her boyfriend who were fixed in the slide, he spread his arms and legs in advance, using them as speed bumps.
The speed bump tactic was quite successful.
Xiao Peng tightly grabbed onto these two people, getting stuck in the middle.
But he understood this wasn't a solution—if one more person came from above, he would definitely be knocked down along with them.
At this moment, Xiao Hua's boyfriend's other hand that wasn't holding the handle was trying to push away Xiao Peng who was grabbing his arm.
Seeing this, Xiao Peng was shocked: "What the hell, are you trying to kill me?!"
At this, Xiao Hua's boyfriend coldly laughed: "Heh, I'm not that vicious. It's just that in this current situation, we're like a clay Bodhisattva crossing the river—we can't even guarantee our own safety."
After saying this, he quickly shouted to Xiao Hua: "Xiao Hua, don't let him hold onto us! This is just adding extra burden to us out of nowhere! It's draining our stamina!"
Hearing this, Xiao Hua hesitated: "But if we don't let him hold on, he'll die!"
As the saying goes, adversity reveals true feelings—Xiao Peng and Xiao Hua who previously couldn't stand each other were now in a situation where Xiao Hua was actually worried about Xiao Peng's safety.
This was something Xiao Peng hadn't expected.
Hearing this, Xiao Hua's boyfriend anxiously tried to persuade her: "Xiao Hua, think carefully—how long can we hold out here? If we can't hold on anymore and drift down, we're definitely dead!"
"Have you considered that if someone crashes into the Cross-shaped Blade first! They would become a human cushion, and even if we fall down, the damage we take wouldn't be as severe!!!"
Xiao Hua was awakened by these words, but she still said: "We should still be able to hold on! We didn't come alone! There's still Wang Ju and the others! When they finish and find we haven't come out yet! They'll definitely come rescue us!"
Xiao Hua's boyfriend said anxiously: "But what if Wang Ju and the others have blades in their slide too, just like ours?!"
Xiao Hua fell silent.
Now, Xiao Peng who had been shaken off by Xiao Hua's boyfriend was grabbing onto Xiao Hua's two slender, jade-like legs.
Through the constantly trembling legs.
Xiao Peng knew that if he didn't let go, Xiao Hua definitely wouldn't be able to hold on for much longer.
After all, she was just a girl—she didn't have that much strength and couldn't bear the weight of two people.
So he looked downward and discovered there were three more handles below.
Gritting his teeth, he let go of Xiao Hua's legs.
He drifted down, dangerously and narrowly managing to grab one of the handles.
Like the two above, he was temporarily fixed in place within the slide.
Safe for now.
Xiao Peng breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, he looked forward.
At that Cross-shaped Blade, checking if there was enough space for a person to pass through.
But after looking carefully, he thought there wasn't.
The space was too small—only a child could get through.
"Xiao Q! Ke Bei! Come save me quickly!!!!!"
Xiao Peng cried, his eyes red, screaming inwardly.
...
Where were Xiao Q and Ke Bei?
Why was Xiao Peng the only one playing on the water slide?
This is what happened.
The three of them finished breakfast on the 10th floor in the morning, then went out to play.
At Xiao Peng's suggestion, the three went to the island's water park.
After playing several water attractions, Xiao Peng said he wanted to play on the water slide.
He asked if the other two wanted to go?
Both Xiao Q and the other shook their heads and refused.
Therefore, only Xiao Peng went alone.
And fortunately, only Xiao Peng went alone—otherwise, they might have been completely wiped out.
